Are you a problem solver? Can you help others identify their goals and get them from where they are to where they want to be? job.description:
Location: NY-Long Island

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Long Island Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

 

This position is 100% commission based. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience. 

  

Benefits for Full-Time roles include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner) 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options

Location: FL-Tampa

Job Title:  Engineering Manager - Tampa Radio

 

Position Overview

Tampa Radio is looking for a Manager of Engineering who will be responsible for executing all broadcast related engineering functions for Cox Media Group (CMG) radio stations in the local market. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, all radio frequency (RF) operations, broadcast and digital distribution systems, studio equipment, tower site operations, IP-based broadcast infrastructure, cybersecurity practices, backup and recovery, and security systems. Planning, execution, and timely completion of all projects, maintenance, upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization initiatives while ensuring compliance with all FCC, FAA, FEMA, OSHA, and company rules, regulations, and guidelines. Maintain, maximize, and service the station’s transmitter, studio, digital distribution, networking, and station facilities. Advise management in the long-range planning for the replacement, modernization, resilience, and secure operation of station equipment and systems. The Manager of Engineering is responsible for improving operational capabilities and supporting all revenue and audience-producing efforts. They will work closely with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, operations, and other departments in the maintenance and operation of their equipment and technical systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and support all broadcast equipment including transmission systems, transceivers, satellite receivers, and broadcast automation equipment for optimum performance 
  • Mange remote, on-location broadcast scheduling, site coordination, timely broadcast equipment setup and operation.  Safely store and maintain remote broadcast equipment 
  • Document equipment installation, wiring, maintenance, repair, and replacement 
  • Ensure that all projects are properly implemented and executed per agreed-upon schedule 
  • Work varied and extended hours may include some weekends, holidays, on-call, and required local travel for scheduled after-hours projects or when emergencies or failure of critical equipment occurs to the operation of the station 
  • Respond to equipment outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems at studio, transmitter, and translator locations 
  • Ensure operation and oversee maintenance of company vehicles with the safety of the operator, other personnel, and the public in mind, according to the guidelines of the station and CMG 
  • Update, improve and implement our business continuity plan and contribute as a member of our crisis management team 
  • Support IP-based broadcast infrastructure, including switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless systems, AoIP platforms, remote control systems, and monitoring tools
  • Support cybersecurity, patching, endpoint protection, access control, secure configuration, backup and recovery, and vulnerability remediation practices across critical technical systems
  • Plan and execute preventative maintenance, technology upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization projects that strengthen reliability, security, scalability, and operational resilience
  • Partner with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, and operations teams to understand business needs, solve technical problems, and deliver dependable service-oriented support

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, radio technical operations, media technology, IT infrastructure, or a related technical field.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio operations, automation, audio chains, remote control systems, and digital distribution workflows.
  • Hands-on experience supporting IP-connected infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, NTP, SNMP, and wireless systems.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals, patching, endpoint protection, backup and recovery, and secure system configuration.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly, especially during outages or time-sensitive station operations.
  • Strong communication, documentation, project management, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
  • Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to support station facilities, transmitter sites, and remote locations as needed.
  • Ability to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call support when critical systems require immediate response.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Society of Broadcast Engineers certification or relevant IT, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or vendor certifications.
  • Experience with radio automation, AoIP systems, HD Radio, high-powered AM/FM transmission, broadcast monitoring/control platforms, or remote broadcast technology.
  • Familiarity with virtualized or cloud-connected infrastructure, Windows Server, Active Directory/Azure, Linux, backup platforms, Fortinet, Cisco, Veeam, Wheatstone, WideOrbit, Burk, or comparable platforms.

Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Executive Business Partner - CMG

 

Position Overview

The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results.

 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support by serving as a highly organized coordinator, relationship builder, and problem solver who helps create structure, streamline processes, and improve efficiency across the executive's areas of responsibility. Success in this role requires sound judgment, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a commitment to excellence.

 

By anticipating needs, identifying risks and bottlenecks, and proactively driving follow-through, the Executive Business Partner helps maximize organizational effectiveness and the impact of executive leader(s) and their teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive Support & Coordination

  • Provides comprehensive support to executive and senior leaders, including complex calendar management, scheduling prioritization, meeting coordination, travel planning, expense reporting, and administrative support.
  • Proactively manages the executive’s time, energy and strategic priorities by identifying conflicts, anticipating emerging issues, preparing decision-ready materials, and ensuring leaders are well-prepared for meetings and positioned for effective decision making and execution.
  • Coordinates internal and external meetings, executive events, leadership forums, off-sites, and other business-related activities, including agendas, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
  • Maintains awareness of key business priorities, organizational developments, and leadership initiatives to help proactively coordinate activities; identify scheduling considerations, dependencies, risks, and opportunities; and items requiring executive attention.

 

Meeting & Communication Management

  • Develops meeting agendas, presentation materials, executive briefings, summaries, reports, and communications that support productive discussions and informed leadership conversations.
  • Coordinates follow-up communications, tracks action items, and maintains documentation of meeting outcomes and commitments to ensure accountability for critical deliverables.
  • Serves as a liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, maintaining professionalism, responsiveness, confidentiality, and discretion.

 

Project & Process Support

  • Supports special projects and business initiatives through organization, coordination, information gathering, documentation, and progress tracking.
  • Tracks key deliverables, deadlines, and commitments and follows up with stakeholders to support timely completion and clear accountability.
  • Creates and maintains project trackers, dashboards, templates, and other tools that support efficient execution and visibility.
  • Assists with coordination across departments, project teams, and executive support partners to promote alignment and effective communication.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Operational Excellence

  • Leverages technology and productivity tools, including AI-enabled solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, to streamline administrative and operational tasks.

Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Develop and coordinate enterprise AI adoption strategies in partnership with business leaders, AI champions, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches, and apply AI capabilities to solve practical business challenges and improve business outcomes.
  • Foster collaboration across teams pursuing AI initiatives to encourage knowledge sharing, consistency, and reuse of successful practices and solutions.
  • Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry practices, applying lessons learned and recommending improvements to adoption approaches, governance processes, and operating models.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify AI deployment and support processes.
  • Help business leaders successfully integrate AI into existing workflows and operating models.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (cont.)

AI Operations & Governance Coordination

  • Manage AI intake, evaluation, prioritization support, and execution tracking processes.
  • Support and coordinate governance reviews, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making activities in partnership with established governance bodies, business leaders, and AI stakeholders.
  • Support implementation of AI policies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Partner with Technology, Security, Legal, and HR stakeholders to ensure compliance with established governance frameworks.
  • Maintain AI operational documentation, reporting, and decision records.
  • Develop scalable operational processes that support long-term AI growth and enterprise adoption.
  • Ensure governance decisions are implemented consistently across AI initiatives

 

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with business AI leaders, champions, and stakeholders to support department-specific AI initiatives, share best practices, and accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Facilitate collaboration and build strong partnerships across business and technology teams to accelerate AI adoption and value realization.
  • Maintain consistent executive communication and reporting cadences.
  • Manage operational relationships with AI vendors, consultants, implementation partners, and service providers.
  • Support evaluation and implementation planning for new AI solutions and capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
  • An equivalent combination of education, professional experience, certifications, and demonstrated success leading technology transformation, AI adoption, operational excellence, automation, and organizational change will be considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant work in technology, AI adoption, operational leadership, change management, enterprise program execution, business operations, or related disciplines.

  • Building executive reporting, KPI frameworks, operational dashboards, and business performance metrics.
  • Measuring AI utilization, productivity gains, business impact, and value realization.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Data Journalism department seeks an experienced journalist with programming and data analysis skills to be based in Texas and work in close collaboration with Times reporters across the Lone Star State.

You'll combine traditional reporting with data collection and analysis to shed light on major storylines. You'll demonstrate a strong command of key Texas datasets. You'll have excellent data analysis skills, with the news judgment to match, and can design rigorous methodologies, bulletproofing your analyses and handling thorny data issues.

Collaboration is at the heart of this role; you'll pair up with other reporters on virtually every story you pursue. You'll also help these colleagues to level-up their own data skills. And you'll be excited, in turn, about learning from them.

This role requires you to be based in Texas. Although The Times does not yet have an office in the state, this position may later involve regular office attendance if The Times establishes an office in the city where you are based. You will report to the Data Editor, who is based in New York City.

Important application requirement: Please submit a cover letter that highlights three relevant stories to which you made substantial contributions. For each story, please provide a link to the story and describe your contribution in one to three paragraphs. Aim to demonstrate a range of skills and variety of deadlines. Your cover letter should be no more than three pages long in total. In it, you are also welcome to provide a more traditional (but brief) description of your career and talents.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Data Journalism department's Texas-focused reporting collaborations
  • Pitch and report data-driven stories that illuminate the day's news events, explain difficult concepts and investigate wrongdoing
  • Obtain and build datasets through records requests, web scraping, document parsing and shoe-leather approaches
  • Develop an understanding of these datasets, enabling you to mine them for reporting leads, meaningful insights, and newsworthy findings
  • Be comfortable working on stories both independently and in diverse teams
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • You will report to the Data Editor

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of data journalism experience
  • Deep knowledge of Texas
  • Experience finding, requesting, cleaning and analyzing complex datasets
  • Ability to communicate data findings powerfully, accurately, and succinctly
  • Proficiency working with data in Python and/or R, spreadsheets, and relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Substantial track record reporting on Texas
  • Spanish language proficiency
  • Experience with, and a preference for, working collaboratively on multidisciplinary teams
  • Experience reporting in response to major news cycles
  • Comfort with command-line tooling, version control, working with large language models, and other important technical skills

job.title: Graphics/Multimedia Editor, Elections Data Developer (Election Analytics)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Election Analytics team produces flagship, standard-setting elections coverage, including the live, election night statistical model known as the Needle and The New York Times/Siena Poll. The department is looking to hire an experienced data developer to contribute to data creation, management and architecture across our products.

Underneath our poll and the Needle are massive amounts of data. This includes the voter file, as well as demographics for different localities, hundreds of scrapers collecting precinct data and countless pipelines for processing and cleaning data. Our understanding of the electorate is only as good as the data we have access to, including the data we create to test our systems and the election night model itself.

You will have a central role in creating and cleaning these data sources for use in our products. You will help knit together data from different sections of the team to build our understanding of what may happen on election night throughout the year. And you will ensure we have proper observability into how data is being used.

Election Analytics is a multidisciplinary team of reporters, developers, statisticians and modelers who work on written coverage, graphics, our polls and the election-night model. This is a highly collaborative role that will involve working with colleagues from Election Analytics, the Graphics department and Interactive News.

The goal is to help our audience understand the world through powerful video stories, reaching our core audience as well as new viewers who increasingly consume journalism in video. You should have a refined understanding of video production and storytelling, including video editing, shooting and writing for narration, with a clear sense for how to creatively use graphics and animation to illustrate complex ideas. 

Your news judgement about what makes a good story in video will be crucial, as will creative ideas for how to reenvision the basic elements of foreign correspondence, across news, features and analysis. You must be an effective collaborator and a strong communicator who can work closely with regional editors and video colleagues to shape our approach to this coverage.

This position is based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.

  • Collaborate closely with International editors, correspondents and video colleagues.

Job Title:  Sr Mgr, Social Media Audience Growth

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager of Social Media and Audience Growth. This role is responsible for helping shape and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy.

 

This role drives audience growth, engagement, content distribution, platform innovation, and monetization opportunities across all major social platforms. It will establish enterprise-wide social media standards, identify emerging opportunities, analyze performance trends, and partner with local stations to maximize the impact and reach of CMG journalism across social platforms.

 

This role will work closely with CMG Content Leaders, News Directors, Digital Leaders, Marketing Teams, Sales, and on-air talent to ensure social media supports CMG’s broader audience and content distribution strategy while building audience loyalty and expanding reach.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent audience growth across CMG social platforms
  • Increased engagement, referral traffic, and loyalty across key social platforms
  • Strong and consistent execution of social best practices across the company
  • Growth of platform-native, original, vertical, and video content
  • Growth of sustainable social revenue and partnership opportunities
  • Stronger integration of social media into daily newsroom and digital workflows
  • Expanded reach and visibility of CMG journalism and journalists
  • Successful adoption of emerging platforms, formats, and technologies
  • Increased use of data and audience insights to drive social decision-making

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Social Media & Audience Growth

  • Helps develop and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Serves as a subject-matter expert on social platforms, audience behavior, content distribution, and emerging trends
  • Establishes platform standards and best practices
  • Drives audience growth, engagement, and referral traffic
  • Leads innovation in vertical video, platform distribution, and emerging channels
  • Identifies external partnerships and opportunities that could enhance CMG’s social strategy, audience reach, and business objectives

Social Media Strategy & Leadership

  • Provides social platform expertise, audience insights, and recommendations to help shape and continuously refine CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Establishes platform-specific standards, best practices, and publishing guidelines
  • Partners with station leadership to align social efforts with audience, content, and business objectives
  • Identifies emerging platforms, technologies, and audience opportunities

Audience Growth & Engagement

  • Drives measurable audience growth and engagement across social platforms
  • Develops strategies that increase referral traffic and platform loyalty
  • Analyzes audience behavior and engagement patterns
  • Establishes performance benchmarks, key performance indicators, and growth goals
  • Identifies opportunities to reach new audiences and expand the reach of CMG journalism
  • Uses data and audience insights to continuously refine content and distribution strategies

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Content Distribution & Platform Optimization

  • Leads social distribution strategies for breaking news, weather, investigations, community coverage, major events, and other high-impact journalism
  • Creates frameworks that help stations maximize the value and reach of content across platforms
  • Develops best practices for audience engagement, including vertical video, platform-native storytelling, and social-first content
  • Partners with newsroom and digital leaders to integrate social strategy into daily editorial workflows
  • Ensures social content remains aligned with CMG editorial standards

Analytics, Revenue & Innovation

  • Analyzes performance metrics, trends, and audience insights
  • Identifies growth opportunities across social platforms
  • Evaluates platform changes, emerging technologies, and distribution opportunities
  • Leads testing and pilot programs for new social products and initiatives
  • Shares learnings, successful strategies, and best practices across CMG markets

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in social media strategy, digital audience development, or digital content distribution, preferably within a media, news, or content organization
  • Proven track record of driving measurable social media growth and high-performing content
  • Strong editorial judgment and understanding of news values, journalism, and digital storytelling
  • Experience creating and optimizing short-form vertical video content and platform-native content strategies
  • Proven ability to use data and analytics to develop strategy, identify opportunities, and measure performance
  • Demonstrated ability to work across teams, influence stakeholders, and drive adoption of enterprise initiatives
  • Deep expertise in Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform algorithms, audience behavior, analytics, trends, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of digital audience development, content distribution, referral strategy, and platform-native storytelling
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly changing digital media environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading social media or audience strategy for a multi-market media organization
  • Experience with social media analytics, monetization, audience measurement, social listening, and publishing tools
  • Background in video editing and mobile-first production workflows
  • Experience launching or testing new platforms, products, content formats, or audience-growth initiatives
  • Understanding of SEO, referral traffic, digital analytics, and broader audience-development strategies

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. The Senior Engineer, Cybersecurity is a hands-on contributor who designs, builds, and operates security controls and services that protect The Times' systems, data, and users. As a member of the Security Architecture team, you will own complex initiatives end-to-end, drive measurable risk reduction, and collaborate across product engineering and enterprise technology with technical depth, operational rigor, and clear communication aligned with business outcomes.

Who are we?

Cybersecurity helps prevent The Times from becoming news. Our teams work to protect the news makers, their support staff, the platforms they rely on every day, as well as all of The Times' products and services, and our readers who consume them.

This role reports to the Director of Engineering, Cybersecurity.

  • Create an environment that favors context, not control. Empower product engineers and ensure they have the relevant information and tools to deliver secure products and services.

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering and security engineering space.

Job Title:  Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV, a Cox Media Group (CMG) station in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced, highly motivated I.T. Manager. Operating in the nation’s 26th largest television market, this hands-on leadership role manages the station's entire computing environment, localized server architecture, high-security network perimeters, and integrated broadcast-I.T. ecosystems.

 

The I.T. Manager ensures 24/7/365 operational continuity for our live news, production, and multi-platform digital channels. The ideal candidate will blend advanced systems administration with deep technical knowledge of specialized, automated broadcast television environments. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering and works in tandem with the station's local engineering team and CMG corporate technology group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Broadcast-I.T. Integration & Support: Maintain high-level technical oversight, provisioning, and daily troubleshooting for mission-critical newsroom and automation systems including Avid, iNews, Grass Valley Ignite, Harmonic, Crispin, Chyron, and Wide Orbit.
  • Infrastructure & Storage Management: Administer and optimize local storage and server environments, directly overseeing the station’s virtualized server platforms (VMware/Hyper-V) and high-capacity NetApp network-attached storage (NAS/SAN) infrastructure.
  • Network & Security Enforcement: Serve as the local gatekeeper for network security. Manage, patch, and monitor the station's Fortinet infrastructure (firewalls, switches, and secure access points), ensuring strict adherence to CMG corporate cybersecurity mandates.
  • Systems & Automation Administration: Direct the optimization of Microsoft enterprise environments, Active Directory, endpoint systems, and localized automated script pipelines to minimize operational overhead and drive reliability.
  • User Support Leadership: Manage the local help desk workflow, ensuring high-priority, zero-downtime technical support for live control rooms, field news crews, digital production teams, sales, and administrative staff.
  • Disaster Recovery & Redundancy: Formulate, test, and manage strict local business continuity blueprints, ensuring off-site cloud backups and local hardware redundancies preserve the on-air and digital stream integrity during critical weather or emergency events.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent combined professional experience.
  •  5+ years of experience in systems administration, network engineering, or I.T. infrastructure management, with a proven track record working inside a high-pressure, live broadcast television or multi-platform media environment.
  • Technical Proficiencies:
    • Advanced administration of Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and desktop operating systems.
    • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware Horizon/vSphere) and enterprise storage management (NetApp solutions).
    • Profound understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, routing protocols, and QoS settings for media over IP).
  • Must be willing to participate in an on-call emergency rotation encompassing nights, weekends, and holiday coverage to support a continuous news cycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Security & Networking Certifications: Active certifications in corporate networking and perimeter protection (e.g., Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert).
  • Industry Accreditations: Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) certifications—specifically the Certified Broadcast Networking Engineer (CBNE) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT)—are highly valued.

You will lead a global team of price reporters and editors responsible for market coverage across key chemical value chains - including aromatics, olefins, plastics, polymers, syngas, methanol, feedstocks, and emerging chemical markets.

About the Role:

 As Principal - Finance Operations, you will transform Technology Finance Operations from a manual, spreadsheet-driven function into an AI-enabled, systems-oriented operating model that delivers greater speed, transparency, and operational leverage. 

You will own the business and financial operating cadence for Technology Operations while helping redesign how planning, governance, and execution works across both capital and operating investments. You will lead the redesign of the FY28 budget process, modernizing how Product, Engineering, and Design triads operate alongside PMO partners, business stakeholders and executives, and build scalable operating systems that allow Technology to accelerate with precision and accountability. 

This is a rare opportunity to build an operating model rather than inherit one. You will help shape how Technology plans investments, governs execution, and measures performance across a $300M+ portfolio while partnering directly with senior Technology and Finance leadership. 

You will report to the Vice President - Head of Financial Operations. 

About the Team:

Technology Operations is in the middle of a significant operating-model transformation: shifting from initiative tracking to OKR-driven governance, driving a vendor-partnered efficiency transformation, consolidating location strategy around strategic hubs, and redesigning processes with automation and AI-enabled capabilities at the core. Business Operations helps translate these strategic priorities into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Market Data
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Market Data, you will own the design strategy for our Market Data platform—the real-time quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, and visualization systems that power how millions of people read and act on financial markets across The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets direction across our financial brands and is the go-to design expert for how Dow Jones presents market data.

Market Data connects across every one of our financial brands, and this role sets the design strategy that spans all of them. Your decisions will establish shared patterns—for quotes, charts, tables, portfolios, and alerts—that these brands build on. You will own the direction for how investors of every kind, from first-time savers to sophisticated professionals, interpret dense, fast-moving data and turn it into confident decisions, balancing the distinct needs of each brand against the consistency and quality users expect wherever they encounter our data.

And this reach won't stop at the consumer. Market and pricing data runs across much of Dow Jones—so your influence will extend well beyond the consumer brands into our professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance to Dow Jones Energy, wherever market data underpins the experience. Where data meets the broader product, you will be the design lead who makes it cohere.

This is a role of real influence and scope. You will shape strategy with senior leadership, resolve tension between individual brand priorities and platform consistency, define the market-data patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across the financial brands. You will be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others in your area build on.

You will report to the VP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

About the Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for the Market Data platform across our financial brands—setting a coherent, multi-year direction for quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, portfolios, and data visualization that spans The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD, and connecting it to measurable outcomes like engagement, retention, and revenue

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your design direction for the Market Data platform to senior design, product, and business leaders—and to executives where the work warrants—building the partnerships that advance it across brands and making the case for how well-designed data experiences create competitive advantage

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain—developing new patterns, methods, and approaches for presenting complex financial information across multiple brands, and building a deep understanding of the problem space that lets you see opportunities ahead

  • Shape the market-data patterns in our Index Design System. Establish the charting, data-table, real-time, and visualization standards that become the norm across the financial brands—knowing when consistency serves the user and when a brand's audience warrants a tailored approach—and help adjacent teams adopt and evolve them

  • Extend your influence beyond our consumer brands into the wider portfolio—the professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Risk & Compliance to Newswires and OPIS, where market and pricing data is just as central—so the experiences built on our data share the same clarity, rigor, and craft. Be the design lead wherever data shapes the product

  • Set a high bar for craft. Define what excellence looks like for dense, real-time financial information—typography, information density, motion, and the accessibility of complex tables and charts—and ensure consistent quality across the brands through design reviews and audits

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and subscription metrics, and help teams across the financial brands understand which measures matter for market-data experiences

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across the financial brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or brands

  • Deep expertise designing data-rich experiences—financial data, analytics, dashboards, data visualization, or other complex information display—where clarity, density, and trust matter as much as visual polish

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or brands: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Mastery of data visualization and information design—charting, tables, real-time data, progressive disclosure—and the judgment to know when complexity serves the user and when it gets in the way

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility standards (WCAG), with particular fluency in making dense, complex data usable for everyone

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity—setting direction in your domain amid shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, related field -OR- equivalent experience 

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for financial services, investing, trading, or fintech products

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data systems and the constraints they place on design

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing meaningfully to a design system

WSOC-TV Charlotte is looking for an enterprising and energetic Anchor/Reporter. They must also be adept at using social media to gather and break stories. This position requires a newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility and strong storytelling

  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA Degree in Journalism, Communications, or other discipline preferred
  • 5 years’ experience as a Reporter required; anchoring experience strongly preferred

It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is looking for a Senior Video Editor who can help bring our shows portfolio to mobile, social and digital audiences through horizontal video podcasts and vertical video clips.

This is a post-production position to manage the editing of individual shows as well as clips. You have a refined understanding of editing techniques in multi-camera environments, a meticulous attention to detail, and are adept at working on complex edits autonomously and under deadline. You have an in-depth knowledge of Adobe systems.

You will work with producers, editors, journalists and other internal and external collaborators to lead the edit and publication of the Shows department's work. This role is for someone with a deep understanding of social video trends who takes an innovative and adaptive approach to video formats and techniques.

You will report to the the Post Production Supervisor.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

  • Edit and color-correct Newsroom podcasts across our entire show portfolio, delivering content in both short-form vertical and long-form horizontal format
  • Deliver top-notch product under intense deadline pressure, and without the need for direct supervision, continuous editorial guidance, or task management

  • Edit creatively both for full-length videos and video clips, and in coordination with an audio edit

  • Perform related work as assigned

job.title: Assistant Editor, Visuals
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

We’re looking for a senior editor to lead our visual journalism across Asia, driving the execution of new forms of storytelling and overseeing a team of graphics and multimedia journalists. This role is based in the Times’ Seoul newsroom. 

Visual journalists at The Times have investigated how China built a great wall of villages along its frontier and strong-armed its way into dominating the South China Sea, documented the Myanmar military’s campaign of terror against its own people and Taliban rule in Afghanistan, and reconstructed South Korean president’s botched martial law bid. They have revealed how drones have transformed the war in Ukraine. They have also devised ambitious multimedia approaches to explain the far-reaching impact of the Iran war, air pollution in India and American households’ reliance on Chinese goods.

We want to do more of these kinds of stories. And we want to continue to transform how we work to bring visual reporting and editing into the core of how we show readers the world and hold power accountable. We will do this through compelling graphical explanations; urgent, immersive field reporting in photography and video; sharp visual news coverage; and investigations driven by deep reporting on imagery and data.

This role reports to the assistant international editor for visuals in New York and collaborates with the Asia editor to help drive coverage of Asia. You will work closely with the lead video producer and photo editor in Seoul, the senior editor for visuals in London, and counterparts in photo, video, graphics and news design.

This is an in-office position based in Seoul,  and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Main responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with international editors to drive visual coverage of Asia. 
  • Coordinate, lead and edit the work of correspondents and visual journalists on visual stories.
  • Serve as the leader of a small group of graphics/multimedia reporters focused on Asia, helping to create, design and edit multimedia coverage. 
  • In collaboration with the deputy International editor for visuals, plan and execute stories that use data analysis and visualization, photography, imagery analysis, open source investigation and other reporting techniques.
  • Work with desk leaders to shape and execute our broader editorial strategy for visual journalism, including how we should work with partners in photo, video, graphics and news design.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the assistant international editor for visuals.

Basic qualifications:

  • Strong news judgment.
  • Ability to identify and conceive ambitious stories, spot visual opportunities in reporting and develop them into a range of compelling visual forms.
  • Skill pulling multiple visual disciplines together into multimedia projects, with an emphasis on visualization, explanatory visuals, digital design, use of video and other visual forms. 
  • A record of clear communication and strong collaboration with colleagues.
  • The ability to write clearly, work on tight deadlines and edit to sharpen the relationship between visuals and copy.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams to create ambitious multimedia news stories, including interactive visuals, and help them develop as journalists. . 
  • Strong portfolio in one or more of these areas: data visualization, mapping, explanatory writing, news illustration, digital design, interactive development and explanatory multimedia or video.

job.title: Analytics Engineer
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

The role

The Analytics Engineer is responsible for bridging the gap between data engineering and data analytics by maintaining and developing scalable data models and solutions that support finance, B2B, and B2C teams. The role plays a key part in delivering value through modern data stack technologies (including dbt), supporting cloud migration efforts, ensuring data quality, and maintaining the performance of analytical data pipelines.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to design and implement robust data models and BI solutions.
  • Build, test, and maintain data transformations using dbt (data build tool).

job.title: Engineering Lead – ERP Services
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

About you

You are an experienced engineering leader with strong knowledge of ERP or similarly complex enterprise platforms and a track record of leading teams responsible for business-critical technology.

You combine people leadership with credible technical judgement. You are comfortable setting direction, making engineering decisions and working with your team on complex technical problems, while creating the ownership and autonomy for engineers to succeed.

You understand that enterprise platform engineering goes beyond implementing configuration or coordinating vendors. You think about the entire technology capability: the core platform, integrations, data flows, extensions, operational processes, security, resilience and how the platform evolves over time.

You are comfortable working closely with Finance and other business stakeholders, translating priorities and requirements into sustainable technology solutions and constructively challenging approaches that create unnecessary complexity or risk.

You are also interested in building capability. You can identify gaps in skills and knowledge, develop engineers and create a team that understands and genuinely owns its technology rather than relying disproportionately on individual specialists or external partners.

About the team

ERP Services sits within Corporate Technology, part of Internal Products, and owns the engineering capabilities supporting critical Finance and enterprise business processes across the FT.

The team is responsible for the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of our ERP technology estate, including Oracle Fusion and the integrations, data flows and supporting capabilities that connect it to the wider FT technology landscape.

ERP Services works closely with Finance, Product, Architecture, Integration & Engineering Services, Security and other Corporate Technology teams to ensure these critical enterprise capabilities remain reliable and can evolve as the needs of the organisation change.

We are strengthening the engineering leadership and platform expertise within ERP Services as part of a wider evolution of the Corporate Technology operating model. The Engineering Lead will establish clear platform and team ownership, reporting to the Principal Engineer – Corporate Technology.

What you’ll work on

As Engineering Lead – ERP Services, you will own the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of the FT’s ERP technology capability.

You will lead the ERP engineering team, providing people leadership, technical direction and clear accountability for the health and performance of the platforms and services the team owns.

A key part of the role will be strengthening our internal ERP engineering capability. You will develop the technical knowledge of the team, establish clear ownership of platforms and services and ensure we have the skills and understanding required to operate and evolve our ERP estate effectively.

You will work closely with Product and Finance stakeholders to understand business priorities and translate them into engineering plans, balancing new capabilities and business change with platform health, technical debt and operational investment.

You will also work with the Principal Engineer and Architecture to ensure decisions within ERP Services support the longer-term direction of Corporate Technology and the wider FT technology estate.

Your responsibilities will include

Engineering & Platform Ownership

  • Owning the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of the ERP technology capability.
  • Providing clear technical direction for the platforms, integrations and supporting services owned by ERP Services.
  • Ensuring ERP platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, maintainable and appropriately supported.
  • Establishing clear ownership across the team for systems, integrations and technical capabilities.
  • Ensuring engineering decisions consider reliability, security, operability, maintainability, cost and long-term sustainability.
  • Maintaining visibility of platform health, technical debt, lifecycle risks and significant dependencies.
  • Working with the Principal Engineer and Architecture on material technical decisions and longer-term platform direction.
  • Ensuring the team maintains sufficient technical understanding of its platforms to make informed decisions and challenge external recommendations.

People & Engineering Leadership

  • Leading, supporting and developing the engineers within ERP Services.
  • Setting clear expectations and providing regular coaching, feedback and career development.
  • Building a team culture based on ownership, accountability, collaboration and constructive technical challenge.
  • Developing ERP and enterprise platform expertise across the team rather than allowing critical knowledge to remain concentrated in individuals.
  • Identifying capability and skills gaps and developing plans to address them through development, recruitment or appropriate external expertise.
  • Creating opportunities for engineers to take greater technical ownership and develop their leadership capability.
  • Supporting recruitment and building a resilient team with the skills required for the future ERP technology landscape.
  • Ensuring appropriate succession and knowledge sharing across critical areas.

Delivery & Planning

  • Working with Product to translate business priorities and technology strategy into clear engineering plans and deliverable outcomes.
  • Owning engineering planning and resource allocation within ERP Services.
  • Ensuring engineering capacity appropriately balances business change, platform improvement, operational work and technical debt.
  • Identifying technical dependencies, risks and constraints early and ensuring these are visible in planning and prioritisation.
  • Ensuring delivery commitments are realistic and supported by appropriate technical understanding.
  • Working across teams where initiatives involve multiple platforms, integrations or engineering capabilities.
  • Providing clear visibility of engineering progress, risks and trade-offs to Product, technology leadership and relevant stakeholders.

ERP Platform Evolution

  • Developing a clear understanding of the current ERP estate and identifying opportunities to simplify, modernise and improve it.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and the Principal Engineer to shape the longer-term evolution of ERP technology.
  • Evaluating platform capabilities and determining when requirements should be addressed through standard functionality, configuration, integration or other engineering approaches.
  • Challenging unnecessary customisation and complexity where more sustainable solutions are available.
  • Ensuring platform upgrades, new capabilities and significant changes are introduced safely and sustainably.
  • Understanding vendor roadmaps and assessing their implications for the FT's technology direction and investment decisions.
  • Ensuring technical debt and lifecycle concerns are actively managed rather than accumulating through incremental business change.

Integration & Enterprise Technology

  • Ensuring the team understands and owns the integrations and data flows connecting ERP with the wider FT technology estate.
  • Working closely with Integration & Engineering Services and other platform teams to establish clear ownership of cross-system capabilities.
  • Ensuring integrations follow appropriate FT engineering and architectural standards.
  • Identifying opportunities to simplify interfaces, reduce duplication and improve reliability.
  • Supporting technical decisions that span ERP, Tax, People and other Corporate Technology capabilities.
  • Ensuring changes within ERP appropriately consider downstream and upstream impacts.

Operational Excellence & Risk

  • Owning the operational performance of ERP Services and ensuring critical services are appropriately monitored and supported.
  • Establishing effective approaches to observability, incident management, problem management, change management and operational readiness.
  • Ensuring recurring incidents and operational problems are investigated to their underlying causes and addressed sustainably.
  • Maintaining appropriate approaches to resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Ensuring relevant security, data governance, compliance and technology standards are met.
  • Maintaining visibility of material operational and technical risks and ensuring appropriate mitigation plans are in place.
  • Using operational insight to inform engineering priorities and platform investment.

Vendors & Technology Partners

  • Managing the technical relationship with ERP vendors, implementation partners and specialist service providers.
  • Ensuring external partners are used effectively while maintaining clear internal engineering ownership.
  • Providing informed technical challenge to vendor recommendations and proposed solutions.
  • Ensuring externally delivered work meets FT engineering, security and operational expectations.
  • Building internal knowledge from vendor and partner engagements rather than allowing expertise to remain externally concentrated.
  • Contributing technical input to vendor performance, technology selection and investment decisions.

Stakeholder & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Building strong working relationships with Product, Finance and other business stakeholders.
  • Translating business requirements and priorities into clear engineering implications, options and trade-offs.
  • Helping stakeholders understand platform constraints, technical risks and investment requirements.
  • Partnering with the Principal Engineer, Architecture, Security and other engineering leaders on decisions that cross platform or organisational boundaries.
  • Working constructively with specialist engineers, including Tax and Compliance engineering, on shared capabilities and dependencies.
  • Representing ERP Services in relevant engineering and technology forums.
Technical and leadership experience we’re looking for
  • Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex, business-critical enterprise technology.
  • Strong experience with ERP platforms or similarly complex enterprise SaaS ecosystems.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion or comparable enterprise ERP platforms would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience providing both people leadership and technical leadership to engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise platform engineering, including integrations, APIs, data flows and system dependencies.
  • Experience owning technology through its full lifecycle, from change and delivery through to production operation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience developing engineering capability and strengthening technical ownership within teams.
  • Experience working with Finance or other complex enterprise business domains.
  • Strong understanding of reliability, security, observability, operational risk and technology lifecycle management.
  • Experience translating business priorities into engineering plans and balancing feature delivery with platform health and technical investment.
  • Experience leading technical decisions involving enterprise SaaS platforms, integrations and supporting services.
  • Experience working with vendors, implementation partners and managed service providers while maintaining internal technical ownership.
  • Experience identifying and addressing technical debt, platform lifecycle concerns and key-person dependencies.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical considerations and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working effectively with Principal Engineers, architects, Product Managers and other engineering leaders.
  • Experience of major ERP transformation, implementation or modernisation would be advantageous.
Characteristics we value
  • Strong engineering judgement and a willingness to remain close to the technology.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for both the team and the platforms it operates.
  • The ability to develop people while setting clear expectations for engineering quality and delivery.
  • Pragmatism when balancing business priorities, technical quality and operational risk.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to develop deep understanding of complex enterprise technology.
  • Confidence challenging vendors, stakeholders and technical colleagues constructively.
  • An instinct for building capability and distributing knowledge rather than becoming the person who owns every technical answer.
  • A collaborative approach to working across Product, business and technology teams.
  • A focus on addressing underlying problems rather than repeatedly managing symptoms.
  • An appreciation for simplicity, resilience and long-term platform sustainability.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community.
