job.title: Senior Digital Designer
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design how Semafor's journalism is presented across digital products, bringing rigorous typography, clear information hierarchy, and strong editorial layout to every story, newsletter, and feature.
  • Work with Product and Editorial to envision and design new news products and formats, exploring multiple visual and structural approaches while keeping readability and usability top of mind.
  • Partner closely with Editorial, Product, and Engineering to design and launch elegant, technically feasible solutions, from story templates to special editorial packages.
  • Hold a high bar for the Semafor reading experience, ensuring our products feel cohesive, considered, and unmistakably ours.
  • Own and evolve typographic standards within Semafor's design system and brand guidelines; ensure visual consistency across platforms and teams globally.
  • Support Marketing and Audience teams in creating brand materials that align with Semafor's digital products.
  • Collaborate with freelancers and other designers, offering critique and feedback that keeps design output consistently high quality.
  • Help build a collaborative, productive design culture as a member of Semafor's design team.
  • Bring a strong point of view on how other news and media brands design for readers: what they do well, where they fall short, and how Semafor can break through.

What Makes You Qualified

  • 5+ years of digital and visual design experience, ideally in media, publishing, or high-growth consumer companies.
  • Sophisticated design sensibilities, with deep command of typography, information hierarchy, grid, and layout.
  • Editorial design experience: you know how to make complex information clear, scannable, and compelling for readers.
  • A portfolio that shows typographic and editorial work alongside shipped digital products.
  • Ability to produce high-quality, production-ready designs with a high degree of independence.
  • Solid grounding in product and interaction design for web and mobile.
  • Experience working with, and ideally developing, design systems.
  • Enthusiasm for collaborating with engineers, editors, product managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working on diverse teams with colleagues from many different backgrounds.
  • Comfort incorporating AI tools into your workflow while holding a strong point of view on craft and quality.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-moving environment, with flexibility and a willingness to jump in wherever needed.
  • An entrepreneurial drive and an eagerness to learn and grow as the company scales.
  • Passion for the media industry and great journalism.
  • Willingness to work in person four days per week in New York and to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

The base salary for this position ranges from $130,000 - $170,000 per year. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

Additional Job Details:

This position is based in our New York City office with a hybrid work arrangement (in-office Monday-Thursday, remote Friday).  Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Intern Strategic Corporate & Transaction Communication
job.description:
Intern Strategic Corporate & Transaction Communication

FGS Global helps the world's most influential leaders move minds and markets. Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments. 

We work as one team across geographies and disciplines - bringing together specialists with backgrounds in communications, finance, law, government, journalism, data science, and digital. Whatever the moment demands, we combine multidimensional perspectives to help leaders anticipate what's next, engage the stakeholders who matter, and drive meaningful outcomes.

Across 31 global offices, we draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust. This collaborative approach has established FGS as a market leader: we are consistently ranked Band 1 for Crisis & Risk Management and Litigation Support by Chambers and Partners, and were ranked the #1 Global M&A PR firm by deal value and deal count for four consecutive years (Mergermarket, 2025).

 

Join our team in Amsterdam as Intern Strategic Corporate & Transaction Communication starting February 1st 2027.

 

What tasks can you look forward to?

  • As an intern, you will be part of the team from day one and experience everyday life as a communications consultant at first hand.
  • You will support the project teams in the development and implementation of communication strategies for national and international clients in matters of strategic corporate communication and positioning.
  • The topics range from M&A transactions, IPOs and strategic realignments to the communication of digitalization and transformation strategies.
  • Together with our team, you will design compelling communications materials for internal and external stakeholders (e.g., communications plans, press releases, corporate presentations).
  • You follow, monitor and understand Dutch and European media.
  • You help with ad-hoc requests and questions from other offices about the media, economy, and society in the Netherlands.
  • For research and analysis, you will dig deep into relevant topics, exciting companies, media coverage and trends.
  • You bring in fresh, inspiring ideas and innovative communications formats.

 

What should you bring along?

  • You are at the end of your undergraduate or master's degree - the subject is less important than your enthusiasm for communication.
  • Ideally, you have already gained practical experience during your studies, for example in communications, finance, journalism, politics and/or strategy consulting.
  • You are a quick learner and it is recommended that you communicate fluently in Dutch and very well in English.
  • You have a good understanding of the Dutch media landscape.
  • You love variety and new challenges and really thrive when working in a team.

 

What we can offer you

  • The opportunity to get to know strategic communications consulting
  • Insights into the activities of a leading strategic communications consultancy as well as into various industries and areas of expertise as part of our integrated project teams
  • Exciting and varied tasks in an international and inspiring working environment
  • The opportunity to benefit from training & development opportunities
  • Induction and individual support as well as detailed feedback from an experienced consultant
  • A committed, collegial and constantly growing team in which mutual appreciation and team spirit are paramount
  • A company culture that combines excellence with team spirit
  • The opportunity to work flexibly both in our offices and from home
  • Our beautiful office in the heart of Amsterdam- Zuid

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? Please don’t worry! Studies have shown that some groups like women or people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. At FGS Global, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. So, if you’re excited about this role and our company but your previous professional experience doesn’t match perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we would like to encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or another role.

We look forward to your complete application (incl. all relevant academic and professional certificates and/or reference letters). Feel free to contact us by email via careers-eu@fgsglobal.com.

 More information: FGS Global

job.title: ESPN Cleveland Spring 2027 Internship
job.description:
ESPN Cleveland Spring 2027 Internship 

(Cleveland, OH) 

Good Karma Sports & ESPN Cleveland are currently recruiting college students for the Spring 2027 Semester. This is a part-time paid internship that will provide an excellent opportunity for students to learn more about sport marketing and media.

The ideal candidate will be an organized self-starter who is interested in hands-on experience in the areas of new business development, promotional event marketing, and sports content creation.

Daily Responsibilities of an Intern: 

  • Take initiative to learn all aspects of the business, ideally becoming competent in marketing execution, the Good Karma Sports partner acquisition process and Good Karma’s content creation strategies and best practices 
  • Assist with event planning, set-up and execution and event breakdown 
  • Engage and interact with local partners and fans during events 
  • Other assigned tasks 
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the Good Karma core values: Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Listen, Teamwork and Follow Through. 

Hours and Pay 

This internship is approximately 20-30 hours/week from late January to April/May 2027. Interns are paid $11.00 an hour and will gain experience in marketing, sales, and content. 

Opportunity for Growth 

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company. 

How to Apply 

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 29, 2026. All are encouraged to apply. 

About Good Karma Sports 

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all. We foster integrity and respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought. job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
Account Manager

#26-1351

Washington, District Of Columbia, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WTOP-AM/FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard DC, which includes WTOP, Federal News Network and 2060 Digital, is committed to reporting relevant news for our region. Through continuously evolving brands, we connect consumers with advertisers across a growing number of distribution platforms including radio, podcasts, social media, and websites. We do this with a commitment to our community...while growing our people and profits.

OUR VISION

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

OUR MISSION

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Account Manager is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Job Responsibilities

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Make presentations to include a customer needs analysis, research and supporting documentation, and creative business solutions.

Follow up and close all pending business in a timely manner.

Update Sales Manager weekly on progress of pending business.

Work closely with other departments in creating effective promotional sales solutions for clients.

Create and make presentations to agency personnel, including selling and pre-selling the station audience attributes.

Provide exceptional customer service to direct and agency accounts. Personally contact each active account regularly- defined as an in-person meeting, including the presentation of pertinent sales information.

Obtain credit approval for new accounts.

Ensure all accounts are paid in a timely manner. Follow up and assist in the collection process for past due accounts.

Utilization of and proficiency with Sales software.

Attend special events, such as remotes and broadcasts, which involve clients. These events may occur after business hours and on weekends.

Complete all written business requirements within established deadlines. These requirements include but are not limited to: forecast reports, pending business updates, written orders and advertising copy.

Attend and participate in weekly sales staff meetings, individual meetings with manager and other necessary meetings and training as required by management.

Have a thorough understanding of rates, promotions, inventory, and personnel. Continue to learn and stay abreast of trends in digital and broadcast advertising industry.

Maintain regular, reliable attendance.

Work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the general public.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous sales, advertising, digital sales, or media experience preferred (required).

Knowledge of, and familiarity with, (or ability to learn) broadcasting and digital terminology and methodology preferred.

Ability to understand the features and benefits of advertising and competitive media.

Familiarity with Microsoft Word for Windows; sales software knowledge helpful.

Excellent written and oral English language communication skills.

Experience developing presentations for the purpose of direct-business selling and ability to effectively present and communicate.

Ability to respond to questions appropriately and think on feet.

Establish and maintain customer relationships; communicate effectively with a wide range of personalities in a professional and courteous manner.

High level of initiative and ability to work independently required.

Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license and a safe driving history as determined by the Company for the purpose of meeting clients and attending events. (Driving record will be checked.)

Demonstrate effective negotiation and closing techniques.

Strong analytical skills, good judgment, and a "positive can do attitude" are required.

Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically, analytically, creatively and logically; and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to work evenings and weekends.

Physical Requirements: Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.). Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Average pushing and pulling, bending and stooping. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job function.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

We offer a competitive starting base salary of $52,000 per year with a guaranteed salary period for a smooth transition to our commission-based model, where top performers can earn 1x to 6x their base salary, providing significant earning potential directly tied to your success and the volume of advertising you sell. Your total compensation will be determined based on your relevant experience, skills, and knowledge.

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser: https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

job.title: Media Consultant - Orlando Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)

  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

  • BA/BS degree

  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. job.title: Community Connections Coordinator, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is searching for a Community Connections Coordinator. We're looking for a driven, people-first professional to join our team and serve as the vital link between our newsroom and the communities we cover. In this role, you'll cultivate meaningful relationships, surface credible story leads, coordinate community events and listening sessions, and help our journalists connect with the trusted local voices that make our coverage matter. Whether you're in the field building source networks, managing audience tips, or supporting breaking news coverage, your work will directly shape how WEWS serves the people of Greater Cleveland every day.


Application Review: Applications received by 11/04 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community organizations, residents, leaders, and trusted sources to gather community insights and identify emerging issues, events, and story opportunities.
  • Monitor, track, and route audience tips, questions, and leads from community channels, ensuring timely communication and escalation to newsroom teams.
  • Support newsroom listening efforts, community conversations, and source development by connecting journalists with credible and diverse community voices.
  • Assist with breaking and developing news coverage by gathering community context, maintaining source networks, and providing timely intelligence to newsroom staff.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for community organizations and residents, fostering positive relationships and trust.
  • Coordinate outreach, maintain partner and contact records, and represent the station at community meetings, events, and activities.
  • Support newsroom talent by coordinating interviews, identifying community contacts, gathering background information, and facilitating community appearances.
  • Coordinate logistics and execution for community conversations, listening sessions, public programs, newsroom events, special coverage initiatives, and station appearances.
  • Manage event-related activities including outreach, scheduling, partner coordination, participant communications, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
  • Support audience engagement across digital and in-person channels, including live discussions, community groups, neighborhood platforms, and other audience interaction opportunities.
  • Maintain community calendars, project plans, contact databases, and engagement records to support execution of the market community strategy.
  • Track community insights, engagement outcomes, story leads, and best practices, preparing summaries and reports that help inform newsroom and community engagement priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associates degree in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in journalism, communications, community engagement, nonprofit work, events, public relations or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong listening, relationship-building and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to establish rapport with diverse community members and organizations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, follow-through and attention to detail
  • Ability to identify and communicate relevant community information quickly and accurately
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with journalists and station teams
  • Comfort working independently in the community and adapting to newsroom needs
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/contact systems, social platforms and collaboration tools
  • Solid news judgment, comfort with newsroom urgency, ability to verify and relay information quickly, and understanding of how community tips can develop into stories
  • Ability to communicate clearly and accurately across digital platforms, maintain professionalism in public-facing conversations and collaborate closely with reporters, producers, anchors, meteorologists and newsroom leaders

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland is a city of neighborhoods, grit, and genuine heart — and it's having a moment. Situated on the southern shore of Lake Erie, Cleveland combines a rich cultural heritage with a revitalized downtown and a food and arts scene that consistently surprises newcomers. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, the world-class Cleveland Museum of Art (with free general admission), and Playhouse Square — the largest performing arts center in the U.S. outside of New York City — give the city a cultural depth that is hard to match. Walkable neighborhoods like Ohio City, Tremont, and Little Italy each bring their own distinctive character, cuisine, and community.


Sports are woven into the fabric of Cleveland life. Cheer on the Cleveland Guardians at Progressive Field, follow the Cleveland Cavaliers at Rocket Arena, and join the passionate faithful who rally behind the Cleveland Browns every season. The sense of community pride around Cleveland's teams is infectious, and game days turn the city into one big celebration.


The outdoors are never far away. Cuyahoga Valley National Park — the only national park in Ohio — sits just south of the city, offering miles of hiking, biking, waterfalls, and scenic railroad excursions. Cleveland Metroparks wraps the city in a beloved "Emerald Necklace" of parks and trails, and Lake Erie's shoreline provides year-round recreation from sailing to fishing. With a lower cost of living than many comparable metros, a growing tech and healthcare economy, and a community-first spirit you can feel on every block, Cleveland is a fantastic place to build a career and a life.

job.description:
Are you a connector, a listener, and a community champion? KPAX is looking for a passionate and strategic community engagement leader to serve as the station's primary bridge to the people and organizations that define our market. In this role, you'll build trusted relationships across civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government sectors — translating community insight into action that strengthens our journalism, deepens audience trust, and creates lasting local impact. If you thrive at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and service, this is your opportunity to shape how KPAX shows up for the community it serves.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related field
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

OUR TEAM: We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, gamers, musicians, community leaders, swimmers, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Missoula, MT where the Clark-Fork River really does run through this vibrant city. Set at the convergence of five mountain ranges, earning Missoula the name of the "hub of five valleys". Missoula is surrounded by 60,000 acres of wilderness and is an outdoor paradise, with national forests, ski areas, incredible hikes, and bicycling, raging rivers with excellent blue-ribbon trout fishing. Missoula has repeatedly earned its ranking as a top 100 Best Places to live and was recently recognized as one of the healthiest places in the US with the highest life expectancy compared to any other city in Montana. If you seek a life that isn't consumed by your work or your commute, where living is about community, exploring the same trails as Lewis and Clark, as well as new adventures, and a place where "fur babies" are considered part of the Missoulian community than this is the place for you! After Billings, Missoula is the second-largest city and metropolitan area in Montana and is home to the University of Montana, a public research university. Where else can you walk outside and jump on a mountain trailhead or drive two to three hours and arrive at the gates of both Glacier and Yellowstone National Park? The economy is growing, culture and arts are thriving, calling filmmakers such as Paramount's Yellowstone to call on Missoula for some of the most beautiful scenic movie and TV show backgrounds. Truly the last best place!​

job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.

job.title: Senior Manager, Community Connections - KIVI
job.description:
Are you a natural connector who thrives at the intersection of community, journalism, and partnership? KIVI in Boise, Idaho, is looking for a Senior Manager, Community Connections to serve as the station's primary bridge to the people, organizations, and conversations that shape our community. In this pivotal role, you'll build trusted relationships, surface emerging issues, and translate community intelligence into meaningful action — keeping KIVI an essential, responsive, and deeply relevant force in local life. If you're passionate about community impact and believe local media has the power to bring people together, this is your opportunity to lead that charge.


Application Review: Applications received by November 4th will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company's required insurance limits

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Boise is one of the West's most exciting and livable cities, a place where big-city energy meets the ease of an outdoor lifestyle. Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains along the Boise River, the city offers a stunning natural backdrop and near-endless recreation — from world-class skiing and snowboarding at Bogus Basin just 16 miles from downtown, to hiking and mountain biking the Ridge to Rivers trail system, to floating the Boise River Greenbelt in summer. Sun Valley, one of America's premier ski destinations, is just a couple of hours away.


Downtown Boise is a thriving cultural hub packed with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, live music venues, and a vibrant arts scene anchored by the Treefort Music Festival and the Boise Contemporary Theater. The city is home to Boise State University and its iconic blue turf, giving it a youthful, collegiate energy alongside a rapidly growing tech sector that's earned it recognition as one of the top emerging markets in the nation. The Saturday farmers market, the Historic Egyptian Theatre, and the Basque Block — one of the most concentrated Basque communities outside of Spain — all add to Boise's rich, one-of-a-kind character.


Best of all, Boise consistently ranks among the most affordable major metros in the West, offering a high quality of life without the cost or congestion of larger coastal cities. With short commutes, friendly neighborhoods, and 206 days of sunshine a year, Boise is the kind of place where you'll quickly wonder why you didn't move here sooner.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KTHV-TV Little Rock, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Little Rock, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of CBS broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Little Rock's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3-5 years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC
job.description:
About the FT

The Financial Times is one of the world's leading business news organisations, recognised internationally for its authority, integrity and accuracy.

Trust sits at the heart of the FT. That means not only producing journalism our readers can rely on, but also being thoughtful, transparent and responsible in how we design our products and use customer data.

Our Product & Technology organisation plays a central role in helping the FT deliver on this ambition, building products and experiences that serve our customers while supporting the long-term growth of the business.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Privacy to lead this important product area on a fixed-term basis, covering maternity leave until the end December, 2027.

The role

Privacy is an increasingly important part of the customer experience.

Customers should be able to understand how their information is used, make meaningful choices and feel confident that the FT acts responsibly with their data. Our ambition is to make privacy a reason for customers to trust the FT.

As Senior Product Manager for the Privacy team, you will lead the product strategy and roadmap for this area.

You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data, Legal, Compliance, Marketing and commercial teams to turn complex customer, regulatory, technical and business needs into simple, trustworthy product experiences.

It is a product leadership role focused on how the FT can create clearer, simpler and more transparent experiences, while ensuring that privacy and responsible data use are embedded into the way we build products. 

You will help us work towards an ambition of being one of the most trusted digital organisations in how we handle customer data and privacy choices.

What you'll work on

You will lead the evolution of the FT's privacy and consent experience, including areas such as:

  • Customer trust: Identifying opportunities to strengthen trust through clear, transparent and respectful privacy experiences.
  • Customer choice: Making it easier for customers to understand and manage how their data is used.
  • Privacy experience: Creating simpler and more consistent experiences across customer journeys.
  • Responsible data use: Helping ensure that product teams use customer data in ways that are responsible, understandable and aligned with customer expectations.
  • Privacy by design: Working with teams across the FT to embed privacy thinking earlier in product and technology development.
  • Measurement and insight: Developing a better understanding of how customers interact with privacy choices and how those experiences affect trust and engagement.
  • Experimentation: Using customer research and responsible experimentation to improve how privacy choices are communicated and experienced.
  • Regulatory change: Working with Legal, Compliance and Data Governance colleagues to ensure that evolving requirements are translated into scalable and customer-friendly product solutions.
  • Product foundations: Helping improve the systems, processes and ownership models that support privacy experiences across the FT, powering more personalised journeys.

What you'll do

Set the product direction

Define and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for the Privacy team

Identify the most important customer and business problems to solve and translate them into measurable outcomes.

Balance customer trust, regulatory responsibilities, product experience, technical sustainability and business needs when setting priorities.

Look beyond individual requirements or projects to build capabilities that can support the FT over the long term.

Champion the customer

Make the customer perspective central to privacy product decisions.

Work with Research, Design and Data teams to understand how customers perceive privacy, data use and consent.

Identify areas where experiences may be confusing, inconsistent or unnecessarily difficult.

Advocate for simple language, meaningful choices and experiences that help customers feel informed and in control.

Lead complex cross-functional work

Lead initiatives involving multiple product and technology teams and a wide range of business stakeholders.

Work closely with Engineering and Architecture colleagues to understand technical opportunities, constraints and dependencies.

Partner with Legal, Compliance and Data Governance teams to translate specialist requirements into effective customer and product solutions.

Build strong relationships across the FT and create alignment where different teams have competing needs or priorities.

Use evidence to make decisions

Define meaningful measures of success and use data and customer research to understand product performance.

Develop hypotheses and experiments that help improve customer understanding and trust.

Use external trends, industry developments and emerging best practice to inform product direction.

Ensure decisions are based on evidence while recognising the importance of judgement in areas involving trust and customer expectations.

Deliver outcomes

Take opportunities from problem definition and discovery through delivery, measurement and iteration.

Give cross-functional teams clear objectives and priorities.

Identify risks, dependencies and trade-offs early and help teams make good decisions.

Communicate strategy, progress, outcomes and decisions clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

Provide senior product leadership

Bring clarity and structure to complex and ambiguous problems.

Influence teams and senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

Contribute to the wider Product community and help raise the quality of product thinking and practice.

Support and mentor other Product Managers where appropriate.

What you'll bring

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is comfortable working in complex, technically challenging and highly cross-functional environments.

You are likely to have:

  • Significant experience managing digital products or platforms.
  • A strong track record of defining product strategy and turning it into measurable outcomes.
  • Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
  • A strong customer focus and an ability to identify the underlying customer problem rather than simply respond to requirements.
  • Excellent judgement when balancing customer, business, technical and regulatory considerations.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data, customer research and experimentation to inform decisions.
  • The ability to turn complex or ambiguous problems into clear priorities and actions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working closely with engineers, designers, researchers, analysts and other specialist disciplines.
  • An understanding of how product decisions contribute to both customer value and sustainable business outcomes.
  • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Experience that would be useful

You do not need to be a privacy lawyer or regulatory expert.

We are interested in experienced Product Managers who can learn a complex domain quickly and work effectively with specialist colleagues.

Experience in one or more of the following would be helpful:

  • Privacy, consent or customer preferences.
  • Customer identity or first-party data.
  • Personalisation or data-driven customer experiences.
  • Data governance.
  • Trust and safety.
  • Regulatory or highly regulated product environments.
  • Large-scale digital platforms or shared product capabilities.

Most importantly, you will care deeply about creating products that customers can trust.

What success looks like

Success in this role means helping the FT make privacy and responsible data use a stronger part of our customer proposition.

You will help us:

  • Create simpler and more understandable privacy experiences.
  • Give customers greater clarity and control over their choices.
  • Build stronger understanding of how privacy experiences affect customer trust.
  • Establish clearer product principles for the responsible use of customer data.
  • Embed privacy thinking more consistently into product development.
  • Improve the foundations that allow teams to deliver trustworthy experiences efficiently.
  • Build stronger alignment between customer needs, regulatory responsibilities and business priorities.
  • Develop a clear long-term product direction for Privacy & Trust.

Ultimately, we want customers to feel that the FT respects their choices, is transparent about how their data is used and consistently earns their trust.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

job.title: Learning & Development Coordinator
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Learning & Development (L&D) Coordinator supports the planning and day-to-day delivery of learning programs. Working under the guidance of the ONWARD Connected Lead and program managers, this role helps keep timelines, participant communications, enrollment details, logistics, records, and follow-up activities organized and on track.

The L&D Coordinator partners with subject matter experts (SMEs), facilitators, Learning Operations, Learning Communications, Learning Impact, Connected Capabilities Leads, Learning & Performance Business Partners (LPBPs), HR Business Partners (HRBPs), and external vendors. The role is suited to an early-career professional who is organized, service-minded, eager to learn, and ready to build program coordination skills while contributing to a positive participant experience.

This is for UK Shift. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Help maintain program calendars, workplans, schedules, task trackers, and key deadlines; update them as plans change.
  • Gather planning information from program leads, SMEs, facilitators, Learning Operations, and other partners, and keep shared materials current.
  • Coordinate routine details across program activities such as marketing, nominations, preparation, delivery, evaluation, and follow-up.

Nominations & Participant Administration

  • Support nomination and enrollment activities using established criteria, processes, forms, and timelines, in partnership with Learning Business Partners.
  • Maintain participant lists, registration status, waitlists, and alumni records, checking information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare participant rosters and provide enrollment details to Learning Operations and other partners as requested.
  • Track participation changes or gaps and bring them to the program lead's attention for review and follow-up.

Participant Communications & Support

  • Prepare and send routine participant communications using approved templates and guidance, including invitations, welcome information, reminders, logistics, and follow-up resources.
  • Help keep communication plans, templates, FAQs, and send dates organized and up to date.
  • Monitor program inboxes or communication channels; respond to routine questions using approved information and route complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate partner.
  • Provide timely, courteous support and help participants understand where to find program information and materials.

Digital & On-Demand Program Support

  • Responsible for LMS setup and enrollment following established processes.
  • Check that program information such as descriptions, dates, links, prerequisites, and instructions matches the approved source materials.
  • Use available reports to track enrollment, progress, and completion; send reminders according to the program plan and share potential concerns with the program lead.
  • Record access or technical issues and route them to Learning Operations or the appropriate support contact.

Program Logistics & Delivery

  • Use program checklists to help prepare virtual sessions, including meeting links, platform settings, breakout rooms, recordings, and technology checks.
  • Coordinate in-person logistics such as room arrangements, audiovisual needs, materials, and onsite details with the relevant partners.
  • Organize and distribute agendas, participant materials, facilitator resources, and other approved program content.
  • Support session-day operations, maintain attendance records, and share required information with Learning Operations for tracking and reporting.
  • Help identify logistical gaps early and bring them to the program lead's attention.

Evaluation, Reporting & Follow-Up

  • Help prepare and distribute program evaluations, surveys, and pulse checks; monitor responses and send planned reminders.
  • Compile attendance, enrollment, completion, and evaluation information in established trackers or templates.
  • Prepare basic status updates and summaries for review by the program lead; flag notable feedback, recurring questions, or participation issues.
  • Keep follow-up tasks and resource distribution organized after program sessions.

Documentation & Process Support

  • Maintain shared program files, calendars, participant records, and materials so information is current, easy to find, and appropriately organized.
  • Follow established version-control, privacy, data-handling, and governance practices when working with program materials and participant information.
  • Update FAQs, checklists, standard operating procedures, and other program documentation as directed.
  • Share practical ideas with the team for making recurring coordination tasks clearer, more consistent, or more efficient

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in Learning & Development.
  • Organization & attention to detail: Keeps information accurate and follows through on assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Clear communication: Writes and speaks courteously, shares updates, and asks questions when expectations are unclear.
  • Service mindset: Responds helpfully to participant and stakeholder needs and knows when to seek support.
  • Teamwork & learning agility: Collaborates well, accepts feedback, and builds knowledge of learning program operations over time.
  • Coordination & prioritization: Tracks multiple tasks, adapts to changing details, and raises capacity or timing concerns early.
  • Problem solving & judgment: Notices issues, gathers relevant details, and escalates appropriately rather than making unsupported decisions.
  • Comfort with digital tools: Willingness to learn collaboration, scheduling, learning-management, and survey tools used by the team.

job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and rewarding careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road®.

Your Opportunity, Your Team


The Senior Media Operations Technician helps keep QVC’s live broadcast and transmission operating reliably across broadcast platforms and streams. You’ll oversee incoming live and remote feeds, monitor channel output, and respond to technical issues where fast, accurate troubleshooting matters.

You’ll work across Media Operations, production, and engineering as a senior technical resource. You’ll also share your expertise with less experienced colleagues and help maintain consistent operating practices.


Where You'll Work


  • This role is onsite and will require you to work from our West Chester location daily. Relocation assistance is not available for this role.
  • This role requires availability to work first, second, and third shifts. Job seekers must reside in New Jersey, Delaware, or Pennsylvania to be considered.

What You'll Do


  • Coordinate incoming live and remote feeds, including booking and scheduling remote broadcasts.
  • Monitor live and non-live channel output and the NOC dashboard; troubleshoot broadcast-network devices and escalate issues to Engineering.
  • Perform quality-control and integrity checks on incoming and outgoing audio and video signals.
  • Troubleshoot transmission, control-room, playout, still-store, graphics, camera, robotics, switcher, and router systems.
  • Install, maintain, and debug equipment; identify parts needed for repairs and projects, and support reliable service across QVC platforms.

What You'll Bring


  • At least 3 years of experience in broadcast engineering, media operations, or network operations in a television broadcast environment, including technical leadership or peer mentoring.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting broadcast equipment and systems, including component-level troubleshooting, system design, and installations.
  • Ability to respond quickly and accurately to critical live-broadcast issues.
  • Understanding of television production processes, broadcast operations, and technical production requirements.
  • College, technical-school, or military training, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

Our Total Rewards package includes benefits you’ll love such as competitive compensation, paid time off, an employee assistance program, parental leave, paid volunteer hours, and amazing company discounts! In our US market, you can also expect health care benefits starting on day 1, 401(k), and tuition reimbursement benefits.

QVC Group is committed to inclusion and belonging for all and ensuring that our workplace provides equal employment opportunities for all team members and candidates and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations. As an equal opportunity employer, QVC Group is committed to a barrier-free employment process. If you need reasonable accommodations/support throughout, please contact us at workwithus@qvcgrp.com for assistance.

If provided, salary ranges are a general guideline only, and actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, and geographic location as well as business and market conditions.

job.title: Assignment Editor
job.description:
FOX6 News is looking for an Assignment Editor to join our busy newsroom. This key role helps shape daily coverage by monitoring multiple news sources, identifying important stories and coordinating coverage across our broadcast and digital platforms. The ideal candidate has strong news judgment, excellent communication skills and a passion for delivering accurate, timely news to viewers across Southeast Wisconsin.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and coordinate daily news coverage for broadcast, digital and social media platforms.
  • Monitor police scanners, email, social media, news wires and other sources for breaking news and developing stories.
  • Identify compelling news, weather and sports content for audiences across Southeast Wisconsin.
  • Coordinate assignments and communicate with producers, reporters, photographers, news managers and field crews.
  • Work with local, regional and national content partners.
  • Coordinate live news assignments and assist with coverage logistics.
  • Research stories and provide relevant information to news producers.
  • Help generate new story ideas and identify opportunities across digital and emerging media platforms.
  • Support the creation of written articles, livestreams, photos, graphics, video and social media content.
  • Maintain accuracy and speed while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced newsroom.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • A degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Previous experience as an assignment editor, associate producer or news intern is preferred, but not required.
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to recognize compelling story ideas.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong writing, editing and research abilities.
  • The ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments at once.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach.
  • Familiarity with digital news platforms, social media and emerging newsroom technologies.
  • The ability to work flexible hours, including mornings, evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • A positive attitude, curiosity and a commitment to accuracy and journalistic standards.

What You’ll Get

  • The opportunity to work in a fast-paced, collaborative newsroom serving Southeast Wisconsin.
  • The chance to contribute to coverage across broadcast, digital and social media platforms.
  • Opportunities to work alongside experienced journalists, producers, reporters, photographers and news managers.
  • FOX Television Stations benefits, including a generous time-off program and 401(k) plan.
  • A role where your ideas, news judgment and ability to move quickly can make a meaningful impact every day.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Multiskilled Journalist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WWL WUPL-TV New Orleans, the CBS/MNTV TEGNA affiliate,  is looking for an experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist to help maintain our tradition of superior reporting and newsgathering. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms with a mix of outstanding photography and unforgettable editing. If you're a creative storyteller who understands true multi-platform journalism and who is not bound by the methods of traditional TV news – we want to hear from you! 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Perform authoritative, compelling live shots in a developing story or in breaking news situations
  • Develop story ideas
  • Mine the community to find sources who will keep you informed about events and ideas in their areas of expertise
  • Ability to identify, write and produce stories within a specific framework.
  • Research for facts and credibility.
  • Maintain and develop sources who will help bring our reporting to the next level.
  • Shoot, write, produce and edit on air and online content within deadlines.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.
  • Use social media and digital tools to research, discover and distribute content.
  • Attend editorial meetings and offer story ideas daily.
  • Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner.

Requirements: 

  • 1-3 years reporting experience preferred.
  • Must possess solid news judgment, display strong communication skills, creativity, and ethical decision-making skills.
  • Strong writing skills, production skills and tease writing abilities.
  • ENPS, EDIUS and Axis graphics experience is preferred.
  • Must be organized with the ability to work under constant deadlines.
  • Must be able to calmly handle live breaking news situations and changing events.
  • Proven social and digital content creation ability.
  • Knowledge of New Orleans a plus ​

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.
