job.title: Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, Morning Edition & Up First
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions:

Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a newsroom overnight in order to deliver the most up-to-date morning broadcast possible.

Intro to Position

Morning Edition and Up First are looking for a resilient journalist with strong news judgment, excellent writing skills and a willingness to work overnights as the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, managing  a production team that executes what is needed to get the live radio show to air and the Up First podcast to publication.

Millions of listeners depend on Morning Edition and Up First to set the news agenda to start their day. We deliver the latest national and international news stories paired with analysis to put headlines into context. Morning Edition is a platform for accountability through interviews with government officials and decision makers who make or influence policy that affect people's lives. The show also features culture stories about music, movies and books that bring joy and provoke thoughtful conversations about who we are in this world.

The right candidate for this position is committed to daily news, and is eager to deliver the freshest, most important stories to listeners. They put the needs and wants of audiences first. They believe in the mission of public media.

As the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, you will join a team of managers who collaboratively lead news and editorial coverage of events in the U.S. and around the world for Morning Edition and Up First. You ensure that the show is at the leading edge of the conversation across a range of issues. Most importantly, you work directly with our hosts to edit and make final changes to the show before and while it is live on air to ensure we are broadcasting our best journalism and editorial work.

Duties for this position include assigning stories and segments to hosts, producers and editors; editing show scripts, crafting live coverage and breaking news plans; leading the control room during the live broadcast; finding guests and reporters to feature on the show when needed; monitoring news and responding with show coverage plans as needed; mentoring and editing producers’ and editors’ writing for stories and show segments; managing staff work schedules as emergencies arise; coordinate and collaborate with other newsroom editors, leaders and journalists on show coverage plans, projects; upload editorial standards and ethics as the lead show manager during your shift. As a manager, you will be assigned direct reports and are expected to evaluate and develop staff.

This is an overnight position with a shift scheduled from approximately 11:30pm - 8:30am Eastern Time Sunday-Thursday.

Morning Edition is a 24/6 news operation. Successful candidates can work holidays and may be asked to temporarily change their work schedule to cover other show shifts and special assignments as needed.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the show production team in bringing the live radio show and podcast to air, including the most listened to segment that airs during the 7a ET hour
  • Manage the editorial operation of the control room during the live broadcast
  • Coordinate with teams for live updates for later news feeds
  • Work directly with show hosts, guests and reporters to prep, record and edit live and taped interviews for the show and podcast on a tight deadline
  • Line edit various scripts for the live show while maintaining NPR’s editorial standards for all parts of the final product
  • Make editorial, programming and news judgment decisions about edits and show coverage plans, especially during breaking news situations
  • Provide written and verbal editorial feedback to staff on work
  • Evaluate, develop, and manage staff performance
  • Collaborate with multiplatform news teams to maximize reach of show content
  • Participate in the hiring of individual staff
  • Cultivate, promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in one’s work and in the workplace.
  • Demonstrated awareness of intersectional identities and ability to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Other duties as assigned

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3  years of experience managing direct reports in a newsroom or operation
  • At least 5  years of experience writing and editing broadcast journalism content
  • At least 5 years of experience producing daily news journalism content for a national or international news organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with audio production and mixing techniques
  • Experience working in a live control room
  • Experience being the lead producer or editor for a radio or podcast show 
  • Experience editing news content for various platforms
  • Familiarity in another written language other than English, such as Spanish or Mandarin

EDUCATION REQUIREMENT

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, DC .

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Mastery in project management such as managing deadlines and time management
  • Expert knowledge and demonstrated skill in news-writing techniques for varied formats such as guest interviews, breaking news,  feature stories
  • Mastery in AP style writing and editing skill for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability and experience in writing and editing news copy for varied platforms including broadcast, podcast, social, mobile, newsletters and other digital platforms, especially during breaking news situations
  • Proficiency in people management skills such as delivering constructive feedback, clear communication and conflict resolution.
  • Proficiency in independent, problem solving. 
  • Ability to adapt and accommodate differing styles of editorial workflows and communication.
  • Ability to negotiate and compromise.
  • Professional communication skills when representing the NPR organization.

Job Type

  • This is a full time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $145,000-155,000 a year plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

#LI-ONSITE

job.title: General Counsel
job.description:
AccuWeather is searching for a dynamic General Counsel to join its leadership team. The General Counsel leads AccuWeather's Legal Services team and serves as chief legal advisor to the CEO and business leaders across a global B2C digital media business, and enterprise B2B weather-data and insights business, and a linear broadcast/OTT network. This role owns the company's legal risk, commercial contracting, IP, privacy, and litigation strategy, and is responsible for modernizing the legal functions, including through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows to deliver faster, leaner, and more scalable legal support to the business.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Legal Operations & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Champion the adoption of AI legal tools (contract lifecycle management, legal research, drafting assistance) to cut cycle time, reduce outside counsel spend, and scale the legal team's output.
  • Build and own the company's internal AI governance framework and advise the business on legal and regulatory risk arising from its own use and development of AI.
  • Redesign commercial contracting and other legal workflows for speed, consistency, and measurable efficiency gains.
  • Structure and manage the internal legal team and legal support staff; manage outside counsel relationships and budget for cost-effective coverage.

Commercial & Corporate Transactions

  • Negotiate and draft high-value commercial agreements, including content and technology licensing, strategic partnerships and alliances, and ad-tech platform arrangements.
  • Serve as lead legal advisor on M&A, divestitures, joint ventures, and corporate investment transactions.
  • Advise on financing activity, including business and legal-entity structuring.
  • Advise on content delivery and distribution issues across broadcast, cable, and OTT platforms.

Data Privacy, Cybersecurity & Regulatory

  • Act as subject-matter expert on consumer data privacy for a digital media company with a global user base, and monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulation for business impact.
  • Partner with Security and IT on cybersecurity risk, vendor data-processing terms, and incident response.
  • Ensure company-wide compliance with applicable domestic and international laws and standards.

Litigation, IP & Risk

  • Direct litigation strategy and outside counsel on matters filed by or against the company; approve settlements.
  • Protect the company's intellectual property portfolio, trademarks, copyrights, patents, and trade secrets — including strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Oversee contract enforcement and delinquency collections.

Corporate Governance & Board Support

  • Serve as key advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors on corporate governance, risk, and major transactions.
  • Participate in defining corporate policies, procedures, and programs, and advise on their legal implications.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • JD and 15+ years of relevant experience, including service as General Counsel or senior in-house counsel in a corporate environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI legal tools and a demonstrated record of using AI to drive legal-department efficiency (not just familiarity, but hands-on experience selecting, implementing, or championing AI tools in a legal setting).
  • Broad intellectual property experience, including patent law, IP licensing, and IP due diligence.
  • Working familiarity with employment law and compliance investigations (DOL/OFCCP).
  • Proven ability to negotiate and draft complex, high-value contracts and to quickly analyze agreements from varied origins.
  • Strong executive presence; able to advise and present to senior management, the Board, and international clients and partners.
  • Experience managing a team of attorneys and legal support staff and managing outside counsel cost-effectively.
  • Experience with corporate governance matters involving a Board of Directors.
  • General knowledge of tax laws and standards as they relate to corporate transactions.
  • Must reside in State College, PA, or be willing to relocate to the State College area.

Preferred

  • Experience in digital media, broadcast/OTT, or a comparable data- or platform-driven industry.
  • Exposure to board governance, M&A processes, or strategic planning cycles.
  • Experience directing strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Experience managing or coordinating cross-functional teams without direct authority.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

 

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Operations & Engagement Coordinator, Agency Development & Sales Strategy
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

About the Team

The mission of the Agency Development & Sales Strategy team is to leverage agencies as our next big source of incremental revenue growth. Our strategy is to create the conditions for our Sales Organization to drive more revenue from agency partners. Our approach is threefold: drive demand by changing perceptions; enable commerce by reducing friction and creating incentives; and standardize ways of working in order to scale. As a small but growing team, we have outsized impact by leveraging other internal teams, including Industry Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Programmatic Ops.

About the Role

You will report to the Associate Director, Agency Development & Sales Strategy. This role is based in our New York office and follows a hybrid work schedule.

As the Operations & Engagement Coordinator, you will support the operational core of the team. You will help execute day-to-day processes, coordinate projects, and manage logistics that enable successful, long-term partnerships with advertising agencies, with a particular focus on agency-facing activations. You will ensure that information, timelines and logistics stay aligned. You will assist in setting up and maintaining internal systems and workflows that translate strategy into successful agency partnership.

This role is ideal for a highly organized professional with strong project coordination skills, attention to detail, and an interest in agency partnerships, engagements, and media. Success in this role is defined by reliable execution, clear communication, and the smooth, scalable operation of our processes.

Responsibilities

Change agency perceptions of The Times

Agency Engagements: Support the planning and coordination of agency-specific engagements (e.g., Lunch & Learns, leadership gatherings, summits); managing logistics, invitations, venue and vendor coordination, materials preparation, and day-of execution

Scheduling: Maintain an event calendar, track deadlines, manage checklists, coordinate internal stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Research, Creative), and ensure follow-up actions and reporting are completed on time

Outbound Communications: Help create external-facing materials – such as competitive reports and presentation decks – to strengthen agency relationships

Enable commerce by reducing friction and creating incentives

Agency Partnerships: Support the development and execution of revenue-generating deals with agency partners (e.g., tracking deliverables, updating status docs, coordinating approvals)

Strategic Implementation: Support the roadmapping, scoping and executing of strategic initiatives and work streams aligned with team goals

Prioritization and Planning: Coordinate with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Programmatic teams to identify opportunities, propose priorities, and ensure alignment on agency engagement strategies

Standardize ways of working in order to scale

Workflows: Help design and refine workflows and processes that streamline repeated tasks and external-facing materials, using AI-driven tools and automations where possible

Industry Research: Monitor industry trends and agency needs, collaborating with Sales Ops and Measurement teams to generate insights that enhance The Times' value proposition.

Lifecycle Support: Support the lifecycle of projects by helping to organize information, schedule meetings, capture notes and action items, and follow up with stakeholders to keep work moving

Accountability: Use and help maintain tools and processes (e.g., CRM and reporting dashboards) required to associate our engagement efforts with real traction with agencies (e.g., RFPs, IOs)

Basic Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience in operations or project coordination, event planning, business strategy support, business development support, or a related field.

  • Experience coordinating events or programs (professional, academic, or extracurricular), including logistics and communication with participants

  • Experience working collaboratively across teams and build positive working relationships

  • High attention to detail and willingness to roll up your sleeves on both administrative and project-based work

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience in Media, Advertising, Media Agencies, or Tech

  • 1+ years experience with project management software tools (e.g., Monday.com, Coda)

  • Comfort working with data in spreadsheets and basic reporting tools; familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

REQ-020851

Additional Compensation and Benefits:

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.

The annual base pay range for this role is between:$60,000—$68,000 USD

If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.

job.title: Senior Director, Entertainment & Sports
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

starpower, part of Real Chemistry, is a leading entertainment, talent, influencer, and cultural marketing agency that helps brands build authentic connections with audiences through the power of culture. For more than two decades, we've partnered with brands to develop impactful programs spanning celebrity partnerships, influencer marketing, talent procurement, experiential activations, content, sponsorships, and strategic consulting. Widely recognized as the bridge between Hollywood and healthcare, starpower brings unmatched expertise in connecting healthcare, wellness, consumer, and lifestyle brands with the talent, creators, and cultural moments that matter most.

 

Job Overview

The Senior Director, Entertainment & Sport will develop, negotiate, and execute strategic partnerships for specific healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts. Working closely with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams, this role will connect brands with entertainment and sport properties, teams, leagues, and talent. The position requires deep industry relationships, strong commercial judgment, and agency-or buyer-side experience building brand partnerships from strategy through activation.

Title: Senior Director, Entertainment & Sports

 

Responsibilities

 

Client Partnership Strategy

  • Develop entertainment and sports partnership strategies for healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts, in collaboration with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities with properties, teams, leagues, talent, rights holders, and other industry partners based on each client’s objectives.
  • Translate client objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into differentiated partnership platforms and activation ideas.

 

Deal Development, Negotiation & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end partnership process, including opportunity sourcing, valuation, proposal development, rights packaging, negotiation, contracting support, and activation planning.
  • Develop clear business cases and recommendations that balance brand impact, audience relevance, budget, risk, and measurable value.
  • Partner with legal, finance, creative, strategy, experiential, influencer, social, and media teams to deliver programs on time and within scope.
  • Oversee partnership activation and optimization, ensuring contractual rights are fully leveraged and programs meet brand and compliance requirements.

 

Client Leadership & Industry Relationships

  • Serve as a senior advisor on assigned client accounts, partnering with Real Chemistry leadership to guide partnership choices and present recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and agency partners.
  • Use market intelligence and relationships to create access, uncover opportunities, and strengthen negotiating positions for clients.

 

Business Development & Team Contribution

  • Support new business pitches, proposals, and organic growth opportunities by contributing partnership expertise, recommendations, and industry insights.
  • Partner with Real Chemistry leadership to strengthen entertainment and sports resources, partner networks, evaluation tools, case studies, and best practices.
  • Represent Real Chemistry at relevant industry events and stay current on emerging properties, talent, platforms, audience behaviors, and partnership models.
  • Share expertise with team members and foster collaborative, rigorous, and commercially minded ways of working.

 

Qualifications and Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in entertainment and sports partnerships, sponsorships, brand marketing, or a related field.
  • Significant agency- or buyer-side experience developing, negotiating, and executing partnerships for brands.
  • Deep, active relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and relevant intermediaries.
  • Demonstrated expertise in rights valuation, deal structure, negotiation, contracting processes, activation planning, and partnership measurement.
  • Experience in healthcare, health and wellness, or another highly regulated category is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer audiences, culture, media, experiential marketing, social platforms, and talent-led programs.
  • Excellent client leadership, communication, presentation, and financial skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex partnerships and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, detail-oriented, and energized by building new capabilities and offerings.

 

Pay Range: $135,000 - $180,000

The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

Why we're hiring:

InfoSum is WPP’s privacy-first data collaboration technology, trusted by global businesses to unlock the full potential of their first-party data without risk. Its patented, cross-cloud, decentralized collaboration technology leverages advanced Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) to radically transform how companies generate audience intelligence and drive better customer experiences. As the foundational infrastructure underpinning WPP Open, InfoSum powers trusted data collaboration across every cloud, client, and capability.

As our Sales Director, North America, you will be a pivotal leader in driving significant growth across our brand, data and media owner business throughout North America, collaborating closely with our dynamic leadership team. This is a unique opportunity to not only build a substantial book of business and advance your career, but also to become a recognized leader in the evolving marketing technology landscape.

You will be responsible for engaging senior-level contacts through compelling, value-based presentations, confidently navigating the technical intricacies of enterprise software sales.

We are seeking an intelligent, self-motivated, dynamic, positive, and collaborative individual who combines these traits with a deep understanding of the vast advertising, marketing, and data industries. You will be adept at closing deals and instrumental in developing and driving our business across North America. You possess a genuine passion for strategic thinking and customer success, a commitment to continuous improvement, and a natural ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external experts. We value a diverse, inclusive, and socially conscious culture that fosters open conversation and mutual understanding.

What you'll need:

  • Proven sales leadership experience (7+ years preferred) within the digital marketing and advertising ecosystem in North America, specifically with a strong track record in data, platform, or SaaS businesses.
  • Deep understanding of the advertising landscape, including ad tech, media buying, campaign optimization and measurement.
  • Demonstrated expertise in navigating complex sales cycles within the agency operations and brand direct environments.
  • Foundational knowledge and keen interest in emerging technologies related to data collaboration, identity resolution, and privacy-centric solutions.
  • Highly motivated, results-driven, and passionate about identifying customer challenges and developing innovative, sales-led solutions that deliver measurable value.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • A strategic thinker with the ability to identify new market opportunities and contribute to product and go-to-market strategies.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, engineering, marketing) to ensure customer success and drive product adoption.

 

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

job.title: Producer / On-Air Talent for X107.9 (KVGS)
job.description:
Position Overview 

Beasley Media Group Las Vegas is seeking a creative, energetic, and versatile Producer / On-Air Talent for X107.9 (KVGS), our alternative music station and the English-language radio home of the Vegas Golden Knights. 

We're looking for a talented broadcaster who can bring personality, creativity, and technical expertise to both sides of the microphone. The ideal candidate is passionate about alternative music, pop culture, sports, and the Las Vegas community, with the ability to produce compelling content, execute flawless broadcasts, and connect with listeners on-air and across digital platforms. 

This is a hands-on position that combines on-air hosting, audio production, live broadcast execution, and digital content creation. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, collaborating with programming and sales teams, and thriving in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 

Key Responsibilities 

On-Air Talent & Content Creation 

  • Host assigned on-air shifts with an engaging, authentic personality that reflects the X107.9 brand. 

  • Deliver compelling, entertaining content focused on alternative music, pop culture, local events, sports, and the Las Vegas lifestyle. 

  • Prepare and execute entertaining on-air breaks, interviews, promotions, and station features. 

  • Maintain strong listener engagement through on-air interaction, social media, and station events. 

  • Execute commercial endorsements, promotional announcements, and sponsored features as assigned. 

  • Represent X107.9 professionally at concerts, community events, promotional appearances, and station activities. 

Production & Broadcast Operations 

  • Produce high-quality audio content, including commercials, station imaging, promotional announcements, interviews, and specialty programming. 

  • Record, edit, mix, and deliver audio using industry-standard production software. 

  • Operate studio equipment, automation systems, and broadcast technology to ensure smooth daily programming. 

  • Coordinate with programming, traffic, sales, and engineering to ensure accurate and timely execution of broadcast content. 

  • Manage production deadlines, maintain organized audio libraries, and ensure consistent quality across all produced materials. 

  • Troubleshoot routine broadcast and production issues in a live environment. 

Vegas Golden Knights & Sports Programming 

  • Support the production and execution of Vegas Golden Knights game broadcasts and related programming on X107.9. 

  • Coordinate with play-by-play talent, producers, board operators, and station management to ensure seamless live broadcasts. 

  • Assist with pregame and postgame programming, sports features, interviews, and special broadcasts. 

  • Execute commercial breaks, sponsorship elements, and in-game features accurately. 

  • Produce and edit hockey-related audio, promotional content, and digital features. 

  • Assist with live remote broadcasts and special events as needed. 

Digital & Social Media 

  • Create engaging content for station social media platforms, streaming channels, and digital properties. 

  • Develop short-form video, audio clips, interviews, and behind-the-scenes content to extend the station's reach. 

  • Collaborate with the programming and promotions teams on digital campaigns, contests, and audience engagement initiatives. 

  • Stay current on alternative music trends, emerging artists, pop culture, and digital content opportunities. 

Programming & Team Collaboration 

  • Work closely with the Program Director to execute the station's programming strategy and brand vision. 

  • Collaborate with sales and promotions on creative client campaigns, sponsored content, and station events. 

  • Maintain accurate programming logs and ensure compliance with FCC regulations and company policies. 

  • Provide support for additional programming, production, and live broadcast needs across the Las Vegas cluster as assigned. 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in radio broadcasting, audio production, on-air hosting, or a related media position preferred. 

  • Strong on-air communication skills, creativity, and the ability to connect authentically with listeners. 

  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software, such as Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, or similar platforms. 

  • Experience with radio automation systems, studio operations, and live broadcast production. 

  • Knowledge of alternative music, emerging artists, pop culture, and current music trends. 

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, digital content creation, and video editing. 

  • Experience with live sports broadcasting or production is a plus. 

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events, including Vegas Golden Knights broadcasts, as needed. 

  • Valid driver's license and ability to participate in off-site promotional events as required. 

What We're Looking For 

We're looking for someone who loves radio, lives for great content, and isn't afraid to jump in wherever needed. You should be equally comfortable behind a microphone, producing a compelling piece of audio, running a live broadcast, or creating content that gets people talking online. 

X107.9 is a station with personality, energy, and a strong connection to the Las Vegas community. As the English-language radio home of the Vegas Golden Knights, we offer a unique opportunity to combine music, sports, entertainment, and live broadcasting in one exciting role. 

If you're creative, technically skilled, passionate about alternative music, and ready to make an impact both on-air and behind the scenes, we want to hear from you. 

About Beasley Media Group 

Beasley Media Group is a leading multiplatform media company delivering engaging content and innovative advertising solutions through its radio stations, digital platforms, and community partnerships. 

Location: Las Vegas, Nevada 
Position: Full-Time 
Department: Programming 
Company: Beasley Media Group

job.title: Program Director – KOAS Máxima 105.7
job.description:
Position Overview 

Beasley Media Group Las Vegas is seeking a dynamic, creative, and results-driven Program Director for KOAS Máxima 105.7, our Spanish-language radio station serving the vibrant and growing Hispanic community in Southern Nevada. 

The ideal candidate is a passionate radio programmer who understands Hispanic culture, music, and audience engagement, with the ability to build compelling on-air and digital content that connects with listeners and drives ratings and revenue. 

This position will oversee all aspects of KOAS programming, talent development, music strategy, promotions, and community engagement. Additionally, the Program Director will play a key leadership role in managing Máxima's Spanish-language broadcasts of the Vegas Golden Knights (VGK), helping expand the team's connection with Hispanic fans throughout Las Vegas. 

Key Responsibilities 

Programming & Content Strategy 

  • Lead the overall programming strategy, sound, and brand identity of KOAS Máxima. 

  • Manage daily programming operations, music scheduling, imaging, production, and on-air execution. 

  • Develop engaging content that reflects the interests, culture, and lifestyle of Las Vegas's Hispanic audience. 

  • Monitor ratings, audience trends, competitive stations, and listener research to identify opportunities for growth. 

  • Ensure consistency in station branding, positioning, and programming quality across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. 

  • Collaborate with the promotions, digital, and sales departments to develop creative programming initiatives and revenue opportunities. 

Talent Management & Development 

  • Recruit, coach, schedule, and develop on-air personalities and programming staff. 

  • Provide regular feedback and direction to improve talent performance and audience engagement. 

  • Oversee airchecks, show preparation, content development, and talent accountability. 

  • Foster a collaborative, creative, and high-performance programming environment. 

Vegas Golden Knights – Spanish Broadcast Management 

  • Oversee the programming and operational execution of the Vegas Golden Knights' Spanish-language radio broadcasts on KOAS Máxima. 

  • Coordinate with the VGK organization, Spanish-language play-by-play talent, producers, board operators, and station operations to ensure seamless execution of game broadcasts. 

  • Manage broadcast schedules, pregame and postgame programming, game-day logistics, and technical coordination. 

  • Work closely with the Spanish broadcast talent to develop compelling hockey-related content that connects with Hispanic listeners and builds the VGK fan base. 

  • Collaborate with the sales team to ensure proper execution of sponsorship commitments, in-game features, commercial inventory, and branded content. 

  • Identify opportunities to expand VGK programming through interviews, promotional appearances, social media, community events, and special features. 

  • Maintain strong communication with the VGK organization and internal departments to ensure broadcast quality and partnership success. 

Promotions, Digital & Community Engagement 

  • Work with the promotions team to develop station events, contests, and community initiatives that strengthen Máxima's connection with Hispanic audiences. 

  • Oversee the station's digital content strategy in collaboration with the digital team, including streaming, social media, video, and audience engagement. 

  • Build relationships with local Hispanic organizations, businesses, entertainers, and community leaders. 

  • Identify opportunities for station visibility at concerts, cultural celebrations, sporting events, and community activities. 

  • Partner with the sales department to develop creative, integrated sponsorship opportunities that deliver value to advertisers while maintaining programming integrity. 

Operations & Compliance 

  • Ensure station programming complies with FCC regulations and company policies. 

  • Oversee programming schedules, commercial execution, and coordination with traffic and engineering. 

  • Manage programming resources, staffing schedules, and departmental budgets. 

  • Maintain high standards for broadcast quality, operational efficiency, and brand consistency. 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 3–5 years of radio programming experience, preferably in Spanish-language or Hispanic-targeted formats. 

  • Previous experience as a Program Director, Assistant Program Director, Music Director, or comparable programming leadership role preferred. 

  • Fluency in Spanish and English required, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages. 

  • Deep understanding of Hispanic music, culture, audience preferences, and the Las Vegas marketplace. 

  • Experience with music scheduling, automation, audio production, and broadcast programming systems. 

  • Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and talent development skills. 

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, promotions, digital, engineering, and corporate leadership. 

  • Experience with sports broadcasting, live events, or play-by-play production is a plus. 

  • Strong understanding of social media, streaming, and digital audience engagement. 

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and special events, including Vegas Golden Knights game broadcasts, as needed. 

What We're Looking For 

We're looking for more than a traditional Program Director. We want a creative leader who understands the power of local radio, embraces the energy and diversity of Las Vegas, and knows how to connect with Hispanic audiences through great music, engaging personalities, community involvement, and compelling content. 

With Máxima's Spanish-language Vegas Golden Knights broadcasts, this role offers a unique opportunity to help grow the station's audience, strengthen its community presence, and build one of the market's most exciting Spanish-language media brands. 

About Beasley Media Group 

Beasley Media Group is a leading multiplatform media company delivering engaging content and innovative advertising solutions through its radio stations, digital platforms, and community partnerships.

As a Senior Industrial Engineer, you will serve as a key technical leader within QVC’s largest and most advanced fulfillment center. This is a highly visible and impactful role and you will lead meaningful impact as both a thought leader and a savvy change agent.

You'll lead high-impact initiatives spanning labor optimization, automation deployment, process design, facility layout, capacity planning, and operational analytics. From implementing advanced material handling technologies to developing scalable solutions that support future growth, you'll help shape the next generation of fulfillment at QVC.
You'll have the opportunity to influence decisions at both the site and network level while partnering with cross-functional leaders to solve complex operational challenges. If you're energized by data-driven decision making, large-scale operations, and creating innovative solutions that deliver measurable business results, this is the role for you.

This role is onsite and will require you to work from our Bethlehem, PA Fulfillment Center daily. Relocation assistance is not available for this role.
Work visa sponsorship will not be provided for this particular position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without QVC Group’s sponsorship.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as the senior engineering partner to site leadership, identifying, prioritizing, and executing opportunities that improve safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance.
  • Lead complex industrial engineering initiatives involving labor planning, process optimization, capacity analysis, workflow design, and facility layout improvements.
  • Develop data-driven solutions through statistical analysis, modeling, simulation, and operational research techniques to optimize labor utilization, throughput, and space utilization.
  • Partner with Operations, Automation, Technology, and Finance teams to evaluate, justify, and implement capital investments and automation technologies.

  • Lead implementation efforts for automation, process redesign, and operational transformation projects while ensuring successful adoption and sustainability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, Operations Engineering, or Supply Chain Engineering within distribution, fulfillment, manufacturing, or logistics environments.
  • Demonstrated experience driving process improvement initiatives, workflow optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Experience analyzing operational data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional stakeholders and operational leadership.
  • Ability to travel 15–25% to support multi-site projects and network initiatives.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading large-scale process improvement, facility design, automation, or operational transformation projects.
  • Strong understanding of fulfillment operations, labor planning, capacity modeling, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience with advanced analytics tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, R, or simulation software.

  • Lean Six Sigma or equivalent continuous improvement certification


Why Engineers Choose QVC

  • Lead projects that directly impact millions of customer orders annually.
  • Influence automation and fulfillment strategies across a multi-site distribution network.

  • Join a team that invests in innovation, technical expertise, and continuous learning.

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.


WBBM-TV, the CBS Owned & Operated station in Chicago, is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Anchor/Reporter (Sports) to help lead and shape our sports coverage across all platforms.


Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community.
We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms.

 

Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Anchor & Host: Lead energetic, authoritative sports segments on linear broadcasts; host high-profile station sports specials and digital/streaming original programming.
•    Multi-Platform Content Generation: Actively write, produce, and adapt sports content tailored specifically for linear TV, CBS News Chicago Streaming, CBSChicago.com, and key social platforms (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube).
•    Remote & Field Reporting: Anchor and report live on location from marquee sporting events, breaking sports news, and deep-dive feature assignments.
•    Modern Storytelling & Enterprise: Move beyond traditional game recaps to enterprise original, character-driven stories; contribute consistently to daily editorial meetings with ideas built for a modern, digital-first newsroom.
•    Digital & Social Strategy: Execute a proactive social media strategy to engage Chicago sports fans in real time, build community, break news, and drive audience tune-in across platforms.
•    Linear Writing & Segment Scripting: Write sharp, conversational copy and craft well-structured segments and package scripts designed for high-impact linear and streaming broadcasts.
•    Journalistic Integrity: Maintain strict journalistic standards, accuracy, and strong editorial judgment in a fast-paced, rapidly shifting multi-platform newsroom.

 

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:

Overview:

The Director of Global Title Marketing, Kids & Family is tasked with leading the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global marketing campaigns for select Paramount+ Kids & Family titles.   This role serves as a key cross-functional leader and steward of both individual titles and broader franchises. Developing campaigns that connect with kids across different age groups while also motivating parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.   The ideal candidate has solid marketing strategy skills and deep knowledge of kids entertainment, family viewing habits, and franchise building. They also understand how young audiences discover and engage with content as those habits keep changing. The Director must be a great leader, compelling storyteller, collaborative partner, and forward-thinking problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.   This is an onsite position at our New York or Burbank office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global go-to-market strategies
  • Translate series, film, character, and franchise attributes into differentiated campaign strategies that resonate with kids, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.
  • Develop audience strategies that account for distinct developmental stages, interests, viewing behaviors, and levels of parental influence across preschool, kids, tweens, teens, and family audiences.
  • Identify clear campaign objectives, audience priorities, strategic opportunities, and measures of success. Holding team members and partners accountable throughout campaign development and execution.
  • Apply a global perspective while recognizing regional differences in family dynamics, cultural relevance, content discovery, and children’s media consumption.
  • Ensure campaign strategies and executions are age-appropriate, inclusive, brand-safe, and aligned with applicable privacy, advertising, and platform guidelines.
  • Proactively identify key milestones, connect workstreams, resolve challenges, and ensure that creative and tactical executions ladder up to the overall strategy.
  • Brief cross-functional teams on campaign strategy so each discipline can develop a cohesive, audience-led plan.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and enthusiastic steward of assigned titles, characters, and franchises.
  • Build marketing strategies that support both the immediate title launch and long-term health, relevance, and growth
  • Partner with franchise, consumer products, licensing, retail, games, publishing, experiences, and other teams, where applicable. Creating related opportunities across the broader Paramount ecosystem.
  • Foster productive and trusting relationships with key stakeholders to ensure plans are developed and executed in a timely, collaborative, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain and build the team’s knowledge of the Kids & Family landscape, including audience behaviors, platform trends, franchise development, and responsible marketing practices.
  • Drive alignment among senior leadership and external partners. This includes: creators, executive producers, filmmakers, talent, studios, and co-production partners.
  • Clearly articulate the audience opportunity, campaign positioning, and strategic choices, behind recommendations.
  • Drive innovative thinking to develop 360-degree global stunts, partnerships, activations, and breakthrough campaign ideas that can generate excitement among kids and families.
  • Identify opportunities to bring titles and characters into the real world through family experiences, fan events, cultural moments, educational initiatives, and strategic brand partnerships.
  • Brief and lead “big idea” initiatives, managing internal teams and agency partners through execution.
  • Evaluate ideas through the distinct lenses of child appeal, parent or caregiver relevance, family participation, brand safety, and earned-media potential.
  • Partner with Media and Campaign Management teams to lead the development and execution of media campaigns across platforms that reach kids, parents, caregivers, and family audiences.
  • Understand the challenges of reaching young audiences. This includes streaming, digital video, social platforms, gaming environments, connected television, family programming, and media focused on parents.
  • Identify opportunities to reach parents and caregivers as content decision-makers while also building organic excitement and cultural relevance among young audiences.
  • Analyze audience research, campaign performance, competitive intelligence, and cultural trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy. Lead cross-functional reviews of awareness, consideration, engagement, viewing, acquisition, retention, co-viewing, repeat viewing, and franchise affinity. Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Combine quantitative data with qualitative audience knowledge. Recognizing that parents, caregivers, and children may each play different roles in content discovery and viewing decisions.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of entertainment marketing experience. With demonstrated experience developing campaigns for kids & family content, family entertainment, animation, or youth-focused brands.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience leading multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution and performance analysis.
  • Solid awareness of the distinct needs and behaviors of kids, tweens, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewing audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to market to young audiences responsibly and navigate relevant brand-safety, privacy, advertising, and platform considerations.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and a proven ability to manage relationships with senior internal stakeholders, creators, talent, filmmakers, studios, agencies, and external partners.
  • Robust strategic judgment and the ability to translate audience, cultural, creative, and business insights into actionable campaign strategies.
  • Data-driven marketer with experience analyzing campaign performance and applying learnings to optimize results.
  • Ability to manage multiple titles, priorities, and stakeholders within a dynamic and highly collaborative environment.
  • Exemplary written, verbal, and presentation skills, with solid attention to detail.
  • Experience marketing original series, films, animation, preschool content, or established Kids & Family franchises for a streaming service, studio, network, or entertainment brand.
  • Experience developing campaigns that speak to both young audiences and parents or caregivers.
  • Insight with emerging Kids & Family creators, platforms, fandoms, and digital content-discovery behaviors.
  • Experience developing global campaigns and adapting strategies for different markets and cultures.
  • Genuine affinity for Kids & Family entertainment, characters, storytelling, and fandom.
  • A collaborative spirit, creative instincts, and a great sense of humor.

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KPNX-TV in NBC is looking for a dynamic and engaging Meteorologist to join our passionate team. This position is responsible for preparing and delivering accurate weather reports on-air and online in a conversational manner. The key responsibility is the ability to gather and analyze information and alert our audiences about what’s going to happen with weather in their community. We are looking for a team player who can help with every aspect of meteorology, from forecasting, to preparing graphics, to reporting in the field, you will be an integral part of severe weather coverage, and reaching our consumers not only on TV, but online and on social media. The ideal candidate embraces new technology and is willing to explore new ways to present the weather story. As a central member of the WX department, the ideal candidate is a team player who participates in brainstorming and planning for future shows, including important weather events and explainers.  

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Provide accurate and compelling weather forecasts in a multi-platform environment
  • Prepare and deliver severe weather updates, interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Produce clean, creative and informative graphics to tell the weather story
  • Fill in on other shifts when necessary.
  • Write and report from the field or inside the newsroom
  • Update website and interact with viewers on social media platforms daily
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Make public appearances

Requirements: 

  • BA/BS degree in Meteorology, Geoscience or Atmospheric Science.
  • 5-7 YEARS on-air meteorology experience required
  • Be proficient at posting content to various websites and social media; computer literacy required, including weather and newsroom computer systems

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive– Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location:  This is a hybrid, outside sales role supporting a designated geographic territory (Langhorne, PA and surrounding region in Pennsylvania and New Jersey).  Success in this position requires regular in-market client and prospect in-person engagement. While much of the work is performed remotely and in the field, periodic attendance at a company office for meetings, training, collaboration, and business activities may be required.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs

Consultative, full-cycle sales

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career.

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive (Integrated Media Specialist) – sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive - Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a book of clients balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles.

Experience in media, digital marketing, advertising sales preferred.

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

job.description:
Job Description:

(You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.)

You Will:


As part of our Customer Insights team, you will support primary research projects providing exposure to qualitative and quantitative research. We are looking for someone who is curious, analytically minded, comfortable learning new tools and methods, and motivated to turn consumer feedback into clear, evidence-based insights.


In this role, you will gain hands-on experience across all phases of the research process from programming quantitative surveys to running statistical analyses and synthesizing findings into insights.


  • Survey Scripting & Execution: Program, test, and field quantitative surveys in Qualtrics, ensuring data quality, branching logic, and seamless respondent user experience.

  • Qualitative Synthesis & AI Augmentation: Review interview transcripts and session recordings to extract themes, customer quotes, and pain points leveraging AI-enabled tools.
  • Reporting: Assist in translating data into charts, tables and visualizations and narrative-driven presentations for cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Marketing, Economics, Social Sciences, Psychology, or a related field
  • Coursework or project experience in primary qualitative or quantitative research methods
