job.title: Program Manager, WP Studios
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post’s WP Studios team is seeking a highly organized and strategic Program Manager to lead the execution and delivery of custom advertising programs, branded content initiatives, and event-based sponsorships across digital, experiential, live, and emerging platforms.


This client-facing role serves as the primary owner of program execution and fulfillment, overseeing production timelines, creative development, event logistics, stakeholder alignment, operational workflows, and delivery from kickoff through launch, live execution, and post-campaign wrap-up. With a particular focus on event-based programs, the Program Manager will serve as a trusted partner to sponsors while coordinating across internal teams, venues, production partners, and external vendors to bring complex campaigns and experiences to life.


The ideal candidate combines strong program and production management expertise with operational judgment, cross-functional leadership, and creative problem-solving. This individual thrives in fast-paced environments, independently manages complex initiatives, proactively identifies risks and opportunities, and continuously looks for ways to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of WP Studios programs.


What Motivates You

  • Bringing complex, multi-platform ideas and live experiences to life through strong execution and collaboration.
  • Leading high-impact programs independently while balancing multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Building trusted relationships with clients, sponsors, agencies, and cross-functional partners.
  • Solving operational, creative, and event-production challenges proactively and with confidence.
  • Delivering innovative, high-quality advertising campaigns, branded content, and live or virtual experiences.
  • Anticipating risks, removing blockers, and keeping complex programs and activations on track.
  • Working collaboratively across creative, editorial, technical, event, and operational teams.
  • Continuously improving processes and identifying scalable solutions that support efficiency, consistency, and business growth.
  • Using data, automation, and AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to improve workflows and execution while maintaining strong human judgment and oversight.

How You'll Support the Mission


Program & Production Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end execution of custom advertising programs, branded content campaigns, and event activations across digital, experiential, live, and virtual platforms.
  • Independently manage programs from kickoff and planning through production, launch, live execution, optimization, and post-campaign wrap-up.
  • Translate sold programs into clear execution plans that align stakeholders, resources, timelines, deliverables, event logistics, and client expectations.
  • Evaluate operational feasibility, resourcing needs, and executional tradeoffs and recommend solutions that balance quality, scalability, and business priorities.

Event & Sponsorship Execution

  • Serve as the primary production point of contact for event and program sponsors, guiding them through onboarding, asset collection, approvals, fulfillment, and execution.
  • Manage sponsor deliverables and branded integrations, including logos, speaking briefs, digital assets, event signage, marketing materials, and on-site or virtual activations.
  • Partner with Events, Editorial, Marketing, Creative, Production, venues, and external vendors to deliver engaging live and virtual experiences.
  • Manage event-related timelines, logistics, dependencies, and sponsor requirements to ensure activations are delivered on time and according to specifications.

Project Management & Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a central point of coordination across Creative, Events, Editorial, Design, Development, Video, Audio, Ad Operations, Product, Marketing, and external partners.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project timelines, workflows, status reporting, and delivery documentation across multiple concurrent programs.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and executional gaps and implement mitigation plans to keep programs on track.
  • Navigate competing priorities, evolving stakeholder needs, and shifting timelines while maintaining delivery quality and accountability.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase operational efficiency, scalability, consistency, and program quality.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead day-to-day client and sponsor communication related to production timelines, deliverables, approvals, requirements, and execution strategy in partnership with Sales and Account Management.
  • Independently facilitate meetings and discussions with clients, agencies, sponsors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage feedback and approval processes to maintain alignment between client expectations and execution realities.
  • Serve as a trusted operational partner by communicating updates, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly and proactively.

Custom Product, Performance & Optimization

  • Collaborate with Ad Operations and Product teams to implement custom advertising solutions and event programs across platforms, ensuring custom elements are built, tested, quality-checked, and launched according to specifications.
  • Support social media, content distribution, promotional, and audience-engagement strategies in partnership with internal teams.
  • Partner with Account Management and Performance teams to monitor campaign delivery, attendee engagement, sponsorship effectiveness, and other relevant performance indicators.
  • Contribute production insights, custom metrics, event engagement data, and sponsor recap materials to post-campaign analysis and recommend opportunities to improve future execution and client outcomes.

Automation & Efficiency

  • Use AI-enabled and automation tools where appropriate to improve project tracking, scheduling, status reporting, meeting documentation, production coordination, quality assurance, and launch validation.
  • Explore opportunities to use emerging tools for audience insights, sponsorship reporting, risk identification, event planning, and activation support while maintaining strong human oversight, strategic judgment, and relationship management.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, production, account management, client services, or campaign execution within advertising, media, events, branded content, or related environments.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex, high-visibility, multi-stakeholder programs from initiation through delivery.
  • Experience executing custom, branded, or native advertising campaigns, including live or virtual event activations and sponsor fulfillment.
  • Strong understanding of digital media, content production, experiential logistics, advertising workflows, and integrated campaign execution.
  • Demonstrated experience managing sponsor or client relationships and leading communications with clients, agencies, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, project planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to proactively identify risks and drive solutions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across creative, editorial, technical, event production, and operational teams.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, navigate ambiguity, and drive execution with minimal oversight.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and project management platforms such as Asana, Jira, Prisma, or MediaOcean.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, workflow automation, collaboration, analytics, or reporting tools preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, or a related field preferred.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Analyst, Measurement & Insights
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description:

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Analyst, Measurements and Insights who is experienced in analysis of campaign performance data and campaign stories for clients advertising. You will support the Measurement team within The New York Times Advertising. You will turn campaign results into applicable findings for clients by using first- and third-party campaign metrics. You will help identify opportunities, bring the strategy and ongoing output of insights, innovate processes, methodologies, and reporting, directly affecting future business.
This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Manager, Insights and Analytics. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

This is a hands-on design role for a creative who can translate the value of all we offer — independent journalism and world-class lifestyle products — into clear, compelling campaigns that drive performance and deepen engagement with Games.

Reporting to the Associate Creative Director, Games, Marketing, you will work closely with writers, designers and our audio and video teams, as well as partners in marketing and media strategy, product design, audience insights and brand identity. You'll contribute to integrated campaigns across the full subscriber journey — from full-funnel product launches to subscriber acquisition campaigns to app store optimization efforts and more.

We are looking for a designer who is passionate about both exceptional craft and the collaborative process it takes to create it. You thrive at the intersection of brand and performance, are excited to contribute directly to growth and product marketing initiatives, and partner with more senior creative leaders on the team.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can expect to come into the office three days per week.

  • Contribute to the development and execution of conceptual, visually compelling campaigns and always-on marketing creative for Games, ensuring work supports awareness, consideration, conversion and retention goals.

  • Design and adapt campaign creative across paid, owned and earned channels, including digital, social, email, in-app placements, app stores and OOH, in line with The Times' brand standards.

  • Translate in-product experiences and key feature benefits into clear, marketing assets that deepen engagement and drive habitual product use.

  • Support the in-house adaptation and extension of major brand campaigns, collaborating with creative leaders and agency partners to build cohesive executions across all channels.

  • Help develop and maintain scalable visual systems, templates and libraries that enable rapid testing and iteration while upholding a high bar for design quality and brand consistency.

  • Partner with other designers, art directors, writers and marketers to concept, refine and ship creative that increases subscriptions and engagement with our journalism and products.

  • Work from creative briefs, participate in reviews, and incorporate feedback from stakeholders, staying comfortable with shifts in strategy or approach based on the news cycle or business needs.

  • Assist in creating clear, compelling presentation materials and articulate the rationale behind your design decisions to a broad group of colleagues, including leadership.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to the Associate Creative Director, Games, Marketing.

  • 5+ years of hands-on graphic design experience at an advertising agency, digital agency, studio or in-house team, with a focus on marketing or advertising creative.

  • A design portfolio that shows sharp execution and conceptual thinking across a range of touch points — including social, digital display, email, in-app and print — and demonstrates how your design choices clarify complex ideas for different audiences across the funnel.

  • High proficiency in the formal elements of design, including typography, layout, balance, hierarchy, proportion, color, emphasis and unity, with a refined aesthetic and strong attention to detail from concept through production.

  • Fluency with design and motion tools such as Figma, and Adobe Creative Suite, with files that support iteration, collaboration and production.

  • Hands-on motion and animation experience in After Effects.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with partners in marketing strategy, media, product design, audience insights and brand identity, and enthusiasm for collaborating on campaigns that not only look great but also perform.

  • Understanding of trends in digital advertising and growth marketing, plus familiarity with the latest social media ecosystem and how brands show up in a way that feels authentic.

  • A background in subscription, media or content businesses, with familiarity in how brand, product marketing, and performance media work together across the funnel.

  • Experience working in video editing software and a working knowledge of on set video production for social channels.

  • Interest in exploring new tools and workflows — including emerging AI production tools — to improve both efficiency and creative quality.

Although you will not be responsible for writing media plans, you are comfortable and expert in guiding internal teams as well as clients in making smart and creative media choices.
  • Client Deliverable Development: You are experienced in owning and creating client-ready visual proposals that are polished and inspiring.

  • Co-lead resourcing across the Strategy Team
  • Consult with Sales leadership to improve processes, practices and strategic deliverables

  • Use research and data to articulate and support sales stories
  • Author and deliver creative briefs on sometimes-tight turnarounds
  • Create and guide others in the creation of powerful proposals with effective storytelling that responds to client needs and telegraphs the value of NYT media offerings

  • Manage internal senior team members, communicating proposal and program status to management

job.title: Executive Assistant (Legal and HR)
job.description:
The Executive Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative support to senior Legal and Human Resources leaders, including the Chief Human Resources Officer, General Counsel, and Assistant General Counsel. Key responsibilities include managing legal invoicing and department finances, supporting litigation efforts, and coordinating executive calendars, correspondence, contracts, and travel arrangements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and discreet, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple executives and handle sensitive legal and employee information with the utmost confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

• Support the chief human resources officer, general counsel, assistant general counsel, and other HR leaders in administrative tasks

• Conduct initial intake of calls and correspondence to the legal and HR teams, including complaints, threats of litigation and service of process

• Complete a wide range of administrative tasks (e.g., submitting expense reports, processing invoices, completing company forms, coordinating meeting logistics, assisting guests with building access, etc.)

• Prioritize conflicting needs, handle matters expeditiously, proactively, and confidentially while following through on a variety of special requests to completion, often with deadline pressures.

• Manage and organize the executive files, documents, and records in both physical and electronic formats. The ability to create and maintain an organized filing system with highly confidential and sensitive material is essential for efficient and secure information management.

• Organize, execute, and/or assist with internal and external meetings and events (i.e., off-site, team gatherings, and other events), including helping to prepare presentations for such meetings

• Provide discovery support services to inside and outside counsel who are responding to litigations

• Prepare initial draft documents, compile requested information, and assist with formatting and editing

• Prepare Executives for meetings by conducting pre-meeting briefings, developing draft meeting agendas, taking and disseminating notes and action items

• Provide support to the executives on various projects and initiatives. Conduct research, gather data and prepare reports and presentations as needed. Monitor project timelines and ensure that deliverables are met.

• Minimum of 3+ years’ progressive experience as an assistant supporting multiple executives within a fast-paced environment, preferably supporting attorneys and human resources professionals.

job.title: LA Galaxy, Sr Manager, Ticket Sales
job.description:
LA Galaxy is where soccer, culture, and community come together. As one of Major League Soccer’s most storied clubs, the Galaxy deliver unforgettable matchdays and moments that connect fans across Los Angeles and beyond.

Owned by AEG, the LA Galaxy are powered by teams who bring energy, creativity, and commitment to everything they do, from matchday operations and fan engagement to the work that happens behind the scenes. Every role plays a part in shaping the experience on and off the pitch and building a club that reflects the city it represents.   If you want to be part of a team where your work shows up live, in real time, and in front of passionate fans, there’s a place for you here. Because on matchday, it happens here.

Job Summary

The Sr Manager, Ticket Sales leads the strategic direction, daily operations, and performance of the Full Season Account Executive team and oversees the Inside Sales function through direct management and development of the Inside Sales Manager. This role drives season ticket sales initiatives, establishes and cascades goals, coaches and develops sales talent, and ensures consistent execution of pipeline management, onboarding, training, and performance standards. The Sr. Manager works closely with all other managers across the sales organization to align priorities, launch campaigns, strengthen career pathways, recruit high-performing talent, and deliver revenue growth and an engaging team culture.

Essential Functions

  • Lead team meetings and general sales meetings; communicate priorities, reinforce accountability, and foster a collaborative, high-energy sales culture.
  • Launch and manage season ticket campaigns and sales contests; cascade department goals to representatives and track progress against weekly, monthly, and annual targets.
  • Coach and manage the performance of Full Season Account Executives and directly manage and develop the Inside Sales Manager; provide regular feedback, conduct evaluations, and support sustained performance and professional growth.
  • Review individual and team pipelines, activity, conversion, and forecasting; provide actionable direction and report performance insights to sales leadership. Work closely with all other managers to align priorities, share best practices, and coordinate execution across teams.
  • Establish lead-distribution rules and service-level expectations, partnering with the CRM Coordinator on execution, quality control, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee Inside Sales onboarding through the Inside Sales Manager, including ramp plans, certification standards, and cohort management; define and support the promotion path from Inside Sales to Account Executive.
  • Roll out sales guidebooks and related training; recruit, interview, hire, and onboard Account Executives and Inside Sales representatives in close partnership with the Inside Sales Manager and other managers.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) In a related field
  • 4-6 years Related ticket sales experience
  • Prior experience leading, coaching, and managing sales teams and people managers
  • Experience recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and developing sales talent
  • Proven ability to set, cascade, and achieve sales goals through disciplined execution.
  • Strong coaching, performance management, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in pipeline reviews, forecasting, KPI analysis, and CRM-based lead management.
  • Ability to build onboarding plans, certification programs, training resources, and career pathways.
  • Excellent organization, prioritization, and ability to collaborate closely with managers across teams.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Experience in professional sports ticket sales or service preferred

Payscale: $87,919.00 - $97,500.00

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

     

Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

 Job Purpose

The Assistant Finance Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day finance operations of FT Japan while supporting assigned finance activities across other Asia entities. The role ensures the delivery of accurate financial reporting, strong financial controls, and full compliance with local statutory requirements and FT Group policies.

Working closely with regional Accounting Services and Finance teams across APAC and the UK, the Assistant Finance Manager serves as a key finance business partner, driving continuous process improvement, promoting strong governance, and supporting efficient finance operations across the assigned areas of responsibility.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Control

  • Lead the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close processes to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations and investigate outstanding items to ensure completeness and accuracy.
  • Review financial results, perform variance analysis, and explain key movements.
  • Monitor cash flow requirements to support day-to-day business operations.
  • Ensure compliance with FT Group accounting policies and IFRS.
     

Statutory & Tax Compliance

  • Coordinate statutory reporting requirements and annual external audits.
  • Liaise with external auditors, tax advisers and regulatory authorities.
  • Prepare and review corporate tax, consumption tax and other statutory filings.
  • Monitor changes in Japanese accounting and tax regulations and assess their impact on the business.
  • Ensure timely completion of all statutory and compliance obligations.
     

Compliance & Internal Control

  • Maintain effective financial controls and ensure compliance with FT policies and global standards.
  • Support internal and external audit activities and ensure timely implementation of audit recommendations.
  • Maintain finance procedures, process documentation and control frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through process automation and standardisation.
     

Accounting Services Collaboration

  • Act as the primary Finance contact for the regional Accounting Services team.
  • Partner with Accounting Services to ensure the accurate and timely completion of month-end accounting activities.
  • Collaborate with Accounting Services to investigate and resolve accounting issues promptly.
  • Contribute to regular operational meetings with Accounting Services by identifying and resolving operational issues, agreeing action plans, and monitoring progress.
  • Work with regional Finance teams to identify opportunities for process improvements and enhance service delivery.
     

Treasury & Banking

  • Manage banking administration, payment processing, and cash management activities.
  • Ensure timely and accurate execution of supplier, employee, tax, and statutory payments.
  • Maintain appropriate banking controls and payment authorisation procedures.
     

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or participate in finance transformation initiatives and regional projects.
  • Support the implementation of new systems, finance processes and policy changes.
  • Drive process improvements to increase efficiency, strengthen controls and reduce operational risk.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and standardise finance processes across the assigned areas of responsibility.
     

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships with Finance teams across APAC and the UK.
  • Collaborate with HR, Legal, Procurement, IT and other business functions.
  • Provide guidance and support to internal stakeholders on finance-related matters.
  • Work effectively with external advisers, banks, auditors and government authorities.
     

Operational Leadership

  • Act as an operational leader within the FT Japan Finance team, fostering collaboration and accountability in day-to-day operations.
  • Coordinate finance activities across multiple stakeholders to ensure the timely delivery of key objectives.
  • Drive the timely resolution of operational issues through effective collaboration with Accounting Services and business teams.
  • Support finance projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Promote best practices, share knowledge, and contribute to the development of an effective and high-performing Finance team.
     

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
  • CPA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.
     

Experience

  • Minimum of five years' experience in accounting, financial reporting or financial control.
  • Experience in a multinational organisation is preferred.
  • Experience managing statutory reporting, external audits and tax compliance.
  • Experience working with shared service centres or outsourced accounting functions is preferred.
  • Experience using Oracle or other ERP systems.
  • Proven experience in driving process improvements and strengthening financial controls.
     

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and journal entry preparation and review.
  • Strong reconciliation and financial analysis skills.
  • Knowledge of IFRS.
  • Good understanding of Japanese statutory accounting and tax requirements.
  • Experience with Oracle or other financial reporting systems.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
     

Language

  • Business-level proficiency in both Japanese and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with local and international stakeholders.
     

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills.
  • Ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.

 

This role will be offered initially on a 1-year fixed term contract, with the intention from there to convert to a permanent role. 

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

We are looking for a detail-oriented finance professional to join our Finance team and support a broad range of accounting, supplier management, statutory compliance, audit, and fixed asset activities.

Working closely with the Financial Accountant and wider Finance team, you will help ensure that financial records, transactions, and supporting documentation are accurate, complete, and maintained in line with internal controls and Philippine regulatory requirements. The role will also involve regular coordination with suppliers, internal stakeholders, auditors, banks, and government agencies.

This is a great opportunity for a qualified CPA with audit and accounting experience who is looking to build broader hands-on experience across financial operations, compliance, and reporting within a fast-paced, international organisation.

Key responsibilities

Supplier and Invoice Management

  • Verify vendor onboarding requirements and coordinate the creation or update of vendor records.
  • Prepare Purchase Requisition (PR) and Purchase Order (PO) requests and follow up on pending approvals.
  • Review quotations, supplier invoices, and supporting documents for completeness and compliance with documentation requirements prior to processing.
  • Maintain and monitor the filing of supplier invoices, official receipts, and other related documents.
  • Assist in preparing payment batches, bank instructions, and supporting documents for supplier, payroll, tax, and other disbursements.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding pending invoices, payment status, and outstanding supporting documentation.
  • Request supplier statements and aging reports and reconcile outstanding balances for review.
  • Prepare BIR Forms 2307 and maintain related supporting records.
  • Assist the Financial Accountant in preparing supplier management and accounts payable-related reports.

Financial Accounting Support

  • Prepare routine journal entry templates and supporting schedules for review and posting.
  • Prepare assigned balance sheet reconciliation schedules and supporting documentation for review.
  • Maintain accounting files, schedules, and records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and proper filing.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities by preparing supporting schedules, documents, and standard reports.
  • Extract financial data and prepare standard reports and analyses requested by the Finance team.

Tax and Statutory Compliance Support

  • Prepare supporting schedules and documentation required for BIR, PEZA, and other applicable government and regulatory submissions.
  • Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual BIR tax returns and supporting schedules for review.
  • Maintain tax compliance files and ensure statutory records and supporting documentation are complete and properly organized.
  • Monitor documentary requirements and compliance deadlines assigned to the role and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Coordinate document requests from government agencies, banks, auditors, and external consultants.

Audit and Internal Control Support

  • Organize audit schedules and supporting documents for internal and external audits.
  • Coordinate routine audit document requests and follow up with relevant stakeholders on outstanding requirements.
  • Ensure accounting records and supporting documentation are complete, properly filed, and readily available for review.
  • Assist in monitoring compliance with internal finance policies, controls, and documentation requirements.
  • Maintain finance process documentation, checklists, and standard operating procedures.

 Administrative and Operational Support

  • Coordinate intercompany documentation, approvals, and filing of supporting records.
  • Assist stakeholders with expenditure coding requests and finance documentation requirements.
  • Track finance-related action items and follow up on outstanding requests with internal and external parties.
  • Support finance system administration by maintaining user records, templates, and standard master data, where applicable.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and special projects assigned by the Finance Manager.
  • Perform other finance-related duties as assigned.

Fixed Asset Administration

  • Maintain the Company's Fixed Asset Register and supporting documentation, including records of asset additions, disposals, and transfers.
  • Prepare fixed asset additions, disposals, transfers, and related documentation for review and recording.
  • Prepare PEZA fixed asset reports, applications, and supporting documentation for review and submission within prescribed deadlines.
  • Coordinate with PEZA, suppliers, and internal stakeholders regarding fixed asset documentation and compliance requirements.
  • Conduct periodic physical verification and inventory counts of fixed assets, identify discrepancies, and prepare reconciliation reports for review.
  • Assist in reconciling the Fixed Asset Register against accounting records and physical inventory.
  • Coordinate and perform fixed asset tagging and maintain asset identification records.
  • Maintain fixed asset files, purchase documentation, importation records, and other supporting documents for audit and regulatory purposes.
  • Prepare schedules and supporting documents for fixed asset reviews and audits conducted by internal auditors, external auditors, and government agencies.

Required skills and experience 

  • Bachelor's degree in Accountancy or a related field.
  • Must be a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
  • Must have 2–5 years of relevant work experience in external or internal audit, preferably with exposure to financial statement audits, accounting processes, and internal controls.
  • Working knowledge of Philippine accounting and regulatory requirements, including applicable BIR, SEC, and PEZA rules and regulations.
  • Experience in general accounting, financial reporting, account reconciliations, and preparation of supporting schedules is preferred.
  • Must have experience using financial accounting software and/or ERP systems.
  • Advanced MS Excel skills
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to review financial information and supporting documentation accurately.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced finance environment.

job.title: Principal Engineer - Integration Services
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

About you

You are an experienced Principal Engineer or senior engineering leader with a strong background in enterprise integration, shared engineering services or platform capabilities.

You have experience working across multiple teams and technology domains, with the judgement to distinguish between capabilities that should be centrally owned and standardised and those that should remain within individual engineering teams.

You are comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels. You can define a direction for shared integration and engineering capabilities while still engaging deeply enough with architecture, engineering practices, reliability and delivery to make credible technical decisions.

You are also an experienced people leader who can build and develop senior engineers and create a high-performing team around a new capability. You are able to influence teams without relying solely on formal authority and can establish common approaches where responsibilities have historically been distributed.

You understand that shared services succeed only when they are useful to the teams that depend on them. You therefore approach platform and integration engineering pragmatically, balancing standardisation and reuse with the needs of individual products and domains.

About the team

Integration Services sits within Internal Products and provides shared engineering capabilities that enable connectivity, automation and engineering quality across the organisation.

The capability spans enterprise integrations, reusable engineering services and quality engineering practices that support multiple products, platforms and teams across Internal Products.

As the FT continues to evolve its enterprise technology landscape and undertake significant transformation, the need for consistent, reusable and reliable integration capabilities is increasing.

Two major programmes are currently running in parallel and both depend heavily on shared integration capabilities across multiple platforms and teams. At present, responsibilities are distributed across different parts of the organisation, creating risks around fragmented ownership, duplicated solutions, inconsistent approaches and limited reuse.

The Principal Engineer – Integration Services will establish and lead this capability, creating clear ownership for shared services while ensuring the team remains closely connected to the engineering teams and domains it supports.

What you’ll work on

As Principal Engineer – Integration Services, you will establish and lead the Integration Services capability across Internal Products.

You will own the technical direction, engineering capability, people leadership, delivery and operational performance of shared integration and engineering services.

A key part of the role will be defining what should become a reusable Internal Products capability and what should remain owned within individual domains. You will establish common integration approaches, reusable services and engineering patterns that reduce duplication and make it easier for teams to connect systems safely and reliably.

You will provide senior technical leadership across major transformation programmes, including the Commercial Technology Programme, ensuring integration decisions made within individual programmes contribute to a coherent and sustainable technology estate.

You will also build and develop the team itself, establishing the engineering capability, operating model and ways of working required for a successful shared service organisation.

Your responsibilities will include

Integration Strategy & Technical Direction

  • Defining the technical direction for integration services across Internal Products.
  • Establishing principles, standards and reusable patterns for enterprise integration.
  • Developing a clear strategy for shared integration capabilities, balancing centralisation, reuse and domain autonomy.
  • Identifying opportunities to simplify integration architecture, reduce duplication and improve interoperability.
  • Providing technical leadership on significant integration decisions spanning multiple platforms, teams and domains.
  • Ensuring integration approaches consider security, resilience, scalability, observability, operability and long-term maintainability.
  • Working with Architecture and senior engineering leaders to align integration direction with wider FT technology strategy.
  • Establishing a clear view of the integration landscape, including major interfaces, dependencies, ownership and technical risks.

Shared Services & Platform Engineering

  • Defining and building reusable integration services and engineering capabilities that solve common problems across Internal Products.
  • Establishing clear ownership for shared services and ensuring they have sustainable operational and engineering models.
  • Ensuring shared capabilities provide genuine value to consuming teams rather than becoming additional layers of complexity.
  • Setting appropriate expectations for reliability, performance, scalability, security and service availability.
  • Establishing effective lifecycle management for shared platforms and services.
  • Identifying opportunities for standardisation, consolidation and reuse.
  • Ensuring teams have clear guidance on when to use shared services and when to build capability within their own domains.

Engineering Quality & Automation

  • Establishing and evolving quality engineering capabilities that improve the reliability and confidence of software delivery across Internal Products.
  • Promoting consistent engineering practices around testing, automation, CI/CD and quality assurance where appropriate.
  • Identifying recurring quality problems across teams and developing reusable approaches to address them.
  • Working with engineering leaders to improve automated testing, release confidence and software quality.
  • Encouraging engineering teams to treat quality as part of engineering ownership rather than a separate activity.
  • Using metrics, operational insight and engineering feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Strategic Programmes & Transformation

  • Providing senior engineering leadership to major transformation programmes, including the Commercial Technology Programme.
  • Working across programme teams to establish coherent integration strategies across multiple platforms and workstreams.
  • Challenging programme-specific solutions where they create unnecessary duplication, complexity or long-term dependency.
  • Ensuring integration decisions made during transformation can be sustainably operated and evolved after programme delivery ends.
  • Supporting technology and vendor evaluations where integration architecture is a material consideration.
  • Helping programmes distinguish between capabilities that should be delivered as reusable Internal Products services and those that are specific to an individual initiative.

People & Engineering Leadership

  • Leading and developing the engineers within Integration Services.
  • Establishing a high-performing team with clear responsibilities, strong engineering standards and appropriate technical ownership.
  • Coaching senior engineers and developing technical leadership capability within the team.
  • Building an environment that encourages collaboration, constructive technical challenge and knowledge sharing.
  • Recruiting and developing the specialist skills required to build a sustainable integration capability.
  • Creating succession and reducing key-person dependency across critical integration knowledge.
  • Establishing clear expectations for engineering quality, operational performance and delivery.
  • Building strong relationships with engineering leaders across Internal Products so the shared capability is embedded rather than operating as a separate silo.

Delivery & Planning

  • Establishing a roadmap for the development and evolution of shared integration services.
  • Prioritising investment across reusable capabilities, programme commitments, operational work and technical improvement.
  • Working with Product and engineering leaders to understand demand for shared services and translate this into realistic delivery plans.
  • Managing capacity and ensuring the team can support both strategic initiatives and ongoing operational responsibilities.
  • Identifying dependencies and delivery risks across consuming teams and programmes.
  • Providing clear visibility of progress, risks, trade-offs and technical constraints.

Operational Excellence & Reliability

  • Owning the operational performance of shared integration services.
  • Establishing appropriate approaches to monitoring, observability, incident management, problem management and operational readiness.
  • Ensuring critical integrations have clear ownership, appropriate resilience and effective recovery mechanisms.
  • Leading the response to significant incidents affecting shared services and coordinating resolution across dependent teams.
  • Using operational data and incident learning to identify systemic improvements.
  • Ensuring operational responsibilities are sustainable and do not depend disproportionately on individual engineers.

Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Building strong working relationships with Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, architects and senior engineers across Internal Products.
  • Establishing effective mechanisms for teams to engage with Integration Services early in the lifecycle of significant initiatives.
  • Helping teams understand integration trade-offs and select appropriate patterns and capabilities.
  • Coordinating decisions where integration ownership crosses domain boundaries.
  • Encouraging reuse and consistency without imposing unnecessary central control.
  • Representing Integration Services in relevant architecture, engineering and technology forums across the FT.

Vendor & Technology Partner Management

  • Providing technical leadership in relationships with integration technology vendors and implementation partners.
  • Challenging vendor-led solutions where they conflict with long-term FT engineering direction or create unnecessary dependency.
  • Ensuring external partners complement rather than replace internal engineering capability.
  • Contributing to technology evaluation, procurement and platform selection decisions.
  • Ensuring partner-delivered work meets FT engineering, security, quality and operational expectations.

Technical and leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in a Principal Engineer, senior engineering leadership or comparable technical leadership role.
  • Strong experience designing, building and operating enterprise integration capabilities at scale.
  • Deep understanding of integration architecture, APIs, event-driven systems, messaging, data flows and distributed systems.
  • Experience establishing reusable engineering services or shared platform capabilities across multiple teams.
  • Experience defining technical standards, engineering patterns or platform strategies across organisational boundaries.
  • Experience leading significant transformation programmes involving multiple platforms, teams and integrations.
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies and modern engineering practices, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS ecosystems and integrating them with internally developed applications.
  • Experience with quality engineering, test automation, CI/CD and engineering productivity practices would be advantageous.
  • Experience leading and developing senior engineers and technical specialists.
  • Experience establishing new teams, capabilities or operating models would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong experience influencing teams and senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Experience identifying and addressing duplicated capabilities, technical debt and fragmented ownership across complex technology estates.
  • Strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational excellence.
  • Experience working with vendors and implementation partners while maintaining clear internal technical ownership.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience balancing strategic technical direction with practical delivery realities.

Characteristics we value

  • Strong technical judgement and the confidence to make decisions across organisational boundaries.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Pragmatism when balancing standardisation, reuse and the needs of individual engineering teams.
  • The ability to influence without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • A collaborative approach to building shared capabilities that teams want to use.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to understand problems across the wider technology estate rather than optimising a single domain.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills, particularly when developing senior engineers.
  • An instinct for reducing unnecessary complexity and duplication.
  • Confidence challenging established approaches constructively.
  • Calm and clear decision-making during complex delivery and operational situations.
  • An appreciation for reusable, sustainable and well-engineered technology capabilities.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. This role will be based in Singapore and work closely with FT colleagues in the region. It will report into an EP in London, liaising closely with the core team based there.

 Key Responsibilities

  • Creatively develop and lead multimedia projects from ideation to completion, with minimal guidance from an Executive Producer, including but not limited to documentaries, animations, podcasts, digital interactives, and articles
  • Work with an Executive Producer to execute the delivery of larger projects that require more oversight
  • Work with clients and the Client Solutions team to develop a content strategy, creative and editorial direction, and establish clear project communication
  • Act as a content lead on campaigns, developing professional relationships with clients, and confidently discussing content ideas
  • Ensure the content supports the client’s brand goals while upholding the values of the Financial Times
  • Manage the end-to-end production process on multiple campaigns, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders
  • Troubleshoot multiple projects simultaneously
  • Write creative briefs for designers
  • Develop and write video scripts
  • Direct video shoots and post-production – this may require travel and flexible working hours
  • Review, test, and proofread content before sending to clients
  • Stay up-to-date on global business trends and FT trending topics
  • Drive content innovation by staying on top of branded content trends and proposing original ideas and new formats
  • Advise on social media and video analytics strategy where needed to assist in the performance of multimedia content
  • Work with Executive Producers and the Client Solutions team to assist in the ideation and development of content proposals
  • Work with the Global Client Services team to assist in the integration of new ways to serve clients
  • Work with Senior Production Manager to help develop effective workflows and processes
  • Actively contribute to FT Studio’s positive working culture by being a team player

Required Skills / Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in video and digital content production
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and manage teams effectively
  • Strong understanding of journalistic storytelling and editorial processes, with the ability to translate complex subjects into compelling, audience-first content
  • Demonstrable experience developing content for business audiences, with a strong understanding of B2B communications and thought leadership.
  • Experience working with clients in financial services, professional services, technology or other complex, regulated sectors
  • Expertise leading video teams, designers and developers to create video and digital content
  • Strong understanding of how editorial credibility and commercial objectives can be balanced to create high-quality branded content
  • Proven track record of success working in a fast-moving agency setting or complex multi-stakeholder environment with a tolerance for ambiguity
  • Degree or demonstrable interest or experience in a related field (e.g. Communications, Media Production, Journalism, Marketing)
  • Excellent command of English; ability to speak any local languages in Asia is a plus
  • Previous working experience in the Asian Pacific region will be advantageous

job.title: Intern, Membership & Industry Relations (Washington D.C. Chapter)
job.description:
INTERNSHIP DETAILS

 

SPRING INTERNSHIP 

APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR STUDENTS: 11/20/2026 

SPRING INTERNSHIP PROGRAM DATES: 1/11/2027 – 4/16/2027 

*The Washington D.C. Chapter Intern position pays county/state minimum wage rates, based on work location. 


 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

 

The Recording Academy Washington D.C. Chapter is seeking a “rock star” student for a spring 2027 Internship with our team. 


Celebrating music through the Grammy® Awards, The Recording Academy continues its legacy as the premier national organization for honoring achievements in the recording arts and supporting the music community. As a membership organization, we represent the most talented music professionals in the world. Our members include recording artists, producers, engineers, attorneys, music supervisors, composers/arrangers, managers, agents, social media and record label executives and many others. 


Our paid Internship Program offers a unique opportunity for full-time college students (juniors or seniors) to gain on-site training in office administration, events management and artist relations, in exchange for college credit. Candidates should be energetic, hard-working and have aspirations of a career in the music industry. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 

  • Internship duration is for a semester (12 weeks or equivalent). 
  • Hours are part-time (20-24 hours a week). 
  • Intern will work with the chapter office on local events during regular business hours as well as some evenings and weekends. 
  • Internship will provide in-depth exposure to professional recording industry techniques and practices. 
  • Projects may include assistance with event management, educational programs, newsletters, membership recruitment, database management, demographics analysis, and administrative office support. 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE  

 

  • Currently enrolled in a college/university. One year of course work towards degree in related field is preferred. 
  • Letter from school stating that intern will receive college credit for the Recording Academy internship. 
  • Display an interest in music and commitment to a career in the recording industry. 
  • Possess strong verbal, written and analytical skills. 
  • Exhibit proficient computer skills. 
  • Be a junior, senior or graduate student. 



PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES:   

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time. The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.   

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES 

 

RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators. 

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation. 

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION 

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives. 

 

MUSICARES 

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs. 

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM 

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include GRAMMY in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

job.title: Data Steward - People Platforms
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.
  • Maintain and update data quality rules as business requirements and source systems evolve, under the direction of the Data Manager.

Role Purpose

As Incident Manager for the WPP Open Platform, you will own the end to end incident management lifecycle from detection through resolution to post incident review   ensuring platform stability, SLA compliance, and transparent communication across all stakeholders.

This is not a traditional incident management role. You will be expected to design, build, and continuously improve automated incident management workflows that connect our toolchain   Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp   into a seamless, intelligent, and low friction incident response system.

You will serve as the central coordination point for all P1 and P2 incidents, driving rapid resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and proactive prevention.   • Perform post incident reviews and drive root cause analysis (RCA) with actionable preventive measures
  • Track and report on incident metrics, SLA performance, MTTR, MTTD, and repeat incident trends

  • Design and implement automated incident workflows across the full toolchain: Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp

  • Configure Jira automation rules for incident ticket creation, priority routing, SLA timers, escalation triggers, and post incident task generation
  • Automate customer facing communication through Intercom and Zendesk   including incident acknowledgement messages, progress updates, and resolution notifications
  • Build WhatsApp and Teams notification workflows for executive and stakeholder briefings during critical incidents
  • Maintain and improve Confluence automation for RCA templates, incident documentation, and runbook generation triggered by incident closure
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting tools (Datadog, Statuspage, PagerDuty) with the communication stack to ensure zero gap detection to notification flows
  • Continuously evaluate and improve automation coverage   reducing manual steps, improving response speed, and ensuring consistency across all incident communication channels

Process & Knowledge Management

  • Develop, maintain, and enforce incident management playbooks, runbooks, and escalation procedures
  • Build and maintain a centralized incident knowledge base in Confluence   ensuring learnings from every major incident are captured and actioned
  • Define and own the post incident review process   including templates, timelines, and accountability tracking for preventive actions
  • Identify recurring incident patterns and work proactively with engineering teams to eliminate root causes
  • Drive continuous improvement of incident detection, response, and communication processes

  • Own all incident communications   internal (engineering, product, leadership) and external (agency users via Intercom/Zendesk/Statuspage)
  • Produce regular incident reports, trend analyses, and SLA performance summaries for leadership and stakeholders
  • Present post incident reviews and improvement plans to the Support Manager and Platform leadership
  • Maintain stakeholder notification lists and communication templates across all channels

Collaboration

  • Work closely with L1/L2 Support Engineers and the Team Lead to ensure smooth ticket triage, escalation, and handover during incidents
  • Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to improve platform observability, alerting quality, and deployment safety
  • Collaborate with Product teams to communicate platform stability status and incident impact on feature delivery

  • Proven experience owning P1/P2 incident response end to end   coordination, communication, escalation, and resolution

  • Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent incidents calmly and effectively under pressure

  • Confluence: Automation templates, structured documentation, RCA frameworks, space management

  • Proven ability to remain composed and authoritative under pressure during major incidents
  • Strong stakeholder management skills   comfortable presenting to senior leadership during and after incidents

Desirable Skills

job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including pod-casts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs over 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

 

On a day to day basis you will:

  • Process daily payable invoices, check requests, and employee expense reimbursements in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and update invoice journals for consistent and accurate entries.
  • Process weekly check runs.
  • Coordinate weekly check runs, ensuring accuracy and adherence to payment schedules.
  • Support the maintenance of an organized and up-to-date electronic invoice filing system.
  • Accurately code invoices using the Ministry’s chart of accounts and appropriate financial dimensions.
  • Collaborate with vendors and Team Members to resolve discrepancies and reconcile vendor accounts.
  • Communicate professionally with vendors, leadership, and other departments to address payment inquiries.
  • Work effectively with colleagues across the Accounting Operations team to ensure shared responsibilities are met.
  • Participate in special projects or assignments as directed by the Accounting Operations Supervisor.

 

Background and qualifications needed:

  • Minimum of six months of financial processing (payables, receivables, donor processing), or related experience.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare reports and speak effectively with vendors and fellow team members.
  • Ability to define problems collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.
  • Strong computer skills; proficient in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).  Experience with NetSuite preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently; establishing and meeting performance/ministry goals.
  • Exhibits versatility and flexibility. Adapts to change while maintaining a positive attitude and high productivity.

 

Employment Requirements:

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

 

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and the promotion of equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is also a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.
