job.title: BROADCAST JOURNALIST: ARTS & CULTURE
job.description:
BROADCAST JOURNALIST: ARTS & CULTURE


Aspen Public Radio is a 45-year-old public media organization serving the vibrant Roaring Fork and Colorado River valleys, nestled in the heart of the Rocky Mountains. We seek a sharp, curious, and team-oriented person with a passion for covering the arts. Our culture is friendly and familiar, but we are professional broadcasters with high standards.


Who We Are Looking For:

We seek an experienced broadcast journalist with a strong skill set that includes reporting, writing, producing, and anchoring. We are looking for someone who is, above all, a good reporter and a team player. We also want you to be a strong writer, have solid broadcast production skills, and be comfortable delivering live newscasts and conducting live interviews on the air. Among other duties, you will be covering a fun and interesting beat that is focused on the local arts and culture sector throughout our coverage area, including both hard and soft news related to nonprofits and arts and cultural organizations and events.


On this beat, you will cover major events throughout our coverage region, such as X Games, Aspen Gay Ski Week, Aspen IdeasFest, and the annual Food & Wine Classic; internationally renowned institutions including the Aspen Institute, the Aspen Music Festival and School, and Jazz Aspen Snowmass; vibrant local arts organizations such as Carbondale Clay Center, The Performing Arts Center at Willis (TACAW), Aspen Words, the Anderson Ranch Arts Center, and countless other events and organizations large and small.


This broadcast journalist will join a growing team, under the direction of News Director Sage Smiley, responsible for bringing ideas forward that advance how the power of radio can be used to tell meaningful stories. You are a multitasker, able to work on in-depth stories and breaking news pieces simultaneously, and you care deeply about connecting with our unique community in a way that continually improves our public service to our community’s diverse stakeholders.


As a small station, every member of our news team is required to support evening breaking news and production duties (one day per week), weekend coverage (approx. once a month), and take substitute host shifts as needed. It is also assumed that each beat reporter will have approximately 25% of their coverage responsibilities held for general assignment.


Duties:

  • Produce high-quality, accurate, and ethical reporting.

  • Write and produce daily spot news and weekly features and interviews, including twice-monthly nonprofit spotlight interviews.

  • Cultivate a pool of sources throughout the Roaring Fork and Colorado River valleys.

  • Produce digital content for our website and social media channels.

  • Anchor morning and afternoon newscasts, as needed.

  • Serve as local show producer for Morning Edition and All Things Considered.

  • Participate in the production of live events.

  • Maintain a local Arts & Culture event calendar in collaboration with hosts and administrative staff.

  • Work with the news director and regional NPR editors to nationalize local stories.

  • Participate in training and workshops to continue honing your craft and skills.

  • Attend donor and station events and participate in on-air fundraising drives.


Required Qualifications:

  • Solid experience in radio reporting, audio editing and production.

  • Deep knowledge of the ethics and practices of journalism, including AP and NPR styles.

  • Excellent writing and editing skills.

  • Strong time management skills and ability to meet deadlines on a regular basis.

  • Well-practiced collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of nonprofit and arts and culture organizations in the Roaring Fork Valley.

  • On-air anchoring experience (knowledge of the Morning Edition or All Things Considered clocks is also a plus)

  • Understanding of the purpose and mission of public broadcasting.


To apply:

Please send a cover letter, resume, three references, and two to three audio reporting examples to jobs@aspenpublicradio.org with “Arts and Culture Reporter” in the subject line.

Application review will begin Monday, November 23, 2026. You may address the application to News Director Sage Smiley; position open until filled. No phone calls, please.

This is a full-time salaried position reporting to the Aspen Public Radio news director, requiring

availability for day, evening, weekend, and holiday shifts. It is required that this employee be a year-round resident in the Roaring Fork Valley. Aspen Public Radio offers full-time staff benefits including 100% employer-paid health insurance, paid vacation, and a 403(b) match. Ski pass financing and rapid transit bus pass financing are available.

Salary is $65,000.

Aspen Public Radio is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to build and scale the foundational systems that power our data platform and personalized recommendations. You’ll design and operate infrastructure that ingests, processes, and serves PBs of data, helping connect listeners with music they love while supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the company. This is a high-impact, senior role at the intersection of Data Infrastructure and ML. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to build the pipelines, feature infrastructure, and low-latency data services that power recommendations and music discovery. Your work will help turn user interactions and content signals into reliable, fresh data for model training and real-time personalization. As Suno grows, you’ll help define the long-term architecture of our data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, latency, and cost. You’ll build systems that are observable and easy to extend, enabling teams to experiment quickly and improve how people discover and engage with music. You’ll own major systems end to end, from design through production operation, and drive architecture and technical direction across teams. Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/yt9eiMi9aj0rmGX6 What You’ll Do Build and scale the data infrastructure behind personalized recommendations and music discovery, working closely with ML and product engineers. Design streaming pipelines that transform user interactions and content signals into fresh features for recommendation models. Develop infrastructure for computing, storing, and serving features across offline model training and online inference, with attention to consistency, reliability, and latency. Enable recommendation experimentation through reliable impression and interaction logging, supporting model evaluation and measurement of recommendation quality. Own the architecture and reliability of core streaming and batch infrastructure, using technologies such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, Flink, and Glue. Build and maintain data workflows and orchestration using Dagster, ensuring pipelines are modular, testable, and observable. Partner with backend and product engineers to define event schemas, data contracts, and ingestion patterns from production systems. Improve the reliability and observability of data pipelines through monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms. Optimize pipelines and storage for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across AWS and Snowflake. Implement infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) to manage AWS and Snowflake resources in a consistent, reproducible way. Contribute to data platform standards, including schema evolution, data quality enforcement, and pipeline reliability best practices. Lead technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of Suno’s data platform. Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability. What You’ll Need 7+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or distributed systems. Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems. Deep experience building and operating real-time streaming and batch processing systems. Experience building data or serving infrastructure for recommendations, personalization, search, or similar ML-powered product experiences. Understanding of feature computation, online/offline data consistency, and the latency and freshness requirements of production ML systems. Experience with streaming and cloud data infrastructure, such as Flink, Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent technologies. Experience designing reliable, observable systems, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery. Strong understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality. Ability to collaborate closely with ML, data, and product engineering teams, make pragmatic technical decisions, and deliver in ambiguous environments. A strong sense of ownership, with a track record of delivering scalable infrastructure and improving engineering practices. Excitement about music, creativity, and AI, and the infrastructure that helps people create and discover music. Nice to Have Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue. Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including performance and cost optimization. Experience with Dagster, Airflow, or similar orchestration frameworks. Experience with dbt for transformations, testing, and modular data modeling. Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools. Additional Notes Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. This role requires working from our Cambridge, MA or New York, NY office five days per week. job.title: Business Supervisor
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support our Eli Lilly business, helping bring culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote. 

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.
  • Build a working understanding of the client’s brands, patient audiences, competitive landscape, and business priorities to inform day-to-day client partnership and internal direction.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives, approved strategy, and client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.
  • Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

  • Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
  • Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.
  • Partner with Program Management and client stakeholders to clarify review requirements, consolidate feedback, and ensure teams understand approval decisions and their implications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $83,000 - $100,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Senior Android Engineer - Fan Monetization
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer to join the SoundCloud Fan Monetization team. Our mission is to deepen the connection between fans and creators, building features that enhance how fans engage with and support their favorite artists. In this role, you will operate as part of a truly global team, collaborating regularly with engineers and product partners in London, Berlin, and elsewhere to deliver high-quality mobile experiences. You’ll focus almost exclusively on a modern Jetpack Compose stack, shipping high-impact features to millions of users worldwide.

This role offers a fantastic growth runway. You'll work in a forward-thinking environment that fully embraces AI acceleration to streamline development, while focusing on building clean, intuitive user interfaces.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and scale SoundCloud's fan-facing features across Android, focusing heavily on building clean, responsive UI and features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
  • Embrace and utilize advanced AI tools to safely, securely, and responsibly accelerate your coding workflows, code reviews, and testing
  • Partner closely with product, design, and data teams across our international offices (including London and Berlin) to define, build, and iterate on features
  • Participate in feature scoping, product experimentation (A/B testing), analytics integration, and agile delivery to optimize user engagement
  • Engage in code reviews and engineering best practices to maintain a high standard of performance, accessibility, and platform consistency

Experience and Background:

  • 5+ years of experience building Android applications with a solid foundation in Kotlin and a strong familiarity with Jetpack Compose
  • You prefer looking forward; this role focuses entirely on our modern Kotlin/Jetpack Compose components, with no requirement to maintain or refactor legacy Java or outdated architectures
  • Excited about leveraging AI development assistants to optimize your productivity, code quality, and learning
  • Skilled at working within agile, distributed teams, proactively communicating, and breaking down problems into elegant, maintainable code
  • While your primary focus is Android, an openness or curiosity toward occasionally learning or collaborating across other tech stacks—such as iOS, Web, or Backend (Go)—is a welcome plus
  • You love music, mobile products, and the idea of helping creators build closer bonds with their audience

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

Copywriting & Content Development

We are seeking a visionary and agile AI-enabled Creative Director to lead the creative direction for our newly concepted TWITCH LAB—an AI-enabled creative rapid-response capability dedicated to quick turn demands of creative assets requested by our clients. While many of the executions will lean toward digital content and story-telling in the corporate and crisis communication space, the North Star will be able building reputation enhancing content that can move at the speed of machine. Done well, this work will begin to redefine how corporate storytelling can be produced, blending cutting-edge generative AI tools with high-impact human craft. 

As the creative lead of the LAB, you will oversee the conceptualization and execution of quick-turn asset development that could range from ad-like digital content to quick-turn executive videos meant for internal employee campaigns, to infographics to help debunk disinformation in real-time and other multi-channel disciplines. You will partner closely with our senior most account leads, clients, strategic intelligence leads (data and intelligence team members), and extensions of our creative team to create and execute reputation driving content.  

What you'll do:

  • Creative Vision & AI Innovation 

    • Set a new Creative Benchmark: Champion and define the creative standard for the TWITCH LAB, blending technology with earned-first human storytelling. 
    • Rapid-Response Concepting: Lead creative concepting under compressed timelines, driving the production of rapid-response variants across digital, social, video, and executive communications channels. 
    • Oversight of Function and Execution: As a new concept, the Creative Director will oversee the proper use of the Twitch Lab while also tending to the work itself, creating a culture of creatives that seeks to define a new way of corporate story-telling at speed and scale.  

    Governance & Quality Control 

    • Brand Integrity & Compliance: Ensure all outputs uphold client brand standards, visual consistency, and legal/IP compliance. 
    • Ethical AI Leadership: Champion responsible AI workflows, implementing rules for executive likeness protection, synthetic media disclosures, and client data security. 

    Leadership & Stakeholder Consultation 

    • Executive Client Counsel: Present creative concepts and scenario-tested options confidently to C-suite executives, client leaders and internal partners. 
    • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Manage, direct and mentor a multidisciplinary studio team (writers, designers, editors, producers), fostering an environment of continuous learning, experimentation, and speed. 
    • Agency Cross-Collaboration: Integrate the LAB’s output seamlessly with Burson’s broader Creative, Strategy, and Insights & Intelligence (I&I) practices. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 8–10+ years of progressive creative leadership experience within an agency, production studio, or corporate communications environment. 
  • AI Competency: Experience and knowledge of generative AI creative tools (text, image, video, voice, and workflow automation). 
  • Reputation & Crisis Savvy: Proven track record of developing high-stakes corporate messaging, crisis responses, executive decks, and brand reputation campaigns. 
  • Portfolio of Excellence: A strong portfolio showcasing innovative visual and narrative campaigns, high-end content execution, and creative leadership. 
  • Agile Leadership: Exceptional ability to remain calm and decisive under high pressure, leading teams effectively during hour-one breaking news events. 
  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to bridge data-driven intelligence with creative execution that earns attention and protects client reputation.

We are seeking a highly organized, operational powerhouse to serve as Senior Producer/Editor PM for our TWITCH LAB. In this pivotal role, you will own the business operations, client workflow, resource allocation, and project delivery for our AI-enabled rapid-response studio. 

You will manage the end-to-end client experience—navigating strict hour-0 to hour-24 turnaround windows during reputational threats. By bridging account leads, creative specialists, legal/governance partners, and AI platforms, you will ensure seamless production, accurate scoping, and flawless execution across all studio engagements. 

What you'll do:

Rapid-Response Production & Workflow Management 

  • Spearhead Lab Operations: Manage intake, project scoping, production schedules, and asset delivery pipeline for all Twitch LAB projects. 
  • Full Content Lifecycle Execution: Drive the rapid-response workflow from initial requests to assessment, draft optioning, legal sign-off, and final deployment. 
  • Tool & Platform Management: Oversee project tracking tools (Asana), review platforms (Frame.io, Vimeo), and asset archives, establishing file management and taxonomy standards for the studio. 

Client & Financial Ownership 

  • Account & Client Interface: Serve as the primary operational contact for account leads and clients, clarifying briefs, setting turnaround expectations, and managing scope. 
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Develop budget estimates, track project utilization, manage out-of-pocket costs, and report financial projections to department leadership. Eventually create best-practice around financial stewardship of this type of creative work and delivery through trial and error across the first 6-8 months of executions. 

Team Leadership & Governance Integration 

  • Resource Optimization: Staff and assign creative and technical talent to incoming briefs, balancing internal core studio resources with shared agency specialists. 
  • Governance Gatekeeper: Ensure legal, IP, security, and synthetic media disclosures are integrated directly into the production workflow without delaying deployment. 
  • Process Evolution: Partner with Creative Operations leads to continually refine studio processes, standard operating procedures, and turnaround benchmarks. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative project management, agency production, or studio operations within a fast-paced environment. 
  • Agile Workflow Expertise: Proven ability to manage rapid-turnaround video, design, and copy projects under tight deadlines and crisis conditions. 
  • Technical Proficiency: High command of project management and asset platforms (Asana, Frame.io, Vimeo, Adobe Creative Cloud workflows, Microsoft Office Suite). 
  • Financial & Scoping Acumen: Strong track record of scoping complex projects, building accurate estimates, and tracking financial performance. 
  • Client & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to maintain calm, authoritative leadership when dealing with senior stakeholders during high-pressure situations. 
  • Resourceful Problem Solver: Highly detail-oriented, adaptable, and proactive in solving logistical or operational roadblocks.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Editor
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Editor—21GRAMS to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

The Senior Editor maintains quality control of agency deliverables during all stages and is a liaison for the Editorial Department to other colleagues to own and reinforce established standard operating procedures. Grows professional relationships with internal brand team members and works collaboratively to ensure best practices. Performs all functions necessary to keep workflow running smoothly and able to maintain a good level of quality control even with crunched timelines.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

  • Establishes solid working relationships internally and with internal brand team accounts to which they are assigned; proactively and collaboratively engages with Copy, Medical, Account, Art/Studio, and Project Management teams to provide support

  • Is the lead editor for 1 or more accounts

  • Raises a red flag with brand teams and/or senior managers when timelines are too tight, additional resources are needed, or when there is a disruption to normal workflow, among other concerns

  • Maintains oversight for their own jobs to complete them on schedule whether by managing their own time or delegating promptly and responsibly to other resources
  • Supports and reinforces team and agency initiatives established by senior managers
  • Participates in team meetings and contributes to fostering a team mentality
  • Practices a positive “can do” attitude at all times
  • Mentors and trains new and/or junior employees and freelancers

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

 

What you should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher desirable
  • 2+ years’ experience in medical advertising, medical publishing, and/or medical education, with 0+ years’ experience in medical advertising
  • Expected to be 95%+ billable
  • Advertising, marketing, business, English, or related degree preferred
  • Ability to interact with diverse internal population (e.g., account, creatives, project management)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and some Excel) and Adobe, and familiarity with digital routing/commenting platforms, spell-check/auto compare programs
  • Ability to comprehend scientific content and data to ensure accuracy of all claims made by agency or its clients

Pay Range: 105,000-120,000
The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. job.description:
Marketing Consultant

#26-1343

Alexandria, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

HBI Radio Alexandria

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio is a full-service media company with 16 radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions in four of northern Minnesota's most beautiful and active resort communities: Alexandria, Bemidji, Brainerd and Wadena. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Marketing Consultant is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Job Responsibilities

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Make presentations to include a customer needs analysis, research and supporting documentation, and creative business solutions.

Follow up and close all pending business in a timely manner.

Update General Manager weekly on progress of pending business.

Work closely with other departments in creating effective promotional sales solutions for clients.

Create and make presentations to agency personnel, including selling and pre-selling the station audience attributes.

Provide exceptional customer service to direct and agency accounts. Personally contact each active account regularly- defined as an in-person meeting, including the presentation of pertinent sales information.

Obtain credit approval for new accounts.

Ensure all accounts are paid in a timely manner. Follow up and assist in the collection process for past due accounts.

Utilization of and proficiency with Sales software.

Attend special events, such as remotes and broadcasts, which involve clients. These events may occur after business hours and on weekends.

Complete all written business requirements within established deadlines. These requirements include but are not limited to: forecast reports, pending business updates, written orders and advertising copy.

Attend and participate in weekly sales staff meetings, individual meetings with manager and other necessary meetings and training as required by management.

Have a thorough understanding of rates, promotions, inventory, and personnel. Continue to learn and stay abreast of trends in digital and broadcast advertising industry.

Maintain regular, reliable attendance.

Work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the general public.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous sales, advertising, digital sales, or media experience preferred

Knowledge of, and familiarity with, (or ability to learn) broadcasting and digital terminology and methodology preferred.

Ability to understand the features and benefits of advertising and competitive media.

Familiarity with Microsoft Word for Windows; sales software knowledge helpful.

Excellent written and oral English language communication skills.

Experience developing presentations for the purpose of direct-business selling and ability to effectively present and communicate.

Ability to respond to questions appropriately and think on feet.

Establish and maintain customer relationships; communicate effectively with a wide range of personalities in a professional manner.

High level of initiative and ability to work independently required.

Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license and a safe driving history as determined by the Company for the purpose of meeting clients and attending events. (Driving record will be checked.)

Demonstrate effective negotiation and closing techniques.

Strong analytical skills, good judgment, and a "positive can do attitude" are required.

Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically, analytically, creatively and logically; and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to work evenings and weekends.

Physical Requirements: Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.). Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job function.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WTVY:

WTVY News4 is the #1 local media organization producing news, weather, and original content for the Wiregrass region of Alabama, Florida, and Georgia. Located in downtown Dothan, AL, WTVY has been the area's favorite local broadcaster since 1955. News4 takes pride in our winning culture and reputation as the "Hometown News Leader". Leadership is about more than being the most popular. Come see how we're embracing our responsibilities to promote prosperity in the Wiregrass for all. Experience the energy of Dothan's impressive economic growth, while still enjoying a very comfortable cost of living.

Job Summary/Description:

A Media Executive at WTVY represents our brand to a community of local clients, advertising agencies, and the general public. You are a business partner and consultant providing media planning and creative strategy support to help local businesses meet their goals. This role offers work schedule flexibility and independence to those who perform at the highest levels, as well as significant compensation opportunities.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Manage and grow a list of clients by helping them meet their business goals through advertising with our #1 local media organization featuring a variety of broadcast and digital ad products.
- New business development through a variety of marketing tactics to introduce our products to local businesses and advertising agencies.
- Deliver exceptional customer service by connecting with clients frequently to monitor their advertising results and celebrate their success or quickly problem-solve as necessary.
- Meet monthly, quarterly, and annual budget goals, as well as driving the success of sales programs thoughout the year.
- Assist with billing and payment collections, as needed.
- Learn WTVY best practices and Gray Television training recommendations to help introduce new products to the market.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- The ideal candidate is a personable and convincing communicator who enjoys finding ways to help local businesses grow.
- Local media sales experience is preferred, but training resources are available to help the right individual get up to speed quickly on selling multi-platform media products.
- A competitive drive combined with a collaborative attitude is welcome on our team.
- Initiative is an absolute requirement.
- Knowledge of Wide Orbit & Matrix is a plus.

  • Load and unload incoming and outgoing trailers, and move pallets on and off conveyors using freight elevators as needed.

  • Operate corrugate and paper balers to compress recyclable materials into bales, and transport hazardous waste in accordance with Federal, State, and Local regulations.
  • Complete all documentation related to stock movement accurately and efficiently.
  • Coordinate with recycling and other contractors for the pick-up and delivery of storage containers and trailers.
  • Perform preventive and scheduled maintenance on balers and power equipment.

  • Certified to operate forklifts and other power equipment, or able to obtain certification.

  • Flexible and a strong team player, able to adapt to changing assignments and priorities.
  • Effective in communication, both with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Committed to safety, with a strong understanding of PPE requirements and hazardous material handling.
  • Organized, with good planning skills to manage workflow and set up work areas efficiently.
  • Able to learn and retain new knowledge, and practice excellent customer service.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KSBY (Santa Maria/North Santa Barbara County)
job.description:
KSBY, The E.W. Scripps Company NBC station in beautiful San Luis Obispo, California, is looking for a creative, driven and community-focused Multimedia Journalist to join our North Santa Barbara County team. If you are passionate about telling impactful stories that engage people across broadcast, digital, and social platforms, this is a chance to bring your talent to a station that is committed to public service journalism. As a beat reporter based out of Santa Maria, you'll cover towns and cities along California's stunning Central Coast - a vibrant region packed with breathtaking scenery and diverse cultures.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) skills, preferred
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Santa Maria puts you in the heart of California's beautiful Central Coast, surrounded by rolling vineyards, scenic open spaces, and easy access to the Pacific. Located in northern Santa Barbara County, Santa Maria Valley offers the relaxed feel of California wine country while serving as a convenient home base for exploring the Central Coast.


Food and wine are a big part of the Santa Maria experience. The region is known for its distinctive Santa Maria-style barbecue tradition, featuring meats grilled over native red oak, and the surrounding Santa Maria Valley is home to wineries and tasting rooms producing acclaimed Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Syrah, and more. The Foxen Canyon Wine Trail winds through the valley, offering another way to experience the area's vineyards and landscape.


If you love the outdoors, you'll have plenty to explore. Santa Maria Valley combines mild weather and wide-open spaces with opportunities for hiking, cycling, golfing, birdwatching, and beach trips. When you're ready for a change of scenery, the surrounding Central Coast offers everything from ocean views and coastal adventures to wine-country escapes.


For a journalist, Santa Maria also offers the chance to live and work directly in the community you're covering, while enjoying everything that makes California's Central Coast such an appealing place to call home. It's a great fit for someone looking for a mix of local community, outdoor adventure, food and wine, and the California coastal lifestyle.

#LI-SM2 #LI-Onsite

COMPENSATION RANGE:

Hourly: $26.44 - $31.25


 

Pursuant to state and local salary transparency laws, the salary range posted is specific to candidates who will perform this work in California.


 

WHAT WE OFFER (ADDITIONAL BENEFITS):

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

job.title: Senior Manager - Treasury
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is on a global transformation journey, and this is an opportunity to join support the treasury activities for operating companies in India.

What you'll be doing:

The role report to Regional Treasurer and responsible for overseeing India’s cashflow & liquidity, investments, banking relationships, foreign exchange risk to support business growth and financial stability.

This role will report into the Asia Pacific Treasurer, key responsibilities are:

Liquidity & Working Capital Management

  • Monitor daily cash position and manage liquidity planning to ensure adequate funding for business operations in India.
  • Prepare and maintain short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts (e.g., weekly, monthly, quarterly) to minimize idle excess cash.
  • Optimize working capital and manage the deployment of surplus funds in deposit placement for yield enhancement.
  • Lead and oversee the service fee settlement and dividend repatriation in timely manner.

Banking & Financial Institution Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for banking partners in India; negotiate terms, pricing, and facilities. Bringing their advice and expertise to bear as required for risk management or other purposes.
  • Manage banking documentation, KYC, and regulatory compliance.

Forex Exposure & Investment Management

  • Identify, manage, and report on foreign exchange (FX) exposure across the networks.
  • Design and implement foreign currency hedging strategies for business operation as to mitigate their financial risks.
  • Advise the business on FEMA (Foreign Exchange Management Act) compliance and requirements.

Business partnering

  • Build deep relationship with CFOs and FDs across diverse networks and influence decisions on working capital and foreign exchange management.
  • Support the communications of treasury policy and internal control standards, ensure it is applied in compliance with the related local treasury procedures.
  • Monitor and assess the impact of local market conditions such as regulation, currency controls, financial products and advise on this internally.
  • Support Treasury GBS team as required on joint or Treasury led developments.

Intercompany Funding & Debt Management

  • Support fund-raising activities through various instruments like bank loans, intercompany financing.
  • Manage the loan drawdown and repayment of operating entities in India, including refinancing and ensuring timely servicing of debt obligations.

Candidate Qualifications & Experience

  • Educational Background:
  • Experience graduate / postgraduate 
  • Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), A CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) qualification is a strong plus.

Professional Experience:

  • 11-15 years of progressive experience in corporate treasury, cash management, or a similar finance role.
  • Proven experience with Treasury Management Systems (e.g., IT/2) is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of RBI regulations, FEMA, and local banking practices.
  • Strong experience in managing banking relationships and forex hedging instruments.
  • Knowledge of derivatives and hedging currency exposures directly or indirectly.
  • Knowledge of accounting in relation to FX gains and losses and where they arise.

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Profound understanding and operation experiences in cash management and FX risk management products
  • Experience operating in a multi-currency, multi-entity global organization is a plus.
  • Experience in Power BI a plus

job.title: Field Coordinator
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Paving field Coordinator is responsible for planning, posting, documenting, and monitoring temporary "No Parking" restrictions required for street paving, reconstruction, utility restoration, and public works projects throughout the City of Los Angeles. The position ensures compliance with City of Los Angeles permitting requirements, parking restriction regulations, traffic control plans, and project schedules to facilitate successful paving operations while minimizing disruptions to residents and businesses.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate and implement temporary parking restrictions for paving and roadway construction projects.
  • Install, maintain, and remove temporary "No Parking" signs in accordance with City of Los Angeles permit requirements.
  • Verify signs are posted within required notification timeframes prior to scheduled construction activities.
  • Photograph and document all posted signs, locations, dates, and times for compliance records.
  • Conduct field inspections to ensure parking restrictions remain visible, legible, and properly located.
  • Communicate with residents, business owners, property managers, and stakeholders regarding upcoming restrictions.
  • Coordinate daily with project managers, paving crews, traffic control personnel, inspectors, and City representatives.
  • Maintain accurate records of permits, posting logs, photographs, and project documentation.
  • Verify project addresses, limits of work, and parking restriction boundaries before posting.
  • Assist with lane closures, traffic control coordination, and field logistics as required.
  • Respond to public inquiries and complaints regarding temporary parking restrictions.
  • Ensure compliance with company safety policies and applicable traffic safety regulations.
  • Support emergency and short-notice paving operations when required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Minimum two (2) years of experience in construction coordination, traffic control, public works, paving operations, utility construction, or related field.
  • Experience working within the City of Los Angeles permitting environment is preferred.

License Requirements

  • Valid California Driver License.
  • Ability to operate company vehicles throughout Los Angeles County.

KNOWLEDGE OF

  • City of Los Angeles temporary no-parking requirements.
  • Public works and paving operations.
  • Traffic control practices and work zone safety.
  • Street and roadway nomenclature throughout Los Angeles.
  • Permit compliance procedures.
  • Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and mobile field documentation applications.
  • Customer service and public communication techniques.

ABILITY TO

  • Work independently in the field with minimal supervision.
  • Read maps, plans, permits, and work orders.
  • Maintain detailed documentation and photographic records.
  • Communicate professionally with residents, businesses, inspectors, and project personnel.
  • Organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, as required by paving schedules.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Walk long distances in residential, commercial, and industrial areas.
  • Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Install and remove temporary parking signs and signposts.
  • Work outdoors in varying weather and traffic conditions.
  • Stand, bend, climb, and perform field activities for extended periods.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS

  • ATSSA Traffic Control Technician (TCT).
  • ATSSA Traffic Control Supervisor (TCS).
  • OSHA 10-Hour or OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety Certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position requires daily travel throughout the City of Los Angeles and surrounding areas. Work is performed outdoors near active traffic, construction zones, and paving operations during both daytime and nighttime hours.

This version is tailored for contractors performing paving, utility restoration, and street work that require temporary No Parking posting and compliance documentation for City of Los Angeles paving permits.

job.description:
Req Id: 433402

 

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day. 

 

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell. 

 

 

Be at the forefront of one of the most exciting and ever-changing industries. On the Bell Media team you will be a part of creating and delivering the best Canadian and international content across digital media, television, radio and out-of-home advertising platforms. You’ll join a team of passionate and driven innovators, who are breaking barriers and expanding the reach of Canada’s most-loved entertainment.

 

At Bell Media, you’ll redefine digital connections and pioneer next-generation services, propelling us to reach new heights, unlock untapped potential and expand horizons for our customers.

 

Summary

CTV News Channel is looking for a dynamic, experienced News Producer who is excited about delivering the news in a fast-paced, multi-platform news environment, and thrives in a breaking news situation. As Canada’s 24-hour news channel, CTV News Channel is leading the charge in delivering breaking news and informing Canadians about what matters to them.

 

Identifying news stories, generating enterprise news content, knowing how to element broadcast stories, lining up, producing and executing live television coverage, writing quickly and accurately are essential to the position, as is strong news judgement and the highest journalistic standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, build, element & execute the LIVE on-air output of CTV News Channel during specified periods of the broadcast day
  • Generate original story ideas for execution 
  • Determine the daily editorial direction and execution of coverage
  • Collaborate with & assign editorial team members to define & execute content & coverage
  • Ensure CTV News Channel is delivering the latest developments in major news stories while covering breaking news quickly & accurately
  • Writing to include but not exclusive to story intros, voice overs, and promos
  • Vet scripts, video, audio, & banners
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency & adherence to CTV News standards of all material
  • Responsible for taking LIVE events to air & future planning for major events
  • Monitor wires, social media, e-mail & all other outlets for news updates or story ideas
  • Participate in news editorial meetings
  • Keep on top of news broadcasting trends on all platforms

Critical Qualifications

  • Degree/Diploma in Broadcast Journalism
  • Excellent skills & extensive experience as a live control room producer
  • Experience in managing news coverage

About WNDU:

WNDU boasts a history of more than 70 years and sits on the campus of the world-renowned University of Notre Dame. We cover northwest Indiana and southwest Michigan. We produce over 36 hours of live news each week and continue to expand our coverage. Our team is committed to the highest standards in news, entertainment, informational, and public service programming. Our viewers love having a major research university in their backyard, the history of a strong manufacturing sector, and a robust court system. They also demand accountability from those institutions. The stories are here. We need the right journalist to find the stories and tell them.

Job Summary/Description:

WNDU in South Bend, Indiana is looking for an Investigative Reporter/MMJ. You will dig. You will file records requests. You will work sources. You will gather documents. You will tell complex, consequential stories in ways that are clear, fair, and impossible to ignore. And you will do it across every platform, on air, online, and on social. This role is not just about producing lengthy series pieces; we expect you on air regularly as part of the 16 News Now team. When a breaking news story has an investigative angle, a document, a record, a source with context no one else has, we want you gathering and fronting that information, bringing depth and accountability to stories as they happen, not weeks later. If you have the chops and the experience, we want to hear from you; apply now.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Drive original daily investigative and enterprise reporting for WNDU. We need more than a long-form series. We want accountability journalism that shows up in every newscast.
- File and manage public records requests (FOIA, state open records) as a core reporting tool, not an afterthought.
- Use data, documents, and records to build stories from the ground up.
- Develop, cultivate, and protect confidential sources across government, law enforcement, business, and the community.
- Examine breaking and day-of news through an investigative lens - gathering records, sourcing context, and fronting stories that go deeper than the surface.
- Manage longer-form investigations simultaneously at different stages of development.
- Shoot, write, edit, and present your own stories as a full MMJ. Own the story from pitch to air. We do have photographers who will work with you, but you shouldn't be reliant on them for every story or shoot.
- Translate complex investigative findings into compelling, accessible content for broadcast, digital, and social audiences.
- Collaborate with editorial leadership on story development, legal review, and publication strategy.
- Uphold the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, and SPJ ethics - every story, every time.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Proven investigative or accountability reporting experience; we want to see the work.
- A track record of using public records, data, or documents to break original stories.
- The ability to work at two speeds simultaneously: daily investigative hits AND longer-term series development.
- Strong on-camera presence and MMJ skills; you shoot, edit, and present your own material, and you are comfortable being a visible, recognizable face of the 16 News Now brand.
- Source development skills built over time; you have relationships, and you know how to build new ones.
- The ability to take a dense, document-heavy story and make it matter to a general audience.
- Unshakable ethical standards; you understand the weight of this work, and you handle it accordingly.
- Comfort with legal and editorial scrutiny; you document your reporting, and you stand behind it.
- Resilience: investigations get complicated, sources go cold, and stories take longer than expected, but you do not quit.
- Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to drive a company vehicle.
- A journalism-related degree is preferred, but not required; your body of work must speak for itself.
- Must be able to carry 35+ pounds of gear, and be experienced in shooting and editing unique content. We do have photographers to partner with on appropriate assignments.
- Familiarity with ENPS, Arc, and Edius is a plus, but not required.

job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

Come work for Hallmark as a Warehouse Order Selector! This is a 3rd shift position working Sunday night through Thursday morning, 8pm-6am. Hallmark offers an exceptional work-life balance, a comfortable environment, a comprehensive benefits package, paid holidays, and great company culture.

This position requires the incumbent to fill retail orders in several different pick mediums within Order Processing that include Single Carton Fill, Multi Carton Fill, and Batch Cart while wearing a headset and using a handheld device. Filling methods and skills will vary according to area. Therefore, flexibility to fill in all work types within this description is required. The incumbent completes customer orders using computer-generated documents to pick 2D and 3D product from bins throughout the warehouse while meeting production expectations. This position requires the highest possible quality and customer service by adhering to standard operating procedures while selecting and packing items in cartons and placing cartons on a conveyor system.

Teamwork, cooperation and flexibility, along with LEAN principles of problem solving and elimination of waste are expectations of the position. Additionally, every employee is responsible for their personal safety, as well as the safety of their peers. Adherence to established safety policies and procedures, along with the reporting of all injuries and unsafe conditions are also requirements of this position.  Business needs of the department may require additions or changes to the duties of this position.

  • At least 18 years of age
  • Able to read, write and understand English
  • Ability to constantly, stand, walk push/pull and reach above shoulder level
  • Ability to push, pull, lift, and carry up to 30 pounds constantly, up to 40 pounds frequently and lift up to 60 pounds occasionally

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent 
  • Ability to follow instructions and prioritize tasks
  • Able to work in a variety of conditions with automated equipment

job.title: Senior Director of News, WKBW
job.description:
Senior Director of News, WKBW


Are you a proven news leader ready to elevate one of the most dynamic newsrooms in Western New York? WKBW, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Buffalo, New York, is seeking an experienced Senior Director of News to lead our newsroom and drive continued audience growth and journalistic excellence. This is your opportunity to lead a talented team of journalists committed to delivering critical community journalism that serves Buffalo and Western New York.

We're looking for a visionary leader who can inspire compelling storytelling, foster innovation, and navigate the rapidly evolving media landscape. If you're passionate about quality local journalism, digital innovation, developing great people, and building a positive, hard-charging newsroom culture, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Create and implement strategic plans for audience growth and newsroom operations.
  • Develop and implement measurable strategies for audience growth while effectively managing news content delivered across multiple platforms.
  • Communicate a compelling and inspired vision consistent with company strategy.
  • Analyze and respond to trends affecting the industry and DMA.
  • Approve all newsroom personnel decisions.
  • Develop and control the annual budget in compliance with station guidelines.
  • Build and maintain key relationships to foster a positive news image within the Buffalo and Western New York community.
  • Monitor all on-air and online products for compliance with federal, state and local laws as well as First and Fourteenth Amendment requirements.
  • Work closely with other members of the station management team to develop and attain departmental and station goals.
  • Maintain knowledge of and proficiency in posting content to station websites.
  • Adapt current resources to emerging technology.
  • Supervise and provide regular feedback and yearly performance appraisals for direct reports, with ultimate responsibility for all newsroom personnel.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • At least 5 years of news management experience is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communication or a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated ability to track and select trending news stories.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to lead and make sound decisions in a rapid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws.
  • Ability to create tactics and strategies to increase audience performance in key target areas across multiple platforms.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws impacting operations.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills.
  • Effectiveness in a variety of formal presentation settings, both inside and outside the organization.
  • Proven and effective leadership skills, including fostering open dialogue, empowering others, and addressing conflict quickly and directly.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Buffalo, New York offers the energy and amenities of a major city with the accessibility and strong sense of community that make Western New York a distinctive place to call home. Located along the shores of Lake Erie and just a short drive from Niagara Falls, Buffalo combines rich history and architecture with professional sports, arts and culture, a vibrant food scene, and year-round opportunities to enjoy the outdoors.


Western New York is known for its passionate communities and strong local identity. From Buffalo's neighborhoods and waterfront to the surrounding communities of Western New York, the region offers plenty to explore. Whether you're taking in a Bills or Sabres game, experiencing the area's festivals and cultural attractions, exploring the waterfront, or making a quick trip to Niagara Falls, Buffalo offers a combination of big-city experiences and a welcoming community atmosphere.


For a news leader, Buffalo is a market where local journalism matters. At WKBW, you'll lead a newsroom focused on delivering important, relevant community journalism to audiences across Buffalo and Western New York while helping shape how that journalism reaches viewers across platforms. WKBW is Scripps' ABC affiliate in Buffalo.
