job.title: Director Sales - New Portland Venue
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Brief Overview

The Director Sales is responsible for the sales, management and production of special events, advertisements, and maintaining the budgets. In addition, the Director Sales will execute special event contracts and letter agreements, and plan and successfully execute special events.

Job Summary

  • Network, research, and cold call potential clients to create new business opportunities.
  • Enter client information into CRM system and manage client relationships.
  • Create event proposals and budgets.
  • Collect event deposits and contract signatures once events are confirmed.
  • Advance event details for confirmed events and serve as the primary contact for event‑related issues.
  • Ensure all steps are taken to guarantee successful event execution.
  • Collect vendor quotes and finalized contracts.
  • Be onsite during event days to manage execution and supervise vendors and staff.
  • Train and manage special event staff, including vendor partners for catering, bar service, security, and other applicable service partners.
  • Ensure special events staff adhere to company policies regarding rentals and event execution.
  • Provide guidance or recommendations on issues that arise during the event process.
  • Follow up with clients to ensure events meet expectations and place holds for future or recurring dates.
  • Respond to date challenges and update the calendar system to reflect new holds or release unneeded holds.
  • Promote upcoming events and venue availability to potential, existing, and past clients.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding availability, pricing, and locations.
  • Negotiate deal terms and pricing.
  • Prepare contracts and letter agreements once proposals are accepted.
  • Initiate creation of invoices and new customer setup.
  • Submit budgets and change orders.
  • Create competitive pricing models to maximize venue revenue.
  • Track sales and develop plans to reach annual goals.
  • Complete monthly forecasts updated to reflect new and existing contracts.
  • Develop strategic collateral materials, online marketing, and other tools to generate activity

Essential Functions

  • Computer savvy and proficient in MS Office Professional Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel)
  • Self‑motivated with a professional and calm demeanor
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Extensive sales experience with the ability to create and foster strong client relationships
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Management experience
  • Strong organization, project management, and decision‑making skills
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Previous experience in event planning and execution, with the ability to manage and delegate tasks

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree (4‑year) required
  • Advanced degree preferred
  • Advanced degree in Sales, Marketing, or a related field preferred
  • 6–8 years of related work experience
  • Prior experience working in music venues preferred

Payscale: $80,000.00- $85,000.00

Bonus:This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Commission:This position is eligible for a 5% sales commission per the commission policy requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship.  AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions.  We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law.

Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Preventative Care & Wellness
job.description:
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR 

The Assistant Manager will play an integral role in supporting and executing MusiCares’ Preventive Health & Wellness program delivery. Guided by the Managing Director, you will support the growth and sustainability of comprehensive preventive care services addressing the needs of music pros across physical health, mental health and financial health. You will also be responsible for operational, client-focused and administrative team support.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Support the Managing Director to refine and expand MusiCares’ comprehensive suite of preventive care services based on data-driven needs.

  • Provide key support to ensure high-quality operations including provider engagement, efficient and timely connection with clients and fiscally responsible clinic management.
  • Coordinate ongoing communications between providers and the Preventive Health & Wellness team.
  • Monitor registrations, participation and provider feedback to support continuous improvement.
  • Leverage knowledge of the intersection of physical, financial and mental health to inform the development of a preventive care package that is adaptable based on the unique needs of the music industry.
  • Collaborate with the Networked Care team to ensure providers offer relevant and topical services based on Wellness in Music data and clinic/program feedback.

 

Develop and maintain systems for effective and sustainable referral pathways.

  • Support the Managing Director with development of pre-qualified systems and ongoing evaluations of the client engagement process.
  • Cross-collaborate across Health & Human Service teams, supporting development of referral pathways that improve client access to customized care services. Collaborate with care teams to ensure effectiveness of internal referrals in addition to cross-departmental work with Marketing and Development teams.
  • Serve as a liaison with Recording Academy staff and across affiliates to help promote services and devise protocol to educate broader industry partners about comprehensive preventive care packages.
  • Evaluate efficacy and ROI of services.
  • Create systems to track client feedback that aligns with organizational procedures and data collection methods.

 

Support program effectiveness through data and reporting and contribute to overall Health & Human Services team collaboration.

  • Support compiling, reviewing and reporting of team/program data for the Board of Directors, grant writing, and internal and external partners.
  • Develop strong knowledge of MusiCares’ data that drives programs and services.
  • Assist with staffing and event coordination for on/off site events, including travel as needed.
  • Participate in team meetings and professional development opportunities.

 

Operational support, including administrative coordination to manage team workflows.

  • Work across the Preventive Health & Wellness team through established processes.
  • Strengthen program operations through effective coordination with providers.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance program/team efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Contribute to implementation of organizational strategic vision and plan.

 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of administrative experience, ideally with a non-profit organization with a similar programmatic focus.
  • A passion for MusiCares’ mission and an interest to professionally grow in this area.
  • Commitment to confidentiality and issues of privacy with the ability to maintain both.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite, Mailchimp, Eventbrite, Airtable, and/or comparable creative suite software.
  • Knowledge of database products and how to optimize data for reports and departmental analytics.
  • Strong communication skills and high emotional intelligence with the ability to interact with a variety of different constituents with a strong client service approach.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative and entrepreneurial business environment.
  • Ability to maintain composure during high-stress, complex situations, particularly when assisting with client care.
  • Ability to adapt well to change while remaining flexible and open minded.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAN ROLES

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

 

The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.

 

 

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 

The starting rate for this position is $31.60 to $34.38 per hour, benchmarked against industry standards. Rates for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market. 
 
The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.


Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity. 

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

job.title: Stage Communicatie 2027 Burson Nederland
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Hoe versterken we de reputatie van één van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland? Welke influencers schakelen we in bij een lancering van een nieuw product? Hoe zorgen we dat de onze klant goed in de media komt? Als jouw hart sneller gaat kloppen van deze vragen, dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Stage lopen bij Burson betekent dat je meteen veel verantwoordelijkheden krijgt. Als stagiair maak je écht onderdeel uit van ons team en word je zoveel mogelijk betrokken bij verschillende activiteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s aan opdrachten voor merken zoals SharkNinja, Jaguar Land Rover en Procter & Gamble (o.a. Gillette, Always en Olay). Afhankelijk van de klanten in jouw portfolio ondersteun je bijvoorbeeld bij andere inhoudelijke taken als het verzamelen van relevante informatie, het maken van media-, concurrentie- of stakeholderanalyses, het meedenken over de invulling van nieuwe social media- of influencer-campagnes en het creëren van content voor verschillende kanalen. Er wordt hard gewerkt in de diverse klantteams, maar de werksfeer is open, informeel en eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd!

Wie zijn wij? 

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Wij helpen bedrijven en organisaties in de meest uiteenlopende en vaak uitdagende omstandigheden, waarbij wij ze adviseren in hun transities en transformaties. Met het creëren van stakeholderacceptatie als doel. Nooit om de status quo te beschermen, niet om op elke hype in te gaan, maar om ze met een gegronde strategie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Onze adviseurs zijn met hun brede ervaring, vakmanschap en integriteit erkende boardroompartners. Onafhankelijk en kritisch zetten zij de discussie met onze opdrachtgevers op scherp. Burson heeft jarenlange ervaring in het adviseren van bedrijven in complexe situaties, onder meer op het gebied van strategie, stakeholdermanagement en geloofwaardige communicatie.

For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Stage Public Affairs bij Burson

Wil jij ervaring opdoen op het snijvlak van politiek, media, bestuur en bedrijfsleven?

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Met ons ervaren team van specialisten opereren we op hoog strategisch niveau en helpen we bedrijven en organisaties door de meest complexe situaties: van het versterken of beschermen van reputaties tot het inspelen op veranderende wetgeving, het agenderen van politieke thema’s, het begeleiden van fusies en overnames, productintroducties of crisiscommunicatie. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.

Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.

Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.

Wat ga je doen?

Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.
  • Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.
  • Verslaglegging: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.
  • Research en analyse: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.
  • Stakeholdermapping: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.
  • Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).
  • Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.
  • Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.
  • Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.
  • Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. job.title: KSL Content Producer, Social Media (Part-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.


Position Overview

The Social Media Producer is responsible for creating, publishing, and optimizing content across all KSL social platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, Threads, and emerging channels. This role plays a key part in growing audience, increasing engagement, supporting newsroom priorities, and ensuring KSL’s social presence reflects strong journalism and brand identity.


The producer collaborates closely with News, Digital, Creative Services/Marketing, Promotions, and the broader social team to translate daily content, enterprise stories, special projects, and initiatives into compelling, platform-native posts.


Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an hybrid role that requires the employee to sometimes work at our Salt Lake City site. Specific hybrid schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management. Employee will need to be on-site during the training period.

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:


Daily Content Production 

  • Produce and publish social posts across all platforms, including:  
  • Headlines, captions, and teases 
  • Vertical and horizontal video 
  • Graphics and thumbnails 
  • Reels, TikToks, Shorts, carousels, and live updates 
  • Create and monitor live streams on YouTube and Facebook 
  • Package newsroom content (breaking news, enterprise, features) into engaging social formats. 

Platform Management & Scheduling 

  • Maintain daily posting cadence across KSL’s social accounts. 
  • Monitor posts for accuracy, engagement, and community response. 
  • Looking for opportunities to live stream.  
  • Participate in real-time coverage for breaking news and major events. 

Audience Engagement & Community Management 

  • Respond appropriately to user comments when needed; escalate issues for moderation. 
  • Identify engagement opportunities and trends that align with brand safety and editorial standards. 

Trend Monitoring & Creative Development 

  • Track emerging trends, formats, audio, and platform features across all networks. 
  • Pitch social-first ideas and series that reflect KSL priorities and audience interest. 

Collaboration & Cross-Department Support 

  • Work with reporters, producers, and editors to build social versions of stories. 
  • Support branding, promotions, and station campaigns with social content. 
  • Assist in producing social deliverables for special projects or advertiser campaigns as assigned. 

Analytics & Best Practices 

  • Review platform insights to understand what topics and formats perform best. 
  • Apply best practices for timing, format, thumbnails, hooks, and retention. 
  • Contribute performance insights in team meetings. 


Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:


Required 

  • 1–3 years of experience in social media, digital content creation, or video production. 
  • Proven ability to create content for multiple social platforms in a professional or brand setting. 
  • Strong writing and editing skills tailored to social platforms. 
  • Experience with basic video editing and graphic tools (CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, etc.). 
  • Solid understanding of best practices for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube. 
  • Ability to work quickly and calmly in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 
  • Flexibility to work occasional nights, weekends, or holidays for major news events or station priorities. 

Preferred 

  • Experience working in a newsroom or media organization. 
  • Knowledge of Utah, local issues, and KSL’s audience. 
  • Familiarity with social analytics tools (native insights, YouTube Studio, etc.). 
  • Comfort appearing on-camera occasionally (not required but a plus). 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Lift, move, and carry up to 30 pounds on occasion.

Compensation

 $16.00 - $20.00 an hour. Hourly rate to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

  • 401(k) with Company match, fully vested from day one
  • Paid time off for volunteering
  • Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners

job.title: KSL Cougar Tracks Producer (Full-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

 

Position Overview

Cougar Tracks is KSL Sports' podcast about BYU athletics. It is where Cougar fans go for news, analysis, and conversation about the teams they follow. We are hiring a full-time Podcast Producer to own production of the show from start to finish and grow its audience on YouTube and social media.


In this role, you will film and edit every episode and turn each one into short clips that bring new viewers to the show. The ideal candidate understands how audiences find and watch content on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and X and can turn that knowledge into more views, subscribers, and engagement.


You do not just finish edits; you want the show to grow. You look at an episode and know which 45 seconds will get shared. You check the analytics because you want to know why one video took off and another did not. You are excited by the chance to build the biggest place online for BYU sports conversation.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an on-site role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Salt Lake City site.
  • This role follows the sports calendar and requires flexibility for game days, evenings, weekends, and breaking news, especially during football and basketball seasons.

 

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Film regular episodes, interviews, and remote or on-location recordings using multi-camera video production.
  • Edit the audio and video for each full episode with clean pacing, consistent sound, and polished graphics, then publish on schedule to YouTube and podcast platforms.
  • Identify strong moments from each episode, including hot takes, breaking-news reactions, funny exchanges, and compelling analysis, and turn them into short vertical and horizontal clips tailored to each platform.
  • Add captions, graphics, hooks, and thumbnails that encourage viewers to stop scrolling and click.
  • Grow the YouTube channel by writing titles, descriptions, and tags; designing thumbnails; and using YouTube Analytics to improve future videos.
  • Lead the social strategy by planning when and where to post, reacting quickly to BYU news, and testing new formats and trends to reach more fans.
  • Partner with the host and editorial staff on episode planning, guest-booking logistics, and promotion across KSL platforms.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:



  • Proven experience editing long-form podcast or video episodes.
  • Hands-on experience filming video, including camera setup, framing, lighting, and audio capture.
  • Strong ability to identify and edit short-form social clips.
  • Proficiency with video-editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Clear understanding of YouTube, including thumbnails, titles, audience retention, and the platform algorithm.
  • Fluency with Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and X, with an understanding of what works on each platform.
  • Ability to work quickly during news cycles and meet recurring publishing deadlines.
  • A portfolio or reel demonstrating full-episode edits and social clips.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and establish positive, cooperative working relationships with staff and management.
  • Strong self-motivation, organization, dependability, and ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to work the hours required to meet deadlines, including game days, evenings, and weekends as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience covering sports, especially college athletics.
  • Experience with the RØDECaster Video or similar live video-production switchers.
  • Knowledge of BYU athletics and its fan base.
  • Experience using analytics to grow a podcast or YouTube channel.
  • Motion-graphics or thumbnail-design skills using tools such as After Effects, Photoshop, or Canva.

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through effective oral and written communication.
  • Use manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys, cameras, audio equipment, and general office equipment; work on a computer for prolonged periods.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods.
  • May lift up to 50 lbs on occasion..

 

Compensation

$19.00 - $24.00 per hour. Hourly rate to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

job.description:
Description

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry!  


SVP of Product


Job Summary

The SVP of Product is responsible for the creative and product direction of Hope Media Group's

family of brands - ensuring each product has a strong identity, product roadmap, clear audience

strategy, and content that connects. This role sits on the Senior Leadership Team alongside

peers such as the Chief of Technology and Chief of Content, working with the Chief Impact

Officer to align brand strategy with organizational mission and growth goals. The SVP of

Product oversees Product Directors across all HMG brands, guiding teams in audience building,

storytelling, and content delivery that reflects HMG's values and mission.


Essential Functions

Portfolio Leadership and Strategy:

  • Lead Product Directors across KSBJ, WayFM, Vida Unida, Worship 24/7, NGEN Radio, and Hope Events
  • Set the strategic direction for each product’s content, audience growth, and market position
  • Represent product strategy in Senior Leadership Team discussions and organizational planning
  • Partner with the Chief Impact Officer on long-range portfolio decisions


Data-Driven Product Development:

  • Utilize user behavior analytics, A/B testing, and digital performance metrics to guide product evolution and feature prioritization 
  • Define and monitor key product health and engagement metrics across all digital platforms to optimize user experience and conversion

Brand Performance and Financial Accountability:

  • Track and assess brand performance across audience metrics, engagement, and growth indicators
  • Partner with brand teams to identify gaps and opportunities in content strategy
  • Set clear performance expectations for Product Directors and review outcomes regularly
  • Connect brand results to organizational goals and report progress to the Chief Impact Officer
  • Use audience data and ministry metrics to inform strategic pivots and investment decisions

Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Collaborate with the VP of Brand, Chief of Technology, and Chief of Content to align product and content direction

iHeartMedia is looking for a strategic, creative, and highly independent Senior Manager to join our Digital Media Strategy & Planning team. In this role, you’ll help shape innovative digital campaigns that span streaming audio, podcasts, social platforms, and live events positioning iHeartMedia as the leading force in digital audio and entertainment.

You’ll serve as a key strategic partner to the sales organization, leading RFP responses, driving creative ideation, and crafting compelling narratives that bring our capabilities to life. job.title: DIRECTOR OF SALES - WLIO
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets, serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach about 37% of U.S. television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency that offers national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WLIO: 

Located in Lima, Ohio, WLIO is proud to bring all four major networks—NBC, CBS, ABC, and FOX—under one roof. As a station serving the Midwest, we enjoy the beauty and variety of all four seasons while staying closely connected to the communities we serve.

WLIO offers applicants the opportunity to be part of a dynamic, collaborative team in a welcoming market where journalists and media professionals can make a meaningful impact.

Job Summary/Description:

WLIO is seeking an experienced, motivated, and strategic Director of Sales to lead WLIO's sales department and drive revenue growth across its broadcast, digital, and emerging media platforms. Reporting directly to the General Manager, the Director of Sales will play a key leadership role in the station's overall business strategy, financial performance, and continued growth in the Lima market.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on sales leader who understands how to recruit, develop, motivate, and retain a high-performing sales team while building strong relationships with local businesses, agencies, and regional advertisers. This individual will bring a proven ability to grow existing business, develop new revenue opportunities, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver effective multi-platform marketing solutions that produce measurable results.

 Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

The Director of Sales is responsible for leading WLIO's sales operation, driving revenue growth, developing client relationships, and supporting the station's overall business objectives. Duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Sales Leadership: Lead and manage the station's multi-platform sales operation, with a focus on growing broadcast, digital, and emerging platform revenue.
  • Revenue Growth: Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed local, national, new business, digital, and other revenue goals.
  • Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, expand existing accounts, and develop creative marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Sales Strategy: Establish sales goals, budgets, forecasts, and performance expectations aligned with WLIO's local brand and overall business strategy.
  • Team Development: Recruit, hire, train, coach, and retain a high-performing sales team. Provide ongoing development and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Performance Management: Monitor sales activity, revenue pacing, and individual performance. Hold team members accountable for achieving established goals and objectives.
  • Client Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key advertisers, agencies, business owners, and community partners.
  • Multi-Platform Solutions: Champion the integration of broadcast television, digital products, and emerging media opportunities to deliver comprehensive advertising solutions.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the General Manager and other department leaders to align sales initiatives with station priorities and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Communication: Maintain consistent communication with the General Manager, sales team, and other departments regarding revenue performance, opportunities, challenges, and business initiatives.
  • Market Leadership: Represent WLIO professionally in the business community and participate in activities that strengthen the station's visibility and relationships throughout the Lima market.
  • Sales Operations: Maintain organized sales processes, effective inventory management, accurate forecasting, and consistent execution of sales policies and procedures.
  • Financial Accountability: Manage the sales department budget, monitor expenses, and provide accurate financial reporting and revenue projections.
  • Compliance and Ethics: Ensure the sales department operates in accordance with company policies, FCC regulations, EEO requirements, SOX guidelines, and all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Culture and Innovation: Foster a positive, collaborative, and accountable sales culture that encourages creativity, innovation, teamwork, and a commitment to results.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the General Manager.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • 5+ years of media sales and management experience preferred, including experience as a Director of Sales, Local Sales Manager, or comparable leadership position.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, communications, marketing, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • Strong understanding of the broadcast television industry, digital media, advertising trends, and the evolving media landscape.
  • Demonstrated success in developing sales strategies, growing revenue, generating new business, and achieving financial objectives.
  • Proven ability to recruit, hire, develop, motivate, and retain high-performing sales professionals.
  • Strong leadership skills, including emotional intelligence, conflict resolution, coaching, and team development.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business needs while maintaining a positive and professional presence.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong client relationships, influence business decisions, and develop long-term partnerships.
  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, revenue forecasting, expense management, and financial reporting.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with station leadership and other departments to achieve overall business objectives.
  • Familiarity with employment practices, personnel management, and applicable workplace compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and business management systems, including CRM and enterprise reporting platforms.
  • Willingness and ability to become actively involved in the local community and represent WLIO as a business and community leader.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record consistent with company policy.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Community Connections - Central Coast & Southern Central Valley
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections for the Central Coast (KSBY) and Southern Central Valley (KERO), you’ll serve as the station’s primary connector to the Central Coast community and Southern Central Valley Coast, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism, and create meaningful partnerships. You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns, and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure these communities remains an essential, responsive, and trusted part of community life. This position will be located on-site at KSBY in San Luis Obispo, CA.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government, and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism, and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust, and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners, and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns, and story tips are acknowledged, routed, and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs, and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership, and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion, and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms, and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills, and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns, and sensitive community issues.

Application Review: Applications received by November 9, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


OUR TEAM:

We’re a team of journalists, storytellers, relationship builders, and community advocates who care deeply about the people and places we serve. At KSBY, we bring different backgrounds, perspectives, interests, and experiences to our work, united by a shared commitment to meaningful local journalism and stronger communities. You’ll work alongside collaborative colleagues who value curiosity, authenticity, responsiveness, and finding new ways to connect with audiences both inside and outside the newsroom.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

San Luis Obispo offers an incredible Central Coast lifestyle, surrounded by rolling hills and within easy reach of California’s coastline. The area blends an active outdoor lifestyle with a welcoming community, local restaurants, wineries, farmers markets, arts, and plenty of opportunities to hike, bike, explore, and enjoy the outdoors.

As Sr. Manager, Community Connections, you’ll have the opportunity to build relationships with the people and organizations that shape San Luis Obispo and communities across the Central Coast. Whether you’re attending a community event, meeting with local leaders, or discovering the stories people are talking about, you’ll be immersed in the communities KSBY serves.

#LI-Onsite

COMPENSATION RANGE:

Annual Salary: $105,000.00 - $115,000.00


 

Pursuant to state and local salary transparency laws, the salary range posted is specific to candidates who will perform this work in California.


 

ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

job.title: Executive Reporter, KNXV
job.description:
KNXV, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for an Executive Reporter who is as passionate about the craft of storytelling as they are about the community. In this role, you'll leading, inspiring, and mentoring reporters and MMJs at every level to discover powerful ways to grow their storytelling skills. You'll partner with newsroom leaders to execute a content strategy rooted in authenticity, impact, and journalistic integrity, all while shaping a culture where great stories aren't just told — they're felt. If you're ready to elevate the voices that matter most and leave a lasting mark on local journalism in one of the country's most vibrant and fast-growing cities, we want to hear from you. 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling .
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of the content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early morning, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix, Arizona, is one of the most dynamic and fast-growing cities in the United States — a sprawling desert metropolis that blends stunning natural beauty with a thriving urban energy. Surrounded by the Sonoran Desert, Phoenix offers year-round sunshine and unmatched outdoor adventures, from hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park to exploring the scenic beauty of the Tonto National Forest just an hour away. The city is a haven for golf enthusiasts, cyclists, and outdoor lovers of all kinds.

Beyond the desert landscape, Phoenix boasts a rich and diverse cultural scene. The city is home to world-class museums like the Heard Museum, dedicated to Native American art and culture, and the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest art museums in the Southwest. The downtown core is alive with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant nightlife, while neighborhoods like Roosevelt Row serve as the beating heart of the local arts community. From the Phoenix Symphony to the bustling farmers markets and food halls, there is always something new to discover.

Sports are a way of life in the Valley of the Sun. Phoenix is home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the MLB's Diamondbacks, the NHL's Coyotes, and the WNBA's Mercury — giving residents a full calendar of live sports action. Whether you're catching a game, exploring a new trail, or dining at one of the city's award-winning restaurants, Phoenix offers an extraordinary quality of life in one of America's most exciting and welcoming cities.

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.

The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

job.title: Freelance Producer, Atlanta Bureau
job.description:
Fox News is looking for a creative, organized, motivated, curious individual with strong editorial and logistical skills to fill a Freelancer Producer position for our Atlanta Bureau. The Freelance Producer will work with reporters to set up interviews, obtain information, build graphics, and deliver compelling live shots and packages for coverage of any breaking or planned news event. The position will be on an “as needed” basis.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Find elements, log events, and identify news developments
  • Be read-in and familiar with daily developments on Southeast stories
  • Work with reporters to set up interviews, ask questions, and obtain information to craft and produce live shots and packages
  • Monitor wires, social media, and other broadcast networks for news developments
  • Relay information regarding story editorial and team logistics to relevant FNC parties
  • Pitch story ideas
  • Work with editors to make sure we deliver visually compelling stories

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of relevant field producing experience, or an equivalent combination of skills and demonstrated experience
  • Experience with producing news live shots and packages
  • Strong logistical and editorial skills with knowledge of national and international stories
  • Ability to arrange interviews, gather information, and develop stories
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multitask, and prioritize daily, especially in breaking news situations
  • Familiarity with iNews is a plus
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts including weekends and holidays

We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des plus importantes entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous diffusons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de marques de cinéma, de télévision et de diffusion en continu, et auquel nous donnons vie grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques à l’échelle mondiale, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’entremise de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics vivent et travaillent. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir à notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir un vaste éventail de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES 

  • As an Associate Design Director, you will support the Design Director in driving the execution, alignment, and day-to-day coordination of the project’s design vision across pillars and disciplines. You will act as a key operational and creative partner, helping ensure design decisions, priorities, and follow-through remain consistent across the project. 

  • Partner closely with the Design Director to define the architecture of shared systems at the intersection of design and programming, including the creator facing-UGC API through which creators build their own experiences. Strong architectural thinking is central to this role: defining clear systems, reusable capabilities, and consistent interfaces. 

  • Support the execution and communication of the gameplay systems and player experience. 

  • Maintain visibility across multiple pillars, strike teams, and cross-disciplinary initiatives to help ensure alignment and consistency. 

  • Help drive follow-up, coordination, and resolution of cross-team design topics and dependencies. 

  • Support design decision-making on gameplay systems, player experience, workflows, and feature implementation. 

  • Collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, Art, UX, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines to ensure alignment between creative goals and execution realities. 

  • Help identify risks, blockers, communication gaps, and production challenges, and proactively work toward solutions. 

  • Mentor and support designers across the team by providing feedback, guidance, and design oversight. 

  • Ensure documentation, communication, and design intentions remain clear and actionable across teams. 

  • Contribute to reviews, playtests, iteration, and feature evaluations to help maintain quality and consistency across the experience. 

  • Help maintain consistency between long-term vision, short-term priorities, and day-to-day execution. 

RESPONSIBILTÉS 

  • En tant qu’Associate Design Director, vous soutiendrez le Design Director dans l’exécution, l’alignement et la coordination quotidienne de la vision design du projet à travers les différents piliers et disciplines. Vous agirez comme un partenaire créatif et opérationnel clé afin d’assurer la cohérence des décisions, priorités et suivis design à l’échelle du projet. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le directeur du design pour définir l’architecture de systèmes partagés à la croisée du design et de la programmation, notamment l’API de création de contenu utilisateur (UGC) permettant aux créateurs de construire leurs propres expériences. La capacité à penser en termes d’architecture est au cœur de ce rôle : définir des systèmes clairs, des fonctionnalités réutilisables et des interfaces cohérentes. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le Design Director afin de soutenir l’exécution et la communication de la vision globale du gameplay et de l’expérience joueur. 

  • Maintenir une visibilité sur plusieurs piliers, strike teams et initiatives transversales afin d’assurer l’alignement et la cohérence entre les équipes. 

  • Aider à assurer le suivi, la coordination et la résolution des sujets et dépendances design entre les équipes. 

  • Soutenir la prise de décision design concernant les systèmes de gameplay, l’expérience joueur, les workflows et l’implémentation des fonctionnalités. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de Production, Ingénierie, Art, UX, Animation, Audio et les autres disciplines afin d’assurer l’alignement entre les objectifs créatifs et les réalités de production. 

  • Identifier les risques, blocages, problèmes de communication et défis de production, puis contribuer activement à leur résolution. 

  • Encadrer et soutenir les designers de l’équipe en fournissant du feedback, du mentorat et de la supervision design. 

  • Veiller à ce que la documentation, la communication et les intentions design demeurent claires et exploitables pour les équipes. 

  • Participer aux revues, playtests, itérations et évaluations de fonctionnalités afin de maintenir la qualité et la cohérence de l’expérience. 

  • Contribuer à maintenir l’alignement entre la vision long terme, les priorités court terme et l’exécution quotidienne. 

QUALIFICATIONS 

Basic Requirements:  

  • Demonstrated experience defining system architectures at the intersection of design and programming, translating complex needs into clear abstractions, reusable building blocks, and well-defined interfaces. 

  • Strong understanding of modularity, abstraction, and composition, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and their tradeoffs to both designers and engineers. 

  • Strong experience in game design on AAA or high-quality indie productions. 

  • Experience leading or coordinating multidisciplinary teams or large gameplay initiatives. 

  • Strong understanding of gameplay systems, player experience, progression, systemic design, and production realities. 

  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to align multiple teams and stakeholders. 

  • Ability to balance creative vision with practical production constraints and technical feasibility. 

  • Strong knowledge of Unreal Engine 5 and Blueprint scripting workflows. 

  • Comfortable operating across multiple gameplay domains, features, and team structures. 

  • Experience collaborating closely with Design, Production, Engineering, Art, and UX leadership. 

  • Ability to make informed moment-to-moment decisions while maintaining alignment with broader project goals. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with UGC systems, sandbox gameplay, live services, or player-driven experiences. 

  • Strong systems design sensibilities and understanding of emergent gameplay. 

  • Experience supporting feature teams, strike teams, or horizontal cross-project initiatives. 

  • Experience designing creator tools, scripting interfaces, APIs, or frameworks used by others to build gameplay experiences. 

  • Experience reviewing implementation quality and ensuring consistency across multiple gameplay features. 

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate ambiguity in fast-moving production environments. 

  • Interest in iterative development, rapid prototyping, and collaborative creative workflows. 

QUALIFICATIONS 

Exigences de base :  

  • Expérience démontrée dans la définition d’architectures de systèmes à la croisée du design et de la programmation, en traduisant des besoins complexes en abstractions claires, en éléments réutilisables et en interfaces bien définies. 

  • Solide compréhension des principes de modularité, d’abstraction et de composition, et capacité à expliquer les décisions d’architecture et leurs compromis aux designers comme aux ingénieurs. 

  • Solide expérience en design de jeux sur des productions AAA ou des productions indépendantes de grande qualité. 

  • Expérience en leadership ou en coordination d’équipes multidisciplinaires ou de grandes initiatives gameplay. 

  • Excellente compréhension des systèmes de gameplay, de l’expérience joueur, de la progression, du design systémique et des réalités de production. 

  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et communicationnelles, avec la capacité d’aligner plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes. 

  • Capacité à équilibrer vision créative, contraintes de production et faisabilité technique. 

  • Solide maîtrise d’Unreal Engine 5 et des workflows de scripting Blueprint. 

  • Aisance à travailler sur plusieurs domaines de gameplay, fonctionnalités et structures d’équipe. 

  • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec les directions Design, Production, Ingénierie, Art et UX. 

  • Capacité à prendre des décisions éclairées au quotidien tout en restant aligné avec les objectifs globaux du projet. 

Atouts recherchés :  

  • Expérience avec les systèmes UGC, le gameplay de type bac à sable, les jeux en service continu ou les expériences façonnées par les joueurs. 

  • Forte sensibilité en design systémique et bonne compréhension du gameplay émergent. 

  • Expérience de soutien à des feature teams, strike teams ou initiatives transversales à grande échelle. 

  • Expérience dans la conception d’outils de création, d’interfaces de script, d’API ou de frameworks permettant à d’autres de construire des expériences de gameplay. 

  • Bonne sensibilité technique et capacité à communiquer efficacement avec des ingénieurs et des technical designers. 

  • Expérience dans la révision de la qualité d’implémentation et le maintien de la cohérence entre plusieurs fonctionnalités gameplay. 

  • Solides capacités de résolution de problèmes et aisance à évoluer dans des environnements de production rapides et ambigus. 

  • Intérêt pour le développement itératif, le prototypage rapide et les workflows créatifs collaboratifs. 

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

RESPONSIBILTIES

The Development QA Tester partners directly with designers, engineers, and artists to test features throughout the development cycle. You’ll validate functionality, identify issues early, analyze root causes, and help maintain build stability. You will collaborate closely with developers, review requirements, and use tools to perform functional, regression, and performance tests, ensuring software is reliable, secure, and user-friendly.

  • Test new features during development and provide clear, actionable feedback to developers.
  • Identify, reproduce, and document bugs with detailed steps, logs, and supporting evidence.
  • Analyze issues to determine severity, patterns, and potential root causes.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to understand feature intentions, edge cases, and technical constraints.
  • Verify bug fixes and ensure regressions are caught early.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and checklists for ongoing features.
  • Support integration testing when new systems, builds, or content are merged.
  • Participate in daily stand‑ups, feature reviews, and sprint planning to stay aligned with development progress.
  • Use debugging tools, logs, and engine features to investigate issues more deeply.
  • Provide feedback on usability, clarity, and player experience from a QA perspective.
  • Help maintain build stability by identifying blockers quickly and communicating them effectively.

RESPONSABILITÉS

La personne occupant le poste de testeur QA en développement travaille directement avec les équipes de conception, d’ingénierie et d’art afin de tester les fonctionnalités tout au long du cycle de développement. Vous validerez le bon fonctionnement des fonctionnalités, repérerez rapidement les problèmes, analyserez leurs causes profondes et contribuerez à maintenir la stabilité des builds. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, examinerez les exigences et utiliserez différents outils pour effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance afin de garantir que le logiciel est fiable, sécuritaire et convivial.

  • Tester de nouvelles fonctionnalités pendant leur développement et fournir aux équipes de développement une rétroaction claire et exploitable.
  • Repérer, reproduire et documenter les bogues en fournissant des étapes détaillées, des logs et des éléments probants à l’appui.
  • Analyser les problèmes afin d’en déterminer la gravité, les tendances et les causes profondes potentielles.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de conception afin de comprendre l’intention derrière les fonctionnalités, les cas limites et les contraintes techniques.
  • Vérifier les correctifs de bogues et s’assurer que les régressions sont détectées rapidement.
  • Créer et tenir à jour des plans de test, des cas de test et des listes de vérification pour les fonctionnalités en cours de développement.
  • Soutenir les tests d’intégration lorsque de nouveaux systèmes, builds ou contenus sont intégrés.
  • Participer aux stand-ups quotidiens, aux revues de fonctionnalités et à la planification des sprints afin de rester en phase avec l’avancement du développement.
  • Utiliser des outils de débogage, des logs et les fonctionnalités du moteur afin d’analyser les problèmes plus en profondeur.
  • Fournir une rétroaction sur la convivialité, la clarté et l’expérience des joueurs selon une perspective QA.

The Regional Marketing Director is the senior marketing leader for the regional marketing team — setting strategy, owning station relationships, and directing the full ecosystem of centralized capabilities toward outcomes that grow audiences and drive business results across the portfolio of markets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: close enough to station leadership to understand what each market needs, and senior enough to direct how Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle work together to deliver it. The RMD leads a lean operational team and is accountable for the marketing performance of every station in the region.

Strategy & Direction

  • Own the audience and market point of view; be the authority on who each station serves and what their market requires, and carry that perspective into every strategic decision and campaign investment.
  • Set the marketing strategy; translate enterprise priorities, station business objectives and competitive dynamics into market-specific plans that direct the full scope of centralized capability investment and drive results.
  • Synthesize audience research, ratings, digital performance and market intelligence into strategic insight that sharpens plans over time and informs enterprise-level decisions.
  • Review and approve campaign briefs before execution begins; serve as the final review before campaigns reach market, ensuring every initiative meets the standard for strategy and quality.

Station Partnership & Leadership

  • Serve as the senior marketing relationship for station general managers, news directors and content leaders across the region; build the trust and institutional knowledge that positions marketing as a strategic voice in station leadership decisions.
  • Own the strategic marketing conversation, aligning with station leadership on business objectives, campaign priorities and resource commitments; manage expectations when capacity or strategy requires adjustment.

Capability Direction & Performance

  • Direct the deployment of centralized capabilities — Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle — across markets; ensure resources are allocated against the highest-priority campaigns and that each channel lead has clear strategic direction.
  • Own marketing performance accountability for the region; track results against station KPIs to evaluate campaign effectiveness and guide resource allocation.
  • Own the regional brand marketing budget; partner with the Paid Marketing Director to manage station performance marketing investment, allocating resources against the right priorities and delivering measurable return.

Team Leadership & Development
