job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Data Scientist

Job Description

 

About The Position |

As a Senior Data Scientist for personalization, you will own the science behind the recommendation engine that powers each user’s personalized product feed. Starting from our user-saved product signals and a live catalog ingested from thousands of retailer feeds, you will design, build, evaluate, and continuously improve the models that learn each user’s taste across brand, category, color, price point, and fit.

 

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role. You will take a recommendation problem from raw data all the way to a production model running on our existing MLOps stack — you own the model layer, not the infrastructure. Our platform team already operates the feature store, serving, and autoscaling; your job is to decide what to model, prove it works through rigorous offline and online experimentation, ship it, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate.

 

A defining challenge of this role is cold-start. We are launching with a small behavioral dataset and a catalog scaling from hundreds of thousands of products toward tens of millions. You will need strong commerce and product-data intuition to produce high-quality recommendations before rich click data exists — and the experimental discipline to keep improving them as it arrives. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

 

Remote or Hybrid 3x a week NYC

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance our offices in New York, the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.

 

About The Team: |

_______________________________________________________________________________

Our next-generation product discovery platform connects shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. We ingest live product feeds from thousands of retailers and use a rich understanding of each user's taste to surface the right product at the right moment.

 

We're building the recommendation engine at the heart of this shopping experience — a system that understands not just what people save, but why they save it. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

About The Positions Contributions:

  • 35% Recommendation & Personalization Modeling

    Own the design and development of the core recommendation models that turn user-saved product data into a personalized feed. Develop multi-signal models spanning brand affinity, category, color/visual attributes, fit and sizing, price sensitivity, and trend. Select and justify approaches across collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, content-based, and hybrid/neural methods (e.g., two-tower and other embedding models), and know when each applies. Build product and user embeddings that capture semantic similarity across the catalog and power candidate generation and retrieval. Design cold-start strategies that produce high-quality recommendations for new users and newly ingested products with little or no behavioral history.

    25% Experimentation & Measurement

    Define what “good” personalization means and how it is measured. Establish rigorous offline evaluation (ranking and relevance metrics, sound holdout design) and connect it to online outcomes. Design, run, and read out A/B and multivariate experiments, and translate results into clear product and business decisions. Bring statistical discipline — sound experiment design, awareness of bias and confounding, and honest interpretation — so the team can trust which changes actually move engagement.

    20% Data, Signals & Feature Understanding

    Develop deep intuition for Picksy’s product catalog and user signals. Turn implicit behavior (saves, clicks, dwell, shares) and catalog attributes into meaningful model features, writing SQL against BigQuery to pull, join, and shape raw data into training/evaluation datasets. Apply NLP and computer-vision techniques — including modern embedding and LLM-based approaches — to extract structured attributes (category, color, material, fit) from unstructured product descriptions and imagery, and to enrich sparse catalog data. Partner with data engineering on data quality, freshness, and coverage as the catalog scales from hundreds of thousands toward tens of millions of products.

    20% Full-Cycle Ownership & Productionization

    Take models from prototype to production yourself. Write clean, production-quality code and deploy into the existing MLOps pipeline (feature store, training, serving, monitoring) rather than building infrastructure from scratch. Own model performance in production: instrument it, watch for drift and degradation, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate. Document models, features, and decisions clearly, and collaborate closely with the MLOps, engineering, and product teams to integrate the model layer into the live product.

Education:

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.

Experience:

You combine the modeling depth of an applied/data scientist with the pragmatism to ship end-to-end. You bring:

  • Strong data science fundamentals: statistics, experimental design, and evaluation methodology, with the analytical ability to turn model results into clear product and business decisions.

  • Demonstrated ownership of the full A/B testing lifecycle: designing experiments, running them, reading them out, and deciding; not just reporting offline metrics.

  • Experience designing, training, and deploying embedding models and vector retrieval (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, or Vertex AI Vector Search) for product or content similarity at catalog scale.

  • Direct experience with cold-start / sparse-signal personalization: building useful recommendations from a new catalog, new users, or both. This is a core, day-one challenge of the role.

  • Strong Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) plus the standard scientific stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). You write production-quality code, not just notebooks.

  • Strong SQL: hands-on experience querying large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred) to pull, join, and assemble the training and evaluation datasets that feed your models. This is a daily part of the role.

  • Experience deploying and serving models on a cloud ML platform: GCP Vertex AI strongly preferred (SageMaker or equivalent acceptable) and you are comfortable owning the full model lifecycle: training, deployment, versioning, and monitoring.

  • Commerce intuition: you’ve worked with product catalogs and understand merchandising, category, and PM concerns. It shows up in how you talk about catalogs and taste, not just models.

  • Curiosity and pragmatism about emerging AI, particularly LLMs and modern retrieval/ranking, with a track record of bringing new techniques into real production use.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Nice to have:

  • Applied NLP and/or computer vision for extracting structured attributes from product text and imagery.

  • Experience with adaptive recommendation and experimentation methods; multi-armed or contextual bandits.

  • Public writing or conference talks on recommendation, personalization, or ranking work.

  • Early-stage or commerce experience where you wore multiple hats and shipped against real business metrics (e.g., commerce SaaS or a vertical commerce startup).

As a key member of the Internal Audit team, the Automated Controls Audit Lead supports the planning and execution of AI audits and internal controls work, along with related initiatives and projects, across Finance Operations. The role evaluates both traditional control frameworks and automated, machine-learning-enabled systems, and assesses AI internal controls supporting business process improvement initiatives. The Lead supports ongoing compliance monitoring and drives the resolution of internal control inquiries and enhancements. Because the AI landscape shifts quickly, the role demands knowledge agility: continuously evaluating and integrating fast-changing AI capabilities and audit tooling into internal processes and controls, and communicating clearly with stakeholders across departments as the Finance organization adapts. You will report to the Manager, FMA, Compliance & Technical Accounting and be based in our New Jersey office.


You Will:

  • Evaluate controls over automated and AI-enabled processes — including model inputs and outputs, system-generated reports, and human-review checkpoints — alongside traditional controls.
  • Provide general audit support, including document retrieval, review, and research in response to internal and external audit requests.
  • Proactively manage the impact of AI-driven shifts on company controls and processes, identifying where control design must adapt before gaps emerge.
  • Continuously align process workflows, control documentation, and knowledge bases with rapid AI advancements throughout the company processes.
  • Lead and/or engage in business process improvement initiatives and projects as assigned, embedding appropriate controls into redesigned and automated processes.
  • Independently research and bring to resolution general compliance issues as they arise, escalating appropriately.

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The New York Times is looking for a strategic, analytical marketer to help improve how AI-generated answers represent our brand, products, subscription value, pricing and customer experience.

In this role, you will build an ongoing understanding of the commercial questions people ask AI systems, the sources shaping their answers, and opportunities to improve the visibility and accuracy of our information. You will identify where to focus, guide experiments, measure results, and turn what you learn into practical recommendations for product marketers and the teams that own or oversee relevant consumer-facing surfaces.

This role sits within the enterprise Marketing team and partners closely with cross-functional colleagues across teams, including Product, Growth, Audience, Communications and Customer Care. It is a full-time, hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You are expected to come into the office 3 days per week.

  • Monitor how AI systems answer commercially important consumer questions about The New York Times, including questions about our brand, products, subscription value, pricing and customer experience.
  • Prioritize topics and opportunities based on their strategic importance to the business.
  • Identify the sources shaping AI-generated answers and diagnose gaps in how our brand and commercial value are represented.

  • 7+ years of experience in SEO measurement, marketing, digital strategy, consumer insights, analytics or a related field. Enough technical SEO literacy to tell a crawler or indexing problem from a messaging problem.
  • Experience researching consumer questions, monitoring how a brand or product is represented and perceived, and synthesizing findings into actionable recommendations.

job.title: AI Fellow
job.description:
The big picture: AI is now central to how Axios builds, operates and innovates. We believe AI is a force multiplier - not a side experiment, not a siloed function, but a capability we are embedding at every level and in every role across the company. We are hiring an AI Fellow to work directly with our co-founders as an in-house AI guide and builder. One seat. Three months. Real impact.

Why you matter: This is a highly selective opportunity for a technically sophisticated builder who lives and breathes AI, and is eager to apply that expertise inside a fast-moving, mission-driven media company. The AI Fellow will work directly with the founders to track and interpret major developments in large language models and emerging AI tools, prototype new product ideas, and pressure-test initiatives that could meaningfully shape how Axios leverages AI across editorial, product, and business functions. 

This is not a traditional internship. You won’t be shadowing someone. You’ll be the person we’re learning from.

The details:
The AI Fellow will work directly with Axios co-founders and senior leaders to accelerate how AI is embedded across the organization. This role will combine research, prototyping, experimentation, and strategic advisory work.

You will:

  • Brief founders and leadership on key developments in LLMs and applied AI
  • Build and test prototypes for internal tools, workflows, and product ideas
  • Pressure-test emerging AI use cases across editorial, revenue, product, and operations
  • Identify high-leverage opportunities where AI can meaningfully increase speed, quality, and impact
  • Help translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical applications for non-technical leaders

About you:

  • You are deeply curious about AI and its real-world applications
  • You think in systems and frameworks, not just prompts
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and experimenting quickly
  • You can clearly explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • You can operate at both the technical and strategic level — building something in the morning and briefing founders in the afternoon
  • Strong preference for a Winter 2026 college graduate
  • Strong preference for candidates located in the DC metro area

Skills:

  • Extensive experience working hands-on with LLMs and generative AI tools
  • Experience building and shipping applied AI projects or prototypes
  • Familiarity with model fine-tuning, embeddings, APIs, or AI orchestration frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Program details:

  • Three-month paid fellowship

job.title: Senior Research Manager, Food Regulation
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a Senior Research Manager to help lead part of its regulatory intelligence and information services product, AgencyIQ. Since its founding in early 2020, AgencyIQ has quickly become the premier source of regulatory intelligence and analysis for professionals working in the life sciences and food industries.


As a subject matter expert in U.S. food regulations issued by the Food and Drug Administration, Department of Agriculture, and state agencies, the Senior Research Manager will be responsible for analyzing the relevance of regulatory changes and developments, articulating the type and degree of impact on food companies, and providing contextualization to an audience of knowledgeable regulatory intelligence professionals.

 

The Senior Research Manager will join a team of experienced researchers responsible producing a mix of daily content, in-depth research, weekly insights, directed deliverables and presentations. The role will cover a variety of food related regulatory topics including labeling, ingredients, packaging, nutrition, safety, and compliance.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Produce daily (3-4 per week) topical intelligence articles and other content for our subscribers based on emerging regulatory and legislative developments related to food regulatory topics
  • Serve as a subject matter specialist on several food topics for AgencyIQ (e.g., labeling, packaging, nutrition, ingredients, safety, compliance, etc.)
  • Lead or participate in the development and delivery of in-depth analysis, deep-dive research, webinars and email newsletters
  • Collaborate with other members of the AgencyIQ research team focused on chemical, food and life sciences regulation
  • Participate in subscriber- and prospect-facing events, briefings, and business development activities

What you’ll need

Required:

  • Have 5+ years’ experience analyzing U.S. food regulations, guidance and policies from the FDA, USDA, and state authorities (e.g., working for a company, trade group, regulator, or consulting company).
  • Have prior experience writing about regulatory developments in a deadline-driven environment for an executive or industry audience (e.g., for an internal company newsletter or for externally-facing publications); 
  • A strong affinity for writing – efficiently and effectively, and for a business or policy audience – paired with a knowledge of (and passion for) regulation and regulatory policy
  • Experience and comfort working in fast-paced, research-driven environments in which daily delivery of regulatory analyses is the norm
  • An excellent working knowledge of food regulatory frameworks and processes (and in particular the FDA) and capable of delivering expert insights to our knowledgeable subscribers
  • Find enjoyment in reading, analyzing, writing, speaking and learning about challenging or new regulatory topics; Have strong attention to detail and accuracy

 

Preferred:

 

  • Have an advanced degree or certification related to food science, law or policy (i.e., a JD, PhD, or relevant master’s degree); or
  • Have prior experience working in media, including as a journalist or writing a product widely read by others (i.e., a business intelligence product or internal newsletter).
  • Experience presenting on regulatory topics to a variety of different audience types (small groups, large groups) in different environments (virtual and in-person)

Compensation: $135-160k Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon! 


About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

Real Chemistry Media is a healthcare-focused media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization dedicated to helping life sciences brands create more meaningful customer relationships. Through integrated media, omnichannel strategy, CRM, analytics, and engagement solutions, we help clients design and activate connected experiences across the healthcare ecosystem.

The Associate Director, Client Experience (Media) leads integrated media and omnichannel planning across complex pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts. job.title: Director of Employee Listening & Insights
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Director of Employee Listening & Insights will lead WPP’s global approach to understanding and responding to employee sentiment, creating a scalable, insight-led listening ecosystem that drives visible action and sustains trust through transformation.

At the heart of the role is connecting employee voice with leadership decisions and tangible employee experience outcomes. The Director will harness technology, analytics and automation to provide timely, actionable workforce insights and embed employee sentiment more deeply into decision-making across WPP.

Partnering closely with HR, People Analytics, Communications, GBS and business leaders, the role will help create a single, trusted view of workforce insights and ensure employee feedback leads to meaningful action and measurable improvements throughout Elevate28 and beyond.

What you'll be doing:

Employee Listening Strategy & Delivery
  • Lead the evolution of WPP’s global employee listening strategy, developing a clear roadmap for implementation from 2027 onwards.
  • Build and embed a scalable, insight-led listening ecosystem that strengthens employee voice, drives visible action and sustains trust through transformation.
  • Review and optimise WPP’s employee listening technology landscape, leveraging technology, analytics and automation to deliver more timely and actionable insights.
  • Lead and continuously enhance WPP’s global listening framework, including engagement surveys, pulse surveys, lifecycle surveys, exit feedback and employee advisory forums.
  • Deliver monthly pulse surveys and transformation sentiment tracking across major geographies, providing leaders with timely visibility of employee sentiment and experience.
  • Ensure listening activities are closely aligned to business priorities, transformation milestones and employee experience objectives.
  • Lead survey governance, stakeholder engagement, vendor relationships and communications, ensuring a consistent and effective global approach.
  • Monitor participation, engagement and feedback quality, identifying opportunities to strengthen employee voice and increase the impact of listening.
  • Partner with the broader People Experience team to identify key employee experience pain points and prioritise areas for improvement.
  • Partner closely with People Analytics, GBS and Technology teams to create a more connected, automated listening ecosystem and a single source of truth for workforce insights.

Employee Insights & Action

  • Define and embed WPP’s employee insights strategy, establishing clear governance, reporting and action-planning frameworks.
  • Translate employee feedback and listening data into clear, actionable insights that strengthen the connection between employee voice, leadership decisions and employee experience outcomes.
  • Analyse data to identify emerging trends, organisational risks, opportunities and areas requiring intervention.
  • Provide executive-ready insights and recommendations for People Leadership, EMT reviews and transformation governance forums.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility of employee sentiment, engagement and experience trends.
  • Track key indicators including engagement, transformation sentiment, change readiness, retention risks and wellbeing.
  • Identify leading indicators and early warning signals, enabling leaders to take proactive action.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to translate insights into measurable actions and track their impact over time.
  • Build a data-driven culture where employee sentiment and experience are embedded into decision-making at all levels.
  • Lead the development of WPP’s “You Said, We Did” communications, demonstrating how employee feedback is influencing decisions and driving tangible change.

Key Measures of Success & Year One Deliverables

Success in the first year will be focused on establishing a stronger, insight-led listening approach and demonstrating a clear connection between employee feedback and action. Key priorities will include:

  • Delivering a reimagined WPP Employee Listening Strategy and roadmap for 2027.
  • Establishing a Continuous Listening Model, including monthly pulse surveys across major geographies.
  • Developing an Employee Insights Dashboard providing timely visibility of employee sentiment, engagement and experience trends.
  • Delivering the first cycle of the “You Said, We Did” programme, clearly demonstrating how employee feedback translates into action.
  • Driving strong listening participation and satisfaction, ensuring employees see value in sharing their feedback.
  • Increasing the insight-to-action ratio, with listening insights translated into tangible and communicated actions.
  • Monitoring transformation sentiment and fatigue, identifying emerging risks and enabling timely intervention.

What you'll need:

job.title: NOC Technician II
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

As a NOC Technician II, you’ll serve as a central point of communication and action during incidents, partnering closely with Engineering and other teams to monitor systems, resolve issues, and maintain the performance of our nationwide network and IT infrastructure. If you're ready to make an impact in the world of broadcast operations, we want to hear from you!

 

*This is an on-site position that will provide coverage for various shifts (1st, 2nd, or 3rd) depending on the need.*

 

Here's some of what you will be doing:

  • Advanced RF Broadcast Support
    • Respond to complex or recurring RF alarms and outages, using deep system knowledge to identify root causes and implement long-term solutions.
    • Analyze telemetry trends and performance data across multiple transmitter sites to proactively detect degradation or abnormal behavior.
    • Coordinate corrective action plans with Field personnel, ensuring resolution timelines, testing protocols, and proper documentation are followed.
    • Proficiency in database script generation for all equipment and all rack configurations with proper logic for effective SNMP alarm management.
    • Support advanced troubleshooting of audio chain components, including signal flow analysis across encoders, processors, multiplexers, and satellite backhauls.
    • Contribute to RF system upgrades and rollouts, supporting configuration, validation, and remote commissioning of new broadcast equipment.
    • Train and mentor junior NOC Technicians in interpreting remote control data, handling RF alerts, and understanding FCC compliance requirements.
  • Enhanced Network Infrastructure Oversight
    • Resolve escalated network issues involving routing protocols, VLAN configurations, firewall policies, or cross-site connectivity problems.
    • Monitor and validate complex network relationships, including multicast configurations, VPN tunnels, and hybrid cloud infrastructure dependencies.
    • Participate in network maintenance windows, supporting firmware upgrades, config changes, or failover testing as part of the operations team.
    • Support integration between broadcast systems and IT infrastructure, such as IP-based audio transport, SNMP monitoring, or broadcast-over-IP platforms.
    • Lead investigation of intermittent or chronic IT service issues, working with cross-functional teams (IT, InfoSec, Broadcast Engineering) as needed.
  • Operational Process & Reliability
    • Review and improve SOPs for alarm handling, troubleshooting procedures, and shift handoffs to increase team efficiency and consistency.
    • Identify systemic issues and recommend improvements to monitoring thresholds, alert routing, or preventative maintenance plans.
    • Act as lead technician on shift, coordinating team response to major incidents, validating troubleshooting steps, and ensuring accurate documentation.
    • Manage escalations with external vendors, such as satellite service providers, remote connectivity carriers, or equipment manufacturers.
  • Reporting, Documentation & Quality Control
    • Oversee accuracy of log entries, work orders, and event tracking, ensuring completeness and compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
    • Perform root cause analysis and produce post-incident summaries that contribute to long-term operational improvements.
    • Create training documentation and job aids for new tools, procedures, or systems introduced to the environment.
  • Leadership & Professional Development
    • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for entry-level team members, providing informal leadership and mentoring support.
    • Participate in cross-team meetings, offering NOC perspectives on operational impacts, monitoring needs, or deployment readiness.
    • Demonstrate ownership of assigned systems or regions, proactively ensuring their health, uptime, and documentation accuracy.
    • Continue professional development in areas such as networking (e.g., CCNA-level topics), broadcast engineering, or cloud systems (e.g., AWS fundamentals).

Here's some experience we are seeking: 

  • Associate’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Networking, or Information Technology.
  • Industry certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA Network+, SBE CBT).
  • 2–4 years of experience in a NOC, broadcast, network support, or hybrid technical environment.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting RF broadcast and IT infrastructure issues.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Kybio) and alarm escalation.
  • Strong documentation skills, able to contribute to process guides and job aids.
  • Ability to mentor entry-level technicians and provide guidance in troubleshooting.
  • Solid teamwork and communication skills across broadcast, IT, and field engineering.
  • Demonstrated capacity to manage multiple incidents and prioritize effectively.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with a strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE? 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values.

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

• Call tracking

• Event Marketing and Management
• Recruitment Advertising

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives

  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

  • Flexible, creative and curious.

  • Digitally savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools highly preferred.


Pay Range

USD $3,000.00 - USD $5,000.00 /Mo.
Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
  • Life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Punjabi News Producer - OMNI 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

OMNI Television, Canada’s only multilingual and multicultural television station is seeking a Full-time Producer in Vancouver to take on the role of leading the Punjabi News team in BC.

 

Reporting to the Senior Manager of News, the successful candidate will be a strong leader who supports and leads in daily news coverage, decision making, and mentorship for Punjabi-speaking journalists in Metro Vancouver.

 

What You'll do:

  • Lead daily news coverage, regular pitch meetings, and editorial direction of OMNI News Punjabi.

  • Support community liaison team with events relating to the Punjabi community.
  • Oversee special news coverage or presentations for OMNI News Punjabi.
  • Lead by example as a strong ambassador of the OMNI News brand.
  • Coach teams to become the best journalists they can be.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

What you bring:

  • Degree or diploma in journalism or broadcasting (or equivalent experience)
  • Proven experience in journalism and media.
  • Television broadcast experience.
  • Keen editorial skills.
  • Leadership/management experience an asset.
  • An ability to work in a dynamic team environment.
  • Fluency in written and spoken Punjabi.
  • Knowledge of cultural and political landscape across Canada.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KSTU
job.description:
News is changing, and we’re looking for journalists who want to help shape what comes next. At KSTU Fox 13, an E.W. Scripps station, you’ll do more than report the news. You’ll help reimagine how stories are discovered, told, and experienced across every platform.


As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll be part of a newsroom that believes local journalism can spark conversation, strengthen communities, and make a real difference. If you’re energized by breaking news, meaningful storytelling, and the opportunity to connect with one of the nation’s rapidly growing communities, this is your chance to be part of something bigger.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize materials and write stories according to editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit or assist in editing videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live or pre-recorded situations.
  • Work cooperatively with photographers assigned to stories, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multimedia stories.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on non-linear systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits

OUR TEAM:

You’ll join a newsroom filled with curious, creative people who believe great journalism starts with understanding the community we serve. Our team brings different perspectives, backgrounds, interests, and experiences to the table, united by a shared drive to tell stories that matter. Whether you thrive on breaking news, unforgettable characters, accountability reporting, or finding the story everyone else overlooked, there’s room here to make your mark.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City gives you the rare chance to pursue ambitious journalism in a place where adventure is practically part of the commute. The Wasatch Mountains rise just outside the city, putting legendary skiing, hiking, biking, and mountain landscapes within easy reach, while Utah’s red rock country and five national parks make weekend road trips hard to beat.

Beyond the outdoors, Salt Lake City offers a vibrant mix of neighborhoods, restaurants, arts, culture, sports, and a thriving tech scene. It’s a place where your career can grow alongside the community you cover, with no shortage of people to meet, places to explore, or stories waiting to be told.

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. El Digital Planner – IZZI Ops será responsable de planificar, administrar y optimizar la distribución y comercialización del inventario publicitario digital de IZZI, asegurando la correcta ejecución de las campañas y el cumplimiento de los compromisos comerciales.

Trabajará de manera transversal con los equipos de Ventas, Marketing, Producto y Operaciones para maximizar el rendimiento del inventario, impulsar oportunidades de monetización y generar insights que contribuyan a la toma de decisiones estratégicas del negocio.


Sobre el puesto

  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de los acuerdos de servicio (SLAs) con clientes internos y externos.
  • Maximizar el rendimiento y la monetización del inventario publicitario digital.
  • Contribuir a la optimización de ingresos y resultados de las campañas.
  • Generar análisis e insights basados en datos para identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

Tu día a día

  • Administrar y optimizar campañas programáticas, supervisando su ejecución, monitoreando indicadores de desempeño y generando reportes analíticos periódicos.
  • Validar el correcto registro y reconocimiento de ingresos de las campañas en Google Ad Manager.
  • Planificar y supervisar la implementación de campañas publicitarias en las plataformas digitales de IZZI.
  • Analizar métricas históricas y resultados de campañas para identificar tendencias, oportunidades de optimización y áreas de mejora.
  • Monitorear la disponibilidad y distribución del inventario publicitario digital de IZZI en sus diferentes plataformas y canales, incluyendo HLS, Stitch y otros formatos de distribución.
  • Proponer e impulsar proyectos e iniciativas que contribuyan al crecimiento, aprovechamiento y monetización del inventario digital.
  • Elaborar forecasts y administrar la disponibilidad de inventario para eventos especiales, anticipando necesidades y oportunidades comerciales.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Marketing, Producto, Operaciones, Administración, agencias y Ventas Digitales para asegurar la correcta ejecución de las estrategias comerciales.

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Backend ( PNR )
job.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer – Backend (PNR API Platform)

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform. Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Personalization & Recommendations (PNR) API Platform team, you will build and operate the backend systems that power personalized content discovery and recommendation experiences across FOX's digital products. The PNR API platform serves real-time personalized recommendations at scale, combining user behavioral signals, content metadata, vector similarity search, and ML model inference to deliver individualized experiences to millions of users.

You will work at the intersection of backend engineering and ML infrastructure - building recommendation engines, reranking services, user profile systems, and model serving pipelines. This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend microservices for real-time personalization and content recommendations
  • Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from system design to production rollout and ongoing operations
  • Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production
  • Work with multiple data stores including relational databases, vector databases, search engines, key-value stores, and caching systems to build efficient data access patterns
  • Integrate ML models into real-time serving pipelines, working closely with ML Engineers and Data Scientists
  • Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions
  • Optimize systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost at scale
  • Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams to deliver recommendation capabilities across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV
  • Participate in on-call rotation and drive production reliability and operational excellence
  • Contribute to engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and security

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience building backend software systems in production environments
  • Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang
  • Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora) including query optimization and data modeling
  • Experience with caching systems (Redis/ElastiCache) and cache invalidation strategies
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and understanding of access patterns and cost trade-offs
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based systems on AWS
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with vector databases (Milvus, Zilliz, Pinecone) and similarity search systems
  • Experience with search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch)
  • Experience with ML model serving and real-time inference systems (Triton, KServe, SageMaker)
  • Experience building recommendation engines, personalization platforms, or content ranking services
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS, Kafka)
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, pod tuning, HPA)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Service mesh experience (Istio)
  • Experience with experimentation / A/B testing platforms
  • Experience with streaming platforms, digital media, or consumer-facing applications

We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We're looking for a Roku Software Engineer to own and evolve our Roku channel, from the SceneGraph UI layer down to the playback pipeline and the APIs that feed it. Roku is one of the largest surfaces in our streaming footprint, and it's also the most constrained: the same channel has to feel fast on a top-tier Roku Ultra and on a five-year-old Roku Express with a fraction of the memory.

This role is for someone who treats those constraints as the interesting part of the job. You'll be measuring texture memory and node counts, chasing down rebuffer events in HLS manifests, and working with backend teams to shape the microservice responses that make a channel launch in under two seconds instead of six.

  • Design, build, and ship features in BrightScript and SceneGraph, with a strong bias toward maintainable, well-factored component architecture rather than monolithic screens.
  • Own video playback quality end to end: startup time, ABR behavior, seek responsiveness, trick play, DRM handshakes, and graceful failure and recovery.
  • Profile and tune channel performance against real device constraints: memory ceilings on legacy hardware, render thread contention, task node usage, image and texture budgets, and cold-start latency.
  • Instrument and act on QoE telemetry (startup time, rebuffer ratio, exit-before-video-start, bitrate distribution), and drive those numbers down over time.
  • Partner with backend teams to define and refine the microservice and BFF APIs that power the channel: catalog, playback authorization, entitlement, continue-watching, recommendations, and search.
  • Implement and maintain Roku platform integrations: deep linking, Roku Search and content feeds, Continue Watching, Roku Pay / Instant Signup, and the Roku Advertising Framework.
  • Build and maintain internal tooling and automation scripts in JavaScript/TypeScript: build and packaging steps, feed and manifest validators, release utilities, device-farm and smoke-test harnesses, and whatever else removes manual toil from the team's day.
  • Own the channel's CI/CD pipeline: automated builds, test execution, static analysis, artifact packaging, sideloading to test devices, and promotion through environments. You treat pipeline code as real code, with the same review and maintenance standards.
  • Shepherd releases through Roku channel certification, including performance and memory requirements, and manage the beta-to-production promotion process.
  • Establish and uphold engineering standards: code review, automated testing, static analysis, and clear documentation.
  • Debug production issues across the stack using the Roku debug console, profiler, ECP, and network capture, and turn root causes into durable fixes.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, including shipping production Roku channels with BrightScript and SceneGraph.
  • Demonstrated experience with performance tuning on constrained devices. You can talk specifically about a time you cut memory usage, reduced startup latency, or eliminated frame drops, and how you measured it.
  • Strong grounding in software engineering best practices: separation of concerns, testability, meaningful abstractions, code review discipline, and refactoring as a habit rather than a project.
  • Hands-on experience with video playback and streaming formats: HLS and/or DASH, adaptive bitrate behavior, manifest structure, buffering strategy, and DRM (Widevine and PlayReady on Roku).
  • Practical experience consuming and integrating with RESTful APIs in a microservice architecture, including pagination, caching, retry and backoff strategies, error contracts, and versioning.
  • Working proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript (Node.js) for internal tooling and build automation. You can write a maintainable CLI or script that other engineers will actually use, not just a one-off.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar), including automated testing, build artifacts, and multi-environment deployment.
  • Comfort with debugging tooling and telemetry: you're at home in a debug console, a profiler, and a dashboard.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining tradeoffs to non-client engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Node-based Roku toolchain: BrighterScript, Rooibos (or another BrightScript test framework), roku-deploy, and ropm.
  • Experience with reusable workflow patterns, composite actions, or shared pipeline libraries across multiple repositories.

  • Familiarity with SSAI/CSAI, VAST/VMAP, and ad-supported playback flows.

  • Background in another living-room platform (tvOS, Android TV / Fire TV, Vizio, Tizen, or webOS), and an understanding of where Roku differs.

  • Experience with CDNs, edge caching, and manifest manipulation.

  • Familiarity with QoE analytics platforms such as Conviva, Mux, or Datadog RUM.

  • Experience defining backend contracts (REST or GraphQL) alongside server teams rather than just consuming them.

  • Accessibility experience: captions, audio description, and voice navigation on TV platforms.

Sr Live Event Technology Specialist (Streaming Operations Specialist)

Location:
Flexible / Global (based on operational needs)

Role Overview

As a Sr. Live Event Technology Specialist, you will serve as the primary technical escalation point for Paramount+’s global Live Event Operations team, providing technical support for Tier-1 live streaming events. This role focuses on diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues across the end-to-end live streaming ecosystem while minimizing customer impact during high-profile live broadcasts.

Working alongside Live Event Operators, Engineering, Product, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and distribution partners, you will lead technical investigations, coordinate cross-functional incident response, and drive root cause analysis for issues affecting acquisition, encoding, packaging, delivery, playback, advertising, and platform integrations.

Your expertise will ensure rapid issue mitigation, operational excellence, and continuous improvements across Paramount’s live streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for the Live Event Operations team during live events.
  • Support global Tier-1 live streaming events by troubleshooting complex issues across the complete video delivery chain.
  • Investigate service-impacting issues involving contribution feeds, cloud encoding, packaging, DRM, origin, CDN delivery, playback, and client applications.
  • Perform detailed technical analysis using streaming manifests, player logs, encoder metrics, QoS/QoE analytics, SCTE-35 signaling, transport stream analysis, and cloud monitoring tools.
  • Coordinate technical response across Engineering, Platform, Network Operations, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and third-party partners to restore service quickly.
  • Lead technical bridge calls during critical incidents, providing real-time updates, impact assessments, mitigation strategies, and recovery coordination.
  • Support Live Event Operators by providing technical guidance during event execution, validating mitigation actions, and assisting with operational decision-making.
  • Perform pre-event technical validation, redundancy verification, workflow testing, and production readiness reviews.
  • Conduct post-event root cause analysis (RCA), identify systemic issues, and drive corrective actions to improve platform reliability.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting documentation, operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support certification, onboarding, and production rollout of new streaming technologies, cloud workflows, monitoring tools, and vendor integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations supporting global live streaming operations and high-severity production incidents.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years supporting large-scale live streaming, OTT platforms, broadcast technology, or video delivery systems.
  • Experience serving as a technical escalation resource supporting live operations teams during Tier-1 live events.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across end-to-end streaming architectures including:
    • Contribution and video transport
    • Cloud encoding and transcoding
    • Packaging and origin services
    • DRM
    • SSAI/DAI
    • CDN distribution
    • Player playback
  • Deep understanding of HLS, DASH, CMAF/fMP4, MPEG-TS, SCTE-35, timed metadata, and adaptive bitrate streaming.
  • Experience analyzing manifests, transport streams, encoder logs, player telemetry, QoS/QoE metrics, and cloud infrastructure metrics.
  • Familiarity with AWS Media Services, CDN technologies, cloud networking, and streaming observability platforms.
  • Working knowledge of contribution protocols including SRT, Zixi, RIST, RTP, UDP, and multicast workflows.
  • Strong understanding of DRM, SSAI, client playback behavior, redundancy architectures, and failover strategies.
  • Excellent incident management, root cause analysis, and cross-functional communication skills in high-pressure live production environments.

People Inc. is looking for a Principal Designer to take on some of the company’s most varied, visible, and important work.

That means pairing ambitious creative thinking with close attention to the details that make the work successful. You’ll bring fresh ideas for what our events can be and the resourcefulness to make the most of the budget, spaces, materials, and time available.


You’ll lead other designers and outside partners project by project while staying hands-on. This is a role for someone highly experienced and influential who loves making the work and seeing it through.

The Design Group at People Inc. brings together multiple teams supporting Revenue Design, Brand & Editorial Design, Product & UX Design, Design Systems, Creative Operations, Transactional Creative, and Events.

 

This role will work across corporate, brand, communications, and experiential design, partnering closely with senior leadership and designers across the organization.

job.description:
Chief Product Officer (CPO) serves as a core member of the executive team, reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, leading the transformation of our product ecosystem into a growth engine for a modern, digital-first media enterprise. This role is central to transforming USA TODAY Co. into a customer-centric, product-led, digitally scaled media enterprise. The CPO will help unlock new growth pathways, leveraging the diversity of the product portfolio, to modernize the product ecosystem, and ensure the company remains competitive in a rapidly evolving media and technology landscape.

This role will define and execute an integrated product vision, strategy, and roadmap across consumer, advertising, and platform experiences—ensuring alignment with company strategy, changing customer needs, and long-term growth objectives. The CPO will partner closely with the CEO and executive leadership team to drive product-led growth, innovation, and differentiated user experiences across USA TODAY and the broader network. Consistent with enterprise priorities, this leader will combine deep product expertise, media industry knowledge, and technology-driven innovation to accelerate revenue growth, audience engagement, customer expansion and loyalty and platform scalability.

• This role is central to transforming USA TODAY Co. into a product-led, digitally scaled media enterprise

• The CPO will leverage the breadth of the product portfolio and potential to unlock new growth pathways, modernize the product ecosystem, and ensure the company remains competitive in a rapidly evolving media and technology landscape

Key Responsibilities

1. Define and Align Enterprise Product Strategy

• Define and communicate a clear, compelling multi-year product vision and strategy aligned with company growth goals

• Translate strategy into actionable product roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes

• Ensure product initiatives directly support revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and engagement, purposefully elevating the overall quality and reliability of the experience across channels and platforms, and safeguarding consumer trust across our product portfolio

• Serve as the executive owner of product portfolio performance across consumer, B2B, and platform products

2. Drive and Scale Product-Led Growth & Innovation

• Drive a product-led growth model across all digital products and platforms

• Identify and scale new opportunities across subscriptions, advertising, data products, and emerging revenue streams

• Lead innovation across AI, personalization, content experiences, and platform capabilities

• Ensure rapid experimentation, testing, and data-driven iteration across the product lifecycle

• Build efficient and fast-cycle development and learning as a practice and cultural norm

3. End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership

• Oversee the full product lifecycle: discovery, development, launch, optimization, and sunsetting

• Ensure a strong focus on customer needs, user experience, and product-market fit

• Deepen understanding of the customer, championing customer-centricity throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Establish clear product KPIs, OKRs, and performance management systems tied to business outcomes

• Leverage analytics to continuously optimize product performance and decision-making

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Technology, Data, Content, Revenue, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deliver cohesive product experiences

• Align engineering capabilities, monetization strategies, and go-to-market execution to achieve product strategy

• Act as a key connector across teams to ensure speed, prioritization clarity, and execution discipline

• Collaborate with the executive team on capital allocation, strategic tradeoffs, and transformation priorities

5. Organization Leadership & Talent Development

• Shape and lead a high-performing design and product organizations (product management, UX, product analytics)

• Establish best-in-class product management disciplines, operating rhythms, and governance models

• Attract, develop, and retain top product and digital talent

• Foster a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement

6. Market Leadership & External Engagement

• Act as a visible leader externally representing USA TODAY Co.’s product vision with partners, investors, and the broader market

• Monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to inform product strategy

• Bring external perspective from high-growth technology environments to accelerate transformation

Qualifications & Experience

Leadership Experience

• 15+ years of progressive product leadership experience, including senior executive roles

• Proven success leading product organizations in high-growth technology companies

• Demonstrated impact driving product-led growth, digital transformation, and revenue expansion

Industry Expertise

• Strong experience in both:

o Technology-driven product environments (SaaS, platforms, marketplaces, or digital ecosystems)

o Media, content, or digital publishing companies with scaled audiences

Functional Expertise

• Deep expertise across:

o Product strategy and roadmap development

o Customer experience and user-centered design

o Data, analytics, and experimentation frameworks

o Monetization models (subscription, advertising, data-driven products)

• Proven ability to align product, technology, and commercial strategies

Leadership Capabilities

• Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen

• Exceptional cross-functional leader with ability to influence at executive and board levels

• Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams and organizations

• Comfort operating in complex, fast-changing environments with competing priorities

Personal Attributes

• Visionary and growth-oriented, with an entrepreneurial mindset

• Customer-obsessed with strong intuition for user needs and product-market fit

• Data-driven decision-maker with bias for action and experimentation

• Highly collaborative, capable of aligning diverse stakeholders

• Resilient, adaptable, and energized by large-scale transformation and change

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Marketing team is responsible for building and growing our audience for podcasts, programs, and platforms. The team seeks to grow the reach and impact of everything NPR puts out in the world—from our up-to-the-minute digital and broadcast content to our on-demand podcasts, events, videos, website, and app  The Vice President, Marketing leads the operational planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies across NPR's portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role manages a team of marketing professionals to execute targeted initiatives that attract, grow, and retain diverse audiences for NPR while driving brand alignment and engagement across all channels. 

Responsibilities

  • Partner across divisions to identify emerging audience opportunities and propose initiatives and campaigns aligned with NPR’s strategic goals.
  • Directly manage, guide, and mentor a team of marketing professionals overseeing audience development work on NPR products, podcasts, and platforms.
  • Define target audiences, perform competitive landscape analyses, identify market opportunities, establish messaging frameworks, and set KPIs to launch new properties and sustainably grow audiences.
  • Create cohesion and consistency across marketing strategy work by lifting up best practices, strengthening and reimagining workflows, and deepening team collaboration.
  • Maintain and enforce a consistent brand expression, voice, and positioning across all channels and consumer touchpoints.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop third-party publisher and brand partnerships to grow, diversify, and acquire new audiences.
  • Strengthen the marketing team’s commitment to cultivating meaningful, collaborative partnerships with our network of Member stations.
  • In close collaboration with the CMO, set operational priorities, allocate staff effectively, and manage project workflows.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships to ensure Marketing’s capabilities, role, and integration across the organization are clear.
  • Measure project success using industry-standard metrics (Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, etc.) to evaluate show and podcast campaign performance.
  • Support and optimize NPR’s consumer products marketing strategy to expand brand reach and complement revenue initiatives.
  • Select, manage, and hold accountable external partners, such as digital ad agencies.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12 to 15+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 7+ years in a senior management role overseeing multidisciplinary teams and project budgets.
  • Proven track record of operationalizing strategic goals into execution roadmaps, managing competing priorities, and leading cross-functional project teams through complex, deadline-driven product or campaign launches. 
  • Hands-on experience conceptualizing, building, and executing end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns across multiple distribution touchpoints—including broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, email lifecycle marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency in establishing performance benchmarks and leveraging audience measurement metrics (such as Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, active users, and conversion rates) to evaluate, optimize, and report on campaign ROI. 
  • Strong listening, writing, and speaking skills.
  • Knowledge of best marketing practices for email, display ads, websites, and apps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the public media landscape, preferably with direct experience either at a Member station or in close collaboration with federated systems.
  • Experience managing external creative or digital advertising agency relationships.
  • Experience supporting product marketing, merchandising, or consumer brand expansion
  • Demonstrated understanding of the unique dynamics, revenue models, and collaborative touchpoints between national network programming and local station engagement. 
  • Hands-on experience working alongside product development, digital design, and editorial teams to align marketing strategy directly with audience UX and content lifecycle management. 

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Exceptional collaboration skills with a proven ability to work cross-functionally and gain the respect and support of internal and external clients.
  • Deep knowledge of modern audience acquisition, retention, and engagement practices across broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, lifecycle email marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Creative mindset with a passion for marketing, advertising, design, and storytelling.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust, drive consensus, and maintain productive relationships across diverse departments (editorial, product development, legal, finance, and revenue teams). 

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree (e.g., MBA) preferred.

NPR Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid-permitted role based in one of NPR’s office locations: New York City, Washington, D.C., or Los Angeles. Employees are expected to work from their designated office at least three days per week and must reside within commuting distance of their assigned office.

job.title: Global Member Services Representative
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Global Member Services Representative provides customer service to ASCAP’s members via telephone, email and ASCAP’s proprietary online account management system (Member Access). The position serves the goals of the ASCAP Global Members Services department in ensuring ASCAP writers, publishers, and internal partners receive the best experience possible. This is a hybrid position with currently a minimum 3 day per week in-office requirement, based out of the ASCAP New York Office.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Member Customer Service:
    • Provide customer service to ASCAP’s writer and publisher Members via telephone, email and ASCAP's proprietary online account management system
    • Communicate effectively with individuals from both within and outside of the organization in order to resolve writer and publisher Member issues and answer all questions
    • Resolve and track inquiries and other types of incoming requests by researching and resolving any issues that may arise from writer and publisher Members and/or their representatives
    • Inquiry subjects vary, but often regard the following:
      • Performance crediting
      • ASCAP’s repertory

job.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Finance
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

The Strategic Finance team at Virgin Music Group [VMG] spearheads global improvement and business integration projects, constructing comprehensive execution plans with a strong focus on finance and global strategy.  The Sr. Manager role will report to the team’s VP and will be based at our New York City office with an in-office presence of 3-4 days/week.  (Note: VP is located in Miami, FL.)

 

How You’ll CREATE:

 

The ideal candidate will be a proactive person with exceptional organizational skills and a strong analytical mindset.  This role will work across many business verticals, driving forward global projects and ensuring timely execution of strategic deliverables.

 

  • Manage internal strategic analyses by working with department leaders across VMG and wider UMG on growth and integration initiatives, business process optimization and global cost reduction.
  • Drive forward implementation of VMG’s strategic goals by managing workstreams and tracking project initiatives with many stakeholders
  • Develop financial models and create concise presentations to communicate project progress to VMG senior management and other UMG leaders.
  • Recommend best practices for improving current processes to facilitate better decision making, team communication, and cost savings.
  • Proactively identify potential opportunities, evaluate strategic implications, and initiate related analyses.
  • Manage finance related communications with label/artist partners and internal UMG stakeholders to ensure transparency of strategic goal achievement.

 

Bring your VIBE:

 

  • Minimum 6+ years of relevant work experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, consulting/strategy or similar field
  • Prior relevant experience in the music industry preferred
  • Ability to take ownership of and drive forward projects independently
  • Superior Excel skills and advanced proficiency Microsoft Office Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and other office tools.  GPT building experience a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to successfully prioritize multiple tasks with minimal oversight
  • Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • High level of intellectual curiosity, especially around music, technology, and entertainment
  • Highly personable with strong team-working skills

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)
