job.title: Manager, Marketing - Atlantic Outpost
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Manager, Marketing - Atlantic Outpost

 

Reports To: Vice President, Marketing, Atlantic Outpost

 

Department: Marketing - Atlantic Outpost

 

Location: Nashville, TN 


A little bit about our team:

Atlantic Outpost is a lifestyle brand rooted in Country and Americana music working with artists such as STELLA LEFTY, Sam Barber, Cameron Whitcomb and more.  The Marketing Department is responsible for overseeing all marketing strategies for Outpost while also streamlining communication internally and externally.


Your role:

As Marketing Manager at Atlantic Outpost, you will be instrumental in crafting and implementing innovative marketing campaigns for our artists. This role involves working hand-in-hand with talent, their management, and various internal teams to elevate our artists' profiles and ensure their music resonates with a global audience.


Here you’ll get to:

  • You will plan, develop and execute comprehensive marketing campaigns for each project.
  • You will manage budgets across departments and in partnership with the VP, Marketing and Marketing Operations team.
  • You will be responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive audience growth, engagement, and long-term development.
  • You will be the day-to-day contact between artists, artist managers, internal label department (A&R, digital, publicity) and external agencies.
  • You will be responsible for scheduling and leading weekly artist marketing meetings.
  • You will coordinate the production of marketing assets, and work closely with the Creative Department and / or other creatives to develop cohesive and identifiable brand strategies for each artist.  
  • You will track streaming metrics, social engagement and ad performance to generate regular reports and optimize campaigns alongside the Digital Department.
  • You will travel as necessary.
  • You will troubleshoot issues and act as a problem solver.
  • You will maintain relationships with artists management, the Nashville community and more.
  • You will stay up to date on all Marketing and social trends.

Rockstar candidates should have/be experienced in:

  • Experience in developing, creating, and implementing strategic marketing plans.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Experience in executing an idea from conception to execution.
  • Analytical skills, with the ability to make informed decisions in a timely manner.
  • Experience in demonstrating excellent planning, negotiation, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced business environment.
  • Can multi-task and is comfortable wearing many hats.
  • Strong organizational skills and adaptability.
  • Being a team player.
  • Experience working cross-functionally. 
  • Working in Country music.

It would be music to our ears if you also had:

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or business from an accredited 4-year university.
  • An already established network of industry contacts, especially in Nashville.
  • Basic knowledge of FTP/HTML services and web-based programs.
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and trends.
  • Experience with photoshop or other editing software.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

job.title: Distribution Processor - Foreign Incoming (Hybrid)
job.description:
Every royalty payment starts with accurate information.

As a Distribution Processor at BMI, you’ll help turn music usage information into the accurate, timely royalty distributions that support the songwriters, composers and publishers we represent. You’ll process information from different sources, use specialized systems and tools, and contribute to a team that values accuracy, consistency and meeting deadlines.

Depending on your team, your work may involve processing cue sheets, identifying reported performances, handling music reports or supporting incoming international royalty payments. You’ll learn established processes, build knowledge of the music industry and work closely with colleagues and management to resolve questions and maintain quality.

If you enjoy detail-oriented work, solving practical problems and seeing how your contributions support the people who create music, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

POSITION SUMMARY

Processes information from a variety of sources using systems, tools and resources that support the accurate and timely distribution of royalty payments to BMI affiliates.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Processes cue sheets, links performances and performs other necessary tasks to meet team goals and deadlines.

Maintains best practices as learned from continuous training on systems, procedures and decision-making.

Applies policies, procedures and guidelines relevant to this business function.

Communicates with management on a regular basis regarding work-related issues and questions.

Meets established departmental goals for quantity and quality.

Performs all tasks and functions handled by a specific team.

Maintains knowledge of industry and affiliate changes through a variety of sources (industry blogs, BMI360, on-line content, and/or updates shared by co-workers and leaders).

Regular attendance.

Supports BMI Core Values and cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion.

Other duties as assigned.

Specific to Distribution and Administration Services Foreign Incoming Team

Processes Audio and Audio-Visual distribution payments made by foreign Performing Rights Organizations.

Creates manual payments to our affiliates.

Reviews and reconciles quality assurance reports related to resolution and payment of Foreign Incoming royalties.

Physical/Visual Activities or Demands

Physical/visual activities or demands that are commonly associated with the performance functions of this job.

Sitting, talking, hearing, walking.

Concentrated mental and visual attention with normal hand-eye coordination.

Clarity of vision at 20 inches; corrected or uncorrected.

Generally negligible physical effort, but occasional moving of 1 to 10 lb. items.

Environmental/Atmospheric Conditions

Environmental and atmospheric conditions commonly associated with the functions of this job.

Normal office conditions.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education: High school diploma or GED. Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred.

Experience: Experience or familiarity with an operational/processing role.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Knowledge of music industry or active participation in the music community highly preferred.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Proficient keyboard and PC skills.

Ability to perform well in a fast-paced, ever-changing, detail-oriented work environment.

Effective decision-making skills to determine when and how to escalate problems or questions.

Demonstrate a passion for music.

Foreign language helpful but not required.

Ability to organize and prioritize work.

Ability to interact professionally with others at all levels.

Ability to work in a team or independently with minimal supervision.

Initiative.

Good problem-solving ability.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, AND WORK AIDS

Personal computer and associated software. Normal office equipment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You process music usage and royalty-related information carefully and accurately.

You meet established quantity and quality goals while keeping deadlines in focus.

You follow established guidelines, ask thoughtful questions and know when to escalate an issue.

You build confidence with the systems, procedures and tools needed for your assigned team.

You stay organized, adapt to changing priorities and contribute positively to team results.

You develop your knowledge of the music industry and understand why getting the details right matters.

WHY JOIN US?

The details behind a music performance matter. At BMI, Distribution Processors help make sure the information needed to pay royalties is handled accurately and on time. Your work supports the process that connects music usage with payments to the people who create it.

You’ll gain hands-on experience with music rights operations, develop specialized skills and join colleagues committed to supporting music creators. If you bring curiosity, care and a passion for music, we’d love to meet you!

job.title: Sr. Manager, Licensing Accounting
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:   Leads the Licensing Accounting function through a Licensing Accounting Manager and Senior Accountant, owning revenue recognition and technical accounting for the company and ensuring compliance with ASC 606 across all revenue streams. Sets team direction, standards and workflow while remaining directly engaged in the highest-judgmental technical matters, the revenue close, review, reporting, controls and audit processes and keeps revenue accounting diligence-ready to support transactions and builds scalable revenue and billing processes as the company grows. Builds scalable revenue and billing processes as the company grows, identifies and implements process improvements pertaining to area of responsibility and works directly with financial accounting, FP&A, licensing, legal, operations, collections services, IT and other departments to uphold company best practices, ensure proper controls are in place and deliver excellent customer service.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions: representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Revenue Recognition & Technical Accounting

Owns revenue recognition policies and ensures compliance with ASC 606 across all revenue streams, applying judgment appropriate to the company's size and complexity, and reviews and updates related company policies and procedures.

Reviews customer contracts, including non-standard terms, bundled arrangements, variable consideration, and contract modifications and determines the correct accounting treatment.

Writes clear technical memos documenting key revenue judgments for auditors, investors and future diligence.

Revenue Close, Reporting & Controls

Oversee the monthly revenue close performed by the Manager and staff, personally reviewing and approving the most complex or judgmental entries (deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, contract asset balances), and ensuring successful coordination and completion of the month-end process.

Prepares revenue schedules and footnote disclosures for annual GAAP audited financial statements.

Designs and maintains a practical internal controls framework over the revenue cycle, scaled to the company's stage and ready to mature toward SOX if needed.

Leads the fiscal year-end audit and manages the revenue portion of the annual external audit, including PBC requests and auditor inquiries, maintaining relations during the audit.

Diligence, Transactions & M&A

Keeps revenue accounting "diligence-ready" to support fundraising, debt financing, a potential sale, or IPO, including quality of earnings (QoE) reviews.

Supports M&A activity through due diligence and integration of acquired revenue streams.

Team Leadership & Development

Builds and leads the Licensing Accounting team, setting direction and standards while empowering the Manager to own day-to-day execution; remains directly hands-on engaged with the Senior Accountant on complex technical matters, and available for escalation on staff-level, ensuring proper internal control and delivering excellent customer service.

Ensures the manager provides proper on-boarding, cross training and coaching to staff specific to Licensing Accounting; directly coaches and develops senior accountant and periodically reviews the manager's coaching effectiveness with the staff.

Develops the Licensing Accounting Manager's leadership capability, delegating operational ownership of the team's day-to-day work while providing guidance on complex technical or personnel matters.

Schedules, coordinates and leads broader team meetings and regular 1:1 with manager and senior accountant to ensure successful communication and collaboration; ensures the Manager runs effective staff level meetings and communication.

Cross functional partnership

Works directly with Licensing, Legal, Operations, Collections Services, IT and other departments to review deal terms before signing, flag revenue impacts early, uphold company best practices, ensure proper controls are in place and deliver excellent customer service.

Educates non-finance teams on how contract terms affect revenue.

Systems & Process Improvement

Ensures CRM, ERP and other financial systems function properly (as related to area of responsibility), and lead or support the selection and implementation of new systems, coordinating with Accounting Technology and IT, as needed.

Accesses and analyzes data to answer business questions and improve processes, leveraging available technology tools.

Builds or rebuilds revenue processes, often moving from spreadsheets toward automation as the company scales, researching, recommending and implementing process and procedural improvements by coordinating with management, team members and internal/external customers.

Acts as project manager for Licensing Accounting projects when appropriate

Supervisory Responsibilities: Directly supervises a licensing accounting manager and accountant and indirectly oversees additional team members in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning, directing and ensuring reliability of work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining team members; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education:  Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required.

Experience: Minimum 8–10+ years' progressive accounting experience, with significant hands-on ASC 606 work. Three (3) or more years' people management experience required. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, less-structured environment.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Experience with ERP and revenue/billing systems, plus advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office

Experience with Oracle Financial modules and Salesforce preferred

Familiarity with AI-powered tools for data analysis and process improvement preferred

Ability to write clear technical memos, reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional literature and technical procedures. Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, particularly ASC 606, with the ability to apply technical guidance to non-standard or complex transactions

Effective communication skills, including presenting to executives and effectively responding to questions from groups of managers, vendors, internal and external customers

Must be capable of building, fostering and working in a team environment focused on quality and customer service

Excellent time management, analytical, decision making and organizational skills

Ability to  develop and lead a multi-tiered team, delegating prioritized operational execution to a Manager while maintaining accountability for team output and quality

Ability to establish good working relationships and interact competently with others at all levels of management

Experience in a PE-backed or multi-entity company preferred

License(s)/Certifications Required: None; CPA license (active or inactive) preferred.

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Manager, Digital Subscriptions to grow our subscription offerings across mobile, web, and connected platforms. This role is instrumental in defining the roadmap for our digital subscription services, driving audience growth and revenue, and ensuring competitiveness in a fast-evolving landscape. Reporting directly to the SVP of Digital Strategy, the successful candidate will bring deep expertise in subscription ecosystems, customer segmentation, product packaging, pricing strategy, and cross-functional leadership.

 

Key Responsibilities:

· Define and execute end-to-end product and go-to-market strategies for digital subscription offerings across all consumer segments.

· Conduct assessments of Total Addressable Market (TAM), perform customer segmentation and needs analysis, and develop pricing models and packaging strategies to drive business growth.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, marketing, sales, operations, and business development—to ensure a unified approach to product development and market execution.

job.title: Event Services & Production Manager (Crypto.com Arena)
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. 

Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. 

If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. 

Job Summary:

The Event Services & Production Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of assigned sports team, as well as support all concerts and special events at the venue(s). In addition, the Manager is responsible for the supervision, scheduling and coordination of the stage crew, including members of stagehands from the local union hall. job.title: Assistant Companies News Editor
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

The role

The Financial Times is looking for a smart and energetic business editor to join the Companies desk in London. This is an important role on the desk, helping steer the coverage of key sectors, ensure the smooth running of the desk and editing some of our highest profile stories, whether splash-worthy scoops or corporate deep dives. 

This person will be liaising with correspondents around the world, helping steer coverage of everything from banks and oil majors, to carmakers, luxury giants and defence start-ups. This is a wide-ranging job, where a good command of corporate reporting, smart news judgement and the ability to make complicated stories sing are essential. 

Business knowledge and a reporting background are important qualifications. This person needs to be able to confidently handle longer investigative stories and take care of legally contentious pieces. 

 

Key responsibilities

  • Commission sharp news stories and original analysis in conjunction with other editors
  • Help maintain a healthy pipeline of scoops and reads that will populate prime slots on the homepage
  • Edit copy so stories have appropriate length, pace and punch
  • Closely co-ordinate with other desks, especially New York, Hong Kong and Markets
  • Project stories to the main news desk with smart headlines and strong graphics to maximise their audience
  • Work on longer term data projects with the long form and visual journalism teams
  • Weekend and some early morning shifts are required as part of the team rota

 

What we are looking for

The right candidate will be news driven, a team player and will ideally have been an accomplished reporter and writer of corporate stories. Good communication and planning skills are essential. This editor must be comfortable exercising editorial judgement on legally contentious stories and be experienced working to tight deadlines and producing stories very quickly on breaking news. Experience editing long form would also be a plus. 

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Sunday 22nd November 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

job.title: Sr Analyst, Associate Group
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

ROLE OVERVIEW

  • The Senior Executive – Integrated Communications (PR & Social) is responsible for supporting the day-to-day execution of integrated communications campaigns, ensuring high-quality delivery across PR, social media, influencer engagement, and digital communications. The role requires strong execution capabilities, proactive project coordination, and the ability to independently manage assigned tasks and workstreams while meeting Edelman Standards and client expectations.
  • S/he demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles, with hands-on experience in media relations, content development, social media communications, influencer engagement, and online community activation. S/he is able to adapt key messages and communications content across different channels to ensure consistency and relevance to target audiences.
  • This role requires the ability to translate communications plans into effective execution, proactively identify opportunities and challenges, and collaborate closely with clients, internal teams, and external partners to deliver impactful integrated communications activities that support client objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Integrated Communications Execution

  • Demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles and how PR, social media, influencer engagement, and digital communications work together to achieve client objectives.
  • Supports the implementation of integrated communications plans, translating approved strategies and directions into actionable activities across relevant channels.
  • Coordinates the execution of communications activities across PR and social channels, ensuring consistent messaging, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Contributes ideas, relevant trends, and tactical recommendations to enhance campaign execution and audience engagement.
  • Proactively identifies execution challenges and opportunities, recommending practical solutions to the account team.

2. PR & Media Relations

  • Executes day-to-day PR activities, including media outreach, press release distribution, media pitching, interviews, press events, and other earned media initiatives.
  • Develops, edits, and proofreads high-quality PR materials, including press releases, media pitches, key messages, briefing documents, and feature stories.
  • Builds and maintains working relationships with journalists, editors, publishers, and relevant media contacts.
  • Identifies relevant media angles and opportunities to secure earned media coverage aligned with approved communications objectives.
  • Coordinates media engagement activities, including interviews, press conferences, media events, and other outreach programs.
  • Monitors media coverage and supports the evaluation of PR activities, identifying key highlights and areas for improvement.

3. Social Media & Influencer Communications

  • Executes social communications activities in line with approved campaign directions, ensuring content relevance, consistency, and alignment with brand objectives.
  • Develops social content angles, editorial calendars, content briefs, captions, and other channel-appropriate communications materials.
  • Demonstrates a good understanding of social media platforms, audience behaviors, content formats, and emerging trends within the Vietnamese digital landscape.
  • Coordinates influencer/KOL/KOC and online community engagement activities, including influencer research, selection recommendations, briefing, content review, and execution follow-up.
  • Works closely with creative, content, digital, and external production teams to ensure the quality and timely delivery of social communications materials.
  • Monitors social conversations, content performance, and audience engagement to identify relevant insights and tactical optimization opportunities.

4. Account & Project Management

  • Independently manages assigned tasks and workstreams, ensuring timely delivery, attention to detail, and adherence to client requirements and Edelman Standards.
  • Supports day-to-day client communications, including status updates, meeting notes, activity reports, and follow-ups on assigned deliverables.
  • Coordinates effectively with internal teams, media, influencers, vendors, and external partners to ensure smooth campaign execution.
  • Maintains project timelines, tracks deliverables, and proactively flags potential risks or issues to the account manager.
  • Supports the preparation of client presentations, campaign proposals, status reports, and other account-related materials.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a solution-oriented approach in managing daily responsibilities.

5. Research, Monitoring & Reporting

  • Conducts desk research on industry developments, competitors, consumer trends, media landscapes, and social conversations to support communications activities.
  • Monitors media coverage, social conversations, and campaign performance across relevant channels.
  • Collects, consolidates, and analyzes campaign results using relevant PR and social performance metrics.
  • Prepares activity reports and post-campaign reports with accurate data, key observations, and actionable learnings.
  • Identifies relevant insights and provides recommendations to improve ongoing campaign execution.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in PR, social media, or integrated communications, including a minimum of 1 year in a Senior Executive or equivalent role.
  • Previous experience in PR, communications, digital, or integrated marketing agency is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in both PR and social communications, with the ability to independently execute activities across media relations, social media, influencer engagement, and online community activation.
  • Solid understanding of the Vietnamese media landscape, social media ecosystem, influencer landscape, and evolving digital communications trends.
  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling, channel-appropriate content for both PR and social media platforms.
  • Experience working with journalists, publishers, influencers, content creators, and online communities, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Good understanding of integrated communications execution, including media outreach, social content development, influencer coordination, and campaign performance measurement.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage assigned workstreams, prioritize tasks, and meet multiple deadlines.
  • Good research and analytical skills, with the ability to identify relevant insights, monitor campaign performance, and recommend tactical improvements.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Excellent Vietnamese writing and editing skills, with good working proficiency in English.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented, collaborative, and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.description:

Edelman has experienced unprecedented growth in recent years – growth that is reflective of the firm’s ongoing evolution from a PR agency into a communications marketing firm. We offer specialized areas of expertise, including digital, social, creative, paid media, creator marketing and research to help clients evolve, promote and protect their brands in the market.

 

By investing heavily in specialty areas – and by focusing on collaboration, agency position, innovation, and establishing a culture of creativity – Edelman is well-positioned to continue to deliver best-in-class work to our clients in today’s complex media landscape.


Edelman has an exciting opportunity for a Vice President, Creator Marketing to join our team in Los Angeles. This role requires a strategic, collaborative and highly organized leader who can oversee complex creator marketing engagements, serve as a trusted advisor to senior clients, and drive excellence across strategy, execution, operations and team development.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in creator marketing, social media and the evolving creator economy, with a demonstrated ability to translate cultural trends, platform developments and audience insights into impactful brand strategies. They are equally comfortable shaping big-picture recommendations, navigating complex client and internal stakeholder relationships, and providing hands-on leadership when needed.


This individual will partner closely with senior practice leadership to drive business growth, strengthen operational effectiveness, develop high-performing teams and deliver best-in-class creator marketing programs within a highly integrated, matrixed agency environment.

 

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership & Creator Expertise
    • Lead the development of innovative, insight-driven creator marketing strategies that align with client business objectives, audience behaviors, and the evolving social and cultural landscape.
    • Serve as a senior subject matter expert across creator marketing, social platforms and the broader creator economy, proactively bringing informed POVs, emerging trends and strategic recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
    • Advise clients on creator partnerships of varying scopes and complexities, identifying opportunities to elevate creative thinking, drive innovation and deliver measurable business impact.
  • Client Leadership & Executive Presence
    • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior-level clients, serving as a strategic advisor and independently leading complex conversations, presentations and decision-making.
    • Provide senior oversight across multiple client engagements, proactively managing escalations, navigating challenging stakeholder dynamics and driving solutions that protect client relationships and business outcomes.
    • Partner with account leadership to ensure exceptional client service, strategic alignment and consistent delivery of high-quality creator marketing programs.
  • Operational & Business Leadership
    • Oversee the operational and financial health of creator marketing engagements, including resource planning, scope management, budgets, profitability and overall delivery excellence.
    • Establish and uphold processes, standards and best practices that drive efficiency, accountability and consistency across creator marketing programs.
    • Proactively identify business and operational risks, anticipate downstream implications, and implement solutions to ensure teams are positioned for success.
    • Drive organic business growth and contribute to new business opportunities through strategic ideation, proposal development, pitching and expansion of existing client relationships.
  • People Leadership & Team Development
    • Lead, mentor and develop high-performing teams, including managers and emerging leaders, through clear expectations, thoughtful delegation, ongoing coaching and actionable performance feedback.
    • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and proactive problem-solving, serving as a senior escalation point while empowering team members to take ownership and make informed decisions.
  • Integrated & Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Navigate complex, matrixed agency environments, building strong relationships and driving alignment across account, creative, strategy, social, paid media, production and measurement teams to ensure creator marketing is strategically integrated into broader brand efforts.
    • Influence cross-functional stakeholders, including senior leadership, to balance competing priorities, drive alignment and maintain clear ownership and accountability across teams.
    • Partner with measurement teams to leverage performance data, audience insights and reporting to evaluate campaign effectiveness, optimize strategies and inform future recommendations.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in marketing, advertising, public relations, digital or social media, including 5+ years of direct experience in creator marketing, influencer partnerships or talent management.
  • Proven experience developing and leading integrated creator marketing strategies and programs for consumer brands, with a strong understanding of social platforms, creator partnerships and the evolving digital landscape.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing teams, including direct people management, coaching, performance management and delegation.
  • Experience independently managing senior-level client relationships, leading strategic conversations and navigating complex stakeholder dynamics.
  • Experience overseeing multiple concurrent client engagements, including program budgets, scopes of work, resource planning and cross-functional collaboration.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Ability to work a hybrid schedule (3x a week) in the Los Angeles office, with ability to travel to clients as needed.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within a large, integrated agency or similarly matrixed organization, collaborating across multiple disciplines, business units and senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience managing managers and developing emerging leaders, including succession planning and building high-performing teams.
  • Strong understanding of agency business operations, including financial forecasting, profitability, staffing models and commercial decision-making.
  • Established relationships across the creator ecosystem, including talent representatives, creator agencies, social platforms and industry partners.
  • Experience integrating creator marketing across paid, earned and owned channels, with knowledge of content usage rights, paid amplification and measurement best practices.
  • Experience contributing to organic business growth and new business development, including strategic ideation, proposal development and executive-level pitching.

job.title: Account Director, Technology - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The stakes in tech storytelling today are higher than ever. Gone are the days of technology simply “saving the world.” The double-edged sword of today’s technologies creates as much reputational risk as opportunity across diverse stakeholder groups.

Want to be on the front lines, shaping the narrative around the innovations and products changing the way people live, work, connect and experience the world?

With nearly a century of behavioral science and state-of-the-art AI helping us understand the changing dynamics of reputation, Burson partners with many of the world’s leading technology companies to develop communications strategies and stories that resonate, inspire and drive real impact. We’re not just about press releases and blogs. We help companies introduce breakthrough products, navigate complex issues and build reputations that stand the test of time.

If you’re obsessed with all things tech, love solving complex communications challenges and want to be part of a growing and collaborative team, Burson’s US Technology practice is the place for you.

As an Account Director on our growing US Technology team, you’ll play a leadership role in developing and delivering integrated communications strategies for leading technology and consumer brands. You’ll serve as a trusted client counselor, lead significant account workstreams, translate complex technologies into compelling stories and guide multidisciplinary teams from strategy through execution.

An initial area of focus will be supporting the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service, providing strategic communications leadership across its product and technology portfolio. You’ll help shape communications around new products, features and innovations, including advancements in AI and personalization, and develop integrated launch strategies encompassing earned media, social, influencer, owned and internal channels.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders across product, marketing, trust and safety, legal and communications, helping teams anticipate opportunities and reputational considerations while bringing complex technology stories to life for consumers.

This is an opportunity for a seasoned communications professional who combines consumer technology expertise, strategic and creative thinking, strong media instincts and confident client counsel with the curiosity and agility required to navigate fast-moving technology and product environments.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a strategic counselor to clients, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and providing thoughtful communications counsel across product, corporate reputation and integrated communications priorities.
  • Lead significant client relationships and account workstreams, setting priorities, anticipating needs and ensuring teams consistently deliver strategic, creative and high-quality work.
  • Develop and lead integrated communications strategies for technology products, features and innovations, including major product launches, media relations, reputation programs and executive thought leadership.
  • Translate complex technologies into compelling narratives, helping clients explain sophisticated products, including AI-powered and personalized experiences, in ways that resonate with consumers, media and broader stakeholder audiences.
  • Lead product and feature launch communications, guiding strategy from early planning and positioning through launch and post-launch storytelling.
  • Bring a 360-degree communications mindset, ensuring strategies consider earned media, social, influencer, owned, internal and paid channels and bringing together the right specialists to deliver integrated programs.
  • Provide strategic media counsel, developing compelling storylines, overseeing proactive media strategies and maintaining strong relationships with influential technology, business and consumer journalists.
  • Counsel clients on emerging technology and reputational considerations, identifying potential risks or stakeholder concerns and helping teams determine when and how issues should be addressed or escalated.
  • Lead cross-functional planning, partnering effectively with product, marketing, social and influencer, trust and safety, legal, analytics, creative and communications stakeholders to build cohesive strategies.
  • Turn trends and insights into strategic opportunities, using an understanding of technology, media, culture and consumer behavior to help clients anticipate conversations rather than simply react to them.
  • Set the strategic direction and quality standard for client deliverables, providing senior oversight of messaging, media materials, executive content, briefing documents and presentations.
  • Lead client presentations and strategic discussions, confidently articulating recommendations, challenging thinking when appropriate and adapting strategies based on client and stakeholder feedback.
  • Oversee multiple complex workstreams, ensuring teams effectively manage timelines, priorities, budgets and deliverables across fast-moving accounts.
  • Manage and develop junior and mid-level talent, providing coaching, feedback and clear accountability while creating opportunities for team members to grow.
  • Partner with senior account leaders on account health and growth, proactively identifying opportunities to expand existing relationships and introduce new capabilities.
  • Contribute to new business and practice growth, including proposal development, strategic planning, pitch participation and broader initiatives that strengthen Burson’s Technology offering.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 6–8 years of experience in public relations or strategic communications, with significant experience supporting technology and/or consumer technology clients. Agency experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading major account workstreams and serving as a trusted client counselor, with the confidence to independently guide client conversations and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong experience developing and leading integrated communications programs for consumer-facing technology products, services, features or launches.
  • Experience across relevant technology sectors such as consumer technology, AI and emerging technologies, digital platforms and services, consumer electronics, gaming, automotive technology or semiconductors.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology and product information into clear, compelling and consumer-friendly narratives.
  • Strong experience with product communications and launches, including positioning, messaging, earned media strategy and integrated campaign planning.
  • Deep media relations experience and established relationships with relevant technology, business and consumer journalists, paired with strong news judgment and storytelling instincts.
  • Experience developing integrated, 360-degree communications strategies that extend beyond earned media to social, influencer, owned, internal and paid channels.
  • A strong understanding of AI, personalization and emerging technology trends, including the communications opportunities and potential reputational considerations surrounding these technologies.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders such as product, marketing, legal, trust and safety, social, influencer and communications teams.
  • Demonstrated experience with issues and reputation management, including the judgment to recognize emerging risks, counsel clients appropriately and determine when concerns should be escalated.
  • Strong strategic and creative problem-solving abilities, with the ability to move fluidly between big-picture strategy and the details required for excellent execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of developing compelling narratives and delivering persuasive presentations to senior audiences.
  • Excellent organizational and project leadership skills, with the ability to oversee multiple complex workstreams, teams and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop junior and mid-level team members, delegate effectively and maintain accountability for the overall quality of account work.
  • Experience contributing to account growth or new business, including identifying opportunities, developing scopes or proposals and participating in pitches.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and the confidence to form a point of view, make recommendations and challenge thinking constructively.
  • A genuine passion for technology and curiosity about the platforms, products, innovations and cultural trends shaping how people live and communicate.

#LI-FB1

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans
  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)
  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes
  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work
  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client
  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions
  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members
  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting
  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes
  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required
  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects
  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)
  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject
  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts
  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Why we're hiring:

 

We are seeking a business-oriented Digital Analyst to join our Global Centre of Excellence (COE) in Mumbai. This role will play a critical part in enabling digital first decision making across across Global Procurement and Real Estate & Workplace Solutions (REWS).

The analyst will act as a digital partner for both functions – Primarily focussed on Procurement where the resource will act as a product owner for Current Source to Contract solution for WPP Procurement (GEP) and also for any future tools. The resource will also be responsible for all

This is a hands-on role requiring strong analytical capability, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership.

 

Digital & System Support – Procurement

· Support the Global Director in managing the Procurement digital roadmap, including enhancements, automation opportunities, and future solution design.

· Support the development and maintenance of Procurement portals, dashboards, and reporting tools to improve visibility of supplier, spend, and performance data.

o user adoption

o compliance

o issue resolution

o stakeholder feedback

o training effectiveness

Stakeholder Engagement & COE Enablement

· Experience working with global stakeholders and complex datasets in a matrix environment.

· Exposure to system implementation, process improvement, or digital transformation programs is an advantage.

· Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

· Highly organized, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple requests effectively.

· Proactive, curious, and solutions oriented.

About Open Intelligence:

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With approximately one-third of all global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the core of this massive network-deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. Operating at our scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle over 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process 10,000 requests per second. With operations spanning the US, UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure continuously interacts with up to 98% of the population in our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer who thrives on owning backend systems end to end — architecture, delivery, and the people who build them. You care more about sound software design, reliable APIs, and clear ownership than about any single framework or language.

You are comfortable setting technical direction for a squad, mentoring engineers, and turning product roadmap into shippable, versioned contracts. Hands-on when it matters, you design and operate services, partner integrations, and orchestration components in production — authentication, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, and the operational discipline that keeps live systems healthy. You are likely highly proficient in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin, and experienced with cloud platforms, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability. Interest in infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), durable workflows, and AI coding assistants is a plus when it helps the team ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

Beyond the technical craft, you are a strong communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders, and align sibling teams on interfaces. You take ownership of reliability and technical debt for the systems your squad runs, escalate blockers early with clear options, and are motivated by growing both the platform and the engineers who build it.

 

WHY ARE WE HIRING We are at a critical inflection point in our growth and need to scale our engineering team to tackle an expanding set of complex challenges. As the digital ecosystem evolves, we are actively developing and releasing a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These solutions are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while remaining uncompromising on our promise to protect user privacy.

To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are hiring because we need strong engineering talent to help us architect for this next order of magnitude in scale-ensuring our systems remain resilient, performant, and compliant as our global footprint and feature set rapidly expand.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

· Lead an engineering squad: set technical direction, prioritize delivery, run design and code reviews, and grow engineers through mentoring and clear ownership.

· Own the architecture and health of activation and orchestration services — API, databases, partner gateways, internal integrations, MCP and agentic integrations.

· Partner with Product and sibling teams to turn roadmap phases into shippable, versioned contracts — not ad hoc

integrations.

· Drive API integration engineering: authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, and runbooks as partner APIs evolve.

· Establish and uphold production standards — CI/CD, testing, observability, auditability, and safe release practices.

· Keep an end-to-end overview of how data flow through activation — what is live, what is in progress, and where dependencies or technical debt block the next phase.

· Contribute hands-on where it matters: critical paths, new gateways, framework foundations (e.g. tool registry, workflow runtime, guardrails hooks).

· Identify and address technical debt deliberately; balance speed with reliability for systems that support live campaigns.

· Share knowledge in design reviews, stand-ups, and cross-team forums; escalate blockers early with clear options.

· Stay curious about agentic orchestration, durable workflows, and AI coding assistants to improve how the team designs and ships software.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

· Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to engineers, product, and non-technical stakeholders and align multiple teams on interfaces.

· 6+ years in software engineering with 2+ years leading engineers or owning a significant technical area (team lead, staff, or equivalent).

· Proven delivery of backend and API-centric systems in production — services, integrations, or platforms at meaningful scale.

· Solid experience building and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems (durable state, async jobs, or orchestration).

· Comfort owning third-party integrations — auth, errors, versioning, operational monitoring, and partner-driven change.

· Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin) and sound software design (patterns, testing, code review).

· Experience with CI/CD, Git, and testing — unit, integration, and boundary/contract tests where APIs matter.

· Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and deploying services with containers and Kubernetes.

· Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and production observability (metrics, logs, tracing).

· A track record of technical debt and reliability ownership — incidents, postmortems, and systemic fixes, not one-off firefighting.

· Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to improve team productivity without lowering the production bar.

 

NICE TO HAVE

· Experience leading delivery of orchestration, workflow, or agentic systems (tool registries, policy/guardrails, human-in-the-loop flows).

· Full-stack exposure — internal UIs or ops tools (e.g. change logs, escalations) backed by the same APIs you own.

· Familiarity with AdTech / MarTech — SSPs, DSPs, deals, audiences, or campaign activation terminology.

· Experience in a monorepo or large shared codebase with many integration surfaces.

· Awareness of data privacy and safe handling of sensitive data in distributed deployments.

· Prior work on audit trails or decision logs for high-trust or automated systems.

  • Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

  • Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
  • Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
  • Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
  • Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
  • Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
  • Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

 

As part of the Global Payroll Team, you will contribute to the ongoing development of the global People strategy. Supporting business growth in an increasingly regulated environment whilst ensuring payroll and tax are compliant across the region. The Payroll Senior Analyst will have the responsibility for ensuring that all compensation, associated deductions and benefits are processed/paid on a timely basis for assigned populations. They will also be responsible for ensuring all statutory filings are completed and deadlines met.

 

 

What you'll be doing:

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and process payroll data for assigned countries, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local legislation
  • Validate payroll inputs (time, bonuses, deductions, new hires, exits)
  • Run assigned payroll cycles (gross-to-net)
  • Perform payroll reconciliations and roll-forward variance analysis
  • Resolve employee payroll queries within SLA
  • Support statutory filings and audit requests
  • Process travel and reimbursements
  • Process other statutory payments for employees
  • Process employee loan and other schemes as applicable
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound tickets/requests from management, handling requests and issues from employees and managers for the assigned population.
  • Monitor, track, and resolve requests/queries related to payroll, benefits, and data changes, escalating as needed.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate data processing and issue resolution.
  • Maintain confidential records and ensure data integrity in all payroll systems.
  • Provide operational support and guidance to employees and managers on payroll data and shared services/workflow processes.
  • Support business growth and compliance in a regulated environment.

KPIs

  • Payroll accuracy (%) – error‑free payslips
  • On‑time payroll processing (%)
  • Payroll query resolution TAT
  • Rework / correction rate
  • SLA adherence for assigned activities


What you'll need:

Skills and Competencies

  • Understanding of regional payroll legislation and statutory requirements.
  • Advanced data processing skills, including data validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Experience managing and resolving queries and tickets, preferably in a global environment.

 

Qualification and Experience

  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal
  • Bachelor's degree in HR, Accounting, Finance, or related field (SSC or multinational preferred)
  • 4-8 years of experience in payroll data processing or ticket management, ideally in a multinational or shared services environment
  • Good knowledge of payroll legislation and compliance requirements for regional countries
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with payroll reporting and reconciliations
  • Experience with service request ticketing systems is a plus.
  • Experience with Workday HCM is a plus.
