job.title: (Senior) Data Engineer – Data Modeling & Core Systems
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why We’re Hiring

We are scaling the core engineering capability behind real-time, high-throughput ad-tech infrastructure that processes large-scale audience data at global scale.

This is not a role for basic ETL scripts or glue code. In this role, data engineering is treated as a true software engineering discipline. You will take deep technical ownership of complex, multi-layered data models (canonical schemas, high-dimensional behavioral signals, and vector embeddings) that power live targeting and measurement decisions for advertisers worldwide.

You’ll help evolve a distributed, production-grade data platform while collaborating with a high-trust engineering team that values clean architecture, continuous improvement (kaizen), and modern development standards.

 

Who You’ll Be Working With

You’ll work closely with fellow engineers across backend systems, Quality Assurance, Analytics, and connector teams. We value teamwork over ego, collaboration over competition, open and honest communication, strong opinions held with curiosity, and delivering well-tested, maintainable code.

Our Technology Environment

  • Languages & Core: Scala, functional programming, strongly typed distributed services
  • Processing & Streaming: Apache Spark for large-scale distributed processing, event-driven architectures
  • Cloud & Storage: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Parquet
  • Engineering Standards: Automated CI/CD, robust unit & integration testing, Git workflows, and Tyda (our open-source, automation-driven SDLC process)

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve production data models spanning input/output models, schema evolution, field types, and partitioning strategies across multi-stage distributed pipelines.
  • Maintain and extend our audience framework, normalizing high-velocity raw inputs into standardized, canonical formats across behavioral signals, demographics, and brand affinity.
  • Design and manage models handling relational structures, real-time behavioral signals, high-dimensional embeddings, and anomaly detection.
  • Develop and maintain Spark-based data services in Scala and GCP, adhering to software design patterns, modular architecture, and edge-case resilience.
  • Lead by example with automated unit/integration testing, strict code reviews, Git branching discipline, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Partner with QA, Analytics, and downstream product teams to guarantee contract integrity, data correctness, and reliable system consumption.

 

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of software engineering or data engineering experience, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade distributed data systems.
  • Production experience writing quality code in Scala OR another statically typed language (Java, Kotlin, C#, Go). If your background is in Java/Kotlin/Go, you are eager and excited to build in a Scala-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating on large codebases with automated testing (unit/integration testing), version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and structured code reviews.
  • Proven ability to design and reason about complex, multi-layered data architectures (e.g., canonical schemas, dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or domain-driven data design).
  • Solid experience with Apache Spark (or similar distributed frameworks) handling high-volume datasets.
  • Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) or equivalent cloud data platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • The ability to explain complex data models, schema trade-offs, and technical designs clearly to both technical and product stakeholders.

What Makes This Role Different? Real Software Rigor. You won't just be stitching together SaaS tools; you'll be writing modular, compiled, testable code for real-time systems.

 

Who you are:

job.title: Beasley Media Group
job.description:
Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Detroit, MI Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accounts Payable Specialist/Receptionist.

Naples, FL Full Time Mid Level Share About Beasley Media GroupBeasley Media Group is an innovative media company operating in one of Florida’s most desirable locations. Join our corporate team in beautiful Naples and contribute to the financial and administrative operations of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.
 Position SummaryWe are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and professional individual to serve as Accounts Payable Specialist/Receptionist. This role is the first point of contact for visitors, clients, and vendors while simultaneously supporting the accounts payable cycle for the corporate finance team.  
 Key ResponsibilitiesFront Desk & Office Operations
  • Serve as the primary point of contact at the front desk, greeting and assisting visitors, clients, and vendors in a professional and welcoming manner.
  • Answer, screen, and direct incoming phone calls and emails; take and relay accurate messages.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries, including courier coordination.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional reception area and common spaces.
  • Coordinate and order meals for executive staff, company meetings, and corporate events.
  • Oversee daily office operations and maintain adequate office supply inventory; coordinate with vendors as needed.

Invoice Management
  • Process and manage accounts payable invoices received through multiple channels (email, mail, and electronic systems).
  • Review invoices for completeness, accuracy, and proper supporting documentation.
  • Verify coding and authorization prior to processing; perform three-way match (PO, receipt, invoice) as applicable.

Payment Processing
  • Ensure timely and accurate payment of all vendor invoices in accordance with vendor terms.
  • Maintain payment schedules to optimize cash flow and prevent late fees.
  • Process payment runs and coordinate check distributions, ACH payments, and wire transfers.

Accounting & Reconciliation
  • Code invoices to appropriate general ledger accounts in accordance with company policies and GAAP.
  • Maintain accurate and well-organized accounts payable records.
  • Support month-end close activities and assist with account reconciliations.

Vendor Relations
  • Serve as the primary contact for assigned vendors regarding invoice status and payment inquiries.
  • Proactively resolve payment discrepancies and disputes in a professional manner.
  • Build strong vendor relationships to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to address invoice questions and approval workflow issues.
 QualificationsRequired
  • Associate degree in Accounting or a related field.
  • Prior experience in a receptionist, front-desk, or administrative support role preferred.
  • Fundamental understanding of accounts payable processes, workflows, and GAAP.
  • Understanding of how AP transactions impact general ledger posting.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).
  • Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Professional demeanor, strong customer-service orientation, and excellent communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Ability to multitask and independently manage competing priorities.

Preferred
  • Experience with accounting software or ERP systems (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite).
  • Familiarity with three-way match processes.
  • Previous experience in media, entertainment, or corporate environments.
 Core Competencies
  • Independent Worker – Manages workload autonomously while balancing multiple responsibilities.
  • Problem Solver – Strong analytical skills; researches issues and develops effective solutions.
  • Team Player – Collaborative mindset with outstanding customer-service orientation.
  • Communicator – Clear, professional written and verbal communication with vendors, visitors, and colleagues.
  • Organized – Systematic approach to work; able to pivot seamlessly between financial and front-office tasks.
 Comprehensive Benefits Package
  • Hourly rate: $21
  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Financial Security: Life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage.
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Work-Life Balance: Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Time Off: Paid time off and company holidays.
Waiting periods apply for certain benefits.
 Why Join Beasley Media Group?
  • Work in the vibrant Naples, Florida area with an excellent quality of life.
  • Grow your career in a dynamic media industry environment.
  • Collaborate with experienced finance and operations professionals.
  • Be part of an innovative, forward-thinking organization.
  • Develop transferable skills in a supportive team setting.
 How to ApplyApplication Deadline: Open until filled. We encourage interested candidates to apply early.
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com, KSL‑TV, and KSL NewsRadio. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

Position Overview

The Digital Content Producer leads KSL’s efforts to create content that supports and reinforces on-air shows. The ideal candidate will pioneer approaches for online conversation and community engagement. You will identify and advance conversations generated by KSL; create a culture of collaboration, connecting our station's voice with our most influential listeners; and collaborate with news, programming and promotions. 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is a hybrid role that requires the employee to sometimes work at our Salt Lake City site. Specific hybrid schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management.

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Responsible for working in conjunction with News and programming to consistently manage content published on KSL's platforms.
  • Deep understanding of station brand to appropriately publish content
  • Write breaking news stories as needed
  • Communicate clearly with the newsroom team
  • Edit photos, graphics, videos, audio clips and text using appropriate editing tools
  • Optimize story performance using various analytical tools
  • Maintain careful documentation of story day planning and publishing schedules
  • Participate in station's digital marketing efforts, as well as staying on top of trending digital developments
  • Video switching and editing capabilities
  • Create content for use on web/social only platforms
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • College degree in journalism or related field. If no degree, 1-2 years of digital project experience
  • Ability to write clear, conversational and accurate content in AP style
  • Ability to work under pressure and on deadline
  • Ability to work well with others on a team
  • Detail-oriented in reviewing content
  • A passion for the news
  • Prefer experience working in graphic design, using Photoshop, Illustrator and Final Cut Pro
  • Prefer 2+ years successful experience working in social media, with a deep understanding of social media techniques and tools
  • Ability to research and implement new social media practices a significant plus, specifically experience with Facebook and Twitter ads and analytics
  • Flexible personality in order to connect news, programming and promotions

job.title: Human Resources Ministry Partner
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

The Human Resources Ministry Partner is an experienced human resources professional responsible for providing comprehensive HR support to team members and leaders across the Ministry. This role requires expertise in employee relations, compliance, onboarding, orientation, HRIS administration, and HR operations.  Will also serve as the first point of contact for HR related questions or concerns.

 

* This is an in-office role at our Franklin, TN Office

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for the HR team, including, but not limited to: development of correspondence for both confidential and non-confidential matters regarding people operations and employee relations processes.
  • Act as the first point of contact for HR related questions or concerns – redirecting team members and elevating issues as appropriate. Clearly and positively communicate solutions with exceptional follow through. Effectively and efficiently route and answer questions within scope of knowledge and authority.
  • Enter and maintain team member data within the HRIS system, ensuring a high level of accuracy, confidentiality, compliance, and timeliness with internal standards. This includes keying new hires, terminations, compensation adjustments, and other changes to team member status.
  • Facilitate new hire onboarding and new hire orientations, ensuring a smooth transition for team members into the Ministry and promoting engagement from day one.
  • Ensure the organization of team member files; maintain confidential records, I-9 documents, and other related employment documentation.
  • Support the VP of Human Resources with conducting investigations into team member complaints, policy violations, worker’s compensation investigations, vehicle accidents, and other workplace issues, ensuring thorough documentation in the Ministry’s case management system.
  • Advise leaders on corrective actions, performance improvement plans, and performance support procedures in alignment with Ministry policies and legal requirements.
  • Partner with payroll to submit Team Member vacation cash out requests, retro-pay amounts, bonus payments (i.e., relocation, sign on, or discretionary bonus amounts).
  • Maintain list of active team members on the Ministry Driver’s Insurance policy. Notifying vendor of changes.
  • Partner with the HR team as needed for Leave of Absences, Workers Compensation, Disability, Unemployment, Employment Verifications, EEO reporting, Public Student Loan Forgiveness, and other related projects.
  • Partner on exit paperwork and interviews.
  • Collaborate with HR leadership and other HR team members to support Ministry initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
  • Assist in the administration of the compliance portal where team members acknowledge policies and trainings.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • PHR and/or SHRM-CP an added plus.
  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years focused on employee relations.
  • Proficiency in HRIS system (ADP preferred), Microsoft Office Suite, and HR reporting tools.
  • Strong knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and HR best practices.
  • Experience facilitating onboarding and orientation programs for new team members.
  • Proven ability to manage complex employee relations cases with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills for building genuine business/ministry relationships.
  • Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Ministry-focused, with a sense of urgency and exceptional follow-through.
  • Adaptable and positive, maintaining productivity amid change.
  • Professional representation of Ministry and team members, ensuring confidentiality.
  • Collaborative team player with a strong customer service orientation.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • High initiative with strong problem-solving abilities.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

job.title: Broadcast Business Development Project Manager II
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

The Broadcast Business Development Project Manager II provides leadership as the primary point of contact with internal and external parties in relation to tenant lease management, compliance, and issues. This role is responsible for preparing, examining, analyzing, negotiating, and revising tenant leases and managing tenant relationships. This position will work closely with Contracts & Leasing Manager and other departments to perform his/her job functions related to owned tower management and tenant lease administration.

 

* This is an in-office role at our Franklin, TN Office

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Serve as single customer point of contact that has direct project management responsibly of all leasing activities (both new business and amendments to existing leases) on owned tower facilities, from customer application creation through installation closeout. This includes tracking and completing project-related activities with minimal supervision.
  • Handle all inquiries, applications, contracting and follow each project to completion, ensure accurate system entry and posting of relevant contracts and documents into company system infrastructures.
  • Work closely with several internal departments to collaborate and ensure communication is completed to all relevant departments.
  • Effectively learn and understand tenant needs by completing thorough applications and site analyses, providing upfront communication to tenants regarding any potential application or asset-related contingencies, providing a proactive resolution when necessary.
  • Develop successful working relationships with all cross-functional teams to ensure project related action items are reviewed and addressed in a timely matter; take lead to provide proactive updates to tenants and internal staff members.
  • Serve as a representative to identify factors that ensure that business needs are communicated and addressed with any project enhancements.
  • Maintain current knowledge of FCC rules and regulations and regularly apply knowledge to his/her job functions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Minimum 5-7 years’ general broadcast knowledge, sales, and leasing experience.
  • Project management experience required including the proven ability to plan, organize, and administer projects desired.
  • Experience reviewing lease agreements of a complex nature, with familiarity of legal (contractual) and engineering terminology.
  • Strong computer skills; advance knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Outlook); advanced knowledge of the Internet and research skills
  • Proven ability to deal with multiple, simultaneous problems in a systematic, logical manner.
  • Exhibits strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, establishing and meeting performance/ministry goals.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values.

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay

job.title: Operations & Innovation Specialist
job.description:
Operations & Innovation Specialist 

(ESPN Network | Milwaukee, WI)

The ESPN Radio Network and Good Karma Sports are seeking a full-time Operations & Innovation Specialist to join the Home Office Innovation Team, with a dedicated focus on supporting ESPN Network teammates.


This role will help teammates work smarter by identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation, and technology.


The ideal candidate is curious, creative, analytical, and action-oriented. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding how things work, challenging the status quo, experimenting with new technology, and turning ideas into meaningful operational improvements.


Career responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build strong relationships with ESPN Network teammates to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes across ESPN Network departments and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate existing workflows, recommend improvements, and design, build, test, implement, and maintain AI-enaabled solutions and automations that improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Partner with ESPN Network leadership and the Home Office Innovation Team to prioritize projects and execute improvements.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies to identify new ways to improve productivity and operations.
  • Develop clear processes, documentation, and training materials that help teammates adopt new solutions.
  • Support the successful rollout and ongoing adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of innovation initiatives, including time saved, improved efficiency, and increased operational capacity.
  • Collaborate with the Home Office Innovation Team and other teammates across Good Karma Sports to share successful solutions, improve workflows, and implement best practices.
  • Complete additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports by demonstrating our core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Follow Through, and Teamwork.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Passion for AI, emerging technology, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows and translate challenges into practical solutions.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code/no-code tools, CRM systems, or reporting tools is a plus.
  • Resourceful, self-directed, and comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence and support change across teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance experimentation, execution, accuracy, and responsible technology use.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment and managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and willingness to learn new platforms and systems.
  • Valid driver’s license required.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is a full-time, in-office, exempt salaried position offering a competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for growth as responsibilities and impact expand.

The position may require occasional evenings and weekends depending on project needs and operational priorities.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 18, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY. 

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Manager of Music & Streaming Content
job.description:
Description

About Hope Media Group

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group is the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! The Next Digital Product is Hope Media Group's first digital product: a music app built for Christians, offering a generosity-funded alternative to ad-driven and algorithm-driven streaming. Rather than inferring what to play from behavioral data, the Next Digital Product starts by asking how you're doing and curates a path in response. It's built to give back to the people who use it, not extract from them.


Manager of Music & Streaming Content


Job Summary:

Hope Media Group is seeking a Head of Music & Streaming Content to lead the overall music and content strategy for the Next Digital Product. This role owns the sound, content direction, playlist philosophy, programming standards, and listener content experience, working closely with product engineering to make sure the platform reflects the intended vision. It directs contractors who execute playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and it directs the Director of Digital Audio Streams.

Essential Functions:

Content Strategy and Sound:

  • Own the Next Digital Product's content strategy and sound direction: genre mix, mood and path curation logic, tone.
  • Set and uphold content standards grounded in a Christian worldview, applied to every song on the platform regardless of where it comes from.
  • Own the Next Digital Product's audio identity: imaging, voiceover, and sound design.
  • Shape how content strategy shows up in-product — the check-in flow, path structure, discovery surfaces.

Programming Standards:

  • Set and maintain programming standards. Decide what qualifies for a path, how playlists are built, and how the catalog is curated across moods and life moments.
  • Build the editorial and programming framework future content roles will execute against day to day.
  • Own the content taxonomy: the mood, genre, and activity attributes that drive curation and personalization.
  • Monitor listening data — skips, completions, saves, repeat listening — to refine programming over time. 

Team Leadership:

  • Direct contract resources supporting playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and manage the production budget.
  • Lead and develop the Director of Digital Audio Streams, delegating day-to-day streaming operations while retaining ownership of standards.
  • You serve as the Next Digital Product's primary representative within the Christian music industry.

Demonstrated Faith

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry's Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG's media platforms for evangelism and discipleship
  • Exhibit a strong moral character
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church


Requirements

Non-Essential Functions

  • Other duties as requested.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Music, Communications, Media, or a related field, or at least 10 years of equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 7+ years in music programming, editorial, or content strategy at a streaming service, radio network, or comparable audio platform.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a playlist or programming philosophy at scale, not just execution of someone else's standards.
  • Experience directing contractors or a small team delivering production work against a budget and deadline.
  • Working knowledge of the Christian/gospel music industry, or a demonstrated ability to build that knowledge fast.
  • Comfort operating without an established playbook.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Direct experience with Christian radio or Christian streaming programming.
  • Experience building or scaling a listening product's editorial function from near-zero.
  • Familiarity with licensing and rights constraints on programming decisions.
  • Heart for Christian ministry
  • Strong moral character
  • Has a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Spiritually grounded and working knowledge of scripture
  • Must be an active member of a Bible believing local church


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • The Director of Digital Audio Streams, and contract resources supporting playlisting, production, and interactive streaming.

Working Conditions and Environment

Travel:

  • As needed for industry events, conferences, and label and partner meetings.

Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • Occasional evenings, weekends, or holidays may be required for board meetings, ministry events, fundraising events, urgent employee matters, or organizational needs.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work.

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.


Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains 
  • Third-Party Recruiter Policy:


We are grateful for the interest of those who wish to support our hiring efforts. However, Hope Media Group does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from external staffing agencies or search firms. Submissions from third parties will not be considered and may be retained without obligation or payment or fees.

job.title: Director of Sales - Alexandria/Wadena
job.description:
Director of Sales - Alexandria/Wadena

#26-1357

Alexandria, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

HBI Radio Alexandria

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio is a full-service media company with 16 radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions in four of northern Minnesota's most beautiful and active resort communities: Alexandria, Bemidji, Brainerd and Wadena. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The position of General Sales Manager is responsible for all aspects of the sales operations of the markets. The General Sales Manager will monitor and control sales efforts to maximize the inventory and revenue opportunities for digital and the stations broadcast media.

Job Responsibilities

Develop short and long-term sales strategies to ensure effective client services and achievement of maximum sales and digital sales revenues.

Monitor and modify sales strategies to ensure viability in the constantly changing marketplace.

Effectively lead, develop, train, cross-train and motivate the sales and support staff.

Organize sales department and develop sales procedures, including sales contract forms, commission/incentive, and pricing/inventory procedures that garner maximum revenue in current market conditions.

Develop creative and special concepts, promotions and programs to maximize revenue.

Establish individual annual sales goals for team members, with quarterly benchmarks.

Manage major sales presentations and client relationships to aid in the business close and/or visibility in the market.

Provide continual flow of station and community information to all AE 's, sales representatives, and national agencies.

Provide input to the General Manager regarding programming decisions related to sales performance.

Qualifications

Minimum of (6) years sales experience with at least (4) years sales management experience within a broadcast environment.

Proven ability to work effectively with management to establish acceptable sales budgets; meet revenue goals and objectives as a result of an effectively coordinated, organized and well-executed sales team effort.

Proven ability to develop systems procedures to regularly monitor and evaluate progress.

Proven ability to coach and supervise staff, including-but not limited to, organizing, delegating, training, interviewing and motivating others to produce at their maximum potential.

Knowledge and success with NTR, with emphasis on vendor programs.

Proven ability to monitor modify current sales strategies to insure viability in a constantly changing marketplace.

Knowledge and experience in the use of marketing research for direct selling and ability to train others in its use.

Must be goal-oriented with a strong focus on business performance.

Project desired company image with respect to dress and demeanor.

Must have a good driving record and a valid driver's license, both will be checked.

Ability to travel to various locations.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The starting base compensation is $100,000 to $120,000 annually. Additional commissions (or bonuses) can be earned above and beyond this amount.

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser: https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

Location:

Colorado Springs, CO: 5725 Mark Dabling Blvd, 80919

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

job.title: RCS Product Support Specialist
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider.

 

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

 

Here is what makes us different:

 

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

 

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

 

If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

                                                                              

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Love solving issues? Join us as a Product Support Specialist and be the primary point of contact with clients. You'll be handling phone calls and emails from customers in the United States and other countries 24x7. You'll provide timely and accurate answers on a wide range of topics. Examples include software clock building, configuring audio devices, network infrastructure, or reviewing a SQL Server database. This is a remote position.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Document interactions with customers; provide answers by identifying problems; research and guide customers through corrective steps. 
  • Troubleshoot problems in software, hardware, networks, and systems.
  • Write up technical documentation that can be used to repair software defects and deliver enhancements. 
  • Work with customers to improve software system performance by identifying problems and recommending changes. 
  • We ask that you keep your skills up to date by participating in educational opportunities and maintaining personal networks. 
  • Handling phone calls, emails, and social interactions from customers in the United States and other countries. 
  • Working with other departments within RCS teams to further extend our product capabilities. 
  • Have fun!

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

The ideal candidate should possess a background in Radio automation software. They should also have excellent customer service skills and a team focus. Attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment is necessary. Candidates should have a fundamentally sound knowledge of networking technologies, Microsoft Windows, and  broadcast systems.


  • We are looking for people with experience working in a Radio, IT, or an Engineering environment. Knowledge of broadcast software such as GSelector, Zetta or NexGen is highly desirable.
  • If you have prior Customer Service experience, we want to hear from you. 
  • We need people with a built-in ability to prioritize. Your experience in Radio or TV means you know what to do when the Off-Air call comes in. 
  • Ideally, you already have well-developed troubleshooting and investigative skills.
  • We never close! Alternate schedules may be required.
  • Bilingual English\Spanish abilities are a plus.
  • We need someone with a can-do attitude!

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. job.description:

Broadcast Operations Manager

Raleigh, NC Full Time Manager/Supervisor Share Curtis Media Group is seeking a Broadcast Operations Manager for our multi-market North Carolina radio stations.  The Operations Manager will work closely with the programming, engineering, traffic and IT staff to oversee the day-to-day operations of our FCC licensed radio stations, digital, networks and additional enterprises.  The Operations Manager will work with ownership and senior management in the administration of operational, compliance and administrative activities.
Duties and Responsibilities
  1. Oversees and coordinates the continuous, multifaceted daily operations of radio stations, ensuring compliance with broadcast standards, FCC rules and regulations, and relevant federal and state laws and regulations.
  2. Maintains accurate schedules, records, discrepancy reports, and follow-through communications, and ensures that all on-air broadcast programming complies with FCC rules and regulations.
  3. Participates in the establishment, organization, and implementation of short- and long-range goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures; monitors and evaluates program effectiveness and effects changes required for improvement.
  4. Directs and administers the provision of day-to-day operation support to the various sub-units of the station, including the non-engineering portions of the station's physical plant, space allocation and utilization, station supplies and inventory, and station safety and security.
  5. Assigns, allocates work, and generally oversees operational and engineering personnel engaged in continuous station operations; performs recruitment, training, scheduling, retention, problem resolution, and performance management.
  6. Develops and implements systems to maintain records on station operations, equipment, and compliance activities; prepares regular and ad-hoc reports.
  7. Provides advice and assistance to senior station management in the planning, implementation, and evaluation of modification to existing operations, systems, and procedures.
  8. Researches and makes recommendations to management pertaining to acquisition of operating equipment; participates in the development and management of annual operating budgets.
  9. Supervises and maintains station FCC Public files including station Political Disclosure Statements, uploading of information to individual station public files including Issues & Ascertainment, EEO and political and issue advertising orders.
  10. May provide services as an on-air host, as required.
  11. Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Minimum Job Requirements
  • High school diploma or GED; at least 5 years of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities specified.
  • Completed degree(s) from an accredited institution that are above the minimum education requirement may be substituted for experience on a year for year basis.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required
  • IT and radio automation operations are a must.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of personnel
  • Records maintenance skills.
  • Skill in the use of personal computers and related software applications.
  • Knowledge of radio principles, procedures, operations, and standards.
  • Knowledge and understanding of radio communications facilities and distribution, and automation systems.
  • Skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
  • Knowledge of inventory management practices.
  • Knowledge of radio organizational structures, workflows, systems, and operating procedures.
  • Ability to develop, plan, and implement short- and long-range goals.
  • Knowledge of project management principles, practices, techniques, and tools.
  • Knowledge of FCC and other federal, state and local broadcasting regulations.
  • Ability to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments.
  • Knowledge of budgeting and fiscal management principles and procedures.
  • Knowledge of facilities management, physical plant, safety, and building safety and security procedures.
  • Ability to create, compose, and edit written materials.
  • Supervision of individual station issues and ascertainment for
  • EEO compliance
  • Uploading of Political and Issue orders to FCC public file database
  • Knowledge of on-air and remote broadcasting processes and procedures.
  • Skills in examining and developing station operations and procedures, formulating policy, and implementing organizational strategies and procedures.
  • Ability to oversee, coordinate, and support the execution of continuous broadcast schedules on a 24x7 basis.
  • Knowledge of current and developing trends in radio.
  • Skill in operating radio equipment.

job.title: Digital Media Buyer & Planner
job.description:

job.title: Sr. News & Corporate Researcher
job.description:
Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Company research: Prepare profiles of potential partners, customers, acquisition targets, vendors, investors, and other organizations.
    • Financial research: Review public filings, earnings reports, investor presentations, industry data, and other financial information.
    • Strategic research: Support management in evaluating new markets, products, geographic expansion, partnerships, licensing opportunities, and investments.
    • Executive briefings: Produce concise research memos, background reports, talking points, charts, and briefing materials for executives.
    • Market research: Analyze industry size, growth rates, trends, competitive conditions, and emerging opportunities.
    • Data collection and analysis: Gather information from databases, government records, surveys, trade associations, research firms, and credible online sources and turn it into actionable findings.
    • Fact checking: Verify statistics, claims, quotations, company information, and other material before it is used internally or externally.
    • Regulatory and policy research: Track legislation, regulations, government policies, court decisions, and agency actions relevant to the company's operations.
    • Special projects: Conduct rapid research for senior executives on acquisitions, business development opportunities, corporate communications, litigation, presentations, or other priority matters.
    • Cross-department support: Work with finance, legal, business development, marketing, communications, and senior management on research-intensive projects.
    • Recommendations: Go beyond simply collecting information by identifying key findings, risks, opportunities, and recommended next steps.
    • News and developments: Monitor news, government actions, regulatory developments, economic trends, and other events that could affect the company.

    News Research to Include:

    • Conduct in-depth research on breaking news, developing stories, current events, public figures, organizations, government agencies, businesses, and other topics relevant to Newsmax programming.
    • Provide producers, anchors, reporters, and editorial leadership with timely background research, facts, statistics, timelines, and other information needed for news coverage.
    • Monitor news developments throughout the day and identify relevant information, updates, and potential story angles.
    • Research and develop background materials for interviews, guest appearances, breaking-news coverage, and special programming.
    • Prepare concise research briefs, background documents, timelines, fact sheets, and other materials for producers, anchors, and newsroom leadership.
    • Research potential guests, experts, newsmakers, and other individuals relevant to developing stories and planned programming.
    • Review government reports, court records, public filings, studies, polling data, transcripts, news reports, and other primary and secondary sources.
    • Conduct research across multiple sources and evaluate the credibility, accuracy, and relevance of information.
    • Quickly respond to research requests from producers and newsroom leadership during breaking-news situations.
    • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

    Position Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, History, English, Liberal Arts International Relations, Research, or a related field preferred.
    • Previous experience in corporate research, news research, television production, digital media, investigative research, or a related field preferred.
    • Strong knowledge of current events, politics, government, business, international affairs, and the broader news landscape.
    • Exceptional research and fact-checking skills with demonstrated ability to locate and evaluate information from credible sources.
    • Ability to quickly research unfamiliar or complex subjects and summarize findings clearly and accurately.
    • Experience researching public records, government documents, court records, public filings, databases, and other primary sources preferred.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and factual integrity.
    • Ability to clearly organize and present research findings for staff.
    • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, online research tools including artificial intelligence and databases.
    • Flexibility to work outside standard business hours as required by breaking news and major events.

    Compensation & Benefits:

    • Competitive salary - $85k -$105k depending on skills and relevant experience.
    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
    • Paid time off and holidays.
    • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Director of Talent Management
job.description:

  • Coordinate communication between on-air talent, agents and representatives, Legal, Production, Programming, Human Resources, and other internal teams as appropriate.

  • Work closely with Production and Programming teams to coordinate talent needs for regular programming, special coverage, breaking news, promotional appearances, and network events.

  • Maintain a high level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality when handling talent contracts, compensation information, schedules, and other sensitive matters.
  • Maintain accurate calendars, trackers, files, and other administrative systems related to on-air talent.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding logistics for on-air talent in coordination with Legal, Human Resources, Production, IT, and other departments as appropriate.
  • Identify and recruit on-air talent, including anchors, hosts, correspondents, reporters, contributors, analysts, and commentators.
  • Develop the network's talent strategy in consultation with the CEO, president, news director, and programming executives.
  • Continuously scout competitors and emerging media for potential talent, including television, radio, podcasts, streaming, YouTube, social media, and local news.
  • Lead contract discussions and negotiations in coordination with legal, HR, finance, and senior management, including compensation, contract length, exclusivity, outside activities, and renewal terms.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Media, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in television, broadcast media, talent coordination, production coordination, entertainment, or a related environment preferred.
  • Previous experience working with on-air talent, talent representatives, agents, producers, or other high-profile individuals strongly preferred.
  • Experience with scheduling, contract administration, production coordination, or talent operations preferred.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage complex schedules, competing priorities, and frequent last-minute changes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with talent, agents, executives, attorneys, and employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential contracts, compensation, personnel information, and other sensitive matters.
  • Ability to anticipate needs, identify potential scheduling or logistical issues, and proactively develop solutions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and calendar management tools.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a service-oriented approach and the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Ability to remain organized and composed during breaking news, schedule changes, and other time-sensitive situations.
  • Knowledge of television production and newsroom operations preferred.
  • Flexibility to work outside regular business hours when necessary to support breaking news, special programming, and talent needs.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary - $150k - $175k depending on skills and relevant experience.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Managing Producer International News
job.description:
Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with Newsmax foreign correspondents to coordinate international news coverage, assignments, and reporting needs.
  • Serve as a primary liaison between foreign correspondents and television show production teams.
  • Monitor and track breaking and developing international news stories and provide timely updates to the News Director and editorial teams.

  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
