  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Liberal Arts, International Relations, Political Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in television news, news production, international news, assignment desk operations, or a related broadcast environment.
  • Television production experience with a strong understanding of newsroom and broadcast production workflows.
  • Experience working with producers, correspondents, assignment desks, and production teams in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience coordinating live shots, taped segments, interviews, correspondent coverage, or other television news production elements preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of international current events, geopolitics, and major global news developments.
  • Strong editorial judgment with the ability to identify relevant and compelling international news stories.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong research, organizational, and time-management skills.

  • Professional development and training opportunities.

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
The Administrative Assistant will primarily provide administrative support to three Senior Vice Presidents. The position will handle a wide range of administrative and executive support-related tasks, including but not limited to calendar management, meeting preparation, travel arrangements and coordination, organizing and submitting expenses, and project management. The Administrative Assistant will operate with the utmost discretion while working with highly confidential information, ensuring impeccable attention to detail, organizational skills, and thoroughness. Additionally, this position will be in constant communication with both internal and external partners and clients.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex and ever-changing day-to-day schedules of the SVPs via Microsoft Outlook, scheduling and organizing meetings across multiple time zones.
  • Anticipate all needs of the executives by thinking and working proactively with a one-step-ahead mentality throughout the day in terms of meeting prep, arising issues and new developments.
  • Prepare for meetings and appointments by creating agendas and other pertinent materials, preparing conference rooms and audio/visual needs and securing external guests when applicable.
  • Provide high-level administrative support to executives including answering phones, coordinating/preparing for meetings, maintaining calendar, arranging conference calls, arranging complex travel arrangements which include international, etc.
  • Serve as liaison between the SVPs and key stakeholders.
  • Act as a "gatekeeper" by managing the SVPs leadership’s calendars. This involves using discretion in identifying critical items, setting up meetings and making scheduling changes with minimal involvement by the executive. Plans, coordinates and ensures schedules are followed and respected.
  • Make thoughtful, quick and accurate decisions when executive is unavailable.
  • Assist in regularly creating and editing memos and PowerPoint presentations to be presented by the executives.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements; prepare detailed travel itineraries inclusive of flights, hotels, meeting agendas, etc.
  • Screen phone calls and forward calls appropriately, communicating with external and internal partners in a professional manner.
  • Oversee personal and departmental expenses. Prepare, reconcile and submit all necessary invoices and credit card expenses in Concur in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Handle confidential information meticulously; escalate any required information with discretion.
  • Ensure SVPs remain organized and on-schedule through proactive, consistent communication throughout the day.
  • Facilitate mass internal communication (ie. distributing company-wide e-mails, reports, etc.)
  • Draft, review and send communications on behalf of executives.
  • Organize and coordinate multiple large meetings, materials, reports, etc.
  • Keep up to date on department specific initiatives and timelines.
  • Maintain an accurate and current list of internal and external contacts.
  • Have a clear understanding of the company structure and the way departments operate.
  • Miscellaneous projects and tasks as assigned in a timely and accurate fashion.
  • Nurtures strong partnerships with a broad range of individuals including other EAs, facilities, the executive’s direct reports, travel, IT, security and other key internal stakeholders.
  • Answer questions with tact, diplomacy and accuracy.
  • Operate with sound judgement and efficiency.
  • Keep executives abreast on time sensitive and priority issues, ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Handle printing, faxing, copying, filing, mail and shipping.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4+ years of prior administrative/executive assistant experience for senior-level executives.
  • Significant experience working in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint required.
  • Strong technology skills including ability to work within PC and Mac programs, iPad, iPhone, and Google products. The ability to type fast and efficiently is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Experience within digital, entertainment or sports industry 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional interpersonal and phone skills and the ability to interact with staff at all levels.
  • Expert level written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing highly sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a positive attitude.
  • Highly organized; a strategic planner who is able to create, implement and improve organizational systems, both digital and physical files.
  • Able to work independently and with little supervision.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Demonstrated comfort interacting with high level executives and high-profile individuals.
  • Ability to work proactively with a solution-oriented mindset and a can-do attitude; always thinking one-step-ahead, while staying calm and confident.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and solutions oriented.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project/program management skills.
  • Exercise a high degree of professionalism and diplomacy in interactions with all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent follow through skills and the ability to anticipate and address business needs proactively.
  • Exemplary time management skills.
  • Highly adaptable to a fluid, ever-changing work environment.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, resourcefulness, resilience and a commitment to process improvement.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional light lifting and standing

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in office.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KTNV
job.description:
At Scripps-owned KTNV, you’ll tell the stories that help Las Vegas viewers understand what’s happening in their community and why it matters. As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll take stories from idea to air, researching, writing, shooting and editing compelling content for television and digital platforms.


You’ll be out in the community, talking with the people at the center of the story and bringing clarity and context to fast-moving news. From breaking news and live reports to memorable enterprise stories, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase strong journalism, visual storytelling and your own creative voice.


If you’re a self-starter who thrives on deadlines and wants to make an impact through local journalism, this is an opportunity to do meaningful work in one of the country’s most dynamic news markets.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop compelling story ideas by evaluating assignments, news leads and tips.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation and research.
  • Write accurate, engaging stories that meet broadcast and AP style standards.
  • Shoot high-quality video and still photography that strengthens your storytelling.
  • Edit video and produce content for television, digital and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver taped interviews, narration and live reports from the scene of breaking and developing news.
  • Collaborate with photographers on assigned stories to create cohesive, visually strong coverage.
  • Partner with producers to help prepare newscasts and meet daily editorial needs.
  • Work with digital team members to develop multimedia stories and extend coverage across platforms.
  • Respond quickly and effectively as stories evolve in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company-required limits are required. Driving is an essential part of this role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills with a focus on accuracy, clarity and engaging storytelling.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and experience capturing video in the field.
  • Videography and nonlinear editing experience preferred, including Final Cut Pro or similar editing systems.
  • Computer literacy, including familiarity with newsroom computer systems.
  • Confidence posting and adapting content for websites and multimedia platforms.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with photographers, producers and digital teams.
  • Self-motivation, sound news judgment and the ability to perform in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Flexibility to move between reporting, shooting, editing and live storytelling as the news demands.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:

At KTNV, you’ll be part of a collaborative newsroom focused on serving the Las Vegas community with relevant, compelling journalism. Our team brings different backgrounds, perspectives, interests and storytelling strengths to the newsroom, all with a shared goal: connecting audiences with the stories that affect their lives. You’ll work alongside journalists who value teamwork, curiosity, creativity and the energy that comes with chasing a great local story.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Las Vegas gives journalists a remarkable range of stories to tell and experiences to enjoy outside the newsroom. Beyond the world-famous Strip, the Las Vegas Valley offers distinctive neighborhoods, a vibrant food and entertainment scene and a community with plenty of personality.

When you're off the clock, Southern Nevada's landscape offers a dramatic change of pace, with desert scenery and abundant opportunities to get outdoors. Whether you're drawn to live entertainment and restaurants or prefer exploring the desert and surrounding natural areas, Las Vegas offers plenty to discover.

job.title: Facilities, CW Maintenance Supervisor
job.description:
Are you a hands-on problem solver who takes pride in keeping a facility running at its very best? Scripps is looking for a Facilities, CW Maintenance Supervisor to join our team in Clearwater, FL. In this essential role, you'll be the backbone of our operations, ensuring our building, equipment, and work environment are safe, clean, and fully functional so our teams can do their best work every single day. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love variety in your workday, and enjoy being the person everyone counts on, this is the opportunity for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Learn and understand all facilities department safety rules, including chemical safety, hearing conservation, etc. Participate in monthly facilities departmental safety meetings.
  • Store, inventory, and deliver supplies to all personnel as assigned.
  • Maintain all facility equipment properly. This includes repair or replacement of light fixtures, painting, remodeling, plumbing, electrical, carpentry, cement repair/replacement, and all other general repairs to building or building equipment as required.
  • Clean, repair, and troubleshoot office chairs, filing cabinets, desks, and other office furnishings.
  • Move equipment, furniture, cubicle components, etc.
  • Keep facilities and departmental area safe, clean, and organized. Properly handle waste disposal (used chemicals, etc.).
  • Perform general facility cleaning, waste removal, floor maintenance, exterior and grounds maintenance, and facilitate company recycling programs.
  • Keep restrooms, break/kitchen areas properly cleaned and stocked with janitorial supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash can liners, etc.
  • Foster good relations between the facilities department and other departments.
  • Handle all other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Generally, a minimum of two years of experience in a facilities department is preferred.
  • High school education or general education degree (GED) preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Excellent problem-solving and basic math skills.
  • Must be familiar with building codes and maintenance trades.
  • Must have familiarity with OSHA requirements applicable facility-wide and have experience with safety programs.
  • Must be able to operate and have a solid understanding of all material handling equipment.
  • Excellent people skills. Must be able to work well and constantly communicate (both written and verbally).
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must have solid organizational and computer skills, including good working knowledge of general software programs.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Clearwater, Florida, is one of the crown jewels of the Tampa Bay region, offering a lifestyle that blends coastal beauty with big-city convenience. The city is home to Clearwater Beach, consistently ranked among the best beaches in the United States, where sugar-white sand, sparkling Gulf waters, and legendary sunsets make every day feel like a vacation. Year-round warm weather means outdoor adventures are always on the agenda, from kayaking and paddleboarding to waterfront dining along the Coachman Park promenade.


Beyond the beach, the Greater Tampa Bay area gives residents access to world-class sports with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Rays, Lightning, and Rowdies all calling the region home. The area also boasts a thriving arts scene, with the Clearwater Marine Aquarium, the Capitol Theatre, and proximity to Tampa's Hyde Park Village and Ybor City historic district offering something for everyone. With a diverse culinary scene, strong job market, and no state income tax, Clearwater and the Tampa Bay region deliver an outstanding quality of life for those who put down roots here.

job.title: Executive Reporter, WGBA
job.description:
Are you a storytelling visionary ready to shape the future of journalism in Northeastern Wisconsin? WGBA, The E.W. Scripps Company NBC affiliate in Green Bay, Wisconsin, is seeking an innovative and creative Executive Reporter to lead our mission, enhance storytelling, and inspire our newsroom team. This role offers the unique opportunity to provide expertise and passion for telling stories that impact our communities while mentoring talent at all levels to find creative ways to grow their skills. The role includes managing the 24-hour stream and ensuring it runs properly withe latest content at all times. The right person will also be producing content for our 24-hour stream and linear shows, as well as writing, editing, and publishing web content and social media posts.

This role requires weekend and late news shift.

We mainly seek former or current Multimedia Journalists, or Anchor/Reporters looking to move into a Management position. Scripps is a company that values internal mobility.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Manage the 24-hour stream and ensure it runs with the latest content at all times.
  • Create content for the stream and linear shows and publish content to the web and social media.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling.
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers, and newsroom staff.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience.
  • Generally, 4+ years of experience in related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling.
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics, and libel laws.
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state, and world we report on daily.
  • Deep understanding of the content strategy.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits

job.title: Director, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!


o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.


o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.


o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.


o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.


o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 


o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.


o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.


o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 


o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.


o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.


The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 


Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.


o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.


o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)


o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.


AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions.

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Bristol, VA. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery.
  • Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times.
  • Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios.
  • Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers.
  • Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to:
  • SOM/EOM of segments
  • Database Information
  • Audio specifications
  • Video specifications
  • Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion)
  • Content
  • Closed Captioning
  • Active Format Descriptor.
  • Ensure proper video routing.
  • Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout.
  • Monitor equipment for performance / device failures.
  • Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies.
  • Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime.
  • Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and follow departmental policies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 Year experience in Master Control Operations functions.
  • Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS)
  • Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously.
  • General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team.
  • Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications.
  • Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution.
  • Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS)  
  • Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

 

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $16.75 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

Tu rol será clave para revisar y validar información relacionada con tiempo extra, elaborar cierres de prenómina, gestionar pagos únicos y realizar actividades administrativas vinculadas con finiquitos, PTU y FONACOT. 

Además, contribuirás al correcto registro y control de la información, asegurando la confidencialidad de los datos de los colaboradores y apoyando la mejora continua de los procesos administrativos. 

 

Tu día a día incluirá: 

 

  • Recibir, revisar y validar los reportes semanales de incidencias de tiempo extra. 
  • Elaborar los cierres quincenales de prenómina, asegurando la correcta integración de las incidencias. 
  • Validar y dar seguimiento a los pagos únicos correspondientes a los colaboradores. 
  • Realizar la reclasificación contable del gasto relacionado con incidencias de nómina. 
  • Gestionar y enviar las incidencias correspondientes al proceso de finiquitos. 
  • Elaborar cartas de FONACOT y dar seguimiento a los requerimientos relacionados. 
  • Coordinar la entrega de cheques correspondientes al reparto de utilidades (PTU). 
  • Atender a colaboradores y áreas internas respecto a dudas, aclaraciones y requerimientos administrativos. 
  • Elaborar reportes, indicadores y análisis de datos que permitan dar seguimiento a los procesos del área. 
  • Asegurar el correcto control y seguimiento de la información administrativa y de nómina. 
  • Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos administrativos para incrementar la eficiencia operativa. 
  • Garantizar el manejo responsable y confidencial de la información de los colaboradores. 

 

Tú deberías tener  

Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Contaduría o carrera afín. 

Experiencia: 

 

  • 4 años de experiencia en administración de personal, nómina o procesos administrativos relacionados. 
  • Experiencia en gestión y control de incidencias de nómina. 
  • Experiencia en elaboración de reportes y análisis de información administrativa.

job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Senior Data Analyst - Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics Job ID 10163175 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 05, 2026 Senior Data Analyst - Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements SUMMARY The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's direct-to-consumer product strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences. You will play a key role in building out ESPN's product analytics function from the ground up, serving as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for the ESPN product and product engineering teams. You will lead the foundational work streams for ESPN app measurement: standing up a governed, centralized source of truth for ESPN app performance metrics — canonical definitions, consistent logic, and numbers the business can align on — and building the self-serve tooling that lets stakeholders not only see that a KPI moved, but locate what drove the movement. You will also be the experimentation partner to the product organization, shaping how ESPN app features are tested and how those results are read. This role is hands-on and technical. You will design and maintain the aggregation logic and metric tables that sit underneath executive reporting, and you will be expected to defend the numbers you publish — including the measurement caveats that travel with them. RESPONSIBILITIES • Own and evolve the source-of-truth metric layer for ESPN app performance — headline KPIs (DAU, time spent, watch minutes), their definitions, their dimensional breakouts, and the documented caveats that accompany each • Design and maintain pre-aggregated metric tables and serving views in Snowflake, and the scheduled pipelines that refresh them, ensuring metrics are correct at every level of aggregation • Build the monitoring and decomposition logic that identifies when a KPI movement is real and where it is concentrated — baselines, significance thresholds, contribution ranking, and volume-versus-mix splits • Distinguish genuine behavioral movements from measurement artifacts and instrumentation breakage, and partner with product engineering to close the analytics QA gap on client releases • Build dashboards and self-serve tooling in Looker that reduce stakeholder reliance on ad-hoc analyst pulls • Conduct analyses using SQL and Python to access and manipulate multivariate product and behavioral data, and ideate new metrics and analytical approaches for in-app user behavior • Partner with product and engineering on experimentation end-to-end — translating a product question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat • Reconcile ESPN app metrics across teams and systems, and drive alignment on definitions with Research, Data Product, and data engineering partners • Serve as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for ESPN product and product engineering teams, taking projects end-to-end from vague business need to socialized insight • Communicate results through compelling data storytelling to product leadership and the broader ESPN business BASIC QUALIFICATIONS • Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience • 5+ years of relevant work experience in analytics, product analytics, and/or business intelligence • Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries, and to reason about correctness of aggregation logic (for example, why a distinct-count metric cannot be summed across segments) • Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and pipeline work • Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling — how metric tables are structured, refreshed, and served to downstream consumers • Applied statistical judgment: constructing baselines, assessing whether a change is meaningful versus noise, and handling seasonality and day-of-week effects • Hands-on product experimentation experience — designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences • Experience taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products • Strong and effective communication and presentation skills PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Hands-on experience with digital clickstream or behavioral analytics data (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), including its identity and measurement limitations • Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing • Experience establishing metric governance — canonical definitions, reconciliation across teams, and change management on metric logic • Experience with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with scaling experimentation practice across product teams • Familiarity with identity resolution across web, app, and connected TV, and the practical consequences of cookie-based measurement • Prior experience in Sports or Media/Entertainment #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $124,900 - $167,400 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Manager, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
FOX Entertainment Global (FEG) is FOX Entertainment's centralized content sales division, providing the worldwide multi-platform marketplace with exclusive access to its diverse, rapidly expanding production pipeline and library of owned original programming and co-production partnerships. A central component of FOX Entertainment's long-term growth strategy is to fortify its globally recognized, world-class brand and owned distribution platforms spanning broadcast and streaming with FOX Entertainment Global's singular focus on broadly distributing the company's full portfolio of owned intellectual property across all genres of scripted, unscripted, and animated programming, including both film and television titles.

FOX Entertainment is seeking a Manager, Business & Legal Affairs to serve as a hands-on attorney supporting FEG.  

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Draft, review, and negotiate various agreements as assigned, across all media windows (Network, Pay Cable, Pay TV, FAST, AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, EST, and digital platforms), possibly including distribution agreements, tape license agreements, format license agreements, amendments, non-disclosure agreements, etc.
  • Conduct detailed contract analysis and rights research to confirm underlying rights, holdbacks, exclusivity, windowing, territorial restrictions to prevent rights conflicts
  • Field day-to-day legal inquiries from internal stakeholders (Sales, Deal & Rights Management, Marketing, Digital, Publicity) and legal team
  • Compile, manage, interpret and synthesize advertising & edit restrictions and disseminate to Operations for exploitation of programming
  • Maintain accuracy of deal tracker and ensure agreements are being assigned and processed in a timely manner
  • Handle general corporate issues as assigned and support the legal with any special projects that may arise from time-to-times

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and active bar admission in good standing (California Bar or Registered In-House Counsel preferred)
  • 2+ years of attorney experience in entertainment transactional law, preferably within a television studio, network, media distributor, streaming platform, or entertainment law firm
  • Equal proficiency in contract drafting and rights research, with demonstrated experience reviewing license agreements, and distribution terms
  • High precision and attention to detail when analyzing contracts, including specific language, rights, holdbacks, exclusivity, etc.
  • Working knowledge of media distribution
  • Excellent time management and self-motivation, with a proven ability to prioritize assignments and manage a high volume of active deals in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally across all levels of personnel and cross-functional departments

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Hands-on experience navigating rights management systems and databases (e.g., Rightsline, Salesforce)

job.title: Platform Ops & Delivery (Sr. SDET)
job.description:
La plataforma directa al consumidor (DTC) de FOX es una iniciativa nueva y visionaria dentro de Tubi Media Group que lleva el incomparable portafolio de contenido de FOX —noticias, deportes y entretenimiento— directamente a los consumidores a través de un innovador servicio de streaming por suscripción.

Impulsado por un equipo de liderazgo altamente experimentado, con trayectorias en la intersección de los medios, la tecnología, el streaming y el contenido, y respaldado plenamente por Fox Corporation, este proyecto combina energía emprendedora con un profundo conocimiento de la industria de los medios.

Nuestra visión es crear una experiencia de visualización unificada y moderna que ponga al consumidor en primer lugar, integrando de forma fluida el contenido en vivo y bajo demanda en todas las plataformas.

En la intersección entre la tecnología de vanguardia y la narrativa de confianza, esta es una oportunidad para dar forma al futuro del streaming en uno de los momentos más decisivos de la industria de los medios. Estamos formando un equipo de clase mundial para cumplir esa visión, y apenas estamos comenzando.

FOX ONE es la aplicación de streaming directa al consumidor de FOX Corporation, ya activa y en operación en Estados Unidos. FOX ONE se está expandiendo ahora a América Latina, y buscamos a un(a) Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) con base en la Ciudad de México para liderar la ingeniería de calidad de esa expansión. Este es un rol de ingeniería altamente técnico y práctico, para alguien que ve la calidad como una disciplina central de la ingeniería y que pueda definir cómo se construye, prueba, lanza y monitorea la versión de FOX ONE para LATAM.

Como Sr. SDET, colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de Producto, Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery desde las primeras etapas de planeación hasta producción. Te asegurarás de que la calidad se diseñe dentro del trabajo de expansión a LATAM, en lugar de validarse al final. Al comprender el producto actual de FOX ONE, los requisitos del mercado de LATAM y la arquitectura de la plataforma, identificarás riesgos de forma proactiva, definirás estrategias de pruebas y construirás capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades para la región.

Extenderás la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad ya existente de FOX ONE para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM, adaptando los frameworks y las herramientas construidas para el producto de EE. UU. de modo que funcionen de forma confiable en los distintos idiomas, monedas, dispositivos y entornos regulatorios de México. Este rol requiere un fuerte criterio técnico e implementación práctica, junto con una colaboración cercana con el equipo de plataforma de EE. UU. para decidir qué se debe reutilizar y qué se debe reconstruir para la región.

El candidato o candidata ideal combina sólidas habilidades de ingeniería de software, experiencia consolidada en automatización de pruebas, una mentalidad orientada al producto y un enfoque “AI-first” hacia las pruebas y la ingeniería. Te sientes cómodo(a) cuestionando supuestos, contribuyendo a la dirección técnica y generando resultados de calidad dentro de tu equipo y de los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca, a medida que FOX ONE se expande a un nuevo mercado. Y lo más importante: entiendes que la calidad va más allá de las pruebas previas al lanzamiento y requiere una validación continua de la experiencia del cliente a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del producto.

  • Colaborar con los Product Managers y los equipos de Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery durante las fases de descubrimiento, planeación y diseño, para identificar desde el inicio los requisitos de calidad y los riesgos.
  • Traducir los requisitos de producto, los objetivos de negocio y los recorridos del cliente en estrategias de pruebas escalables y frameworks de validación automatizada.
  • Construir frameworks de pruebas, herramientas y capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades, para garantizar la preparación para el lanzamiento.
  • Definir quality gates, criterios de lanzamiento y estándares de preparación para el lanzamiento de tu(s) área(s) de producto dentro de FOX ONE.
  • Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de pruebas end-to-end que validen la experiencia del cliente en web, móvil, TV conectada, servicios backend, APIs e integraciones de plataforma.
  • Contribuir a la estrategia de pruebas de las capacidades de plataforma usadas por tu equipo y por los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca.
  • Desarrollar capacidades automatizadas de generación de datos de prueba, configuración de entornos y orquestación que den soporte a pruebas continuas a gran escala.
  • Crear suites de regresión automatizadas que validen de forma continua los recorridos críticos del usuario en todos los clientes y plataformas soportados.
  • Construir validación automatizada para experiencias complejas como Multiview, autenticación, derechos de acceso (entitlement), suscripción, comercio, descubrimiento de contenido, reproducción y flujos de transmisión en vivo.
  • Asegurar que Multiview y otras capacidades de la plataforma se prueben automáticamente en todos los dispositivos, configuraciones, tipos de contenido y escenarios de reproducción soportados.
  • Validar de forma continua los recorridos del cliente antes y después de cada lanzamiento, para asegurar que la experiencia en producción se mantenga estable, confiable y con buen desempeño.
  • Extender la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad, los frameworks de pruebas y las capacidades de automatización ya existentes de FOX ONE, para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM.

  • Aprovechar herramientas y flujos de trabajo impulsados por IA para mejorar la generación de pruebas, la cobertura de automatización, el análisis de defectos, el mantenimiento y la productividad de ingeniería.

job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a creative and highly organized Sales Marketing Presentation Designer to support our Sales and Marketing teams. This person will develop compelling, visually engaging presentations and sales materials that help communicate the value of our creators, content, audience, and advertising solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with an understanding of sales storytelling. They will be able to take complex information, data, and ideas and turn them into clear, polished, and persuasive materials for advertisers, agencies, partners, and internal stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and develop high-quality sales presentations, pitch decks, RFP responses, media kits, one-sheets, case studies, and other marketing materials.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Programming teams to understand business objectives and translate them into effective visual stories.
  • Create customized presentations for advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners.
  • Organize complex information, audience data, campaign results, and advertising solutions into clear and compelling presentations.
  • Develop layouts, graphics, charts, infographics, and other visual assets that enhance the sales narrative.
  • Maintain consistency across RSV’s brand, creator, show, and advertising materials.
  • Help build and maintain presentation templates, sales collateral libraries, and design standards.
  • Review materials for accuracy, grammar, formatting, and brand consistency before distribution.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Incorporate feedback from multiple stakeholders while maintaining strong design judgment and attention to detail.
  • Stay current on presentation design trends, advertising formats, media industry developments, and emerging tools.
  • Support special projects, events, and other marketing initiatives as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–5 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, sales enablement, marketing design, or a related field.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design, storytelling, information design, and visual communication.
  • Advanced experience with PowerPoint and/or Google Slides.
  • Experience with design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to turn complex information and data into simple, understandable visuals.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at the same time.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in media, advertising, podcasting, creators, and digital content.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting a media, advertising, sales, entertainment, or technology organization.
  • Experience creating materials for advertisers, agencies, or brand partners.
  • Familiarity with media measurement, audience insights, advertising terminology, and campaign reporting.
  • Experience designing materials for live presentations and executive meetings including senior leadership offsites, financial planning, and revenue operations discussion..
  • Basic knowledge of motion graphics, video editing, or interactive presentation tools.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up or high-growth environment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Sales teams have polished, persuasive, and on-brand materials that help them win business.
  • Presentations clearly communicate the value of RSV’s creators, content, audiences, and advertising solutions.
  • Materials are delivered accurately and on time, even when priorities shift.
  • Sales and Marketing teams have organized, reusable templates and collateral.
  • Complex information is presented in a way that is easy for clients and partners to understand.
  • The RSV brand is represented consistently across all sales and marketing materials.

  • Familiarity with podcast advertising formats, including host-read sponsorships and dynamically inserted ads.

NBCUniversal’s Intellectual Property Analytics, Operations, and Technology (IPAOT) team supports NBCUniversal’s content globally with four key areas: (1) developing more secure and scalable frameworks for Internet-based video distribution, (2) improving security technologies and processes in content production and distribution, (3) addressing voluminous copyright infringements on websites, apps and protocols, and (4) analyzing data to measure and understand the drivers of unlicensed video consumption on the Internet.

The IPAOT team at NBCUniversal is looking for a passionate and curious Jr. Software Engineer to help design, build, and maintain applications supporting content protection, investigations, analytics, and security. This role will have a particular focus on expanding the use of artificial intelligence and large language models (LLMs) across the team's application portfolio, identifying opportunities to enhance existing workflows and develop new AI-powered capabilities.

Reporting to the Manager, Product and Emerging Technology, the Jr. Software Engineer is a fast-paced role with opportunities to work across traditional software engineering, generative AI, emerging technologies, and content protection.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance AI-powered features across the team’s applications using large language models and other AI technologies.
  • Build LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows using model APIs, retrieval technologies, and supporting frameworks.
  • Integrate AI models and services into existing applications based on defined requirements
  • Develop and refine prompts, system instructions, and model interactions to improve application performance and reliability
  • Build integrations with internal systems, tools, and data sources using APIs, MCPs, and other technologies
  • Support monitoring, testing, and evaluation of AI-powered features.
  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate requirements into working features and improvements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 1 + years of professional software development experience, including experience developing and delivering software to production.
  • Programming experience with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience developing modern web applications and backend APIs using frameworks such as Next.js, FastAPI, or comparable technologies.
  • Hands-on experience developing applications or features using large language models through APIs.
  • Experience integrating APIs, backend services, and third-party systems.
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
  • Familiarity with modern software development practices including source control, testing, debugging, and code review.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Experience building LLM-powered workflows using LangChain or similar frameworks
  • Familiarity with multiple LLM providers and model platforms such as OpenRouter.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, or semantic search.
  • Experience developing cloud-based applications, preferably using AWS.
  • Familiarity with video technologies, streaming media, content protection, cybersecurity, or digital rights management.
  • Interest in emerging AI technologies and their practical application in software development.

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Product Manager, Enterprise Data & AI will be part of our Enterprise Data + AI Product organization and will help turn business problems into products, solutions and experiences that create measurable value across NBCUniversal. 

This is a hands-on product builder role at the intersection of business, product, data and AI. The Product Manager will work directly with business and product teams to understand how they work, uncover meaningful problems and opportunities, connect those needs to our enterprise capabilities, and help move ideas from discovery through validation and adoption. 

The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment with business curiosity, technical fluency and a bias toward action. You should be equally comfortable talking with a business stakeholder, understanding how a data or AI capability works, shaping a use case, building or prototyping a solution with modern tools, developing a clear product story and determining whether the resulting experience is creating value. 

This is not a traditional Product Manager role centered solely on managing a feature backlog. It is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, operates with high ownership and uses technology… particularly AI, to shorten the distance between an idea and a meaningful business outcome. 

What you will own (day-to-day): 

  • Business discovery and stakeholder engagement to identify meaningful problems, opportunities and use cases 
  • Translation of business needs into clear product opportunities, hypotheses, outcomes and success measures 
  • Rapid prototyping and experimentation to make ideas tangible and accelerate learning 
  • Product positioning, demos, enablement and other go-to-market motions that drive understanding and adoption 
  • Voice of the Customer and product feedback loops that inform future priorities 
  • Adoption and business-value measurement for priority initiatives 
  • Clear communication between business, Product, Data, Engineering and AI teams 
  • AI-enabled ways of working that increase speed, quality and individual leverage 

Responsibilities: 

  • Business Discovery & Use-Case Development: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across the enterprise, understand their workflows and proactively uncover problems, opportunities and unmet needs — including needs that may not initially be well articulated. 
  • Product Opportunity Development: Translate stakeholder needs into clear use cases, product opportunities, hypotheses and measurable outcomes; connect those opportunities to existing enterprise products and capabilities whenever possible. 
  • Build, Prototype & Validate: Use modern AI-assisted development, prototyping and workflow tools to rapidly bring ideas to life, test assumptions and create tangible experiences that accelerate learning and decision-making. 
  • Product Adoption & Enablement: Develop the positioning, demonstrations, enablement materials and engagement motions necessary to help stakeholders understand, adopt and successfully use enterprise products and capabilities. 
  • Voice of the Customer & Feedback Loops: Establish structured feedback loops using stakeholder input, qualitative insights, usage signals and business outcomes to identify friction, unmet needs and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Data & Success Measurement: Define and track appropriate measures of adoption, engagement and business value; use quantitative and qualitative data to tell a clear story and drive decisions. 
  • Product Strategy Partnership: Bring business, customer and adoption signal back to Product Managers and product leaders to help inform roadmap priorities, investment decisions and future portfolio direction. 
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner across Product Management, Product Operations, Engineering, Data, AI and business teams to determine the right path from opportunity to scalable solution without relying on formal authority. 
  • Translate Complexity into Clarity: Make sophisticated data, technology and AI capabilities understandable and actionable through clear product narratives, demos, executive-ready materials and reusable enablement assets. 
  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Apply AI throughout discovery, research, analysis, prototyping, documentation and workflow automation, while continually identifying new opportunities to increase organizational leverage and self-service. 

Primary Stakeholders: 

  • Product Managers and Product Operations teams across Enterprise Data + AI 
  • Engineering, Data and AI product teams 
  • Business teams that consume enterprise data, technology and AI products, including Marketing, Advertising, Analytics and other enterprise functions 
  • Executive leadership and business partners evaluating new capabilities and opportunities 
  • External technology partners and vendors, where appropriate 

Requirements:  

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, technical Product Marketing, MarTech/AdTech, Solutions, Data/AI products, customer-facing technology or a related product and technology discipline. 
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer or business problem from discovery through a clear product opportunity, solution or measurable outcome. 
  • Strong product judgment and customer-discovery skills, including the ability to challenge a stated request and uncover the underlying business need. 
  • Strong data fluency and comfort working with analytics, metrics, data products and technical concepts. 
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development, prototyping or automation tools to turn ideas into working prototypes, workflows or other tangible solutions. 
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling and actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills with demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority. 
  • Proven ability to operate independently, create structure from ambiguity and drive work from problem through outcome with minimal oversight. 
  • Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, MarTech, AdTech, identity, CRM, analytics, AI platforms or other data-intensive product environments. 
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot strongly preferred; experience with Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI development environments is also valuable. 
  • Experience building prototypes, lightweight applications, automations or agentic workflows without relying exclusively on an Engineering team. 
  • Experience developing product positioning, go-to-market strategies, demonstrations, enablement or adoption programs for technical products. 
  • Experience establishing Voice of the Customer, customer-success, product usage or adoption feedback loops. 
  • Familiarity with modern product and collaboration tools such as GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Figma and analytics/BI platforms. 
  • Builder mentality with a bias toward experimentation, learning and tangible outcomes over process for process’s sake. 
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to rapidly learn unfamiliar business and technical domains. 
  • Strong ownership mindset and follow-through; proactive driver who identifies gaps and moves work forward without waiting for perfect clarity. 
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution — from senior-level business conversations to hands-on building and problem solving. 

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

As Learning Experience Designer within the Leadership Capability & Learning COE, you are the team’s primary design expert responsible for translating strategic capability priorities into high-quality, engaging, and effective development experiences (e-learning, instructor-led training, etc.). You create solutions that are modern, immersive, and genuinely impactful. Where others see a slide deck, you see an opportunity for a simulation. Where others see a workshop, you see a multi-modal experience that extends into the flow of work. Where others see a leadership program, you see a design challenge. 
You work in close partnership with the Sr. Manager, Leadership Capability, who sets the strategic design direction – diagnosing capability gaps and defining what behavior change needs to happen. Your role is to bring that direction to life with craft, creativity, a deep understanding of how adults learn, and a strong point of view on the tools, technologies, and emerging practices that can make learning more effective. You operate with significant creative autonomy within that partnership, bringing your own ideas, pushing the boundaries of what development experiences can be, and continuously raising the bar for what great looks like. 
Beyond individual experiences, you are also the visual and design standard-bearer for the COE. You own how this function presents itself to leaders, the business, and the broader organization. That means owning the COE's visual design standards and templates so that every deliverable that comes out of this function looks and feels like it belongs to the same world. 

Major Responsibilities
Design & Build Immersive Learning Experiences 

  • Design and build simulations, scenario-based experiences, experiential labs, and immersive learning environments that put leaders in realistic situations and require them to make real decisions. 
  • Develop engaging, high-quality e-learning and digital learning assets that extend development into the flow of work, not just for formal learning moments but for the spaces in between. 
  • Translate the defined capability priorities and design direction into concrete learning experiences, bringing creative solutions to the build. 
  • Prototype rapidly, pilot with real learners, gather feedback, and iterate, always optimizing for behavior change over production polish. 
  • Build a reusable library of design assets, templates, and components that accelerate future work and ensure design consistency across the COE's portfolio. 

Set & Own Visual Design Standards 

  • Establish and maintain visual design standards for the Leadership Capability & Learning COE – defining the look, feel, and quality bar for all deliverables including program materials, participant guides, presentations, and digital assets. 
  • Build a template library that is practical, flexible, and easy for others to use so that design standards get maintained even when you are not the one producing the output. 
  • Bring visual storytelling expertise to the design of leadership experiences, ensuring that the narrative arc of every program, module, and asset is as intentional as its instructional design. 
  • Translate complex leadership concepts, capability frameworks, and development models into visuals that are immediately legible to a theme park operations leader as much as to an HR professional. 
  • Elevate the quality of how the COE communicates its strategy, impact, and value through decks, one-pagers, infographics, and other visual communication formats.

Own Learning Technology & Innovation 

  • Own all internal instructional design and learning production tools – selecting, managing, and maintaining proficiency in the technologies that power the COE's design work. 
  • Actively monitor and experiment with emerging learning technologies including AI-powered development tools, immersive and simulation platforms, adaptive learning technologies, and other innovations reshaping how people develop. 
  • Bring a point of view on what the COE should be doing differently based on what you are seeing in the field – not just executing on existing ideas but challenging the standard. 
  • Partner with Learning Operations on any technology decisions that intersect with leader-facing platforms, ensuring alignment on sustainability, budget, and operational support. 
  • Integrate AI meaningfully into design and delivery – not as a gimmick but as a genuine capability enabler that makes development more personalized, more scalable, and more effective.

Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.

Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – CBS Sports Digital

Req: 45930 | Department: CBS Sports.com Technology | Type: Full-Time, On-Site Locations: Nashville, TN; Louisville, KY; Fort Lauderdale, FL

 

 

 

About the Role

Join CBS Sports Digital and help build the web experiences that millions of sports fans use every day across CBSSports.com and our apps. We are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer to join our Content Management team, a small engineering group that partners closely with design and product to turn ideas into fast, accessible, production-grade fan experiences.

 

You will own the quality of what fans see and feel: how fast pages load, how components behave, and how reliably we ship. Candidates with Lead-level scope are also encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

  • Build Front-End Features: Design and ship production-grade features for web using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, from prototype through launch.

  • Own Performance: Improve and protect Core Web Vitals through rendering strategy, code splitting, lazy loading, and image and asset optimization.

  • Contribute to Standards: Build and evolve reusable components and shared patterns that scale across the organization.

  • Collaborate and Prototype: Work with design and product to quickly design, develop, and test solutions to key business challenges.

  • Raise the Bar on Code Quality: Review code for style, testability, accessibility, and efficiency, and mentor engineers on front-end best practices.

  • Type Safety: Contribute to TypeScript standards (strict mode, shared types, codegen) so our codebases stay maintainable and refactor-safe.

  • Monorepo Workflows: Use and contribute to monorepo tooling (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web applications.

  • Operational Excellence: Build with reliability in mind, including testing, front-end monitoring, and alerting.

  • Document: Contribute clear documentation and diagrams to help onboard other engineers.

  • Use AI Tools: Use AI development tools to speed up your workflow and share what works with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications with React and Next.js.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and modern ES6+ features.

  • Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).

  • Experience consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
 
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.  If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! 
 
In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking and you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.  

 

 

We now have an opportunity for a junior video editor to join our team at Paramount and Network 10 based in Pyrmont. 

 ** this role is permanent full-time, and you must be available to work a 7-day rotating roster.

 

Enough about us! What you’ll do as a Video Editor:

 

You’ll combine your creative flair and technical skills to produce broadcast-quality video content for News, Programming and Production across both linear and digital platforms.

 

Day-to-day, you’ll support our fast-paced News operations, predominantly reformatting international content and editing assets for 10 News programs, while also gaining exposure to a diverse mix of projects and productions.

 

Working with state-of-the-art editing tools in a supportive, high-morale team, you’ll have the chance to expand your skills, collaborate across business units, and engage in storytelling that informs and inspires.   This is a place where variety is the norm, teamwork is strong, and learning opportunities are everywhere!

  

Functions will include:  

  • Manage the ingest, asset management, quality control, distribution, and receipt of News media assets across the network, affiliates, and third parties
  • Edit and deliver high-quality media content for News, Programming and Production using Avid Media Composer and other NLE tools
  • Prepare, QC, and adapt broadcast programs to meet technical and compliance standards across free-to-air, catch-up, and streaming platforms
  • Operate studio EVS systems (IP-Director, LSM-VIA and X-File) to support live studio productions, archive, and restore media assets
  • Contribute to pre-production and creative editing processes, ensuring all content is delivered accurately, on time, and to broadcast-ready standards.

 

What are we looking for in a Video Editor? What’s important?   

  • Proven experience with non-linear editing systems (preferably Avid Media Composer) and technical literacy across video production workflows
  • Ability to thrive under tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail, accuracy, and editorial integrity in a fast-paced news production environment
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a customer-focused approach and the ability to build positive relationships across teams
  • Creative mindset with a genuine interest in storytelling and crafting engaging content, alongside adaptability to reformat, edit, and deliver content for multiple platforms
  • A motivated self-starter who embraces new technology, works proactively, and is flexible to work a 7-day rotating roster with early and late shiftbands.

More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

The Associated Press seeks a Consumer Product Strategist for AP News based in New York City. We are a hybrid environment, with employees on site Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.  

  

About the Role  

As a Consumer Product Strategist, you will help AP News better understand its audience and use those insights to shape the future of our digital products and user experience. You will look beyond the numbers to uncover the story of how users discover, experience and engage across web and app platforms, turning those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, experimentation and long-term growth.

Job Description:


About the Team: This role offers direct exposure to a transforming, AI-enabled Finance organization, a broad view across Finance Operations workflows, and the opportunity to shape a leaner, more automated control environment at one of the world's most trusted business-information companies.


About the Role

As a key member of the Internal Audit team, the Internal Controls Optimization Lead supports the evaluation, streamlining, and enhancement of the organization's internal control environment, with the goal of reducing compliance cost while maintaining the effectiveness of risk management. The role spans traditional control frameworks and automated, machine-learning-enabled systems, and contributes to business process improvement initiatives and related projects across Finance Operations. The Lead supports ongoing compliance monitoring and drives the resolution of internal control inquiries and enhancements. A defining feature of the role is pace: the successful candidate will evaluate and integrate fast-changing knowledge and audit tooling — including AI-driven capabilities — into internal processes and controls, and communicate effectively with stakeholders across departments as the Finance organization evolves. You will report to the Intnl Controls/Compliance Manager and be based in our New Jersey office.


You Will:

  • Lead and/or engage in business process improvement initiatives and projects as assigned, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate controls.

  • Independently research and bring to resolution general compliance issues as they arise, escalating appropriately.
