job.title: Manager, Software Development, iOS Mobile App
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a Manager, Software Development to lead the engineering team responsible for our iOS app, the foundation for personalization, ads, sections, articles, App Store subscription management, analytics, audio, video and more, and one of The Post’s most important channels for reader engagement. This role provides dedicated people and delivery leadership for the team while partnering closely with Android, Staff Engineering, Product, and shared engineering teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences quickly and predictably.


This is a hands-on engineering management role. The Manager, Software Development will set priorities and assignments, develop engineers, remove blockers, identify delivery risks early, and establish clear accountability for delivering approved work to readers, while remaining close enough to the technology to guide difficult engineering decisions. The manager is expected to write code, build prototypes, and review pull requests on a regular basis, and will partner with Staff Engineers and feature leads to verify progress, identify misalignment, and follow work through to release.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep iOS engineering knowledge, sound technical judgment, and a disciplined approach to execution. This manager will help the team ship faster while maintaining the architecture, performance, reliability, quality, and technical health readers expect from The Washington Post’s flagship mobile experience. The role is data-driven: priorities, estimates, improvements, and results are tracked against agreed baselines and measured by evidence, such as time to users, commitments met, blocker resolution time, and app stability and performance, not by activity or opinion.


What Motivates You

  • You want to help bring The Washington Post’s journalism to readers through high-quality mobile experiences.
  • You measure success by the value delivered to users and how quickly it reaches them.
  • You develop engineers through direct feedback and clear expectations, and you judge your impact by their growth.
  • You care about predictable execution. You know the real remaining work, test whether estimates and status reports are credible, and surface risk before it becomes a missed commitment.
  • You want to stay technically hands-on, writing code, prototyping, and reviewing pull requests to solve problems, evaluate approaches, and stay connected to the systems your team builds.
  • You care deeply about mobile architecture, application quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • You enjoy removing blockers and working across engineering and product teams to move complex work forward, while leaving ownership with the people who hold it.
  • You hold yourself to the standard you set for others: you own your commitments, communicate risk early, and confirm that issues are closed.
  • You look for wasted effort and ways to improve how teams work, and you measure whether those improvements create value.
  • You enjoy building AI agents and automation that solve real mobile engineering problems, and you care about proving that they work and that people actually use them.
  • You stay current on the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple platform releases, Swift language and concurrency changes, and AI-assisted development in Xcode, and you know which changes are worth adopting and when.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead and develop the software engineers responsible for The Washington Post’s iOS app, providing timely feedback, career development, performance management, and coaching that builds independent ownership and accountability.
  • Establish priorities and assignments, set delivery baselines, and track progress against estimates through to availability for users. Report on measures such as time to users, commitments met by the agreed date, and blocker resolution time, and surface material delivery risks early with clear facts, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.
  • Address performance concerns promptly and directly, set clear expectations, and confirm that behavior and results improve.
  • Partner with the Android Manager, Staff Engineers, Product, feature leads, and shared teams to sequence work, resolve dependencies and blockers, and keep mobile initiatives aligned without taking over others’ ownership.
  • Provide technical leadership across iOS architecture and development in partnership with Staff Engineers, helping the team make sound decisions on application design, performance, testing, maintainability, and platform best practices across Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Objective-C, and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
  • Track changes in the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple OS releases and design updates, Swift and Swift Concurrency evolution, and agentic and AI-assisted tooling in Xcode, and turn them into clear recommendations on what the team should adopt, when, and at what cost.
  • Stay hands-on by writing code, building prototypes, and reviewing pull requests to solve technical problems, evaluate approaches, and set the quality bar for the team.
  • Establish and reinforce engineering practices that support robust testing, code quality, application performance, reliable releases, and the long-term health of the iOS platform.
  • Identify bottlenecks, unnecessary work, technical debt, and opportunities to improve engineering processes and productivity, setting a baseline before each change and measuring the benefit afterward against its cost, rework, and any regressions.
  • Partner with Product and engineering leadership to balance reader experience, business priorities, delivery commitments, and long-term technical health.
  • Build and roll out AI agents and automation that solve iOS and mobile engineering problems, including crash and issue triage, test generation, code review assistance, release workflows, estimation, and detection of stalled work. Verify their output, keep human accountability for decisions, and measure whether they remove delay and effort or only move it.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional native iOS development experience with the iOS SDK, including Swift and modern iOS tools and frameworks, and experience building and releasing production mobile applications.
  • Substantial experience writing production iOS code and designing app architecture, including modular design, concurrency, performance, and testable code, with the ability to review pull requests and architecture proposals at a senior level, evaluate tradeoffs, and diagnose and fix defects.
  • Experience directly managing software engineers, including coaching, career development, and performance management, with a record of timely, specific feedback and of coaching engineers toward independent ownership.
  • Experience leading complex engineering work from planning and estimation through implementation, testing, release, and production support, including setting priorities, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks, and revising forecasts as evidence changes.
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, version control, and software delivery practices for production mobile applications.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with experience partnering effectively with Product, senior technical contributors, other engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, including escalating material risks promptly.
  • Experience defining and using engineering metrics and delivery data, including baselines and targets, to identify bottlenecks, make decisions, and demonstrate improvement in team effectiveness.
  • Working knowledge of the current iOS platform, Swift, and Xcode tooling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience developing and releasing large-scale consumer iOS applications to the App Store.
  • Experience with modern iOS technologies such as SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, App Intents, Apple’s latest design system, on-device AI frameworks, or comparable technologies; familiarity with Objective-C and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Experience with mobile performance optimization, debugging, memory management, and application reliability.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs, third-party SDKs, or other services into native mobile applications.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for the full mobile application lifecycle, including architecture, development, automated testing, CI/CD, release, observability, and production support.
  • Experience coordinating engineering work across iOS, Android, backend, platform, or other shared technical teams.
  • Experience improving engineering productivity, delivery predictability, or development processes and measuring the impact of those improvements.
  • Experience mentoring engineers across career levels and partnering effectively with Staff-level or other senior technical contributors.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents or automation that solve real iOS or mobile engineering problems, with verification of the output and measured benefit.
  • Experience with agentic development workflows in Xcode and with connecting agents to engineering tools such as issue trackers, CI, crash reporting, and source control, for example through Model Context Protocol (MCP).

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$144,600 - $241,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

This position is responsible for assisting the department in marketing activities surrounding our releases including budget management, processing marketing department-related invoices, and routing of key marketing information. The position also provides other departmental support as needed (including booking travel, routing vendor contracts, and assisting with calendars and expenses).


How you’ll CREATE:

  • Support of product managers in the execution of marketing plans and strategy 
  • Submit and monitor art or video requests to completion for any marketing assets needed (invites, posters, pseudo videos, etc.) 
  • Create and update all one-sheets, timelines, quote sheets, and any other project-related documents

job.description:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Data Product Manager – Streaming & Social within the Global Data & Analytics Products team.

As AI transforms how artists are discovered, audiences are understood, and content performance is optimized; trusted consumption data becomes a strategic enterprise asset. In this role, you will ensure UMG's streaming and social data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume music consumption data at enterprise scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, documentation, prototyping, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable data-driven decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise data products and domain-specific data marts that serve as the authoritative source of truth for music consumption and streaming/social engagement across UMG. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent audience insights, artist development, repertoire strategy, marketing effectiveness, forecasting, and executive decision-making. By establishing trusted, governed, and semantically rich data products, you will help create the enterprise data foundation that enables AI-driven insights and intelligent decision-support across UMG.

You will partner closely with Global Insights, Commercial Strategy, Digital Business, Marketing, Label Analytics, Data Engineering, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring consumption & social data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

job.title: SVP, Global Supply Chain Transformation
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Your role:

We are seeking a world-class, execution-focused Senior Vice President (SVP) of Global Supply Chain Transformation to lead the comprehensive modernization of our physical operations. In this role, you will redefine the future-state of our physical operations—spanning global manufacturing partnerships, distribution hubs, e-commerce fulfillment, and inventory optimization—while spearheading the end-to-end implementation of a modern, enterprise-wide Supply Chain Management (SCM) system.


While our industry is music, prior music industry experience is not required. We are specifically seeking a sophisticated supply chain leader trained in best-in-class Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), retail, or high-volume manufacturing and shipping environments who can bring world-class operational discipline, predictive data modeling, and rigorous systems architecture to our global physical business.


Here you’ll be responsible for:

  • Operational Transformation: Evaluate, re-engineer, and optimize our global physical supply chain network , physical media, and merchandise) to improve speed-to-market, reduce fulfillment costs, and scale for massive demand spikes around global release cycles.
  • Systems Architecture & Rollout: Serve as the executive sponsor for the selection, design, and phased global implementation of an advanced enterprise SCM / ERP technology platform, moving the organization away from tech debt accumulated in  legacy, fragmented systems.
  • CPG-Style Rigor & Planning: Introduce sophisticated demand forecasting, sales and operations planning (S&OP), and inventory replenishment models tailored to a highly variable, hit-driven physical product lifecycle.
  • Change Management: Direct a comprehensive organizational change management strategy, ensuring corporate stakeholders, global territory leads, and physical warehouse operators successfully adopt new digital workflows and standardized processes.
  • 3PL & Vendor Optimization: Partner with operational leadership to create a framework enabling them to standardize and hold global third-party logistics (3PL) providers, manufacturers, and freight forwarders accountable to strict, data-driven SLAs
  • Executive Leadership: Partner closely with the C-suite, technology teams, and global business unit heads to integrate supply chain capabilities into the broader corporate data ecosystem.

About you:

  • 15+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience, with a proven track record as a VP or SVP managing large-scale physical logistics and distribution network footprints.
  • Deep operational, foundational experience within a premier CPG, retail, or fast-moving consumer goods environment 
  • Proven success as the business lead for a large-scale, global SCM or ERP system implementation (e.g., o9 solutions, SAP) from blueprinting through to post-go-live optimization.
  • Mastery of advanced demand planning, data-driven inventory optimization, and setting up rigorous KPIs across a complex, multi-region distribution network.
  • Exceptional cross-functional influence and communication skills; the ability to translate complex, rigid supply chain methodologies into agile strategies that support a creative, fast-paced industry.
  • A proven track record of delivery in a creative or similarly unpredictable environment, driven by high pressure or release date driven deadlines.

We’d love it if you also were:

  • Excellent communicator, and dedicated professional with strong organization skills
  • Goal Oriented - setting both short- and long-term goals for teams, motivating them towards high performance.
  • Relationship Builder - develops internal and external relationships globally to accomplish business and revenue goals.
  • Strong Leader who exhibits problem-solving skills to drive and motivate cross functional team members and major projects or initiatives.
  • Capable of establishing and maintaining excellent relationships with top level executives globally and decision-makers, continuously communicating priorities and exploring new opportunities to drive new revenue.
  • Commercially-minded, with sound and practical business judgment


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $225,000 to $275,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. We are seeking a meteorologist with strong forecasting and communication skills to join the AccuWeather Forecasting Team at our Global Headquarters in State College, Pennsylvania, beginning January or February 2027. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, curious, and passionate about helping people and businesses make the best weather-informed decisions. Our mission is to save lives, protect property, and help people plan with confidence. If you want to grow your career on a team that is committed to Superior Accuracy™, this opening is for you!

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Meteorologist I, you will prepare and communicate impact-driven forecasts that power AccuWeather’s app, website, and business solutions used by millions worldwide. These include:

· Prepare specialized weather forecasts and products for media outlets, business clients, and digital platforms.

· Collaborate with colleagues to evaluate data, discuss differing analyses, and reach consensus on predicted weather outcomes.

· Communicate complex weather scenarios clearly through verbal briefings, written products, and digital forecasts.

· Monitor new weather data, determine whether forecast adjustments are needed, and communicate updates to customers.

· Contribute to special projects such as quality assurance, process improvement, customer support, or research and development.

· Stay current on emerging forecasting tools, models, and techniques, and learn to use AI and machine learning to improve forecasting efficiency, and streamline product creation and dissemination.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Sciences, or equivalent education and experience.

· Eligibility for membership in the American Meteorological Society or National Weather Association.

· Proven forecasting skills across multiple regions or weather types.

· Ability to translate complex meteorological data into clear, accurate forecasts.

· Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills.

· Strong collaboration and leadership abilities in a team-based environment.

· Availability to work evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays.

· All levels of forecasting experience are encouraged to apply.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

 

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Vice President, General Counsel Corporate Finance and Securities
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

 

How you’ll make an impact:

The Vice President, General Counsel Corporate Finance and Securities will lead the corporate finance and securities legal function and provide executive-level oversight and strategic direction while advising on corporate finance, public company reporting, securities law compliance, and capital markets activities. This position will partner closely with Finance, External Reporting, Investor Relations, and senior leadership to support SEC reporting obligations, financial disclosures, financing transactions, and compliance with securities laws and stock exchange requirements. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in corporate finance, public company securities reporting, and complex financial transactions. The role is accountable for establishing functional priorities, directing legal risk management strategy, and aligning staffing, outside counsel resources, and execution with enterprise objectives.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the corporate finance and securities legal function, setting its strategy, multi-year priorities, operating standards, and measures of success in alignment with enterprise objectives.
  • Oversee and develop the function’s legal leaders and professionals, including performance management, succession planning, coaching, organizational effectiveness, and talent decisions.
  • Own the function’s resource plan and budget, including headcount planning, allocation of legal resources, external counsel spending, and disciplined financial stewardship.
  • Exercise executive decision-making authority over significant corporate finance and securities legal matters, setting escalation protocols and leading resolution of material legal and regulatory risks.
  • Lead functional change initiatives that strengthen disclosure governance, cross-functional operating processes, risk controls, and responsiveness to evolving regulatory and business needs.
  • Play a lead role in providing legal advice on corporate finance, securities matters, public company reporting, and capital markets transactions.
  • Partner with Finance and External Reporting teams to lead the legal review and preparation of SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, registration statements, and other required financial disclosures.
  • Advise on compliance with federal securities laws, SEC regulations, NYSE/NASDAQ listing requirements, and applicable disclosure obligations.
  • Provide legal guidance on financial reporting and disclosure matters, including materiality assessments, disclosure controls, and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Tax, Investor Relations, External Reporting, and Compliance to address corporate finance matters, financial disclosures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct and oversee due diligence processes, identifying key legal risks and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business development, corporate development, compliance, finance and tax, to assess deal feasibility and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Support timely and accurate securities filings, financial disclosures, and ongoing public company reporting obligations.
  • Provide legal support for capital markets and corporate financing activities, including debt and equity offerings, credit facilities, refinancing transactions, and other financing arrangements.
  • Provide legal guidance on corporate structure, subsidiary matters, intercompany arrangements, and related corporate finance considerations.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate documentation related to debt and equity financing transactions, credit agreements, and other corporate finance arrangements.
  • Work closely with Finance, Treasury, External Reporting, and Investor Relations to ensure accurate and consistent financial disclosures and communications.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, auditors, financial advisors, and other corporate advisors.
  • Provide strategic legal counsel to senior executives on corporate finance, public company reporting, securities compliance, and related risk management matters.
  • Participate and collaborate with M&A and other strategic transactions as needed, with a focus on corporate finance, securities law, and disclosure implications.

 

What you’ll need:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and active membership in a state bar.
  • Typically has 12 years of legal experience in corporate finance, securities, law, public company reporting, and capital markets matters at a major law firm of in-house legal department.
  • Demonstrated executive leadership of a legal function, including management of senior legal professionals, functional strategy, budget and outside counsel oversight, and accountability for enterprise-level legal risk.
  • Strong expertise in corporate finance transactions, SEC reporting requirements, and federal securities laws.
  • Proven experience advising on SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K, and related public company financial disclosure obligations.
  • Experience advising on debt and equity financings, credit facilities, and other capital markets transactions.
  • Strong understanding of public company reporting requirements, SOX compliance, and stock exchange regulations.
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to manage complex legal matters and time-sensitive regulatory reporting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical business guidance.
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

 

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $234,200 - $300,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

 

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. The requirements and duties described above may be modified or waived by the Company in its sole discretion without notice.

job.title: Associate Director, Client Partnerships (Local Advocacy & Public Affairs)
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring an Associate Director, Client Partnerships to join our growing Public Affairs advertising team, with a dedicated focus on expanding Axios' state and local advocacy business. This role will report to the Head of Public Affairs, Client Partnerships. 

Why it matters: As policy decisions increasingly play out in state capitols and at the ballot box, organizations need effective ways to reach influential audiences in local markets. In this role, you will drive new revenue by building partnerships with advocacy organizations, political and public affairs agencies, trade associations, coalitions, and other policy-driven entities seeking to influence the conversations shaping state and local communities.

You will play a key role in expanding Axios' presence in the state and local advocacy advertising market, leveraging Axios Local and our broader portfolio of advertising, custom content, and event solutions.

Go Deeper: Ideal candidates will bring an entrepreneurial spirit, a strong hunting mentality, and a passion for Axios' mission. This is a high-energy, business development-focused role requiring an understanding of state and local politics, the advocacy advertising landscape, and the ability to translate client priorities into creative, effective media partnerships.

In this role you'll:

  • Drive new business: Identify, prospect, and secure new advertising partnerships with organizations investing in state-level public affairs, issue advocacy, ballot initiatives, and legislative campaigns.
  • Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with political and public affairs agencies, trade associations, advocacy organizations, corporate government affairs teams, coalitions, and other stakeholders managing state and local advocacy budgets.
  • Own the state and local opportunity: Identify priority markets, legislative calendars, ballot initiatives, and emerging policy issues that create opportunities for Axios advertising partnerships.
  • Develop integrated solutions: Work with clients and agencies to build strategic advertising programs leveraging Axios Local newsletters, digital advertising, custom content, and experiential opportunities to reach influential audiences.
  • Grow Axios' market presence: Represent Axios at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to establish the company as a valuable partner for state and local advocacy campaigns.
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Lead prospecting, discovery, proposals, negotiations, and closing, while developing long-term relationships that create repeat business.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with Axios Local, integrated marketing, advertising operations, and other internal stakeholders to develop and execute successful client campaigns.
  • Deliver against revenue goals: Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline, identify opportunities for growth, and consistently achieve individual revenue targets.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit and a growth mindset, with a proven ability to build relationships and generate new revenue. This position requires the following:

  • 5+ years of experience in advertising sales, digital media, campaigns, political advertising, public affairs, or agency business development at the state level. 
  • Existing relationships with state-level political and public affairs agencies, advocacy organizations, trade associations, or other entities investing in state and local issue campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of the state legislative landscape, ballot initiative campaigns, and the dynamics of state and local advocacy advertising.
  • Proven experience in outbound sales, new business development, and managing the full sales cycle.
  • Experience developing multi-market advertising campaigns or selling local and regional media.
  • Familiarity with digital advertising, media planning, audience targeting, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify business opportunities around legislative sessions, elections, ballot measures, and other policy-driven moments.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel to priority markets and attend relevant industry events.
  • Track record of successfully meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $66,000 - $87,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Note that the total compensation offered for this role includes incremental variable compensation based on sales territory, which is contingent upon the successful achievement of predetermined sales targets.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Tele-mental health services through Headspace
  • OneMedical membership, including tele-health services
  • Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate 
  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • Access to the Axios Employee Support Fund, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies 
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers 
  • Virtual company-sponsored social events
  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

 Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. job.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Content Platform
job.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Policy & Safety (P&S) is a domain within Content Platform in the Experience Mission, responsible for building Spotify’s content moderation and regulatory compliance infrastructure. This includes rule engines, enforcement pipelines, policy configuration systems, and compliance data platforms that ensure safety at scale.

The team operates at the intersection of backend platform engineering, machine learning systems, and regulatory compliance, partnering closely with Licensing, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs. Sitting on the critical path for every new content type and feature, P&S enables safety-by-default experiences while supporting global regulatory requirements and evolving product innovation.

job.title: Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Business Director to join Translation!

Position Summary

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

Drive Business & Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the day-to-day senior business lead on assigned accounts, serving as a strategic partner who uncovers and addresses core client challenges and opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders, proactively offering strategic counsel rooted in a deep understanding of their business, category, and competitive dynamics.
  • Partner closely with Program Management to align on priorities and ensure our collective approach delivers on both business objectives and operational rigor.
  • Keep a constant pulse on the health of client relationships and business performance, identifying risks or growth opportunities early and collaborating with agency leadership to proactively address them.

Lead Creative Solutions with Business Impact

  • Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, and other internal teams to ensure our work solves real business problems and capitalizes on cultural opportunities.
  • Champion the development of strategies and creative solutions that are grounded in business insights and tied to clear performance metrics.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and cultural shifts to bring fresh, informed thinking that drives innovative solutions for clients.
  • Partner with production leads, creative teams and program management to execute creative work that fully brings to life the approved creative concepts within the allocated time and budget
  • Advocate for additional budget and or push the boundaries with clients to create the most compelling executions possible 

Team & Partnership Leadership

  • Guide and inspire cross-discipline partners, fostering a culture of strategic curiosity, accountability, and partnership excellence.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Program Management, who will lead the operational planning, scoping, budgeting, and executional excellence—freeing you to focus on driving the business agenda and strategic growth.
  • Together with Program Management, ensure seamless integration across disciplines, maintaining the highest standards in client service and delivery.

Champion Growth & Client Success

  • Proactively identify opportunities to grow agency partnerships within existing accounts, aligning agency capabilities with the client’s long-term business goals. Responsible for creating and actioning growth plans for assigned clients
  • Play a key role in broader business development efforts, participating in pitches and strategic growth initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly grasp client industry dynamics and uncover opportunities for impactful creative solutions.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to provide strategic counsel to clients and inspire internal teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading integrated work across multiple channels, with a strong sense for how creative and strategic solutions drive business results.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the optimism and resilience to tackle challenges and move work forward.
  • Passion for culturally relevant work that delivers against both business objectives and consumer engagement.
  • Proven track record of leading creative initiatives that drove real business change or results for clients

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success managing the end-to-end lifecycle of integrated campaigns, engaging with mid-to-senior-level clients, and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on production experience with large-scale, multi-channel initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Culturally driven brand experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $115,000 - $135,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Context Director
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters, Inc. is a first-of-its-kind company that lives at the intersection of culture, tech and storytelling. Through our creative solutions company, Translation, we build ideas that transcend traditional marketing to 

drive business results through cultural impact. Through our music tech platform, UnitedMasters, we power the careers of independent artists through music distribution services and partnership opportunities with the world’s biggest brands. As one-company, we are building a world where cultural capital is equitably exchanged at scale by serving as the go-to source for shared gains between artists and brands. 

If this description makes you feel like running through a brick wall, you’re in the right place.

The Role

Context Planning is the connective tissue between what we make and who we’re making it for. This is a team that only exists at Translation and we built it to help brands diffuse their ideas through culture by focusing on where, when and who they live through.

This role is for a leader who can translate raw insight into real influence, help brands find their voice inside the communities they are looking to engage with, and build systems that make great ideas scale. At your core, you're not just a comms planner. You’re a front row student of culture, a campaign conductor, and an idea amplifier. The Context Director is a leadership position that demands creative foresight, cultural nuance, business acumen, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep connection to what’s moving the world today. 

What You’ll Do

Functional Skills

  • Cultural Research: Lead and assign cultural deep dives that inform strategy and creative development.
  • Comms Planning: Own authorship of holistic GTM plans that connect the dots creatively while translating business objectives into actionable rollouts over time and space/channels.
  • Casting & Talent Strategy: Lead authorship of casting filters that help identify talent who personify our campaign message while ensuring brand safety and creative alignment. 
  • Creative World-Building: Analyze hero deliverables (e.g., film scripts) and provide cultural nuance that infuses insider fan perspective in the form Easter eggs, and additional engagement tactics that will resonate with core audience members.
  • Convergence & Collaboration: Facilitate onboarding for new hires to ensure alignment on Context’s function and value. Partner across PR, Media, and Social teams to preserve creative integrity and contextual fluency from pitch to publish.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a core member of the business leadership team, aligning day-to-day execution with our broader One Company Vision. Mentor DRs across IC1–IC3 levels and informally coach team members outside your direct reporting line.

Who You Are

  • A systems thinker who can orchestrate brand storytelling through people, platforms, and moments.
  • A culture junkie with strong intuition and analytical rigor—you know what’s next, and why it matters.
  • A collaborator who’s equally fluent in creative, strategy, talent, and media environments.
  • A researcher at heart, with a passion for ethnography, behavioral analysis, and emerging platforms.
  • A mentor and motivator who uplifts junior talent and brings out the best in cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 7–9 years experience in cultural strategy, brand planning, or creative strategy roles.

job.title: Video Editor and Motion Designer, Temporary
job.description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. 

Applications will close on Monday, November 16th, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET.

In 2024, ProPublica launched a short-form vertical video team to adapt our long-form investigative journalism for audiences on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Since then, the team has amassed nearly 65 million views. Now we’re building out the second phase of our social video strategy and have launched a new YouTube team dedicated to producing midlength adaptations for the platform.

We are looking for a video editor and motion designer who has a passion for accountability journalism and is excited by the opportunity to bring our reporting to an increasing number of viewers who treat YouTube as a platform to learn about the world around them.

In this role, you will work alongside video producers on the YouTube team and will own the creative and technical postproduction for several assigned videos a month. As this is a new team, you will also be a key part of building the workflows and best practices that make our YouTube video pipeline sustainable as well as creating the visual identity that helps to answer: What should ProPublica look and sound like on YouTube? 

The videos you help create for YouTube are meant to serve as standalone editorial products, and we’re looking for your platform-native expertise to drive experimentation that helps us learn quickly, adapt and deliver the most compelling storytelling formats while adhering to our rigorous editorial standards and practices. You should be comfortable working with reporters and editors across the newsroom as well as freelancers we’ll bring on to help with projects.

This is a temporary two-year role that will report to our director of multiplatform audience strategy. The YouTube team sits within the larger ProPublica audience team.

Essential responsibilities 

  • Collaborate with producers to create videos — and related promo cuts — that are grounded in ethical journalistic principles, standards and practices.
  • Use editorial judgment to translate investigations and video scripts with the sensitivity, care and appropriate tone they require.
  • Own the creative and technical postproduction for videos — editing, motion graphic design and animation, color grading and sound design — ensuring projects are shaped and paced for a YouTube-first audience.
  • Own end-to-end motion design workflows, including creating storyboards, animatics and the polished final products for videos.
  • Establish and maintain a central motion design library of MOGRTs, templates, toolkits and other reusable visual assets for teamwide use.
  • Maintain ProPublica’s brand standards and overall design system, collaborating with the design and graphics teams, among others, to ensure visual cohesiveness in videos.
  • Communicate proactively with the team regarding project status and timelines and directly collaborate with producers on scoping and delivering videos on schedule. 
  • Manage multiple projects in various stages of production, sometimes meeting tight deadlines.

About you

We are looking for candidates who have proven that they can use video editing and design skills for journalistic ends.

The ideal candidate will have these skills and attributes:

  • Four or more years of professional video editing and motion design experience in a newsroom, media organization or production studio. 
  • High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, with expert proficiency in both Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.
  • A portfolio that highlights videos you have edited specifically for YouTube, including hosted, vlog-style and/or explainer formats.
  • Experience building tension in hooks, controlling pacing and navigating tonal shifts in video storytelling. 
  • You are energized by the opportunity of being part of a founding team and creating something from scratch — establishing formats, defining visual languages and building efficient workflows. 
  • You thrive while collaborating, seeking input from others and iterating your work based on feedback. 

And many of these: 

  • Experience being part of a founding YouTube team or launching a new project initiative. 
  • Experience in on-site production, including shooting on professional camera equipment and knowledge of lighting and audio setups.
  • Experience with digital asset management and video archival workflows. 
  • Proficiency in Figma and Google Workspace.

This job is full time and includes benefits. ProPublica is based in New York, but we’re open to remote candidates. We have offices in New York City; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta; Chicago; Phoenix; and Berkeley, California. Applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. and have the ability to travel, as necessary, for team meetings, training and video-related duties.

This role is subject to an in-office work requirement of two days per week in the New York City office. That requirement may be extended to other offices with 60 days’ notice. 

This job is covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with The NewsGuild of New York, Local 31003, CWA, AFL-CIO.

The expected salary range for this position is $90,000 to $115,000.

This is a good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position. The final salary figure will take into account a person’s experience, accomplishment and location. ProPublica is committed to paying its staff equitably, and these ranges should not be considered career salary limits or caps.

We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, but we will continue to consider candidates as long as the posting remains live on our site.

Questions? Send an email to talent@propublica.org. 

No phone calls, please.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law. We are dedicated to building an inclusive newsroom and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, AgencyIQ by POLITICO
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to design and deliver new tools and features for AgencyIQ by POLITICO, a policy-driven product for regulatory professionals in the life sciences, food, and chemicals sectors.


AgencyIQ combines expert research, data, and software tools for regulatory professionals in the life sciences, food, and chemicals industries. This Senior Product Manager will shape AgencyIQ’s roadmap and help the product team move from customer insight to working solutions faster. The role spans product innovation (including the development and roll-out of AI-driven tools), commercial strategy, and technology execution—driving measurable growth in subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention across both product lines.


The ideal candidate has a strong grasp of AI coding tools (Codex, Claude Code, etc.), can speak in technical terms with the engineering team, and has a proven ability to translate subscriber insights into product roadmaps that deliver commercial results.


Who You Are

• You are a highly user-centric product manager with a strong track record of translating research, data, and market insight into clear roadmaps and measurable business impact.

• You are comfortable with both customer discovery and hands-on technical work. You can test an idea with users, understand how it fits into a subscription product, and collaborate with engineers on APIs, data flows, security, and deployment.

• You enjoy enabling others by creating repeatable processes that make the whole team more effective.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy & Roadmap

• Own and prioritize a roadmap for AgencyIQ features and workflows, balancing customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and engineering capacity.

• Interview customers and prospects; analyze usage, feedback, market developments, and competitors; turn findings into clear product requirements, experiments, and defined KPIs.

• Partner with research, commercial, design, and engineering teams to improve acquisition, engagement, expansion, and retention of customers across the market segments we serve.


AI-Assisted Prototyping and Technical Enablement

• Design and roll out a repeatable workflow that lets others on the AgencyIQ product team use approved AI coding tools, such as Codex or Claude Code, to build and test feature prototypes and data collection tools.

• Work with POLITICO’s engineering and design teams to create reusable templates and documentation that adhere to company standards and connect to POLITICO systems through approved access paths.

• Align new templates and workflows with the tooling, policies, and procedures established by POLITICO’s engineering and operations teams.

• Define how prototypes are evaluated with users, reviewed by engineers, and either hardened for release or retired.

• Build representative prototypes yourself and coach other product managers through the workflow, and improve it based on where they get stuck and what engineers need for an efficient handoff.

• Create reusable evals for prototypes and AI-enabled features, using representative regulatory tasks, expected results, and clear quality thresholds. Run them as designs change and use the results to guide engineering review and release decisions.


Regulatory Data and Delivery

• Scope and prototype reliable ways to collect public data from government sources in the United States, Europe, Japan, and other global jurisdictions using official APIs or structured feeds where available and compliant scraping where appropriate.

• Partner with research and engineering on source provenance, data quality, parsing, change detection, monitoring, and maintainability so promising data prototypes can become dependable product capabilities.

• Write clear specifications, make trade-offs visible, coordinate delivery to make the most of limited engineering capacity, and measure whether shipped features improve customer outcomes.


Required Experience

• 3+ years of product management experience delivering B2B software or data products, with evidence of strong product judgment and measurable customer or business results.

• Hands-on ability to prototype with modern AI coding tools and enough working knowledge of code, APIs, databases, and software delivery to assess output and collaborate credibly with engineers.

• Experience designing usable product workflows from interviews, usability tests, feedback, and behavioral data; fluency in product metrics and prioritization.

• Experience working with engineering on technical requirements, integrations, testing, and release processes; sound judgment about security, data access, and where human review is necessary.

• Ability to teach technical practices to colleagues with different backgrounds and to communicate decisions clearly to commercial, research, technology, and senior leadership teams.


Preferred Experience

• Familiarity with Python or JavaScript, SQL, web data collection, cloud development environments, CI/CD, and API-based integrations.

• Experience in information services, regulatory intelligence, or another B2B subscription business that combines expert content, structured data, and software.

• Knowledge of public regulatory sources or the needs of regulatory affairs, policy, legal, or scientific users.

• Knowledge of the U.S. capital markets—namely public equities and the institutions that trade them.



COMPENSATION: $110,000 - 120,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon! 


About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

job.title: Executive producer, Full Story
job.description:

We are seeking an Executive producer for Guardian Australia’s flagship daily podcast, Full Story. You will have a pivotal role in brainstorming ideas to commissioning them, through to production and editorial sign off. 

 

This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, with early starts or late finishes.


In this role you will…
 

  • Manage and executive produce our daily news podcast - Full Story - including commissioning daily episodes, managing staff and production schedules 
  • Ensure that Full Story covers topics our audience is interested in and that showcase Guardian Australia’s award-winning journalism in a timely manner
  • Manage and mentor staff as directed
  • Oversee episode editing sessions, including directing and signing off sound design, audio and video edits
  • Ensure episodes meet the highest editorial standards and legal compliance
  • Work closely with producers on interviews and scripting, and with sound designers to elevate stories
  • Work with hosts to continually develop the show’s sound and structure
  • Ensure that senior editorial staff are updated on progress and work with department heads to guide our marketing and social media teams to make sure the shows are promoted to the widest audience possible
  • Create audio and video episode pages with engaging headlines
  • Create site-specific thumbnails and headlines for YouTube and social clips  
  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in audio and video podcasting


You’ll bring….
 

  • At least 6-7 years’ experience in news storytelling in a digital news environment 
  • Substantial experience of producing news accurately and quickly under tight deadlines
  • Advanced level of editorial judgement, preferably developed in a national newsroom 
  • Significant experience of managing journalists and/or producers, key contributors and on-air talent
  • Proven track record in making high quality audio programming
  • Experience in producing interviews, collaborating on scripting and overseeing schedules 
  • Understanding of video podcasting processes and promotion
  • Commitment to showcasing diverse perspectives
  • Good knowledge of media law
  • Ability to consistently meet tight deadlines
