job.title: Helpdesk Support
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The IT Helpdesk role provides Level 1/2 end-user on-site and remote support to agency end users in a predominantly Mac OS environment in the country. This includes end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site. This role provides audio-visual support as needed for high-visibility meetings on-site, as well as advanced smart-hands support as needed to support other Omnicom IT centralized services. The role requires flexibility and adaptability to supporting multiple agencies in the region and supporting “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom support as needed.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device , and audio-visual support.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides executive and VVIP support and audio visual (AV) support.
  • Provide quality assurance over any 3rd party IT services provided on-site.
  • Facilitate and coordinate site-specific activities (e.g., office moves, weekend power downs) as needed.
  • Support “ad-hoc” agency IT support as needed and directed by the IT Support Manager.
  • Works directly with internal and external 3rd party resources to ensure that end-user issues are resolved efficiently.
  • Manage the end-user experience delivered to agency end-users on-site and remote in the region.
  • Provide Level 1/2 end-user on-site support to agency end users, including troubleshooting, resolving, and documenting issues with desktop, laptop, mobile device, printer, and peripheral hardware and software.
  • Maintain rapport with agency end-users and be a go-to resource for IT troubleshooting.
  • Provide end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site, including setting up, configuring, and testing devices, applications, and network connectivity.
  • Engage IT Support Manager(s) as needed to identify systemic issues with end-user support.
  • Maintain asset inventory and track IT hardware in the region.
  • Follow Omnicom IT policies, procedures, and standards for end-user support and service delivery. And report any violations of Omnicom security policies to management.
  • Provide attended meeting support for high-visibility internal and external meetings.
  • Provide “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom IT support to agencies, while also documenting the support requirements for review as a consolidation opportunity for Omnicom IT centralized services.
  • Provide advanced smart-hands support on-site, supporting other Omnicom IT centralized services that may not have an on-site presence.
  • Support cross-functional IT processes such as onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, incident resolution and request fulfillment.
  • Use ServiceNow ITSM platform to receive and manage incident and request tickets, maintaining proper ticket management protocols such as detailed comments and close notes.
  • Manage assigned tickets to complete within service level criteria.
  • Participate / provide after-hours support and flexibility to travel as needed.

Individual must also maintain an extreme level of confidentiality in dealing with all information that flows through the office.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device, and audio-visual support.
  • Strong technical knowledge and skills in Mac OS
  • In-depth knowledge of end-user platforms and services, including but not limited to, MacOS, Office365, Windows OS, Active Directory, etc., current desktop and mobile computing technology, core media business applications and their operation.
  • Familiarity with networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Must possess a “can-do” attitude and be ready to roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
  • Ability to function within a group and support other team members to resolve problems.
  • Ability to quickly analyze problems, interpret operational needs, and resolve or escalate problems in a timely manner as well as ability to provide real time support for end-user issues.
  • Ability to work calmly under high pressure situations.
  • Ability to maintain good rapport with agencies being supported.
  • Ability to communicate with executives and their staff.
  • Ability to prioritize and work on multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to train others in the use and support of Omnicom business systems.
  • Understanding of ITIL principles is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Jamf platform is preferred.
  • Knowledge of advertising and media businesses is highly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft, Apple, or Cisco are preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience, is preferred.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation's technologies and infrastructure, enabling the creation and continued delivery of quality content across all platforms. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people, and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology—not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines and operational needs.

 

The Opportunity

 

Are you passionate about technology transformation, evolving operating models and shaping new ways of working from concept through to adoption? In this key role, you will serve as a strategic technology transformation adviser to leaders and teams, helping diagnose challenges, define and structure change initiatives, and drive operational implementation and adoption across the organization.

 

Reporting to the Director of the Operational Excellence Office within Technology & Infrastructure (T&I), you will join the team leading the Daily Content initiative in Innovation & Delivery. You will be joining us at a pivotal moment as CBC/Radio-Canada undergoes a major overhaul to modernize its content creation platforms. This transformation goes beyond software and tools — it redefines how production platforms are designed, delivered and used within an organizational model focused on product management, agile at scale, and continuous value creation.

 

In this role, you will combine a strategic consulting mindset with hands-on execution across all stages of the transformation. You will analyze complex issues, challenge established ways of working and provide actionable recommendations while actively driving their implementation by designing and producing the strategies, plans, frameworks, tools and other deliverables needed to execute and adopt the transformation.

 

Key areas of focus include transitioning to a product management model, modernizing collaboration with partners and contributors, and driving user adoption of new production tools. You will help define, structure and roll out the transformation and change management strategies required across all levels of the organization.

 

You will also play a central role in bringing together and aligning diverse teams and stakeholders across CBC/Radio-Canada around a shared vision and common goals. Your ability to grasp and navigate a complex organizational ecosystem, balance operational constraints and competing priorities, and exert influence without direct authority will be essential to align perspectives, build consensus, streamline decision-making and remove roadblocks.

 

Working alongside key stakeholders, you will support the organization in preparing for and implementing changes — including by developing and rolling out effective engagement and communications strategies — and by preparing and supporting end users in tandem with our Learning & Development partners.

 

You will work closely with operational and strategic leaders, as well as with the Daily Content Director, to structure challenges, shape recommendations and guide the evolution of work practices and production tools.

 

As a member of T&I’s Operational Excellence Office, you will help ensure alignment, practical execution and long-term adoption of the transformation by continuously refining our approaches based on results, key insights and frontline needs. Beyond the Daily Content initiative, you will also help build the Office’s methods, practices and capabilities as well as nurture a transformation community of practice across CBC/Radio-Canada to share lessons learned and scale high-impact practices.

 

This position can be based in Toronto or Montreal, with occasional travel required.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise leaders and teams on defining and implementing technology transformations, engaging early in the life cycle to analyze needs, diagnose challenges, identify required changes and deliver recommendations aligned with the organization's vision and goals.
  • Guide departments and divisions in evolving their operating models and ways of working, advising on process design, governance, roles and responsibilities, and team collaboration structures.
  • Develop approaches, frameworks and tools to structure and implement transformation — including simple, scalable and reusable interaction models and practical guides — with a focus on change management, Lean, SAFe and Scrum methodologies.
  • Design and execute change management and adoption strategies and plans, incorporating impact assessments, organizational readiness, risk mitigation and stakeholder support.
  • Define and lead engagement, communication and capacity-building strategies — including user training and the preparation of delivery teams and change agents — in partnership with Learning & Development.
  • Proactively identify and resolve risks, resistance and operational roadblocks that could hinder transformation and adoption.
  • Define and track metrics to measure the progress, adoption and effectiveness of new ways of working, using data and insights to continuously refine strategies.
  • Actively participate in key transformation forums and events, including strategic and alignment meetings, sprint reviews, program demos and quarterly planning sessions.

 

What You Bring

  • Undergraduate degree in business administration, technology or a field relevant to organizational transformation (or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Seven to 10 years' experience leading large-scale technology transformations, including evolving technology operating models, processes, governance structures, roles and responsibilities, and ways of working within complex, matrixed environments.
  • Proven track record as a strategic transformation adviser, with strong skills in analyzing and diagnosing complex issues, challenging current practices, formulating actionable recommendations and guiding execution.
  • Solid understanding of product management models and agile practices at scale, with hands-on experience applying them to tech transformations. Expertise in SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), Scrum or other scaled agile frameworks required.
  • Experience with Lean and iterative transformation approaches, alongside the ability to adapt strategies and solutions based on key insights, data and frontline needs.
  • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end change management and adoption, including impact analysis, stakeholder engagement, strategic communications and capability building.
  • Knowledge of media production, broadcasting workflows and related technologies (e.g., audio/video editing, publishing, distribution, graphics generation) a major asset.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics (including labour relations), manage resistance, resolve conflict and build trust-based relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with sharp business acumen and the ability to synthesize complex challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, guide and engage leaders and teams without direct authority.
  • Exceptional facilitation and active listening skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, plain language.
  • Bilingualism in English and French (written and spoken) required.

Experiences Coordinator

Reports to:

Experiences Manager

Brand(s)

Cruz, play

Location:

Edmonton, AB

November 15, 2026

Only those candidates selected to interview will be contacted and no phone calls please

Do you love being a part of concerts and events? Do you want a job that makes all your friends jealous? Here is your chance to help plan and execute exciting promotions, contests, and activations.

Harvard Media is looking for an Experiences Coordinator to join our Edmonton team and work closely with our Experiences Managers, Program Director and Director of Sales. We need your help executing compelling contests and exciting events that build our brands, engage our listeners, and benefit our clients.

Are you up for the challenge? You’ll work in a fun, fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, with a team and a company that wants to see you learn and grow. Sound good? Send us your resume.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Post promotional content across station websites and social media platforms to support experiences and marketing initiatives.

Track and document station promotions, events, and community initiatives.

Attend and represent brands at all major station events and designated client promotions as needed.

Create and manage giveaways using SPARC, ensuring accuracy and compliance with station policies and ensuring prizing is accounted for.

Manage the distribution of prizes and maintain records of contest winners and prize fulfillment.

Be present at off-site promotional events, including giveaways, live broadcasts, and special appearances.

Preparation of equipment and merchandise for events.

Gather data for experience wrap reports.

Maintain promotional materials and station vehicles by ensuring cleanliness, fueling, and identifying items that need repair or replacement.

Other duties as assigned by the Experiences Manager.

Strong computer skills including proficiency in Microsoft systems like Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams, Excel & Word

Canva knowledge and skills considered an asset

Video editing software experience is an asset

Social media editing and posting for a brand

Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Creative, dynamic, energetic, and accountable

Self-motivated, team player with a positive attitude and passion to succeed with an eagerness to learn new skills

Must have high attention to detail with exceptional organizational skills

The skills necessary to update station websites and social media with a willingness to learn

Ability to work well under pressure and handle multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment under minimal supervision

Must be willing to work flexible hours. Weekend and evening hours will be required for station events and promotions

Must hold a valid Class 5 driver's license with a clean driving record and provide a driver’s abstract

Must be eligible for coverage under Harvard’s Insurance Plan

A love for getting out in the community and meeting and greeting our listeners first-hand

job.title: Photojournalist
job.description:
Photojournalist

#26-1356

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-TV

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

KSTP 5 Eyewitness News is the award-winning ABC network affiliate for the Twin Cities. Part of Hubbard Broadcasting, KSTP-TV is a longtime market leader, and is committed to excellence in all that it does-broadcast news with hyper-local coverage, important public service that deals powerfully with today's issues, and now, more than ever, top-notch digital content, to reach our viewers and followers with information the way they want to receive it. When you work for KSTP, or our other local, independently operated station KSTC, Channel 45, you will find yourself among dedicated, passionate people who work hard every day to improve our product and our community. If you have the qualifications, and you are a person of talent and integrity, we invite you to apply!

Job Overview

Responsible for shooting and editing video for daily newscasts under tight deadlines. Works with reporters and producers to create accurate, engaging content for broadcast and digital platforms.

Job Responsibilities

Shoot steady, sequenced video with good, clean audio for news, weather and sports for daily newscasts, specials and station websites, as well as social medio under tight deadlines.

While shooting, get clean audio and Gather great natural sound while in the field. Ensure good lighting, making sure the shot is bright not dark.

Edit in camera for sequences. Uses movement off the shoulder to show viewers what is seen in the field and a tripod or steady bag for the steady Soose wide, medium and tight shots with a variety of subjects for the purpose of telling the story through pictures.

Edit video and audio satisfactorily for news stories, VOs, VO/SOTs, setups and reporter packages using different techniques and editing platforms (including non-linear editing with Adobe ang Final Cut Pro) under tight deadlines and in stressful situations while completing on time. Editing is done in house and in the field. Learn and perform competent multi-layering and special effects such as witness protection, highlighting video clips, color correction, and Photoshop. Aspire to editing excellence to raise the level of storytelling.

At times, may conduct interviews for broadcast with formulating May also use questions supplied by producers, reporters or news management.

Work in tandem with a reporter to “tell” a story.

Have full knowledge of working with reporters to turn packages and live shots for daily newscasts.

Learn streets and highways to drive quickly to a news Be able to operate and follow GPS.

Learn and operate effectively and satisfactorily new technology and equipment including but not limited to Final Cut Pro, different cameras, servers, and editing platforms.

Communicate frequently throughout the day and work collaboratively with others in the newsroom including reporters, anchors, producers, assignment editors, creative services and other photographers about assigned stories and other assignments. Check in face-to-face with Assignment Desk when returning to station from assignments and proactively pitch in to assist others.

Respond and work well in a crisis and during breaking.

Handle last minute and unexpected changes, communicating quickly and clearly to necessary staff and talent.

Attend editorial and other Come prepared, interact professionally with others and contribute story ideas daily.

Have knowledge of local, national and world Have a handle on what is going on in the community.

Travel regularly, often locally however, may travel nationally and internationally.

Work assigned Shifts may change often. Fill in for absent co-workers, if needed.

Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules including when called to cover breaking news.

Drive company vehicles to and from stories under various driving conditions.

Obey all traffic laws and safety rules of the road while in a company vehicle.

Report any problems or concerns with vehicle and traffic incidents promptly to appropriate company representative.

If assigned to take a news vehicle home, must follow take home guidelines which include securing equipment and vehicle.

Keep car clean and in good condition.

Ensure equipment is in good working condition.

Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the public.

Act in a courteous professional manner when representing the station and the news department.

Look presentable and neat on the job.

Must possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record as determined by the company. A driving record check will be required.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

Minimum 2 years of TV news photography and editing experience preferred.

Must be proficient with current broadcast cameras and editing equipment.

Have knowledge and expertise of non-linear editing.

Ability to work alone and with a reporter.

Must be reliable and able to work additional hours if needed, as well as travel as required.

Must possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record as determined by the company. A driving record check will be required.

Good news judgement and thorough understanding of daily news content.

Ability to read, write and speak English well.

Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Ability to learn and run ENG trucks preferred.

Physical Requirements:

Must have manual dexterity to operate camera and editing equipment.

Must be able to lift, carry and move with up to 50lbs of equipment in various environments, including outdoors in extreme weather conditions.

Must be able to work in areas and conditions that are often noisy, have many distractions, in extreme weather (heat and cold) and landscape conditions.

Must be able to stand for long periods of time.

Able to listen to and respond verbally to others in English.

Able to move quickly inside and outside on uneven, unfamiliar terrain and areas.

Able to drive news vehicles.

Work under tight deadlines and in pressure situations.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. job.title: Director of Engineering - Dome Productions
job.description:
Req Id: 433339

Dome Productions is North America’s leading production and transmission facilities provider, Dome is unique in its business approach and sets itself apart from others with its integration of primary business units of Mobile Production, Host Broadcaster and Media Services, and Transmission services all under its corporate umbrella. Dome Productions’ resume includes work with major worldwide broadcasters, leagues, production companies, government parties and other content creators, with a major emphasis on sports, eSports, and entertainment. 
     
We provide a supportive and inclusive community where all team members can succeed. And through our commitment to environmental, social and governance initiatives, you will feel good about the greater impact you will have – making every day better for people as they connect, work, learn and play. 
 
Join us. You belong at Dome Productions’

Summary

The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, technical direction, operational performance, and ongoing evolution of Dome Productions' engineering organization. This role oversees the maintenance, readiness, and modernization of Dome's mobile production fleet, technical infrastructure, and engineering resources while ensuring the delivery of reliable, industry-leading broadcast solutions.

As a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Engineering will establish the long-term technology vision for the organization, lead the transition to next-generation IP, cloud, and hybrid production environments, and develop high-performing engineering teams that support North America's most prestigious live sports and entertainment productions.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technology Innovation

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for Dome’s engineering organization, establishing the vision and multi-year roadmap for media platforms, mobiles, studios, software, architecture, and infrastructure.
  • Execute Dome's long-term technology strategy and roadmap, ensuring continued leadership in broadcast and production technologies.
  • Lead the evaluation, adoption, and implementation of emerging technologies, including IP-based workflows, cloud-based production, UHD/4K, HDR, and software-defined infrastructure.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to executive leadership, clients, and industry partners regarding technology trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Collaborate with leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media and Rogers Media to understand business priorities and future growth plans, translating them into scalable technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Establish strategic partnerships with technology vendors, service providers, and industry organizations to support current and future business requirements.
  • Represent Dome Productions within industry associations, technology forums, and key vendor partnerships.

Engineering Operations & Infrastructure Management

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Dome's mobile production fleet, studios, control rooms, and supporting technical infrastructure.
  • Guide the evolution of Dome Productions infrastructure and shape the transition to next-generation architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Ensure all systems meet operational, reliability, performance, and broadcast quality standards.
  • Oversee engineering support for major live productions and serve as the senior escalation point for critical operational issues.
  • Lead large-scale engineering projects, system upgrades, equipment acquisitions, and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Ensure effective asset lifecycle management, maintenance planning, and operational readiness across all technical platforms.

Business Partnership & Financial Accountability

  • Partner with division leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media, Rogers Media, to align technology investments with business objectives.
  • Develop capital plans, operating budgets, forecasts, and business cases that support strategic priorities.
  • Manage/oversee capital projects ensuring adherence to cost, time and quality deliverables. Oversee purchase, delivery, and installation of new equipment. Ensure the smooth integration, training and communication of new equipment or process.
  • Make sound business decisions that balance operational excellence, financial stewardship, and long-term organizational success.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineering leaders, technical specialists, and field engineering personnel responsible for building, maintaining, and continually evolving Dome’s technology ecosystem.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, workforce development, performance management, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Establish training and development programs that advance technical expertise and leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Promote a safe, inclusive, and high-performing work environment for employees and freelance resources.

Industry Leadership & Client Support

  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, partners, and industry stakeholders.
  • Update and maintain thorough knowledge of the mobile, studio and distribution business including who’s who, trends, technology, changes, relationships, competitive and client landscapes and changes within the industry
  • Support client-facing discussions involving technical strategy, production solutions, and future business opportunities.
  • Ensure exceptional service delivery and client satisfaction across all engineering-supported productions.

Critical Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in broadcast engineering, media technology, or related technical environments.
  • Minimum 5 years in a senior management or director-level role leading technical teams and complex operations.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing technology strategies, infrastructure roadmaps, and large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading high-performing engineering teams within live production, broadcast, media, or technology environments.
  • Strong knowledge of live production and broadcast technologies, including video, audio, routing, replay, intercom, transmission, and contribution systems.
  • Significant experience with SMPTE 2110, IP-based workflows, cloud-based media technologies, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Understanding of modern networking, compute, storage, cybersecurity, and software-defined architectures.
  • Knowledge of broadcast industry standards, including SMPTE, ATSC, UHD/4K, HDR, and related emerging technologies.
  • Experience overseeing complex technology implementations while maintaining highly reliable production operations.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build cross-functional partnerships.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities in high-pressure environments.
  • Ability to lead through change while maintaining team engagement and operational excellence.
  • Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional client experiences.
  • Builds trust and credibility across technical, operational, and executive teams.
  • Balances innovation with operational reliability.
  • Develops future-ready engineering capabilities while maintaining exceptional service delivery.
  • Leads confidently in fast-paced, high-stakes live production environments.
  • Creates a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Degree or diploma in Engineering, Broadcast Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Relevant industry certifications and professional affiliations are considered assets.

 

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec. 

 

Additional Information:

Position Type: Management 
Job Status: Regular - Full Time 
Job Location: Canada : Ontario : Toronto 
Work Arrangement: Full-time in office (meaning that you will be required to perform your work on-site)
Application Deadline: 11/20/2026 

 

For work arrangements that are ‘Hybrid’, successful candidates must be based in Canada and report to a set Dome office for a minimum of 3 days a week.  Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, Dome offers flexibility in work hours based on the business needs.

 

Please apply directly online to be considered for this role.  Applications through email will not be accepted.

 

We know that caring for our team members is at the heart of a healthy, positive and thriving workplace. As part of our team, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive compensation package that includes a competitive salary and a wide range of benefits to support the well-being of you and your family. As soon as you join us, you'll be eligible for medical, dental, vision and mental health benefits that you can tailor to your specific needs. Plus, as a Dome team member, you'll enjoy a 35% discount on our services and access exclusive offers from our partners. 

 

At Dome, we are proud of our focus on fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace where all team members feel valued, respected, supported, and that they belong.

 

Dome is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise. We also want to make sure that everyone has an equal opportunity to join our team. We encourage individuals who may require accommodations during the hiring process to let us know. For a confidential inquiry, email your recruiter or recruitment@bell.ca to make arrangements. If you have questions or feedback regarding accessibility at Bell, we invite you to complete the Accessibility feedback form or visit our Accessibility page for other ways to contact us.

job.title: Market Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role

  • Enjoy presenting to clients of sales opportunities and post-sale successes

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit

  • Positive and friendly with a willingness to collaborate

  • High energy and passion for sales

  • Flexible, creative and curious

  • Digitally savvy
  • 3+ years in Media Sales background preferred

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
    Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

The Senior Union Benefit Analyst will serve as the in-house union benefit Subject Matter Expert (SME) and is responsible for ensuring that all union benefit employer contributions and employee deductions are setup, maintained, paid, and reported in accordance with applicable collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

job.title: Sports Intern- Spring, 2027
job.description:
WGNO, the ABC affiliate in New Orleans, is Southeast Louisiana’s trusted source for local news, sports, and weather. It serves the city and 13 surrounding parishes with coverage that informs, inspires, and connects our community.

At WGNO Sports, we cover everything from Friday night high school football to college rivalries and professional teams. As our intern, you’ll be immersed in the fast-paced world of sports journalism and expected to:

  • Report, write, and edit compelling sports stories in line with Nexstar Media Group and Associated Press standards
  • Assist with shooting and editing highlights, interviews, and stand-ups

Scripps Company ABC station in Bakersfield, California, is seeking a Morning Meteorologist / Weather Forecaster who will analyze complex weather data and deliver forecasts that matter to the people of Bakersfield and Kern County. You'll be at the forefront of weather coverage, from daily forecasts to critical severe weather events, using cutting-edge technology to tell the story of our ever-changing skies.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.
  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.
  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.
  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.
  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.
  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit, and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelors degree in Meteorology preferred
  • Generally 3+ years experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy, including weather and newsroom computer systems
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Knowledge of editing systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Bakersfield, California, offers an exceptional quality of life in the heart of the San Joaquin Valley. Known as the gateway to the Southern Sierra Nevada, Bakersfield provides easy access to world-class outdoor recreation, with Sequoia and Kings Canyon National Parks less than two hours away. job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KNXV
job.description:
We're looking for a storyteller who can do it all — shoot, write, report and most importantly - connect with the community. KNXV, ABC 15 in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for a talented Multimedia Journalist to join our newsroom. At ABC 15, you'll be more than a journalist — you'll be a one-person powerhouse who brings the stories of the Valley of the Sun to life across television and digital platforms. From breaking news to in-depth community coverage, your work will inform, inspire and make a real difference in the lives of viewers across one of the nation's fastest-growing markets.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix is one of America's most exciting and sun-soaked cities, offering an extraordinary quality of life for those who call it home. With more than 300 days of sunshine a year, the Valley of the Sun is a playground for outdoor enthusiasts — whether you're hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park, kayaking along the Salt River, or exploring the stunning red rocks just a short drive away in Sedona. The sprawling Sonoran Desert landscape is unlike anywhere else on earth, and it's right at your doorstep.

Beyond the outdoors, the downtown arts district offers a vibrant scene that includes the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest in the Southwest, as well as the Musical Instrument Museum — a one-of-a-kind destination that draws visitors from around the globe. The local food scene reflects the city's rich cultural diversity, from authentic Sonoran-style Mexican cuisine and acclaimed farm-to-table restaurants to a thriving craft brewery and coffee culture. The city also hosts beloved annual events like the Barrett-Jackson car auction and the Waste Management Phoenix Open, one of the most attended sporting events in the world.

For sports fans, Phoenix is a major-league city all the way, home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the WNBA's Mercury, the NHL's Coyotes, and MLB's Diamondbacks. With a booming economy, a young and diverse population, and world-class amenities at every turn, Phoenix isn't just a great place to work — it's a phenomenal place to build a life.

job.title: Multimedia Accountability Reporter, KTNV
job.description:
Scripps-owned KTNV is looking for a Multimedia Accountability Reporter who believes journalism should do more than fill a newscast. You’re a creative, curious storyteller who wants to uncover what’s really happening in Las Vegas, hold the powerful accountable and produce work that can make a difference in people’s lives. You’ll have the freedom to dig deeper, follow compelling leads and find fresh ways to bring important stories to life across broadcast, digital, social and emerging storytelling platforms. Whether you’re analyzing data, working sources, shooting in the field or experimenting with a new way to tell a story, you’ll focus on journalism that connects with audiences wherever they are. If you want to push beyond the traditional reporter playbook and create ambitious, memorable journalism with purpose, this is your opportunity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop original news leads and tips, cultivating sources and identifying accountability stories with meaningful impact for the Las Vegas community.
  • Investigate issues through in-depth reporting, public records, research, data and interviews to uncover facts and provide important context.
  • Analyze databases, statistics and other complex information to identify trends, verify facts and strengthen reporting.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation, research and field reporting while maintaining high journalistic standards.
  • Write and produce compelling, accurate stories for broadcast, digital, social and other multimedia platforms, often on deadline.
  • Shoot video and still photography and edit visual content to create complete, engaging multimedia stories.
  • Deliver polished on-camera reporting, including live reports, taped interviews, narration and breaking-news coverage from the field.
  • Own stories from idea through publication, determining the strongest focus, structure, visuals and storytelling approach for each platform.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, digital teams and newsroom colleagues to strengthen coverage and maximize the reach and impact of reporting.
  • Contribute to daily news coverage while balancing enterprise and accountability reporting that may require longer-term research and development.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in journalism, communications or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, preferred.
  • Generally, 5+ years of journalism or related experience preferred, including experience reporting, writing and producing stories across multiple platforms.
  • Valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required. This position requires driving as part of the job.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong investigative instincts, curiosity and the persistence to keep digging when a story demands more.
  • Advanced critical-thinking and research skills, with the ability to make sense of complicated subjects, statistics and records.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a strong command of compelling, accurate storytelling.
  • A confident and engaging on-air presence, including the ability to communicate clearly during live and breaking coverage.
  • Multimedia skills and the willingness to report, shoot, write, edit and produce content across platforms.
  • The ability to juggle daily assignments, enterprise reporting and multiple developing stories in a fast-paced newsroom while consistently meeting deadlines.
  • A collaborative mindset and commitment to working effectively with journalists and colleagues throughout the station.
  • Sound editorial judgment and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, verification and accountability journalism.

OUR TEAM:

At KTNV, you’ll join a collaborative newsroom focused on serving the Las Vegas community with journalism that informs, explains and creates impact. Our team brings together journalists with different backgrounds, perspectives, experiences and interests, united by curiosity and a commitment to telling stories that matter. We value colleagues who share ideas, support one another, embrace multiple forms of storytelling and believe great local journalism starts with listening to the community.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Las Vegas is much more than the Strip. It’s a fast-growing, diverse community with an endless supply of meaningful stories, from local government and education to housing, growth, water, public safety and the issues affecting neighborhoods across Southern Nevada. For an accountability reporter, it’s a dynamic market where strong local journalism can make a real difference.

When you’re off the clock, Southern Nevada offers world-class dining, entertainment and professional sports alongside incredible outdoor experiences. Red Rock Canyon, Lake Mead and the surrounding desert and mountains put hiking, climbing, cycling and weekend adventures within easy reach, while Las Vegas provides the energy, culture and experiences of a destination known around the world.

job.description:
Drive Auto is seeking a collaborative, hands-on Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations to lead the teams responsible for paid-media execution and technical support. This role is ideal for an experienced digital advertising leader who combines deep paid media expertise with strong operational judgment, people leadership, and a commitment to high-quality client delivery.

The Senior Manager will lead the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support Managers, providing direction, coaching, and accountability across both teams. This person will ensure campaigns and technical work are delivered accurately and efficiently; maintain strong support and service standards; and keep the organization prepared for changes across advertising platforms and emerging channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coach the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture.
  • Oversee the Drive Auto Media team’s execution of paid campaigns, including campaign builds, optimization practices, quality standards, testing, and performance analysis.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and leadership across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms, including emerging advertising platforms, ensuring teams remain current on meaningful platform changes, new capabilities, and evolving best practices.
  • Evaluate the operational impact of platform updates and new advertising products; determine when the team should test, adopt, document, or train on new capabilities.
  • Oversee the Tech Support team’s work across platform configuration, technical setup, QA, implementations, migrations, troubleshooting, projects, and escalations.
  • Monitor and improve service-level expectations, customer service, workflow consistency, and operational processes across the Tech Support function.
  • Partner closely with the Drive Auto Onboarding, Customer Support, and Account Management teams to deliver media campaigns, issue resolution, and platform deliverables on time and with accuracy.
  • Confidently represent Drive Auto in client-facing conversations, presenting recommendations clearly, making decisive calls when needed, and guiding stakeholders toward the solution that best serves the client and the business.
  • Collaborate with Sales, leadership, and other internal teams to align on operational needs, resolve escalations, and support a strong client experience.
  • Mentor and develop team members through regular feedback, coaching, recognition, and training opportunities.
  • Lead by example through professionalism, adaptability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, paid media, automotive marketing, or automotive technology
  • 2+ years of experience leading and developing a team
  • Hands-on experience building and optimizing paid search and paid social campaigns
  • Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager; experience with TikTok and other digital advertising platforms 
  • Experience overseeing campaign execution, optimization, QA, and performance analysis
  • Experience with technical support, platform implementation, configuration, migrations, troubleshooting, ticket workflows, and client escalations
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising platform changes, industry trends, and the ability to translate them into practical guidance for operational teams

job.description:
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is looking for a Manager, Podcast Marketing to lead cross-promotional campaigns across our portfolio of nearly 70 podcasts while building relationships with external shows, creators, and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Director, Podcast Marketing, you will own campaigns from initial planning and creative development through ad operations, measurement, and reporting. You will translate campaign performance into clear insights that help senior leaders understand what worked and what we should do next.

This position sits within a growing Audience Development function with established systems and active campaigns already in place. The work is currently hands-on and high-volume as we continue to improve and automate our processes. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys owning complex systems, maintaining operational precision, and turning campaign data into a compelling and actionable story.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Book and manage in-network and out-of-network cross-promotional campaigns, including launches for new shows and always-on promotional rotations
  • Own campaign execution details, including flight dates, frequency caps, audience targeting, creative trafficking, and delivery
  • Build and deliver weekly and monthly reports on net-new listeners, conversion, and retention for senior leadership
  • Develop clear performance narratives and recommendations based on campaign data
  • Maintain consistent campaign naming conventions across booking, hosting, and measurement platforms so promotional activity can be accurately matched to results
  • Research and pitch podcasts and YouTube channels for promotional swaps, collaborations, and client guest appearances
  • Manage scheduling and promotional materials, including biographies and headshots, in partnership with client teams, host-show contacts, and Creator Partnerships
  • Maintain the programming calendar for editorial pitches to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, iHeart, and YouTube
  • Track upcoming show moments, platform requirements, and submission lead times to support timely and relevant editorial pitches
  • Help improve and automate campaign workflows, reporting processes, and other repetitive operational tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3–5 years of experience in audience development, marketing operations, campaign management, or ad operations within podcasting, audio, or digital media
  • Hands-on experience booking campaigns in an enterprise podcast hosting and advertising platform
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including experience using pivot tables and lookup functions to create clear reports from raw data exports
  • Familiarity with podcast measurement or attribution platforms such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Strong written communication skills and the confidence to present performance data, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience managing outreach or partnerships, including promotional swaps, guest bookings, creator collaborations, or platform relationships
  • Careful and consistent execution, with the judgment to identify incorrect date ranges, mismatched metrics, or other discrepancies before they reach a final report
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive approach to improving systems, solving operational challenges, and identifying opportunities for audience growth

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Day-to-day experience working with podcast attribution tools such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Previous experience working within a podcast network
  • Listener fluency across podcast genres such as news, true crime, comedy, and sports
  • Working knowledge of SQL or light Python
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and repetitive workflows, including agentic tools such as Claude Code or Codex

The Lead Animator supervises a team of animators in creating and implementing top-tier animation for real time gameplay systems. You will be responsible for managing the creation and delivery of exceptional NPC and player animations while providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and mentorship to your team. You will ensure that production goals are met and that the animation production runs smoothly and efficiently depending on the needs of production.

  • The lead animator guides the animation team in creating expressive, polished, and gameplay‑ready animations that elevate the player experience.
  • This role blends artistic leadership with technical expertise, ensuring that animation quality, style, and performance meet the standards of AAA production.
  • Help design, construct, document and uphold pipeline procedures to deliver competitive, cutting-edge assets.
  • Motivate, mentor and inspire the animation team. Support animators in their career development, while guiding them through various stages of production with clear direction.
  • Coordinate and update the production team on assignments for the animation team.
  • Sync and communicate with other leads and disciplines and help resolve production blockers.  
  • Create, document and communicate guidelines, directories and procedures.
  • Help create gameplay animation content as required, working with mocap data, keyframed animations and facial animations, to set a quality bar for other animators to follow.
  • Create style guides, best‑practice documents, and clear communication channels for the team.

 

Le ou la chef.fe d'équipe de l’animation supervise une équipe d’animateurs et d’animatrices dans la création et l’intégration d’animations de haute qualité pour des usages gameplay en temps réel. Vous serez responsable de gérer la création et la livraison d’animations exceptionnelles pour les PNJ (NPC) et les personnages joueurs, tout en fournissant une direction claire, des commentaires constructifs et du mentorat à votre équipe. Vous veillerez au respect des échéanciers de production et à ce que la production d’animation se déroule de manière fluide et efficace, selon les besoins de la production.

Principales responsabilités :

  • Diriger l’équipe d’animation dans la création d’animations expressives, raffinées et prêtes à être intégrées au gameplay, afin d’enrichir l’expérience des joueurs.
  • Assurer un leadership à la fois artistique et technique pour garantir le respect des standards de qualité, de style et de performance propres aux productions AAA.
  • Contribuer à la conception, à la mise en place, à la documentation et à l’amélioration continue des pipelines d’animation.
  • Mobiliser, encadrer et mentorer les membres de l’équipe, en soutenant leur développement professionnel et en les accompagnant à toutes les étapes de production.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables des autres disciplines afin d’identifier et de résoudre les enjeux de production.

  • Mettre en place des guides de style, des bonnes pratiques et des processus de communication clairs au sein de l’équipe.
  • 7+ years of experience as 3D character animator in video game development, having worked on at least two AAA games.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills and the ability to work within cross-disciplinary teams. Experienced in leading others.
  • Expert knowledge of industry-standard animation tools such as Motionbuilder or Maya.
  • Strong understanding of gameplay-systems and in-game engine workflows.
  • Excellent key frame and mocap animation skills with a great understanding of human motion, body mechanics, biped locomotion and animation principles.
  • Experience with Unreal 5 is a strongly desired asset.

  • Shipped at least one major title as a senior or lead animator.
  • Experience creating scripted events and cutscenes.
  • Experience in developing first-person and third-person gameplay systems and good understanding of 3C concepts
  • Understanding of animation-graph techniques and workflows
  • Experience working on locomotion, occupation, conversation and traversal systems
  • Understanding of camera animation and creation of a cinematic experience
  • Experience in creating creature-, animal- and combat-animations

Exigences essentielles

  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en leadership, avec une capacité démontrée à travailler dans des équipes multidisciplinaires et à encadrer du personnel.

  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes de gameplay ainsi que des processus liés aux moteurs de jeu.

  • Une expérience avec Unreal Engine 5 constitue un atout important.

Atouts

  • Expérience en création d’événements scriptés et de cinématiques.
  • Expérience en développement de systèmes de gameplay à la première et à la troisième personne, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des concepts de « personnage, contrôles et caméra (3C) ».
  • Connaissance des techniques et des processus liés aux graphes d’animation.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de locomotion, d’interaction, de dialogue et de déplacement (traversal).
  • Compréhension des principes d’animation de caméra et de la mise en scène cinématique.
  • Expérience en animation de créatures, d’animaux et de séquences de combat.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Technical Animator (Rigging) you will be creating rigs for characters and animated objects. You will refine skin-weights, work on cloth simulation, and physical objects. As a rigger, you will improve character setups and game engine workflows to overcome the technical challenges associated with creating animations for our games.

  • Skinning of human character meshes, animated props and interactive objects.
  • Setting up physics for cloth objects, accessories and props.
  • Integrating characters into the game and maintaining rigs for DCC and ingame.
  • Find solutions to animation and rig problems. Keep current with the latest animation technologies and trends.
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve animation bugs across tools, pipelines, and in-game setups.
  • Optimize character rigs and animation assets to ensure they meet memory and frame rate performance budgets without compromising visual quality.
  • Sharing knowledge with animators, artists and programmers, and writing technical documents and guidelines.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

En tant qu’animateur technique (Rigging), vous créerez des rigs pour les personnages et les objets animés. Vous peaufinerez les pondérations de skinning, travaillerez sur la simulation de tissus ainsi que sur les objets physiques. En tant que spécialiste du rigging, vous améliorerez les configurations de personnages et les workflows du moteur de jeu afin de relever les défis techniques liés à la création d’animations pour nos jeux.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Effectuer le skinning des maillages de personnages humains, des accessoires animés et des objets interactifs.
  • Configurer la physique pour les objets en tissu, les accessoires et les props.
  • Intégrer les personnages dans le jeu et assurer la maintenance des rigs pour les DCC et dans le jeu.
  • Trouver des solutions aux problèmes d’animation et de rig. Se tenir au courant des plus récentes technologies et tendances en matière d’animation.
  • Examiner, diagnostiquer et résoudre les bogues d’animation dans les outils, les pipelines et les configurations en jeu.
  • Optimiser les rigs de personnages et les assets d’animation afin de respecter les budgets de mémoire et de fréquence d’images sans compromettre la qualité visuelle.
  • Partager ses connaissances avec les membres des équipes d’animation, d’art et de programmation, et rédiger de la documentation technique et des lignes directrices.

Basic Requirements: 

  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in the field of 3D character animation for video games.
  • Excellent technical skills like rigging and skinning as well as a good understanding of the principles of animation.
  • Expertise working with Unreal Engine, Motionbuilder and Maya.
  • Experience in the creation of animations tools and the development of workflows and asset pipelines.
  • Experience with animation retargeting, physics, IK & control-rig, deformers and cloth setup.
  • Experience in the creation of facial rigs.
  • Experience with modular character setups.
  • Good understanding of optimization strategies for video game performance
  • Strong problem-solving skills

Exigences de base : 

  • Un minimum de 4 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de l’animation de personnages 3D pour les jeux vidéo.
  • Excellentes compétences techniques en rigging et en skinning, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des principes de l’animation.
  • Expertise avec Unreal Engine, Motionbuilder et Maya.
  • Expérience dans la création d’outils d’animation et le développement de workflows et de pipelines d’assets.
  • Expérience avec le retargeting d’animation, la physique, l’IK et le control rig, les deformers et la configuration de tissus.
  • Expérience dans la création de rigs faciaux.
  • Expérience avec les configurations de personnages modulaires.
  • Bonne compréhension des stratégies d’optimisation des performances pour les jeux vidéo
  • Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Knowledge of Python script is highly desired.
  • Experience using Metahuman
  • Some experience in writing tools for artists
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within cross-disciplinary teams
  • Experience rigging animals and creature characters as well as interactable objects

  • Collaborate closely with end‑users to understand workflow needs and translate them into practical, user‑friendly tools.
  • Integrate tools with engine systems, asset pipelines, data processing, and automation workflows.
  • Build automation and utilities using Python, C#, or command‑line tools where appropriate.
  • Maintain and improve existing tools to ensure performance, stability, and usability.
  • Debug complex tools issues involving editor systems, file I/O, data validation, and external integrations.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code following established team standards.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to ensure tools scale with project complexity.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and provide input on tools architecture and workflow improvements.
  • Mentor junior programmers through technical guidance and code reviews.

À titre de programmeur senior - Outils, vous êtes responsable de la conception, de l’implémentation et de la maintenance d’outils favorisant une création de contenu et un développement efficaces. Votre travail couvre les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine ainsi que les applications de bureau autonomes, permettant aux équipes d’itérer rapidement et de façon sécuritaire dans le cadre d’une production AAA. Vous prenez en charge des outils complexes et contribuez à l’évolution à long terme des technologies et des workflows liés aux outils.

  • Concevoir, implémenter et maintenir des outils, des extensions d’éditeur et des applications de bureau autonomes.

  • Développer des outils autonomes à l’aide de frameworks tels que Qt, .NET / WPF ou des technologies similaires.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les personnes qui utilisent les outils afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière de workflows et de les traduire en outils pratiques et conviviaux.

The Manager, Product role will spearhead the product side of Enterprise Rights Management, including the strategy, roadmap, operating model, and execution of complex technology initiatives. The role combines senior product leadership, technical product management, and direct people management. It will lead and develop Product Managers and related product resources while partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders.

A primary focus will be the successful implementation and evolution of a modern Rights Management System (RMS), supported by integrated data capabilities, workflow automation, and responsible use of AI. The role must be able to translate business and rights-management needs into clear product direction, technically sound solutions, executable roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership
    • Define and drive the product vision, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and delivery strategy for RMS and the broader Enterprise Rights product portfolio.
    • Translate business objectives, operational pain points, and user needs into product capabilities, investment priorities, and sequenced delivery plans.
    • Provide oversight across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams, balancing strategic priorities, delivery dependencies, risks, and available capacity.
    • Establish clear product governance, decision rights, success measures, and communication practices across the portfolio.
    • Partner with senior stakeholders to align product investments with enterprise technology strategy and business outcomes.
  • Technical Product and Solution Leadership
    • Act as the senior product partner to Engineering, Architecture, Data, and platform teams throughout discovery, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and adoption.
    • Guide product decisions involving SaaS platforms, enterprise integrations, APIs, data models, workflow orchestration, cloud services, security, and scalability.
    • Ensure business requirements are translated into clear product requirements, capabilities, epics, acceptance criteria, and implementation priorities.
    • Establish and reinforce effective use of Jira and Confluence for backlog management, requirements traceability, product documentation, decision tracking, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Challenge assumptions, identify technical and process dependencies early, and help teams make informed tradeoffs across scope, value, timing, risk, and maintainability.
    • Provide product leadership for vendor evaluations, implementation partners, and third-party platforms where applicable.
  • RMS Implementation and Transformation
    • Lead the product side of the RMS implementation, including business alignment, capability definition, prioritization, roadmap management, readiness, and adoption.
    • Coordinate product activities across rights, content acquisition, legal, distribution, finance, operations, engineering, data, and other impacted functions.
    • Ensure RMS delivery is connected to the broader Rights ecosystem, including source systems, downstream consumers, reporting, integrations, and the enterprise data layer.
    • Drive transparent reporting of progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, and required leadership actions.
    • Promote sustainable product practices that support implementation delivery as well as long-term platform ownership and continuous improvement.
  • AI, Data, and Intelligent Automation
    • Define and prioritize opportunities to use AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to improve rights workflows, decision support, data quality, and user experience.
    • Partner with Data, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business teams to evaluate AI use cases and move appropriate concepts from discovery into delivery.
    • Ensure AI-enabled product capabilities are grounded in reliable data, clearly defined business value, measurable outcomes, and responsible governance.
    • Champion reusable data and AI capabilities that complement RMS and strengthen the future-state Rights platform.
    • Monitor relevant technology trends and recommend practical opportunities for innovation without losing focus on core delivery commitments.
  • People Leadership and Product Operating Model
    • Directly manage, coach, and develop Product Managers and other product resources, setting clear expectations, priorities, and development goals.
    • Create a consistent product management operating model across discovery, planning, requirements, delivery, stakeholder engagement, and outcome measurement.
    • Lead the product delivery operating model across Agile teams, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, capacity management, sprint execution, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement, adapting the approach to the needs of each initiative.
    • Assign ownership across initiatives and ensure Product Managers have the context, support, and accountability needed to lead their workstreams.
    • Build a collaborative, high-performing culture focused on customer value, technical credibility, transparency, and execution.
    • Assess team capacity and capability needs and recommend appropriate staffing, role design, and external support when required.
  • Stakeholder, Change, and Executive Communication
    • Serve as a primary product leadership contact for Enterprise Rights and represent the portfolio in cross-functional and leadership forums.
    • Facilitate alignment across business and technology teams, resolve competing priorities, and escalate decisions when necessary.
    • Communicate roadmap status, delivery health, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise and decision-oriented manner.
    • Partner with change-management, training, and operational teams to support adoption and successful transition to new capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, business solutions, technology product leadership, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of direct people-management experience, including coaching and developing product professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise product portfolios or large-scale technology transformations from strategy through implementation.
  • Strong technical fluency and experience partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, and enterprise platform teams.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS implementations, systems integration, APIs, data platforms, cloud services, workflow automation, or related technologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of Agile methodologies and product-delivery practices, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage product backlogs, document requirements and decisions, track delivery, and maintain clear communication across product, engineering, and business teams.
  • Scrum, Agile, or product management certification, such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), SAFe certification, or an equivalent credential, is preferred.
  • Practical understanding of AI-enabled products, automation, analytics, data governance, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational-change skills.
  • Experience in media and entertainment, rights management, licensing, content operations, intellectual property, or a similarly complex domain is strongly preferred.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on delivery leadership.
  • Can move comfortably between business outcomes, product details, and technical discussions.
  • Builds clarity in ambiguous environments and creates structure across complex, interdependent work.
  • Leads through influence while also holding direct accountability for team performance and delivery.
