The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements
  • Lead audits of highly technical areas within applications and infrastructure, security and vulnerability assessments, third party management, identity and access management, change control, asset management, disaster recovery, data privacy, cybersecurity, cloud services, and other emerging technologies
  • Evaluate the design and performance of internal controls and communicate audit and special project findings to management by clearly articulating risk exposure and providing realistic, cost-effective recommendations to mitigate risk and improve operational efficiency
  • Assess risks and controls associated with system implementations, major technology transformations, and pre- and post-implementation reviews
  • Coordinate audit activities with IT and business management while supervising and critically evaluating the performance of audit staff
  • Serve as a primary audit contact for assigned business and technology functions, developing trusted relationships and providing risk-based insights to management and executive teams
  • Perform special assignments, including business process reviews, due diligence activities, investigations, and strategic risk assessments, as directed by the Vice President of Internal Audit
  • Review work completed by staff members to ensure sufficient documentation, quality, and support for audit conclusions
  • Support the Internal Audit Vice President in periodic risk assessments and development of the annual audit plan
  • Draft, edit, and review audit reports, executive summaries, special project reports, and administrative communications
  • Develop the technical, management, and audit capabilities of IT Audit Managers and Staff through coaching, mentoring, and formal development activities
  • Stay informed on emerging risks and trends in cybersecurity, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, media technology, privacy regulations, and technology governance
  • Partner with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen risk management and control environments across the organization
  • Some domestic travel may be required

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive audit experience, including 2+ years of leadership experience in IT audit/accounting 
  • Experience within a top public accounting company, consulting organization, or internal audit function of a large public company preferred
  • Prior IT consulting, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technical operational experience is a plus
  • BS or MS in Information Systems, Accounting, Information Systems Auditing, Computer Science, or a related field required
  • Ability to work successfully with senior business and technology leaders and establish credibility across all levels of the organization
  • Demonstrated team management capabilities, with a track record of developing high-performing audit teams
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex engagements simultaneously
  • Ability to understand the Company’s operational and technology environment, business objectives, key processes, and associated risks
  • Advanced knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity, cloud security controls, infrastructure operations, application development and support, data privacy, and technology risk management practices
  • Experience applying IT and information security frameworks (e.g., NIST, SOX, COBIT) to audit testing and risk assessments
  • Strong comprehension of system development and implementation lifecycle methodologies and related controls
  • Experience auditing automated environments, enterprise applications, cloud technologies, and complex global security and compliance functions
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, and drive successful outcomes in a matrixed organization through collaboration rather than direct authority
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, audit management tools, Microsoft Office applications, and collaboration platforms
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences

Press Operator III

Gannett Publishing Services

Wilmington, Delaware

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking an experienced, technically rigorous Senior IT Systems Engineer to join our IT Systems team. In this role, you will serve as a primary technical lead responsible for the design, deployment, administration, and optimization of NPR’s core virtualized data center infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise in VMware vSphere, enterprise Storage Area Networks (SAN/NAS), and Cisco Unified Computing System (UCS) environments.

You will play a critical role in ensuring the high availability, scalability, performance, and security of our enterprise systems while partnering across Technology to advance infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives in support of our nationwide public media mission.

Responsibilities

Data Center Architecture & Storage Administration

  1. Architect Virtualized Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core virtualized data center infrastructure, leading enterprise VMware vSphere environments, Cisco UCS compute platforms, and SAN/NAS storage arrays.
  2. Administer Enterprise Compute & Storage: Execute routine server builds, security patch management, virtual machine lifecycle administration, and enterprise storage capacity allocation.
  3. Advance Cloud & Hybrid Integration: Evaluate systems architecture and hybrid-cloud strategy, taking operational ownership of the maintenance and integration of cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).

Systems Governance & Disaster Recovery

  1. Govern Disaster Recovery Strategies: Design, maintain, and rigorously test business continuity and disaster recovery strategies, including enterprise backups, data replication, and automated site failovers.
  2. Manage Structured Change Processes: Recommend, test, and implement system enhancements in strict adherence to established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  3. Publish System Documentation & SOPs: Author and maintain comprehensive systems architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and technical documentation for IT colleagues and system stakeholders.

Incident Escalation & Operational Automation

  1. Lead Tier-3 Escalations & Root Cause Analysis: Serve as the senior technical escalation point for enterprise technology teams, isolating root causes and resolving complex production incidents.
  2. Automate Infrastructure Operations: Design and execute automation scripts using modern scripting languages to streamline routine administrative tasks, infrastructure provisioning, and systems health reporting.
  3. Maintain Operational Communications: Provide timely status reporting on system health to engineering leadership, manage incident response on a 24x7 rotation, and articulate outage impact clearly to technical and operational partners.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Systems or Infrastructure Engineer supporting, administering, and troubleshooting systems in an enterprise data center environment.
  • Proven, hands-on experience designing and managing complex VMware vSphere environments (clustering, DRS, HA, vMotion).
  • Extensive experience with Cisco UCS Manager, configuring service profiles, templates, and physical hardware deployment.
  • Strong background in configuring and managing enterprise SAN/NAS storage arrays and storage networking protocols.
  • 2+ years of experience planning, designing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
  • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Windows Server (2016+), Active Directory, Azure AD, Office 365, IIS, SQL, DFS, DHCP, and DNS.
  • Experience creating detailed systems documentation and flow charts.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to successfully handle multiple projects in a high-pressure, collaborative environment.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and a 2-week onsite rotation every two months (or as required).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Infrastructure Automation & Scripting: Experience utilizing configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet) and writing automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, or Bash).
  • Identity, Access & Messaging Services: Practical experience managing enterprise SSO/MFA solutions, Exchange Online/Hybrid environments, or Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).
  • Industry Certifications: Active professional certifications in VMware (VCP), Cisco (CCNA/CCNP Data Center), Microsoft, or AWS/Azure solutions architecture.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Expert-level analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex hardware, software, and performance issues under pressure.
  • Deep understanding of networking concepts (VLANs, routing, switching, LACP, DNS, DHCP) as they relate to virtualization and server infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of security best practices for data center infrastructure and virtualization platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating technical challenges to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead infrastructure upgrades and migrations independently.
  • Self-motivated team player with a willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and perform after-hours maintenance.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location for a two-week block approximately every two months. The employee will also be  expected to be onsite as needed to support onsite projects.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $125,000 - $145,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

Why This Role Matters

 

This role ensures that the Chief Product Officer (CPO) can operate at their highest level by keeping their schedules organized, aligned, and free of conflicts. job.title: Desktop & A/V Support Engineer
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #


Job overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented individual with strong Mac devices and Audio Visual skills. This role will be part of our existing team of desktop engineers, primarily focused on Macs and Audio Visual support, with a secondary focus on Windows support.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer prioritizes and ensures timely responses and resolutions to requests and incidents for our Mac and conference room users. This role will provide IT support for hardware and business applications while also supporting AV functions such as video conferencing and events with AV components. Additionally, the Desktop & A/V Support Engineer will shift and adjust priorities based on changing business needs in our dynamic environment, while also remaining task-oriented to ensure completion of work from start to finish with appropriate solutions. This role will provide high-touch concierge support for senior ASCAP executives.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer within the Global Technology Solutions department is based in our New York office and reports to the Director, Support Services. This position is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex Mac/PC hardware and software issues with a focus on device security.
  • Support and continually review enterprise Mac/PC client hardware / software standards and strategy.
  • Support client OS, application, mobile, virus, and hardware issues for users.
  • Design, implement, and maintain both Mac desktop group policy using JAMF and PC desktop group policy using BigFix and Intune.
  • Support and troubleshoot conferencing systems including platforms such as Webex, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, as well as hardware room systems.
  • Support the AV production at internal & external events.
  • Work with vendors to design and maintain hardware and software standards.
  • Develop automated workflows and technologies to efficiently manage Mac endpoints.
  • Maintain an inventory database, assign hardware and software assets, and manage warranty and service agreement information.
  • Assist with root cause analysis as it relates to Apple/PC computers and all peripheral devices.
  • Interact with IT and AV vendors, and management, to ensure solutions are being provided for all escalating tickets.
  • Independently resolve complex, break/fix issues in person or via telephone.
  • Be available as needed and provide high-touch technical support to onsite and remote members of ASCAP Senior Management.
  • Write, maintain and implement systems documentation for incident responses and recurring issues.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, or a related field preferred.
  • Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) and/or Apple Certified IT Professional (ACITP) Certifications preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant working experience, including troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex Mac/MS and PC hardware and software issues.
  • Ability to communicate seamlessly and work productively with peers and senior management.
  • Experience with Mac endpoint patching platforms and administration procedures using JAMF.
  • Experience supporting Webex, Zoom, MS Teams, and Google Meet.
  • Experience supporting AV production environments and events.
  • Experience with Microsoft desktop imaging and distribution platforms such as Intune and BigFix.
  • Hands-on desktop support experience in a large enterprise environment preferred.
  • Experience working with anti-virus platforms preferred.
  • In-depth understanding of Mac based hardware, software, and peripherals.
  • Experience with Cisco conferencing hardware including room kits, boards, and peripherals.
  • Shell scripting experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, adjusting set shift hours or days when needed.
  • Ability to travel to other satellite offices when needed.
  • Interest in audio engineering and event production is a plus.
  • This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office three days per week.

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network

job.title: Identity Operations Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. Job Summary:

As a key member of the UMG Operations Center, the Identity Operations Engineer operates and continuously improves UMG’s hybrid identity, access, authentication, privileged-access, and identity-governance services. The role provides specialist operational support across Workday-driven identity lifecycle processes, Saviynt/IGA, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, MFA, PAM, enterprise application integrations, and connected services.


The position will be a team player working to maintain reliable identity integrations and resolve operational issues involving joiners, movers, leavers, contractors, rejoiners, application access, entitlements, authentication, privileged accounts, and non-human identities. The role includes incident, request, change, problem, access-review, audit-evidence, monitoring, and automation activities. The role partners closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud, Observability, ITSM, security, regional IT teams, and external providers. Effective communication skills are a must, all while being sensitive to a wide diversity of cultural and technical backgrounds in a global business environment.


Job Functions:

  • Apply least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, secure administration, and identity-governance best practices to protect UMG information resources from unauthorized use, inappropriate access, disclosure, damage, or loss.
  • Troubleshoot and resolves issues related to identities, systems, access, accounts, authentication, authorization, entitlements, and permissions.
  • Investigate and resolve specialist escalations from AD Services and TechOps IAM queues, including application-role access, SecAdmin access, reference-user comparisons, disabled application accounts, access removals, and entitlement issues.
  • Provide ITIL-based operational support across identity services, including incident, request, change, problem, and major-incident participation. Maintain clear ServiceNow assignment, evidence, troubleshooting notes, resolution details, and closure criteria.
  • Operate and troubleshoot identity lifecycle integrations, including joiner, mover, leaver, contractor, rehire/rejoiner, and exception scenarios. Investigate failed provisioning tasks, reconciliation issues, orphaned accounts, and mismatches between authoritative HR data, IGA records, directories, and target applications.
  • Support Workday-driven lifecycle processes and Saviynt/IGA workflows, including access requests, approvals, entitlement ownership, access reviews, remediation, audit evidence, and provisioning/reconciliation failures.
  • Operate and support on-premises and cloud identity services and their configuration, including Active Directory domain services, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Duo, YubiKey/FIDO/PIV authentication, CyberArk/PAM, Saviynt/IGA, Splunk, Active Roles where applicable, PingOne/Aura where applicable, 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, and connected enterprise applications.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Entra enterprise applications and federation integrations, including SAML, OIDC/OAuth, claims, redirect URIs, app registrations, group assignments, Conditional Access, Microsoft Graph, certificates, and token/authentication failures.
  • Support privileged and non-human identities, including elevated accounts, service accounts, application accounts, RPA accounts, resource/test accounts, B2B/guest identities, and accounts requiring vault onboarding, password rotation, or ownership validation.
  • Support MFA and authentication operations, including Duo, YubiKey, FIDO/PIV, recovery/reset workflows, OAuth-token issues, and authentication failures across workforce and application services.
  • Complete the key metric reporting and analysis for the Identity Management environment as required.
  • Work to ensure audit tasks related to Identity Management are completed on time, with participation of appropriate parties. Maintain auditable evidence for access approvals, reviews, privileged access, lifecycle actions, exceptions, and remediation.
  • Participate in security incident response teams as needed, including identity compromise, suspicious authentication, privileged-access, credential, and account-containment activities.
  • Utilize industry best practices for appropriate standards, processes, procedures, tools, and documentation.
  • Ensure the maintenance, patching, operating, and monitoring of IAM systems is in place and completed on schedule. Use Splunk and observability service dashboards to identify failures, trends, and emerging operational risk.
  • Maintain accurate ServiceNow CMDB relationships for identity services, configuration items, application integrations, owners, support groups, and dependencies; identify and report stale or incomplete CMDB data.
  • Participate in developing automation to reduce the time spent on routine tasks.
  • This is a shift-based role supporting UMG’s 24/7 follow-the-sun Technical Operations Center. The role participates in scheduled shifts, weekend/public-holiday coverage, on-call rotation, and structured handoffs with regional operations teams

Essential:

  • Solid technical skills in the Identity Management space, including Active Directory and Entra ID.
  • Minimum of five years directly related experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • A strong ability for troubleshooting and problem analysis is required, along with the ability to clearly communicate the results of problem analysis to business stakeholders, IT support teams, and network providers to quickly and effectively resolve operational issues.
  • Experience troubleshooting and solving issues related to identities, systems, access, accounts, authentication, authorization, entitlements, and permissions
  • Hands-on experience operating and supporting Active Directory and Entra ID, including directory services, delegated administration, group policy, OUs, sites/replication, identity synchronization, enterprise applications, federation, Conditional Access, and authentication.
  • Hands-on experience with Saviynt or another IGA platform, including access requests, approvals, entitlement administration, access reviews, failed-task remediation, reconciliation, and audit evidence.
  • Experience with identity lifecycle integrations from an authoritative HR source such as Workday, including joiner/mover/leaver, contractor, rehire, and exception handling.
  • Customer service driven/focused with a proactive and positive can-do approach. Demonstrates commitment to organization’s policy framework and practices continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience and skills with systems such as M365 and ServiceNow are required. Experience using ServiceNow for IAM incidents, requests, changes, knowledge, evidence, assignment groups, and CMDB relationships is required.
  • Demonstrated current work experience supporting integrated IAM solutions such as Entra ID, Active Roles where applicable, Duo, PKI, and CyberArk/PAM
  • Working knowledge of site-reliability/operational-engineering principles, monitoring, automation, and safe use of AI-assisted tools.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Solid written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills

Desirable:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, a closely related field, or comparable education and experience.
  • Experience with at least two of the following is desirable: PingOne/Aura, 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, Microsoft Graph, SAML/OIDC/OAuth, enterprise application onboarding, or secrets/service-account rotation.
  • Experience integrating or troubleshooting ServiceNow orchestration with identity platforms, directories, SaaS applications, or enterprise applications is desirable.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 identity, group, collaboration, and federation dependencies.
  • Experience using PowerShell, Python, JSON/REST, Microsoft Graph, SQL, or comparable scripting/API technologies for IAM automation and troubleshooting. Legacy Java, SOAP, or database experience
  • IT Certifications including MCSE Certification specialization in Identity Management, Certified Access Management Specialist (CAMS), and ITIL Foundations certifications desired
  • International experience beneficial; multiple language skills a plus

job.title: Senior Director of Analytics
job.description:
Company And Culture

Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.

Why We're Hiring

Data and analytics are critical to how Complex makes decisions, but this role is about much more than dashboards, reporting, or tracking KPIs. We’re looking for a senior analytics leader who can turn complex, imperfect data into clear business insights and strategic action.

Complex operates across eCommerce, Content, Advertising, and Live Events, creating a uniquely rich—and often complicated—data environment. Understanding how these businesses work individually, and how they intersect, is a core part of the opportunity. The right person will embrace that complexity, quickly identify what matters, and help leadership make better decisions across the organization.

This role requires a strategic thinker who can move fluidly between high-level business questions and detailed analysis. You will partner directly with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, solve important business problems, and determine where data can have the greatest impact. You will be expected to use AI and emerging analytics tools to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive work, explore new questions, and move from question to insight to action faster.

The goal isn't to build more dashboards. The goal is to help Complex make better decisions and drive better business outcomes.

This role will be on-site 5 days a week at our NYC office or our Los Angeles, CA office.

job.title: Editorial Data Analyst
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join our Editorial Analytics team. You’ll use data to help understand how our journalism reaches and engages readers, and supports decision making across the newsroom and wider business. 

 

About the role

  • Provide insights on reader engagement and content performance to inform newsroom strategy.
  • Develop an understanding of editorial workflows, audience behaviour and business priorities, and apply this context when interpreting data.
  • Communicate findings clearly, tailoring outputs to different audiences and explaining context and limitations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering and other teams to support feature development, experimentation and performance analysis.
  • Work responsibly and ethically with data, following privacy and governance standards.

 

About you

  • Experience working with data using SQL (in a professional or academic setting).
  • Understanding of core analytical concepts (e.g. averages, distributions, basic statistical testing).
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker).
  • Ability to think logically about problems and break them down into manageable analyses.
  • Comfortable working with stakeholders and building positive working relationships.

We operate in a hybrid environment working 3 days a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 2 days a week remotely. 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV. You don't need to provide a cover letter. Instead, we have included a question on the application questionnaire relating to editorial analytics that we would like applicants to complete. This question should take about 5 minutes to answer, so please factor in the extra time when applying.

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process. 

 

The closing date for applications is Wednesday 18th November 2026. 

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers on anna.vipers@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

Opportunity  

Our Brunswick Arts team, known as B’Arts, is an international communications consultancy specialising in championing and protecting the reputations and interests of leading arts, cultural and charitable organisations worldwide. With teams in London, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, New York and Hong Kong, we work alongside some of the most prestigious institutions and exciting initiatives across the global cultural landscape.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and adaptable Executive Assistant to join our London team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is a pivotal role providing high-level support to two Partners, ensuring the smooth running of their day-to-day activities and anticipating their needs in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The role is based in our London office Monday to Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. The ideal candidate will be a confident self-starter who thrives in a creative and collaborative environment, bringing exceptional organisational skills, sound judgement, discretion and a genuine interest in the arts and cultural sector.

As an Executive Assistant at Brunswick Arts, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive diary, inbox, and communications management for two Partners.
  • Organise and maintain Partner inboxes and diaries with a clear, structured system, using colour coordination and folders to ensure efficiency and visibility.

Qualifications

  • Expertise in user experience (UX) and digital product design.
  • Digital strategy or marketing experience an asset.

job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

job.title: GRAY MEDIA TRAINING PROGRAM SPRING '27 - KWCH
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KWCH:

KWCH-TV (12 News) is a CBS television affiliate operated by Gray Television with one of the best corporate and local cultures in the country. Our top-rated station is located in the beautiful south-central region of Kansas. KWCH-TV is the market leader, with viewers relying on news and weather coverage. Along with strong programming ratings, the #1 website, CBS Sports, and CBS Primetime, we deliver results for our advertisers.

The Training Program:

Are you tired of just watching from the sidelines? Ready to stop "shadowing" and start actually doing the work that reaches thousands of people every single day? We’re looking for the next generation of media powerhouses, producers, reporters, weather experts, and sales executives who are hungry to dive head-first into the fast-paced world of local media. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job; you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award -winning team from day one. The intern rate of pay can range from the minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

General Requirements: 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online). 
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen; think social media, streaming apps, and web stories—because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook. 
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies.
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 113 stations.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand. 
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift. 
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence. 
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule. 
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn—this is a paid internship.
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

Qualifications/Requirements: 

▪️ Be currently enrolled in a college/university (preferred: Junior/Senior)
▪️ Strong work ethic and organizational skills
▪️ Earning a degree in Journalism/Communications, News, or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media industry

If you are interested in interning in these areas, the station may have openings in these departments for you:

- Sports
- Weather
- News MMJ

Ready to stop practicing and start performing? Let’s build the future of media together

The intern rate of pay can range from the minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

▪️ Interested in the program?  Go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, type "KWCH" (in the search bar)

job.title: Assistant News Director
job.description:
WFRV-TV is seeking an experienced, dynamic, transformative Assistant News Director to help lead the day-to day operations of our newsroom.

 

This is a key leadership role for an accomplished journalist who is passionate about news, storytelling, innovation and developing people. The Assistant News Director will help drive daily content, guide coverage decisions and champion strong breaking news coverage across television and digital platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced newsroom leader with excellent news judgment and a passion for developing compelling stories. This person will work closely with reporters on story development while collaborating with producers to create distinctive, engaging newscasts that serve our audience.

 

You will be responsible for the production of local programs, including holiday parades, July 4 Fireworks and Nexstar assigned specials. 

 

The Assistant News Director must be a strong leader who can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure newsroom while remaining calm and focused. A digital-first, 24/7 mindset is essential, along with a willingness to embrace new technology and innovative ways of reaching our audience.

 

The Assistant News Director will work in close partnership with the News Director and will play an important role in mentoring, coaching and providing daily feedback to the newsroom staff.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help lead the day-to-day operations of the newsroom.
  • Work closely with the News Director to establish daily coverage priorities and long-term content strategies.
  • Drive breaking news coverage across on-air, digital and social platforms.
  • Guide reporters and producers in developing strong, compelling stories.
  • Work with producers to create distinctive and engaging newscasts.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship and constructive daily feedback to newsroom staff.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable and creative newsroom culture.
  • Monitor developing news and make sound editorial decisions under deadline pressure.
  • Embrace a digital-first approach to news coverage and audience engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to use technology and new storytelling tools to enhance coverage.
  • Help lead and develop a large newsroom staff.
  • Adjust schedules and priorities as news demands change.
  • Participate in newsroom management and leadership responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of broadcast newsroom management experience.
  • Strong producing background with a demonstrated understanding of newscast execution.
  • Excellent news judgment and editorial decision-making skills.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach and motivate a large staff.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills.
  • Strategic approach to building content and developing innovative storytelling.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social news operations.
  • Passion for journalism, storytelling and serving the community.
  • Willingness to embrace emerging technology and new approaches to news delivery.
  • Flexibility to work varied schedules and be available for breaking news and coverage needs.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Communications, Journalism or a related field preferred.

 

WFRV and Nexstar Media Inc. are an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Manager, Production Finance
job.description:
Tennis Channel’s Production Finance Manager manages day-to-day production accounting and financial analysis for domestic and international production activities. Reporting to the Director of Production Finance, the role supports live events, studio productions, original content, and digital initiatives through accurate close, event cost reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial controls. The manager works closely with Production, FP&A, and Accounting, coordinating broader accounting requirements with the Director of Accounting. This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

In this role, you will do the following:

  • Manage the production-related monthly close in accordance with corporate deadlines, including production and program costs by line of business, prepaid assets, accrued liabilities, amortization entries, and account reconciliations. Maintain job-cost schedules and supporting calculations; reconcile production records to the general ledger and investigate discrepancies.
  • Support the Director of Production Finance in preparing annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, long-range planning schedules, variance analyses, and monthly reporting packages for Finance and Production leadership.
  • Maintain event-level estimates of total expected costs, incorporating actual spending, outstanding commitments, and remaining costs. Review assumptions with Production, explain cost drivers, and escalate potential overruns, forecast changes, and financial risks promptly.
  • Track production costs, vendor obligations, talent commitments, and open purchase orders. Prepare recurring event cost reports and post-event analyses, including budget-to-actual comparisons and recommendations for future planning.
  • Review crew payroll, timecards, overtime, labor coding, and related production labor costs for accuracy, budget impact, supporting documentation, and required approvals. Coordinate exceptions with Production, HR, and payroll providers in accordance with established responsibilities and approval authority.
  • Review production payables, purchasing card activity, employee expense reimbursements, and per diem payments for appropriate coding, documentation, approvals, and compliance with policy. Approve transactions within delegated authority and coordinate with Corporate AP and expense systems, including Concur.
  • Support financial review of production agreements and vendor commitments for cost tracking, accounting treatment, payment timing, and budget impact. Escalate exceptions to the Director of Production Finance and coordinate technical accounting questions with the Director of Accounting.
  • Serve as a day-to-day finance contact for Production on project setup, chart of accounts, transactional workflows, policies, and procedures. Coordinate with Production on financial requirements while Production retains responsibility for talent, hotel, and crew booking and operational logistics.
  • Prepare production-related audit schedules and supporting documentation, coordinating submissions and requests through the Director of Accounting. Support Corporate tax requests related to production, including international costs and tax/VAT documentation, as directed by Accounting and Corporate Tax.
  • Coordinate production accounting priorities, close deadlines, and supporting work with Finance and Accounting team members. Maintain clear process documentation, reporting calendars, and follow-up on unresolved items.
  • Improve production accounting, forecasting, and reporting processes through standardized templates, reconciliations, and approved automation and AI-enabled tools. Maintain cost benchmarks, savings trackers, and operational metrics across vendors, staffing, travel, and other production spending.
  • Support production-related corporate initiatives, parent-company integration, and system upgrades under the Director of Production Finance, coordinating with the Director of Accounting and VP Finance/Controller as appropriate.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or a relevant master’s degree preferred.
  • Five to seven years of progressive accounting or finance experience, including hands-on budgeting, forecasting, production or project job costing, monthly close, and reconciliations.
  • Experience in live sports, production finance, entertainment, or media preferred; familiarity with domestic and international production costs is valuable.
  • Ability to build and maintain event cost forecasts, analyze actuals and commitments, and translate financial results into clear explanations for production managers and Finance leadership.
  • Strong understanding of accrual accounting, financial controls, production labor and vendor cost review.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and financial modeling; experience with Oracle or a comparable ERP/project accounting system preferred.
  • Strong communication, organization, and judgment; ability to manage competing deadlines, work independently, collaborate across teams, and deliver accurate work with appropriate review.
  • Experience documenting processes and improving reporting workflows; familiarity with BI tools and approved automation is a plus.

job.title: Manager, AI Engineering and Vendor Operations
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR's AI Labs team is looking for a Manager of AI Engineering and Vendor Operations. This person will serve on the AI Labs leadership team and help inform NPR's AI technical strategy. We are seeking a player-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build-versus-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work-life balance.

Responsibilities

  • People Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth.
  • Delivery: Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders.
  • Engineering Standards: Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team.
  • Code Quality and Architecture: Review designs and code, and contribute hands-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards.
  • Testing and Evaluation: Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team.
  • Production Support: Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow-up reviews to prevent repeat problems.
  • Vendor Evaluation: Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner.
  • NPR-wide AI Tool Review: Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve.
  • Vendor Relationships: Take over day-to-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. 
  • Responsible Scaling: Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them.
  • 2+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers.
  • Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards.
  • Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews.
  • Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Hands-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Experience working across technical and non-technical teams, including explaining technical and cost trade-offs to people without a technical background and working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution.
  • Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team.
  • Experience designing harnesses for AI coding agents, including permissions, approval steps, and automated checks.
  • Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search.
  • Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation
  • Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama.
  • Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat-based and usage-based pricing.
  • Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role include duties that are better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office, preferably at the Washington, DC location, at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of onsite days they choose.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $180,000 - 206,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

Job Title: Vice President, Strategy

The Global Strategy team is a cross-functional group working across Recorded Music and Music Publishing, sitting at the intersection of creative and corporate operations. The team serves as a trusted partner to senior leadership at WMG, focusing on high-impact strategic projects, data analysis, and execution.

Serve as a key member of the Global Strategy team, partnering with the EVP, Global Head of Strategy and senior leaders across Warner Music Group to drive the successful execution of company-wide strategic priorities and transformations.


Lead high-impact enterprise strategic initiatives that enhance business performance, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. This role involves collaborating with diverse departments globally and in multiple countries to build strategic direction. The position translates vision into actionable plans supported by clear decision frameworks, data-driven insights, and important metrics.


Success in this role requires exceptional analytical capabilities, robust program management skills, and outstanding communication. The ideal candidate will build trusted relationships, influence senior collaborators, secure agreement from business operators, and translate complex business challenges into practical, actionable solutions.

Have Strategic Impact

  • Partner with executive management to assist in the development and execution of Warner Music Group’s global strategic priorities.
  • Lead strategic analysis to evaluate business opportunities, organisational efficiency, organizational frameworks, and long-term growth initiatives.
  • Convert complex business challenges into clear, data-driven recommendations and arguments that support executive decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic programmes from planning through implementation, ensuring delivery against agreed objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Establish effective programme governance, delivery plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and success measures.
  • Design and evaluate target operating models, including organisational structures, functional design, role scoping and span-and-layer analysis, to support sustainable growth and organisational effectiveness.
  • Build alignment across global functions and international markets, influencing collaborators and securing agreement to ensure the effective implementation of pivotal initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted strategic partner, providing insight, challenge and recommendations to the highest levels of management.

  • Support the development, tracking and reporting of strategic objectives, OKRs, KPIs and programme performance measures.
  • Partner with Business Intelligence, Finance and other functional teams to ensure reporting provides meaningful, actionable insights that support business decisions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure central initiatives are delivered efficiently and effectively.
  • Find opportunities to improve business processes, governance, operating models and overall organisational efficiency, enabling greater scalability across the organisation.
  • Promote consistency, collaboration and continuous improvement across project development and programme execution.

  • Have at least 8 years of relevant experience within a leading management consulting firm and/or a corporate strategy, strategic transformation, or business operations function.

job.description:
Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500? We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.

· Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.

· Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.

· Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.

· Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.

· Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.

· Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.

o Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear, actionable architecture and technical design documentation.

job.title: Database Administrator III
job.description:
Want to be part of a team that keeps AccuWeather's critical database environments reliable, secure, performant, and available around the clock for a global audience? We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator with deep hands-on expertise in SQL Server and PostgreSQL who can take ownership of the health and reliability of our production database systems while helping modernize our database infrastructure for the future. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this role will serve as a hands-on database administration expert responsible for the day-to-day operational health and long-term reliability of AccuWeather's database environments. Key responsibilities include performance tuning and optimization, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, capacity planning, monitoring and maintenance, and incident and root-cause analysis. The DBA will work closely with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish strong database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns. This role will also play an important part in the migration of select backend databases to cloud-based environments, helping assess existing workloads, plan and execute migrations, optimize databases for their target environments, and ensure appropriate performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition. It is an opportunity to combine deep database administration expertise with meaningful involvement in the continued modernization of AccuWeather's data infrastructure.

 

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Administer SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases end to end — performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategy, and execution plan analysis.

· Design, implement, and regularly test backup, replication, and disaster recovery procedures for databases, ensuring high availability across production environments.

· Manage database security — roles, permissions, access control, and auditing.

· Monitor and plan for database capacity — storage growth, connection pooling, and resource allocation.

· Manage database version upgrades, patching cycles, and configuration tuning.

· Perform routine database maintenance — index/statistics upkeep, vacuuming, storage optimization, and space reclamation — to sustain performance over time.

· Proactively monitor database health and performance, identifying and resolving issues before they affect production.

job.title: Senior Lightning Scientist
job.description:
The Senior Lightning Scientist is a subject-matter expert responsible for advancing AccuWeather’s lightning detection, analysis, and interpretation capabilities. This role combines deep scientific understanding of lightning physics with practical expertise in RF systems, sensor networks, and algorithm development. The Senior Lightning Scientist plays a critical role in improving lightning detection accuracy, developing new methodologies, guiding technical strategy, and collaborating across science, engineering, and product teams to deliver industry-leading lightning intelligence products.

Working closely with data science, hardware, and software engineering teams, this role drives innovation in lightning detection technologies, signal processing, and real-time analysis systems that support AccuWeather’s operational, commercial, and public safety offerings.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a technical and scientific authority on lightning physics, detection methodologies, and operational interpretation.
  • Lead the development, evaluation, and improvement of lightning detection algorithms using techniques such as TOA, TDOA, interferometry, and hybrid approaches.
  • Analyze RF signals across relevant frequency bands used in lightning detection, including waveform characterization, noise mitigation, and signal classification.
  • Collaborate with hardware and electrical engineering teams on sensor design, RF front-end considerations, antenna design, placement, and calibration strategies.
  • Develop and refine signal processing pipelines for real-time and post-processed lightning data.
  • Design, test, and validate algorithms for lightning geolocation, flash clustering, classification (e.g., CG vs IC), and quality control.
  • Evaluate network performance, detection efficiency, location accuracy, and timing precision using ground truth and statistical methods.
  • Contribute to the integration of lightning data into forecasting, nowcasting, severe weather detection, and machine learning systems.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to scientists and engineers working on lightning-related systems.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, system limitations, and scientific findings for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with product, operations, and research teams to translate scientific advances into scalable, customer-facing solutions.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (PhD or MS with significant experience) in Atmospheric Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Geophysics, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of lightning physics, electromagnetic emissions from lightning, and storm electrification processes.
  • Strong background in RF systems, signal processing, and spectral analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with lightning detection techniques such as TOA, TDOA, interferometry, or related geolocation methods.
  • Proficiency in algorithm development and data analysis using Python, C++, or similar scientific computing environments.
  • Experience working with large-scale, real-time observational data systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing or working directly with lightning detection hardware, sensors, or ground-based networks.
  • Background in antenna theory, antenna design, and RF propagation effects.
  • Familiarity with FPGA, SDR, or embedded systems used in RF signal acquisition.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
  • Published research or patents related to lightning detection, RF sensing, or atmospheric electricity.
  • Experience collaborating with operational forecasting or severe weather teams.
  • Familiarity with machine learning applications applied to lightning or RF signal classification.
