job.title: Alert Team Lead I
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

SiriusXM Connect (SiriusXM CV) is a leading provider of connected services to vehicle manufacturers, delivering one of the most broadly adopted connected vehicle platforms in North America for the last 25 years. Named the 2020 Company of the Year in the Telematics Industry by Frost & Sullivan, we provide safety, security and convenience services to millions of vehicle owners across major automotive brands. Our teams are continuously working to develop leading-edge technology that can not only add convenience to the daily lives of so many drivers across the country but our advancements in safety and security could also help save their lives.


How you’ll make an impact:
As an Alert Team Lead I, you will play a critical role in supporting the daily operations of the SiriusXM Connect Help Desk and Response Center. This position serves as a second-level support resource for contact center agents, internal business partners, and external customers. The Alert Team Lead I is responsible for resolving complex customer escalations, troubleshooting technical and service-related issues, coordinating with internal support teams, and assisting with time-sensitive safety and security requests.

You will also provide guidance to frontline agents, support operational processes, and help ensure customer concerns are handled accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established procedures. Success in this role requires strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, attention to detail,
and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do:

Operational Support & Escalation Management
• Serve as a second-level support resource for contact center agents, internal departments and external customers.
• Research, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer concerns involving connected vehicle services, account management, billing, enrollment, and service delivery.
• Handle escalated customer interactions professionally, demonstrating empathy, accountability, and effective de-escalation techniques.
• Provide real-time guidance to frontline agents to support accurate issue resolution and minimize unnecessary escalations.

• Assist with complex service requests, including account adjustments, refund research, subscription issues, and other operational activities.
• Manage multiple priorities while maintaining service quality, accuracy, and responsiveness.

Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Management
• Investigate technical issues involving connected vehicle functionality, remote services, provisioning, enrollment, and system-related errors.
• Research account information, service history, system activity, and technical errors to identify potential causes and appropriate next steps.
• Create, document, monitor, and escalate technical support tickets through established incident management processes.
• Collaborate with internal technical teams to investigate system defects, service interruptions, and recurring technical issues.
• Communicate known system issues, approved workarounds, and troubleshooting procedures to frontline agents and operational teams.
• Follow up on unresolved technical issues and provide timely updates to appropriate stakeholders.

Safety, Security & Stolen Vehicle Support
• Support Stolen Vehicle Location (SVL) requests in accordance with established company procedures and security requirements.
• Coordinate with law enforcement agencies, Public Safety Answering Points (PSAPs), and authorized third parties when handling specialized or time-sensitive requests.
• Assist with exigent requests, missing/endangered person cases, and other safety-related escalations as authorized by company policy.
• Verify required information and documentation while maintaining customer privacy and compliance with established procedures.
• Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to support timely and accurate handling of safety and security requests.
• Maintain accurate case documentation and follow established escalation and
communication protocols.

Agent Support, Quality & Development
• Provide guidance and support to contact center agents regarding complex procedures, troubleshooting, and customer escalations.
• Reinforce established processes, service standards, and customer experience
expectations.
• Identify recurring agent knowledge gaps and communicate coaching or training opportunities to leadership.
• Assist with quality monitoring, interaction reviews, and performance feedback as assigned.
• Support new and existing agents by sharing knowledge, clarifying procedures, and promoting consistent service delivery.

• Contribute to achieving operational performance, service quality, and customer satisfaction objectives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Support
• Partner with Account Managers and internal business teams to research customer concerns and support client relationships.
• Provide accurate updates regarding escalated issues, service tickets, and operational concerns.
• Collaborate with technical support teams, operations, and other departments to resolve issues affecting customers or service delivery.
• Communicate process changes, system updates, and operational guidance to
appropriate teams.
• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce repeat contacts, and enhance operational efficiency.

Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
• Maintain accurate and complete documentation of customer interactions, escalations, service tickets, and operational activities.
• Assist with operational reporting, quality reviews, audits, and special projects as assigned.
• Monitor recurring issues and identify trends that may require additional investigation or process improvements.
• Support compliance with established policies, procedures, privacy requirements, and quality standards.
• Perform administrative duties and other responsibilities as assigned by leadership.

What You'll Need:

Required Qualifications
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Minimum of one year of experience in a fast-paced customer service or contact center environment.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex information clearly and professionally.
• Demonstrated customer service skills, including empathy, active listening, conflict resolution, and de-escalation.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to research complex issues, exercise sound judgment, and determine appropriate resolution or escalation paths.
• Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
• Willingness to learn new technologies, systems, and operational procedures.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and cross-functional partners.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and other standard business applications.
• Must have legal authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications
• One to two years of operations, customer service leadership, or contact center support experience.
• Experience providing agent guidance, coaching, training, or second-level operational support.
• Familiarity with contact center performance metrics, quality standards, and escalation procedures.
• Experience with customer relationship management (CRM), ticketing, or incident management systems.
• Familiarity with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Genesys, or similar applications.
• Technical troubleshooting experience involving connected services, mobile applications, account provisioning, or system-related issues.
• Knowledge of automotive connected vehicle services, safety and security operations, or telematics.
• Experience working with internal technical teams, external business partners, or law enforcement agencies.

Key Competencies
• Customer Focus & Accountability.
• Technical Troubleshooting & Critical Thinking.
• Communication & De-escalation.
• Operational Excellence & Attention to Detail.
• Leadership & Team Collaboration.
• Adaptability & Continuous Improvement.
• Sound Judgment & Confidentiality.

job.description:

Why it Matters: Business Development Associates help shape where and how Axios pursues new business. Through industry expertise, account intelligence, and close collaboration with Client Partners, BDAs translate market opportunities into focused prospecting strategies and meaningful conversations with prospective advertisers. Their work strengthens pipeline quality, expands our reach into priority markets, and increases the team’s capacity to develop and grow advertising partnerships.

Go deeper: As a BDA, you will develop and execute business-development initiatives across assigned industries, markets, or products. You will work alongside Client Partners to evaluate opportunities, prioritize accounts, understand prospective advertisers’ business needs, and determine effective approaches to engagement.

  • The role combines research and analysis with direct prospect engagement, performance evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
  • You will exercise judgment in selecting accounts and stakeholders, developing messaging, evaluating advertiser fit, and recommending next steps.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Shape prospecting priorities: Analyze industry trends, buying signals, account potential, and alignment with Axios audiences and products to develop prioritized account recommendations. Explain the rationale, potential value, and trade-offs behind proposed priorities, and reassess them as market conditions and prospect needs change.
  • Partner on account strategy: Develop account briefs that synthesize prospective advertisers’ business priorities, relevant stakeholders, potential needs, and engagement opportunities. Recommend messaging and engagement approaches, and partner with Client Partners to evaluate alternatives and determine next steps aligned with advertiser needs and revenue goals.
  • Develop prospective relationships: Create targeted outreach connecting prospect objectives with Axios audiences, products, and proof points. Adapt engagement based on responses and results.

  • Improve performance: Analyze outreach effectiveness, prospect feedback, and pipeline progression to identify barriers and evaluate alternative approaches. Recommend and implement approved improvements to targeting, messaging, follow-up, and handoffs, and assess whether those changes improve results.
  • Refine tools and workflows: Test AI and automation with leadership, Revenue Operations, and Enablement to improve effectiveness, validate quality, and create capacity.
  • Build shared expertise: Translate successful campaigns, industry insights, and workflow improvements into practical playbooks and resources for the broader team.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios’ mission, and the following skills:

  • Experience in business development, advertising, sales, marketing, or a related client-facing role; at least one year preferred.

job.title: Business Director
job.description:

We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

  • Partner closely with Program Management to align on priorities and ensure our collective approach delivers on both business objectives and operational rigor.
  • Keep a constant pulse on the health of client relationships and business performance, identifying risks or growth opportunities early and collaborating with agency leadership to proactively address them.

  • Guide and inspire cross-discipline partners, fostering a culture of strategic curiosity, accountability, and partnership excellence.

  • Together with Program Management, ensure seamless integration across disciplines, maintaining the highest standards in client service and delivery.

Champion Growth & Client Success

  • Play a key role in broader business development efforts, participating in pitches and strategic growth initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Deep understanding of the QSR or restaurant category, with an appreciation for cultural nuances that inform creative strategies.
  • Experience leading multicultural or African American targeted work
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly grasp client industry dynamics and uncover opportunities for impactful creative solutions.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to provide strategic counsel to clients and inspire internal teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading integrated work across multiple channels, with a strong sense for how creative and strategic solutions drive business results.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the optimism and resilience to tackle challenges and move work forward.
  • Passion for culturally relevant work that delivers against both business objectives and consumer engagement.
  • Proven track record of leading creative initiatives that drove real business change or results for clients

Minimum Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. job.title: Solutions Lead, AI Transformation
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

We're transforming how work gets done across Edelman, redesigning specialty workflows around AI, developing the tools and solutions that support them, and translating these new ways of working into more standardized, scalable services and offerings.

 

As the AI Transformation Solutions Lead, you'll support the SVP of AI Transformation in driving Specialty-Based Transformation across the firm, working closely with subject matter experts, product and engineering teams to rethink how work is performed and bring AI-enabled solutions to life.

 

You'll also help translate these redesigned workflows into clearly defined deliverables, service models and pricing frameworks that shape how Edelman scopes, delivers and goes to market with its services.

 

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of AI transformation, solution design and business transformation. You'll help connect the dots from understanding how people work today, to designing and implementing better ways of working, to defining how those capabilities can be consistently delivered and commercially packaged for clients. 


What you'll do 

  • Support specialty workflow discovery and redesign: Work directly with specialty leaders and subject matter experts to understand how work is currently performed, identify pain points and opportunities for AI, and map current-state and future-state workflows end to end. 
  • Translate workflows into AI-enabled solutions: Turn specialist knowledge and business needs into clear scopes, product requirements and workflow documentation that guide the development of new AI-enabled tools and solutions. 
  • Support solution prototyping and development: Use generative AI tools to create mockups, prototypes and early solution concepts, working with product managers and engineering teams to turn ideas into practical applications. 
  • Bridge business and technical teams: Act as a connector between subject matter experts, transformation leaders and engineers, ensuring that solutions reflect real workflow needs, technical requirements are clearly understood, and stakeholder feedback informs development priorities. 
  • Support testing, rollout and adoption: Coordinate user feedback and testing, help develop onboarding and training resources, and track whether new workflows and tools are being adopted and delivering measurable improvements. 
  • Translate redesigned workflows into standardized deliverables: Help connect new AI-enabled ways of working to Edelman's standardized menu of services and deliverables, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize or evolve what we deliver and how we deliver it. 
  • Support service definition and commercial modeling: Work with offering leads and operational stakeholders to define deliverables, validate complexity and effort assumptions, and understand the skills, roles, staffing and costs required to deliver services through transformed workflows. Support the development of consistent scoping and pricing frameworks that reflect these new delivery models and inform how services are taken to market. 

What we're looking for 

  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, operations, AI transformation, service design or a related field. 
  • Strong understanding of generative AI tools and their applications in business, with enthusiasm for exploring how AI can fundamentally change workflows and service delivery. 
  • Experience conducting user research, gathering requirements and documenting workflows, processes or solutions. 
  • Ability to translate in both directions: turning complex business needs into clear technical requirements, and explaining technical concepts in practical terms to non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Strong analytical skills, including confidence working with structured data, spreadsheets and models to identify insights and inform decisions. 
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to turn ambiguous or complex information into clear requirements, frameworks, recommendations and documentation. 
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and evolving priorities. 
  • Curiosity about how businesses operate, how services are delivered and how technology can improve efficiency, quality and commercial value. 
  • Confidence working collaboratively across specialty teams, product and engineering, operations and business leadership. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and comfort working in an evolving environment where processes and solutions are still being defined. 

Nice to have:
Experience in PR, communications or professional services; familiarity with AI prototyping, prompt design or product development; exposure to service catalogs, process improvement, workforce planning, commercial modeling or pricing frameworks. 

 

You'll be part of a team fundamentally rethinking how the world's largest global communications firm works and goes to market in an AI-enabled world. 


You'll gain hands-on experience across the full transformation lifecycle, from discovering opportunities and redesigning workflows to developing AI solutions, shaping standardized offerings and supporting new commercial models. 


Working closely with transformation leadership, specialty experts and technical teams, you'll help build tools and ways of working that create real business impact, while contributing to how Edelman defines, delivers and sells its services in the future. 


This is an opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of AI, product development, business transformation and commercial innovation, helping shape not just how people work, but what the firm is able to offer its clients.

job.title: Senior Medical Writer
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Position Summary:

The Senior Medical Writer serves as an integral part of the Real Chemistry Medical Communications division in developing scientific content in support of a variety of omnichannel medical communication tactics, as assigned to particular therapeutic areas and client brands. The Senior Medical Writer must have the ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific data and translate these into compelling and relevant clinical communications and commercial/medical messages. The Senior Medical Writer collaborates closely with the Medical Director and cross-functional teammates in the development and execution of scientific strategies and tactics. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, Lambertville (NJ), or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role requires working eastern US hours.

What you'll do:

  • Develop core deliverables (eg, PowerPoint slides, manuscripts, video scripts, executive summaries) and ancillary materials (eg, participant handouts, moderator guides) for medical communication projects, including promotional/medical presentations, advisory board meetings, product theaters as well as various educational videos and digital solutions
  • Perform and analyze literature searches and scientific research regarding clinical data and key scientific information for content development projects to meet client needs for relevant, up-to-date, evidenced-based, and accurate medical communication content
  • Collaborate with the Medical Director, in partnership with Creative and Client Services, on medical storytelling, drawing upon client insights, landscape intelligence, and relevant evidence-based medical literature to provide informed and relevant strategic recommendations
  • Partner with Presentation and Graphic Designers on various illustrations, animations, and creative applications of medical and scientific information
  • As assigned, develop relationships and collaborate closely with clients and key opinion leaders to develop scientific content and execute medical communication strategy to communicate complex scientific information to medical professionals 
  • Conduct quality checks on all content-related materials, including annotated deliverables, to ensure scientific integrity and accuracy, and support Veeva submissions of all medical communication deliverables for client medical/legal/regulatory reviews by highlighting all relevant references and creating detailed reference notes
  • Support project management within the cross-functional team by effectively communicating and aligning with Account and Project Managers, and actively participating in all internal and client meetings
  • Train and mentor more junior medical writers under the guidance of the Medical Director
  • Maintain full compliance with legal, regulatory, and corporate requirements as well as all applicable US laws and regulations
  • Perform any other duties as reasonably assigned; duties and responsibilities may be removed, modified, or added by leadership at any time as business or operations warrant 

Working Conditions:

  • Work Schedule/Hours: This position requires occasional nonstandard work hours in accordance with project needs, deadlines, deliverables, and urgent client requests    
  • Business Travel: This position requires moderate overnight/weekend travel (up to 20%) based upon client geography
  • This position has no direct reports and does not perform supervisory tasks 

What you should have: 

  • Advanced degree (eg, MD, PhD, PharmD, MPH, MS) in a healthcare-related field required 
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in medical education, scientific research, or clinical practice/insights preferred, or 2-3 years of experience in medical education in a pharmaceutical company or medical communications agency required, with experience in promotional/medical communication to healthcare professionals preferred
  • Experience with medical, legal, and regulatory reviews preferred
  • Expert verbal and written communication skills in the field of medical science 
  • Intermediate ability to analyze the scientific relevance, validity, and credibility of the published medical literature
  • Intermediate level of conceptual and functional understanding of modern digital marketing practices and the applications of artificial intelligence technology 

Core Competencies:

Whether acting in a promotional or nonpromotional nature, we serve as envoys for our clients’ messages, a resource for their customers, and stewards of the money they invest with us. As such, Real Chemistry holds employees to a high standard when it comes to communication, culture, and collaboration, specifically: 

  • Model corporate values—Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability With an “I”—in interactions with colleagues, clients, vendors, and HCPs as well as exercise impeccable professionalism and sound judgement when representing the agency
  • Demonstrate strong work efficiency by managing time, meeting deadlines, and achieving billability expectations
  • Display excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as a high level of emotional intelligence, as demonstrated by advanced verbal, writing, and presentation skills as well as a strong ability to influence and impact others through meaningful and persuasive delivery
  • Exhibit advanced teaming and collaboration skills, including proactively communicating changes, completing tasks as assigned and on agreed timeline, adapting to changes provided by the team, and seeking opportunities to help other teammates
  • Apply the knowledge and skills necessary to deliver high-quality work, as exhibited by strong accuracy, problem solving, quality management, and client-centric behaviors 

Pay Range: $90,000.00-100,000.00
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

AdTech Strategy & Market Intelligence

Go-to-Market as Product Strategy

AdTech Expertise

Founder Mentality

  • Have conviction and communicate it compellingly

AI-Forward & Go-to-Market Focused

  • Understand that product success requires narrative alignment across engineering, sales, and strategy

Execution Excellence

job.title: Employment Counsel
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world’s most ambitious clients.

We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a work force with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.

Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com.

Overview

Stagwell is seeking a talented, highly motivated, and business-oriented employment attorney with experience advising on U.S. employment law, executive contracts, and litigation management across a global organization. In this position, you will partner with Stagwell’s Human Resources team, and our dynamic agencies around the world to deliver high-quality legal advice and strategic business guidance on a broad range of employment matters with a primary focus on U.S. federal, multi-state law and Canada (Ontario).

Responsibilities

  • Reporting to the Head of Global Employment Law, you’ll oversee employment law across the U.S. and other global markets as needed— advising on complex employment matters, partnering closely with HR leaders, and serving as a trusted problem-solver for business teams across the region.
  • Provide day-to-day advice on a broad range of employment issues including investigations, HR best practices, performance management, RIF and individual terminations, recruiting, hiring, compensation and benefits, wage and hour, and other strategic advice.
  • Deliver proactive, commercial, and risk-based employee relations guidance with a strong ability to advise and counsel effectively.
  • Advise senior leadership and HR on complex and high-risk matters including investigations, litigation strategy, workforce restructuring, regulatory risk, and reputational concerns.
  • Manage dispute matters across global and international markets, create a framework for evaluating legal claims proactively.
  • Lead and collaborate with cross-functional partners on complex projects to sustain and enhance employment law compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with the legal and People Operations teams to help manage equity awards and ensure compliance with applicable global, regional, and local requirements.

Qualifications

  • J.D. with New York Bar admission
  • Big Law experience, with experience advising on U.S. federal and multi-state employment law matters, required
  • Experience with Canadian or EMEA or APAC employment law a plus
  • Outstanding writing, drafting and communication skills
  • Ability to use good judgment and demonstrate attention to detail
  • Ability to deliver complex legal advice in a business-friendly manner
  • Must be able to balance large volume of work through effective time management and prioritization
  • A team player who acts with high integrity and professionalism
  • Inspire, trust, and earn the confidence and cooperation of your business partners

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation in New York City for this role is $275,000 - $285,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. Total compensation includes a highly competitive bonus and equity structure.

 

In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Sactown Sports Talk Host
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

 

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 19 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspriring with respect and giving voice to the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville, our stations, and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Ready to Make Noise?

If you’re passionate about sports, storytelling, and connecting with your community - we want to hear from you.

 

Sactown Sports is on the hunt for a bold, engaging, and digitally-savvy Talk Show Host who’s ready to energize our audience across radio, web, and social platforms. If you live and breathe sports, know how to connect with listeners, and thrive in a fast-paced media environment, this is your moment.

 

We’re looking for someone who can deliver compelling content with personality and purpose, both over the air and online. You’ll be a key player in shaping our sound, growing our digital footprint, and building a loyal community of fans.

Apply now and bring your voice to Sactown Sports!

 

 

Overview

Sactown Sports is looking for a dynamic personality who can engage with our audiences and support our mission by contributing daily on-air, off-air and online content. A successful candidate will deliver remarkable content in an interesting, compelling and entertaining style that attracts the targeted audience, building ratings and digital users. You will be charged with creating exclusive content and regularly contributing to the various digital platforms including, but not limited to regular blogs, podcasts and/or videos, online listener chats and use of other social media platforms in addition to emerging digital technologies.

 

Note: On-air positions within Bonneville are generally considered onsite roles that require employees to regularly work in our offices/studios with occasional live events and remote broadcasts. Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion. 

 

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Host and deliver informative, entertaining, and engaging content through a daily talk show that connects with the target audience.
  • Create exclusive digital content – blogs, articles, podcasts, videos, listeners chats, and more.
  • Stay sharp on local and national stories, topics, trends and culture.
  • Represent the brands at live events and promotional appearances. 
  • Operate studio eqipment and manage show elements like call-ins, recorded bits, and live interviews.
  • Attend staff meetings and collaborate with producers and team members to develop fresh show ideas.
  • Build strong relationshiops with listeners, clients, and colleagues.

Helping Canadians make sense of our world is our mission. Trade wars and talk of Canada becoming the 51st American state have made this mission more important than ever. And covering an unpredictable administration in Washington, DC brings new challenges as well.


We’re looking for an experienced correspondent who is keen to dive in and help us tell stories about this pivotal time in Canada’s history – as we work to tell these stories in new ways to grow new audiences.


We are hiring a correspondent for our Washington DC bureau. The successful candidate will be an exceptional journalist who thrives on breaking news, building contacts and working in a team to turn political stories that can feel hard to grasp into creative stories that connect. They bring a broad range of storytelling skills and are excited to produce strong social media-first content, aimed at mobile and streaming audiences. 


You thrive in a demanding daily news environment meeting multiple deadlines. You understand how to hook an audience on TikTok, write comprehensive analysis pieces and can go live when news breaks. You build a list of trusted sources and work to break news about the Canada - U.S. relationship. You are a storyteller who can navigate a variety of audio and video formats.  All of your journalism adheres to the CBC News Journalistic Standards and Practices. 


In this position, you will be supported by the Senior Producer in Washington DC who will assign American coverage, and supported by the World News teams in Toronto.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Cover the news in the United States: join the team of journalists reporting on news there, and other locations, as assigned. Working with the assignment team and other reporters in Washington, DC  the correspondent will generate and produce journalism guided by our audience news needs, across our platforms. 
  • Go live on any platform whenever a story requires it.
  • Produce original content while also responding to breaking news and emerging stories in a fast-paced environment.
  • Pitch and cover stories that resonate with our national audience, with an ability to find the significance in world events for a Canadian audience.
  • Research and analyze complex issues using specialized sources to ensure our audience gets a deep, nuanced understanding of important topics.
  • Develop and maintain a strong network of contacts with a wide range of sources.

  • You are a journalist with a minimum of 7 years of comparable experience, including significant reporting experience at a network/national level
  • Exceptional storytelling skills, with a proven ability to produce memorable social, written, audio and visual content
  • Demonstrated ability to produce compelling vertical visuals and social media content
  • Strong on-air presence and skill with live reporting.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills, with an ability to breakdown complex issues and explain them clearly to audiences
  • Your extensive experience demonstrates that you can pivot quickly when a story changes, you remain respectful to colleagues when there are competing deadlines and content demands, and be open to social-centric presenting / hosting.
  • Extensive knowledge of world news and current affairs issues
  • A collaborative team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and willingness to work long and flexible hours, including overtime, evenings and weekends as needed.

About the First Peoples Program


The First Peoples: Tell Us a Story initiative is a specialized professional development program designed to build bridges between First Peoples and Radio-Canada. It aims to amplify Indigenous voices in the media while nurturing lasting, reciprocal relationships with Indigenous communities.


Building on the success of its 2025 pilot, the initiative returns this year with a redesigned format. This paid training opportunity has been expanded to eight (8) weeks and will focus on the craft of storytelling. Throughout the program, you will hone your skills through hands-on workshops led by both Indigenous and non-Indigenous media professionals. You will also have a dedicated platform to share your stories, showcase your culture, language and lived experiences, and highlight your community's achievements.


We are looking for four (4) individuals from First Nations, Inuit or Métis communities ready to take the next step in their media careers.


The program runs full time for eight (8) weeks, from February 1st to March 26, 2027. Full-time availability, Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (ET) for the entire eight-week program is mandatory.


This program is in hybrid mode (remote work with required travel to Montreal and a regional station).


Candidates must meet the following eligibility requirements:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Self-identify as First Nations, Inuit or Métis.
  • Be available full time for the duration of the program (February 1st to March 26, 2027).
  • Be willing and able to travel for three (3) separate five-day sessions during the eight (8) weeks (travel and accommodation expenses are fully covered by Radio-Canada).
  • Be able to work and communicate in French (reading, writing and speaking). 

Who You Are:

  • You have a working proficiency in French across speaking, reading and writing. 
  • You have a genuine curiosity about news and current affairs, paired with a passion for storytelling.
  • You have an open, collaborative attitude.
  • You are eager to learn new things.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace tools is an asset.

Program Overview:

As part of this second cohort, you will complete an eight-week learning curriculum running from February 1st to March 26, 2027.


The program includes the following:

  • Orientation and Onboarding: Settle into the cohort and preview your training plan through a combination of virtual sessions and in-person activities in Montreal. 
  • Theory Instruction (Three (3) weeks, Virtual): Build foundational journalism skills across digital writing, audio/radio storytelling and video production, culminating in one (1) to three (3) portfolio-ready pieces. 
  • Regional Station Placement: Shadow and work alongside Radio-Canada journalists at a regional station to experience the day-to-day rhythm of an active newsroom.
  • Professional Development (Virtual): Take part in sessions designed to support your learning and development. 
  • Closing Week (Montreal): Wrap up the program alongside your peers with a final week of hands-on activities.

Job Overview

This person is responsible for all tasks involved with producing a show, editing for syndication, assisting in content creation, editing and administrating podcasting and operating the control board for a live talk show.

Job Responsibilities

· Responsible for overall content and flow of a live show.

· Assist the Donna & Steve syndication team with gathering and editing content for national syndication affiliates.

· Edit, upload and administer all podcasts for the shows you produce.

· Gather daily segments for use as “Best of” broadcasts in the case of emergency, illness, vacation or company holidays, etc.

· Assist and collaborate with show host on preparations for show on daily basis and for future shows. Make sure all aspects of the talk show are complete before the show airs. Plan and meet deadlines so show can run smoothly for all involved. Important details include booking guests as directed by show host, offering suggestions for guests, confirming guest appearances, daily postings to website on

show content, understanding program log, assembling audio clips for daily promo updates and key information.

· Notify proper people of any changes or special situations that may come up in a timely manner (i.e. breaking news, cancellations, and technical problems).

· Ensure show runs smoothly while on air by following established timelines, handling caller requests, notifying talent of important information, keeping show host on time and on track, interacting with talent, callers and guests when appropriate, following program log, taking breaks, running the board flawlessly, handling changes, monitoring of equipment to ensure it is operating correctly.

· Answer phone calls during airtime and screen calls for use on the show. Make decisions as to which callers go on the air. Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis.

· Be able to handle last minute and unexpected changes during regular work shift, during shows and at other times as necessary. Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to show hosts, guests and others as needed.

· Ability to relate and communicate with a variety of people including talent, guests, callers, and other staff.

· Working knowledge of radio systems to solve minor, routine problems as needed.

· Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call Engineering, ENCO or Programming managers for additional support. When necessary, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

· Understands and can articulate station and show's programming directions and philosophies.

Qualifications

· One year of professional broadcast experience.

· Ability to run the board flawlessly under pressure. Ability to work effectively in a high intensity, environment with on air talent.

· Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the show (may have to track down guests and/or talk to listeners while running the technical operation of the show).

· Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected show changes calmly. Able to make decisions and judgments quickly, often in a chaotic environment.

· Operating knowledge of Zetta is extremely helpful.

· Ability to work on short deadlines and in pressure situations.

· Ability to make basic programming decisions based on emergency situations.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as a Multi-Market Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Multi-Market Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

Brand Partnership Manager - SALES ID 3847 Position Type Regular Full-Time Location : Location US- Overview Salem Influencer Network, a division of Salem Media, is seeking an early-career seller to develop new brand partnerships across our national influencer portfolio and event opportunities. We connect consumer brands with trusted creators through sponsored content, social campaigns, and live experiences. We’re looking for someone who understands creator culture, follows consumer brands, and can recognize what makes a partnership feel authentic to talent and valuable to an advertiser. Maintenance Technician

Prince George, BC

Pattison Media is looking for an experienced Maintenance Technician to join our Technical Services team in Prince George.

This is a hands-on technical position supporting our radio and television operation in Prince George. We are looking for someone with a strong technical background who enjoys troubleshooting, working with technology, and learning how complex systems work. Broadcast experience would certainly be an asset, but we are equally interested in candidates coming from electronics, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video, RF, or other related technical fields.

The successful candidate will support day-to-day operations and participate in equipment installations, system upgrades, technical projects, and the ongoing modernization of Pattison Media's broadcast infrastructure. The position works closely with our broader Technical Services team, which will provide support and help the successful candidate become familiar with our specialized radio and television systems.

What you'll do
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and install radio and television studio and broadcast equipment.
  • Maintain and support radio and television transmission systems, including transmitters, RF systems, and associated equipment.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot audio and video systems, including studio, production, and signal-distribution equipment.
  • Support computers, servers, network equipment, and other technology used throughout the Prince George operation.
  • Support broadcast and production systems, including automation, newsroom, audio, video, and content-delivery systems.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting on-air, production, newsroom, and business operations.
  • Install and commission new technical equipment and systems.
  • Diagnose problems across complete broadcast workflows, from studio and production systems through transmission and distribution.
  • Work with IP networking, server infrastructure, and increasingly IP-based and cloud-connected broadcast systems.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, records, and system drawings.
  • Work closely with programming, news, television production, sales, and other departments to provide reliable day-to-day technical support.
  • Help ensure technical systems follow Pattison Media standards for reliability, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure.
What we're looking for
  • A graduate of a recognized Electronics Technician, Electronics Engineering Technologist, Broadcast Technology, or related technical program, or a combination of relevant education and practical technical experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to logically diagnose technical and electronic systems.
  • Experience working with electronics, electrical systems, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical equipment.
  • Good working knowledge of computers, IP networking, and modern IT infrastructure.
  • Comfort learning and working with radio and television studio, transmission, audio/video, automation, and production systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and see tasks through to completion.
  • Ability to work independently while also being part of Pattison Media's larger Technical Services team.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills with a practical, positive, solutions-focused approach.
  • Comfort working at transmitter sites and other technical facilities as required.
  • A valid driver's license.
Experience we're particularly interested in

Previous radio or television broadcast experience would be an asset, but it is not essential.

We recognize that strong technical candidates can come from many different backgrounds. We are interested in people with solid hands-on experience in electronics, telecommunications, IT and networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical fields. Someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting skills, and a willingness to learn the specialized systems used in broadcasting could be an excellent fit.

Experience with broadcast automation, production, or newsroom systems would also be an asset. Pattison Media uses systems such as WideOrbit in radio and Broadstream OASYS in television, along with newsroom and other supporting broadcast technologies.

Pattison Media is one of Canada's leading independent media companies, operating radio, television, and digital platforms across Western Canada. We continue to invest in modern broadcast technology, IP and cloud-based systems, and new workflows that support reliable multi-platform content delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to work with a broad range of technology. One day may involve troubleshooting a radio studio or computer system, while another may involve television production equipment, networking, servers, or a transmission system.

If you enjoy solving problems, working with technology, and keeping radio and television operations running reliably, we'd like to hear from you.

When applying, please identify that you are applying for the Prince George Maintenance Technician position.

Bill Stovold

Director, Technical Services

bill.stovold@pattisonmedia.com

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment

  • Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills

  • Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions
  • Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development
  • Experience collaborating with and coaching reporters, writers, personalities, producers, or other content creators

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, social publishing tools, analytics platforms, and digital/video production workflows
  • Curiosity about emerging platforms, creator trends, changing audience behaviors, and new technologies
  • Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. You should be excited to experiment, pay close attention to what audiences are telling us through performance and engagement, and turn those insights into action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

The Market Engineering Manager exercises independent judgment on matters that directly affect station revenue, regulatory standing, and operational performance, and will personally perform technical work when operational circumstances require.

 

Essential Functions:

The following duties are essential functions of this position. The ability to perform each of these functions, with or without reasonable accommodation, is a condition of employment.

Independent Judgment and Decision-Making

  • Exercise independent judgment to assess, prioritize, and resolve technical failures affecting station broadcast continuity, including real-time decisions during on-air emergencies where delays directly impact revenue and regulatory standing
  • Evaluate equipment performance and determine appropriate corrective action, including the authority to take systems offline, reroute signals, or authorize emergency repairs without prior approval when broadcast continuity is at risk
  • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations
  • Develop and recommend capital expenditure plans for infrastructure upgrades, including vendor evaluation, budget proposals, and cost-benefit analysis for executive approval
  • Evaluate and select vendors and contractors for engineering projects and maintenance

Technical Operations

  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Travel and Emergency Response

  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations

  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Cognitive and Communication Requirements

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports, technical documentation, and correspondence
  • Communicate effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with the Senior Vice President of Engineering, Senior Vice President of
  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

Safety and Physical Requirements

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

Required

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible broadcast engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgment in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

  • Experience with Zetta and Wheatstone systems

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Grand Junction and Montrose markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Grand Junction and Montrose stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Regional Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facilities in the Grand Junction and Montrose markets. 

 

Essential Functions:

Travel & Transportation:

  • Maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Technical Operations:

  • Manage activities for a goal of 100% uptime of station on-air and streaming products
  • Inspect, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with FCC technical rules and perform duties of Chief Operator
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Cognitive & Communication:

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Speak effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with Senior Vice President of Engineering and Senior Vice President, Information Technology, as well as other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed.

Safety & Physical Requirements:

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, visually inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

  • Technical training school, or two to four years related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience (required)
  • SBE or computer-related certification helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows (all versions), Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

 

Work Schedule:

  • After-hours and weekend work as required
  • On-call availability for emergency response

job.title: Senior Designer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

The Durham Bulls are hiring a Senior Designer to help bring one of Minor League Baseball's most iconic brands to life. You will report to the Creative Director and work alongside a small team to create the graphics, content, and photography fans see every day. Will also help create the imagery that defines the Bulls' 125th anniversary season in 2027.

Photography is a core part of this job, as important as graphic design. With no staff photographer on our team, you will be the club's primary photographer, capturing everything from retail and merchandise to in-game action and styled campaign shoots. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing at a desk and shooting from the field level, and is excited to tell the Bulls' story through both.
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS

Design

  • Create graphics for social media, web, email, video boards, in-ballpark signage, print, advertising, and merchandise.
  • Design campaigns for theme nights, promotions, giveaways, and special events from concept through final files.
  • Build partner and sponsor creative that meets their goals and still looks like the Bulls.
  • Apply and help maintain brand standards so every piece looks consistent.
  • Prepare production-ready files for printers and vendors.


Photography

  • Own photography for the club, including:
  • In-game action, fans, and ballpark atmosphere
  • Retail and merchandise product shots for the team store and e-commerce
  • Stylized and studio-style shoots for campaigns, promotions, and social content
  • Community events, partner activations, and behind-the-scenes moments
  • Plan shoots, including shot lists, locations, props, and talent coordination.
  • Edit, retouch, organize, and archive photos so the team can find them fast.
  • Turn around game-day photos quickly for social and media use.

 
Motion and content

  • Create animated graphics and short-form motion content for social and video boards.
  • Partner with the video producer on graphics packages, lower thirds, and in-game elements.
  • Pitch content ideas that fit current trends and platforms.

 
Team and collaboration

  • Take direction from the Creative Director and help manage your own project load.
  • Work with ticketing, partnerships, promotions, merchandise, and community relations on their creative needs.

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of professional graphic design experience, in-house or agency.
  • 3+ years of professional photography experience, including live events and sports.
  • A portfolio that shows both design and photography work, including brand, campaign, and social.
  • Hands-on photography skills: camera operation, lighting, composition, and shooting in fast-moving live settings.
  • Strong photo editing and retouching skills in Lightroom and Photoshop.
  • Expert in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Strong typography, layout, and color skills, with sharp attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.
  • Availability for nights, weekends, and holidays during the season, including home games and events.

 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Motion graphics experience in After Effects or similar tools.
  • Experience in sports, entertainment, or live events.
  • Video shooting or editing experience (Premiere Pro).
  • Product or e-commerce photography experience.
  • A team player who takes feedback well and enjoys helping a junior designer grow.
  • Organized, reliable, and proud of the details.

Work Conditions: 

  • Work is performed in a stadium environment with exposure to varying weather conditions.
  • Schedule includes nights, weekends, and holidays based on game and event schedules.
  • Extended or irregular hours may be required during peak season.

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in the Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) program. However, completing the WOTC questionnaire is completely voluntary. Your decision will have absolutely no impact on your hiring chances, and your application WILL be accepted regardless of whether you choose to provide this information or not.

Capitol Broadcasting Company is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
