Capitol Broadcasting Company, Inc. is a diversified communications leader which owns and/or operates WRAL-TV, WRAZ-TV, WRAL News+ (WNGT-CD), WRAL-FM, WRAL-HD2, WCMC-FM, WCMC-HD1, WDNC-AM, WCMC-HD2, WCMC-HD3, WCMC-HD4, Microspace Communications, and Capitol B Creative in Raleigh, NC; WILM-TV, WILT-LD and Sunrise Broadcasting in Wilmington, NC; The Durham Bulls Baseball Club, Bull City Hospitality, and the Coastal Plain League in Durham, NC; The Holly Springs Salamanders in Holly Springs, NC; the Zebulon Devil Dogz in Zebulon, NC; the American Underground startup hub and workspace in Durham, NC; and real estate interests including the American Tobacco Historic District in Durham, NC, and Rocky Mount Mills in Rocky Mount, NC.

job.title: Creative Director
job.description:
OVERVIEW

The Durham Bulls are hiring a Creative Director to lead the look, feel, and voice of one of the most recognizable brands in Minor League Baseball. From the snorting bull at the DBAP to Wool E. Bull to the legacy of Bull Durham, few teams have a brand this rich. We want someone who will protect it, sharpen it, and keep it fresh for the next generation of fans. Even better, 2027 is the Bulls’ 125th anniversary, and you will shape how fans see and remember it. 

The Creative Director leads a small in-house team of two graphic designers and a video producer. You will be a hands-on leader who still makes work, not just approves it. You will also act as the hub for every creative request in the building, working with ticketing, partnerships, promotions, merchandise, community relations, events and food & beverage to make sure projects get prioritized, scheduled, and delivered on time. 

Working with senior leadership, you will help set the brand and visual direction for the club and make sure it shows up consistently everywhere fans see us: in the ballpark, on social, on the web, in email, on merchandise, and around the Triangle.

 
KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS

Brand and creative direction

  • Partner with senior leadership to define and evolve the Bulls' brand, visual identity, and messaging.
  • Own brand standards and make sure logos, colors, typography, and tone are used consistently across every touchpoint.
  • Lead creative for season campaigns, theme nights, promotions, in game content and special events from concept through delivery.
  • Stay hands-on: design, art direct, write concepts, and pitch in on shoots and edits when the team needs it.
  • Give clear, constructive feedback that raises the quality of everything that goes out the door.

 
Team leadership

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of graphic designers and a video producer.
  • Set clear expectations, priorities, and goals, and hold regular check-ins and reviews.
  • Build a positive, collaborative team culture that can handle the pace of a 75-game home schedule in addition to a full slate of special events.

Project management and creative traffic

  • Serve as the single point of intake for creative requests from every department.
  • Prioritize, schedule, and assign work so the team stays on deadline without burning out.
  • Build and maintain a simple, reliable request and approval process (forms, project board, timelines).
  • Push back or reset expectations when requests come in late or out of scope, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Manage the creative budget, plus freelancers, printers, and outside vendors as needed.

 
Collaboration

  • Work closely with ticketing, corporate partnerships, promotions, merchandise, community relations, and game day operations.
  • Bring partner activations to life with creative that meets sponsor needs and still feels like the Bulls.

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of professional design or creative experience, including at least 2 years leading or supervising other creatives.
  • A strong portfolio showing brand, campaign, and social work across print, digital, and video.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign; Premiere or After Effects a plus).
  • Proven project management skills: you can juggle many requests, set priorities, and hit deadlines.
  • Clear, confident communication with both creative teams and non-creative stakeholders.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays during the season, including home games and events.
  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Experience in sports, entertainment, live events, or hospitality.
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Trello.
  • Photography and Videography skills preferred.
  • Experience with in-venue video boards, motion graphics, or photography.
  • Strong concept and copywriting skills
  • A maker and a leader: you are just as comfortable in the design file as in the meeting.
  • Organized and calm under pressure, especially on a busy game day.
  • A low-ego collaborator who builds trust across departments and can say "not yet" diplomatically.
  • Passionate about baseball, the fan experience, and the Durham community.
  • Tuned in to design trends, social platforms, and what makes content connect.
  • Curious and coachable, and eager to help your team grow.

job.title: Manager, Social Media & Digital Content
job.description:
Why This Role Matters

The Durham Bulls are one of the best-known brands in minor league baseball, and most people meet us on a phone screen before they ever walk through the gates at the DBAP. Your work is often the first reason someone buys a ticket.

We are more than what happens on the field. A sunset over the Blue Monster, a kid catching their first foul ball, or the energy of a Friday night fireworks crowd can tell a stronger story than any box score. Our content should make people feel something and make them wish they were here.

Position Overview

The Manager, Social Media & Digital Content owns the day-to-day voice of the Durham Bulls online: social channels and the team website. You will help plan, create, publish, and measure content that grows our audience and drives real business results, including ticket sales, partner value, and community reach.

You will work closely with the Marketing Leadership, our graphics and video teams, ticketing, corporate partnerships, and community relations. You start by executing an agreed calendar and brand direction, and you earn more creative ownership as you show strong judgment and results.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media Execution

  • Run daily posting and community engagement across all Bulls social platforms, YouTube and LinkedIn. Work closely with mascot coordinator on Wool E. Bull’s accounts.
  • Cover games live: in-game posts, highlights, promotions, and moments in the stands, published fast and on-brand.
  • Respond to fans in comments and messages and flag service issues or negative trends to the right department quickly.
  • Watch platform trends and act on the ones that fit the Bulls brand.

Content & Storytelling

  • Plan and deliver content with our graphics and video teams, and with photographers and creators as needed.
  • Shoot and edit quick-turn photo and mobile video, especially during games and events.
  • Write clear, creative captions and copy in the Bulls’ voice.
  • Tell stories beyond baseball: the ballpark, fans, staff, community, and the full Bulls experience.
  • Build relationships with local creators and influencers who can bring new fans to the DBAP.

Revenue & Partnerships

  • Create content that sells: tickets, group outings, theme nights, and merchandise, in coordination with ticketing and marketing.
  • Deliver and document social and web assets promised to corporate partners and help develop new sponsorable content ideas.
  • Support paid social campaigns, including creative, targeting input, and performance tracking.

Calendar, Planning & Collaboration

  • Build and maintain the content calendar with leadership, covering the season, offseason, and special events.
  • Coordinate content around promotions, partnerships, community initiatives, the Tampa Bay Rays and MiLB where applicable.
  • Bring new ideas to the table, take feedback well, and follow through on agreed priorities.

Website Management

  • Own routine updates to the Bulls website so schedules, promotions, news, and fan information are accurate and current.
  • Gather timely content from other departments and recommend improvements to the online fan experience.
  • Monitor and respond to fan inquiries through the email tied to the website.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Track performance across channels and the website and share a regular report with clear learnings and recommendations.
  • Use results to adjust the content mix, posting times, and formats.
How Success Is Measured

Targets will be set with the leadership in your first 90 days. In year one, success looks like:

  • Steady growth in engagement, impressions and followers on our priority platforms.
  • Measurable traffic from social to ticketing and promotion pages.
  • Every partner social and web deliverable completed on time and documented for renewal.
  • A content calendar that is always current, with no missed game days or major promotions.
  • A website fans can trust to be accurate.
What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in social media, digital content, or a related field. Sports or entertainment experience helps but is not required.
  • A portfolio or accounts you can show us that prove you can make content people stop for.
  • Strong instincts for what makes content emotional, timely, and worth sharing.
  • Comfort shooting and editing mobile photo and video and writing original social copy.
  • Working knowledge of the major social platforms and their native analytics.
  • Basic experience updating a website or content management system.
  • Strong organization and follow-through during busy calendars and live events.
  • Good judgment and an understanding of what it means to represent a public brand.
Schedule & Work Environment

This is an on-site, event-driven role. Evening, weekend, and holiday work is required during the season and at other events, often in busy, noisy, outdoor conditions. The offseason is for planning, building content libraries, special event content and setting up the next season.

Our goal is simple: show people what makes the Durham Bulls special, not just what happened at the game, but why being here matters.

job.title: Food & Beverage Staffing Coordinator
job.description:
Overview:

The Food & Beverage Staffing Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting game day operations by recruiting, scheduling, and managing nonprofit group staffing for concession stands and food service areas throughout the ballpark. This position is responsible for coordinating both hourly staff and nonprofit fundraising groups to ensure proper coverage and a high-quality guest experience. This role also supports payroll processes, training, and operational communication between staff and leadership.

Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

  • Aids in the execution of a successful nonprofit fundraising group program.
  • Trains nonprofit group members in operation of a concession stand, food sanitation, alcohol and customer service.

job.title: GRAY MEDIA TRAINING PROGRAM SPRING '27 - KLTV
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KLTV:

KLTV is the dominant station in the Tyler/Longview, TX area of East Texas. We are an ABC affiliate and have been #1 by every ratings measure, uninterrupted in every newscast for 30+ years. We also have a very powerful, dominant digital presence in the market. We are a leader in the industry in digital innovation and digital products--operating and populating eleven different apps and producing a nationally recognized, innovative, 19-hour a day live streaming news service from our newsroom on connected TV, desktop and on our mobile apps.

Modern facility. Top notch equipment. Experienced News Managers. Positive, encouraging workplace with an emphasis on teaching job skills and journalism. Dominant station preparing for the future in a very powerful company in this industry. We believe we are among the best TV stations in the country.

The Training Program:                              

General Responsibilities:

Are you tired of just watching from the sidelines? Ready to stop "shadowing" and start actually doing the work that reaches thousands of people every single day? We’re looking for the next generation of media powerhouses, producers, reporters, weather experts, and sales executives who are hungry to dive head-first into the fast-paced world of local media. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job; you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award-winning team from day one. The intern rate of pay can range from your state's minimum wage to $15.00/hr.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online).
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen- think social media, streaming apps, and web stories because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook. 
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 15 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies.
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 117 stations.
  • Be able to learn shooting, video editing, and writing for on-air and web.
  • Practice writing web and on-air scripts.
  • Shoot video and interviews.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand. 
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift. 
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule. 
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.

job.title: Technical Director
job.description:
MAJOR PURPOSE: Direct and TD live programs using Ross Overdrive.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


The Technical Director/ Director is responsible for switching fast-paced live news, pre-taped shows and segments, and original programming which may include live special events. The TD/Director is a leader among the technical crew in the control room who communicates effectively with our editorial, engineering, and design partners.


Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:


• Call and punch live and recorded broadcasts, special coverage, and breaking news using Ross Overdrive Automation.


• Supervise the production side of our broadcast and ensuring the highest quality broadcast reaches air. You will also sometimes only have seconds to diagnose a problem. Video decks crashed? CG channel stopped working? The Director is the last line of defense before the product hits the air.


• Code, organize and execute newscasts and specials using ENPS based rundowns.


• Build and customize OverDrive coding for news productions, working closely with producers and technical staff to enhance automation efficiency.


• Ensure clean transitions between segments, graphics, and live elements by effectively managing production automation programs.


• Applicants must possess the ability to work well under pressure and work well with others. Strong organizational and logistical skills are a must.  Must be able to work flexible hours including weekends and holidays.


• General knowledge of Overdrive, Streamdeck, OBS, Dejero, Optic, Xpressions, Bit Central, and Ross Acuity.


• Applicants must demonstrate creativity, initiative, and a desire to try and create new things.


• Must be able to make and execute last second decisions.


Working Relationships:


Must be able to work closely with Producer, Editors, Transmission, Engineering, Floor Crew, other directors.


Training Requirements:


Experience with Ross XPression graphics, Overdrive and other production switchers is a plus.


Physical Demands:


Required to sit for long periods of time Required to operate a keyboard and mouse. Some lifting Ladder climbing.


Work Environment:


Work performed primarily in an office environment, in the Control Room and in studio Exposure to electrical equipment.


Qualifications:


College degree or equivalent related experience is required.


2 years experience as a director/technical director.


Compensation - $21.00+/hr commensurate with experience and skill level.


EEO Statement: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

KTXL Fox40 will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act. You do not need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if KTXL Fox40 is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

job.title: Sr. Analyst, Strategic Partner Development
job.description:
Are you ready to drive revenue growth and operational excellence in the fast-paced world of digital media? We're looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Analyst, Strategic Partner Development to lead the optimization of our digital monetization platforms and partner-managed revenue channels. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of technology, revenue strategy, and cross-functional collaboration—maximizing performance, solving complex challenges, and ensuring our digital operations align with business priorities and brand safety standards.


If you thrive on turning data into action, building strong partnerships, and leading initiatives that directly impact the bottom line, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact at Scripps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external platform partners or clients serving as key operational contact.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key platform and technology partners, including YouTube/Google, serving as a primary liaison to drive revenue growth, platform optimization, content monetization, and partner success.
  • Lead day-to-day platform performance, revenue activity, and compliance requirements for assigned digital monetization platforms, accounts, or partner channels.
  • Support the development, implementation, and refinement of monetization strategies to improve revenue yield, operational efficiency, content monetization, rights management, brand safety, and policy compliance.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex platform, policy, delivery, reporting, or monetization issues; assess root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Provide timely reporting and analysis to cross-functional teams that connects platform performance, revenue trends, audience behavior, inventory performance, and partner updates to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Content, Product, Sales, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and execute new monetization opportunities, evaluate emerging platform capabilities, and support business development initiatives that advance Scripps' digital revenue strategy.
  • Maintain a consistent operating rhythm with external platform or technology partners by coordinating updates, tracking follow-through, and communicating changes that may affect revenue, workflows, or compliance.
  • Support cross-functional projects related to platform launches, monetization tools, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, or partner initiatives.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best-practice guidance to support consistency, accountability, and scalability across accounts or platforms.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced team members by providing guidance on complex issues, reviewing work for accuracy, and sharing platform knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Experience building strategic partnerships with digital platforms, including YouTube/Google, to drive revenue growth and content monetization, is strongly preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Advanced skill with digital ad operations, platform monetization, video operations, or a related digital media role with a track record of increasing responsibility
  • Strong understanding of platform policies, partner requirements, brand safety, rights management, and compliance impacts
  • Ability to analyze complex performance data and translate insights into revenue-focused recommendations
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous, or non-routine issues independently
  • Project leadership skills, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder influence, and initiative execution
  • Clear communication skills for technical, operational, business, and leadership audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal teams and external platform or technology partners
  • Ability to mentor others and promote consistent practices across teams or accounts

●    Implement AI Features: Implement and assist in the architecture of advanced Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to power intelligent recommendations and dynamic user personalization.
●    Drive Development: Drive the rapid prototyping and full-cycle development of production-grade features for mobile and web applications.
●    Contribute to Standards: Promote and adhere to scalable platform standards, engineering patterns, and reusable components across the organization.
●    Collaborate and Prototype: Work closely within a small engineering group, partnering with design and product teams to rapidly design, develop, and prototype solutions to key business challenges.
●    Utilize AI: Utilize AI development tools to optimize your workflow and promote the use of AI-driven development practices across the team.
●    Operational Excellence: Implement solutions with scalability and reliability in mind, incorporating appropriate testing, monitoring, and alerting.
●    Mentor and Document: Contribute to clear documentation and diagrams to facilitate easy onboarding for other engineers and support teams. Review code to ensure adherence to best practices (style, testability, efficiency).
●    Monorepo Tooling: Utilize and contribute to the evolution of monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web and mobile applications.
●    Type Safety & Standards: Adhere to and contribute to the evolution of TypeScript and typing standards (e.g., strict mode, shared types, codegen) so that codebases stay maintainable, type-safe end to end, and refactor-safe.


Required Qualifications
●    Experience in AI:  Experience or familiarity with Generative AI and RAG architectures.
●    Platform Experience: Experience contributing to scalable platform products and adhering to cross-team engineering standards.
●    Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
●    Browser & Performance: Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).
●    Monorepo Experience: Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages, task pipelines, and cross-project dependencies.
●    Education & Experience: BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
●    7+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js) and Node.js.
●    Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and advanced ES6+ features.
●    Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.
●    Experience consuming and designing APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client and microservices-based architectures.
●    Proven experience modeling complex data flows for transactional and integration workflows.
●    Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or OCI) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
●    Familiarity with distributed systems concepts including caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
●    Experience designing and developing highly scalable, high-performance applications.
●    Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including use of monitoring/observability tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, New Relic).
●    Soft Skills: Able to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex code problems. Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.


Preferred Qualifications

●    Exposure to popular proprietary or open-source CMS systems such as Wordpress, Drupal, Joomla, Magento
●    1+ years experience with one or more vector databases (e.g., TurboPuffer, Mongo Atlas).
●    Cloud Focus: 3+ years experience working with Cloud technologies (AWS is strongly preferred).
●    Frontend Skills: React/Next.js experience with fundamental HTML/CSS (layout, specificity, cross-browser compatibility).
●    Collaboration: Proven experience in cross-team collaboration for requirements, implementation, and testing.
●    Certifications: Cloud certifications (GCP, AWS, OCI).
●    AI Tooling & Standards: Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails—rules, commands, skills, sub-agents—to keep AI-generated code clean, consistent, and production-ready.
●    Theming & Styling:  Experience with multiple styling approaches (Stylex, CSS Modules, SASS, CSS-in-JS) and design tokens in component libraries or design system.

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

job.description:
Job Title

Executive Assistant, Corporate Governance & Board Operations

Job Description

About The Position: 

The Executive Assistant, Corporate Governance & Board Operations provides high-level administrative and governance support to the Deputy General Counsel and legal leadership team, focusing on board management and corporate governance. As the central liaison for the Board of Directors, this role ensures seamless communication and meticulous preparation of materials for executive meetings. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized professional who handles competing demands with exceptional judgment, strict confidentiality, and high integrity. 

Hybrid 3x a week- NYC

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team: 

The People Inc. legal team operates as a trusted strategic partner across the enterprise, safeguarding the company’s assets, reputation, and compliance standards. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented, and high-performing team that values integrity, proactive problem-solving, and continuous improvement. This role interacts closely with executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and external stakeholders, representing the legal department with professionalism and poise. 

About The Position’s Contributions: 

75% Board of Directors & Corporate Governance Support: 

  •  Manage logistics for Board and Committee meetings, including scheduling, facilities, and virtual arrangements.

  • Prepare and distribute confidential Board materials, agendas, and presentations per established timelines. 

  •  Maintain the Board portal to ensure secure and timely document updates.

  • Coordinate the collection of reports and presentations from executive leadership for Board books. 

  •  Track Board action items, resolutions, and follow-up requests to ensure timely completion.    

  • Maintain official corporate records, including minutes, resolutions, and governance documentation. 

  • Assist with governance initiatives, such as calendars, director onboarding, and shareholder meetings. 

  • Oversee the execution and retention of resolutions, written consents, and executive certifications.       

10% Operational Excellence: 

  •  Identify opportunities to improve administrative and operational processes that increase efficiency within the Legal department.   

  • Build collaborative relationships across Legal, Human Resources, Finance, Executive Leadership, and other business functions. 

  • Anticipate business needs and proactively recommend solutions that enhance executive effectiveness and department operations.    

10% Executive Admin Support to Deputy General Counsel, Head of Corporate Legal Affairs & Litigation: 

  • Provide comprehensive executive support to the Deputy  General Counsel (calendar, travel, expenses, and communications)

  • Facilitate legal operations (meeting coordination, document management, contract administration, budgeting, and vendor support). 

5% Executive and Legal Team Support Back-Up: 

  • Serve as back-up coverage during the Executive Legal Assistant's absence to provide comprehensive executive support to the SVP and General Counsel as needed including: calendar, travel, expenses, and communications, meeting coordination, document management, contract administration, budgeting, and vendor support. 

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements: 

Education: 

  •  Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.  

Experience: 

  •  5+ years of executive administrative or paralegal experience supporting C-suite executives, preferably within a Legal department.    

  • Experience supporting a Chief Legal Officer, General Counsel, Corporate Secretary, or Board of Directors strongly preferred. 

  • Experience handling highly confidential legal, employment, corporate governance, or executive information. 

  • Experience coordinating Board of Directors meetings and preparing Board materials preferred. 

  • Experience working in a publicly traded company or highly regulated environment is a plus.    

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities: 

  •  Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Zoom, and Google Workspace ( Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Slides.   

  • Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential, proprietary, and sensitive information with absolute discretion. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion. 

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interface confidently with C-suite executives and board members. 

  • High level of organizational skill with a proven ability to prioritize heavy workloads, manage multiple deadlines, and maintain meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate executive needs.

  • Ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization, including executive leadership and Board members. 

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining flexibility in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.    

% Travel Required (Approximate): 0% – 5% (Occasional travel may be required for off-site board meetings).

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 


How we LEAD:

We are seeking a highly experienced, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant to support the General Manager of Interscope and the EVP & Chief Revenue Officer of IGA, based in Santa Monica, CA. The ideal candidate will bring 6+ years of executive support experience, preferably within the music or entertainment industry, and a proven track record of supporting senior-level executives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

This individual will serve as a trusted partner to executive leadership, operating with a high degree of independence, discretion, and sound judgment. The successful candidate will anticipate executive needs, proactively identify priorities, and manage competing demands with minimal guidance. They will be adept at navigating complex schedules, managing sensitive information, and ensuring executives are well-prepared and positioned for success. The ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization, exercise exceptional attention to detail, and remain composed as priorities evolve is essential. A solutions-oriented mindset, strong business acumen, and genuine passion for the music industry are key to success in this role.


How you’ll CREATE:

  • Independently manage and proactively optimize complex executive calendars, meetings, and conference calls, balancing competing priorities and exercising sound judgment when resolving scheduling conflicts.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, effectively managing incoming requests, prioritizing communications, and determining when matters require executive attention.
  • Anticipate executive needs and proactively prepare for upcoming meetings, including developing agendas, gathering relevant materials, tracking follow-ups, and ensuring all necessary information is readily available.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries, proactively managing changes and resolving issues as they arise.
  • Exercise discretion and sound judgment when screening calls, managing interruptions, and determining the appropriate timing and escalation of urgent matters.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of the artist roster, company structure, key employees, industry relationships, and important external contacts.
  • Build strong partnerships with other executive assistants and cross-functional teams to coordinate schedules, facilitate communication, and ensure seamless executive support and coverage.
  • Draft, edit, and distribute polished, grammatically accurate internal and external communications on behalf of executive leadership.
  • Organize, prioritize, and maintain executive correspondence, email archives, and relevant deal communications, ensuring timely follow-up on outstanding items and ongoing business matters.
  • Create, update, and maintain presentations, briefing documents, reports, and other materials to support executive meetings and business priorities.
  • Coordinate executive meetings and visitor experiences, including greeting guests, arranging tours, organizing meeting spaces, and managing catering and other logistical requirements.
  • Independently troubleshoot day-to-day administrative and operational challenges, including coordinating with IT and other internal partners to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Manage travel and entertainment expense reporting, review and approve expenses as appropriate, and ensure timely and accurate processing in accordance with company policies.
  • Track vacation and other administrative information for salaried employees, maintaining accurate records and coordinating updates as needed.
  • Oversee office-related administrative needs, including supplies, restaurant reservations, and other executive and team logistics.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline administrative processes, improve organization, and proactively address recurring needs to increase executive effectiveness.
  • Handle sensitive information and confidential business matters with the highest level of professionalism, discretion, and integrity.
  • Take ownership of additional administrative responsibilities and special projects as needed, managing deliverables independently and following through to completion.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal direction, exercise sound judgment, and make informed decisions on behalf of senior executives.
  • Exceptional ability to anticipate executive needs, proactively identify potential challenges, and address issues before they require escalation.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and adapt quickly in a demanding, deadline-driven environment.
  • Outstanding organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to manage complex workflows without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with employees at all levels, including senior leadership, as well as external business partners and industry contacts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft polished communications and represent executive leadership professionally.
  • Strong discretion, confidentiality, and professionalism when handling sensitive information and high-level business matters.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the confidence to take initiative, troubleshoot independently, and recommend improvements to existing processes.
  • Exceptional time management skills and the ability to stay composed, responsive, and effective as priorities shift.
  • A high level of service orientation, professionalism, and accountability, paired with the ability to anticipate and meet the needs of multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and the Microsoft Office suite, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 6+ years of progressive experience providing direct executive-level administrative support, ideally to an EVP, President, General Manager, or comparable senior leader.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex calendars, travel, communications, and competing priorities with a high degree of autonomy and minimal supervision.
  • Proven track record of anticipating executive needs, exercising sound judgment, and proactively managing day-to-day operations to maximize executive effectiveness.
  • Significant experience handling confidential information and navigating sensitive business matters with discretion and professionalism.
  • Experience supporting multiple senior executives simultaneously is strongly preferred.
  • Music or entertainment industry experience is highly preferred.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where priorities shift frequently is strongly preferred.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

job.title: Senior Payroll Operations and Tax Analyst
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Please Note: This position is hybrid (2 days in-office - Woodland Hills)

How We LEAD:

The Senior Payroll Operations & Tax Analyst helps deliver accurate, timely payroll and compliant payroll tax administration across a large, multi-state U.S. workforce. This role combines hands-on payroll processing support with ownership of payroll tax and garnishment activities, and contributes to strong controls, responsive employee service, and practical process improvements.

The analyst works with Payroll, People, Finance, Legal, Corporate Tax, and external service providers to resolve issues, maintain compliance, and support reliable payroll operations. The role also evaluates technology and automation opportunities that can improve accuracy, reporting, and efficiency while protecting employee data.


How You’ll CREATE:

  • Coordinate payroll operations across weekly, bi-weekly, and semi-monthly cycles, providing coverage during peak periods and planned or unexpected team absences.
  • Prepare, validate, and enter payroll data, including hours, earnings, deductions, taxes, leave, direct deposits, and payroll adjustments.

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary

Universal Music Group (UMG) is the world’s leading music company. We are committed to artistry, innovation, and entrepreneurship, with businesses spanning recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content across more than 60 countries.


The A/V Senior Manager leads the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operational excellence of UMG’s global audiovisual and workplace technology capabilities. This role enables reliable, secure, and intuitive experiences across conferencing, telephony, meeting rooms, workspace reservation, digital signage, performance spaces, and related collaboration technologies.


Based in Nashville, this is a global leadership role overseeing and enabling a distributed A/V and Workspace Engineering team across Australia, the United States, and the United Kingdom. The leader partners closely with Infrastructure, Facilities, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders to deliver consistent standards while supporting the distinct needs of UMG’s offices, artists, and business functions.


Key Responsibilities

·    Strategy and roadmap: Define and execute UMG’s global A/V and workplace technology strategy, translating business needs into a prioritized, outcome-oriented roadmap and investment plan.

·    People leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team. Set clear expectations, support career growth, manage performance, and attract and retain exceptional technical talent.

·    Architecture and standards: Establish reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and governance for conferencing, telephony, room systems, workspace technology, and associated integrations.

·    Portfolio and lifecycle management: Evaluate, select, implement, standardize, and retire platforms and devices across their lifecycle, balancing user experience, interoperability, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost of ownership.

·    Service reliability and operations: Strengthen incident, problem, change, and request-management practices; improve service availability; and drive disciplined root-cause analysis and continual service improvement.

·    Automation and observability: Create a practical framework for inventory, telemetry, monitoring, automation, capacity planning, and health reporting so that teams can identify issues proactively and make decisions using reliable data.

·    Stakeholder partnership: Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, Facilities, Real Estate, Security, Network, End User Computing, Production, and business teams. Explain trade-offs clearly and influence outcomes across organizational boundaries.

·    Budget and vendor management: Own or contribute to budget planning, sourcing, contract management, vendor performance, and financial optimization for the A/V and workplace technology portfolio.

·    Risk, security, and compliance: Partner with Security and Risk teams to incorporate appropriate access controls, privacy, resilience, data protection, and lifecycle controls into A/V and workplace solutions.

·    Innovation and continuous improvement: Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies, test promising capabilities, and recommend adoption when they create measurable value for UMG.

·    Executive communication: Provide concise reporting on service health, priorities, risks, investments, roadmap progress, and business outcomes to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

·    Leadership experience: Progressive experience leading A/V, workplace technology, unified communications, or related infrastructure engineering teams, including responsibility for direction, delivery, and talent development.

·    Technical depth: Strong knowledge of enterprise A/V and workplace technologies, including conferencing and collaboration platforms, telephony, room and workspace reservation systems, digital signage, signal flow, and related integrations. Experience with Dante or comparable audio-over-IP technologies is expected.

·    Engineering and architecture: Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, integrating, automating, and supporting reliable A/V solutions in complex enterprise environments.

·    Operational discipline: Strong background in IT service management, incident and problem management, change enablement, service measurement, and continual improvement.

·    Program and commercial management: Experience managing cross-functional programs, business analysis, vendor relationships, budgets, and competing priorities.

·    Communication and influence: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues in plain language and convert business needs into practical technology outcomes.

·    Hands-on problem solving: Comfortable deep-diving into existing and emerging technologies, diagnosing issues, evaluating options, and guiding teams toward pragmatic solutions.

·    Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, plus at least eight years of relevant A/V, workplace technology, unified communications, or infrastructure experience.

·    Global collaboration: Experience working across regions, time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries. Occasional travel may be required but is not expected to be part of the regular work schedule.


Preferred Qualifications

·    Experience operating A/V or workplace technology services at global scale, including distributed offices and high-visibility executive, artist, or performance environments.

·    Experience with AV-over-IP, DSP, room control, room analytics, digital signage, device management, and enterprise collaboration ecosystems.

·    Relevant certifications such as CTS/CTS-D, Dante, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent practical experience.

·    Experience building service catalogs, operating models, technology standards, or reference designs that improve consistency and reduce operational complexity.

·    Experience in the music, media, entertainment, creative, or live-events industries.


How Success Is Measured

·    Improved reliability, availability, and user experience across critical A/V and workplace services.

·    Reduced repeat incidents and faster, more consistent resolution through effective service management and root-cause practices.

·    Clear standards, lifecycle plans, inventory visibility, and adoption of supported solutions across locations.

·    Responsible use of budget and vendor capacity, with transparent reporting on value, risk, and total cost of ownership.

·    A strong, engaged, and developing global team that delivers predictably and is recognized as a trusted partner by the business.

job.description:
Position Title: Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms Department: Enterprise Products & Services Corporate Area: PBS Technology Status: Regular, Full time Exempt Manager Title: Director, Product Management

Position Overview

The Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms is responsible for defining, documenting and managing the business requirements for the mbank API layer and the microservices that connect mbank with external media metadata sources, specifically EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry) and IMDb. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product managers, data engineers and software developers, translating business needs into clear API specifications, integration requirements and acceptance criteria. The Business Analyst III owns the integration backlog, monitors the health and quality of the data exchanged between mbank and its partner services, and supports user acceptance testing and quality efforts. The role requires a strong understanding of media identifiers and metadata, key business processes and drivers, and the short- and long-term strategies and related technologies of the Data Products & Platforms team.

Key responsibilities

will include, but are not limited to: Serves as business owner and subject matter expert for the mbank API and the microservices that integrate mbank with EIDR and IMDb, aligning technical solutions with business strategies across moderate to complex business processes. Gathers, analyzes and documents business, functional and non-functional requirements for API endpoints, data mappings, and microservice workflows, including user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows. Defines and maintains API specifications and integration documentation (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman collections, data dictionaries and mapping documents) in partnership with developers and architects. Manages the integration between mbank and EIDR, including identifier registration, lookup, matching and reconciliation of titles, editions and versions; tracks changes to EIDR schemas, services and registry rules and assesses their impact on mbank. Manages the integration between mbank and IMDb, including data ingestion, field mapping, match logic and refresh cadence; monitors licensing, terms-of-use and usage constraints of the data with Legal and the data owners. Establishes strong, positive relationships with business units, Product Managers and external data providers to identify and document requirements and serves as the point of contact for partner-service questions and issues. Prioritizes business demands; participates in planning and prioritization meetings and maintains a prioritized backlog of enhancements, defect fixes, report requests and other mbank integration work that reflects organizational priorities. Defines data quality rules, validation and exception-handling requirements; monitors API and microservice performance, error rates and data discrepancies, and coordinates root-cause analysis and resolution. Plans and executes user acceptance testing, regression testing and release validation for API and microservice changes; supports deployment, change management and post-release review. Supports data governance and metadata standards by documenting identifier crosswalks, authoritative sources, data lineage and ownership between mbank, EIDR, IMDb and downstream consumers. Collaborates with product and project teams, business partners, IT and security leaders, and often leads planning efforts; manages ambiguity, creates accurate effort estimates, and recognizes the implications of business strategy changes. Develops training materials, process documentation, SOPs and help guides; supports and trains staff and business partners on mbank data and API capabilities. Investigates, resolves and escalates problems, and serves as an escalation point for others. Supports the Scrum Master and acts as a facilitator in all phases of the application lifecycle except development. Requirements for success: 7 years’ related experience, including: Gathering process requirements for IT systems, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria Defining, documenting or testing REST APIs and microservices (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman, JSON/XML payloads) Data migration, integration and governance Developing support materials, including SOPs and Help Guides Tracking risks and changes

Experience

with media or entertainment metadata, identifiers or registries (e.g., EIDR, IMDb, EIDR-based title/edition/version models) preferred Bachelor’s degree in a technology-related field Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA) preferred Skills/Abilities required: Working knowledge of API and microservices architecture, including REST, authentication/authorization, versioning and rate limiting Ability to read and map data models and payloads across systems, and to define match, merge and reconciliation rules Strong understanding of user

experience

and risk management best practices Skilled in business process engineering and information governance Demonstrated knowledge of at least one software development methodology (Agile/Scrum preferred) Demonstrated ability to communicate technical/complex information both verbally and in writing, to technical and non-technical audiences Ability to manage relationships with external data providers and registries Possesses a “can-do” style and a demonstrated interest in understanding the business Effective time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and respond to emergency situations effectively Strong leadership skills coupled with a drive to innovate Ability to work well both independently and in a team, establishing and maintaining cooperation, understanding, trust and credibility Ability to function and adapt to new goals, practices, etc. within a dynamic work environment Proactively stays current in requisite skills within job scope, and incorporates knowledge and other feedback into work The base pay range for this position at the beginning of employment is expected to be between $130,000/year to $140,000/year. The actual base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. benefits

You will determine proper accounting treatment, and record following generally accepted accounting principles. You can query and analyze data sets, summarize data in a concise and meaningful manner, and highlight insights that help inform validating recorded transactions. Have the opportunity to recommend, document, and implement processes to facilitate the proper accounting of revenue and expense contracts. Furthermore, you will collaborate with partners to foster communication, learn about new contracts and products, improve processes, and to ensure the accuracy of accounting and reporting.

Responsibilities:

  • Review customer contracts and other transactions and ensure/document the proper accounting following ASC 606 or other relevant accounting standards.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

  • Advanced excel skills (i.e. macros)
  • Experienced communicating across multiple partners and ability to work cross functionally, including the ability to understand goals and and translate into transactional and reporting impacts

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The Metro desk at The Times is seeking a creative, knowledgeable and collaborative Senior Producer for its video journalism. Metro's journalism spans fast-moving breaking news, enterprise and investigations on a range of beats, from politics and education to transportation and criminal justice. We bring the issues of New York and its surrounding tri-state region to readers around the world, with deeply-reported narratives and unexpected tales.

You will bring a passion for news, a commitment to fast, authoritative coverage of breaking and developing stories, and the news judgment to identify enterprise stories and exclusives. An experienced video journalist and a manager, you'll help broaden Metro's coverage in a range of video formats. You are a talented storyteller and strong people manager who is passionate about breaking news, live journalism and enterprise.

Metro is known across the newsroom for its collegial culture. You'll work closely with Metro editors and reporters, and build strong relationships across the newsroom — especially Video and Photo — and partner with Metro leadership to shape and drive coverage. You'll bring an innovative, collaborative approach to motivating and inspiring teams to scale video on the desk and deliver fast-turnaround and ambitious work.

You will oversee everything from live streams and news clips to enterprise projects and Reporter Video, managing a team of video journalists to execute on each of those priorities. Your sharp visual and editorial skills will ensure that the right stories are assigned. Before videos are published onsite and on social media, you will ensure that they meet the editorial standards, style and quality of the Times.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • You will drive innovative, exclusive video coverage across a range of video formats, from short-form live-blog updates to Reporter Videos featuring Times journalists, enterprise stories and columns, and occasional field deployments.

  • You will manage and help hire video journalists on the desk.

  • You will help colleagues assess whether a story is suited to video and whether it should be told primarily or exclusively in that format, and mentor them as they develop their video storytelling skills.

  • You will lead story development and story edits.

  • You will review, assign and provide clear feedback on video productions.

  • You will support and guide script writing and visual approaches for effective short-form video.

  • You will oversee production across multiple projects.

  • You will guide interviews and shoots as needed, both in studio and field.

  • You will work with Metro and Video leadership to develop new video approaches and editorial strategies for the desk.

  • You will coordinate breaking news coverage with Video's Daily News and The Times's Live team, which produces real-time updates and analysis.

  • You will work with the Editor, Video Training to identify coaching opportunities for on-camera and shooting skills.

  • You will oversee the production of social content and off-platform video.

  • You will draw ideas from a range of video sources, including wire services, UGC, eyewitness video, archival footage, motion graphics, and originally-shot footage.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to the Metro editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years experience producing digital news videos.

  • 4+ years experience managing video journalists or newsroom teams.

  • Demonstrated expertise in sourcing, assessing and verifying video from a range of sources.

  • Expert knowledge of digital storytelling formats.

  • Understanding of mainstream and emerging social channels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.

  • Expert knowledge of current events with advanced level experience covering breaking news stories in New York and experience covering news in the eastern United States.

  • Experience overseeing geolocation and UGC verification work.

  • Experience developing and editing visual material for social platforms.

  • Flexibility to work extended hours and some weekends.

job.title: Senior Manager, Workplace Experience
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role As Suno grows its teams and real estate footprint across Cambridge, New York, Los Angeles, and San Francisco, the company is looking for a senior lead to own all workplace experience initiatives that make our offices feel unmistakably Suno, while helping us efficiently scale. You're the one who notices what's not landing, figures out why, and fixes it before anyone has to ask. Our Senior Manager, Workplace Experience sits at the center of a lot of moving parts: you'll build and iterate on in-office operations and programming, stand up systems that let workplace experience scale across four sites while keeping our human, music-centered touch, plan and run the operational and financial aspects of major office-based events and company offsites, and act as the cross-functional partner between Workplace and IT, Security, Finance, Communications, Music, Brand, and Executive Assistants, to name but a few. This is a builder's role for someone who is equally comfortable running the operations of a 300-person offsite and sitting in a room helping shape what Suno's culture should feel like as the company doubles in size. You'll report to the VP of People and partner closely with her as a strategic thought partner, not just an executor. What You’ll Do Own the workplace experience strategy, roadmap and budget across all four offices: forecast spend, track it against plan, negotiate with vendors, and make sure every dollar goes toward experiences people actually value. Manage our office managers and coordinators in Cambridge, New York, San Francisco, and Los Angeles as they design and run in-office programming, share playbooks, vendors, and what’s working so every office feels genuinely Suno. Lead operations for office events, company offsites or celebrations, and any recruiting events, from budgets, to venue hire, to run-of-show and day-of execution, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders. Keep the Workplace team’s roadmap on track by chasing down commitments and dependencies, setting up workplace operations ahead of new office openings, and flagging risks before they become last-minute fires. Partner with Physical Security to ensure that all offices are operating according to required codes and protocols, ensuring employee health and safety is a top priority. What you'll bring 8–10 years in workplace operations and experience, including owning a multi-site program. 3–5 years managing people, including hiring, onboarding, and developing a team spread across multiple locations. Experience owning a large workplace budget end to end: forecasting, tracking spend against plan, and making tradeoffs on where money goes. A track record of planning and running large events and offsites (hundreds of attendees), from budget and venue to run-of-show and day-of execution. Experience sourcing and negotiating with vendors and managing those relationships over time. Strong cross-functional influence, comfortable working with executives and partners like IT, Security, Finance, and Brand, and shaping strategy rather than only executing it. job.title: Application Support Analyst (D365 F&O)
job.description:
The Application Support Analyst provides administration, technical and functional support, maintenance, and continuous improvement for enterprise business applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O). This role owns the operational processing and validation of financial data within D365 F&O, including billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, to support accuracy, financial integrity, and compliance with applicable requirements.

The Application Support Analyst monitors financial batch jobs, manages application configurations, troubleshoots issues, and supports reliable integrations and workflows across business functions. This position serves as a liaison among business stakeholders, IT, developers, and external vendors to resolve issues, improve application performance, and promote effective system utilization. This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports.

MAIN JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the operational processing and validation of billing, payments, revenue, and expense data within D365 F&O. Monitor and execute scheduled financial batch jobs, validate timely and accurate completion, troubleshoot failures, and resolve or escalate issues to support financial integrity, business deadlines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Serve as the primary contact for application support requests and the primary owner of triaging technical and functional configuration issues across D365 F&O modules and related enterprise applications. Manage incidents through the enterprise ticketing system, investigate root causes, identify recurring issues, and coordinate resolution or escalation of complex application, infrastructure, integration, and code-related problems.

• Configure and maintain application settings, workflows, security roles, user access, and system controls in accordance with approved business requirements and security standards. Coordinate configuration changes across D365 F&O modules and associated upstream and downstream processes to maintain reliable operations and appropriate access.

• Monitor and validate application integrations, interfaces, and related batch jobs to support accurate and reliable data flow. Partner closely with Application Support Engineers, developers, and vendors to maintain, enhance, test, and support custom code, D365 objects, and system integrations.

• Coordinate application upgrades, patches, maintenance, and enhancement deployments to minimize business disruption. Gather requirements, support or lead user acceptance testing, document changes, and assist with implementation and post-deployment stabilization in accordance with IT change management processes.

• Maintain application inventories, architecture diagrams, configuration records, technical specifications, operational runbooks, and knowledge base content. Develop user guides and training materials, and deliver onboarding and ongoing guidance to improve system utilization and adoption of effective practices.

• Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate enhancement requests and identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting, and operational efficiency. Use approved AI tools, low-code platforms, and automation technologies to support documentation, ticket analysis, and process improvements, and collaborate with technical teams to test and validate solutions.

• Coordinate with business units, IT teams, and external vendors to support service continuity, resolve escalations, and manage support needs, licensing compliance, and supported application versions. Prioritize assigned work independently, communicate service impacts and resolution status.

• Other duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field and at least four years of progressive experience supporting enterprise or business-critical applications; or at least six years of relevant progressive experience in lieu of a degree.

• Hands-on experience providing technical and functional support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including financial processing, application configurations, and scheduled batch jobs.

• Working knowledge of financial workflows involving billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, including related data validation and system controls.

• Experience troubleshooting application issues, managing incidents, conducting root cause analysis, and supporting users in a business-critical environment.

• Working knowledge of integrations, APIs, middleware, and interface technologies, including experience investigating data flow issues and coordinating technical resolution.

• Experience creating, maintaining, or supporting reports using Power BI, SQL, or equivalent reporting tools.

• Experience using enterprise ticketing systems, such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk, to document, prioritize, resolve, and escalate support requests.

• Experience supporting application configuration, user access, security roles, workflows, testing, and change management activities.

• Strong documentation, organization, and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users and collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, IT teams, and vendors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supporting multiple D365 F&O modules and their upstream and downstream integrations.

• Experience partnering with developers to support custom D365 code, objects, extensions, and integrations.

• Experience with middleware, automation, or integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or comparable iPaaS solutions.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, approved AI tools, or other low-code technologies used for workflow automation and operational improvements.

• Experience supporting media, publishing, manufacturing, or multi-entity business environments.

• Familiarity with cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS, and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace.

• Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, or ITIL service management practices.

• Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or ITIL certification.

job.title: Senior Video Producer, Audio/Video
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a creative and strategic Senior Video Producer to help make and grow our video products across YouTube, podcasts and social media. This role is a player-coach — you’ll be a hands-on producer and editor for key interviews and series, and work with the team on strategy and execution of other projects. 


You’ll join in shaping the visual identity and creative direction of multiple video products, working closely with hosts, editors, and newsroom partners to turn strong reporting into compelling, distinctive video. You’ll also play a key role in POLITICO’s YouTube presence — from programming strategy to growth and performance.


Who You Are:

  • An experienced video producer with a strong editorial sensibility and a track record of building and overseeing video projects — including booking and managing crews for field shoots. 
  • A great video editor, who can create excellent videos and give guidance to the edits of others. 
  • A creative editor and storyteller who enjoys shaping look, feel, and format — not just executing a run of show.
  • A strategic thinker who understands how video lives on YouTube and other platforms, and how to design content accordingly.
  • A strong collaborator who can work across the newsroom to surface smart ideas and translate them into scalable video concepts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the production of a weekly video show — including running field shoots (when needed), overseeing recording sessions, and editing a strong video from beginning to end. 
  • Help oversee POLITICO’s long-form video podcast ecosystem, helping define the visual identity, brand, and publishing strategy for each show — and ensuring they feel distinct from one another.
  • Grow POLITICO’s YouTube channel, including strategy, programming mix, performance analysis, and audience growth.
  • Work with more junior video editors on social videos and other projects, giving feedback as necessary.
  • Assist on key projects, big interviews, high-profile news moments, and other such needs as they arise.

What You’ll Need:

  • 6+ years of experience producing video, ideally in news, politics, or policy. Experience with audio is a strong plus. 
  • Significant experience with video editing and post-production workflows, as well as overseeing the work of other editors.
  • Strong editorial judgment grounded in journalistic standards and POLITICO’s mission.
    Experience managing projects in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • Deep familiarity with YouTube strategy, analytics, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects at once.
  • Comfort experimenting with new formats and iterating based on performance and feedback.

Compensation:

  • $100,000-$135,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here.


About Us.

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. Learn more about Axel Springer.
