job.title: LN Concerts, Accounting Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

We are seeking an Accounting Manager for the Live Nation Concerts division, a segment of the Live Nation live music business. This position oversees accounting and control in a corporate setting, and interacts with multiple divisions, including the development and implementation of accounting policies and procedures. This person must be a self-motivated individual with the ability to multitask.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Establish, implement, and enforce financial and reporting policies and standards in compliance with GAAP and FASB, Sarbanes-Oxley, SEC and the requirements of other applicable regulatory bodies.
  • Perform and supervise month-end close tasks as assigned including preparation and review of general ledger entries, analysis and completion of corporate Balance Sheet and P&L reports
  • Review period close submissions and assist in  month/quarter end reporting package consolidation
  • Complete various balance sheet schedules to be used by senior management in monthly and quarterly financial statement reviews
  • Complete detail reviews regional and/or divisional balance sheets providing accounting guidance as needed.
  • Assist in managing central accounting team ensuring compliance with company’s policies and objectives. 
  • Ensure timely, accurate and reliable financial statements and reporting, and to ensure that policies and procedures meet other organizational objectives and needs.
  • Ensure compliance with generally accepted accounting principles and company procedures / policies, including Sarbanes-Oxley requirements
  • Interface with company’s external and internal auditors.
  • Foster a culture that encourages the highest level of performance, integrity and ethical behavior and cooperation in all business activities.
  • Undertake special projects and/or general management assignments as requested by senior management

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, CPA preferred. MBA a plus
  • 7-10 years of comparable work experience
  • The successful candidate will have directed an accounting and control organization of relevant size and complexity through a period of sustained growth. First-hand experience in the corporate office of a global, publicly traded company with multi-national locations and revenue greater than $1 billion is strongly preferred.
  • Strong accounting experience, ideally in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial company.

  • Experience and confidence dealing with auditors, senior management and divisional operations.

  • Strong organizational and time management abilities that allow projects and goals to be completed on time.

job.title: Commercial Sales Manager, FT Live Fixed Income Events
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

FT Live is the global events division of the Financial Times, delivering over 200 conferences, forums and virtual events annually. Our Fixed Income Events business brings together senior decision-makers from across the global debt capital markets through a portfolio of leading bond and structured finance conferences, including the CEE Forum, Borrowers & Bond Investors Forum and Covered Bonds Congress.

We are looking for a motivated and commercially driven Commercial Sales Manager to accelerate revenue growth across our bond market events portfolio.

In this role, you will identify and develop new sponsorship opportunities. You will grow existing commercial partnerships and establish long-term connections with senior decision-makers in the international debt capital market sector.    

You will play an important role in shaping the next phase of growth for this established portfolio, combining proactive new business development with strategic account management and consultative selling.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced B2B sales professional who enjoys forming relationships, exceeding commercial targets and working with influential global organisations.

Key responsibilities

  • Identify, pitch and secure new sponsorship and commercial partnership opportunities across the FT Live bond events portfolio.

  • Proactively lead, develop and grow existing accounts, including global investment banks, law firms, asset managers and other financial services providers.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers, finding opportunities to deliver long-term commercial value.

  • Lead client meetings, both in person and virtually, developing tailored sponsorship proposals and negotiating commercial agreements.

  • Collaborate closely with FT Live's content, marketing and operations teams to deliver high-quality sponsor experiences and measurable partner value.

  • Work with colleagues across FT Live's global business to deliver impactful sponsor activations and support year-round client engagement.

  • Attend relevant industry events and FT Live conferences to strengthen relationships, develop market knowledge and identify new commercial opportunities.

  • Monitor industry trends, emerging themes and competitor activity to inform commercial strategy and find opportunities for portfolio growth.

Required skills and experience

  • A demonstrated ability in commercial B2B events, media or sponsorship sales.

  • A consistent track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets, with experience running complex sales cycles and closing high-value commercial agreements.

  • Strong consultative selling and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior partners.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills, coupled with the capacity to develop compelling commercial proposals.  

  • A proactive approach to business development, with the confidence to find opportunities and build new client relationships.  

  • Strong organisational skills, capable of running multiple accounts, prioritising contending deadlines and performing effectively in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform to run sales activity, opportunities and client relationships.

Desirable

  • A general understanding of capital markets, alongside an interest in developing deeper knowledge of the global bond market.

  • Previous experience working with financial services clients, particularly investment banks, private credit managers or legal advisers.

  • Experience collaborating across international teams or within a matrixed organisation.

  • An ambitious approach, with a passion for commercial growth, accountability and ownership.

  • The ability to combine critical thinking with hands-on execution to deliver commercial results.

What's in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may use AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essencrucial all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

Interested in the FT but don’t see the right role yet? Join our Talent Community to receive exclusive updates, featured jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

  • Clear interpersonal communication skills and an interest in collaborating with cross-functional teams.

job.title: Manager, Client Media Solutions
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. Our teams bring together media, omnichannel strategy, analytics, CRM, creative, influencer, technology, and client services capabilities to create connected customer experiences that drive business results across the healthcare ecosystem. 

The Manager, Client Media Solutions serves as a day-to-day leader responsible for the successful planning, execution, and stewardship of integrated media programs for pharma and life sciences clients. This role combines strong media planning fundamentals, financial and operational rigor, client partnership, and project leadership to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, on time, and aligned to client objectives. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

What You'll Do 

  • Own media plans, flowcharts, budget summaries, project trackers, timelines, and workflow documentation across assigned accounts and brands. 
  • Execute and manage campaign work orders, service requests, deliverable rotations, approvals, and project timelines from planning through launch. 
  • Support the development of integrated media recommendations by conducting research, gathering marketplace intelligence, evaluating vendor opportunities, and managing RFP processes. 
  • Collaborate with media partners and vendors to identify direct-buy opportunities and negotiate recommendations with guidance from senior team members. 
  • Monitor campaign pacing, budget performance, and financial health, proactively identifying variances and partnering with Business Operations on invoicing, reconciliation, and reporting. 
  • Serve as a day-to-day client contact, providing project updates, meeting recaps, and ongoing communication across internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Lead campaign stewardship efforts, ensuring plans are executed accurately and align with approved client objectives and budgets. 
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Analytics, Omnichannel Strategy, Activation, Creative, Influencer, CRM, and Client Services teams to deliver integrated solutions. 
  • Translate strategic direction from senior team members into accurate, high-quality deliverables and actionable recommendations. 
  • Support the development of junior team members by reviewing work, providing feedback, and helping ensure quality and process adherence. 

 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You If 

  • Our values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I" genuinely reflect how you work and collaborate. 
  • You are equally comfortable discussing campaign strategy, managing details, and ensuring flawless execution. 
  • You enjoy owning projects from start to finish and can effectively balance multiple priorities across brands and clients. 
  • You are naturally organized and thrive in environments that require strong attention to detail, budget management, and project coordination. 
  • You are a proactive problem solver who can independently navigate day-to-day challenges while escalating larger strategic or commercial decisions appropriately. 
  • You enjoy building relationships with clients, partners, and cross-functional teams and are viewed as a dependable, solutions-oriented contributor. 
  • You can communicate clearly and confidently, tailoring information appropriately for internal and external audiences. 
  • You embrace new technologies, data, and AI-enabled tools that help improve planning, collaboration, and performance. 

 

What You Should Have 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
  • 3-5 years of experience in media planning, media account management, client services, integrated marketing, or agency environments. 
  • Experience managing media plans, budgets, timelines, and campaign documentation across multiple stakeholders and workstreams. 
  • Strong understanding of digital media channels, including programmatic, social, search, endemic, and other paid media tactics. 
  • Experience partnering with media vendors and supporting RFP, proposal evaluation, and recommendation development processes. 
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience managing budgets, pacing, invoicing, reconciliations, and reporting. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight. 
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. 
  • Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and media planning tools such as Prisma, Mediaocean, Comscore, Pathmatics, Kantar, Telmar, or similar platforms. 
  • Healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences marketing experience is preferred. 
  • Experience mentoring junior team members or interns is a plus. 

 

Pay Range: $60,000-$80,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

job.description:
Thanks for visiting the Curtis Media Group Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Morning News Host

Raleigh, NC Full Time Experienced Share Morning News Host/Operations Manager – WPTF FM 92.9/AM 680, Raleigh, NC

WPTF is seeking a dynamic and experienced Morning News Anchor/Operations Manager to lead our morning programming and oversee day-to-day station operations. This dual-role position blends the energy and visibility of a live news host with the strategic oversight of a broadcast operations manager.

As the morning news host, you will be the voice that wakes up the Triangle — delivering local, state, and national news in a clear, engaging, and informative way. As operations manager, you’ll also work closely with programming, engineering, and station leadership to ensure seamless technical execution and content delivery.

This is a high-impact role for a broadcast professional who is passionate about news, understands the Raleigh/Durham market, and is ready to lead both behind the mic and behind the scenes.

Responsibilities
On-Air Hosting:
  • Anchor the live weekday morning news broadcast from 5AM to 9AM.
  • Deliver news, weather, traffic, and information updates in a conversational, clear, and unbiased manner.
  • Conduct live and pre-recorded interviews with newsmakers, public officials, experts, and community members.
  • Collaborate with the VP of News and other show contributors to create engaging, relevant content.
  • Stay up to date on breaking news and local developments to keep the show timely and informative.
  • Maintain a strong social media presence that extends the show’s reach and drives audience engagement.
Operations Management:
  • Oversee daily station operations, including broadcast scheduling, automation systems and technical coordination.
  • Work with programming and engineering to ensure smooth transitions between shows and clean broadcast execution.
  • Manage communication between departments and troubleshoot on-air or backend issues as they arise.
  • Help implement station policies, ensure compliance with FCC regulations and maintain broadcast standards.
  • Assist in onboarding and training part-time staff or interns as needed.
Requirements and Skills
  • Proven experience as a radio host, anchor, or reporter — morning drive experience a plus.
  • Strong understanding of radio operations, scheduling and broadcast automation systems.
  • Broad knowledge of current events, public affairs and local Raleigh-area issues.
  • Confident and professional on-air delivery with strong storytelling ability.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work early mornings and flexible hours as required.
  • Social media savvy with an understanding of how to engage and grow an audience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, broadcasting, communications, or related field preferred.
  • Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Raleigh area, with a working knowledge of the Triangle market.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

    Overview   The Data Products Team within the Data Insights Group (DIG) at Paramount Global builds the internal platforms that power how the business understands streaming performance, audience behavior, and content strategy. We own the applications, APIs, and automation systems that analysts and stakeholders rely on daily. You'll join a small team with outsized impact, working across NextJS applications, FastAPI services, and AI-powered workflows. We build and ship quickly, and the tools we create are used immediately across the organization. If you want to own products end-to-end and see your work drive decisions at scale, this is that type of role.     What You'll Do  
  • Architect and build internal web applications using NextJS and FastAPI
  • Design and own backend services and REST APIs that power automation tools and AI-driven features
  • Partner with data engineers to integrate BigQuery pipelines and metadata systems into user-facing products
  • Drive features from concept through production, owning technical design, implementation, and reliability
  • Solve ambiguous problems across the stack, balancing delivery speed with maintainability
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance
  • Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, and system design
  • Shape the technical roadmap and architectural decisions as the team scales
    Basic Qualifications  
  • 5+ years of software development experience building internal tools or data-driven applications
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Experience architecting production web applications with React or NextJS
  • Experience designing and scaling REST APIs (FastAPI, or similar)
  • Deep knowledge with SQL and cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), including performance optimization
  • Proven ability to own systems end-to-end: design, deployment, monitoring, and iteration
  • Experience mentoring engineers and spearheading engineering standards
  • Strong communication skills with non-technical stakeholders
    Additional Qualifications  
  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) at scale
  • Hands-on experience building production AI solutions, including agents, agentic workflows, and RAG systems
  • Deep knowledge with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK) and their tradeoffs
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) into production, including prompt engineering and cost management
  • Strong background in containerization and cloud infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, GCP/AWS)
  • Background in data engineering, pipeline design, and building tooling for analysts
  • Experience in media, entertainment, or streaming industries
    How We Work  
  • Small team, direct access to stakeholders, short feedback loops. As we grow, you'll shape our technical direction and engineering culture.

Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. job.title: Vice President of Donor Engagement
job.description:
Description

 Join a company that truly impacts others!


Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope.

Hope Media Group the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. 

We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! 


Summary: 

The Vice President, Donor Engagement provides leadership for Hope Media Group's entire donor engagement and fundraising strategy, ensuring an integrated donor journey from acquisition through transformational giving. The VP leads the strategy and performance of donor care, donor communications, mid-level giving, major and catalyst donor engagement, and other donor-facing initiatives, with accountability for donor retention, revenue growth, stewardship, and long-term donor value. As a senior leader within Donor Engagement, this role develops leaders, drives cross-functional alignment, uses data and analytics to inform investment and strategy, and partners with the Chief of Donor Engagement and organizational leadership to advance HMG's ministry and revenue objectives.  

 

Essential Functions

Strategic Direction: 

  • Develop and lead HMG's comprehensive donor engagement strategy, establishing the vision, priorities, goals, and measures of success for donor acquisition, cultivation, retention, stewardship, and growth across the donor lifecycle. 
  • Use data and analytics to evaluate donor behavior, fundraising performance, and engagement trends, informing strategies across the donor lifecycle and identifying opportunities for growth, retention, and increased donor value. 
  • Establish and maintain clear donor pathways that move individuals from initial engagement through mid-level, major, and catalyst giving. 
  • Provide strategic leadership and input into fundraising campaigns and initiatives that generate resources to expand ministry impact. 
  • Collaborate with ministry and organizational leaders to ensure a cohesive, integrated donor journey across HMG brands and platforms. 
  • Establish key performance indicators and regularly evaluate progress toward donor engagement, retention, and revenue objectives. 

Organizational & Executive Leadership: 

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Chief of Donor Engagement in establishing fundraising priorities, revenue strategies, and long-term donor engagement goals.
    • Translate organizational strategy into clear priorities and measurable objectives across Donor Engagement teams.
    • Partner with senior leaders across HMG to align donor strategy with programming, marketing, digital, finance, data, and ministry initiatives.
    • Provide executive-level insight into donor trends, fundraising performance, opportunities, and risks.
    • Represent Donor Engagement in organizational planning and cross-functional initiatives.
    • Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team, equipping directors and managers to effectively lead their functions and teams. 
  • Ensure alignment, accountability, and effective decision-making across Donor Engagement functions while empowering leaders to execute within their areas of responsibility. 

Donor Engagement & Program Oversight 

  • Provide strategic oversight of HMG's donor engagement programs, ensuring alignment and effectiveness across donor care, communications, mid-level, major, catalyst, events, and other donor-facing initiatives. 
  • Oversee the mid-level donor advisor program, ensuring effective portfolio strategy, donor cultivation, stewardship, and pathways to major giving. 
  • Lead Donor Communications strategy, including collaboration with fundraising consultants, ensuring cohesive multi-channel stewardship and solicitation across print, digital, on-air, and other donor touchpoints. 
  • Provide strategic oversight to Donor Care, ensuring donors receive responsive, compassionate, and effective support. 
  • Guide strategies that strengthen donor acquisition, retention, engagement, stewardship, and long-term donor value. 
  • Ensure alignment between fundraising leadership and HMG's overall donor engagement strategy. 

Department Operations & Performance: 

  • Ensure Donor Engagement has effective systems, processes, tools, and resources necessary to achieve departmental objectives. 
  • Establish expectations for operational excellence, accountability, documentation, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration across Donor Engagement. 
  • Identify organizational or departmental barriers to effectiveness and partner with Donor Engagement leaders and cross-functional teams to implement solutions. 
  • Provide executive oversight of key departmental projects and initiatives, ensuring appropriate ownership, prioritization, and accountability. 
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, and other organizational functions to ensure Donor Engagement leaders and teams have the resources and support necessary to achieve fundraising and donor engagement objectives. 

Budget Management:

  • Partner with the Chief of Donor Engagement and Finance to develop annual departmental budgets, fundraising revenue goals, and forecasts. 
  • Regularly evaluate departmental spending and fundraising performance against budget and forecast, identifying risks, opportunities, and necessary adjustments. 
  • Ensure departmental resources are strategically allocated toward initiatives that advance donor engagement and fundraising objectives. 
  • Provide FP&A monthly input to accurately forecast costs and revenue. 
  • Ensure departmental spending complies with HMG financial, credit card, travel, and purchasing policies. 

 Demonstrated Faith: 

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ 
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate 
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies 
  • Live Christian principles defined by the Ministry Statement of Faith 
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed 
  • Passion for leveraging the platform of radio for evangelism and discipleship 
  • Exhibit a strong moral character 
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church 

Requirements

 Non-Essential Functions:

  • Perform other duties as requested 

Requirements and Qualifications: 

Education: 

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred 

Experience: 

  • 7–10 years nonprofit fundraising, donor engagement, or donor communications experience.  
  • Demonstrated success in donor program design and execution, including mass, mid, and major stewardship programs.   
  • Experience managing and coaching diverse teams.  
  • Familiarity with direct mail, digital campaigns, and donor care strategies 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

  • Heart for Christian ministry.  
  • Strong moral character and personal relationship with Jesus Christ.  
  • Strategic thinker with ability to use data for decision-making.  
  • Skilled communicator with ability to build rapport and inspire trust.  
  • Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills.  
  • Ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams.  
  • Knowledge of donor databases, fundraising systems, and Microsoft Office Suite. 

Supervisory Responsibilities: :

  • Immediate supervision over a unit, section, or department. Recommends candidates for hiring, termination; prepares and conducts performance appraisals and salary reviews and applies company policies. 

Working Conditions and Environment 

Travel: 

  • Occasional overnight travel required for donor meetings, events, and organizational gatherings 

Nights/Weekends/Holidays: 

  • May be required occasionally for donor events or fundraisers 

Physical Requirements 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers including pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than the whole hand as in handling.  

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work. 

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains

job.title: Manager, Creative Video
job.description:
Overview:

The Durham Bulls are seeking a talented, driven, and visually minded individual to lead the concept, production, and delivery of all video content across the Durham Bulls organization. From high-energy promotional hype reels to in-game videoboard packages to sponsor deliverables and social media content, this role owns every frame of video that represents the Bulls brand.


This role sits at the intersection of creativity and execution, collaborating with marketing, corporate partnerships, community relations, and game presentation to ensure every video asset, whether a 15-second social clip or a four-minute opening day hype film, is delivered on time, on brand, and at the highest possible standard.

 

Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions:


Video Production & Creative Development

  • Lead the creative vision, planning, production, editing, and delivery of all Durham Bulls video content. 
  • Produce high-quality promotional videos, hype reels, player features, season recaps, theme night content, organizational messaging, and in-game entertainment packages. 
  • Develop compelling visual storytelling that strengthens the Durham Bulls brand and enhances the fan experience. 
  • Shoot and edit video content for baseball games, special events, community appearances, player features, and organizational initiatives. 
  • Create engaging short-form video content optimized for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and other digital platforms.




Project & Production Management

  • Manage the organization's video production calendar, balancing multiple concurrent projects while ensuring deadlines are consistently met. 
  • Coordinate video requests from internal departments, establish production timelines, and communicate project status with stakeholders. 
  • Organize and maintain all raw footage, project files, and completed video assets for future use. 
  • Maintain video production equipment, cameras, lighting, audio equipment, and media storage while ensuring all equipment remains production-ready.


Ticket Sales & Marketing Support

  • Produce video assets supporting season ticket campaigns, group sales initiatives, suite sales, mini plans, and promotional campaigns. 
  • Create video content for digital advertising, email marketing, website promotions, and organizational communications. 
  • Collaborate with the Marketing Department to develop campaigns that drive attendance, engagement, and brand awareness.

Corporate Partnerships

  • Produce sponsor fulfillment videos, commercial spots, branded content, and partnership deliverables in accordance with contractual obligations. 
  • Collaborate with Corporate Partnerships to develop creative concepts that maximize sponsor visibility and value.


Game Presentation

  • Produce and deliver videoboard content, player introductions, walk-up videos, countdowns, transitions, entertainment features, and promotional elements. 
  • Work closely with the Game Presentation team to ensure all content is properly formatted, tested, and integrated into the live game presentation. 
  • Build and maintain a library of evergreen video assets for use throughout the season. 



Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Video Production, Film, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3–5 years of professional video production experience within sports, entertainment, media, or an agency environment.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro with demonstrated experience editing high-quality content under tight deadlines.
  • Experience operating DSLR and/or mirrorless camera systems for both studio and field production.
  • Experience with lighting, audio recording, and on-location production techniques.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments.
  • Passion for storytelling, sports, and creating engaging fan experiences.
  •  

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Adobe After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop, Illustrator, or other creative software.
  • Motion graphics and animation experience.
  • Experience producing content for MiLB, MLB, collegiate athletics, or professional sports organizations.
  • Familiarity with videoboard production workflows and live event presentation.
  • Experience creating sponsor-branded content and commercial deliverables.
  • Knowledge of current social media trends and platform best practices.

 

Physical Demands: 


  • Seeing, hearing, listening, touching, ability to move across distances, climbing, pushing, and pulling, and hand/finger dexterity. 
  • Capacity for intermediate reading and writing, basic clerical and math skills, advanced analysis and comprehension skills, advanced judgment, and decision-making skills. 
  • Able to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds. 

 

Work Conditions: 


  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to remain focused and perform work in noisy and crowded environments with multiple distractions. 
  • This position may occasionally require working outdoors in unpredictable weather conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, snow, and wind, necessitating the ability to adapt to changing environmental factors and wear appropriate protective gear as needed.

job.title: Line Producer, America's Newsroom
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

America’s Newsroom is looking for a sharp, creative, and highly motivated Line Producer to oversee the live production of the program’s 10 AM hour. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, breaking news environment, exercises strong editorial judgment, and understands how to create compelling television. The Line Producer is more than an executor—they are a key contributor to the editorial process who consistently generates ideas, identifies opportunities, and helps shape the day’s coverage. We are looking for someone who is curious, collaborative, and eager to grow into expanded editorial and leadership responsibilities.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build, maintain, and execute the rundown for the 10 AM hour
  • Manage live control room production and make real-time editorial decisions during breaking news
  • Collaborate with senior producers, bookers, and associate producers to develop daily coverage
  • Identify strong video, soundbites, graphics, and visual storytelling opportunities
  • Produce guest segments, reporter hits, anchor discussions, and breaking news coverage
  • Copy edit scripts, banners, and graphics to ensure accuracy, clarity, and strong storytelling
  • Monitor multiple news sources and flag important developments throughout the day
  • Participate in editorial meetings and contribute original story ideas and segment concepts
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with talent, directors, and technical staff during live broadcasts
  • Assist with social media and cross-platform content initiatives as needed
  • Help mentor junior producers and contribute to a collaborative team environment

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field of study is preferred, or equivalent experience
  • Prior television and live control room experience
  • Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions independently in a fast-paced news environment
  • Strong news judgment and passion for breaking news, politics, and current events
  • Excellent writing, copy editing, and communication skills
  • Ability to remain calm and decisive under deadline pressure
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Familiarity with iNews, Dalet, VIZ, and newsroom production workflows
  • Ability to identify compelling elements that elevate television storytelling
  • Demonstrated curiosity about emerging technologies, audience trends, and new workflows that can enhance storytelling and newsroom efficiency
  • Desire to grow into larger editorial and leadership responsibilities

job.title: Content Operations Specialist
job.description:
Content Operations Specialist

Overall Responsibilities

The Content Operations Specialist is responsible for managing and ensuring the technical and broadcast quality of all inbound and outbound content feeds, including video and audio signals, for live and recorded programming at Weather Group Television (WGT). This role combines responsibilities from media acquisitions and master control operations and longform content preparation for Entertainment Studios eight digital channels. As this position supports a 24x7 news/weather environment, candidates must have flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed and without advance notice.

Specific Responsibilities

ESN - Network Content Operations

  • Review the next day’s list of “barter shows” and editing requirements.

  • Edit barter show segments for two channels, match file titles, segment lengths, and proper transmission standards.  

  • Make necessary adjustments and verify all file segments for final delivery and playback.

  • Review playlists and associated content for missing segments or other incomplete assets

  • Purge older content files, per policy and procedures.

  • Verify all assets for all channels' playlists are correct and ready for playback

  • Verify timing for all playlists for the current day/weekend days.  

  • Communicate playlist or file issues to the appropriate internal or external partner and work toward a solution prior to air time. 

  • Process dub list for promotional/commercial assets

  • Upload/download files to/from the assigned storage repository (local or cloud)

WGT - MEDIA ACQUISITIONS

  • Ensure broadcast quality of all inbound/outbound video and audio feeds using scopes, analyzers, and level monitoring equipment.

  • Monitor multiple networks for high-standard quality control and report technical issues to appropriate departments.

  • Operate video/audio/L-Band routers, route remote feeds, and perform corrective actions to maintain broadcast signal integrity.

  • Manage content acquisition platforms, including LiveU, Dejero, TVU, LTN, and The Switch.

  • Use newsroom content systems to manage recordings and elements for live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate remote resources (IRDs, encoders, and format converters), adjusting levels and troubleshooting in real time.

  • Operate playout automation across networks to edit, load, and update playlists for live programming.

  • Perform daily checks on critical broadcast gear to maintain industry standards and proactively resolve system issues.

  • Utilize technical software tools, including FTP clients, satellite/scheduling software, MAM, MS Office, and Google Workspace.

TWC - MASTER CONTROL OPERATION

  • Responsible for editing, loading, and monitoring The Weather Channel (TWC) playlist using the automation systems.  

  • Work with Editorial and Programming teams to alter the playlist, within approved guidelines to maintain operational “on-air” continuity. 

  • Monitor multiple TWC feeds (uplinks, downlinks, STAR feeds, etc.) and those of other Allen Media & Entertainment Studios networks. 

  •  Provide Tier 1 technical support to internal technical teams by reporting/requesting Engineering  / IT assistance.   

  • Work closely with Engineering on any signal issues, alarms, or technical issues related to monitored network feeds. 

  • Perform operational checks, monitor video/audio quality, and proactively resolve system defects or failures.

  • Maintain shift logs, outage notifications, service request forms, and operational documentation.

  • Communicate status updates and repair workflows with management, engineering teams, and MCR clients.

  • Participate in technical training and adapt to changing operational demands.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Broadcasting, Communications, a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in news environments, teleport operations, cable, or national broadcast environments.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate professionally with multiple internal technical teams and external vendors. 

  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills, with the ability to manage time effectively and operational resources in a dynamic, 24/7 environment with critical deadlines.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of satellite news gathering (SNG) processes, digital satellite equipment, waveform and vector scopes, and spectrum analyzers.

  • Understanding of broadcast automation systems and how to monitor signal workflow for troubleshooting

  • Experience understanding file formats, including codecs, wrappers, and technical specs

  • Proficiency in HDTV, SDI, ASI, and IP formats, as well as conversion technologies

  • Experience with electronic news/field gathering, teleport, and satellite truck operations, including ingest operations, is desired.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to respond quickly to technical issues and implement solutions under operational constraints.

  • Ability to interact effectively and collaboratively across departments and with management, maintaining professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Sensitivity to the unique needs and challenges of a 24/7 operation, ensuring operational continuity and quality.

  • Ability to work in a project and live broadcast environment simultaneously

  • Basic understanding of closed captions, including formats and regulations.

Behavior Requirements

  • Unquestionably high ethical standards

  • Customer-focused and team player mentality

  • Flexible and adaptable attitude in an ever-changing environment

  • Ability to get along well with others, willing and able to deal with a diverse cultural & customer base in numerous types of challenging situations

  • Interest in learning as well as teaching and developing skills in others

  • Strong teamwork and problem-solving skills

  • Willingness to work in a team environment or on individual projects on an as-needed basis

  • Ability to interact effectively “horizontally” through Weather Group TV and Allen Media as needed, working closely and collaboratively with multiple departments and management


Physical Requirements

  • Will be required to sit in a chair from 2-5 hours at a time

  • Will be required to view multiple computer documents and video images on multiple screens and/or listen to multiple audio sources simultaneously

  • Must be able to lift and move equipment as required

  • May be required to carry a laptop.


Equal Opportunity

Reporting to the Director of Internal Communications, this individual will bring subject-matter expertise to NBCU’s total rewards and benefits communications while also serving as a versatile communications and change management partner supporting our Corporate Functions and executive communications. The ideal candidate is a strong writer and strategic partner who can translate complex information into clear, compelling content and experiences that inform, inspire, and engage employees across NBCU.

  • Partner closely with HR, Legal, and Corporate Communications teams to translate complex benefits policies, programs, and strategic priorities into clear, accurate, and engaging communications that help employees make informed decisions.

  • Plan and execute employee engagement campaigns, events, and activations that promote participation, strengthen culture, and enhance the uniquely NBCU employee experience. 

  • Support organizational change and company-wide initiatives through thoughtful communications planning. Manage projects and editorial calendars, coordinate stakeholder reviews and approvals, and use employee feedback and engagement insights to continuously improve content effectiveness. 

Here you'll need:

  • 5+ years of experience in internal, corporate, or employee communications, including meaningful experience leading benefits or total rewards communications.

Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que les quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de calibre mondial partout dans le monde grâce à Universal Destinations & Experiences, dont Universal Orlando Resort, qui accueille Universal Epic Universe, ainsi qu’Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Pour en savoir plus, visitez www.nbcuniversal.com.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des collectivités où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que notre personnel ait l’occasion de contribuer activement à sa communauté. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir un vaste éventail de contenus qui reflètent le monde dans lequel nous vivons.

As Lead Tools Programmer, you are responsible for defining, building, and guiding tools and workflows that empower content creators and developers across the project. This role spans in‑engine tooling, standalone desktop applications, and optional web‑enabled tools, enabling efficient production at scale on an AAA title. You provide technical leadership for tools architecture while collaborating closely with Design, Art, Production, and Engineering to ensure tools are robust, scalable, and production‑ready.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Lead the design and implementation of tools supporting content creation, iteration, validation, and debugging.
  • Define and maintain tools architecture spanning Unreal Engine editor tools and standalone applications.
  • Design and oversee standalone desktop tools using frameworks such as Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI, or similar cross‑platform solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for tools written in C++, with supporting layers in Python or C# where appropriate.
  • Act as the primary technical partner for artists, designers, and developers, translating workflow needs into effective tools.
  • Mentor and support tools programmers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best‑practice development.
  • Collaborate with Pipeline, Gameplay, UI, and Production teams to integrate tools into daily workflows.
  • Oversee performance, stability, usability, and maintainability of tools used across disciplines.
  • Establish coding standards, documentation practices, and testing strategies for tools development.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and drive improvements through tooling, automation, and data‑driven solutions.
  • Guide the evolution of tools toward extensibility, cross‑project reuse, and long‑term scalability.
  • Debug complex tools issues involving engine integration, file I/O, data pipelines, and external services.
  • Stay current with industry trends in tools development, automation, and developer experience.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

À titre de Programmeur ou programmeuse outils Lead, vous êtes responsable de définir, développer et orienter les outils et les flux de travail qui permettent aux créateurs et créatrices de contenu ainsi qu’aux équipes de développement de travailler efficacement à l’échelle du projet. Ce rôle couvre les outils intégrés au moteur, les applications de bureau autonomes et, au besoin, les outils connectés au web, afin de soutenir une production AAA efficace à grande échelle. Vous assurez le leadership technique de l’architecture des outils tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Design, Art, Production et Ingénierie afin de garantir que les outils sont robustes, évolutifs et prêts pour la production.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Diriger la conception et l’implantation d’outils soutenant la création de contenu, l’itération, la validation et le débogage.
  • Définir et maintenir l’architecture des outils couvrant les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et les applications autonomes.
  • Concevoir et superviser des outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de frameworks tels que Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI ou d’autres solutions multiplateformes comparables.
  • Fournir un leadership technique pour les outils développés en C++, avec des couches complémentaires en Python ou en C# lorsque pertinent.
  • Agir comme principal partenaire technique des artistes, des concepteurs et conceptrices ainsi que des développeurs et développeuses, en traduisant les besoins liés aux flux de travail en outils efficaces.
  • Encadrer et soutenir les programmeurs et programmeuses outils grâce aux revues de code, à l’orientation technique et aux pratiques exemplaires de développement.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Pipeline, Gameplay, UI et Production afin d’intégrer les outils aux flux de travail quotidiens.
  • Superviser la performance, la stabilité, la convivialité et la maintenabilité des outils utilisés par les différentes disciplines.
  • Établir les normes de codage, les pratiques de documentation et les stratégies de test pour le développement d’outils.
  • Identifier les goulots d’étranglement dans les flux de travail et piloter les améliorations au moyen d’outils, d’automatisation et de solutions fondées sur les données.
  • Orienter l’évolution des outils vers une plus grande extensibilité, la réutilisation entre projets et une évolutivité à long terme.
  • Déboguer des problèmes complexes liés aux outils, notamment l’intégration moteur, les entrées-sorties de fichiers, les pipelines de données et les services externes.
  • Se tenir à jour quant aux tendances de l’industrie en matière de développement d’outils, d’automatisation et d’expérience des développeurs et développeuses.

Basic Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in C++, with extensive experience developing tools or editor‑focused systems.
  • At least 8+ years of professional experience in game programming, with shipped titles or equivalent AAA production experience.
  • Professional experience with Unreal Engine editor tooling and engine integration.
  • Strong understanding of tools architecture, data‑driven systems, and content creation workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or technically guiding programmers on a production team.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to design robust systems under production constraints.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Perforce or Git.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience building standalone desktop tools using Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms), or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python for tooling, automation, and glue code.
  • Familiarity with web‑enabled tools using technologies such as REST APIs, Electron, or lightweight web dashboards.
  • Strong empathy for end‑users and a focus on usability and iteration speed.
  • A passion for enabling teams through high‑quality tools and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base :

  • Solide maîtrise du C++, avec une vaste expérience dans le développement d’outils ou de systèmes axés sur les éditeurs.
  • Au moins 8 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en programmation de jeux vidéo, avec des titres commercialisés ou une expérience équivalente dans des productions AAA.
  • Expérience professionnelle avec les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et leur intégration au moteur.
  • Solide compréhension de l’architecture des outils, des systèmes pilotés par les données et des flux de création de contenu.
  • Expérience démontrée de leadership, de mentorat ou d’accompagnement technique de programmeurs et programmeuses au sein d’une équipe de production.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de résolution de problèmes et capacité à concevoir des systèmes robustes dans un contexte de contraintes de production.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec diverses disciplines.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de gestion de versions tels que Perforce ou Git.

Atouts souhaités :

  • Expérience dans le développement d’outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms) ou de frameworks comparables.
  • Expérience avec des langages de script tels que Python pour les outils, l’automatisation et le code d’intégration.
  • Connaissance des outils connectés au web utilisant des technologies telles que les API REST, Electron ou des tableaux de bord web légers.
  • Forte sensibilité aux besoins des utilisateurs et utilisatrices et souci de la convivialité ainsi que de la rapidité d’itération.
  • Passion pour soutenir les équipes grâce à des outils et des flux de travail de grande qualité.

  • Support live events and linear channels, helping ensure reliable and high-quality streaming experiences.
  • Collaborate with Engineering Managers and Principal Engineers to develop solutions that improve video delivery and enhance audio and video quality.
  • Work closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient services across multiple regions.
  • Monitor system performance using metrics, logs, and traces to identify issues, troubleshoot problems, and improve service reliability.
  • Manage and maintain cloud-based services and content delivery systems.
  • Continuously improve code quality, system performance, and development processes.

  • Working for a well-known, globally leading Media Streaming organization
  • Exposure to high-level business professionals in a variety of departments and geographic locations
  • Opportunity to work and grow your career in fast-paced environment
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 5+ years’ experience in software development and web technologies.
  • Proficiency with languages such as Java, Go, Python, JavaScript
  • Experience in building real-time, large-scale, low latency distributed systems
  • Understands CI/CD pipelines and large-scale deployment
  • Deep understanding of OO Design Principles and Patterns.
  • Embrace open-source technologies
  • Technical experience with cloud-based technologies, specifically within architecture/infrastructure (AWS)
  • Understanding of TDD, ATDD and BDD and approaches
  • Understanding of containerization as it relates to Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Key understanding of technology principles and work methods (Agile, Scrum, etc.)

job.title: Sr DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.


Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues. 

 

You will play a key role in defining the software architecture, database schemas, and overall system experience, while helping to track and visualize optimization progress over time. As this is a brand‑new platform with no prior internal equivalent, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape its foundations and influence how performance testing is approached across our game development teams. 

 

 

What you will do: 

  • Develop and maintain a platform (applications, integrations and infrastructure) supporting gaming department

  • Partner closely with software architects, game developers, QA, and operations to remove bottlenecks and improve delivery 

  • Build and Maintain CI/CD Pipelines 

  • Script repetitive tasks and develop self-service tools for developers 

  • Design and manage infrastructure 

  • Implement and manage containers, stand up and manage VMs 

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting 

  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, secure, and reliable. 

 

We are looking for Engineers that: 

  • Is fully self‑reliant and can take responsibility for future deliverables, 

  • Value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and contributing to the team's overall effectiveness,  

  • Equally enjoys coding applications and managing infrastructure 

  • Keep up to date with modern web technologies,   

  • Want to actively participate in decision making and fully understand products they work on,   

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.  

 

And on the technical side, we need: 

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Very good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture 

  • Proficient in coding in at least one programing language (preferred: Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, C++/C#) 

  • Experienced in code collaboration and proficient in Git, 

  • Experienced in containers orchestration in Kubernetes, 

  • Deep knowledge and practical experience managing Cloud infrastructure. OCI is a huge plus. 

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and Linux VMs 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience scripting in BuildGraph 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience in code collaboration using Perforce

Overview:

Own the product direction for one of the largest sports apps in the country. The CBS Sports App is home to some of the biggest sporting events in the world: The Masters, NFL, March Madness, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full app experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you’re in the details.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for the CBS Sports App and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on.
  • Own the app's plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to continue, change, or stop.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1–2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.
  How We Build (The Builder Culture):
  • We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions.
  • AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll model it and push what's possible further.
  • The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission.
  What success looks like:
  • The app's product strategy is coherent. People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not to do.
  • Ideas are tested before they're committed. Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity. Fewer false starts, less rework.
  • PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer environment, ideally mobile-first and at scale. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold app-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view on how AI changes what a product team can do.
