job.title: Lead Engineer, Discovery
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Consumer Platform Engineering owns the API layer that sits between Paramount's client apps (Web, iOS, Android, Roku, CTV, Apple TV, Fire TV, and more) and the downstream content, identity, and commerce systems that power them. The org is organized into three domains — Identity & Commerce, Experiences, and Discovery. Discovery domain engineers build and operate the backend services powering content discovery across search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata. Our systems focus on helping viewers discover content at scale—delivering low-latency, high-concurrency services across millions of devices ranging from legacy TVs to modern streaming boxes. 

 

Role Summary 

We are hiring a Lead Engineer to be the senior technical anchor for a team of backend engineers building the services that power content discovery across Pluto TV and Paramount+. You will drive architecture and design for the domain's most complex initiatives, set the technical bar through hands-on coding and code/design review, and mentor engineers — while partnering with your Engineering Manager, Product, Data Science & Personalization, and adjacent platform domains to ship performant services that drive viewer engagement. 

 

This is a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through technical depth and influence, not through formal people-management authority. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Technical Leadership & Architecture 

    • Drive the architecture and design for the domain's backend services and APIs (search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata), balancing feature delivery against platform health, scalability, and technical debt.

    • Serve as the hands-on technical authority in design reviews — making the call on service boundaries, caching strategies, and data models for high-throughput systems, and staying close enough to the code to lead by example. 

    • Break large-scale architectural initiatives (such as personalization engine overhauls and new recommendation surfaces) into shippable, measurable phases, and personally lead delivery of the highest-complexity or highest-risk pieces. 

    • Set and uphold engineering standards for the team: code quality, testing practices, API design conventions, and documentation. 

  • Operational Ownership 

    • Ensure backend services meet availability, low-latency, and high-concurrency targets for APIs consumed across Pluto TV and Paramount+ client apps. 

    • Lead on-call engineering practices, incident response, and postmortems for the team's services; be the senior escalation point for the most complex production issues. 

    • Define, track, and optimize operational KPIs (p99 latency, error rates, cache hit ratios, and API adoption), and drive the technical investments needed to keep them healthy.

  • Cross-functional Partnership

    • Partner with Product Management and the Data Science & Personalization teams as the technical voice for the domain, translating engagement goals into concrete technical designs. 

    • Represent the team in cross-functional and cross-domain technical discussions with Identity & Commerce and Experiences, ensuring backend APIs integrate cleanly with entitlement, playback, and UI client layers. 

    • Communicate technical trade-offs, design decisions, and risks clearly to your Engineering Manager, peer leads, and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Technical Mentorship & Team Enablement

    • Mentor and grow engineers on the team through code review, design pairing, and hands-on guidance — raising the technical level of the team over time.

    • Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical aspects of hiring (interviewing, technical bar-raising) and onboarding new engineers. 

    • Foster a culture of technical ownership and operational accountability, giving engineers context and room to drive their own implementation decisions. Support coordination with distributed or offshore engineering partners on technical execution and design alignment. 

  • Process & Delivery 

    • Contribute to and help run agile workflows (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives), with a focus on technical sequencing and de-risking dependencies. Own comprehensive documentation for system architecture, API contracts, domain data models, and operational runbooks. 

 

Basic Qualifications and Experience 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a solid track record as a senior hands-on contributor on backend and distributed systems in streaming, media, e-commerce, or another high-traffic consumer platform. Demonstrated experience owning the design and delivery of high-concurrency APIs or platforms consumed at scale across heterogeneous client surfaces (web, mobile, legacy TVs, and modern streaming devices). Deep familiarity with core discovery domains: search indexing, recommendation pipelines, content metadata, or ranking systems. 

  • Technical Acumen - - - - Deep, current, hands-on expertise in distributed systems, API design, caching strategies, and data modeling for high-throughput, low-latency services. Ability to serve as the technical tie-breaker in architecture reviews — evaluating system trade-offs, service boundaries, and design choices under ambiguity, and defending decisions with data. Hands-on expertise with Java-based backend services, cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), and modern CI/CD practices. Proven experience operating services under strict SLAs, leveraging metrics (p99 latency, error rates, cache hit ratios, A/B test data) to guide technical and operational decisions. 

  • Leadership & Collaboration - - - - Track record of mentoring and raising the bar for engineers through code review, design guidance, and pairing — without formal management authority. Strong communicator who bridges technical and non-technical partners — translating product visions into scoped, actionable technical designs. Skilled at navigating competing priorities across cross-functional groups, including Product Management, Data Science & Personalization, and adjacent platform teams. Comfortable working alongside geographically distributed engineering teams across time zones, including partner or offshore engineering teams. 

  • Mindset - - - Strong bias toward incremental, measurable delivery over big-bang system launches. Genuine curiosity about how content discovery and personalization drive viewer engagement — you care as much about the "why" (watch time, engagement) as the "how" (systems, APIs). Proactive ownership mindset toward operational health and system reliability, building resilient production services rather than just reacting to incidents. 

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with recommendation systems, ML-adjacent infrastructure, or search technologies (e.g., Elasticsearch, Solr). 

  • Prior experience in multi-brand or multi-app streaming platforms (AVOD, SVOD, FAST).

  • Experience working alongside vendor and offshore engineering resources on technical delivery.

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Saint Louis, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Saint Louis's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3-5+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Sales Assistant / Sales Development position provides comprehensive support to the KWES Sales Department and Director of Sales while gaining broad exposure to the station's sales, operational and client-service functions. This is a department-wide sales support position and is not dedicated exclusively to individual Account Executives. Responsibilities and priorities may shift based on the operational, Account Manager, sales and leadership needs of the department.
  The position will support sales leadership, assist Account Executives as needed, provide backup Account Manager coverage, and develop knowledge of KWES's broadcast, streaming and digital sales solutions. This role is also designed to provide professional development and exposure that may prepare a successful employee for a future Account Executive opportunity as business needs and openings arise.
Four Core Areas of Responsibility
1. Director of Sales & Department Support
Serve as a primary support resource to the Director of Sales and overall
KWES sales organization.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist the DOS with sales reports, presentations, meeting preparation
and follow-up. • Support preparation for weekly sales meetings, revenue discussions
and sales initiatives.
• Assist with revenue, inventory and sales activity reporting.
• Maintain current sales materials, programming information,
sponsorship opportunities and other department resources.
• Track department deadlines, outstanding items and projects requiring
follow-up.
• Assist with special sales initiatives, client events and station
opportunities.
• Coordinate information and workflow between Sales and other
departments, including Traffic, Creative Services, Finance, Digital and
Sales Fulfillment.
• Assist with organization and execution of seasonal programming,
sports, political and special sales opportunities.
• Provide administrative and project support as assigned by the DOS.
• Take on additional responsibilities based on changing department
priorities and business needs.
2. Account Executive & Sales Support
Provide operational and administrative support to Account Executives as
needed and based on department priorities to allow sellers to maximize
client-facing and new-business development time.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist with order entry, revisions and schedule changes.
• Support campaign setup and maintenance.
• Monitor active schedules and campaign delivery.
• Assist with makegoods, preemptions and discrepancy resolution. • Prepare and update client presentations, proposals and sales
materials.
• Assist with avails and inventory coordination.
• Coordinate commercial materials, scripts and creative needs.
• Follow up with Traffic, Creative Services and Sales Fulfillment on
outstanding items.
• Assist with routine client and agency administrative requests.
• Support campaign recaps and post-campaign reporting.
• Help maintain accurate client, account and campaign information.
• Assist with Matrix/CRM administrative support while maintaining AE
accountability for prospecting activity, opportunities and pipeline
management.
The Sales Assistant supports the business of the sales department rather
than being permanently assigned to any individual Account Executive.
3. Account Manager Coverage & Operational Support
Develop proficiency in Account Manager responsibilities to provide reliable
backup coverage during vacations, PTO, vacancies, periods of increased
workload or other business needs.
Responsibilities include:
• Become proficient in WO Media Sales and applicable sales systems.
• Enter and revise orders accurately.
• Understand Traffic workflow, deadlines and requirements.
• Assist with schedule maintenance and campaign stewardship.
• Coordinate makegoods and resolve scheduling discrepancies.
• Assist with billing and invoice questions as appropriate.
• Track commercial materials and creative requirements. • Understand MediaFerry and applicable creative workflows.
• Provide professional client and agency administrative communication.
• Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaign fulfillment.
• Maintain continuity of sales operations when Account Manager
coverage is needed.
The expectation is that this employee becomes a dependable cross-trained
resource who can step into operational gaps without disrupting service to
clients or the sales team.
4. Account Executive Development
Develop the foundational skills, product knowledge and sales experience
necessary to potentially advance into a future Account Executive position.
Development opportunities may include:
• Participate in sales and product training.
• Develop knowledge of KWES/KIDY/KXVA broadcast programming and
sales opportunities.
• Learn TEGNA's Total TV approach: Broadcast + Streaming + Digital.
• Develop working knowledge of Premion, CTV/OTT, Audience
Marketplace and other digital solutions.
• Learn Matrix CRM and proper pipeline management.
• Participate in prospect research and new-business development
exercises.
• Learn effective prospecting techniques.
• Observe and participate in client discovery.
• Attend selected client meetings and AE ride-alongs.
• Assist with development of integrated client recommendations.
• Learn proposal development and presentation skills. • Gain exposure to pricing and inventory strategy.
• Develop understanding of campaign measurement, stewardship and
renewal.
• Participate in role-play, presentation and sales-development exercises.
• Demonstrate the ability to communicate the value of
KWES/KIDY/KXVA and TEGNA solutions to local businesses.
Career Development Opportunity
This position is designed to provide broad exposure to the KWES/KIDY/KXVA sales organization and may serve as a developmental pathway toward a future Account Executive opportunity. As the employee demonstrates proficiency in their core responsibilities, additional opportunities may be provided to develop prospecting, discovery, presentation, client relationship and new-business skills. Advancement into an Account Executive position is not guaranteed and will depend upon individual performance, demonstrated sales readiness, business needs and future position availability.
Key Qualifications
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Professional written and verbal communication.
• Strong customer-service mindset.
• Ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Comfort learning new software, systems and processes.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Teams,
PowerPoint and Excel. • Ability to analyze information and identify potential problems before
they affect clients.
• Initiative and willingness to take ownership of assignments.
• Interest in sales, marketing, advertising and business development.
• Ability to work independently while functioning as part of a larger
sales team.
• Desire to learn and grow within the organization.
Experience in media, advertising, sales support, customer service or account
management is beneficial but not necessarily required for the right
candidate.
Measures of Success
Success in this position will be measured by:
• Accuracy and timeliness of work.
• Responsiveness to DOS and department priorities.
• Reliability of AE and AM support.
• Ability to manage and follow through on assigned projects.
• Reduction of administrative and operational workload on sellers and
sales leadership.
• Quality of internal and external communication.
• Campaign and order accuracy.
• Ability to identify and resolve issues proactively.
• Growth in product, system and sales knowledge.
• Demonstrated readiness to assume increasing responsibility.     Role Philosophy

•    Demonstrate flexibility and initiative in balancing creative, technical, and operational responsibilities.

•    Demonstrated hands-on videography experience, including field and/or studio shooting.

job.title: Benefits Manager
job.description:
Job Title

Benefits Manager

Job Description

The Benefits Manager will assist with the design, implementation, administration, and promotion of our employee benefits programs across People Incorporated. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Benefits, this individual will collaborate to ensure that People Incorporated’s benefit offerings remain highly competitive, fully compliant with regulations, and aligned with overall organizational goals. This role requires an experienced professional with vendor management expertise and project management skills to support benefit initiatives, manage partner relationships, and drive program rollouts.


The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.


About The Position

Benefits Strategy & Administration

  • Manage employee benefits programs across the People Incorporated portfolio, including healthcare, life/disability, 401(k), voluntary benefits, and leave management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for employee benefit questions, policy interpretations, and operational concerns.
  • Evaluate existing benefit vendors and assist with RFPs and implementations as needed.
  • Oversee the annual open enrollment process, including plan design decisions, benefits administration system testing, multi-channel communications, onsite events, and employee education.

Vendor Management & Strategic Partnerships

  • Manage benefit vendor relationships, brokers, consultants, and administration partners to ensure all issues are escalated and resolved quickly and appropriately.
  • Assist with monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for benefit vendors, ensuring high-quality execution, accountability, and continuous performance review.
  • Lead benefits billing for multiple vendors including tracking administrative and claims costs and managing the intercompany billing process.
  • Act as a key contact point for vendor service issues, financial reconciliations, and operational discrepancies.

Project Management & Process Optimization

  • Manage  projects related to benefits system integration, policy updates, structural plan changes, and process optimization.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestone tracking for key HR and benefits initiatives. Coordinate with vendors to track updates.
  • Tracks the status of contracts. Coordinates with Legal and Vendors as necessary to facilitate the review and approval of contracts.
  • Partner with HRIS and our 3rd party  benefits administrator to ensure seamless integrations, early detection of any issues, and oversight of the resolution.

Compliance & Governance

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant federal, state, and local laws and regulations governing benefits, including ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, ACA, and HIPAA.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local requirements across all benefit programs, assisting with required filings and disclosures including Form 5500s, 1095-Cs, RxDC, and non-discrimination testing.
  • Perform regular plan audits and risk assessments in collaboration with internal and external audit teams.

Communication & Education

  • Establish a benefits calendar with different benefits communication and promotion strategies from the various benefit partners. Enhance employee engagement, understanding, and program utilization.
  • Maintain an employee resource database within the benefits administration system and ensure all materials are up to date.
  • Partner with our vendors to coordinate employee education sessions for 401k and other benefit plans. 
  • Coordinate communication campaigns across all subsidiaries, ensuring accurate distribution lists and advance planning with the internal communications team.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CEBS or CBP certifications are a plus.


Experience: 5+ years of experience in benefits administration with demonstrated experience managing multiple benefits plans and programs.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated track record in vendor management, evaluating existing benefit vendors, and assisting with RFPs and implementations.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing multiple projects, cross-functional HR technology, and deadlines.
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local laws and regulations governing employee benefits (ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, ACA, HIPAA, etc.).
  • Adept in benefits administration systems and HRIS, especially Workday.
  • Experience supporting varied populations, including hourly, part-time, salaried, union, and retirees.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with a data-driven approach to interpreting data, decision-making, and plan performance evaluation.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across departments and companies.

% Travel Required (Approximate): ~5%

In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing hr@people.inc.

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

Salary: New York: $120,000.00 - $130,000.00

job.description:
The Courier Journal/courier-journal.com, the leading news and information provider in Kentucky and part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seeks an experienced digital producer who will be part of a team that helps manage the newspaper's digital content across a number of platforms to ensure our content is compelling and engaging for our audience. This person will be part of the team that plays a critical role in our goals to be urgent each day with news and information that is relevant and timely for our audience.

The successful candidate will have experience with audience metrics and the ability to write clear, accurate copy and social posts using AP style. Candidates must be detail-oriented and work well under pressure to meet demanding deadlines, as well as demonstrate an understanding of audience metrics and SEO with the goal of growing the audience.

The candidate must demonstrate strong news judgment to manage the website’s fronts, send alerts, write daily newsletters and serve as quality control on its content. The ideal candidate will be a strong collaborator who can work closely with reporters, content coaches and newsroom leadership.

The Courier Journal was awarded a 2020 Pulitzer Prize for its breaking news coverage. It’s a high-performing newsroom focused on meeting the demands of an engaged readership. Louisville has some of the highest-profile coverage opportunities in the country: national championship-caliber college basketball teams; SEC and ACC football; and the world-famous Kentucky Derby. Our coverage is built on digital storytelling and mobile consumption, which includes real-time reporting, smart analysis, video, deep storytelling and social engagement.

Responsibilities:

Edit, produce and publish content, optimizing for SEO and digital best practices.

Edit sensitive content for clarity, fairness, legal issues, spelling, grammar, punctuation and style.

Work with reporters and editors on projects to produce in-depth story packages.

Create engaging social media posts on all relevant platforms, editing video or creating graphics as needed.

Use metrics to determine traffic patterns and make changes tied to the data. Familiarity with Parse.ly and Google Analytics products is a plus.

Manage courier-journal.com home pages, programming desktop and mobile, and send alerts to engage a loyal audience.

Manage workflow to meet deadlines.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

1-3 years of experience working for a daily news organization.

Excellent news judgment.

Top-notch writing, editing and headline-writing skills.

Excellent communication skills.

Proven experience with advanced storytelling techniques on multiple platforms.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Able to multitask and excel under intense deadline pressure in a rapidly changing industry.

Ability to act calmly and decisively in complex breaking news situations.

Able to work early mornings, nights or weekends.

Application Instructions:

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager, Remote

Amplified Digital, a division of Lee Enterprises, is seeking a highly skilled and analytical Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager to manage, optimize, and scale digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, with a primary focus on Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic demand-side platforms (DSPs).

This position will be responsible for the hands-on execution of paid media campaigns, advanced conversion tracking and attribution, and in-depth performance analysis to drive measurable business outcomes for our clients. The ideal candidate combines strong technical platform expertise with a strategic mindset, leveraging data to uncover optimization opportunities, improve campaign performance, and support client retention and upsell opportunities.

This role will work closely with our Client Experience, Sales, Analytics, and Product teams to translate campaign data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

Position Responsibilities

Campaign Management & Optimization: Build, launch, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube), Meta (Facebook and Instagram), and programmatic DSPs.

Performance Analysis: Conduct detailed campaign performance evaluations, identifying trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates, and overall advertising effectiveness.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement, troubleshoot, and maintain conversion tracking and attribution solutions utilizing Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI).

Advanced Analytics: Perform deep-dive analysis across advertising platforms, website analytics, and customer conversion data to assess the complete customer journey, identify attribution gaps, and recommend data-driven improvements.

Strategic Growth Opportunities: Proactively identify campaign expansion, budget reallocation, cross-channel advertising, and upsell opportunities based on performance data, audience insights, and client business objectives.

Cross-Channel Strategy: Evaluate performance across Google, Meta, and programmatic channels to develop cohesive strategies that maximize advertising effectiveness throughout the customer journey.

Reporting & Insights: Develop actionable performance insights and recommendations utilizing GA4 and other reporting platforms. Translate complex datasets into clear findings for internal teams and client-facing discussions.

Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve tracking discrepancies, conversion reporting issues, campaign delivery challenges, and platform integration problems.

Campaign Quality & Compliance: Ensure campaigns adhere to platform advertising policies, internal best practices, budget pacing requirements, and established quality assurance standards.

Automation & Efficiency: Leverage platform automation, AI-powered bidding strategies, and campaign management technologies to improve operational efficiency and campaign performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Client Experience, Sales, Product, and technical teams to develop advertising strategies, resolve performance concerns, and deliver recommendations that support client growth.

Platform Expertise: Stay current on changes to advertising platforms, measurement capabilities, privacy regulations, AI-driven optimization, and emerging digital advertising opportunities.

Advanced proficiency in Google Ads, including campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, keyword management, and conversion-based optimization.

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and programmatic advertising platforms, including The Trade Desk, DV360, or comparable DSPs.

Demonstrated expertise in GA4 and Google Tag Manager, including event configuration, conversion tracking, attribution analysis, and technical troubleshooting.

Understanding of server-side tracking, enhanced conversions, Meta Conversions API, offline conversion imports, and CRM-based attribution.

Ability to interpret complex performance datasets and identify meaningful insights beyond standard platform reporting.

Strong understanding of marketing attribution models, conversion paths, customer acquisition costs, and the limitations of platform-reported performance.

Experience analyzing campaign performance to identify opportunities for budget expansion, incremental investment, and additional advertising products.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate performance discrepancies and recommend solutions.

Ability to communicate technical findings and strategic recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and performance deadlines.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment with an emphasis on accountability, continuous optimization, and measurable client outcomes.

Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying performance improvements and growth opportunities.

Certifications:

Google Ads Search Certification required.

Google Analytics Certification required or willingness to obtain within 90 days.

Google Ads Display, Video, and Measurement certifications preferred.

Meta Blueprint and The Trade Desk Edge Academy certifications preferred.

Work Environment: Remote position with collaboration across distributed teams. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings or company events.

Education & Experience

3–5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns, preferably within a digital advertising agency.

Demonstrated experience managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple clients, industries, and budget levels.

Minimum 2 years of experience working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and digital advertising conversion tracking.

Experience managing Meta advertising campaigns and working within at least one programmatic DSP.

Proven ability to analyze advertising performance, troubleshoot attribution discrepancies, and implement optimization strategies that produce measurable results.

Experience identifying strategic growth opportunities through campaign analysis and performance insights.

Familiarity with CRM integrations, offline conversion tracking, and first-party data measurement strategies preferred.

Experience with marketing automation, campaign management platforms, and reporting tools is a plus.

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Google Tag Manager (GTM)

Meta Ads Manager and Events Manager

The Trade Desk, DV360, Madhive, or similar DSPs

Looker Studio, Power BI, or comparable BI platforms

HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable CRM platforms

Campaign automation and management platforms

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position offers opportunities to earn performance-based bonuses tied to individual contributions and measurable business outcomes. Bonus considerations may include:

Achievement of campaign performance and optimization goals.

Client retention and overall account performance.

Identification of strategic upsell and revenue growth opportunities.

Operational efficiencies and improvements in campaign execution.

NEWSROOM INTERNSHIP IN WINSTON-SALEM, N.C.

The Winston Salem Journal, a Lee Enterprises company, located in Winston Salem, NC., is now hiring a creative, motivated student journalist or recent graduate for a 10-week paid internship this summer.

We want our interns to walk away with a rewarding, real-world newsroom experience, a pile of great clips and the skills they need to develop into the next generation of journalists.

Qualified candidates should be inquisitive self-starters capable of producing compelling content for our digital and print platforms. This editor brings enthusiasm and fresh ideas to the coverage of cultural insights and deep respect for the curious audience. They will work to identify and explain the values, beliefs, and social dynamics that shape our culture and guide the reporting team to explain and contextualize emerging trends with verve, speed and accuracy. This mandate includes providing insights into current artistic movements and trends, as well as deep dives to explain meaningful cultural change. This editor’s leadership will help the team break news and ideas. Because of the breadth of this beat, this editor will be a key decision-maker on the shape and design of day-to-day news coverage for the entire team.

Generate story ideas and review story pitches with reporters on the Society & Culture desk, which includes coverage of movies, books, sports, religion and education, among other things.

job.title: Head of Shows, New York Magazine
job.description:
THE ROLE

New York Magazine is seeking a Head of Shows to lead our multiplatform show strategy across audio and video programming. This person will identify the most promising opportunities across our editorial brands, develop original franchises, and build a sustainable slate of shows that extend the reach and impact of New York Magazine across audio, video, social, and live platforms.

The ideal candidate is both a creative leader and a skilled production operator: someone who has successfully developed and launched multiple shows out of newsrooms, understands the audio and video landscape, and can recognize distinctive editorial voices and talent that translate into compelling programming.

In this role, you will work across New York Magazine’s portfolio, including The Cut, Vulture, and its four additional verticals, to identify talent, concepts, and audience opportunities that can become signature New York franchises.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop and execute a long-term video and audio strategy for New York Magazine, identifying the largest audience, editorial, and business opportunities across the magazine’s brands, coverage areas, and talent roster.
  • Conceive, develop, and launch new show concepts from idea through pilot, testing, and release, including the creation of multiple pilots and proof-of-concept projects in the first year.
  • Oversee all aspects of show development, including editorial direction, host development, visual approach, production workflows, and programming.
  • Build a long-term roadmap and development pipeline for a portfolio of multiplatform shows that support audience growth, engagement, and revenue objectives.
  • Partner with audience, video, and social teams to develop programming and distribution strategies for YouTube, podcast platforms, and social channels, including episode packaging, clips, and original social content.
  • Use audience insights and performance data to refine formats, grow existing shows, and inform development and investment decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate the potential to acquire or partner with existing external shows, creators, and talent when there is an opportunity to strengthen coverage areas aligned with the magazine’s audio and video strategy.
  • Build and manage a team, recruiting producers, external creative partners, and talent as needed, and oversee production budgets and schedules.
  • Work with the editorial team to integrate show appearances and video opportunities into major editorial bookings.
  • Partner with editors and production teams to develop author-read audio versions of major stories at a regular cadence.
  • Lead broader cross-functional stakeholder management and execution, e.g., collaborating with the audience team to develop multiplatform growth strategies and partnering with ad sales and subscription teams to build out franchise business opportunities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 10+ years of experience developing, launching, and growing original video programs, podcasts, or multiplatform franchises.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking shows from concept to launch and audience growth, with experience across both video and audio.
  • Strong editorial instincts and experience translating culture, politics, business, lifestyle, or entertainment coverage into compelling audio and video formats.
  • Experience identifying, developing, and coaching on-air and on-camera talent.
  • Experience cultivating, managing, and collaborating with top-tier talent, creators, and celebrities.
  • Strong understanding of original video programming, video podcasting, creator-led media, and cross-platform content strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of audience behavior and distribution across YouTube, podcast platforms, and social channels.
  • Understanding of how shows can extend into newsletters, community, and live experiences.
  • Experience building teams, managing production budgets, and establishing development and production workflows.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills, including experience working closely with audience and revenue teams.
  • Ability to operate strategically while also executing hands-on development work.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort building programs from the ground up

job.title: Manager Treasury Operations
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

Treasury operations protect The Washington Post’s liquidity, enable timely payments and collections, and provide leaders with a clear view of near-term cash needs. The Manager, Treasury Operations leads the day-to-day team and operating routines that make this possible. This role improves the performance of GSD, establishes a practical treasury measurement cadence, and represents treasury needs in the NetSuite implementation. It also helps establish a reliable 13-week cash flow forecast so Finance can manage near-term cash needs with greater visibility and confidence.


What Motivates You

  • You are energized by making treasury operations reliable, measurable, and easier for colleagues and business partners to navigate.
  • You enjoy leading a small team and working with service partners through clear expectations, sound judgment, and continuous improvement.
  • You are fluent in the connection between cash collections, payments, working capital, operational discipline, and business performance.
  • You like translating finance needs into practical system design and can work productively with implementation partners and technology teams.
  • You bring rigor to forecasting, data quality, and controls while staying adaptable as business conditions and priorities change.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead the treasury operations team by managing, coaching, and developing Sandra and Joann; setting clear priorities and accountability; and building a collaborative, control-conscious team that delivers dependable daily execution.
  • Oversee GSD service delivery by maintaining service expectations, operating routines, escalation paths, and performance reviews that help ensure timely, accurate, and efficient treasury support.
  • Maintain a treasury KPI dashboard by capturing pre-GSD performance baselines, tracking agreed measures, and reporting trends that make service quality, control performance, and operating improvements visible to Finance leaders.
  • Recommend operational performance targets by using relevant industry standards and internal baselines for measures such as cash collections cycle time, unapplied cash, payment timeliness, forecast accuracy, exception volume, and reconciliation quality, then coordinating improvement activity toward approved goals.
  • Represent treasury in NetSuite process design by partnering with Cameron, Plative, and internal Finance and Technology stakeholders to document current-state needs, test proposed workflows, and validate treasury requirements, controls, reporting, and user needs.
  • Coordinate ERP implementation readiness by supporting treasury testing, data validation, cutover preparation, documentation, and training so the team can adopt the new system effectively.

job.title: Jr. Manager, International Marketing
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Jr. Manager, International Marketing 

 

A little bit about our team:

International Marketing is responsible for developing the careers of all artists signed to Warner Records US, outside of America. You will work with all domestic departments and deliver an artists vision and opportunity to the rest of the world. You will travel with artists on promotional trips around the world. You will liaise with Warner teams in all countries to deliver success and opportunities to your roster.


Your role:

If you want an incredible education in how the global music business works. If you love to travel. If you love how music dovetails into different cultures all over the world. IF you want to help develop your artists careers outside of the USA.


This position will be responsible for spearheading strategic international marketing and commerce campaigns for audio and video releases, for a defined roster of artists, across all 50+ Warner Music Group affiliates and licensees.  Will also act as liaison between artists, managers, and Warner Records International affiliates.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Have your own roster of artists that you will be responsible for.
  • With department head be jointly responsible for building a strategy and plans to develop their careers outside the USA.
  • Get to know a LOT about streaming, radio, fan engagement, digital marketing, publicity and more. How all these things work in all music markets around the world and how we can use them all to effectively build an artist’s career – locally and globally.
  • Travel and build relationships with your artists on promo trips to Europe, Asia, Australia, Latin America, Canada.
  • Be part of a close-knit team that will support your growth and help you succeed.
  • Build a global network of friends and colleagues

Marketing:

  • Work with affiliates to develop the strongest and most active campaigns bespoke for each territory and each artist.
  • Supply affiliates with all marketing tools for the U.S. originated releases, including but not limited to: press releases, press photos, bios, label copy, sales sheets, album covers, music videos, advertising assets, as well as customizing these as needed, and custom assets from scratch.
  • Work with artist management and affiliates to instigate, coordinate and approve all international press and promotion
  • Communicate priorities and general releases to the world through e-mail updates, contributions to the international newsletter, direct and conference calls and release schedules for both audio and video products.

Artist Development / Promotion:

  • Initiate, develop and implement global promotion for Warner Records artists
  • Plan and budget international promotion trips for artists includes scheduling in-person and phone interviews, organizing and hosting press junkets
  • Manage artists’ international schedules as it relates to promotions, book artist travel, accompany artists on international promotion trips
  • Interact with domestic marketing, sales, promotion, new media, radio, creative, brand, sync, and A&R departments
  • Attend planning meetings and label events
  • Look to be aware of opportunities for Warner Records artists in international territories, and to have our artists at the forefront of new campaign opportunities around the world.

Commercial Revenue:

  • Request projections from the key international territories for fleshing out large advance-driven projects
  • Possess knowledge of Global Marketplace / global, local and regional streaming/commercial partners.
  • Communication:
  • Act as the gatekeeper for all communication regarding release from your roster for all territories
  • Originate calls with key territories to discuss present and future releases, marketing materials and opportunities.
  • Responsible to communicate international needs and successes with domestic staff

Finance:

  • Responsible to supply international consumption reports to executive staff and artist management
  • Drive international consumption to achieve projected international budget numbers
  • Raise PO’s and process invoices associated with international marketing costs

About you:

  • You have the ability to build a strategic view for your artists, matched with an ability to get in the weeds and execute plans.
  • You have the ability to balance nuanced conversations between the domestic team, artists & managers and affiliates.
  • You have the ability to both care about what you do, and also not take things personally. 

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience managing your own roster of artists.
  • A background in international music marketing.
  • Passion for music and understanding of business.
  • A passport!
  • 2-3+ years of professional experience in music marketing. Preferable international music marketing.
  • In-depth knowledge of all social media platforms and analytics & streaming services.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with added attention to details and deadlines
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to effectively work in a fast-paced environment with both creative and business-oriented colleagues and partners
  • Background in working across multiple genres.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

job.description:
We are seeking a graphic production artist with strong artistic and communication skills to join the AccuWeather Graphics Team at our Global Headquarters in State College, Pennsylvania, beginning January 2027. In this operational role, you’ll support graphics creation for internal stakeholders and external clientele across several medias, including print, television and digital. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, creative, and passionate about creating clear and accurate weather graphics that help people and businesses make the best weather-informed decisions.

 

Key Responsibilities

· Create weather maps, charts and graphs utilizing several different graphic programs and operating systems, including Baron and Photoshop

· Follow set graphical standards across print, television and digital.

· Assemble complete weather pages and graphic products by client and internal deadlines, utilizing automated and manual assembly procedures.

· Communicate effectively with Clients and other departments regarding any service or schedule changes or client requests.

· Ensure that all responsibilities are carried out with a proper sense of urgency, priority, and accuracy with a focus on the best service to the Client.

· Collaborate with fellow artists and operational team members (meteorologists, editors, broadcasters, etc) to produce clear and descriptive weather graphics.

· Contribute to special projects such as quality assurance, process improvement, customer support, or research and development.

· Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

 

Required Qualifications

· Associates Degree or higher in graphic design or similar field.

· At least 1 year of graphic creation experience.

· Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator software.

· Excellent written and oral communication skills.

· Demonstrated ability to effectively work and collaborate with a team.

· Strong eye for visual design, with the ability to create graphics that are clear, balanced, and visually appealing.

· Ability to follow instructions and standards to deliver on-brand graphical displays.

· Creative curiosity and a desire to develop new graphic concepts that support the established brand identity.

· Flexible availability to support 24-7 operation, including working weekends and holidays.

 

Preferred Qualifications

· Knowledge or hands-on experience with weather design software such as Baron or WSI is strongly preferred, (or similar software from News, Media, Sports industry).

· Interest in or familiarity with meteorology, weather forecasting, climate, environmental science or science communication.

· Experience collaborating directly with technical or scientific subject-matter experts.

· Knowledge of InDesign and Filemaker Pro software.

· Familiarity with using AI, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to create graphics, mock-ups or workflows.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. job.title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist, Content Understanding
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

At SiriusXM and Pandora, understanding content is critical to delivering high-quality search, recommendation, discovery, and personalization experiences. As a Senior Machine Learning Scientist, Content Understanding, you will develop advanced machine learning solutions that help extract meaning, context, and structure from audio, text, and multimodal content. Your work will directly support content enrichment, metadata generation, semantic understanding, and emerging AI-powered experiences that improve how listeners discover and engage with content.

Working independently on complex technical challenges, you will partner with cross-functional teams to develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning solutions that deliver measurable impact for users and the business.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop, deploy, and improve machine learning models that support content understanding across audio, text, and multimodal content sources.

  • Apply modern machine learning techniques, including deep learning, transformer architectures, large language models, and multimodal learning approaches to solve content understanding challenges.

  • Own complex machine learning projects from problem definition through model development, deployment, evaluation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate offline metrics, experimentation frameworks, and business outcomes to drive continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Data teams to identify opportunities and deliver impactful machine learning solutions.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of data pipelines, feature engineering processes, experimentation workflows, and model evaluation methodologies.

  • Stay current with emerging advancements in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and content understanding technologies, identifying opportunities to apply new approaches where appropriate.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior scientists and contribute to a culture of collaboration, learning, and technical excellence.

  • Contribute to technical discussions, architecture reviews, and solution design efforts within the team.

  • Support production machine learning systems through monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and continuous improvement activities.

  • This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

What You'll Need:

  • Education: M.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field required; Ph.D. preferred.

  • Experience: 3+ years of production experience developing and deploying machine learning models at scale, including experience working on complex machine learning initiatives and delivering measurable business impact.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong experience with machine learning approaches used in content understanding, including deep learning, transformer architectures, large language models, natural language processing, and multimodal learning techniques.

  • Production ML: Experience developing, deploying, monitoring, and optimizing machine learning systems in production environments.

  • Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems, analyze large datasets, and develop scalable machine learning solutions.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively across product, engineering, analytics, and data science teams to deliver impactful results.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated, curious, and driven to solve challenging problems while continuously developing technical expertise and business understanding.

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You'll Make an Impact

At SiriusXM and Pandora, search plays a critical role in how listeners discover and access the content they love. As a Senior Staff Machine Learning Scientist, Search, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for advancing the long-term direction of search and discovery capabilities across our audio ecosystem. You will drive the development of next-generation retrieval, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and AI-powered search experiences that improve how millions of listeners discover music, podcasts, channels, live programming, and emerging content experiences.

Operating with significant autonomy, you will lead highly complex initiatives, influence technical strategy across multiple teams, and help shape the evolution of search systems through deep expertise in machine learning, information retrieval, and generative AI. Your work will have broad impact across products and business objectives, requiring the ability to solve ambiguous problems, drive alignment among stakeholders, and translate emerging technologies into scalable production solutions.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the design, development, and evolution of advanced machine learning systems supporting search relevance, retrieval, ranking, query understanding, and personalization across diverse audio content types.

  • Define technical approaches and drive execution for highly complex search and discovery initiatives that span multiple products, systems, and stakeholder groups.

  • Develop and improve transformer-based, deep learning, semantic retrieval, and generative AI solutions that enhance content discovery and user engagement.

  • Establish and refine methodologies for search evaluation, experimentation, offline relevance measurement, and online testing to ensure continuous improvement of user experiences.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Content teams to influence roadmap decisions and align technical investments with business priorities.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in search and machine learning, providing technical leadership and consultation on complex challenges across multiple teams.

  • Drive adoption of emerging technologies and industry best practices related to information retrieval, large language models, semantic search, recommendation systems, and machine learning infrastructure.

  • Lead the investigation and resolution of highly ambiguous technical problems that require innovative approaches, sound judgment, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Establish best practices, standards, and scalable approaches for machine learning development, deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and model lifecycle management.

  • Influence technical direction through architectural guidance, technical reviews, and mentorship of scientists and engineers.

  • Contribute to the growth and development of the organization by mentoring team members, sharing expertise, and fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

  • Continuously evaluate business impact through metrics, experimentation, and operational performance to ensure solutions drive measurable outcomes.

  • This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

What You'll Need:

  • Education: M.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field required; Ph.D. preferred.

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning systems in production environments, including significant experience solving complex search, ranking, retrieval, or recommendation problems at scale.

  • Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in information retrieval, search relevance, ranking systems, semantic search, query understanding, transformer architectures, and modern machine learning methodologies.

  • Production ML: Extensive experience designing, deploying, monitoring, and optimizing production machine learning systems, including experimentation frameworks, model lifecycle management, feature stores, and large-scale distributed systems.

  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence decisions across teams, and drive outcomes without direct authority.

  • Problem Solving: Proven success solving ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges and translating emerging technologies into scalable business solutions.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration: Strong track record of working cross-functionally to align priorities, drive execution, and deliver measurable business results.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated, strategic, and passionate about solving challenging problems while continuously advancing technical excellence.

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the role

The HR Operations Specialist supports employees across the company by coordinating HR transactions, resolving production issues, and responding to questions. This role partners with employees, department managers, HR Partners, Payroll, and other teams to keep HR processes running smoothly and employee data accurate. You will report to the HRIS Operations Supervisor.

This is a hybrid role based in our Norfolk, Virginia office. You can typically expect to work in the office three days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Be the primary contact for employee HR inquiries, partnering with the appropriate teams to provide clear, guidance.
  • Work with department managers and HR Partners to gather information, process employee transactions, and maintain accurate employee data in Workday.
  • Process complex administrative transactions and participate in Workday HR system workflows.
  • Troubleshoot Workday production issues across HCM modules, including HCM Core, Recruiting, Time and Attendance, and Compensation; resolve related support tickets involving HR processes and employee data.
  • Support biweekly payroll processing by reviewing and validating payroll transactions and inputs, processing vacation payouts, and managing paid time off (PTO) adjustments in Workday following established procedures.
  • Work with Payroll and other teams, handling confidential information.
  • Help with user acceptance testing, configuration and reporting requests, and testing for biannual Workday releases.
  • Build and upload Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) files for employee and company changes.
  • Help employees use HR-related technology by answering questions and contributing to user enablement and training.
  • Develop training materials using Google Sites.
  • Manage end-user channels and the team email group, responding to inquiries from employees, HR Partners, and managers.
  • Audit HR processes and employee transactions to support data quality and integrity; follow security and data-handling protocols.
  • Process employment verification requests.
  • Manage a varied daily workload, reprioritizing to complete incoming transactions and department requests.
  • Take on other tasks as assigned.

Basic qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience working with Workday HCM processing HR transactions.
  • Solid awareness of how human resources transactions influence payroll processing, financial reporting, and broader operational tasks.
  • At least one year of experience using Microsoft Excel, including formulas and pivot tables.
  • You know how to provide clear, professional guidance.
  • Care for the impact your work can have across related processes.
  • You are resolution-oriented.
  • You have strong attention to detail.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday Payroll processing.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Familiarity with additional Workday modules and teams, such as Benefits, Payroll, Finance, Security and Integrations.

Essential Responsibilities You’ll Own

  • Preparation of monthly royalty payment reports and support documentation
  • Reviewing contracts to determine royalty payment requirements
  • Assists in the review of new contracts received from Licensors

What will set you up for success

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $65,000 – $75,000

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world's leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
