job.title: Principal Software Engineer / Architect – AI – Legal FDE
job.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is looking for a recognized technical authority to set the direction for how the world's top law firms and corporate legal departments adopt AI. CoCounsel is trusted by over 20,000 law firms and corporate legal departments, including the majority of top US courts and Am Law 100 firms, and is used by one million professionals across 107 countries.

As the senior-most individual contributor on the Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, you will define and drive the technology strategy and roadmap for designing, building, and operating bespoke AI solutions. You will own the team's most complex, highest-risk, and most strategically important engagements, working alongside Staff Software Engineers and Architects, Senior Legal AI Engineers, and AI Solution Engineers. You will partner with Product, Engineering, and business leadership to align FDE work with CoCounsel's long-term objectives.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with broad influence. You will make high-stakes architectural decisions with autonomy, raise the engineering bar across the team and beyond, and help make the team AI-native in everything it does.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Vision and Strategy

  • Define and drive the long-term technical vision and strategy for FDE, including vision documents, technology requirements, and roadmaps tied to product and business objectives.
  • Lead the selection, evaluation, and adoption of technologies, frameworks, and patterns, and build consensus across teams.
  • Identify where emerging capabilities such as agentic systems, MCP and A2A interoperability, and new model and orchestration patterns could cause a transformational shift, and communicate the opportunities and trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Contribute to cross-functional and cross-business-unit engineering strategy, standards, and, where appropriate, patents.

Architecture and Delivery of Complex AI Systems

  • Lead complex, high-risk, high-visibility AI initiatives from concept through production, staying hands-on in design, prototyping, and code for the hardest problems.
  • Architect scalable, secure AI systems that integrate with client environments, including document management systems, enterprise platforms, and legal technology ecosystems.
  • Design RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, event-driven backends, and agentic workflows using CoCounsel, Westlaw, and Practical Law capabilities, plus third-party AI APIs.
  • Build reusable AI components, frameworks, and solution templates that scale delivery across the team.
  • Set standards for MLOps/LLMOps, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD so delivery is secure, repeatable, and fast.
  • Identify weaknesses in existing designs and drive remedies.

Quality, Observability, and Trust

  • Set the strategy for AI monitoring and observability, covering performance, output quality, latency, cost, and production reliability risk.
  • Own LLM evaluation, including accuracy, hallucination risk, citation quality, A/B testing, and red-teaming, and define quality benchmarks grounded in real legal workflows.
  • Ensure every solution meets ethical AI, data protection, and enterprise security requirements.
  • Drive operational excellence across the software development lifecycle, including post-launch measurement.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as the senior technical voice in discovery on high-value engagements, scoping use cases, shaping architectures, and building credibility with legal and technical executives.
  • Present complex technical concepts and strategy to audiences from engineers to business unit executives, and negotiate solutions between key stakeholders.
  • Work with legal SMEs to translate professional reasoning and domain heuristics into pipeline design, evaluation criteria, and benchmarks.
  • Anticipate customer and market needs and feed field insights back into the product roadmap.

Leadership, Mentorship, and Culture

  • Mentor and coach Staff, Senior, and Lead engineers, and indirectly lead a small team of engineers and technical experts on ambiguous problems.
  • Review architecture and design at team and sub-unit levels and give authoritative feedback.
  • Strengthen engineering culture through knowledge sharing and by championing AI-native tools and practices.
  • Work with program and project managers to bring the technical dimension into status and risk reporting, and consult on budgets for large programs where applicable.
  • Represent Thomson Reuters externally through speaking, publications, community engagement, or open-source and standards participation.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, and architecture, and a track record of leading highly complex, high-risk projects.
  • Extensive experience owning technical requirements and strategy, setting technology roadmaps, and prioritizing between competing features and investments.
  • Expert-level, hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML and LLM-powered applications in production.
  • Deep proficiency with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or AutoGen, and expert understanding of RAG architectures and vector databases.
  • Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) patterns for interoperable, tool-augmented AI systems.
  • Expert Python (FastAPI or equivalent), with strong experience in RESTful, async, and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent).
  • Production observability experience (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar) and experience with AI evaluation platforms (LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, or W&B).
  • Strong background in secure API development using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and a track record of driving AI-native engineering practices.
  • Proven ability to influence across teams and domains, advise senior leadership, and communicate complex ideas at multiple levels of an organization.
  • Autonomy, sound judgment, comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced agile environment, and strong attention to detail.
  • Recognized as a technical role model and leader in your field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a regulated industry (legal, fintech, or healthcare), with familiarity with compliance and data privacy requirements.
  • Experience building agentic AI systems with autonomous decision-making.
  • Familiarity with legal platforms, document management systems, and legal technology ecosystems.
  • Container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes) and MLOps/LLMOps lifecycle management.
  • Understanding of transformer model scaling, limitations, and fine-tuning.
  • External presence through conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or standards participation.
  • Experience developing vision documents and leading cross-business-unit technology strategy.

#LI-GK1


 

 

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

job.title: Copywriter
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

We are looking for a dedicated and versatile Copywriter to join the Financial Times' Brand and Partnerships team, creating compelling, creative and persuasive marketing copy that brings the FT brand to life across a wide range of channels and audiences.

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Copywriter, you will work closely with colleagues across global communications, commercial marketing, design, creative and editorial teams to deliver impactful campaigns and messaging that strengthen the FT's reputation and encourage audiences to engage with our journalism.

From conceptual advertising campaigns, podcast and video scripts to digital ads, direct response emails, event marketing, speeches, white papers and social media, you'll have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of creative projects. You'll also help promote the FT's brand platform to both internal and external audiences, ensuring our distinctive tone of voice is reflected consistently in everything we do.

This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, collaborative and ambitious team at the heart of a global news organisation. We're looking for someone who combines exceptional writing skills with critical thinking, creative flair and a genuine passion for news, brands and digital media.

Key responsibilities

  • Create high-quality, engaging and persuasive copy for a wide range of marketing campaigns, channels and audiences, including both B2B and B2C communications.

  • Work collaboratively with the Senior Marketing Copywriter, brand and creative teams, external agencies and internal collaborators to develop compelling creative concepts and messaging.

  • Champion and protect the FT's brand identity and tone of voice, ensuring consistent and impactful communications that strengthen our reputation as a trusted source of global journalism.

  • Write and adapt copy across multiple formats, including conceptual advertising, digital campaigns, emails, social media, podcast and video scripts, speeches, events and longer-form content.

  • Manage copywriting briefs from across the business, identifying the right approach for each audience and channel while balancing multiple projects and deadlines.

  • Review, edit and refine AI-generated copy, applying creative judgement to ensure accuracy, quality, originality and alignment with the FT's brand standards.

  • Ensure messaging is consistent, complementary and aligned with FT brand guidelines across all marketing activities.

  • Support the wider brand, marketing and business teams in developing communications that build awareness, encourage engagement and attract new subscribers.

Required skills and experience

  • A qualification in English, marketing, advertising, journalism or a related field.

  • At least two years' professional copywriting experience in advertising, marketing, media or a related field.

  • Exceptional writing skills, with demonstrable experience creating engaging and effective copy across a variety of channels, including print, digital, audio and speeches.

  • Experience writing for both consumer and business audiences, with the ability to adapt tone, style and messaging to suit different needs.

  • Strong creative and conceptual thinking, with the ability to interpret and challenge briefs and translate ideas into compelling copy.

  • Experience collaborating with designers, planners, product and technology teams to deliver effective creative communications.

  • Proficiency in using AI tools, alongside strong editorial judgement and the ability to review, edit and rewrite AI-generated content.

  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to handle priorities and work in a timely manner.

  • Experience working with senior collaborators and building effective relationships across teams.

  • A strong interest in journalism, current affairs, communications and digital media.

  • A proactive, adaptable and collaborative approach, with the confidence to work across different teams and levels of seniority.

  • Sound strategic judgement, creative curiosity and a commitment to producing consistently high-quality work, whether for a digital banner or a major brand campaign.

Desirable

  • Experience developing creative concepts for integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns.

  • Experience creating copy for brand platforms and maintaining a consistent tone of voice across different audiences and formats.

  • A passion for brand storytelling and an understanding of how creative communications can build reputation, engagement and loyalty.

What's in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may use AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

The Role

The FT Group is entering a new chapter of growth and transformation. With record revenue and subscriptions, the business is evolving from a digital-first media organisation to one positioned for the AI era.

Our global Communications team plays a central role in this transition, protecting and strengthening the FT’s reputation, amplifying its world-class journalism and supporting the growth ambitions of its businesses. Working across the newsroom and business, the team develops integrated communications strategies that build trust, extend our reach and influence, engage employees and support the FT’s long-term success.

We’re looking for a Head of Communications, Editorial to lead our global editorial communications strategy, raise the profile of our journalism and editorial talent, and strengthen the FT’s reputation around the world.

This is an opportunity for an experienced communications leader with a passion for journalism to help shape how one of the world’s most respected news organisations tells its story. You’ll lead proactive communications around our journalism, advise senior editorial leaders on complex reputational issues and identify opportunities to extend the reach and influence of our editorial brands and talent.

The role

We're looking for a Marketing Automation Journey Lead to join our Reader Revenue Group and play a key role in shaping how we engage with customers across their lifecycle.

As our Consumer and B2B subscription businesses evolve towards a more sophisticated, customer-led approach to growth, engagement and retention, Marketing Automation plays a critical role in delivering relevant, connected and effective customer experiences.

Our Marketing Automation teams operate as a Centre of Excellence, bringing together journey expertise, platform capabilities, experimentation, personalisation and measurement to drive customer and commercial value.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing Automation (Consumer or B2B), you'll be responsible for ensuring we're automating and improving the right customer experiences.

Sitting between lifecycle strategy and execution, this is a journey architecture, orchestration and optimisation role. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing and other collaborators to understand customer needs and commercial objectives, translating these into effective automated experiences.

You'll take a comprehensive view of the automated journey portfolio, finding opportunities to improve how journeys, campaigns, triggers and customer or account states work together. You'll assess existing activity, identify gaps or overlaps, and recommend whether journeys should be optimised, extended, redesigned, consolidated or retired.

Rather than focusing primarily on building individual campaigns, you'll lead the thinking behind journey design and optimisation, developing actionable recommendations and coordinating delivery through Marketing Automation Specialists and Executives.

You'll also work closely with your counterpart in the Consumer or B2B Marketing Automation team, sharing expertise and helping establish consistent standards, experimentation approaches and guidelines across the Centre of Excellence.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the FT's customer experience, ensuring automated journeys are connected, measurable and continuously improving.

Key responsibilities

Journey architecture and orchestration

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing and other collaborators to understand business objectives, customer needs, target audiences and lifecycle challenges.

  • Translate strategic briefs into effective automation opportunities, challenging proposed solutions where necessary to address the underlying customer or commercial problem.

  • Maintain a comprehensive view of the automated journey portfolio, ensuring journeys, campaigns, triggers and customer or account states work together coherently.

  • Map and visualise customer journeys, identifying gaps, overlaps, friction and opportunities to improve reach, relevance and effectiveness.

  • Determine whether objectives are best achieved by optimising existing journeys, introducing new pathways, adjusting triggers, content or sequencing, or retiring existing activity.

  • Design automated experiences using appropriate audiences, channels, behavioural signals, personalisation, decisioning and timing.

  • Define journey sequencing, eligibility, hierarchy and suppression rules to handle interactions between customer experiences.

  • Work with Data, Technology, Creative and Marketing Automation colleagues to translate journey designs into delivered experiences.

Portfolio optimisation and prioritisation

  • Own and maintain the journey opportunity and optimisation roadmap, prioritising activity according to customer and commercial impact, reach, effort and strategic importance.

  • Regularly audit automated journeys to find opportunities for improvement, redesign, consolidation or retirement.

  • Investigate underlying audience, data, design and execution issues to understand journey performance.

  • Find opportunities to improve customer experiences through behavioural triggers, segmentation, personalisation and multichannel orchestration.

  • Ensure journeys are continuously reviewed and optimised rather than treated as one-off launches.

  • Work with the Head of Marketing Automation to align optimisation priorities with the wider strategy and available capacity.

Measurement, testing and learning

  • Establish clear objectives, KPIs and measurement approaches for significant journey interventions.

  • Incorporate testing and experimentation into journey design, including hypotheses, control groups and learning objectives where appropriate.

  • Use customer, account, behavioural and commercial data to assess journey effectiveness and find opportunities.

  • Evaluate broader journey outcomes alongside individual campaign performance, focusing on measurable customer and commercial impact.

  • Translate analysis and experimentation into actionable recommendations and future improvements.

  • Contribute to shared learning, measurement frameworks and procedures across the Centre of Excellence.

Delivery leadership and collaboration

  • Translate journey recommendations into clear, actionable briefs for Marketing Automation Specialists and Executives.

  • Work with delivery teams to define audience requirements, triggers, branching logic, personalisation, sequencing, testing and data dependencies.

  • Provide architectural direction, reviewing implementation proposals and identifying risks or opportunities for improvement.

  • Coach and support colleagues in journey design, optimisation and effective use of automation capabilities.

  • Collaborate with Consumer and B2B counterparts to share expertise, find opportunities and develop consistent approaches.

  • Contribute to Centre of Excellence playbooks and standards for journey design, testing, personalisation and orchestration.

Platform and capability development

  • Apply a strong understanding of marketing automation and customer data platforms to design effective journeys.

  • Find opportunities to make better use of existing automation capabilities and work with technical colleagues where further development may be required.

  • Combine customer and account data, behavioural signals, segmentation and decisioning to improve relevance and effectiveness.

  • Support the development and adoption of scalable, reusable Marketing Automation standards and ways of working.

Required skills and experience

  • Significant experience in marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related field.

  • Strong expertise in customer journey architecture, design and orchestration, with the ability to think across interconnected customer experiences rather than individual campaigns.

  • Experience handling or optimising a portfolio of automated journeys, identifying gaps, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.

  • Ability to translate customer and commercial challenges into clear journey strategies and practical automation solutions.

  • Strong understanding of automation principles, including triggers, segmentation, personalisation, decisioning, channel selection, frequency and journey sequencing.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using customer, behavioural and commercial data to improve outcomes.

  • Experience developing testing and experimentation approaches and applying insights to journey optimisation.

  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how automated journeys contribute to acquisition, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention and customer value.

  • Ability to map, visualise and explain sophisticated customer journeys to collaborators with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • Strong relationship management, collaboration and influencing skills, including confidence challenging briefs and recommending alternative approaches.

  • Experience coaching or mentoring colleagues and supporting the development of others.

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise contending opportunities and make evidence-based recommendations.

  • Sufficient technical and platform knowledge to understand implementation requirements, identify dependencies and challenge proposed solutions.

Desirable

  • Experience in subscription, digital media, recurring revenue or other customer lifecycle businesses.

  • Familiarity with sophisticated marketing automation or customer data platforms such as Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo or equivalent.

  • Experience with behavioural decisioning, next-best-action, dynamic content or advanced personalisation.

  • Experience designing or optimising multichannel journeys across email, onsite and other digital channels.

  • Knowledge of account-based marketing, multi-contact buying journeys or complex B2B customer relationships.

  • Experience developing reusable journey frameworks, playbooks or operating standards.

  • Experience working across B2C and B2B audiences or within a Centre of Excellence.

job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Job Description

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista Financeiro para integrar nosso time de Serviços Financeiros Compartilhados (Financial Shared Services), apoiando as operações financeiras das Unidades de Negócio das Américas, incluindo Estados Unidos, Canadá, Brasil, México, Colômbia, Argentina e Peru.

Procuramos uma pessoa organizada, analítica, com atenção aos detalhes e que goste de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e internacional, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos financeiros e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.

Nesta posição, você atuará em parceria com equipes locais e globais, garantindo a qualidade dos processos de Contas a Pagar, o bom relacionamento com as Unidades de Negócio e a melhoria contínua das operações financeiras.

O que você vai fazer

  • Apoiar as atividades da equipe de Contas a Pagar (Accounts Payable – AP), garantindo a execução eficiente dos processos financeiros.
  • Realizar o registro, processamento e arquivamento de notas fiscais e faturas no sistema Ascend, atendendo às operações das Américas (Estados Unidos, Canadá, Brasil, México, Colômbia, Argentina e Peru).
  • Acompanhar e validar ordens de compra (Purchase Orders – POs), garantindo que estejam corretamente preenchidas, aprovadas, conciliadas e encerradas, conforme as políticas internas.
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de inconsistências e pendências relacionadas a faturas, ordens de compra e demais transações financeiras.
  • Atender e solucionar dúvidas de fornecedores e clientes internos, mantendo uma comunicação clara e eficiente com as diferentes Unidades de Negócio.
  • Apoiar o processamento de transações financeiras em diferentes moedas, garantindo a precisão das informações.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua e otimização dos processos de Contas a Pagar, identificando oportunidades de simplificação e ganho de eficiência.
  • Acompanhar indicadores operacionais (KPIs) e apoiar o cumprimento dos acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs), garantindo qualidade e agilidade nas entregas.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos e cronogramas de fechamento mensal.
  • Atuar em parceria com equipes financeiras locais e globais, oferecendo suporte à operação de Contas a Pagar do Brasil sempre que necessário.
  • Apoiar demandas pontuais e atividades adicionais da área, conforme as necessidades do negócio.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência em Contas a Pagar, operações financeiras ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência com processos de recebimento, conferência, registro e processamento de notas fiscais e faturas.
  • Conhecimento em processos de ordens de compra, aprovações e controles financeiros.
  • Experiência com Excel e utilização de planilhas para acompanhamento e controle de informações financeiras.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência no processamento de transações em múltiplas moedas.
  • Experiência no atendimento e resolução de demandas de fornecedores e clientes internos.
  • Perfil organizado, analítico, detalhista e com alto nível de precisão.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar prioridades, administrar o próprio tempo e cumprir diferentes prazos.
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e facilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa e independente.
  • Habilidade para interagir com profissionais de diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos, em um ambiente dinâmico e multicultural.

  • Vivência com operações financeiras de diferentes países da América.
  • Conhecimento do sistema Ascend ou de outros sistemas de gestão financeira.
  • Experiência com processos financeiros internacionais e transações em múltiplas moedas.

  • Universidade Corporativa com trilhas de desenvolvimento, mentorias e capacitações;
  • Day off de aniversário.

job.title: Associate Director, Influence - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is building three global Influence & Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.

This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.

As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.

What you'll do:

Grow: Commercial & Sector Partnership

  • Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.
  • Commercial & Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.
  • Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.

Enable: Delivery, Operations & Best Practice

  • Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.
  • Creative, Paid & Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.
  • Governance, Tools & Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.

Transform: Innovation & Modern Measurement

  • Measurement & Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.
  • Platform & Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.
  • Strategic & Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.
  • Negotiation & Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.
  • Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).
  • Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.
  • Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.

Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!

#LI-CY1

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

job.title: Technical Security Governance Lead - Exposure Management
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a lead for Exposure Management to provide deep technical investigation of suspected security exposures across WPP's global technology estate. 

Working within TSG, this role will investigate vulnerabilities and attack opportunities across a highly diverse environment spanning cloud, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, applications, AI and emerging technologies. You will use modern security, exposure and adversarial-testing capabilities to understand whether weaknesses are genuinely exploitable, how they could combine into realistic attack paths, and which exposure deserves attention first. 

This is a hands-on technical role with enterprise-wide reach. You will investigate complex security questions, challenge assumptions with evidence, identify systemic patterns, and translate technical findings into clear priorities for the teams responsible for remediation. You will not own every fix. Your role is to establish technical reality, determine what matters, and direct attention towards the improvements that will most meaningfully reduce WPP's exposure. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation. 

What you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as WPP’s technical Principal for Exposure Management, providing senior technical judgement on attack paths and systemic exposure across the global technology environment.
  • Investigate suspected vulnerabilities across infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications, data and AI.
  • Follow the evidence beyond the tool output, combining information from multiple sources to determine what is genuinely exploitable, how weaknesses connect, and what actually matters.
  • Assess attack paths and systemic exposure, maintaining enough perspective to distinguish significant enterprise risk from isolated or technically interesting findings.
  • Establish technical priorities for mitigation, helping teams focus effort on the exposures most likely to materially improve WPP's security posture.
  • Work with TSG specialists across Cloud, Identity, Data, Infrastructure, Application and AI to understand findings in context and develop technically credible recommendations for system owners.
  • Provide broad technical security expertise on complex security questions, technologies and protective approaches, including areas such as encryption, security tooling and emerging threats.
  • Support major security events where rapid technical investigation, exposure analysis and remediation prioritisation are required.
  • Continuously improve how WPP understands exposure, identifying recurring patterns, challenging assumptions and helping us get better at finding the problems that actually matter. 

What you'll need:

Essential: 

  • 5+ years of hands-on technical security experience, with meaningful practical experience investigating, defending or validating real enterprise technology.
  • Strong foundations across enterprise technology, such as networks, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications or security operations, with enough breadth to understand how weaknesses interact across domains.
  • Practical attacker and defender knowledge, with the ability to reason about vulnerabilities, exploitability, attack paths, defensive controls and realistic attack opportunities.
  • Strong investigative and critical-thinking skills, including the curiosity to challenge assumptions, question tool output and follow evidence until the underlying technical reality is understood.
  • The judgement to prioritise, knowing when to investigate deeply, when enough is known to act, and when an interesting technical issue is not the most important problem.
  • Professional English, sufficient to investigate, collaborate and communicate effectively across WPP's global technology and security organisation.
  • Ability to work primarily from WPP's São Paulo office as part of the wider security team. 

Desirable: 

  • Practical experience in one or more of Red Team, Blue Team, Purple Team, Vulnerability Management, Exposure Management, Security Engineering, Security Research, Vulnerability Research, adversarial validation or attack-path analysis.
  • Experience translating complex technical findings into clear priorities and recommendations that other technology teams can act on.
  • Experience working across multiple technology domains rather than remaining exclusively within a single technical specialism.
  • Experience operating with substantial autonomy, creating structure from ambiguity and maintaining perspective across competing technical problems.
  • Experience influencing technical outcomes through expertise, evidence and collaboration, rather than relying on direct authority.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work equally well with deep technical specialists and senior stakeholders.
  • 10+ years of broader IT or cybersecurity experience, ideally including earlier hands-on experience with enterprise infrastructure, networks, operating systems, applications or security operations.
  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability, attack-surface, exposure, BAS or security-posture platforms, particularly where multiple sources must be correlated to understand the real picture.
  • Experience investigating exposure across cloud, identity, applications, AI or agentic systems.
  • Experience supporting major incidents, urgent remediation programmes or complex technical investigations under time pressure.
  • Experience designing or improving technical security methodologies, processes, metrics or prioritisation approaches.
  • Relevant technical education or certifications. Practical experience and demonstrated technical judgement matter more than certification volume. 

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Leadership & Market Strategy

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor market KPIs and implement corrective action plans when necessary.

Community Impact

Required

job.title: Morning Show Co-Host / Board Operator - 96.3 KKLZ
job.description:
Position Overview
96.3 KKLZ, Las Vegas' heritage Classic Hits station, is searching for an experienced, creative, and entertaining Morning Show Co-Host to join our established morning team.
We're looking for a dynamic personality with a quick wit, strong conversational instincts, and the ability to connect with listeners through humor, storytelling, and relatable content.
This is a hands-on position requiring a versatile broadcaster who can entertain, create, produce, and execute. The successful candidate will serve as a primary on-air personality while also operating the broadcast console and sharing responsibility for daily show preparation and production.
The ideal candidate brings strong ideas, exceptional chemistry, and a collaborative spirit. We want someone who can lead a conversation, share the spotlight, and help create memorable radio every morning.

Key Responsibilities
On-Air Performance & Content Development
  • Serve as a primary morning show personality, sharing responsibility for the show's entertainment, content, and overall success.
  • Develop and deliver compelling, original content, including topical discussions, humor, storytelling, interviews, and recurring features.
  • Research and prepare relevant daily topics that resonate with the station's adult audience.
  • Demonstrate strong conversational chemistry, improvisational skills, comedic timing, and the ability to engage listeners.
  • Collaborate with fellow hosts to plan show content, develop creative ideas, and maintain a consistent, entertaining presentation.
Broadcast Operations & Production
  • Operate the broadcast console and automation system during live programming.
  • Execute music, commercials, audio elements, contests, and scheduled programming with accuracy and precision.
  • Maintain proper show pacing, timing, and seamless transitions.
  • Share responsibility for producing, editing, and preparing audio elements, including interviews, comedy bits, recurring features, and other show content.
  • Assist with daily show preparation, organization, and execution without reliance on a dedicated producer.
  • Troubleshoot routine technical issues and coordinate with engineering or programming staff as needed.
Station & Audience Engagement
  • Participate in station promotions, live appearances, community events, and special programming.
  • Engage listeners through phone calls, contests, social media, and other interactive platforms.
  • Contribute to the station's digital presence through engaging and brand-appropriate content.
  • Collaborate with programming, promotions, and sales teams to support station initiatives.
  • Represent KKLZ and Beasley Media Group professionally on and off the air.

Required Qualifications
  • Professional on-air radio experience, preferably in a live, multi-host morning show environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and deliver compelling, personality-driven radio content.
  • Experience operating a broadcast console and radio automation systems.
  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, improvisational, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, self-motivation, and the ability to independently prepare content.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously during a live broadcast.
  • Strong understanding of radio formatics, show pacing, and audience engagement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, accept direction, and contribute to a positive team environment.
  • Willingness to work early morning hours and participate in occasional station events outside regular broadcast hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Proven success as a primary morning show personality.
  • Experience developing and producing original comedy bits, recurring features, and entertaining audio content.
  • Familiarity with Classic Hits or other mainstream, adult-targeted radio formats.
  • Experience with social media, video production, and digital audience engagement.
  • Knowledge of the Las Vegas market and local community.

The Ideal Candidate
We're looking for a well-rounded broadcaster who loves creating great radio.
Someone who can generate compelling ideas, deliver a great punchline, tell a memorable story, and make their co-host shine. Someone who understands how to balance spontaneity with preparation and entertainment with the demands of a music-intensive format.
You should be equally comfortable behind the microphone, behind the board, and behind the scenes preparing the content that makes a morning show successful.
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands that the best morning shows are built on chemistry, creativity, collaboration, and a genuine connection with the audience.

About 96.3 KKLZ
96.3 KKLZ is a heritage Las Vegas radio station delivering Classic Hits, engaging personalities, and strong community connections. As part of Beasley Media Group, KKLZ is committed to creating compelling local radio that entertains and connects with listeners.
Location: Las Vegas, Nevada
Position: Full-Time Morning Show Co-Host / Board Operator
Schedule: Weekday mornings, with additional station appearances as needed

Beasley Media Group LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Continuous AI Risk Management Expert, to design, build and lead the enterprise-wide governance, security and continuous risk management program for artificial intelligence (covering both traditional AI and generative AI) across the Corporation.

In this role, you will design and deploy an enterprise AI risk assessment framework and conduct continuous evaluations of AI systems throughout the AI life cycle (from design to production). You will collaborate closely with data protection analysts, as well as the legal, compliance and enterprise architecture teams, to identify, measure and mitigate cybersecurity risks associated with AI technologies.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s in It for You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Design and deploy the AI risk assessment framework: Develop, formalize and implement a standardized risk assessment methodology tailored to AI systems, including ethical impact matrices, model criticality criteria, bias analysis, algorithmic vulnerability assessments and data exposure risks.
  • Support enterprise AI governance architecture: Collaborate closely with architecture teams and governance committees to design, integrate and evolve the security foundation for AI technologies across the Corporation.
  • Maintain the AI inventory and classification: Build and manage a centralized registry of all AI systems, models (internal, SaaS, open-source) and AI agents deployed across the organization, classified by risk level.
  • Conduct continuous model risk assessments: Perform technical risk evaluations on new AI use cases, analyzing training data security, prompt/query confidentiality, algorithmic bias and intellectual property risks.
  • Perform AI security testing: Define and execute specialized security and adversarial testing for AI and large language models (LLMs).
  • Assess third-party AI and SaaS solutions: Partner with the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Analyst to evaluate the security posture, privacy controls and model-training policies of external vendors. Provide specialized AI expertise to analyze contractual data-use terms (e.g., ensuring corporate data is not used for model training), evaluate SaaS API security and verify privacy guarantees in third-party environments.
  • Manage the AI risk register: Document, maintain and map AI-specific model vulnerabilities, technical debt and approved exceptions in the risk register.
  • Assess program maturity: Conduct periodic evaluations of AI governance maturity, developing dashboards and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) for executive and governance committees.
  • Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years' applied experience in IT security, data governance or technology risk management.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing or implementing risk assessment methodologies and evaluating AI models.
  • Proven ability to translate complex AI concepts into structured risk frameworks for project teams, with a deep understanding of AI architectures and AI-specific attack vectors.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

job.title: Seasonal Senior Product Designer

The NFL is looking for a Senior Product Designer to bring compelling, innovative and user-centered design digital experiences to life across the NFL portfolio. The ideal candidate will be a passionate product designer, adept in balancing the nuances of user flows, product requirements and UX practices with a love of the details that bring thoughtful, well-crafted designs to life. We will look to you for strategic design thinking as well as best in class execution, along with a passion for collaboration, a curious mind, and an enthusiastic approach to making great products.

This role will work closely with Product Management, Project Management, Engineering, UX and User Research across all products and platforms to creatively solve problems and partner with all facets of the NFL organization to help bring those ideas to life for the incredible NFL fan base.

This is an exciting opportunity to have a major impact on all of the products within the NFL portfolio and help shape our process to continuously improve and ship them.

*Please submit a resume and portfolio (pdf or website link) with your application.

Responsibilities

  • Design compelling, informative, and engaging user experiences & flows.
  • Deliver high-fidelity UI and UX specs that clearly communicate requirements.
  • Be an excellent communicator and storyteller both verbally and visually, bringing ideas to life using sketches, workshops, journeys, comps, prototypes, presentations and more to communicate clearly and move the needle within creative teams and with less design-fluent stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the UX, User Research, Product Managers and Engineering teams to identify needs, determine approaches, create design solutions and iteratively refine ideas through development and launch.
  • Advocate for design and experience priorities within interdisciplinary teams in creating products that consider users, push for innovation, prioritize usability, and balance business objectives from ideation to launch through maintenance on live products.
  • Identify, align, and establish shared user experience patterns across different platform features.
  • Contribute to creating and managing a cohesive design system across the NFL digital portfolio via flexible and reusable components.
  • Be a champion for experience cohesion, helping the expansive NFL digital ecosystem function in one unified voice.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Product Design experience developing user experiences and interface design for digital products.

job.title: Production Supervisor, WTMJ
job.description:
Are you a seasoned broadcast professional ready to step into a leadership role that keeps a station running at its best? WTMJ in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, is looking for an energetic, organized, and collaborative Production Supervisor to lead our talented production team. In this pivotal role, you'll oversee the studio calendar, manage production schedules, and ensure our studio is always ready for prime time — including special events and programs. You won't just be leading from the sidelines, either; you'll roll up your sleeves and step in as an acting director, technical director, or other studio role, making you a true hands-on leader at the heart of everything we do.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Assist the director of operations with personnel decisions, including hiring, performance management, coaching, training, and development.
  • Act in a studio role such as director/technical director and as back-up to such positions.
  • Coordinate production personnel work schedules and studio calendar/scheduling.
  • Oversee studio maintenance and changes as necessary, i.e., lighting, shot blocking, set, etc.
  • Assist director of operations in coordinating special events including: meetings, planning with multiple departments, and on-location planning.
  • Coordinate special event staff scheduling.
  • Other duties as assigned by manager.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Prior supervisory experience a plus

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Ability to work well with all levels of personnel and departments to plan and negotiate
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Must be detail-oriented
  • Familiarity with live broadcast newsroom and production operations
  • Ability to work all studio positions and at least two control room positions
  • Ability to read/follow up on newscast variance reports and continuous creative improvement of all shows
  • Ability to prioritize projects and tasks
  • Strong leadership skills to maintain department morale and team building
  • Microsoft Office experience
  • Familiarity with work scheduling for a multi-shift department
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Keen sense for anticipating issues and resolving them before they occur
  • "On-call" person for assigned shift to fill in for various positions: director, control room, studio, SAT center
  • Requires squatting, lifting, and climbing
  • Able to climb ladders and other equipment
  • Possible non-traditional shift, 2:15 pm-10:45 pm, may include weekends, holidays, and special events
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Milwaukee is a city with genuine character — a place where big-city energy meets Midwestern warmth. Situated along the southwestern shore of Lake Michigan, Milwaukee's waterfront is a stunning backdrop for everyday life, offering miles of trails, beaches, and festivals. The city is internationally famous for Summerfest, the world's largest music festival, which draws hundreds of thousands of visitors each summer. Year-round, the Third Ward arts district, vibrant Brady Street corridor, and the celebrated Bay View neighborhood give residents a rich mix of galleries, independent restaurants, coffee shops, and live music venues to explore.


Sports fans will feel right at home cheering on the Milwaukee Brewers at American Family Field or watching the NBA's Milwaukee Bucks at Fiserv Forum. Milwaukee's deep brewing heritage — home to legendary names like Miller and Pabst — lives on through a thriving craft beer scene, and the iconic Harley-Davidson Museum is a must-visit landmark. World-class culture rounds things out, highlighted by the Milwaukee Art Museum, whose breathtaking Santiago Calatrava-designed Quadracci Pavilion is one of the most photographed buildings in the Midwest.


Best of all, Milwaukee offers an outstanding quality of life at a cost well below many major metros. With affordable housing, friendly neighborhoods, and easy access to both Chicago (90 minutes south) and the natural beauty of Wisconsin's lakes and forests, Milwaukee is a city that is easy to call home and hard to leave.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. The Senior Product Manager, SAP GRC is an integral part of the Corp Core Innovation & Operations organization, reporting directly to the Director, GRC. This role leads the strategy and execution of complex SAP security and access-governance initiatives across NBCU, using advanced functional and technical expertise to evaluate multiple variables, resolve complex problems, and enhance methods, systems, and tools. The Senior Product Manager serves as a subject matter expert for SAP GRC and security, provides technical guidance and oversight, drives architecture and design decisions, and ensures successful delivery of high-impact initiatives. The role also mentors and coaches associates, advises stakeholders on complex matters, adapts communication to influence audiences across the broader business, and may be accountable through the team for delivery of tactical business targets.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of SAP GRC Access Control (AC) and Identity and Access Governance (IAG) modules, ensuring successful execution across complex, interdependent workstreams.
  • Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) security concepts, including identity authentication, authorization, role collections, destination security, and integration with enterprise identity providers.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Joule and AI-enabled SAP solutions, with an understanding of security, access governance, data privacy, and responsible AI considerations in SAP environments.
  • Ability to support security design for SAP BTP extensions, Fiori applications, cloud integrations, and AI-driven business processes across SAP S/4HANA and connected systems.
  • Familiarity with securing and governing emerging SAP capabilities such as Joule, generative AI, workflow automation, and cloud application services within SAP’s security and compliance framework.
  • Lead collaboration with architecture, application, engineering, business, and compliance teams to evaluate and implement secure access models for SAP BTP, AI services, and intelligent automation solutions; provide technical guidance and drive architecture and design decisions.
  • Design and implement role-based access controls (RBAC), firefighting, and segregation of duties (SoD) rules to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and company policies.
  • Build and maintain a network of key contacts across and beyond the immediate area of expertise; influence senior stakeholders, adapt communication style, and use persuasion to translate business needs into scalable technical specifications and delivery priorities.
  • Recommend new SAP GRC features and functionality, security technologies, tools, and practices to improve the organization's risk and compliance posture.
  • Own and evolve SAP GRC strategies, policies, roadmaps, standards, and procedures; break down complex problems and identify opportunities to enhance methods, systems, and tools.
  • Serve as the SAP GRC and security subject matter expert, applying deep domain specialization to frequently advise product, engineering, architecture, audit, compliance, and business teams on complex matters.
  • Lead complex projects with multiple variables and dependencies, establish clear delivery outcomes, provide technical oversight, proactively manage risks, and remain accountable through the team for achievement of tactical business targets.
  • Mentor and coach product, security, and technical associates, strengthening domain capability, technical judgment, and consistent application of SAP security and governance standards.
  • Exercise independent judgment on product, architecture, control, and delivery decisions that can affect the broader area of contribution, balancing business value, technical feasibility, compliance, and risk.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, GDPR) and industry standards.
  • Exposure to other GRC products like SAP IAG, SAP BIS, SAP Audit Management, and Process Controls.       
  • Develop and maintain GRC workflows, including access request, approval, and review processes.
  • SAP GRC integration with SAP Analytics Cloud, Success Factors, SAP BTP, SAP HANA, Fieldglass, AD, etc.
  • Conduct detailed assessments of existing access controls and authorization processes to identify gaps and risks.
  • Designs, develops and maintains the company’s SAP user management and security architecture across multiple SAP environments in addition to providing solution recommendations
  • Analyze & understand the current Roles and Access Restrictions from Audit standpoint and synchronize with existing GRC access management solution to provide a risk-free environment
  • Maintaining, managing and monitoring compliance with the SAP IT Security framework; tracking Internal Security Control (ISC) gaps and exceptions for the global IT control environment
  • Commitment to upholding government and corporate security guidelines including Segregation of Duties (SoD), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and Privacy related standards
  • Assist with the development and implementation of SAP security policies, processes, architecture, training, and communications.
  • Identify security solutions, implement standards and best practices, proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Responsible for managing Security for SAP ERP, SAP BW, Fiori, Gateway, SAP S/4, SAP HANA Implementation in accordance with SAP Security Strategy and Administration/Troubleshooting the complex SAP Security Issues
  • In partnership with solution architects and the business process owners, translate business requirements into the SAP Security design and maintenance of the SAP Security Roles in SAP Systems

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC, Identity and Access Management, or related SAP security disciplines.
  • Strong knowledge of the SAP Authorization Concept, including roles, profiles, authorization objects, user administration, and troubleshooting authorization issues.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining SAP security roles and authorizations across SAP S/4HANA, MDG, BW4HANA, SAC, CIS/BTP environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control, including Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Business Role Management (BRM), Emergency Access Management (EAM/Firefighter), and MSMP workflows.
  • Experience performing Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis, security risk assessment, remediation, and mitigation.
  • Experience supporting SAP security implementations, upgrades, migrations, and production environments.
  • Knowledge of application security concepts across ABAP, SAP HANA, Fiori, and related SAP technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex SAP security and authorization issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business, functional, technical, audit, and compliance teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing technologies and business priorities.

Desired Characteristics:

  • 12+ years of experience as an SAP Security and/or SAP GRC professional, preferably in large, complex enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership of at least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including architecture and design decisions, cross-functional delivery, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Preferred experience with 3 to 5 full lifecycle SAP Security/GRC implementations, particularly across SAP S/4HANA, and SAP GRC Access Control/Process Control 12.x.
  • Deep expertise in one or more SAP Security/GRC domains with demonstrated credibility as a Subject Matter Expert (SME).
  • Experience designing SAP security architecture and authorization models for SAP S/4HANA and Fiori, including business roles, catalogs, spaces/pages, OData services, and backend authorization requirements.
  • Experience with SAP HANA security, including database roles, privileges, and integration with application-level security.
  • Experience with SAP cloud security technologies such as SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS and IPS, SAP IAG, and SAP Analytics Cloud, where applicable.
  • Experience integrating SAP security with enterprise Identity and Access Management and Privileged Access Management solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor and coach team members, and establish security standards and best practices across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to translate complex SAP security, SoD, and compliance issues into business risks and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Experience partnering with Internal Audit, External Audit, SOX, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and Risk Management teams.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple variables, resolve ambiguous issues, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
  • Strategic thinker capable of aligning SAP Security and GRC architecture with broader cybersecurity, IAM, compliance, and business strategy.
  • SAP Security, SAP GRC, cybersecurity, IAM, or related professional certifications are preferred.

Additional Requirements: 

  • Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.
