job.title: Director, Technical Product Management – Audience
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

job.description:
Vox is a user’s guide to the news produced by those who know it best. Today, Explained and Explain It to Me are the podcast expressions of that mission.

Proficiency in audio editing/mixing in ProTools

About the Role

The New York Times is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join the Games Web Platform squad. You'll help shape the platform behind The Times' suite of games, building the capabilities that help our teams to deliver engaging, reliable experiences for players. You'll take ownership of complex engineering work across our application, and help the team turn new puzzle ideas into scalable product capabilities.

You'll strengthen the technology behind our existing games and help create the foundation for new experiences. Working with engineers, designers, product managers, and production partners, you'll guide technical decisions from discovery through launch, balancing a high-quality player experience with maintainable, reliable systems. You'll also share your expertise through mentorship, thoughtful technical reviews, and contributions to an engineering organization that values transparency, diversity, learning, and a community of practice.

Our team builds web applications with React, semantic HTML, and SCSS, prioritizing accessibility and performance in the player experience. You'll contribute across the stack: shaping front-end architectures and shared platform capabilities, and designing and building performant Go APIs that support the Games ecosystem. Our infrastructure runs on Amazon Web Services, with Fastly providing edge delivery and caching. We're looking for someone who can make sound architectural tradeoffs, improve the systems they work on, and help other engineers deliver high-quality work.

You will report to the Engineering Manager, Platform squad.

This is a hybrid role based at our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 2-3+ days/week.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and evolution of foundational web platform capabilities and shared component libraries, helping Games teams deliver reliable, accessible, high-quality experiences.

job.title: Manager, Payments and Fraud Analytics - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and other providers to review performance, investigate issues, evaluate capabilities, and hold partners accountable for agreed service and optimization actions.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud Prevention, and senior leaders on priorities, tradeoffs, and policy or process changes; communicate complex findings and gain support for recommendations with financial and customer impact.
  • Establish the operating model, priorities, documentation, and performance standards for the analytics function; coordinate work across analysts and develop, coach, and manage direct reports as positions are added.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on advanced SQL analysis using large transaction-level datasets and development of dashboards or data visualizations for business decisions.
  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in payments analytics, fraud analytics, payment operations, risk, or a closely related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating the work of analysts, or managing and developing team members.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to join, validate, segment, and interpret large payment and fraud datasets.
  • Advanced data visualization and dashboard development skills using Tableau, Looker, or comparable tools; experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Strong knowledge of card payments, authorization and decline behavior, routing, processing economics, interchange and network fees, settlement, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud controls.
  • Working knowledge of payment networks and processors or gateways, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, and Stripe.
  • Knowledge of tokenization, 3DS, alternative payment methods, cross-border payments, and the customer checkout experience.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business questions, perform root-cause analysis, quantify financial and customer impact, and recommend practical actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis to technical and nontechnical audiences and influence decisions across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Leadership skills to set priorities, establish standards, coordinate work, coach analysts, and build a high-performing analytics function as the team grows.

 

Pay Scale: $95,000 - $109,000

 

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 

 

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace

 

 

More about AXS

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

 

 

More about AEG

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people feel, share, and remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience over 13,000 live events across five continents, from iconic concerts and major festivals to championship-level sports and entertainment destinations.

We are dedicated to a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

THE TEAM

Live Nation Entertainment believes live music has the power to bring people together and strengthen communities. Through strategic initiatives, partnerships, and programs, the Social Impact team creates meaningful opportunities that connect fans, artists, crews, and communities through the power of live music. 

THE ROLE

The Senior Director will build, lead, and continuously evolve the marketing function for Live Nation Entertainment’s Social Impact organization, overseeing integrated marketing, digital marketing, brand strategy, communications, and storytelling across On the House, LiveNation.org (as applicable), strategic partnerships, employee engagement initiatives, and future social impact programs. 


This role will translate organizational priorities into marketing strategies and campaigns that build awareness, strengthen engagement, elevate Live Nation’s reputation, and deliver measurable business and community impact. 


Working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional partners across Marketing, Communications, Creative, Legal, Government Affairs, Digital, Concerts, and Sponsorship, this leader will own marketing initiatives from strategy to execution while building the processes, systems, and operational excellence needed to support a growing organization. 


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO 


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Leadership 

  • Own the marketing and communications strategy for Live Nation Entertainment Social Impact. 
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns and digital marketing strategies from concept through launch, including strategy, planning, creative development, execution, optimization, and performance measurement. 
  • Build annual marketing plans and campaign roadmaps that align with organizational priorities and business objectives. 
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Social Impact marketing team by setting clear priorities, providing ongoing feedback, and creating opportunities for professional growth while fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture. 

Brand, Digital & Audience Engagement 

  • Own brand positioning, messaging, storytelling, and launch communications across all Social Impact initiatives. 
  • Develop compelling narratives that translate programs, partnerships, and impact into meaningful stories for fans, artists, partners, employees, nonprofit organizations, and community stakeholders. 
  • Ensure a consistent, premium, and culturally relevant experience across all marketing channels. 
  • Own the digital marketing strategy across web, email, CRM, social media, and emerging digital platforms, ensuring cohesive audience experiences and measurable engagement. 

Marketing Operations 

  • Establish scalable marketing processes, workflows, approval systems, and planning tools that enable efficient execution within a lean organization. 
  • Lead and develop the Social Impact marketing team by setting clear priorities, providing coaching and feedback, and fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture. 
  • Own the integrated marketing calendar, ensuring visibility, coordination, and alignment across campaigns, launches, partnerships, and organizational communications. 
  • Manage external agencies, creative partners, freelancers, consultants, budgets, and production resources. 
  • Measure campaign effectiveness through defined KPIs and performance reporting, using insights to continuously improve future initiatives. 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 12-15 years of progressive leadership experience in integrated marketing, brand strategy, communications, or related disciplines. 
  • Proven success developing and leading integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement. 
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing strategy, audience development, CRM, email marketing, social media, web experiences, content strategy, SEO/SEM fundamentals, campaign analytics, and emerging digital platforms. 
  • Experience leading and developing marketing professionals while fostering accountability, collaboration, and strong execution. 
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing marketing teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across multiple teams and leadership levels. 
  • Experience managing agencies, creative partners, consultants, and external vendors.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with experience developing messaging for executive, public, partner, and employee audiences. 
  • Highly self-directed with the ability to independently prioritize work, navigate ambiguity, and drive initiatives forward with minimal oversight. 
  • Passion for live music and entertainment, with a desire to leverage marketing to create meaningful community impact. 
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and travel as needed for events and organizational initiatives. 


WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • You are a strategic marketing leader who thrives at building brands, launching campaigns, and turning ambitious ideas into measurable results. 
  • You understand that great marketing is more than creative ideas – it’s thoughtful planning, disciplined execution, strong cross-functional collaboration, and continuous optimization.
  • You’re equally comfortable developing long-term strategy and rolling up your sleeves to move projects forward
  • You know how to take an initiative from concept to launch, building the strategy, aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, overseeing creative development, navigating approvals, and ensuring flawless execution across every touchpoint.
  • You enjoy creating order in fast-moving environments. Whether building marketing calendars, establishing workflows, or developing scalable processes, you bring clarity, accountability, and momentum to complex organizations
  • You are energized by using marketing to tell meaningful stories that strengthen communities, inspire engagement, and demonstrate the positive impact Live Nation creates through music. 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Director of JV Accounting who will oversee accounting and financial reporting for the LATAM division, ensuring accurate results, timely closes, and compliance with US GAAP and company policies.


This role will work closely with local finance teams, joint ventures, and corporate accounting to standardize processes and strengthen internal controls, and report to an SVP, Group Reporting and Controlling.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Lead, manage, and mentor the accounting team. Set priorities, assign responsibilities, balance workloads, and provide training and performance feedback in a supportive working environment.
  • Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close. Establish deadlines, review journal entries and reconciliations, and hold team members accountable for complete and accurate deliverables.
  • Oversee preparation and review of financial statements and supporting schedules for consolidated reporting. Analyze the P&L and balance sheet, investigate unusual balances, and resolve reconciling items.
  • Ensure appropriate US GAAP accounting for revenue, expenses, accruals, fixed assets, intercompany transactions, foreign currency, and non-controlling interests, including current and long-term classifications.
  • Review JV financial reporting and coordinate with local finance teams to resolve accounting differences, reconcile intercompany balances, and support consolidation and eliminations.
  • Oversee accounting integration for acquisitions, including opening balances, reporting requirements, and adoption of company procedures. Review acquisition transaction costs and legal expenses for proper treatment and timely accruals.
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously strengthen the accounting policies, procedures, and internal control environment required to support accurate financial reporting and SOX compliance, where applicable.
  • Partner with the Director of Accounting to ensure accounting policies, financial-reporting controls, and audit requirements are appropriately designed, implemented, and monitored.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits, assign supporting schedules to team members, review responses, and ensure findings are resolved on time.
  • Review annual joint venture financial audit results for completeness and accuracy; validate shareholder distribution calculations to ensure each shareholder is paid the correct percentage and amount in accordance with governing agreements.
  • Partner with Tax, Treasury, Legal, and corporate finance on reporting and compliance matters. Support budgets, forecasts, and management requests with reliable accounting information and variance explanations.
  • Identify and implement improvements to accounting systems and workflows, including ERP transformation projects, to improve efficiency and reporting quality.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

job.title: Education & Community Engagement Manager
job.description:
This is a hybrid position. Applicants must reside in the Tri-State Area to be on location for occasional programming and meetings.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 

The Education and Community Engagement Manager supports the development, implementation, and refinement of Grammy Museum Education & Community Engagement programs with a focus on educator-facing initiatives, curriculum development, professional development, student recruitment, and regional program support. Based in New York City, you will help expand the Museum’s East Coast education presence and support programs primarily East of the Mississippi River including Grammy in the Schools, professional development sessions, and seasonal Grammy Camp support.

 

You will provide curriculum expertise across programs to ensure consistency, continuity, and alignment with the Museum’s educational goals. You will build and maintain relationships with K-12 teachers, school partners, districts, and arts education organizations to support educator engagement, student recruitment, and professional development. You will also support application and recruitment processes for student and educator programs, ensuring outreach, application review, and participant communication reflect program goals and expand access for students and teachers.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

Professional Development & Educator Engagement

  • Lead planning, development, and facilitation of educator professional development programs, including virtual, in-person, district-based, and conference-based sessions.
  • Build and maintain relationships with K–12 teachers, school districts, arts coordinators, and education partners to support professional development, program participation, student recruitment, and ongoing educator engagement.
  • Identify and cultivate professional development opportunities with schools, districts, conferences, and partner organizations.
  • Collect and synthesize educator feedback to inform future professional development offerings, curriculum tools, and program improvements.

 

Program Alignment

  • Provide curriculum expertise across Education programs to ensure consistency, continuity, and alignment with departmental learning goals, while remaining adaptable to different student, teacher, and community contexts.
  • Develop and refine learning objectives, instructional materials, rubrics, classroom extensions, and develop and maintain program manuals.
  • Support alignment of programs with music education, arts education, career and technical education, college/career readiness, and workforce development frameworks where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with internal team members to connect curriculum and instructional design across Grammy Camp, Grammy in the Schools, Industry Sessions, professional development, and other education initiatives.

 

Recruitment, Applications & Program Process Support

  • Support recruitment for student and educator programs including outreach to schools, teachers, districts, community partners, and professional networks, building an application pipeline.
  • Support application and review processes for selected programs, including outreach, applicant communication, submission tracking, rubric development, review coordination, and documentation.
  • Help ensure recruitment and application processes are accessible, organized, and aligned with program goals, student readiness, educator needs, and equity of access.
  • Collaborate with the Coordinator and program leads to maintain accurate applicant records, support review timelines, and communicate next steps to applicants and participants.

 

Grammy in the Schools Support

  • Support planning and implementation of Grammy in the Schools programs, particularly those based on the East Coast and primarily East of the Mississippi River.
  • Assist with educator and school partner communication, program planning, instructional materials, and on-site implementation.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure Grammy in the Schools programming is educationally consistent, student-centered, and aligned with the Museum’s broader learning goals.
  • Support development of program resources that help students connect music learning to industry pathways, creative careers, and transferable skills.

 

Grammy Camp Support

  • Support Grammy Camp planning and implementation including curriculum alignment, faculty support, student learning outcomes, and summer travel for on-site program delivery.
  • Support faculty onboarding, curriculum implementation, instructional planning, and integration of curriculum benchmarks across the camp model.
  • Help ensure consistency across camp cities while supporting local adaptation based on partners, faculty, students, and facilities.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Vice President, Senior Director, Senior Manager, and Coordinator to support program strategy, planning, implementation, and evaluation.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, Advancement, Production, Guest Services, and Finance as needed.
  • Support public programs in New York as needed.
  • Represent the Education & Community Engagement team in meetings with schools, districts, partners, artists, faculty, and external stakeholders.
  • Travel for programs, conferences, partner meetings, Grammy Camp, Grammy in the Schools and other education initiatives as needed.
  SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred in music education, arts education, curriculum and instruction, education, music industry, or a related field.
  • 3-5+ years of experience in music education, arts education, curriculum development, professional development, or youth program implementation.
  • Experience designing or facilitating professional development for educators preferred.
  • Strong understanding of secondary music education, music technology, ensemble instruction, career-connected learning, and/or music industry pathways.
  • Experience developing curriculum, lesson plans, educator resources, rubrics, or instructional materials.
  • Experience supporting student or educator recruitment and application review processes preferred.
  • Ability to build relationships and collaborate with educators, students, artists, K-12 schools, districts, partners, and internal teams.
  • Strong writing, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple programs and timelines.
  • Willingness and ability to travel including significant summer travel to support Grammy Camp.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

 

The employee may be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.

 

 

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 

The starting salary for this position is $66,300 to $70,800 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market. 
 
The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.


Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity. 

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Corporate Affairs, Health Policy - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is seeking a Senior Vice President, Health Policy and Public Affairs, to lead one of the agency's most strategically important global healthcare accounts.

This role serves as the senior strategic counselor to client leadership across a portfolio of marketed and pipeline therapies in neurology and rare disease. The EVP will lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for patient advocacy engagement, access and reimbursement policy, stakeholder mobilization, executive visibility, corporate reputation and issues management.

The successful candidate will possess deep healthcare public affairs expertise, exceptional stakeholder engagement experience, and a strong understanding of the evolving policy, regulatory, reimbursement and market access environment impacting innovative medicines globally.

This leader will work at the intersection of science, policy, patient need and reputation, helping shape conversations among patient organizations, professional societies, policymakers, healthcare providers, caregivers and advocacy stakeholders while ensuring communications and engagement strategies support both long-term corporate reputation objectives and product-related priorities.

The ideal candidate combines the strategic instincts of a public affairs leader, the stakeholder expertise of a patient advocacy professional, and the business acumen of a senior agency executive. They are equally comfortable discussing healthcare policy with government stakeholders, scientific innovation with medical leaders, reputation strategy with the C-suite and patient priorities with advocacy organizations.

Most importantly, they understand how policy, science, access, patient advocacy and reputation intersect, and can help global healthcare organizations navigate that complexity to create meaningful impact for patients, caregivers and society.

This Hybrid role is ideally based in New York and Washington DC. 

What you'll do:

Strategic Client Leadership

  • Serve as senior strategic counselor to global and regional client leadership teams.
  • Lead integrated public affairs, corporate reputation and stakeholder engagement programs across neurology and rare disease portfolios.
  • Shape strategic communications approaches that connect policy, patient advocacy, access and reputation objectives into a cohesive narrative.
  • Develop executive-level recommendations informed by evolving healthcare, political, reimbursement and regulatory environments.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex business, reputation and policy challenges.

Public Affairs, Policy & Access Leadership

  • Lead policy and advocacy strategies addressing market access, affordability, reimbursement and healthcare system priorities.
  • Counsel clients on emerging U.S., European and global policy developments affecting innovative medicines.
  • Monitor and advise on pricing, reimbursement and trade-related policy developments, including initiatives such as Most Favored Nation (MFN) pricing models, international reference pricing and healthcare cost-containment efforts.
  • Translate complex policy developments into impactful engagement and communications strategies.
  • Partner with policy experts, economists and scientific leaders to develop evidence-based advocacy initiatives.

Patient Advocacy & Stakeholder Relations

  • Build and strengthen relationships with patient organizations, advocacy coalitions, caregivers, healthcare professional associations and disease community leaders.
  • Design and implement engagement strategies that elevate patient perspectives throughout the disease lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities for trusted partnerships that advance awareness, access, education and health outcomes.
  • Guide stakeholder mapping and influence strategies across advocacy, policy and medical communities.
  • Ensure patient-centered engagement approaches are integrated across all programs.

Neurology & Rare Disease Expertise

  • Provide strategic counsel across brain health, neuroscience and rare disease areas.
  • Help clients advance a more integrated and holistic view of brain health that addresses patient outcomes, access, caregiver needs, public awareness and policy considerations.
  • Develop reputation and thought leadership platforms supporting both established therapies and future innovation.
  • Counsel clients on scientific milestones, breakthrough therapies, disease awareness efforts and emerging healthcare trends.
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle communications for pipeline and marketed assets.

Issues & Reputation Management

  • Lead proactive reputation management and complex issues preparedness initiatives.
  • Develop risk assessments, scenario planning exercises and stakeholder response frameworks.
  • Counsel executives during periods of heightened scrutiny involving pricing, access, clinical development, regulatory matters or public policy debates.
  • Ensure consistency of corporate and product-related narratives across stakeholder groups and geographies.
  • Protect and strengthen organizational reputation during critical moments.

Regulatory & Commercialization Strategy

  • Advise clients throughout the therapy development lifecycle, including:
    • Clinical development and trial communications
    • Regulatory milestones
    • FDA and global regulatory approval processes
    • Launch readiness
    • Market access preparation
    • Lifecycle management
  • Partner with scientific, medical and market access teams to connect innovation stories with stakeholder priorities and policy realities.

Business Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and inspire cross-functional account teams across multiple markets.
  • Drive account growth through expansion opportunities and strategic advisory services.
  • Contribute to new business efforts across the health and public affairs sectors.
  • Mentor and develop senior talent while fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture.
  • Strengthen Burson's intellectual capital across healthcare public affairs, patient advocacy and reputation management.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 15+ years of experience in healthcare public affairs, policy, corporate communications, government affairs, market access, advocacy or related disciplines.
  • Significant experience counseling pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare clients on complex public affairs and reputation issues.
  • Demonstrated expertise in neurology, neuroscience, rare disease, specialty pharmaceutical or adjacent therapeutic areas.
  • Deep understanding of healthcare policy, pricing, reimbursement and access environments in the United States and internationally.
  • Experience developing and executing stakeholder engagement strategies involving patient advocacy organizations, healthcare professional associations, policymakers and caregiver communities.
  • Strong familiarity with FDA approval pathways, clinical trial communications and pharmaceutical commercialization strategies.
  • Proven experience supporting both marketed products and clinical-stage pipeline assets.
  • Knowledge of European and/or global healthcare policy environments and stakeholder ecosystems.
  • Exceptional executive presence and ability to counsel C-suite and senior healthcare leaders.
  • Experience leading large, multi-market client engagements and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex reputation and issues management situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within global pharmaceutical companies, healthcare trade associations, public affairs consultancies or communications agencies.
  • Understanding of rare disease and neurological policy frameworks within key international markets.
  • Familiarity with health technology assessment (HTA), reimbursement decision-making and payer environments.
  • Experience engaging with organizations such as patient advocacy coalitions, specialty medical societies, health policy organizations and caregiver networks.
  • Exposure to global market access, international pricing policy and cross-border regulatory considerations.

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

#LI-MG1

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:$125,000—$295,000 USD

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you will have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities  connect with our products, with one another, and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams.

 

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country.  We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of the team. As such, working closely with the product owners, project managers, architects and technical manager, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of a harmonized product, powering ICI TOU.TV and CBC Gem.

 

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

Your responsibilities:

 

  • Design and modify reusable components for Radio-Canada's digital platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and control the quality of the product throughout the project's execution.
  • Stay informed of new trends in the various fields of digital development.
  • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings to track deliverables in production, oversee necessary fixes, and assess the impact of completed projects.
  • Participate in the technical implementation of user stories for our various products.
  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, code reviews, and application deployments.

 

We are looking for a candidate matching the following profile:

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience developing complex, high-performance native Android applications.
  • Excellent command of the Kotlin language and advanced concepts in object-oriented and functional programming.
  • Hands-on experience developing user interfaces with Jetpack Compose and traditional XML views.
  • Solid understanding of modern Android architectures (MVVM, MVI) and common software design patterns (Design Patterns, SOLID principles).
  • Proficiency in state management, local persistence, and consuming REST/GraphQL APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with dependency injection (Hilt, Koin, or Dagger).
  • Experience with the full deployment and release cycle of applications on Google Play.
  • Proficiency in Android performance optimization techniques (app startup time, rendering smoothness, Baseline Profiles, memory footprint, and battery management).
  • Excellent command of Android Studio and its advanced diagnostic tools (Memory/CPU Profiler, Layout Inspector, debugging).
  • Proficiency in Git and collaborative workflows (code reviews, branching).
  • Ability to read, produce, and adhere to software architecture diagrams (UML, sequence diagrams, etc.).
  • Experience developing for Android TV / Google TV, an asset.
  • Experience with Gradle in creating, versioning, and publishing internal libraries to Maven repositories (Nexus, Artifactory, or GitHub Packages), an asset.
  • Interest in or experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), an asset.
  • Experience implementing authentication systems, session management, or multi-profile environments, an asset.
  • Experience writing automated unit and UI tests, an asset.
  • Awareness of and experience with mobile accessibility principles (TalkBack, dynamic font scaling, Jetpack Compose / XML semantics), an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages, an asset.
  • Technical rigor, attention to detail, and a constant focus on software performance.
  • Autonomy, initiative, and a demonstrated ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
  • Team spirit, intellectual curiosity, and ease in communicating technical decisions.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Functional knowledge of written and spoken French is considered a strong asset.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). Therefore, employees working in this role will be expected to make the required efforts and adjustments to navigate this multilingual environment in a respectful manner for all.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting assignment but a long-term opportunity with attractive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check. 

  • Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

Job Description Summary


We are seeking an Adviser, Internal Communications to join the Corporate Communications team. Your primary focus in this role will be on creating and leading internal communication strategies and employee engagement initiatives centered on Equity, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI), Accessibility, and Accommodation. Additionally, you will deliver internal communications support for the Indigenous Office and key corporate priorities, such as the environmental plan.

The employee experience is central to our strategy, and we strive to achieve this by:


  • Making equity, diversity, inclusion and accessibility a priority.
  • Creating agile, customizable programs that focus on the needs of the business.
  • Providing integrated, high-impact service offerings.
  • Deploying technology that contributes to building a modern, agile and safe workplace.
  • Providing an engaging, ethical work environment that reflects the public broadcaster’s values.

Reporting to the Director, Internal Communications, you are a skilled communicator, strategist  and content creator who excels at advising corporate leaders and navigating complex internal messaging. You also possess a strong cultural and emotional intelligence, passionate about building an accessible, equitable, and inclusive workplace.


Your Responsibilities:


  • Develop and execute comprehensive corporate-wide internal communications strategies and plans to support and position CBC/Radio-Canada’s initiatives in Equity, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI), Accessibility, Accommodation and other related areas.
  • Support internal communications and engagement strategies for Indigenous files and projects, ensuring respectful, culturally grounded messaging aligned with organizational commitments and Indigenous initiatives.
  • Create and produce engaging, high-impact internal communications plans and content, including key messages, intranet stories, leadership messaging, employee newsletters, presentations, town halls, and FAQs.
  • Advise senior leaders, managers, and working groups on internal communications best practices within an inclusive, multicultural environment, helping them navigate complex change messaging and sensitivity considerations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and consistent messaging across English Services, French Services and other parts of the organization.
  • Ensure representation, accessibility standards, accommodation best practices, and inclusive language are integrated into all communications channels and projects, amplifying a diversity of voices across the public broadcaster.
  • Manage internal communications projects end-to-end, including content development, presentation design, and coordination with internal production teams (design, web, translation, accessibility services).
  • Measure the reach and impact of internal comms initiatives regarding EDI and accessibility, using feedback and analytics to continually refine strategies.

What We’re Looking For:


  • University degree in communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Five to seven years of relevant internal or corporate communications experience in a large, complex, or multi-site organization.
  • Considerable knowledge and demonstrated experience managing projects and communication strategies involving Equity, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI), Accessibility, and Accommodation.
  • Experience with Indigenous files, projects, or cultural engagement initiatives is considered a significant asset.
  • Excellent written, reading, and oral communication skills in both official languages (English and French).
  • Strong writing and editing skills with a proven ability to translate complex policies, frameworks, and cultural topics into engaging employee messaging.
  • Strong interpersonal, stakeholder management and critical thinking abilities, paired with high emotional and cultural intelligence, an open mindset, and a demonstrated aptitude for influencing key stakeholders.
  • Solid project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This role requires full-time on-site presence.

Role

In this role, working independently or coordinating the work of assigned technicians, you will perform all duties required to maintain transmission and broadcasting systems/equipment in a cross-functional environment spanning networking, electronics and computer systems.
 

Description of duties:

  • Perform all duties required to maintain transmission and broadcasting systems/equipment and remote monitoring equipment (including function-testing, configuring, installing, inspecting, diagnosing, troubleshooting, modifying, repairing and refurbishing).
  • Serve as a collaborative technical lead, taking responsibility for the technical quality of work performed by other technicians.
  • Co-ordinate, review and guide the work of other technicians.
  • Resolve latent or intermittent technical issues to maintain reliable transmission and broadcasting services.
  • Perform testing and complex adjustments to optimize technical facility performance.
  • Source required parts and technical materials, contacting vendors for information and sharing details with relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain workplace safety for all site personnel, contractors and visitors in compliance with operating standards.
  • Keep plans, schematics and operating procedures up to date, creating new diagrams or sketches as needed.
  • Oversee jobsites and co-ordinate subcontractor activities as needed to ensure all work meets project specifications.

job.title: SALES ENABLEMENT & OFFICE SUPPORT
job.description:
Sales Enablement & Office Support

Play 103.7 & 100.5 Cruz FM | Harvard Media

Location: Fort McMurray, AlbertaSchedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PMWork Arrangement: 100% In-OfficeReports to: Market Lead / Sales Manager

YOUR ROLE

We're looking for a highly organized, creative, and proactive individual to join our Fort McMurray team in Sales Enablement & Office Support.

This position plays an important role in supporting our local sales team, ensuring advertising campaigns run smoothly, client commitments are fulfilled, and creative ideas are brought to life.

Working closely with our Sales Manager, Sales Representatives, and internal departments, you'll help turn great ideas into successful advertising campaigns and memorable client experiences.

From preparing sales proposals and coordinating advertising campaigns to supporting sales-driven promotions, events, and daily office operations, you'll be an essential part of keeping our sales team and office organized, efficient, and moving forward.

This is a hands-on, fully in-office position that requires a strong sense of ownership, initiative, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what needs to be done. You'll anticipate needs, recognize priorities, take responsibility for assigned projects, and follow through to completion.

The ideal candidate thrives in a busy environment, can confidently juggle multiple responsibilities, adapt when priorities shift, and takes pride in being the person the team can count on to keep things running smoothly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sales Support & Campaign Coordination

Assist the Sales Manager and Sales Representatives with preparing proposals, presentations, sales materials, and client communications.

Support the coordination and execution of advertising campaigns, promotions, and client commitments.

Maintain accurate sales records, inventory trackers, reports, and internal documents.

Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaigns and projects are completed accurately and on time.

Follow up on outstanding requests, deadlines, and deliverables to keep projects moving forward.

Creative & Marketing Support

Use Canva to create professional sales presentations, promotional materials, social media graphics, and other marketing assets.

Assist with the development and execution of sales-driven promotions, contests, and special events.

Support the preparation of client proposals and customized advertising packages.

Bring creative ideas and solutions to the team while maintaining brand consistency and professionalism.

Office & Administrative Support

Support daily office operations, ensuring the workplace remains organized, professional, and efficient.

Welcome and assist clients, visitors, and staff in a friendly and professional manner.

Assist with scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, and general administrative duties.

Maintain organized files, supplies, records, and office resources.

Respond to changing office and sales needs while managing multiple tasks and deadlines.

Ownership, Initiative & Accountability

Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and projects from start to finish, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Proactively identify what needs to be done and take action without waiting for direction.

Anticipate the needs of the Sales Manager, Sales Representatives, and office, staying one step ahead whenever possible.

Confidently multitask in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing deadlines, unexpected requests, and changing priorities.

Manage competing priorities independently, recognizing urgent requests and adjusting accordingly.

Follow up on outstanding tasks, client commitments, and internal requests until they are resolved.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, organization, and efficiency within the sales department and office.

Communicate proactively, providing updates, flagging concerns early, and asking questions when clarification is needed.

Be a reliable, consistent presence in the office who takes pride in supporting the success of the entire team.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Experience with Canva and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) is required. Candidates must be comfortable using these programs independently and confidently.

Strong Canva skills, with the ability to create professional sales presentations, promotional materials, social media graphics, and other marketing assets.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel for tracking and organizing information, Word for document preparation, PowerPoint for presentations, and Outlook for email and scheduling.

Proven ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing several projects, requests, and deadlines simultaneously without sacrificing accuracy or attention to detail.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively as needs change throughout the day.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

High attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, professional work.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow projects through to completion with minimal supervision.

Strong problem-solving skills, resourcefulness, and a willingness to learn new systems and processes.

A positive, team-oriented attitude with the flexibility to jump in and help wherever needed.

Previous experience in sales support, marketing, administration, or a related role is considered an asset.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means:

The Sales Manager and Sales Representatives can focus more of their time on selling and building client relationships.

Sales orders, campaigns, promotions, and client commitments are completed accurately and on time.

Tasks and projects are managed independently with minimal follow-up required.

Multiple projects and competing priorities are handled efficiently, even during busy periods.

Office needs are anticipated and addressed before they become problems.

Clients, visitors, and colleagues receive friendly, professional, and timely assistance.

Sales resources, inventory trackers, and internal systems are consistently organized and up to date.

Communication between departments is clear, proactive, and efficient.

The team has confidence that when something is assigned, it will be handled from beginning to end.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & EXPECTATIONS

This position is based entirely at our Play 103.7 and 100.5 Cruz FM office in Fort McMurray.

Regular working hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Being physically present is an essential part of the role, as the position supports daily office operations, walk-in visitors, client needs, staff, and time-sensitive sales activities.

Our office is a busy, fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. The successful candidate must be comfortable multitasking, adapting to unexpected requests, and maintaining a high level of organization and professionalism throughout the day.

The successful candidate will be expected to work independently, exercise good judgment, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate a high level of accountability in their daily responsibilities.

job.title: Manager, Technology Product Quality & Testing
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Technology

Work Status: Full Time, Hybrid

Location: Toronto, ON

About The Role

Reporting to the Director, Technology Product & Business Application Support, the Manager, Technology Product Quality & Testing, leads a team responsible for testing software and business applications across the Corus application portfolio.

This role balances two priorities. You will lead the team's day-to-day testing delivery, including functional, regression, integration and business-oriented testing, while gradually expanding the team's quality engineering and test automation capability.

Initially, you will work alongside the team to establish a practical and maintainable automation foundation. Over time, your focus will shift toward coaching, technical guidance, test strategy, people leadership and continuous improvement. Automation will complement manual testing and will be applied where it provides clear and sustainable value.

You will contribute by:

• Lead, coach and support a team of QA professionals with varied technical experience

• Develop risk-based test strategies and priorities based on the scope, complexity, likelihood of failure and business impact of changes across the team’s application portfolio

• Plan and coordinate functional, regression, integration, exploratory and release testing

• Ensure test plans, results, defects and release risks are documented and communicated clearly

• Coordinate test environment and test data needs with application, platform, business and vendor teams

• Coordinate defect triage and resolution with application teams, business stakeholders and vendors

• Partner with application, product and business teams early in the change lifecycle to identify quality risks, clarify test requirements and improve testability

• Coordinate business testing and UAT where business validation is required

• Provide a clear quality and release-readiness recommendation to the accountable release stakeholders

• Manage team capacity, workload, hiring, performance and development

• Work hands-on with the team to establish and grow a maintainable test automation approach

• Prioritize automation based on risk, repeatability, business value and long-term maintenance effort

• Identify opportunities to automate testing across user interfaces, APIs, integrations, data exchanges and end-to-end business processes where practical

• Establish and continuously improve the team’s overall testing framework, standards and practices across manual and automated testing

• Coach team members through pairing, review, structured learning and practical application

• Work with platform and technology partners to incorporate automated tests into delivery pipelines where appropriate

• Introduce meaningful quality metrics that support risk, release and improvement decisions, including measures of test effectiveness, automation reliability and escaped defects rather than test volume alone

• Expand the team's testing coverage into additional software and business applications based on business risk, capacity and team readiness

• Continue to improve manual testing, integration testing and business-testing practices alongside automation

Skills and experience you will bring:

• 5 or more years of progressive experience in software testing, quality assurance or quality engineering

• At least 2 years of experience leading or managing QA professionals, including coaching, work allocation or performance responsibilities

• A pragmatic practitioner and coach, comfortable stepping in to help directly when needed

• Strong experience with manual functional, regression and integration testing

• Experience developing test strategies and coordinating testing across complex applications or system integrations

• Hands-on experience creating and maintaining automated tests using at least one modern automation framework

• Ability to help design and establish an automation approach while building capability and ongoing ownership across the team

• Practical understanding of SDLC, STLC, defect management and release validation

• Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and how automated tests can be incorporated into delivery workflows

• Experience working with business stakeholders, application teams and third-party vendors

• Ability to communicate testing status, quality risk and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences

• Proficiency with modern automation technologies such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or WebdriverIO

• Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, or comparable programming or scripting languages

• Background working with enterprise applications, packaged software or vendor-managed platforms

• Exposure to performance or load testing

• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar delivery platforms

• Knowledge of broadcast, media, advertising, revenue or financial systems

• Familiarity with ITIL, IT General Controls or audit-sensitive technology environments

• ISTQB, ITIL, Agile or Scrum certification

  • Collaborate specifications and requirements with HMG Technology on data engineering roadmap to acquire, store and retrieve data that addresses HMG missional, operating and revenue interests
  • Review existing systems in relation to future needs and benefits and recommend improvements to meet HMGs data needs and eliminate duplicative tools or other costs

Solution Management & Analytics
