The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Anchor for our top-rated morning news block. Our next anchor will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

In this role, you’ll anchor 3-hours of morning news from the studio and then transition to anchoring streaming programs from our redesigned newsroom during the remainder of your day. For streaming news shows, you’ll be responsible for operating our Tricaster switcher, while disseminating live and breaking news in a raw, unscripted format with no teleprompter.


Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter. We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Fox News Media is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Design Engineer to develop, maintain, and implement broadcast systems designs across our media facilities. This role will establish engineering standards, produce and review technical documentation, and ensure that system designs are accurately implemented in our in house NDOX documentation tool.


The ideal candidate has strong broadcast engineering experience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to translate operational requirements into clear, scalable, and supportable systems designs.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design broadcast systems for studios, control rooms, production spaces, technical facilities, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Define and maintain systems design standards, engineering guidelines, documentation requirements, drawing conventions, and design workflows.
  • Develop system architectures, signal-flow diagrams, block diagrams, equipment lists, rack elevations, wiring documentation, network requirements, and technical specifications.
  • Implement and maintain systems designs in NDOX, ensuring that design data, equipment information, system relationships, and documentation remain accurate and current.
  • Review engineering drawings, system designs, technical specifications, bills of materials, vendor submittals, and installation documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Perform design reviews and provide technical feedback to engineering teams, vendors, contractors, and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure that approved designs are implemented consistently during installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Design and support baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast systems using current industry practices and technologies.
  • Develop solutions incorporating SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast networking, routing, storage, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with broadcast engineering, operations, IT, networking, facilities, and vendors to validate requirements and ensure system interoperability.
  • Evaluate proposed technologies and equipment for technical suitability, lifecycle support, scalability, reliability, and alignment with engineering standards.
  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation and update NDOX records following system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and commissioning activities.
  • Participate in system testing, troubleshooting, acceptance reviews, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Support continuous improvement of design processes, documentation quality, and system lifecycle management.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience designing, integrating, or supporting complex broadcast, media, audiovisual, or technical infrastructure systems.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast system architecture, signal flow, routing, synchronization, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Experience developing and reviewing detailed engineering documentation and technical drawings.
  • Experience defining or applying engineering standards, design criteria, documentation practices, and quality-control processes.
  • Experience working with systems databases, documentation platforms, or facilities engineering management tools; experience with NDOX is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with IP-based broadcast technologies, including SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast, and networked media systems.
  • Experience designing baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast environments.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control systems, media asset management, storage, automation, monitoring, and cloud-based media workflows.
  • Proficiency with technical design and documentation tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of networking, VLANs, routing, switching, storage, cybersecurity principles, and system interoperability.
  • Experience reviewing vendor designs, submittals, installation drawings, test documentation, and as-built records.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Project coordination experience and PMP certification are preferred but not required.

This dual-focus role leads day-to-day station IT operations and systems administration while serving as the primary backup to the Chief Engineer on core television technologies and broadcast facilities.

The ideal candidate possesses deep, fluent expertise in enterprise IT (networking, virtualization, cybersecurity, directory services, and storage) combined with a solid working knowledge of broadcast television systems (SDI/SMPTE ST 2110 signal flow, production switchers, master control automation, newsroom computer systems, and RF transmission basics). Information Technology & Systems Administration:
● Manage, configure, and maintain all local station IT infrastructure: Windows Server environments, Active Directory/Azure AD, group policies, and enterprise endpoint workstations (Windows/Mac).

● Partner with Regional IT leadership and corporate engineering to plan, deploy, and document technology rollouts and software lifecycle upgrades.

Broadcast Engineering & Operational Backup:
● Act as the designated technical backup to the Chief Engineer, maintaining operational continuity across studio, control room, master control, and transmission facilities during absences or on-call emergencies.
● Support and troubleshoot broadcast production equipment, including production switchers (Grass Valley, Ross), Crispin master control automation, Chyron graphics engines, audio consoles (Wheatstone, Calrec), and multi-viewer/routing infrastructure.
● Understand SDI, HDMI, and IP-based media transport (SMPTE ST 2110, NDI, SRT, Dante/AES67) signal flow, conversion gear, and video monitoring systems.
● Assist in monitoring and basic first-line troubleshooting of transmission systems, microwave studio-to-transmitter links (STL), satellite downlinks, EAS decoders, and transmitter facility infrastructure (HVAC, liquid cooling systems, generators, and UPS units).
● Coordinate with production, news, and operations crews to resolve live on-air technical discrepancies quickly and calmly.
● Maintain accurate, up-to-date station wiring diagrams, network schematics, rack elevations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Leadership & Project Management:
● Lead and execute technology implementation projects from scoping and rack installation to commissioning and user training.
● Manage technical vendor relationships, RMA processes, warranties, and software support agreements.
● Promote a culture of proactive maintenance, cleanliness, security, and continuous improvement across all equipment racks and technical spaces.
● Participate in an engineering on-call rotation to support 24/7/365 news and broadcast operations.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Required Qualifications:
● 5+ years of combined hands-on experience in enterprise Information Technology systems administration and broadcast/media production environments.
● Proven expertise in Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, VMware/virtualized environments, and enterprise backup solutions.
● Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, managed switches, VLAN configurations, subnets, QoS, and network troubleshooting tools (Wireshark, traceroute, etc.).
● Working knowledge of basic television broadcast workflows and equipment (SDI signal paths, video routing switchers, audio distribution, sync/timing, and studio cameras).
● Familiarity with newsroom production systems (e.g., ENPS, iNEWS) and digital media encoding/transcoding formats.
● Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical problems rapidly under live broadcast deadlines.
● Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
● Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
● Availability to work flexible hours, including on-call response for breaking news, severe weather, off-hours maintenance windows, and emergencies.

Preferred Qualifications:
● Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent military/technical training.
● Relevant industry IT certifications (CompTIA Network+/Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Certified, or VMware VCP).
● Broadcast engineering certifications such as SBE Certified Broadcast Technologist (CBT) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT).
● Familiarity with modern broadcast IP technologies (SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6, Dante, Ravenna, NDI).
● Exposure to transmitter site fundamentals, RF systems, ATSC 1.0/3.0 exciters, or backup power generators.

job.title: Associate, Global Event Operations
job.description:
The NFL Global Event Operations team is seeking a highly motivated individual for a fulltime temporary position who has experience in live event operations, venue/stadium management and logistical planning. The role is focused on NFL tentpole events including Super Bowl and International events, while supporting other events as assigned (eg NFL Draft, Hall of Fame, Combine).  Additionally, the candidate is organized and has strong technical skills to create visually appealing, persuasive and effective presentations.   • Identify and drive new opportunities & innovation across NFL portfolio of events to increase revenue and evolve event experience
  • Support internal RFP process year-over-year pertaining to third party vendors at tentpole events

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively interact with people of diverse backgrounds and variety of levels inside and outside of the organization
  • Strong work ethic
  • Ability to work long hours, nights/weekends, as needed
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and administrative skills
  • Service oriented style with professional presentations skills
  • Ability to improve the bottom line
  • Clear concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Effective in providing exceptional customer service
  • Ability to oversee and motivate support staff
  • Must be able to travel domestically and internationally
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • High energy
  • Entrepreneurial spirit

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Creativity
  • Adaptability
  • Self-direction

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in multi-layered, large scale sports and entertainment-related events
  • Vendor/labor/workforce management
  • Knowledge of venue/stadium, media and broadcast operations
  • High-end client servicing experience

job.title: Lead Product Designer
job.description:
Tennis Channel is looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape the future of our digital experiences across streaming (OTT), mobile, and web. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, craft, and execution. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and content teams to design industry-leading streaming applications that make tennis—and everything around it—more accessible to fans.

 

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking products from 0–1, brings strong design thinking to organizations ready for it, and loves solving complex, strategic problems through systems design. As an early hire in a growing product organization, you’ll help raise the bar for design quality, establish expectations of excellence, and influence how design shows up across the company. You’ll also learn how to take ideas from concept to production, help shift an organization toward a true product mindset, and grow through close 1:1 mentorship as part of a small, high-impact team.

 

We’re a team of tennis obsessives who care deeply about the sport and take pride in building great products together. We work hard, play hard, and genuinely enjoy collaborating with people who are curious, thoughtful, and passionate about what they do.

Tennis Channel operates multiple broadcast and digital platforms, including Tennis Channel, T2, Pickleball TV, and Tennis.com. While this role will focus on our dedicated OTT experiences, responsive web, and native mobile apps, you’ll be designing within a broader ecosystem that reaches fans wherever they watch and engage with the sport.

 

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end product experiences across OTT, mobile, and web — from early concepts and AI-assisted prototyping through high-fidelity execution

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, rapidly prototype and explore solutions using AI-powered tools, and ship high-quality work

  • Contribute to and help evolve the Tennis Channel design system, patterns, and accessibility standards

  • Evolve the brand look and feel across the digital ecosystem

  • Present work clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, articulating design rationale and tradeoffs

  • Participate in critiques and feedback loops, both giving and receiving thoughtful, actionable feedback

job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

Start Inside. Grow Into Sales.

Ready to launch a career in sales? At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, you can build the skills, confidence, and media know-how to grow into a client-facing sales role.

You’ll start by learning the business from the inside: supporting our sales team, helping develop media marketing solutions, coordinating campaigns, and seeing how great ideas turn into results for clients. If you’re graduating soon or recently earned your degree and want a real starting point in media sales, this could be your next step. Take a look at the checklist below. If it sounds like you, hit Apply Now and let’s talk about where this opportunity could take you.

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

This means helping them fulfill orders, manage accounts, craft proposals, create engaging presentations, and develop materials that clearly communicate the benefits of our services. Your creativity will play a huge role here in driving results. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

o Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research to understand trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to amplify our sales strategies.

 

o Data Analysis:  Data-driven decisions are the name of the game! Report and analyze sales data, providing insights to optimize our strategies for better results.

 

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!

 

o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams and other departments. Ensuring everyone is on the same page creates a cohesive approach to sales marketing, which is super important for overall success. Connect with internal and external clients, building relationships to understand their needs to provide support. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!

 

o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Analytical thinking is important, as you'll be interpreting data and helping with making informed decisions. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  

 

o A Passion for helping Others: You are committed to collaborate with various people and departments, so being adaptable and open to working with others will help you thrive in this role to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Anchor for our top-rated morning news block. Our next anchor will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

In this role, you’ll anchor 3-hours of morning news from the studio and then transition to anchoring streaming programs from our redesigned newsroom during the remainder of your day. For streaming news shows, you’ll be responsible for operating our Tricaster switcher, while disseminating live and breaking news in a raw, unscripted format with no teleprompter.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter. We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background.

We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

We’re looking for a Design Engineer I who thrives at the intersection of interaction design, front-end engineering, and emerging technologies. You are passionate about collaborating on early-stage ideas and bringing them to life as real, tangible, high-fidelity prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and internal tools that help teams learn faster, make better decisions, and automate manual tasks.

In terms of core skill set, you look like a front-end engineer, but you think like a designer. You bring a strong visual and interaction sensibility, paired with pragmatic engineering judgment. You bias toward speed, clarity, and craft, while maintaining a deep respect for usability, performance, and maintainability. You’re eager to learn from senior teammates, building your ability to work independently, and proactively identifying opportunities where prototyping, tooling, or automation can unlock new possibilities.

You’re also excited about how AI is reshaping design and product workflows. You don’t just use AI tools—you experiment with them, integrate them into prototypes and pipelines, and explore how generative and assistive AI can meaningfully improve user experiences, internal workflows, and design quality.

You’ll be joining a small but mighty Design Engineering team within the Viewing Experience, Product and Design organization at Peacock. Our mission is to bring ideas to life and power innovation. Your primary focus will be helping build high-impact prototypes that explore new features and experiences across the Peacock ecosystem, while also contributing to design tools, Figma plugins, and AI-powered utilities that help our teams work faster, smarter, and with greater confidence.   • Explore and apply AI-driven approaches to design, prototyping, automation, content exploration, and workflow optimization

  • Contribute to shared toolkits, frameworks, and codebases that accelerate prototyping across the team
  • Contribute technical and creative ideas to projects, including experimenting with new frameworks, tools, or approaches with guidance from senior team members
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging interaction patterns, and new technologies, and proactively apply them where they create leverage
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve how the team prototypes, experiments, and collaborates
  • Regularly present and demo work to the immediate team, seeking feedback and flagging issues early as you grow your craft
  • 1+ years of relevant professional experience in design engineering, front-end engineering, or a related hybrid role
  • Degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or equivalent practical experience
  • Portfolio of relevant work and code samples demonstrating strong interaction design sensibility, technical execution, and polished final outcomes
  • Working proficiency in HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript, and React
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Augment, Cursor, etc.) to assist with coding and design-related tasks
  • Working knowledge of design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong eye for visual detail and a foundational understanding of interaction design principles, user experience best practices, and modern design workflows
  • Some experience contributing to software projects in a team environment, including peer code reviews, version control, and shared coding standards
  • Familiarity with building and/or consuming APIs and working with live or structured data
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain ideas to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience presenting and demoing work to peers and cross-functional partners
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, engineers, product managers, and user researchers
  • Ability to complete assignments on time and without handholding, with comfort asking questions and flagging issues early
  • Curiosity and technical fluency around AI models, APIs, and limitations, with an emphasis on practical application over theory

 

Nice-To-Have:

  • Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in design engineering, front-end development, or a related field
  • Exposure to or experience integrating AI capabilities into prototypes, internal tools, or workflows (e.g., content generation, summarization, analysis, automation)
  • Experience developing Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
  • Experience developing Figma plugins and working with the Figma API
  • Familiarity with modern frameworks and languages such as TypeScript, Next.js, or LightningJS
  • Experience with platforms and tools such as Node.js, GraphQL, GitHub, AWS, Azure, GCP, Cloudflare, Firebase, Mixpanel, Contentful, Vercel, Xcode, and Apache, and with web and cloud infrastructure and deployment workflows

  • Define and evolve engineering standards for architecture, API design, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, observability, documentation, and production readiness.
  • Establish and maintain service-level objectives, operational metrics, alerting, incident-response practices, capacity planning, and continuous-improvement mechanisms for production media services.
  • Drive adoption of new codecs, HDR formats, packaging standards, and AI-assisted media processing.
  • Mentor engineers through coaching, career development, hiring, and performance management.

  • Experience leading iterative software delivery, dependency management, roadmap planning, and prioritization across multiple technical workstreams.
  • Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.
  • Strong understanding of video compression, adaptive bitrate streaming, HLS, DASH, CMAF, and DRM.
  • Experience with FFmpeg or equivalent media frameworks.
  • Understanding of video quality analysis (VMAF, SSIM, PSNR and subjective evaluation).
  • Knowledge of video codecs (H.264, HEVC, AV1, VVC), HDR formats (HDR10, Dolby Vision, HLG), audio codecs (AAC, HE-AAC, Dolby Digital Plus), and subtitle/caption technologies (WebVTT, TTML, IMSC1, CEA-608/708).

  • GPU-accelerated media processing.
  • AI/ML or computer vision for media workflows.
  • Encoding optimization and bitrate reduction.
  • Cloud migration and platform modernization.

Location: US - In Office (LA, NY, SF)

 

About This Role

Paramount is looking for a hardworking Lead Software Engineer - Android to develop cohesive solutions to content based technical obstacles. The role will be end-to-end from understanding the goals and roadmaps of the product and engineering teams, through design and architecture of any solution and the delivery and maintenance of those platforms once in place.

 

This role sits at the intersection of deep Android platform engineering and AI-native development: daily use of AI agents and coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) and hands-on collaboration with ML and data science teams on client-facing features.

 

We are seeking someone who will participate in the definition of product requirements, being able to articulate how the engineering effort will align to those requirements and provide accurate estimates of the effort. You will also be involved in platform architectural discussions and initiatives paving the way for optimizations and performance alongside. You will also be working with a team of engineers through the development process, including implementing standards around code, tooling, metrics, progress reporting and interactions with the QE team to ensure a quality first approach to any work.

 

Responsibilities

 

Technical Leadership

  • Drive the architectural direction and design of Android applications
  • Establish best practices for coding, testing, and deployment
  • Evangelize new tools, frameworks, and processes for continued innovation and development efficiency
  • Prepare architectural diagrams and technical specifications for the engineering team to deliver high quality, maintainable software
  • Lead architectural discussions around feature development and software development best practice
  • Involvement in performance and playback optimizations, overall app stability and profiling

 

Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy new solutions as well as maintaining, integrating and improving existing solutions using modern technologies and industry best practices
  • Ensure robust performance, responsiveness, and quality of applications, troubleshooting and debugging as needed

 

AI-Integrated Development

  • Leverage AI-driven coding assistants like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude as a core component of the daily engineering lifecycle, including architectural design, implementation, and refactoring.
  • Partner with technical leadership to establish and optimize safe, high-impact practices for utilizing AI tools within the development team.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to integrate LLM and ML capabilities into product features, such as advanced search, discovery, and personalized content understanding.

 

Mentorship

  • Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers, sharing technical expertise and guiding professional growth
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and consistency across the team

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements
  • Coordinate with backend services and APIs to ensure seamless integration and feature delivery

 

Process Improvement

  • Enhance software development processes and policies, driving continuous improvement in code quality, development speed, and overall team productivity
  • Stay current with emerging Android technologies, libraries, and trends, recommending their adoption where beneficial

 

Ownership and Accountability

  • Partner closely with the Android Engineering Manager on development strategies
  • Ensure the application is highly responsive and performant
  • Safeguard against production incidents
  • Enable engineers to deliver mission-critical features and enhancements
  • Identify technical risks and potential bottlenecks, proposing solutions to mitigate them

 

Expertise in Android Development

  • Proficient in Kotlin and Java, with a solid understanding of the Android SDK and different Android versions
  • Deep knowledge of Architecture Patterns and Material Design (e.g., MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, Compose UI)
  • Experience using Gradle and Android Studio
  • Experience following and implementing software design patterns.

 

System Design & Architecture

  • Proven ability to design scalable, high-performing, and secure Android applications
  • Experience integrating complex RESTful APIs and third-party libraries

 

Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Strong experience in writing unit tests, UI tests, and automated tests using frameworks like JUnit, Espresso, and others
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

 

Performance Optimization

  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, including memory leaks, slow rendering, and network inefficiencies
  • Skilled in using performance profiling and optimizations (e.g., Android Profiler, Leak Canary)

 

Leadership and Communication

  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, stakeholders, and executives
  • Strong mentoring skills, with a track record of developing and inspiring high-performing teams

 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 6 years focused on Android development
  • Demonstrated history of leading and delivering multiple large-scale Android projects in a production environment with multiple scrum teams in an agile process
  • Proven track record of architectural ownership and driving technical decisions
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to facilitate conversations with business partners in project definition, business requirements definition and functional design sessions
  • Eye for quality and user experience
  • Translate business objectives into software requirements

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands on software development on the Android/Android TV/Amazon/Amazon Fire TV platform
  • Have shipped one or more apps to the Google Play and/or Amazon app store
  • Experience working remotely with globally distributed and multiple interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience working on Android projects with multi-module architecture
  • Experience with assistive technologies such as JAWS/VoiceOver, ZoomText, and keyboard-only input methods
  • Experience evaluating front-end code against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
  • Experience developing accessible front-end experiences with techniques such as TalkBack properties used in XML (labelFor, contentDescription), TalkBack announcements, dynamic text scaling, and responsive design

 

AI Literacy

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent, with a clear sense of what these tools are good and bad at.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts, structuring context, and evaluating AI-generated diffs critically before they land in the codebase.
  • Working understanding of LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, and prompt engineering, enough to design client integrations and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes.
  • Practical experience shipping or seriously prototyping at least one ML- or LLM-powered product feature (search, ranking, personalization, content understanding, in-app assistant, etc.).
  • Judgment about responsible AI use: privacy, IP, attribution, and when a human review gate is required.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice To Have)

  • Experience with Video Streaming (HLS / MPEG-DASH)
  • Experience working with ExoPlayer
  • Widevine DRM knowledge

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Experimentation Lead, Sign-Up & Cancellation Optimization
Team: Applied Intelligence
Company: Paramount Streaming (Paramount+, Pluto TV)


About the Role
Paramount Streaming is investing heavily in personalization, experimentation, and applied AI to shape how millions of viewers begin — and continue — their journey with Paramount+ and Pluto TV. We are seeking an Experimentation Lead to own and scale experimentation across the sign-up and cancellation flows. This is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role focused on identifying, prioritizing, launching, and scaling experiments that directly impact conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Reporting to the Principal Machine Learning Engineer for Sign-Up Optimization, you will act as the connective tissue between product, ML, engineering, data science, design, and growth — ensuring we are running the right experiments, running them well, and learning from them rigorously. This role blends product thinking, scientific rigor, experimentation design, and operational management.

 

What You’ll Do
Experimentation Strategy & Roadmapping

  • Define and own the experimentation roadmap across sign-up, onboarding, and cancellation flows for Paramount+ and Pluto TV.
  • Identify high-impact test opportunities across UX, messaging, offers, personalization, pricing, bundling, and model-driven experiences.
  • Translate business goals (conversion, churn reduction, engagement, LTV) into structured, testable hypotheses.
  • Prioritize experiments using data-driven frameworks balancing impact, risk, and resource constraints.

End-to-End Experiment Ownership

  • Drive experiments from ideation → design → instrumentation → launch → feedback → iteration.
  • Partner with ML engineers and applied scientists to test model-driven experiences (ranking, personalization, content ordering, offer targeting).
  • Ensure experiment configurations are correctly implemented and debug issues in targeting, logging, or exposure.
  • Monitor live experiments for integrity, guardrail breaches, or unintended side effects.
  • Lead post-test readouts and translate results into clear, actionable next steps.


Scientific Rigor & Measurement

  • Design robust A/B, multivariate, and sequential testing frameworks.
  • Define primary metrics, guardrails, and success criteria aligned to long-term value, not just short-term conversion.
  • Improve offline-to-online validation practices in partnership with ML teams.
  • Standardize experimentation best practices across the Applied Intelligence group.
  • Champion causal reasoning and statistical discipline in decision-making.

Cross-Functional Management

  • Partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Design, Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination for experimentation across the lifecycle entry/exit flows.
  • Communicate insights clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Create scalable documentation and experiment tracking processes.


Basic Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in experimentation, growth, product analytics, applied ML, or related quantitative roles.
  • Proven track record designing and executing high-impact A/B tests in high-scale consumer digital products.
  • Deep fluency in experimentation methodology: statistical inference, power analysis, guardrails, sequential testing, causal reasoning.
  • Experience working closely with ML-driven systems (recommendation, ranking, personalization) in production environments.
  • Strong analytical toolkit (SQL required; Python/R preferred).
  • Ability to debug experiment integrity issues (logging, targeting, traffic splits, instrumentation gaps).
  • Strong product intuition and ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured testable frameworks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and executive-level communication.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in subscription businesses, streaming media, or lifecycle optimization.
  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms and feature flag systems.
  • Background in growth, pricing optimization, offer testing, or churn reduction strategies.

job.title: Enterprise Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive - Performance Marketing – Outside Sales

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: USA Remote with some travel

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential Visibility, recognition, and growth opportunities within a performance‑driven, enterprise sales environment

Access to the full USA TODAY Network + additional partners—860+ markets, trusted media assets, and subscriber‑based audiences at scale

True ownership of enterprise relationships with the autonomy to build and grow a national book of business

Remote flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory with some travel

Structured onboarding, coaching, and sales support to help you ramp quickly

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career.

Backed by marketing expertise, post‑sale specialists, and industry‑leading tool

About LocaliQ:

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role:

This is an enterprise-level role focused on C-suite conversations rather than local business owners. PIQ is a performance-based marketing program that converts print advertising space into marketing opportunities on a revenue-share, cost-per-acquisition, or cost-per-lead model. The PIQ Account Executive tells an enterprise story about partnership relationships—not transactional relationships—leveraging USA TODAY’s entire asset base to partner with national and regional clients. The role aligns with national sales efforts and one-to-many programs, focusing on enterprise-level relationships that allow the company to leverage its full scale.

In your first 90 days, you’ll ramp into the PIQ enterprise story—gaining a deep understanding of our performance-based model, how we partner with C-suite leaders, and how our national scale creates value for enterprise clients. As you progress, you’ll begin building and advancing a strong enterprise pipeline while establishing core sales rhythms and collaborating closely with internal strategists. By the end of this period, you’ll be confidently owning enterprise opportunities and leading complex, high-impact deals with support from a seasoned cross-functional team.

What You Will Do:

Generate a sales pipeline through self-directed prospecting using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, attendance at vertical-specific expos, referrals from existing clients, and AI tools for finding leads and building outreach strategies.

Qualify and pursue enterprise level opportunities—focus on prospects capable of $150,000+ deals selling to C-suite and marketing directors at regional, state, and national level.

Deliver the PIQ value proposition—one-to-one exclusive leads to subscriber-based audience, with high frequency exposure through trusted USA TODAY content, and scale across 860 markets/publications.

Collaborate with strategists on proposals for deals exceeding $150,000; quarterback internal resources to design, build, and deliver campaigns.

Manage and grow existing accounts; maintain weekly client touchpoints to drive retention and expansion.

Lead cross-functional delivery—delegate effectively, maintain quality control, run pod cadences, and own outcomes while leveraging specialist expertise

Track performance data—monitor campaign metrics, set clear expectations, review performance regularly, address issues early, and resolve problems through appropriate specialists.

Maintain client data in Salesforce—log activities, track pipeline, and forecast accurately.

Qualifications:

5+ years’ proven track record of success in B2B sales, with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles, selling to the C-suite or marketing director level on deals that exceed $150K+

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

Digital acumen—understanding of digital marketing landscape and performance-based marketing models.

Data-minded, able to understand tracking, performance metrics for client campaigns and developing strategies from that data.

Experience working with agencies and understanding agency operations and relationships.

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here:

You’ll thrive here as a self‑motivated, competitive, and consultative seller who owns a book of business, creates opportunities, and confidently leads complex deals. Top performers are data‑driven, resilient, and results‑focused—energized by real‑time performance metrics and rankings, motivated by commission upside, and accountable for outcomes. They consistently outperform peers, earn expanded roles or territories, and effectively quarterback internal teams to deliver measurable client impact.

Benefits:

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Flexibility and Autonomy: remote work environment

Access to industry-leading tools, resources and marketing expertise

Career development opportunities

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and contests

#LI-REMOTE#LOCALiQ

If you’re energized by enterprise level selling, motivated by performance and ownership, and ready to build something meaningful at scale, this role was designed for you. Apply now to bring your expertise, ambition, and curiosity to PIQ—and be part of a high‑impact team shaping the future of performance marketing.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $65,000 and $75,000. $108,333-$125,000 OTE. Uncapped commission with accelerators. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Other duties as assigned

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Wall Street Journal is a global news organization that provides leading news, information, commentary and analysis. The Wall Street Journal engages readers across print, digital, mobile, social, podcast and video. Building on its heritage as the preeminent source of global business and financial news, the Journal includes coverage of U.S. & world news, politics, arts, culture, lifestyle, sports, and health. It holds 38 Pulitzer Prizes for outstanding journalism. The Wall Street Journal is published by Dow Jones, a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

 

The WSJ Opinion section has long served as a forum for intelligent, values-driven commentary, dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy that can be summed up as ‘free markets, free people.’ While we aim to persuade, every word we publish is the product of rigorous reporting, research and debate. WSJ Opinion offers sharp, original analysis and strong points of view on the news of the day. This position supports the Opinion section’s audience data and insights work.

 

About the Role:

The Wall Street Journal’s Opinion section is seeking an Audience Data Analyst based in New York to support our audience reporting and editorial performance tracking.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights, you will be responsible for tracking audience trends, updating reporting dashboards, and translating audience behavior into clear takeaways for editorial leadership. You will assist in compiling recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses covering Opinion, Free Expression, Books and Arts in Review across web, mobile apps, newsletters, video, and podcasts. This is a hybrid role based in New York, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week.


You Will:

  • Extract, validate, and analyze reach, engagement, and subscription data from Snowflake using SQL to support editorial decision-making.
  • Help build, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting views in Tableau.
  • Support the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights in compiling the recurring weekly analytics report and monthly performance summaries, with the expectation of taking ownership of these reporting processes.
  • Monitor audience interaction, visitor loyalty, and how effectively content converts visitors into subscribers across articles, newsletters, video series, and podcasts.
  • Utilize Adobe Analytics, Parse.ly, and native analytics tools from platforms such as YouTube Studio, TikTok Studio, and Meta Business Suite to pull performance data
  • Assist with data quality assurance, reviewing query outputs and validating metrics between reporting dashboards and warehouse data sources.
  • Contribute to code updates and documentation following team version control practices in GitHub.

You Have:

  • 1–4 years of professional experience in data analytics, digital analytics, or business intelligence, preferably in a media, publishing, or subscription environment.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to aggregate, filter, and join multi-table datasets.
  • Experience developing and updating data visualizations and dashboards in Tableau.
  • Knowledge of GitHub for basic version control and documentation.
  • Experience working with audience, subscription, or editorial performance data preferred.
  • Experience using AI-assisted productivity tools such as Claude or Glean preferred.
  • Familiarity with Python or dbt preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a focus on data accuracy and proactive communication regarding task progress.
  • An interest in news and opinion journalism, and an appreciation for the Opinion section's editorial standards and philosophy.

job.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Principal DevOps Engineer is the organization’s senior individual contributor for enterprise DevOps and platform engineering. This role defines and evolves cloud, automation, software delivery, and operational reliability patterns that align Architecture and business strategy. The position leads the design of secure, scalable Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) platforms; establishes reusable infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and governance capabilities; and sets technical standards adopted across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations. Azure DevOps is the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform for application and infrastructure delivery across both cloud environments. The Principal DevOps Engineer serves as a hands-on technical authority, leads complex cross-functional initiatives and proofs of concept, mentors engineers, and uses measurable outcomes to continuously improve developer experience, delivery performance, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions

Own the enterprise technical strategy and reference architecture for DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, software delivery, and engineering automation, translating business and Architecture direction into actionable standards and roadmaps.

Design, implement, and support secure, resilient, scalable cloud infrastructure and shared platform services across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including Kubernetes, containers, networking, identity, compute, storage, data, and other cloud-native capabilities.

Architect and govern infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, versioning, automated validation and testing, remote state management, policy checks, controlled promotion, and lifecycle management.

Define and evolve enterprise CI/CD and software-delivery patterns using Azure DevOps as the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform, including Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, quality gates, artifact management, release controls, progressive delivery, rollback, and traceability across Azure and AWS environments.

Lead GitOps architecture and deployment practices using Azure DevOps, Argo CD, Helm, Kubernetes, and related technologies; establish secure, repeatable patterns for containerized and cloud-native workloads across Azure and AWS.

Create automation and platform capabilities using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and event-driven integrations to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and increase engineering throughput.

Establish Git and repository governance, including branching strategies, pull-request and code-review standards, release practices, dependency management, and software supply-chain controls.

Design and enforce multi-cloud governance and security controls across Azure and AWS, including policy as code, identity and access integration, secrets and certificate management, network and workload security requirements, resource organization and tagging, cost governance, compliance evidence, and automated guardrails.

Define the enterprise observability strategy across Azure and AWS using Datadog and OpenTelemetry as cross-platform capabilities, together with cloud-native telemetry services such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Amazon CloudWatch; establish standards for logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, service-level indicators, actionable alerting, and operational telemetry.

Lead reliability engineering practices across Azure and AWS, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, performance engineering, high availability, disaster recovery, operational readiness, incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-through.

Monitor and analyze key delivery, reliability, security, and platform-adoption metrics; identify systemic constraints and lead improvements that produce measurable business and engineering outcomes.

Chair or provide technical authority for architecture reviews, platform design decisions, change-control standards, and quality and testing requirements for software and infrastructure builds and deployments.

Lead complex technology evaluations and proofs of concept; document findings, risks, total-cost and operational trade-offs, and recommendations for leadership.

Create and maintain reference architectures, implementation guides, reusable templates, technical standards, decision records, training materials, and operational procedures for varied technical and executive audiences.

Provide expert consultation, technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to DevOps, platform, development, and infrastructure engineers without requiring direct people-management responsibility.

Facilitate alignment across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations teams; resolve cross-domain technical issues and influence adoption of enterprise standards.

Participate in development, testing, deployment, implementation, and continuous-improvement activities across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Lead multiple concurrent initiatives of high scope, ambiguity, risk, and organizational impact; communicate status, decisions, dependencies, and risks clearly to leadership and stakeholders.

Ensure completeness, accuracy, accessibility, and currency of required technical documentation.

Support organizational values and cultivate a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, diversity, inclusion, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

Perform other duties as assigned.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Experience

Ten (10) or more years of progressive experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field.

Five (5) or more years designing, implementing, managing, and supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure and cloud-based platforms in Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS), with demonstrated ability to design and operate across multi-cloud environments.

Demonstrated experience functioning as a senior technical lead, principal engineer, architect, or equivalent authority for enterprise-scale DevOps or platform engineering initiatives.

Hands-on experience designing and operating distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, containerized workloads, and production services in a large enterprise environment.

Progressive achievement in job history, including successful delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable technical or operational outcomes.

Required Technical Expertise

Expert-level infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, including reusable module design, testing, state and dependency management, upgrade strategy, drift detection, and governed deployment workflows.

Expert-level design and implementation of CI/CD and release-engineering systems using Azure DevOps, including Azure Repos and Azure Pipelines, for application and infrastructure delivery across Azure and AWS.

Advanced Kubernetes and container-platform expertise, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Helm, GitOps with Argo CD, workload security, cluster operations, upgrades, scaling, networking, storage, and troubleshooting.

Advanced automation and software-development capability using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and Git-based development practices.

Deep understanding of Azure and AWS governance, policy as code, identity and access management, secrets and certificate automation, network security, DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, resource organization, tagging, and cloud cost controls.

Advanced multi-cloud observability and reliability engineering experience using Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Amazon CloudWatch, or comparable tooling, including SLOs, actionable alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.

Expert understanding of SDLC automation, Agile delivery, design and development practices, testing standards, change control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and operational readiness.

Ability to develop reference architectures and technical standards that balance security, reliability, developer experience, cost, maintainability, and speed of delivery.

Leadership and Professional Capabilities

Operates independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and exercises sound judgment when requirements are incomplete or priorities conflict.

Influences technical direction across teams and levels through credibility, facilitation, clear decision frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations.

Communicates complex technical concepts effectively to engineering, security, architecture, operations, business, and executive audiences.

Demonstrates exceptional analytical, systems-thinking, troubleshooting, problem-solving, presentation, and technical-writing skills.

Mentors engineers, promotes knowledge sharing, and raises engineering quality through reviews, standards, pairing, and practical guidance.

Demonstrates strong attention to detail, accountability, collaboration, open communication, and commitment to engineering excellence.

Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, when required to support releases, incidents, or critical initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an internal developer platform, paved-road or golden-path capabilities, self-service infrastructure, or developer portals.

Experience applying FinOps practices, cloud cost allocation, capacity optimization, and unit-cost or consumption metrics to platform decisions.

Experience with enterprise risk, regulatory, audit, or compliance requirements and automated evidence collection.

Relevant professional certification such as Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or comparable credentials.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT AND WORK AIDS

Personal computer and associated software; Microsoft Azure; Amazon Web Services (AWS); Azure DevOps; Azure Repos; Azure Pipelines; Terraform; Kubernetes; AKS; EKS; Argo CD; Helm; PowerShell; Bash; Python; APIs and SDKs; Datadog; Azure Monitor; Application Insights; Amazon CloudWatch; OpenTelemetry; artifact-management, security, collaboration, and documentation platforms; and standard office equipment.

LICENSE(S) / CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED

None required. Relevant advanced Azure, AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code certifications are preferred.

JOB DESCRIPTION NOTICE

This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and perform other job-related duties as requested, subject to all applicable state and federal laws. “Commonly associated” is not intended to mean always or only. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPENSATION

The salary range is $140,000-$160,000 USD per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and skills. This role may also be eligible for incentives, benefits, and other rewards as part of BMI’s total rewards package.

You will join the team that builds the websites and apps for our local news stations in Detroit, Houston, San Antonio, Orlando, Jacksonville and Roanoke. In 2027 our focus is engagement: helping people connect with their local news and with each other and giving them reasons to come back.

You will listen to our audiences through surveys, comments and community spaces, and turn what they tell us into experiences that fit them. You will connect survey answers to real, activated audiences: newsletters, alerts and pages our newsrooms use, and first-party audiences our advertising team offers to local businesses. Then you will help both teams plan how each launch reaches the people it is for.

This is a technical role for someone who wants their work used. You will ship, watch real people use what you built, hear what they think, and make it better. You take pride in using modern tools, including AI coding agents you set up and run yourself, to move fast and build with care.

Responsibilities

  • Own an audience product of your own, live with at least one of our stations within your first 90 days.

  • Turn survey answers into first-party audiences that refresh on their own, with consent recorded, and that our newsroom and advertising teams both put to work.

  • Plan each launch with our editorial and advertising teams: who it serves, how stations use it and how sellers explain it.

  • Grow the number of people who come back: return visitors, email and push subscribers, and contributors.

  • Ship steadily. Take small features from ideas to live in two weeks or less. Set a success metric up front and report the results afterward

  • Actively listen to our users and station partners, translating their real-world feedback into meaningful product changes.

  • Share the AI agent workflows and guidelines that work well, so everyone on the team can use them.

  • Adhere to privacy and security rules with every release; treat both as requirements from the start, not checks at the end.

Requirements

  • Proven track record of shipping production-ready web or mobile app features that real people use.

  • Fluency in TypeScript or JavaScript, React or a similar framework, and Node. Comfort across the stack: interface, APIs, data and deployment.

  • Experience with audience data: SQL, event tracking and survey data, and turning raw responses into segments someone can use.

  • Strong proficiency with modern AI development tools. You have set up and run your own coding agents, and you review and test everything they write.

  • Git, code review, CI/CD, testing and feature flags as everyday habits.

  • A habit of measuring what you ship. You define the metric before you build and read the results honestly, including the misses.

  • Sound privacy judgment and working knowledge of web security: consent, common attacks and how to prevent them, and recently announced exploits and their fixes.

  • An audience-first mindset. You start from the person using the product, seek out feedback after launch and welcome it.

  • A clear bias toward shipping: you would rather release a good v1 and iterate than polish something indefinitely before users ever see it.

  • Ownership. You see a project from idea to production and beyond, and you fix problems before anyone reports them.

  • Clear communication with newsroom, sales and product partners, and a willingness to share what you learn.

  • Experience with survey tools, audience platforms such as Google Ad Manager audiences or Braze, or mobile apps in Flutter or React Native is a plus.

job.title: Analyst - Community Intelligence
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for an Analyst, Community Intelligence to help us build a deeper understanding of the creators and listeners who make SoundCloud what it is.

Sitting at the intersection of Community, Product, Data, Growth, and Music, you will build the intelligence engine that connects what happens on SoundCloud with what is happening across the broader creator, music, and cultural ecosystem. You will combine product behavior, support conversations, surveys, social signals, market trends, and external intelligence to understand who our creators and listeners are, what they need, where they experience friction, and what drives long-term engagement and retention.

A core part of this role will be owning SoundCloud’s creator segmentation and lifecycle framework, creating a durable understanding of how creators evolve across the platform and turning that understanding into strategic recommendations for Product, Growth, Marketing, Music, and senior leadership. You will also partner closely with our Music Intelligence function, applying the same analytical lens to artist discovery, music trends, forecasting, and artist ecosystem research.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve SoundCloud’s creator and listener intelligence framework, combining behavioral, transactional, attitudinal, and qualitative data into a clear understanding of our community.
  • Lead the development of creator segmentation and lifecycle models, identifying meaningful creator groups, needs, behaviors, ambitions, and stages of development.
  • Analyze creator journeys, cohorts, funnels, and retention patterns to understand what drives activation, growth, engagement, monetization, and churn.
  • Build a holistic Voice of the Community program by connecting signals from support interactions, NPS and surveys, social channels, community feedback, and in-product behavior.
  • Identify recurring friction points, unmet needs, and emerging shifts in community behavior, and translate them into strategic recommendations for the Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Music, and Business teams.
  • Bring external intelligence into our understanding of the SoundCloud community by monitoring creator-economy trends, competitor and platform developments, music and cultural signals, and relevant industry benchmarks.
  • Connect external shifts with SoundCloud first-party data to identify emerging risks, opportunities, and changes in creator and listener needs.
  • Partner with Music Intelligence on artist discovery, audience and trend analysis, forecasting, and research into emerging artists, genres, scenes, and communities.
  • Articulate cultural trends through data, leveraging contextual and qualitative data types to turn growth trends into fuel for storytelling about where music is heading.  
  • Support reporting around creator and streaming trend analysis, building self-serve tools to allow Music Intelligence, Community and adjacent teams to tell stories about music movements on the platform.
  • Own reporting around NPS, community sentiment, creator behavior, lifecycle health, and experience drivers, turning complex data into clear narratives for senior stakeholders.
  • Leverage analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to accelerate research and synthesis while applying strong judgment to validate outputs and turn them into reliable insights.
  • Partner closely with Data Science, Analytics, Research, Product, and Community teams to build scalable frameworks and establish Community Intelligence as a trusted source of user and creator knowledge across SoundCloud.

Experience and Background:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer or consumer insights, product analytics, audience intelligence, strategy, research, or a similar analytical role, ideally within consumer technology, media, entertainment, social, creator, or music businesses.
  • Strong experience turning complex datasets into strategic recommendations that influence product, customer, or business decisions.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Experience with segmentation, cohort analysis, lifecycle analysis, funnel analysis, and retention/churn analytics.
  • Comfortable combining quantitative analysis with qualitative inputs such as surveys, support conversations, social listening, community feedback, and market research.
  • Strong understanding of customer or audience research methodologies, including NPS, Voice of Customer, segmentation, and behavioral analysis.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to move from data to insight to a clear recommendation.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with experience presenting complex findings to senior and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Comfortable using AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis while maintaining strong analytical rigor and judgment.
  • A genuine curiosity for creators, music, technology, culture, and online communities.

Nice to Have 

  • Experience in music, entertainment, social media, streaming, or the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with music and audience intelligence tools, social listening platforms, or external market datasets.
  • Experience with Python/R, statistical analysis, forecasting, or network analysis.
  • Experience with artist discovery, cultural trend analysis, or creator growth ecosystems.

The salary range for this role is $115,000 - $122,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with.
