job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Blog

  • November 10, 2026
  • Posted by ssalas

Chief Engineer

Chief Engineer

Department: Engineering
Reports To: General Manager / Corporate Director of Engineering
FLSA Status: Exempt
Location: Boise Market (KQXR-FM, KJOT-FM, KTHI-FM, KRVB-FM)

 

POSITION SUMMARY

Lotus Boise Corp is accepting applications for a Full-Time Chief Engineer. This position is responsible for the technical operation, maintenance, and regulatory compliance of all broadcast transmission and studio facilities for the cluster. Working closely with the local GM and Corporate Director of Engineering, this role ensures uninterrupted broadcast operations, maintains FCC compliance, and oversees building and facility maintenance.

Due to the nature of broadcast operations, the Chief Engineer position is considered an on-call role and must be available to respond to technical issues or facility emergencies that may impact broadcast operations at any time, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Operations

  • Oversee the installation, maintenance, and repair of all broadcast equipment including transmitters, antennas, STL systems, automation systems, and studio equipment.
  • Ensure reliable operation of broadcast facilities to maintain continuous on-air operations.
  • Monitor transmitter performance and conduct routine inspections of transmitter sites.
  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently often whilst under pressure.
  • Self-motivated to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals
  • Maintain broadcast automation systems, audio routing systems, and studio consoles.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues affecting broadcast operations.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with all applicable FCC regulations and licensing requirements.
  • Maintain and update required FCC documentation and station engineering records.
  • Manage EAS (Emergency Alert System) equipment testing and compliance.
  • Coordinate required FCC filings, inspections, and technical reporting.

 

Building and Facility Maintenance

  • Oversee the maintenance and operational readiness of studio facilities, transmitter buildings, and related infrastructure.
  • Coordinate routine maintenance of building systems including electrical, HVAC, grounding systems, generators, and backup power systems.
  • Monitor and address building maintenance needs to ensure a safe and functional work environment for staff and visitors.
  • Coordinate facility repairs and improvements in collaboration with management.
  • Ensure transmitter sites, towers, and studio spaces remain compliant with safety and operational standards.

Vendor Management and Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison with technical vendors, contractors, tower companies, equipment suppliers, and facility maintenance providers.
  • Coordinate vendor scheduling for maintenance, repairs, and equipment installations.
  • Obtain quotes, evaluate service providers, and recommend vendor solutions for engineering and facility needs.
  • Monitor vendor work to ensure quality, compliance with safety standards, and completion of contracted services.

Engineering Leadership

  • Coordinate with General Manager and corporate engineering leadership on capital equipment needs and long-term technical planning.
  • Assist with engineering budgets, equipment procurement, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Provide technical guidance and training to station personnel.

Programming and Promotions Support

  • Support programming operations including studio setup and signal quality management.
  • Provide technical support for remote broadcasts, live events, and promotional activities.
  • Assist in implementation of new broadcast technologies and digital platforms.

On-Call and Emergency Response Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary on-call engineering contact for technical emergencies affecting broadcast operations.
  • Respond to equipment failures, signal disruptions, facility issues, or other operational emergencies in a timely manner.
  • Be available outside of normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, when technical issues require immediate attention.
  • Coordinate emergency repairs with vendors or technical staff as necessary to restore broadcast operations.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5–7 years of broadcast engineering experience.
  • Strong knowledge of FCC broadcast regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with radio transmitters, automation systems, audio consoles, and studio-transmitter links.
  • Working knowledge of IP networking and broadcast automation systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues under time-sensitive conditions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing engineering operations for a multi-station broadcast cluster.
  • Experience overseeing facility maintenance and vendor coordination.

 

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to climb ladders and work at transmitter sites and tower locations.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in indoor studios and outdoor transmitter environments.

 

Work Environment

This position works in broadcast studios, office environments, and transmitter facilities. The role requires travel between studio and transmitter sites and may require work during evenings, weekends, or holidays to support station operations, technical maintenance, or emergency response situations.

 

Disclaimer:

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

ABOUT US:

Lotus Boise Corp. is a subsidiary of Lotus Communications Corp. and is a media, entertainment and digital marketing services company that owns and operates radio properties. Lotus Communications Corp. operates 47 radio stations in the Western United States including stations in Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Sacramento, Boise, Tucson, Fresno and Bakersfield. Este rol es responsable de habilitar un soporte al cliente escalable y de alta calidad en toda América Latina, brindando a los agentes la guía, las herramientas y los procesos que necesitan para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a los clientes.

Serás el socio operativo principal para el equipo de atención al cliente de LATAM, trabajando de forma multifuncional con los equipos de Atención al Cliente, Marketing, Producto y Tecnología para operacionalizar iniciativas, evaluar impactos y mantener comunicaciones de primer nivel con los agentes. Operaciones de Atención al Cliente y Habilitación de Agentes

  • Ser responsable de impulsar comunicaciones claras y consistentes hacia los agentes a través de múltiples productos e iniciativas, asegurando que los equipos de primera línea estén preparados, informados y capacitados para atender las consultas de los clientes.
  • Diseñar, mantener y gobernar el contenido de la intranet, los procedimientos operativos estándar y las herramientas de ventas/soporte que mejoren la preparación, el compromiso y el desempeño de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la calidad, precisión y consistencia de toda la documentación operativa y dirigida a los agentes.
  • Desarrollar y mantener un conocimiento profundo de las operaciones de Atención al Cliente, incluyendo sistemas, flujos de trabajo y particularidades regionales del mercado de LATAM.
  • Crear, actualizar y gestionar documentación operativa dentro de las plataformas de gestión del conocimiento aprobadas.

Liderazgo de Proyectos Operativos

  • Liderar iniciativas y flujos de trabajo operativos que impactan a Atención al Cliente, aplicando las mejores prácticas de gestión de proyectos, actuando como socio operativo integrado más que como una función formal de PMO.
  • Evaluar y comunicar con claridad el impacto operativo y en la experiencia del cliente de nuevas iniciativas, promociones, lanzamientos de herramientas o cambios en los sistemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para definir requisitos, cronogramas, dependencias y factores de riesgo relacionados con las operaciones de Atención al Cliente.
  • Mantener a los stakeholders informados y alineados sobre el avance de los proyectos, especialmente aquellos que afectan a los agentes y clientes de LATAM.
  • Aplicar resolución de problemas estructurada y disciplina operativa para resolver desafíos de forma rápida y sostenible.

Datos, Insights y Reportes

  • Usar datos para identificar tendencias de desempeño, brechas y oportunidades en las operaciones de atención al cliente y la experiencia de los agentes.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Analítica, Herramientas y Tecnología, y Marketing para desarrollar y mantener reportes sobre el desempeño de los agentes y los resultados de la experiencia del cliente.
  • Traducir los insights basados en datos en recomendaciones concretas que equilibren la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio.

Colaboración y Liderazgo

  • Ser el socio principal de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente de LATAM, construyendo relaciones multifuncionales sólidas con stakeholders de toda la organización.
  • Defender la experiencia del agente en primera línea y del cliente, alineándose con las metas y prioridades más amplias de la organización.
  • Fomentar una cultura de claridad, responsabilidad y mejora continua dentro de las operaciones de atención al cliente.
  • Promover el intercambio de conocimiento y el desarrollo del equipo dentro de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente.

SOBRE TI

Eres un(a) profesional experimentado(a) en operaciones de atención al cliente que se desenvuelve con soltura en la intersección entre ejecución y estrategia. Sabes traducir situaciones complejas y ambiguas en acciones operativas claras, y te importa tanto la gente que hace el trabajo como los resultados que genera.

  • Tienes experiencia de liderazgo en entornos de atención al cliente y entiendes lo que se necesita para mantener a los equipos de primera línea capacitados y efectivos.
  • Navegas la ambigüedad con confianza, transformando la complejidad en indicaciones claras y accionables.
  • Equilibras la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio sin perder de vista ninguna de las dos.

  • Te motiva mejorar la forma en que trabajan los equipos, no solo gestionar tareas, sino construir sistemas y hábitos que escalen.

CALIFICACIONES

  • 5-7 años de experiencia en Operaciones de Atención al Cliente, Gestión de Programas o Liderazgo Operativo.
  • Experiencia demostrable trabajando con herramientas y tecnologías de contact center: CRM, plataformas de chat, sistemas de telefonía, bases de conocimiento y herramientas relacionadas.

DESEABLE

job.title: GENERAL MANAGER - WBRC
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WBRC:

Are you a high-trust, high-performance leader who inspires deep loyalty and excellence? We’re looking for a General Manager to lead WBRC, the #1-rated news station in Birmingham, Alabama. This isn’t just about managing a station; it’s about leading a powerhouse duopoly (FOX and Telemundo) in a great city, driving innovation across linear and digital platforms, and fostering a culture where people feel truly valued, challenged, and empowered to innovate. If you’re a culture builder who believes in growing the next generation of talent while honoring the excellence of longtime veterans, we want to talk to you.

Job Summary/Description:

We’re looking for a General Manager to lead WBRC, the #1-rated news station in Birmingham, Alabama. This isn’t just about managing a station; it’s about leading a powerhouse duopoly (FOX and Telemundo) in a great city, driving innovation across linear and digital platforms, and fostering a culture where people feel truly valued, challenged, and empowered to innovate.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Lead with vision: Direct the overall operations of our Birmingham duopoly/triopoly, ensuring WBRC remains the dominant #1 news leader while growing our FOX and Telemundo presence.
* Drive multi-platform growth: Execute aggressive strategies to grow both linear and digital audience and revenue—because in our world, every screen matters.
* Build a culture of learning: Create an environment where our longtime, excellent employees are empowered to mentor and grow the next generation of sales professionals and journalists.
* Empower your team: Foster a high-trust workplace where team members feel valued and safe to take the creative risks necessary to innovate.
* Own the P&L: Manage all financial aspects of the stations, including budgeting, forecasting, and strategic resource allocation to maximize ROI.
* Connect with Birmingham: Serve as a visible leader in the community, building strong relationships with local leaders, advertisers, and organizations to amplify our local impact.
* Collaborate across Gray: Work closely with corporate leadership and peer stations to share best practices and leverage Gray Media’s national scale.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Proven GM experience: Prior experience successfully running a television station is preferred (you know the rhythm of the business).
* Revenue & Audience growth: A documented track record of growing revenue and audience across both linear and digital platforms.
* Inspirational leadership: You are a natural culture builder who leads with empathy, urgency, and a deep commitment to employee development.
* Digital-first mindset: You understand that our future is multi-platform and you know how to lead a team through digital evolution.
* Strategic agility: The ability to pivot quickly in a fast-paced media landscape while keeping the long-term vision in focus.
* Strong communication: You can articulate a vision that gets people excited and aligned, from the newsroom to the sales floor.
* Integrity and trust: You lead by example and build the kind of trust that creates lasting, high-performing teams.
* Lead a #1 powerhouse: You’ll be at the helm of the top-rated station in a vibrant, growing media market.
* Innovation at scale: Gray Media is the nation’s largest owner of top-rated local stations—you’ll have the tools and support to lead the future of media.
* Mentorship & Legacy: You’ll lead a team that values both the wisdom of experience and the energy of new talent, creating a true culture of learning.
* Community impact: Birmingham is a great city with a rich history; you’ll play a key role in how this community stays informed and connected.

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people,  go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

(Current employees who are interested in this position can apply through the Gray-TV UltiPro self-service portal)

WBRC-TV/Gray Media is a drug-free company

Additional Info:

Gray Media provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Gray Media complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: NEWSCAST PRODUCER - WLFI
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WLFI:  

Established in 1953, WLFI (News 18) is the premier television station serving the Lafayette-West Lafayette area - DMA Market 189. As a CBS affiliate, it provides comprehensive local news, weather, and sports coverage across West-Central Indiana. The Lafayette-West Lafayette area is a dynamic blend of small-town charm and high-tech innovation. Lafayette serves as the scenic county seat, featuring a vibrant, walkable downtown filled with quaint local shops & eclectic dining. Across the river, West Lafayette is the proud home of Purdue University, part of the BIG 10 Athletic Conference, and nationally ranked in multiple areas. Purdue is also an international hub for research. Overall, the area offers a rich quality of life with over 50 parks, the Columbian Park Zoo, and the Celery Bog Nature Area. With its proximity to Indianapolis and Chicago, it provides a perfect balance of Midwestern hospitality and global influence.

Job Description/Summary:

WLFI News 18 – the long-time news leader in Greater Lafayette, Indiana - is looking for a Newscast Producer to join our news team. You will be responsible for creating, writing, and producing two of our daily broadcasts. The ideal candidate will be passionate about storytelling, demonstrate a solid grasp of local, regional, national, and international news, and thrive under deadline pressure.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Produce live newscasts daily
• Select stories and determine story order
• Write broadcast and digital scripts
• Communicate with anchors, reporters, and others to ensure execution of a high-quality newscast
• Participate in editorial planning sessions and originate story ideas
• Possess in-depth knowledge of today’s news and current events
• Demonstrate strong online research skills to locate stories and information
• Help create and produce digital and social news content as needed

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Experience preferred, but not required
- College degree in journalism or related field
- Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required
- Strong News judgment
- Strong Writing Skills
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment under the pressure of strict deadlines
- Non-linear editing
- ENPS
- Web Publishing Skills
- Background check required

job.title: Hallmark Territory Supervisor (part-time) Metairie, LA 70003
job.description:
To learn more about this role, watch our Territory Supervisors in action.

Step into a leadership role where you can grow, inspire and Make Your Mark with Hallmark.  

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Weekly Pay consistent income every Friday
  • Paid training and travel reimbursement
  • Insurance Options dental, vision, accident, critical illness, etc.
  • Leadership Experience with a nationally recognized, trusted brand 
  • Training & Support led by seasoned Hallmark Field Supervisors

Pay & Schedule 

  • Starting Pay: $16.50 to $18.50 per hour depending on your skills and experience 
  • Hours: 20-25 hours per week - this is variable schedule.
  • Schedule: Primarily daytime hours Monday - Friday. Holiday availability will include the week before and after major holidays, which may include weekends.

Lead & Inspire Your Team 

  • Supervise, coach, and motivate your team across multiple stores

Guide Floor Sets

  • Manage time effectively across multiple locations

  • Strong communicator and motivator 
  • Organized, dependable, and adaptable

This is an active role that keeps you moving:

  • Work on sales floors and in stockrooms

job.title: News Photographer
job.description:
WKRN-TV in Nashville, Tennessee has an immediate opening for a News Photographer who is a creative shooter and thrives on the daily hustle of breaking news. The Photographer will work collaboratively with reporters to bring news stories to life with creative shooting and editing skills. The Photographer will also be responsible for operating equipment that allows for live shots and coverage of major news events. This is a chance to live and work in great part of the country.

 

The News Photographer operates television or video cameras to record images or scenes for news reports.

•   Shoots video for news reports

•   Confers with other personnel to discuss assignments, logistics and shot requirements

•   Sets up, composes and executes video shots

•   Maintains video equipment

•   Edits video clips for television broadcasts and digital content

•   Capable of editing newscasts

•   Operates live microwave and satellite trucks in remote situations

•   Performs other duties as assigned

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

•  High school diploma

•  Fluency in English

•  Excellent communication skills, both oral and written

•  Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment

•  Proficiency with video recording equipment

•  Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously

•  Flexibility to work any shift

job.title: Multimedia Journalist Reporter
job.description:
ABC4 News (ABC4 Utah/Utah’s CW30) is looking for a dynamic, experienced Multimedia Journalist Reporter. The Multimedia Journalist Reporter produces, reports, shoots, writes, voices, edits and feeds news production content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.  The ideal candidate has excellent news judgement, is calm under pressure and is a multi-tasker.  Must have the desire to win breaking news and own weather coverage across the state.  They must also possess excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Reports news stories for broadcast, describing the background and details of events
  • Arranges interviews with people who can provide information about stories
  • Reviews copy and corrects errors in content, grammar and punctuation, following prescribed editorial style and formatting guidelines
  • Reviews and evaluates notes taken about event aspects to isolate pertinent facts and details
  • Determines a story’s emphasis, length and format, and organizes material accordingly
  • Researches and analyzes background information related to news stories to be able to provide complete and accurate information
  • Gathers information about events through research, interviews, experience or attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social or other functions
  • Pitches stories to news managers and news producers which are relevant to the local community
  • Receives assignments and evaluates leads and tips to develop story ideas
  • Discusses issues with producers and/or news managers to establish priorities or positions
  • Checks reference materials such as books, news files or public records to obtain relevant facts
  • Revises work to meet editorial approval or to fit time requirements
  • Shoots and edits news events and news reports
  • Produces and presents reports for all platforms
  • Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality
  • Writes stories for the web and other eMedia platforms
  • Interacts with viewers/users on social media sites
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

Requirements and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Superior on-air presence
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record
  • Flexibility to work any shift

Physical Demands & Work Environment: 

  • Must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work near others, work outdoors occasionally in all weather conditions, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.
  • In addition, must be able to lift, set up and operate equipment weighing up to 25 pounds, and can handle, control or feel objects, tools or controls. Repetitive movements are required. Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions.

#LI-Onsite

job.title: Broadcast Engineering/IT Intern - Spring, 2027
job.description:
WGNO-TV/WNOL-TV is searching for a top-notch student who is interested in an internship with our IT and engineering departments to help identify solutions for IT/computer related problems and to learn how to maintain the broadcast systems for our duopoly in New Orleans.

 

This is an unpaid/for credit, supervised position for the Spring, 2027 semester only.


We are looking for someone who is studying communications, engineering, IT, or equivalent courses, and has an interest in broadcast engineering and live broadcast technologies, and/or an interest in design, construction, and operation of complex broadcast systems.

 

The successful candidate must have a willingness to learn the inner workings of a local TV station and see how IT and engineering support all of the other departments. The ideal student must be enrolled in a college/university as a junior or senior who is eligible to receive credit for the internship.  Students are expected to complete any forms required by their school and by our company. The intern must be able to work on-site during a weekday schedule agreed upon with the head of our engineering department.

job.title: Content Producer
job.description:
ABC4 Utah is seeking a dynamic and motivated Content Producer to help drive content across television, digital, social media, and streaming platforms. This hybrid role combines the responsibilities of a newscast producer, digital news producer, assignment editor, and streaming content creator, making it ideal for a news-driven storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

 

The Content Producer will oversee daily news gathering, coordinate coverage with reporters and photojournalists, monitor breaking news, and help generate original content for News4Utah+, ABC4’s streaming platform. They will also be trained as a traditional newscast producer to help back up the production of newscasts. They will also contribute to the creation of compelling, audience-focused content for broadcast, digital, and social media. This position is also responsible for developing and producing original video, podcast, and streaming content from concept to completion.

Key Responsibilities


  • Strive to be #1 on ABC4's television newscasts, digital and streaming platforms 24 hours/day
  • Report news quickly and accurately
  • Be able to craft original content that stands out from competition
  • Must be able to independently produce a television newscast to air on ABC4 news following training
  • Program News4Utah+, ABC4's streaming app for Roku, Apple TV, Samsung TV and Fire TV
  • Coordinate daily newsroom coverage and assignments across television, streaming, and digital platforms.
  • Book guests, schedule interviews, and maintain relationships with local sources and public information officers.
  • Ability to host streaming shows on varied topics
  • Write articles, breaking news updates, and digital content that drives audience engagement.
  • Develop, produce, and manage original video series for News4Utah+.
  • Oversee content calendars, production timelines, and distribution strategies.
  • Create and execute social media campaigns to grow audience reach and engagement.
  • Ensure all content meets ABC4’s editorial standards, journalistic ethics, and production quality expectations.

Qualifications


  • Strong news judgment and ability to work under tight deadlines. 
  • Experience with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Audition, or similar platforms. 
  • Knowledge of social media strategy, SEO, audience analytics, and AP Style. 
  • Comfortable conducting interviews and appearing on camera when needed. 
  • Creative thinker with a finger on the pulse of entertainment, internet culture, and streaming trends. 
  • Excellent communication, organization, and multitasking skills. 
  • Enjoys working in teams and is a strong communicator 
  • Ability to adapt quickly to breaking news and changing priorities. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office a must; HTML, CSS and Photoshop experience a plus 
  • Seeks out new technology in a fast-evolving industry 
  • Work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends. 

This position requires creativity, flexibility, and a passion for producing compelling content that informs and engages audiences across all ABC4 platforms. Evening, weekend, and holiday work may be required.

As a Seasonal Product Designer, you will support the design of NFL owned and operated experiences like the NFL App, NFL.com and our Connected TV experience as well as the creation and delivery of digital assets across the NFL’s product portfolio. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Design, Marketing, Creative, and Product Management, as well as senior designers and other team members, to craft thoughtful, high-quality design that enhances the fan experience across all platforms and aligns with brand guidelines and project requirements. You will also help design and deliver marketing, e-commerce and promotional assets for various projects and platforms. Responsibilities often include creating app/web/connected TV UI, graphics, mockups, and prototypes, as well as managing and organizing design files. 

This is a unique opportunity to make a real impact on the look and feel of NFL digital products, from concept to execution, throughout the 2026-27 season.

  • Developing design concepts: Contributing to the ideation and development of design solutions. 
  • Managing digital assets: Organizing and maintaining design files and assets.
  • Meeting deadlines: Managing multiple projects and prioritizing work to meet deadlines. 

 Required Qualifications

  • High Proficiency in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), understanding of photo editing, cutouts and manipulation as well as editing PSD/AI assets that are provided.
  • High Proficiency in Figma: All of our product experiences are designed and managed in Figma and this will be the primary space we will be designing, collaborating, reviewing and delivering work from for not just designers but also our entire Product Team including Product Managers, Engineers, Project Managers and Marketing Team.

job.title: Sr Mgr, Community Connections
job.description:
Are you a natural connector who thrives at the intersection of community and journalism? KSTU is looking for a passionate, strategic leader to serve as the station's primary bridge to the people, organizations, and conversations that shape our community. In this role, you won't just be part of the newsroom — you'll be the heartbeat that keeps it connected to the community it serves. From building trusted relationships with civic and nonprofit leaders to guiding story opportunities and leading impactful public forums, you'll help ensure KSTU remains an essential, credible, and trusted voice in the market. If you believe in the power of local journalism and the importance of showing up for your community, this is your opportunity to make a lasting difference.


*Applications received by November 17, 2026, will be prioritized*.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City is a city that surprises and inspires. Nestled against the dramatic backdrop of the Wasatch Mountains, it offers an unmatched quality of life for outdoor enthusiasts and culture lovers alike. Within an hour's drive you'll find some of the best skiing in the world at world-renowned resorts including Alta, Snowbird, Park City, Brighton, and Solitude — and in warmer months, those same mountains transform into a playground for hiking, mountain biking, and trail running. The nearby Great Salt Lake, Red Butte Garden, and an extensive network of urban trails mean adventure is always close at hand.


Downtown Salt Lake City is a thriving, walkable hub with a booming food and arts scene, eclectic neighborhoods, and a growing reputation as a major tech corridor — often called "Silicon Slopes." The city is home to the NBA's Utah Jazz, Real Salt Lake of Major League Soccer, and the newly arrived Utah Hockey Club, giving sports fans plenty to cheer for year-round. Pioneer Park hosts one of the region's most beloved farmers markets, and the Natural History Museum of Utah and Utah Museum of Fine Arts offer rich cultural experiences for residents of all backgrounds.


Salt Lake City also serves as an ideal home base for exploring some of America's most spectacular landscapes. Zion, Bryce Canyon, Arches, and Canyonlands National Parks are all within a few hours' drive, making weekend adventures legendary. With a relatively affordable cost of living compared to other major western cities, a diverse and welcoming population, and the energy of a city that continues to grow and reinvent itself, Salt Lake City is a remarkable place to build a career and a life.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
KATU News is seeking a creative, forward-thinking Evening Meteorologist to lead weather coverage across our broadcast and digital platforms. We're looking for more than a great forecaster. We want an innovative storyteller and newsroom leader who can help viewers prepare for what's ahead by tracking the "next big weathermaker" and explaining how changing conditions will impact their lives.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong forecasting skills with engaging, conversational storytelling and a willingness to experiment with new ways to reach audiences. This role requires someone who can take ownership of our evening weather coverage, develop original reporting, and help shape the future of local weather.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver accurate, engaging, and conversational weather forecasts during evening newscasts, with an emphasis on tracking the next big weathermaker and its potential impacts.
  • Take a leadership role in shaping the station's weather coverage and identifying opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop original, enterprise weather stories that go beyond the daily forecast to explain trends, impacts, and issues affecting our communities.
  • Create compelling, platform-specific content, including short-form videos, explainers, live streams, and interactive storytelling.
  • Experiment with emerging technology, new storytelling formats, and creative approaches to audience engagement.
  • Provide authoritative, calm, and timely coverage during breaking and severe weather, including live cut-ins and extended coverage.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership, producers, reporters, and digital teams to develop creative and impactful weather coverage.
  • Build strong connections with viewers through authentic storytelling, audience interaction, and community engagement.
  • Help establish KATU as a trusted, innovative source for weather information across the Portland DMA.
  • Represent the station professionally on-air, online, and at community events.

 

Qualifications

  • Degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong forecasting skills and a confident, conversational on-air presentation style.
  • Demonstrated creativity and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to weather storytelling.
  • Experience or strong interest in developing original content for social media, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to inspire new ideas and help bring them to life.
  • Ability to explain complex weather topics in clear, relatable, and audience-focused ways.
  • Comfortable experimenting, taking creative risks, and adapting to changing audience habits.
  • Ability to work effectively under deadline pressure and respond quickly during severe or breaking weather.
  • Commitment to Sinclair's core values and weather philosophy.

 

What We're Looking For

We want a meteorologist who sees opportunity beyond the forecast. Someone who is passionate about helping viewers understand what's coming next, asks "How can we tell this story differently?" and is willing to turn creative ideas into meaningful coverage.

If you're passionate about forecasting, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of local weather coverage, we want to hear from you.

Sinclair Broadcast Group seeks a motivated and experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join the Cloud Engineering Team. The individual will develop, integrate, and support key Enterprise infrastructure solutions.

job.title: Sr. Security Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced, technically driven security professional to advance Sinclair’s Information Security program. You will serve as a Senior Information Security Engineer focused on Security Operations, incident response, and advanced detection engineering. You will independently investigate complex threats, engineer high-fidelity detections across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments, and strengthen incident response through security tooling, workflow orchestration, and automation. You will also help evaluate and apply AI-assisted capabilities where they improve investigation quality and response efficiency. You will partner with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external security providers to improve detection coverage, accelerate response, and reduce enterprise risk.

Responsibilities:

Processes & Execution

  • Lead technical investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for complex security incidents across on-premises, cloud, identity, and endpoint environments.

  • Analyze security telemetry, authentication activity, process execution, network traffic, and threat intelligence to determine root cause, attack scope, impact, and appropriate response.

  • Perform proactive threat hunting and retrospective investigations; identify gaps in telemetry, detections, and response capabilities.

  • Own high-severity incident investigations, document evidence-based findings, communicate business impact, and coordinate timely remediation with system owners and external partners.

  • Apply MITRE ATT&CK and other relevant threat-informed methodologies to improve investigation quality, detection coverage, and response effectiveness.

  • Demonstrate independent technical judgment, clear communication, and accountability for outcomes in time-sensitive situations.

Engineering, Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously tune complex detection mechanisms for multi-stage attacks, identity compromise, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and other advanced adversary behaviors.

  • Correlate endpoint, SIEM, identity, email, network, and cloud telemetry to create behavioral, contextual, and risk-based detections rather than relying solely on static indicators.

  • Develop and maintain detection-as-code content, queries, analytics, and validation tests; assess false positives, data quality, precision, and detection gaps.

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated SecOps and incident response workflows using security platforms, APIs, SOAR technologies, and enterprise ticketing systems to streamline enrichment, investigation, containment, and remediation.

  • Advance security operations automation by integrating AI-assisted analysis and agent-based capabilities, where appropriate, into existing investigation and response processes to improve context, prioritization, and analyst efficiency.

  • Apply established security engineering controls to automated response workflows, including least-privilege access, action validation, approval for high-impact remediation, logging, exception handling, and escalation to analysts.

  • Integrate third-party alert and investigation outputs with internal telemetry to support independent validation, deeper investigation, and consistent remediation.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, IAM, cloud, endpoint, IT operations, and external security partners to validate detections, remediate threats, and operationalize new capabilities.

Performance Improvement

  • Measure and improve detection coverage, fidelity, mean time to detect/respond, investigation quality, automation success, and analyst effort saved.

  • Continuously test detections and response workflows using attack simulations, adversary emulation, incident lessons learned, and controlled validation.

  • Document engineering designs, investigation procedures, response decision criteria, automation safeguards, and operational runbooks.

  • Identify repetitive analyst tasks suitable for automation while preserving human oversight for uncertain, destructive, or business-disruptive actions.

  • Mentor engineers and analysts through technical reviews, investigation feedback, and knowledge sharing; promote sustainable engineering standards.

  • Evaluate new security detection and response technologies, including AI-assisted capabilities, based on practical operational value, reliability, security, and measurable risk reduction.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, security engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of complex investigations.

  • Demonstrated experience building and tuning advanced detections in a SIEM, EDR/XDR, or cloud security analytics platform; ability to explain detection logic and validate underlying evidence.

  • Strong understanding of attacker techniques, Windows and Linux internals, identity-based attacks, network protocols, cloud security, and incident response methodology.

  • Hands-on experience integrating security platforms through APIs, developing orchestration workflows, and implementing automated investigation or response actions using SOAR tools and enterprise IT service management platforms.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted security investigation, agent-based automation, or LLM-enabled security workflows is a plus; specialized AI development or production AI-agent experience is not required.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender security suite (such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, or Defender XDR) and related Microsoft security/identity technologies, including Entra ID.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies such as Zscaler, CrowdStrike Falcon, Abnormal Security, Tines, Armis, and Splunk, or equivalent platforms; strong experience across multiple tools is expected, but experience with every named product is not required.

  • Proven ability to investigate incidents and engineer or tune detections directly in EDR/XDR, SIEM, network security, email security, and identity platforms, including querying telemetry, investigating alerts, and operationalizing response actions.

  • Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST incident response guidance, and security engineering best practices.

  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or equivalent preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and demonstrated ownership of technical initiatives.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Associate Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Job ID 10165027 Location New York, New York, United States Business ABC News Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Associate Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements ABC News Live is seeking expressions of interest from experienced Associate Producers who may be available to support our 24/7 streaming news operation in New York. This is an opportunity to join our as-needed talent pool for future production needs, including breaking news and other coverage requiring additional editorial support. We are interested in journalists who thrive in fast-paced environments, react quickly to breaking news, generate strong story ideas, source compelling video, demonstrate solid news judgment, and work effectively under tight deadlines. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. What You May Do Produce a variety of stories, including writing, editing video, and creating graphics or working with Graphics Team to segment produce. Source video and other editorial elements and help keep coverage fresh as stories develop and editorial needs arise Support production in a high-pressure, fast-paced control room environment. Take initiative while collaborating closely with producers and the broader editorial team. What We’re Looking For At least 3 years of experience producing in a digital, streaming, or broadcast environment. Familiarity with Avid and/or other non-linear editing software, experience with iNews, and camera shooting experience preferred. Ability to take initiative and manage multiple assignments simultaneously. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Prior video production experience, strong editorial judgment, writing skills, organization, and attention to detail. Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, which may include evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage. Education Bachelor’s degree in TV, film, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in New York, NY is $300.00 per day. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call ABC News. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Job Summary: Job Requirements Did you grow up dreaming about weather forecasting, wondering about lake-effect snow, hurricanes, tornadoes and the amazing impact of nature on our environment? ABC News is looking for an extremely motivated Meteorologist Producer to join our best in the business weather team. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. RESPONSIBILITIES Our meteorology producers work with our on-air talent and editorial teams to communicate the day’s weather, climate and science stories. Produce on-air meteorologists Create all WSI/IBM weather graphics for on-air usage and playback Assist producers and writers with correspondent’s weather pieces, headlines and other content. Job Summary: Job Requirements ABC News Live is seeking expressions of interest from dynamic, editorially strong, innovative Producers who may be interested in future opportunities with our 24/7 streaming news operation in New York. We are looking for skilled newsroom journalists with exceptional editorial judgment, strong video editing abilities, and demonstrated control room experience in a fast-paced live news environment. The ideal candidate thrives under deadline pressure, is energized by breaking news, and has a passion for compelling storytelling. Candidates should be comfortable developing segments from concept to air, producing live coverage, collaborating with talent and correspondents, and making sound editorial decisions throughout the day. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. What You May Do Produce live and taped segments for ABC News Live programming. Edit video packages, tape elements, and visual storytelling components using industry-standard editing tools. Write scripts, teases, banners, headlines, and anchor copy while ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, and journalistic integrity. Exercise strong editorial judgment to identify, develop, and prioritize stories across a fast-moving news cycle and track emerging stories throughout the day. Monitor breaking news and rapidly adjust rundowns and coverage plans as events unfold. Produce live interviews and breaking news events from the control room. Partner with directors, technical teams, and production crews to ensure seamless execution of live broadcasts. Source and evaluate video, graphics, and airworthy approved social content to enhance coverage and storytelling. What We’re Looking For Minimum 5 years of experience producing live news in a broadcast, cable, streaming, or digital newsroom environment. Strong control room producing experience and demonstrated ability to lead coverage during breaking news. Advanced video editing skills and experience producing visual storytelling under tight deadlines. Excellent news judgment and a strong understanding of journalistic standards and ethics. Proven ability to generate story ideas and execute coverage from planning through air. Strong television writing, copyediting, and communication skills. Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and prioritize effectively in a high-pressure live-news environment. Experience collaborating with talent, correspondents, and cross-functional newsroom teams. Familiarity with iNews or comparable newsroom systems. Flexibility to work varied hours, including weekends and breaking-news coverage as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience producing live streaming news programming. Experience covering major breaking news and special events. Knowledge of audience trends and digital news consumption habits. Experience working across multiple platforms and formats. Education Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Television Production, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. job.title: Streaming Host/Reporter
job.description:
STREAMING HOST/PRODUCER:

Are you a dynamic journalist who thrives in live coverage? Are you one in your family or friend group who is always explaining this week’s biggest news? Are you ready to be a news influencer?

We’re seeking a talented Streaming Host & Producer to join our team and help us captivate audiences with engaging content. As a Streaming Host & Producer, you’ll be the face of our digital platform, guiding viewers through live news events together and bringing clarity and focus to the most important news in the region.

What you’ll do:

  • Host Streaming News: Host a continuous live stream on a variety of news topics, from breaking news to politics to business and sports.
  • Produce High-Quality Content: Produce your own content, including explainer videos, longform podcast-style interviews, and live reports.
  • Connect with the Audience: Build a strong connection with our audience and your own unique audience through engaging conversations and social media interactions.
  • Stay Ahead of Trends: Stay informed on current events to identify potential content opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Team: Work closely with producers and editors to create high-quality content.



What you’ll need:

  • A strong on-camera presence and excellent communication skills.
  • A strong understanding of social media platforms and digital trends. You will be editing and posting content on TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram both before and after your hosting and producing.
  • A confirmed skill set in streaming video production and editing; you will be operating live streaming technology LIVE as you host. editing and posting content.


If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, shakeup the news and information industry and become a leading voice in streaming media, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Senior Manager, Social Media Strategy & Growth
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Seat Ventures is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Manager, Social Media Strategy & Growth to oversee social media strategy and on-platform growth across its portfolio of clients. You will be responsible for identifying the strengths & weaknesses of each client’s presence across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X, creating audience & revenue growth strategies, and working closely with key staff members and creator teams to ensure the proper execution of action items.  Our ideal candidate is an expert of each platform’s respective best practices, who understands how to reach a client’s ideal subscriber/follower and is adept at directing content strategy that will resonate with existing and new potential audiences. This role requires a highly detail-oriented, data-driven individual who can operate within a quick-paced environment, with a proven track record of experience and success.  

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, implement & oversee social media strategy and on-platform monetization for a portfolio of large (1M+ Follower) pages across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X
  • Activate and optimize on-platform revenue surfaces (Reels Play, in-stream video ads, and other monetizable formats), and incorporate video content produced for TV, podcasting and YouTube into the social strategy to drive new revenue
  • Maintain expert knowledge of each platform’s monetization policies & best practices while building strong relationships with platform representatives at Meta, TikTok and X. 
  • Direct creator and production teams on day-to-day content strategy, posting cadence and platform best practices, while assisting with hands-on page management as needed
  • Set-up, manage, analyze and scale social content campaigns that encourage greater audience participation & growth across owned channels
  • Continuously ideate, implement, and measure results of A/B testing for both creatives and campaign targeting to optimize for engagement, growth and conversions
  • Prepare and deliver regular performance reports across all clients and platforms, conducting deep-dive analysis on what is working, what is underperforming, and where teams should be doubling down
  • Manage the execution of paid social campaigns & promotional campaigns, and support the social sales team on the ad ops execution of branded content integrations 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and on multiple projects & campaigns simultaneously 
  • 5+ years’ experience managing social media strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X for personalities or businesses
  • A verifiable track record of successfully growing social reach & revenue across multiple platforms
  • Expert-level proficiency with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager and platform-native analytics, plus working knowledge of cross-platform analytics tools 
  • The ability to edit video and create graphics for social media platforms is a plus
  • Pre-existing relationships with relevant social network connections (e.g. platform representatives and partner managers at Meta, TikTok and X) is a nice to have
  • Excellent copywriting and proofreading skills 
  • An interest in current events and podcast and digital media content

job.title: Manager Care Ops (LatAm)
job.description:
El puesto de Gerente, Operaciones de Atención al Cliente - LATAM es una posición de liderazgo clave en la intersección entre la ejecución en primera línea y las operaciones estratégicas. Este rol es responsable de habilitar un soporte al cliente escalable y de alta calidad en toda América Latina, brindando a los agentes la guía, las herramientas y los procesos que necesitan para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a los clientes.

Serás el socio operativo principal para el equipo de atención al cliente de LATAM, trabajando de forma multifuncional con los equipos de Atención al Cliente, Marketing, Producto y Tecnología para operacionalizar iniciativas, evaluar impactos y mantener comunicaciones de primer nivel con los agentes. Se requiere dominio del español para asegurar una colaboración genuina con los equipos y stakeholders regionales.

Operaciones de Atención al Cliente y Habilitación de Agentes

  • Ser responsable de impulsar comunicaciones claras y consistentes hacia los agentes a través de múltiples productos e iniciativas, asegurando que los equipos de primera línea estén preparados, informados y capacitados para atender las consultas de los clientes.
  • Diseñar, mantener y gobernar el contenido de la intranet, los procedimientos operativos estándar y las herramientas de ventas/soporte que mejoren la preparación, el compromiso y el desempeño de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la calidad, precisión y consistencia de toda la documentación operativa y dirigida a los agentes.
  • Desarrollar y mantener un conocimiento profundo de las operaciones de Atención al Cliente, incluyendo sistemas, flujos de trabajo y particularidades regionales del mercado de LATAM.
  • Crear, actualizar y gestionar documentación operativa dentro de las plataformas de gestión del conocimiento aprobadas.

Liderazgo de Proyectos Operativos

  • Liderar iniciativas y flujos de trabajo operativos que impactan a Atención al Cliente, aplicando las mejores prácticas de gestión de proyectos, actuando como socio operativo integrado más que como una función formal de PMO.
  • Evaluar y comunicar con claridad el impacto operativo y en la experiencia del cliente de nuevas iniciativas, promociones, lanzamientos de herramientas o cambios en los sistemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para definir requisitos, cronogramas, dependencias y factores de riesgo relacionados con las operaciones de Atención al Cliente.
  • Mantener a los stakeholders informados y alineados sobre el avance de los proyectos, especialmente aquellos que afectan a los agentes y clientes de LATAM.
  • Aplicar resolución de problemas estructurada y disciplina operativa para resolver desafíos de forma rápida y sostenible.

Datos, Insights y Reportes

  • Usar datos para identificar tendencias de desempeño, brechas y oportunidades en las operaciones de atención al cliente y la experiencia de los agentes.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Analítica, Herramientas y Tecnología, y Marketing para desarrollar y mantener reportes sobre el desempeño de los agentes y los resultados de la experiencia del cliente.
  • Traducir los insights basados en datos en recomendaciones concretas que equilibren la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio.

Colaboración y Liderazgo

  • Ser el socio principal de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente de LATAM, construyendo relaciones multifuncionales sólidas con stakeholders de toda la organización.
  • Defender la experiencia del agente en primera línea y del cliente, alineándose con las metas y prioridades más amplias de la organización.
  • Fomentar una cultura de claridad, responsabilidad y mejora continua dentro de las operaciones de atención al cliente.
  • Promover el intercambio de conocimiento y el desarrollo del equipo dentro de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente.

Eres un(a) profesional experimentado(a) en operaciones de atención al cliente que se desenvuelve con soltura en la intersección entre ejecución y estrategia. Sabes traducir situaciones complejas y ambiguas en acciones operativas claras, y te importa tanto la gente que hace el trabajo como los resultados que genera.

  • Tienes experiencia de liderazgo en entornos de atención al cliente y entiendes lo que se necesita para mantener a los equipos de primera línea capacitados y efectivos.
  • Navegas la ambigüedad con confianza, transformando la complejidad en indicaciones claras y accionables.
  • Equilibras la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio sin perder de vista ninguna de las dos.
  • Eres una persona muy organizada, detallista y proactiva, que anticipa necesidades antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
  • Comunicas con claridad y confianza tanto a audiencias técnicas como no técnicas, desde agentes hasta ejecutivos.
  • Te motiva mejorar la forma en que trabajan los equipos, no solo gestionar tareas, sino construir sistemas y hábitos que escalen.
  • 5-7 años de experiencia en Operaciones de Atención al Cliente, Gestión de Programas o Liderazgo Operativo.
  • Experiencia demostrable trabajando con herramientas y tecnologías de contact center: CRM, plataformas de chat, sistemas de telefonía, bases de conocimiento y herramientas relacionadas.
  • Capacidad demostrada para liderar iniciativas operativas multifuncionales desde la definición del alcance hasta la ejecución.
  • Sólidas habilidades de documentación, comunicación y organización; estableces el estándar de claridad.
  • Tomador(a) de decisiones basado(a) en datos, con capacidad para convertir insights en acción.
  • Se requiere dominio del español (escrito y verbal).
  • Licenciatura o experiencia profesional equivalente.
  • Experiencia previa apoyando operaciones de atención al cliente en LATAM.
  • Familiaridad con Salesforce o plataformas CRM comparables.
  • Experiencia en comunicaciones con agentes, gestión del cambio o disciplinas de gestión del conocimiento.
  • Se valora el manejo de herramientas creativas o de producción (por ejemplo, Adobe Creative Suite).
  • Se requiere horario flexible
  • Es posible que se requieran viajes ocasionales

job.title: Vice President, Legal, FOX News Media
job.description:
FOX News Media is seeking a lawyer to support its efforts to develop emerging businesses.  Reporting to the Executive Vice President & General Counsel for FOX News Media, this VP role will draft, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of digital agreements encompassing commerce, sponsored content, syndication, podcasts, and other strategic initiatives.  This role is based in New York City and has a five-day, in-office requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

  • Draft, review, and negotiate agreements for FOX News Media involving licensing, syndication, commerce, sponsored content, digital partnerships, and audio and podcasting, among other initiatives
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on deal structure, legal risk, and strategy for commerce and other strategic initiatives
  • Set legal negotiating strategy and positions for complex, high-value partnerships
  • Prepare and negotiate proof of concept, partnership, master services, SaaS, and other long-form agreements, along with related statements of work
  • Collaborate with legal and business stakeholders across Fox Corporation (e.g., IP, privacy, compliance) to close deals efficiently
  • Develop and maintain templates, playbooks, and negotiating positions for recurring deal types
  • Review and advise on wide variety of vendor agreements, often on a quick timeline
  • Manage multiple matters independently on tight timelines with accuracy

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and admission to the bar in good standing (New York preferred)
  • Minimum 10 years of experience at a law firm or as an in-house lawyer with a media, technology, or digital focus
  • Extensive experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements
  • Experience with agreements related to digital content licensing, syndication, artificial intelligence, audio/podcasting, commerce, affiliate marketing, and digital advertising
  • Strong negotiating, drafting, and communication skills
  • Sound independent judgment and ability to advise senior business stakeholders with confidence
  • Collaborative team player with strong organizational skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Pragmatic, business-minded approach to legal issues
  • Previous experience working in the media industry or with media clients strongly preferred

job.title: Part Time Security Officer
job.description:
The Fox Studio Lot is looking for Part-Time Security Officers. The Fox Security Officer’s top priority is to provide a safe and secure work environment for our employees, guests, clients, and vendors.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Observe and report activities or incidents at an assigned site, providing for the security and safety of studio property and personnel
  • Patrol assigned site on foot, bicycle or golf cart; check for unsafe conditions, hazards, unlocked doors, security violations, blocked entrances and exits, mechanical problems, and unauthorized persons
  • Control access to studio site or facility through the admittance process. This includes checking permissions of persons entering the lot and refusing to admit those without appropriate documentation
  • Respond to incidents of fire, medical emergency, flooding, water discharge, elevator emergency, hazardous materials, inclement weather, and other incidents
  • The position may require standing for long periods of time (i.e., hours at a time, potentially).  Security officers may be assigned to any shift; business operates 24/7 every day of the year.  May be assigned outdoors during all weather conditions
  • Work Schedule:  Various regular shifts available, though must be able to work holidays, weekends, and overtime on short or even no notice


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Excellent customer service
  • English language skills (verbal and written) must be at a level to communicate and give directions effectively during emergencies
  • Ability to lift, push, and/or pull heavy objects (e.g., stage doors) that can weigh more than 50 pounds
  • Current CA Guard Card
  • Current CA driver's license
  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Basic computer skills

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • 1+ year of security or public safety experience
