job.title: Sr Designer, Design & Development (Seasonal)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

About UDX FRANCHISE, PRODUCTS & PARTNERSHIPS:

Universal Destination & Experiences’ Franchise, Products & Partnerships team (UDX FPP) extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.  www.udxfpp.com

 

 

We are seeking a highly creative and trend-driven Senior Designer to lead the product development of innovative product collections across Seasonal Merchandise, In theater, and Lifestyle categories. Creative Leadership | 30%

  • Partner closely with the VP, Franchise Creative – Multimedia to deliver the creative vision and quality standards for video storytelling, presentations, and live-event content.
  • Translate business and marketing objectives into clear, persuasive narratives, and engaging visual stories.
  • Lead development of creative for executive presentations, partnership opportunities and trade shows and other high-visibility initiatives.
  • Provide hands-on creative direction across concepting, storyboarding, creative reviews and final execution for high-profile projects.
  • Collaboratively shape overall team culture as a thought leader and creative champion by modeling  inclusive, accountable people leadership that promotes collaboration, recognizes contributions, and empowers creative talent to succeed.
  • Establish project-level creative review criteria and provide timely, actionable feedback to uphold creative excellence and brand/IP integrity

Multimedia Leadership | 50%

  • Lead multimedia content for executive meetings, sales summits, leadership events, roadshows, and partner experiences
  • Partner with senior leaders to structure narratives, clarify messaging, and elevate delivery

Leads the creative team to drive compelling storytelling and ensure production quality standards are maintained

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud
  • Experience creating onscreen content and experiences for live-events and meetings
  • Working knowledge of presentation production AV best practices
  • Familiarity with emerging creative technologies and responsible AI-enabled production tools

Bachelor's degree in design, film, production, communications, advertising, multimedia, or a related field required

  • Digital Platforms: Marketing promotion plans and alerts for top stories. You will be writing different variations of headlines for stories to optimize click-through rate and engagement.
  • Digital Culture & Trends: Writing and reporting stories on pop culture, entertainment, internet trends and lifestyle news. You’ll work alongside reporters and editors to pitch and write stories for NBCNews.com, contribute to breaking news coverage and help cover major pop culture events.
  • Digital Health & Medical: Reporting and writing timely, in-depth original features on a wide range of health topics for the website. The intern will be interviewing experts about medical studies, pitching story ideas, and identifying trends in lifestyle and wellness, including nutrition and women’s and men’s health.
  • Today.com: Assisting editors across TODAY.com’s news/trending and lifestyle teams, and writing for sections including Pop Culture, Health, Food, Parents, Style and TMRW.

Social

  • Social Newsgathering: Using digital platforms to find user-generated content, verify social media-sourced content, interview sources and obtain information for the network's coverage. You will be covering a range of stories from breaking news to investigations and feature topics.
  • NBC News Social, TODAY Social: Helping drive social media production and publication to multiple social media accounts. You will be writing headlines, editing video and graphics, and distributing content across social media platforms.

The WNBC/WNJU New York Duopoly is seeking a dynamic, Reporter to join our integrated newsroom. This role is designed to serve audiences across both WNBC and WNJU, delivering original journalism in English and Spanish across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

The ideal candidate is an enterprising, multiplatform journalist with strong live reporting skills, excellent news judgment, and the ability to tell compelling stories for both English- and Spanish-language audiences. This reporter will play an important role in our duopoly approach to news coverage, working seamlessly across both stations to maximize original reporting, share content effectively, and serve the diverse communities of the New York Tri-State area.

The reporter must be equally comfortable covering breaking news, developing enterprise and community-driven stories, conducting live interviews, producing content for multiple platforms, and adapting storytelling for the audiences of WNBC and WNJU.

  • Report, write, and deliver original stories for both WNBC and WNJU across newscasts, streaming platforms, websites, social media, and emerging platforms.

  • Cover breaking news and major events from the field through live shots, interviews, digital updates, and packaged reports.

  • Demonstrate flexibility in reporting assignments and work across both stations based on daily editorial priorities and breaking news needs.
  • Contribute to special projects, major event coverage, investigative or enterprise initiatives, and other duopoly-wide editorial efforts.
  • Represent WNBC and WNJU at community events and public appearances as assigned.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of local, national, and international news developments.
  • Uphold NBCUniversal journalistic standards, ethics, and editorial guidelines.
  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcasting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of reporting experience in a television news environment.
  • Full proficiency in English and Spanish, including speaking, writing, translating, interviewing, and live reporting.
  • Strong live reporting, interviewing, writing, and storytelling skills.
  • Experience covering breaking news and developing stories under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment.
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to make sound decisions in fast-moving news situations.
  • Ability to work independently in the field and collaborate effectively within a team environment.
  • Experience creating content for broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media platforms.
  • Valid driver's license with a good driving record.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during major news events.
  • Must be willing to work throughout the New York metropolitan area and surrounding coverage regions.

  • Proven ability to generate original enterprise reporting and develop trusted sources.
  • Experience working across English- and Spanish-language news operations or in a bilingual/multicultural newsroom.
  • Strong understanding of how storytelling and editorial priorities may differ across audiences, platforms, and brands.
  • Strong social media and audience-engagement skills.
  • Ability to ad-lib confidently, accurately, and calmly during breaking news situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple platforms and brands.
  • Collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working within an integrated duopoly newsroom.
  • Passion for local journalism, community connection, and public-service reporting.
  • Experience with investigative, consumer, political, or community-focused reporting is a plus.

job.description:

Overview and Responsibilities

As a Manager of Risk & Data Analytics, you deliver data-driven insights, lead risk-based audits, and support investigations, risk assessments, and special projects across Paramount. You work with leaders across corporate, media, streaming, and production to evaluate processes, governance, and controls using useful judgment and analytics. The role requires comfort with complex data, deep risk assessment skills, and the ability to operate in fast-moving, judgment-heavy environments. Engagements include operational reviews, T&E and production audits, and advisory projects in partnership with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  • Plan and lead risk‑based analytics to support operational audits, advisory work, and special projects across corporate, media, streaming, advertising, and production areas
  • Develop focused project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments aligned to key business priorities
  • Design flexible approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring solid professional judgment
  • Use analytics to evaluate processes, controls, and governance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and growth
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis to address underlying issues
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth or transformational initiatives
  • Apply advanced analytics to audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks across areas such as production, T&E, payroll, vendor payments, and revenue
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics and communicate insights through clear visuals and presentations
  • Lead or support special projects through data collection, validation, analysis, and documentation of findings
  • Synthesize insights from multiple systems and data sources and present conclusions through dashboards and presentations
  • Build robust relationships with business leaders and cross‑functional partners, including SOX, Compliance, Finance, and Legal
  • Communicate results and recommendations clearly, explaining root cause, risk, and business impact in an accessible language
  • Create recommendations that fit the business needs. When needed, promote remediation plans while keeping a focus on solutions
  • Serve as a trusted advisor while maintaining sovereignty and objectivity
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to internal standards
  • Advance the team’s shift toward insight‑driven, judgment‑based auditing
  • Contribute to annual risk assessments and audit planning using data and industry insights
  • Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, analytics capabilities, and investigative approaches
  • Partner with the Audit executive team on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends to enhance the function’s capabilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related discipline

  • Experience leading or executing analytics-driven reviews, including areas such as T&E, production, vendor payments, or revenue-related processes

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.
●    Experience owning a growth funnel end to end, including shipping changes to a live product.
●    Hands-on experience running paid user acquisition (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, or similar).
●    Fluency with app metrics: installs, CAC and LTV, activation, adoption, retention, and cohort analysis.
●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
●    Experience embedded on a product and engineering team in an Agile environment.
●    Background in sports, streaming, media, or consumer subscription apps.
●    Familiarity with ASO and app store editorial and featuring processes.
●    Experience with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), attribution (Kochava, AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust), and lifecycle tools (Braze, Iterable, Airship, SalesForce Marketing Cloud).
●    A real interest in sports and how the sports calendar shapes fan behavior.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own the technical direction of the Paramount+ Roku application — the platform, the patterns, the architecture. This is a hands-on leadership role where you write and review code and set the standard for a team of engineers shipping features to millions of viewers.

Roku's constraints — tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, hardware spanning five years of device generations — are the environment you thrive in, not just tolerate. You know these constraints well enough to teach them, and you'll lead a team through them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Set technical direction for the Paramount+ Roku application — choose the patterns, own the architecture, defend the decisions

• Ship real-time personalization features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, and ad engagement experiences — within Roku's memory and threading constraints
• Drive adoption of RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing across the team
• Scope projects, identify risks before they become blockers, and keep the team shipping
• Coordinate with Product, Design, Backend Engineering, and DevOps/SRE to translate requirements into plans your team can execute
• Write architecture docs, RFCs, and component guides so decisions are visible and durable

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on the results

job.title: Breaking News Reporter
job.description:
The Cincinnati Enquirer/cincinnati.com part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking a digital-first reporter to be part of the Breaking News team.

Job Details:

This reporter will be at the center of the region's biggest stories, from breaking crime and public safety news to severe weather. The reporter understands that breaking news is often the front door to deeper accountability and enterprise reporting.  A great breaking news reporter cuts through official-speak and lets the community know what’s happening clearly and concisely. We’re looking for a reporter who goes beyond standard press releases, digging into how and why things happen. Reporters on this team also pursue explainers, features and other enterprise stories that reflect life in Greater Cincinnati.  The position requires urgency, curiosity, accuracy and a willingness to chase news wherever it leads. It also demands strong news judgment and the ability to find and identify stories with impact and reflect the community through the inclusion of a variety of voices.

About The Enquirer:

The Enquirer, founded in 1851, serves communities in southwest Ohio and Northern Kentucky. With major league sports (go Bengals!), a blossoming food and craft beer scene, hundreds of parks, world-class performing arts and eight Fortune 500 companies, Cincinnati offers the amenities of a big city with the comfort and charm of a small town.

Responsibilities:

Monitor real-time news and sniff out stories that are important to our audiences.

Report quickly, clearly and accurately and deliver news via stories, video, newsletters, Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok or any other methods available to reach our audience and develop new audiences.

Use metrics to inform story choices and shape beat strategies.

Work a schedule that may include nights, weekends and whenever news demands.

Work with editors to experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and through alternate story forms. This includes long-tail (evergreen) content.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

2 + years of reporting experience, applicants with less experience and strong clips may be considered.

Proven ability to write on deadline.

Exceptional core journalism skills (reporter, producing, editing). Strong command of AP grammar and style.

Familiarity with public records and their use in reporting.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

Photo and video skills.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Knows how to use time effectively in a 24-hour news environment.

Works collaboratively within a cross-functional environment.

Must embrace peer-to-peer feedback and training.

Applies innovative, creative thinking to support the company's goals.

Industry knowledge.

Organizational skills.

Command of media law and Principles of Ethical Conduct.

This position sometimes requires employees to work extended hours, evening, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly.

This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer pre-employment background check, motor vehicle record check.

job.description:
USA TODAY Co. is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms. This full-time role will use strong editorial judgment and AI-assisted production workflows to turn local reporting, photos, data and graphics into timely, accurate and engaging short-form video.

The producer will work directly with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories that can reach broader audiences through video. Coverage will span the range of local journalism, including breaking news, public safety, weather, government, education, business, consumer issues, community stories, major local events and other topics important to individual markets. This is a hands-on production and service role focused on helping local newsrooms publish more video efficiently across owned and social platforms.

What you’ll do:

Serve as a dedicated video production resource for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms, supporting market needs and network-wide local coverage priorities.

Use AI-assisted platforms, including Stringr, along with templates, automation and editing tools to produce a high volume of accurate, on-brand video from local reporting, photos, data, graphics, user-generated content and newsroom briefs.

Use Stringr AI UGC production capabilities to help local newsrooms identify and develop relevant user-generated content into publishable video while following verification, sourcing, rights and editorial standards.

Use Stringr Clip Gen to create timely clips and short-form video from press conferences, public meetings, interviews, podcasts and other longer recordings.

Use Stringr Show Stacker and other AI-assisted long-form production tools to assemble structured video from local programs, interviews, recurring shows and extended newsroom content.

Partner with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories with strong visual, audience and distribution potential.

Respond quickly to local breaking news and major developing stories while also supporting planned enterprise, service and community coverage.

Repurpose AI-assisted and automated content for owned-and-operated and social platforms, tailoring each version to the audience, market and platform.

Optimize video length, aspect ratio, captions, headlines, thumbnails, metadata and calls to action using platform best practices and performance insights.

Program videos on corresponding local articles and support distribution workflows that increase the reach and value of local journalism.

Manage and prioritize requests from multiple newsrooms, communicate progress and blockers, and balance planned work with urgent coverage needs.

Maintain editorial, legal, brand and visual standards, including accuracy, sourcing, attribution, captions, fonts, colors and overall presentation.

Track core performance metrics, identify successful local formats and topics, and share repeatable lessons with newsroom and video partners.

Test emerging AI and automation capabilities responsibly, helping improve templates, workflows and production standards for local newsroom use.

Review videos produced by others for quality and accuracy and provide feedback

Local newsrooms receive reliable, timely video support across a broad range of coverage needs.

More high-priority local stories include relevant video on owned and social platforms.

Story-to-video turnaround improves, particularly during breaking news and other time-sensitive coverage.

Produced videos meet high standards for accuracy, clarity, audience value and brand consistency.

Local newsroom partners have clear visibility into priorities, progress and production capacity.

Strong formats and workflows are identified, documented and applied across additional USA TODAY Network markets.

AI-assisted tools and automation improve production efficiency while preserving editorial judgment and quality.

Who you are:

A digital-first journalist or producer who understands the role video can play in extending the reach and impact of local journalism.

A strong editor with sound news judgment, a sharp eye for visuals and the ability to identify the clearest audience takeaway from a story.

Comfortable producing quick-turn, high-volume video without sacrificing accuracy, quality or brand standards.

Able to move between breaking news, service journalism, enterprise reporting and community stories based on newsroom needs.

Highly organized and able to manage requests from multiple markets, changing priorities and deadline pressure in a remote environment.

A clear, responsive and collaborative partner who can work effectively with local reporters, editors, newsroom leaders and centralized video teams.

Curious and adaptable, with a practical interest in AI, automation and new approaches to newsroom production.

Committed to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, transparency and responsible use of emerging technology.

2-5 years Professional experience in digital journalism, video production, social video or a related field.

Demonstrated video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, mobile editing applications or comparable tools.

Experience creating and publishing video for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.

About the role

The Revenue Operations Manager owns everything that happens after a deal closes. You make sure campaigns launch on time, run as planned, and are set up to renew, and you make sure what each campaign teaches us shapes the next one. Sales owns the commercial relationship; you own delivery quality, O&O ad operations, buying, measurement, workflow, vendors and team capacity.

Launch Point runs two sides of one revenue cycle. Presale support (Digital Strategist and Sales Enablement) helps Sales win the work. Post-sale delivery, which you lead, gets it done. Closed deals move between the two through a single documented handoff, and you are the person who accepts it.

What you will own

  • Team leadership. Lead the Campaign Coordinators and Media Operations Lead, with the two Ad Order Entry Specialists reporting through the Media Operations Lead. Set workload, priorities and standards.
  • Handoff and kickoff. Accept closed-won handoffs, run internal kickoffs, and return incomplete submissions to Sales.
  • Delivery workflow. Maintain delivery workflows, QA checklists and turnaround standards across digital, O&O and print.
  • O&O ad operations. Own creative execution and standards for all O&O placements, including premium executions like Home Page Takeovers, and oversee seller submissions and changes. Work with product and technology teams to improve ad position performance, CTR and site speed.
  • Vendors and partners. Manage managed-service vendors and partners, including terms and escalations.
  • Media buying. Oversee buying across Google Ads, Meta, DV360, Basis and other DSPs, including programmatic and CTV. Set buying standards, review plans and optimizations, and step in hands-on on complex or high-value campaigns.
  • Conversion tracking and attribution. Own conversion tracking setup and attribution across campaigns using Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, connecting all media platforms (Meta, Basis, Reddit, Google Ads and others) and client CRM data so performance ties back to client goals and ROI.
  • CRM integration and automation. Connect HubSpot with ad platforms, call tracking and client CRMs, and automate handoffs, status updates and reporting to reduce manual work.
  • Book health. Monitor pacing, delivery issues, margin and client retention risk across all accounts.
  • Reporting and insights. Work with Sales Enablement to keep post-sale data in HubSpot and client reporting dashboards accurate. Pair results with insights, open questions and recommended next steps, so each report gives Sales a reason to revisit client priorities and uncover new needs.
  • Campaign learnings. Capture what worked across audiences, creative and channels, and make sure those learnings carry into the next campaign.
  • Visibility. Report delivery health, staffing capacity and issues to the Director, and escalate systemic risks early.

What you will partner on

  • Sales. Clean handoffs in, renewal and upsell conversations out. Sales owns the client relationship and commercial decisions; you bring the performance insights and recommendations that support those conversations.
  • Digital Strategist. Making sure what was sold is what gets delivered, and turning campaign learnings into specific recommendations for the next plan and for broader client growth.
  • Audience-based sponsorships. Help Sales and the Digital Strategist spot high-impact sponsorships that pair O&O assets with the full digital media platform, such as sports, holiday initiatives, music events and other major community moments.
  • Product and technology. Ad position performance, page and ad load issues, and site changes that improve O&O delivery.
  • Sales Enablement. HubSpot fields, the handoff checklist, and reporting templates.
  • Agency. Coordination on accounts over $5,000 per month and other complex opportunities.

What you bring

  • 8 or more years in agency operations, ad operations, account services or campaign delivery at an agency, media company or publisher.
  • Two or more years leading people, including setting priorities and coaching.
  • Hands-on buying experience in Google Ads, Meta and at least one DSP (Basis, DV360 or similar), plus working knowledge of O&O, programmatic, CTV, search and social delivery and managed-service relationships.
  • O&O ad operations experience: creative specs, premium and takeover placements, ad server trafficking (GAM preferred), and working with product or development teams on ad load and site performance issues.
  • Experience setting up conversion tracking and reporting on attribution with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and CRM data, and explaining performance and ROI to clients.
  • Experience integrating a CRM with ad platforms and other tools, and automating workflows and reporting.
  • Process discipline: you build checklists and standards that hold up under volume.
  • Comfort with pacing, budget and margin math, and with CRM reporting.
  • Clear communication with sellers, clients, vendors and leadership, including turning performance data into practical recommendations.

Bonus points: HubSpot administration or integration experience; Google Ads, Google Analytics or Basis certifications; experience with sponsorships or event-driven media packages; print production exposure; experience building an operations function rather than inheriting one.

Why Work at the Tampa Bay Times

  • Be part of an organization committed to public service and journalistic excellence.
  • Support a diverse workforce that includes newsroom, production and corporate teams.
  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.
  • Health coverage for you and your family through medical, dental and vision plans.
  • 100% employer-paid short-term and long-term disability and basic life insurance.
  • Supplemental life insurance and flexible spending account options.
  • Tax-deferred savings plan for retirement.
  • A generous PTO program and much more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Tampa Bay Times is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

job.title: Director, Business Intelligence
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director of Business Intelligence

CD Baby | A Virgin Music Group Company

Full-Time | Los Angeles, CA / Nashville, TN / New York, NY | Remote Considered

The Opportunity

As Director of Business Intelligence, you will define and own the strategy and roadmap for making data accessible, trusted, and actionable across CD Baby. You’ll establish the metrics that matter most, drive data normalization across teams, and build the infrastructure that enables self-service insights at scale.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and stakeholders across the company to prioritize the highest-impact KPIs, ensure consistent definitions across the organization, and embed data into how decisions get made.

This role is both strategic and hands-on: you’ll architect the BI function while also building dashboards, leading analyses, and translating complex data into clear business recommendations.

What You'll Do

Define the BI Strategy & Roadmap

• Establish a company-wide BI vision and multi-quarter roadmap.

• Standardize core metrics and KPIs across business, product and technology teams.

• Prioritize the highest-impact insights that drive growth, retention, and artist success.

• Build scalable and self-service reporting that reduces ad hoc dependency.

• Evaluate and deploy AI-enabled analytics tools that scale insight generation and reduce dependency on manual reporting

Drive Customer & Product Insights

• Lead segmentation, cohort analysis, lifetime value modeling, and churn analysis.

• Identify growth opportunities, at-risk artists, and high-value segments.

• Define and measure success metrics for new product and feature launches.

• Support experimentation and A/B testing with rigorous statistical analysis.

• Analyze streaming consumption, revenue, and audience trends across digital platforms to identify opportunities for artist growth, monetization, and business performance.

Build Data Analytics Models

• Partner with Data Engineering to continuously improve data quality, modeling, and governance.

• Own the business-facing analytics layer, building scalable data models, reporting infrastructure, and self-service tools that enable trusted, actionable insights across the organization.

• Translate complex datasets into clear, executive-ready narratives.

What You Bring

• 7 or more years of experience in data analytics, customer insights, business intelligence, or a related field.

• Advanced SQL; experience with modern BI tools and cloud warehouses, such as Snowflake,

BigQuery, dbt, Cube.

• Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in enterprise BI tools.

• Strong foundation in customer and commercial analytics, including segmentation, lifetime value,

retention, churn, experimentation, and revenue performance.

• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and communicate clearly at all levels.

About CD Baby

CD Baby is a music industry pioneer, empowering independent artists to distribute, monetize, and grow

their music careers globally. As a Virgin Music Group company, we combine the entrepreneurial spirit of

an indie platform with the resources and reach of a major music group. Our technology and data teams sit

at the heart of how we serve millions of artists worldwide.

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

job.title: Account Manager, Strategic Partnerships
job.description:
AccuWeather’s mission is to save lives, protect property, and help people and companies make the best weather-impacted decisions. We are seeking an enthusiastic, curious, and growth-oriented Account Manager to advance that mission through our technology and media partnerships.

You will manage a portfolio of technology and media partners and work with some of the world’s leading companies. Your work will help partners strengthen their products, serve their audiences, and achieve their business goals—bringing trusted weather intelligence to the platforms people use every day.

As part of the Strategic Account Management team, you will gain exposure to AccuWeather’s top strategic accounts and complex commercial deals, learning how major partnerships are developed, negotiated, and expanded. You will build skills in commercial judgment, data analysis, storytelling, negotiation, and strategic relationship management.

You will understand your partners’ businesses, dig into performance data, and identify how AccuWeather’s Proven Superior Accuracy™, proprietary products, and ongoing innovation can help them achieve more.

Success requires a commitment to partner service and a drive to grow revenue. Business development will focus on expanding existing relationships across technology and media, primarily in the business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) space. External prospecting is outside this role’s scope.

You will be part of a collaborative team, sharing insights, contributing ideas, and working toward shared goals. You will receive direct training, coaching, and mentorship while taking increasing ownership of your accounts. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through independently, welcomes feedback, and helps improve both our partnerships and how we work together.

What you will do

  • Own partner relationships. Manage a portfolio of technology and media accounts, developing a strong understanding of each partner’s goals, products, audiences, and priorities. Build trust through thoughtful engagement, responsive service, and reliable follow-through.
  • Know the data. Analyze revenue, API usage, audience engagement, referral traffic, and other relevant metrics. Investigate changes, recognize opportunities, and turn findings into recommendations that improve performance and support partner goals.
  • Lead business reviews. Prepare and conduct regular partner meetings and quarterly business reviews that demonstrate value, assess performance, and look ahead. Work with partners to identify priorities, explore opportunities, and agree on actions and next steps.
  • Tell the AccuWeather story. Learn how AccuWeather’s forecast accuracy, scientific expertise, and proprietary offerings—including AccuWeather MinuteCast® and RealFeel®—help partners deliver differentiated experiences and enable users to make more confident decisions.
  • Bring fresh opportunities to partners. Gather relevant product updates, innovations, success stories, awards, and achievements from across AccuWeather. Connect them to each partner’s needs to strengthen their offerings and expand the value of the relationship.
  • Grow existing accounts. Identify where additional AccuWeather capabilities can advance partner goals through expanded usage, new products, new applications, and broader partnerships. Develop account plans, advance commercial opportunities, and achieve revenue growth targets.
  • Collaborate and advocate for partners. Bring partner needs, feedback, and ideas into AccuWeather. Work with product, technical account management, forecasting, marketing, finance, legal, and other teams to resolve issues, develop solutions, and advance shared opportunities.
  • Present with clarity and impact. Develop and deliver presentations for partners and internal audiences. Use compelling narratives, clear visuals, and well-presented data to communicate results, explain opportunities, and support decisions.
  • Use AI to increase effectiveness. Apply AI tools to research, analysis, presentation development, and routine workflows to improve efficiency and the quality of your work. Explore emerging capabilities and use judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information.
  • Maintain account discipline. Keep account plans, CRM records, revenue forecasts, commitments, and follow-up actions accurate and current. Track contractual obligations, renewals, and emerging risks.

What you bring

  • Energy and enthusiasm: You take an active interest in your work, engage thoughtfully with people, and bring momentum to opportunities and challenges.
  • Curiosity and a learning mindset: You ask good questions, seek context, and enjoy building expertise in unfamiliar subjects.
  • Coachability: You listen to feedback, put it into practice, and take responsibility for improving your work.
  • A commitment to partner service: You listen carefully, seek to understand what success means for your partners, and care about helping them achieve it.
  • Commercial motivation: You want to achieve measurable revenue growth by connecting partner needs with valuable business opportunities.
  • An interest in data: You like working with numbers, investigating what drives performance, and explaining what the findings mean.
  • Communication and visual storytelling: You enjoy—or are motivated to develop your ability in—presenting to others and translating complex information into clear conversations, written updates, and visually effective presentations.
  • Self-awareness and ownership: You understand that your actions, communication, and follow-through affect partners and teammates. You take responsibility for your work, acknowledge mistakes, seek help when needed, and act on what you learn.
  • Initiative and independent judgment: You organize your work, solve problems, and move priorities forward while recognizing when to seek guidance.
  • Teamwork and collaboration: You enjoy working within a team, share knowledge and ideas, and support your colleagues. You contribute to shared goals and look for ways to improve how the team works together.
  • AI curiosity and adaptability: You follow emerging AI tools and trends and actively look for ways to use them to improve productivity, strengthen your work, and increase your impact.

Relevant experience and skills

  • Experience in account management, customer success, partnerships, business development, or a related client-facing setting. Relevant experience may come from employment, internships, or substantial academic, volunteer, or leadership responsibilities.
  • Strong organization and the ability to manage multiple relationships, priorities, and commitments.
  • Comfort using spreadsheets to analyze data and presentation tools to communicate findings.
  • Practical familiarity with generative AI tools and a willingness to build proficiency in applying them to business tasks.
  • Experience with technology, digital media, APIs, data licensing, or B2B2C partnerships is helpful.
  • An interest in weather and its impact on people and businesses, along with a desire to learn and communicate AccuWeather’s brand and story.

We welcome early-career candidates and those with transferable experience who can demonstrate the curiosity, analytical ability, initiative, and sense of responsibility this role requires.

What success looks like

Your partners view you as a trusted, proactive resource who understands their business and helps them achieve meaningful results. You have a strong command of account performance, deliver engaging and useful business reviews, and turn insights into action. You achieve revenue growth goals by expanding the value partners receive from AccuWeather.

As you build your expertise, you demonstrate increasing independence, sound judgment, and confidence. You apply feedback, contribute to your teammates’ success, and grow into a capable commercial professional who makes a measurable impact.

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

AccuWeather is seeking an accomplished, strategic and results-driven Advertising Sales Director in Los Angeles to help build and sell digital advertising solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced sales leader with a proven track record to navigate complex digital media and data targeting solutions, work cross-functionally to develop innovative advertising solutions and build lasting client relationships. You’ll contribute to a high-caliber team in a business that is experiencing rapid and dramatic growth. job.title: Associate Context Planner
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. job.title: Manager, Solution Consulting
job.description:
Job Description

The Risk Solution Consulting Manager leads a high-performing, experienced US-focused team responsible for translating customer risk, fraud, identity, compliance, investigation, and integration requirements into compelling solutions involving the Thomson Reuters CLEAR public records data and analytics product. The role owns the Solution Consulting strategy for the Corporates Risk business, partners with Sales and cross-functional leaders to improve revenue outcomes, and develops a high-performing team of CLEAR Product Specialists and Integration Specialists.

This manager balances people leadership, opportunity strategy, technical and product credibility, go-to-market execution, operational discipline, and customer experience. The position ensures that Solution Consulting is engaged early, focused on the highest-value opportunities, and able to support both direct-to-customer and partner-enabled solutions involving the CLEAR product.


Key Responsibilities

1. Lead and Develop the Risk Solution Consulting Team

  • Build, lead, and retain a high-performing, inclusive team spanning both pre-sale CLEAR Product Specialist (Corporate customer remit) and pre/post-sale Integration Specialist (Corporate and Government customer remit) roles.
  • Set clear goals and expectations; maintain a consistent coaching cadence through one-on-ones, call reviews, in-the-moment feedback, and documented development plans.
  • Onboard and support cross-training of new team members across CLEAR products, customer use cases, discovery, demonstration, integration, presentation, and value-articulation skills.
  • Differentiate coaching and success measures for product-focused and integration-focused roles while increasing bench strength and reducing single points of failure.
  • Lead the team’s professional development through stretch assignments, mentoring opportunities, etc.
  • Represents Risk Solution Consulting in leadership forums and serves as a visible advocate for the team, customers, and business.

2. Drive Sales Strategy and Revenue Outcomes

  • Partner with Risk Sales and Sales Management on new and existing customer opportunities, including qualification, discovery strategy, solution alignment, competitive positioning, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and executive presentations.
  • Prioritize Solution Consulting capacity toward the opportunities with the greatest customer value, revenue potential, strategic importance, and probability of progression.
  • Improve opportunity quality and predictable outcomes by promoting early SC engagement, clear next steps, accurate technical scoping, and disciplined opportunity documentation in Salesforce.
  • Support pipeline creation as well as pipeline conversion through customer education, webinars, industry events, partner activities, thought leadership, and targeted account programs.
  • Provide leadership presence on complex, high-value, and multi-stakeholder solution opportunities.

3. Own Team Readiness for CLEAR Product Positioning and Customer Value

  • Ensure the team can position the CLEAR portfolio against customer workflows including investigations, identity verification, fraud prevention, risk assessment, enhanced due diligence, know your customer (KYC), and adverse media/sanctions monitoring.
  • Maintain strong demonstration readiness across the CLEAR product portfolio, including AI-enabled features.
  • Ensure integrated solution conversations appropriately cover CLEAR API/Batch services, customer technical environments, implementation dependencies, security considerations, and onboarding/compliance requirements.
  • Translate complex product, data, analytics, and integration capabilities into clear business outcomes for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Promote trusted advisor behaviors by grounding recommendations in customer needs, workflows, data requirements, and business objectives, using a solution selling methodology.

4. Support Integrated Solutions via Strategic Partnerships

  • Partner with Corporate & Government Partnerships & Alliances, Product & Innovation, Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and external technology partners to shape repeatable Risk solutions.
  • Guide Solution Consulting support from early solution design through go-to-market preparation, field enablement, customer opportunity support, technical onboarding, and post-launch refinement/support.
  • Establish clear ownership and operating rhythms for partner opportunities, including qualification, discovery, demonstrations, technical alignment, deal progression, and implementation handoffs.
  • Help scale CLEAR product usage through pre-integrated partner solutions and customer-specific workflow integrations.

5. Strengthen Customer Experience and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as a senior escalation and coordination point for complex customer, product, solution, and integration issues that affect strategic opportunities or relationships.
  • Represent customer and field feedback to Product and Product Management to improve roadmap decisions, product readiness, documentation, and overall customer experience.
  • Model ownership and proactive problem solving while maintaining clear role boundaries and sustainable team capacity.

6. Run the Business with Data and Operational Discipline

  • Establish and maintain operating metrics that show Solution Consulting activity, capacity, opportunity engagement, win rate, revenue influence, deal progression, discovery compliance, and customer or partner outcomes.
  • Use Salesforce, Gong, Workday, dashboards, and other approved tools to guide prioritization, coaching, forecasting, and continuous improvement.
  • Create regular leadership views that identify trends, capacity risks, skill gaps, process issues, and actions needed.
  • Work with Solution Consulting leadership to standardize core Solution Consulting practices while allowing appropriate flexibility for distinct product, integration, customer, and partner motions.
  • Use and promote AI and automation responsibly to improve team productivity, knowledge access, call coaching, content preparation, and scalable enablement, with measurable outcomes.

Key Deliverables and Measures of Success
  • Achievement of Risk business financial targets in partnership with Sales leadership, with clear evidence of Solution Consulting influence.
  • Improved win rate, deal progression, late-stage conversion, and time-to-close on SC-supported opportunities.
  • A healthy, engaged, and continuously developing Product Specialist and Integration Specialist team with documented coaching and succession coverage.
  • Consistent, high-quality customer discovery, demonstrations, technical consultations, and integrated solution designs.
  • Effective support for launch and execution of strategic CLEAR solution partnerships and repeatable integrated solutions.
  • Actionable operational and value metrics used regularly to make prioritization, staffing, coaching, and go-to-market decisions.

Required Qualifications
  • Substantial experience in solution consulting, pre-sales, technical consulting, product consulting, or a related customer-facing role in risk, fraud, identity, compliance, investigations, data, or enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including goal setting, mentoring, and leading through change.
  • Strong knowledge of CLEAR or comparable public-records, risk, identity, fraud, due-diligence, compliance, investigation, or data-integration solutions.
  • Experience leading complex sales cycles involving business, technical, legal, security, procurement, implementation, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to guide both functional product demonstrations and technical discussions involving API and batch services.
  • Proven collaboration across Sales, Product, Partnerships, Marketing, Customer Success, and senior leadership groups.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands, make evidence-based decisions, remove barriers, and maintain customer focus in a rapidly-changing environment.
  • Willingness to travel for strategic customer meetings, internal leadership sessions, partner activities, and industry events as business needs require.

job.title: Consultor Sênior Tax One
job.description:
Descrição da Vaga (Job Description)


Você busca desenvolver sua carreira como Consultor Sênior Tax One em uma empresa global de tecnologia e informação? Junte-se à Thomson Reuters!


Na Thomson Reuters, combinamos inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam profissionais e empresas a tomar decisões com mais segurança e alcançar melhores resultados. Atuamos nos mercados Tributário, Contábil, Jurídico, Comércio Exterior e Tecnologia, apoiando milhares de clientes no Brasil e no mundo.



Principais Responsabilidades (Key Responsibilities)


  • Atuar como referência técnica e funcional da solução Tax One para clientes Prime, garantindo excelência no atendimento e na condução das demandas;
  • Realizar análise, investigação e resolução de chamados complexos relacionados aos processos fiscais e tributários da solução;
  • Atuar como ponto de escalação para consultores juniores e plenos, apoiando tecnicamente o time na resolução de casos críticos;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs e acompanhar indicadores operacionais, propondo ações para melhoria contínua;
  • Coordenar acompanhamentos assistidos em períodos críticos, como fechamentos fiscais e entregas de obrigações acessórias;
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes para entendimento de necessidades, alinhamento de expectativas e acompanhamento de planos de ação;
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato em situações críticas, assegurando comunicação clara, gestão de riscos e direcionamento adequado das tratativas;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de Produto, Tecnologia, Conteúdo e Desenvolvimento para investigação e resolução de problemas sistêmicos;
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária, incluindo os impactos da Reforma Tributária, avaliando reflexos para clientes e para a solução;
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica, artigos de conhecimento e materiais de apoio para clientes e equipes internas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Qualificações Obrigatórias (Required Qualifications)


  • Experiência em suporte, sustentação, atendimento consultivo ou implantação de soluções Tax One;
  • Vivência com integrações entre sistemas, como Oracle ERP SAP, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos.


Qualificações Desejáveis (Preferred Qualifications)


  • Conhecimento sobre os impactos da Reforma Tributária e sua aplicação em processos fiscais corporativos.
  • Conhecimento em análise de banco de dados e SQL para investigação de incidentes.
  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de serviços, como ITIL.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com times globais.


#LI-RB1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

job.title: Executive Producer, Sub-Saharan Africa
job.description:
Job Description


Executive Producer, Sub-Saharan Africa


The Executive Producer, Sub-Saharan Africa role is focused on story assets and requires a creative, versatile and collaborative editorial leader to help manage the delivery of breaking news once teams are deployed in the field. This role is central to Reuters' One Newsroom initiative, which ensures that content across formats is delivered with speed, coherence and impact.


The successful candidate will be the final editorial checkpoint before content reaches clients or the publishing desk. They will coordinate live shots, spot news edits, and stringing for trunk stories, setting clear ETAs and ensuring that coverage meets Reuters’ editorial standards and client expectations. They will work closely with other Editors focused on assignments and planning, as well as cross-format teams, to maintain editorial priorities and maximise the value of field reporting.

This role demands a proven track record in multimedia storytelling and strong editorial leadership in fast-moving news environments.



Key Responsibilities


  • Manage the delivery of breaking news content once teams are in the field.
  • Coordinate live shots, spot edits, and trunk story development across formats.
  • Set ETAs for content and ensure timely publication to clients and platforms.
  • Act as the final editorial link before content is published or distributed.
  • Collaborate with Hub and Planning Editors to align coverage with editorial priorities.
  • Maintain high editorial standards across text, video and pictures.
  • Support cross-format integration and newsroom transformation efforts.
  • Lead the editorial response as major stories develop, making fast decisions on priorities, resources and coverage.
  • Bring text, video and photography together to create a stronger, more complete Reuters story.
