job.title: Company Secretary
job.description:
Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, fully qualified Company Secretary to join our Finance and Tax team and support Brunswick’s international operations.

This is a senior role at the heart of Brunswick’s governance framework, providing trusted advice to the Board of Directors and senior leadership. The Company Secretary will lead our corporate governance and regulatory compliance activities, ensuring Brunswick maintains high standards of governance and meets its obligations under the UK Corporate Governance Code and Companies Act 2006.

Reporting to the Group Head of Tax and Partnership Affairs, the role will work closely with the Group Financial Controller and other senior colleagues across the firm, providing thoughtful, pragmatic guidance on governance and corporate matters.

We are open to considering part-time or flexible working arrangements for the right candidate.

About the Role

Your key responsibilities will include:

Board and governance

  • Support the effective operation of the Board, including preparing agendas and papers, drafting minutes, tracking actions and ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Act as a key point of contact for executive and non-executive directors on governance matters.
  • Manage the forward calendar and terms of reference for the Board and its committees.
  • Ensure the Board operates in accordance with the Articles of Association, shareholder arrangements, the Companies Act 2006 and other relevant governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep the Board and senior colleagues informed of relevant developments in corporate governance and regulation.

Committee support

  • Provide company secretarial support to the Audit & Risk Committee.
  • Attend committee meetings and prepare accurate and timely minutes.
  • Track actions and support appropriate follow-up.

Shareholder matters

  • Maintain the shareholder register and oversee quarterly updates presented to the Board.
  • Prepare and coordinate communications and documentation for shareholders.
  • Work with the Head of International Tax to support partners on shareholder and share-related matters.

Annual General Meeting

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of the Annual General Meeting.
  • Prepare notices and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate communications with shareholders.
  • Manage meeting arrangements and prepare minutes.

Share buy-backs

  • Coordinate the documentation and approvals associated with share buy-backs.
  • Manage relevant filing and record-keeping requirements.

Corporate documentation and records

  • Draft resolutions, letters and other corporate documentation for entities and transactions across the Group.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date statutory books and corporate records for the Group’s subsidiaries using Diligent.
  • Maintain authorised signatory records.
  • Own and maintain the Group structure chart.

Statutory filings and compliance

  • Manage the Group’s Companies House filings, including confirmation statements and other statutory returns.
  • Ensure filings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain oversight of filing deadlines and other company secretarial obligations across the Group.

Corporate transactions

  • Lead the company secretarial and governance aspects of corporate and commercial transactions.
  • Support matters including entity closures, share conversions and Group restructurings.
  • Work closely with Legal, Finance, Tax and other colleagues to ensure transactions are appropriately documented and implemented.

Advice and stakeholder support

  • Provide thoughtful and pragmatic corporate governance advice to directors, Finance, Legal and other senior stakeholders across the firm.
  • Support in-house Legal colleagues on company secretarial and governance matters.
  • Work with and provide guidance to Executive Assistants on Board governance and administration.

KYC

  • Coordinate KYC requests relating to directors and senior management.
  • Ensure relevant information is accurate, current and provided efficiently.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who brings:

  • Significant corporate secretarial experience, typically gained over 6–8 years, with experience working in a UK-listed, highly regulated or complex international environment.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK Corporate Governance Code, Listing Rules and Companies Act 2006, combined with the judgement to apply this expertise thoughtfully and pragmatically.
  • Excellent written and analytical skills, with the ability to listen carefully, identify what matters and capture complex Board and executive discussions in clear, accurate and considered minutes.
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence and judgement to build trusted relationships across executive and non-executive leadership while maintaining discretion and impartiality.
  • Fellowship or Associate status with the Chartered Governance Institute (CGI, formerly ICSA) is required.
  • A legal degree or professional qualification as a solicitor would be an advantage.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: Global PMO Lead - People Technology 12M FTC
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is delivering a significant People Technology transformation, modernising the platforms, processes and data that underpin how we manage and support our people globally.

We’re looking for an experienced PMO Lead to sit at the centre of this transformation, bringing the structure, discipline and visibility needed to successfully deliver a complex, global programme. This is more than a reporting PMO role. You’ll create the governance, integrated planning and delivery controls that enable leaders to make informed decisions and teams to deliver effectively. You’ll connect multiple workstreams, make risks and dependencies visible, ensure actions translate into delivery, and provide a clear view of whether the programme is achieving its objectives and intended benefits.

Working across the intersection of People, Technology, HR processes, data and organisational change, you’ll partner closely with programme leadership, Workstream Leads and cross-functional teams to turn strategy into an executable plan and create the rhythm and discipline needed to deliver transformation at scale.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own and maintain the integrated programme plan, ensuring milestones, dependencies, deliverables and critical paths are clearly understood and actively managed.
  • Establish and maintain effective programme governance, providing appropriate control over scope, cost, timelines, risks and delivery.
  • Lead programme reporting, providing clear and insightful updates on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions and areas requiring intervention.
  • Own the programme RAID process, proactively identifying risks and issues and ensuring clear mitigation, escalation and resolution plans are in place.
  • Coordinate dependencies across workstreams, ensuring actions have clear owners, deadlines and accountability through to closure.
  • Support and facilitate programme governance forums, ensuring decisions are captured and translated into clear actions and outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain the frameworks, processes, templates and programme documentation required to drive consistency and effective ways of working.
  • Ensure programme benefits are clearly defined, baselined and tracked, with appropriate business ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop meaningful metrics and reporting to monitor programme performance and benefits realisation.
  • Partner with Workstream Leads and delivery teams to identify roadblocks, resolve delivery challenges and maintain momentum.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to project and workstream teams, championing strong programme management disciplines and collaborative ways of working.
  • Work across the wider organisation to identify interdependencies with other transformation initiatives and ensure these are reflected in programme planning.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve operational effectiveness and strengthen programme delivery.
  • Champion effective ways of working across globally dispersed and cross-functional teams.
  • Act as Project Manager for selected strategic initiatives or workstreams where additional delivery leadership is required

What you'll need:

  • Significant experience working as a PMO Lead, Senior PMO, Programme Manager or in a similar role within a large-scale transformation environment.
  • Strong programme management capability, with hands-on experience of integrated planning, governance, RAID management, dependency management and executive-level reporting.
  • Experience supporting complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, geographies and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience delivering People Technology, HR transformation or enterprise technology programmes would be highly valuable.
  • Experience working with HRIS/HCM platforms, with an understanding of the processes, data, integrations and business change surrounding enterprise HR technology, is strongly preferred.
  • Workday experience would be advantageous but is not essential. We’re equally interested in candidates with experience of other major enterprise HRIS/HCM platforms who can demonstrate strong technology-enabled transformation experience.
  • Strong understanding of Agile and traditional programme delivery approaches, with the ability to apply an appropriate level of governance depending on the programme environment.
  • Experience developing programme governance, reporting frameworks, delivery standards and ways of working.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex programme information into clear insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Experience establishing and tracking programme benefits, KPIs and delivery metrics.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bring diverse teams together around shared priorities.
  • A practical, action-oriented approach, with strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain control across multiple moving parts.
  • Confidence operating in ambiguity, quickly identifying problems and creating the structure needed to move towards resolution.
  • Experience working with globally dispersed teams through significant organisational or technology transformation.
  • Experience of process improvement approaches such as Lean, Six Sigma or Design Thinking would be advantageous.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid #LI-DNP

 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

We are looking for a Lead Application Security Engineer to strengthen Secure Development across WPP. 

Working within TSG, you will partner with software engineers, architects and product teams to establish practical security guardrails, help teams build the capabilities needed to meet them, and develop technical assurance that demonstrates whether those controls remain effective. 

You will not own development pipelines, security tooling or software delivery. Instead, you will provide the technical leadership, evidence and challenge that helps engineering teams build security into the way they develop software and continuously improve their security practices. 

Success requires strong technical credibility with engineers, a practical understanding of modern software development, and the ability to influence technical outcomes without direct authority. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation. 

 What you'll be doing 

  • Act as WPP’s technical lead for Application Security, providing senior judgement on Secure Development, assurance and software-security risk. 
  • Understand how software is designed, built, tested and released across WPP, identifying where common guardrails and engineering capabilities will most improve security. 
  • Define practical Secure Development guardrails across secure design, threat modelling, coding, dependencies, software supply chains, CI/CD, cloud-native and AI-enabled development. 
  • Work directly with software engineers, architects and product managers to help establish the security capabilities and practices needed to meet those guardrails. 
  • Develop technical assurance capabilities that continuously demonstrate whether Secure Development controls are present, operating and effective. 
  • Use engineering evidence, security tooling and targeted validation to identify gaps, challenge assumptions and drive meaningful improvement. 
  • Help engineering teams understand recurring weaknesses and improve their own ability to identify, prioritise and address software-security risk. 
  • Provide evidence and technical challenge where controls are ineffective or risks remain, while keeping implementation and remediation ownership with the teams responsible for the software. 
  • Continuously evolve WPP’s Secure Development approach as engineering practices, technologies and threats change. 
  • Own Application Security Risk Factors through their lifecycle, raising and documenting issues, advising teams on remediation, tracking progress and challenging where exposure is not being addressed effectively. 

What you'll need 

Essential criteria: 

  • Strong practical understanding of modern software development and how security fits across design, development, testing, CI/CD and release. 
  • Meaningful experience in Application Security, Product Security, DevSecOps or Secure Development, with enough technical depth to work credibly with software engineers and architects. 
  • Ability to translate security expectations into practical engineering guardrails that teams can understand and implement. 
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers and senior management. 
  • Sound technical judgement, balancing security outcomes with engineering constraints and knowing when to challenge and when different approaches can achieve the same outcome. 
  • Ability to lead through technical credibility, evidence and influence rather than direct authority. 

Nice to have: 

  • Previous hands-on experience in software development, software engineering, DevOps or a closely related engineering role; 5+ years would be particularly valuable. 
  • Experience establishing or improving Application Security, Secure Development or DevSecOps practices with engineering teams. 
  • Familiarity with common capabilities such as threat modelling, SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets detection, CI/CD security, API security or software-supply-chain controls. 
  • Experience using technology, automation or engineering evidence to provide security assurance at scale. 
  • Experience influencing technical decisions where security and delivery priorities compete. 
  • Security Champions, paved roads, developer enablement or similar experience. 
  • Cloud-native, SaaS or highly distributed application experience. 
  • AI-enabled application or AI-assisted development security experience.

job.title: KSL On-Call Master Control Operator (Part-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

 

Position Overview

The On-Call Master Control Operator plays an important role in supporting the daily operations of KSL TV by providing flexible staffing coverage for Master Control, VTR, and streaming operations. This position helps maintain consistent broadcast operations by filling staffing gaps, covering scheduled absences, assisting during periods of increased workload, and providing additional support when operational needs arise.

 

This role is on-site and requires the employee to work at our Salt Lake City site. As an on-call position, hours are not guaranteed and will vary based on staffing requirements, scheduling needs, and operational demands. The employee must be available to work a flexible schedule, including weekdays, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays. Shifts may be scheduled in advance or requested as needed to address unexpected staffing shortages.

 

What You Will Do

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

 

  • Provide Master Control, VTR, and streaming coverage as needed to support daily operations.
  • Fill in for regularly scheduled employees during vacations, sick leave, and other absences.
  • Assist with staffing shortages, scheduling gaps, and increased operational demands.
  • Monitor multiple incoming and outgoing signals via broadcast and streaming.
  • Maintain broadcast logs and schedule timing.
  • Ensure the continuity and accuracy of station programming.
  • Perform on-air switching of live news and network broadcasts.
  • Set up, control, and monitor broadcast equipment.
  • Prepare content and clips for on-air playback.
  • Support the production of newscasts and other live or recorded programs.
  • Follow FCC and EAS monitoring procedures.
  • Maintain proficiency with broadcast systems and procedures through ongoing training.
  • Cross-train on different shifts and operational responsibilities as needed.
  • Assist with special projects and assignments as requested by management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For

  • Previous Master Control experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of NVerzion automation equipment is helpful.
  • Must be a team player who works well with others.
  • Ability to maintain positive and cooperative relationships with staff and management.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain composure and make sound decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Computer literacy is required.
  • Ability to learn specialized broadcast applications and equipment.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Dependable, responsible, and responsive when contacted regarding available shifts.
  • Must be willing and able to work a flexible, on-call schedule, including weekdays, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays, to meet the needs of a 24/7/365 operation.
  • Must be able to accommodate schedule changes and occasional short-notice staffing requests.

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Perform substantial physical movements involving the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Ability to extend hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction with good eye and hand coordination.
  • Lift, move, and carry up to 25 pounds on occasion.

$18.00 – $23.00 an hour. Hourly rate will be determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

Headquartered in Chicago, the Big Ten Network (BTN) is a joint venture between FOX Sports and the Big Ten Conference, dedicated to delivering comprehensive coverage of the nation's premier collegiate conference. As part of the broader FOX Sports portfolio, BTN produces more than 3,100 live events across all platforms, paired with studio shows, game highlights, and original programming across linear and digital platforms. 


FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. You will also compile competitive intelligence and audience data to inform partnership pitches, collaborate on new activation ideas, and spearhead a semester-long research project on an emerging market category to inform BTCP’s sales strategy.

job.title: Producer/Planner, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We’re hiring a Producer/Planner to join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX Television Stations’ national live-streaming news product. LiveNOW delivers relevant, engaging live news coverage from across the country and around the world, moving seamlessly between breaking stories and major events as they happen. Coverage is live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

 

Based in LiveNOW’s West Coast newsroom at FOX 10 Phoenix and reporting to the Executive Producer, the Producer/Planner will research and plan coverage, book live guests, coordinate incoming content, and produce live coverage of breaking news and important events. We’re looking for a resourceful, dependable, highly organized journalist with strong news judgment who can anticipate coverage needs, build relationships, and thrive in a fast-moving newsroom.

 


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Research, gather, curate, and produce timely original content, including breaking news and live coverage of major events, for digital, social, streaming, and broadcast platforms nationwide.
  • Help execute the editorial plan and coordinate coverage with FOX owned-and-operated stations and other internal and external partners.
  • Coordinate live video feeds, interviews, reporter hits, and other content for LiveNOW coverage.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key contacts across FOX stations and partner organizations.
  • Monitor live video feeds, newsgathering tools, social media, and other sources to identify developing stories, fresh content, and breaking information.
  • Maintain and continuously update the editorial calendar to support short- and long-term coverage planning.
  • Research upcoming events and anticipate coverage and resource needs.
  • Pitch relevant and compelling story ideas.
  • Stay current on breaking news, major stories, and events across the U.S. and internationally.
  • Monitor real-time audience analytics and use insights to inform coverage decisions.
  • Maintain high journalistic and editorial standards.
  • Fill in for Digital Journalists as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3+ years of experience producing news content preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Strong news judgment and a thorough understanding of journalistic standards.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of digital news production, including live streaming and video publishing.
  • Proficiency with web-based newsgathering, content creation, and digital analytics tools.
  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms and their use in newsgathering and news distribution.
  • Ability to remain composed, accurate, and effective during breaking news and other high-pressure situations.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with newsroom teams, FOX stations, and internal and external partners.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, including weekends and holidays, as required.
  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience is a plus.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. job.title: Sr. Manager, Legal and Business Affairs LATAM
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary


The Senior Manager, Legal & Business Affairs will provide strategic legal counsel and business-oriented support to the company's operations across Latin America, with a particular focus on Mexico and Central America.

This role will serve as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders and cross-functional teams, providing practical, commercially focused guidance on a broad range of legal, contractual, regulatory, and corporate matters.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience navigating complex legal and business environments within multinational organizations, demonstrating the ability to assess legal risks, develop effective solutions, and support business objectives while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The position requires strong commercial awareness, sound legal judgment, excellent stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both English and Spanish.


Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Advisory & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted legal and business advisor to regional leadership and cross-functional teams across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America.
  • Provide strategic, practical, and timely legal guidance on commercial, operational, regulatory, and corporate matters.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate legal implications, identify potential risks, and develop solutions that support business priorities and commercial objectives.
  • Provide legal support for business initiatives, transactions, and operational projects, ensuring alignment with corporate policies and applicable legal requirements.

2. Commercial Contracts & Negotiations

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of commercial agreements, including marketing, vendor, licensing, service, and other business-related contracts.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contractual terms, obligations, liabilities, and potential legal or commercial risks.
  • Support contract negotiations with external partners, suppliers, and service providers, balancing legal protections with business needs.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and corporate standards.

3. Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support corporate governance activities, including legal entity management, corporate documentation, regulatory filings, and coordination with external legal advisors.
  • Provide legal guidance on regulatory requirements affecting business operations across relevant Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with internal compliance teams to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks.
  • Monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments and proactively communicate potential implications for business operations.
  • Support the implementation of appropriate legal and compliance practices in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

4. Legal Risk Management & External Counsel

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with commercial activities, contractual relationships, and regional operations.
  • Develop practical, risk-based recommendations that support informed business decisions.
  • Coordinate and oversee external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring consistent, high-quality, and cost-effective legal support.
  • Manage legal matters requiring specialized external advice and facilitate coordination between internal stakeholders and external advisors.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate closely with business, finance, compliance, and operations teams to support regional business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on cross-functional projects and initiatives involving multiple business units or jurisdictions.
  • Facilitate effective communication between legal and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on legal requirements, commercial priorities, and operational needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing legal processes, operational efficiency, and risk management practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Law degree from an accredited university or institution.
  • Admission to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, either as in-house counsel or at a reputable law firm, preferably within a multinational or regional business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on commercial contracts, corporate matters, and business operations.
  • Experience supporting legal and commercial activities across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America, is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, advertising, technology, or other fast-paced industries is considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to provide practical legal advice while balancing regulatory requirements, risk management, and business objectives.

Languages

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required.
  • Ability to draft, review, and negotiate legal documents and communicate effectively with stakeholders in both languages.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial operations and the ability to align legal recommendations with business objectives.
  • Legal Analysis & Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks while providing practical, solution-oriented guidance.
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation: Excellent legal drafting, contract review, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships with business leaders, cross-functional teams, and external advisors.

Are you an innovative, results-driven engineering leader who thrives on solving challenges, developing people, and embracing new technology?

KRQE Media Group is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our technical operations and help shape the future of local broadcasting in New Mexico.

As part of Nexstar Media Group, America's largest local television broadcasting company, KRQE offers an opportunity to lead technology initiatives across a dynamic, multi-platform media operation.


Reporting directly to the Vice President & General Manager, you will serve as a key member of the station's leadership team, collaborating with News, Production, Digital, Sales, and Operations to advance our technology strategy, improve operational efficiencies, and support exceptional local content.


We're looking for more than a technical expert.   We want a forward-thinking leader who can turn innovation into action, inspire a talented engineering team, and keep KRQE at the forefront of broadcast technology.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Engineering Leadership & Operations

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the station's Engineering and technical support teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and professional growth.
  • Oversee the maintenance, reliability, and performance of broadcast, production, studio, and technical infrastructure.
  • Support the technical operations of KRQE News 13, CW, My50, streaming, digital platforms, and locally produced programming.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, troubleshooting, and timely resolution of critical system failures.
  • Collaborate with department leaders to identify technical needs, improve workflows, and support station-wide initiatives.

Technology Innovation & Strategic Planning

  • Develop and execute a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with KRQE's operational objectives and Nexstar's technology strategy.
  • Partner with News, Production, and Digital teams to improve content creation, distribution, and delivery across linear television, streaming, and digital platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize equipment, streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and reduce operating costs.

Broadcast Infrastructure & Compliance

  • Oversee transmitter facilities, translator sites, and remote technical operations, including facilities supporting KRQE's broadcast coverage throughout New Mexico.
  • Maintain reliable broadcast transmission, master control, studio, production control room, and related technical systems.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable FCC regulations, technical operating requirements, and company policies.
  • Maintain appropriate emergency broadcast readiness, technical redundancy, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
  • Coordinate preventive maintenance, equipment inspections, technical documentation, and system upgrades.

Budget Management & Cybersecurity

  • Develop and manage engineering operating and capital budgets, including equipment replacement, infrastructure improvements, and major technology investments.
  • Direct technical projects from planning through implementation, ensuring appropriate scheduling, cost management, and accountability.
  • Partner with Nexstar's corporate technology and IT teams to support cybersecurity standards, network security, system access controls, and technical safeguards.
  • Monitor system performance, assess operational risks, and recommend improvements to protect station assets and maintain service continuity.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Experience managing operating budgets, capital expenditures, vendors, and complex technical projects.
  • Knowledge of applicable FCC regulations and broadcast technical compliance requirements.
  • Ideally five years of supervisory or management experience in broadcast engineering, television production technology, or a closely related technical environment.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of modern broadcast RF equipment, IP-based infrastructure, studio systems, transmission systems, and production workflows.
  • Experience with broadcast and production technologies such as Ross, Evertz, Bitcentral, ENPS, vMix, OBS, Florical, Clear-Com, Vinten, Cobalt, or comparable systems.
  • Working knowledge of computer networking, cybersecurity practices, broadcast automation, and digital media distribution.
  • Demonstrated leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands, respond effectively to technical emergencies, and collaborate across multiple departments.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to the station’s broader leadership objectives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Engineering degree, Broadcast Technology, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with cloud-based broadcast solutions, IP migration, streaming infrastructure, and ATSC 3.0 technologies.
  • Experience supporting multi-station operations, remote transmitter facilities, or distributed broadcast infrastructure.
  • Relevant broadcast engineering certifications, including SBE certifications.



Work Environment & Physical Requirements:

This is an on-site leadership position requiring active involvement in station operations, technical facilities, and remote broadcast locations.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Travel to transmitter and remote technical sites, including high-elevation mountain environments where weather and temperatures can vary significantly.
  • Periodic lifting, carrying, or moving equipment weighing approximately 20–50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Occasional strenuous activity associated with equipment installation, maintenance, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Availability outside regular business hours when necessary to address critical technical issues, emergencies, or scheduled maintenance.

Why Join KRQE Media Group?

At KRQE Media Group, engineering is more than maintaining equipment. It's about enabling great journalism, supporting creative content, and bringing new ideas to life.

You'll join a collaborative leadership team, help develop the next generation of broadcast technology, and play a meaningful role in shaping the future of local media in New Mexico.

If you're ready to lead, innovate, and make an impact, we want to hear from you!


SCAM ALERT:

Please be aware candidates may be at risk of being targeted by scammers seeking personal data or money. Recruiters with Nexstar Media Group and its local stations will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with Nexstar.tv domain or official station email addresses (example:@wreg.com).  Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nexstar or its recruiters via any other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. We will not contact you using a @gmail email address. If you are unsure about the authenticity of a job inquiry or offer, email us at corporaterecruiters@nexstar.tv.

The Executive Director will establish a unified technology strategy across NewsNation while maintaining hands-on oversight of the New York technology operation. The role is responsible for technical reliability, team development, infrastructure planning, and ensuring Technology has the skills and readiness required to support a fast-paced national news operation.

Key Responsibilities

·    Lead NewsNation's technology strategy and technical operations across New York, Chicago, and Washington, D.C.

·    Directly lead the New York and Washington technology teams, provide functional leadership to the Chicago team, and maintain hands-on oversight of New York team development, technical readiness, troubleshooting capabilities, and day-to-day performance.

·    Serve as the senior technology partner to the Vice President, Operations and Operations leadership.

·    Establish network-wide standards and priorities for system reliability, technology support, maintenance, documentation, disaster recovery, and technical projects.

·    Ensure technical issues have clear ownership, escalation, communication, and follow-through; drive recurring problems toward sustainable resolution; and lead the technology response during major incidents, breaking news, special events, and other critical production periods.

·    Lead technical planning for studios, control rooms, signal paths, transmission, remote production, and supporting broadcast infrastructure, advancing appropriate cross-market standardization in technology practices, ownership, documentation, and resilience.

·    Develop a network technology roadmap identifying technical risks, lifecycle requirements, infrastructure needs, and investment priorities, and partner with Operations on capital planning, facility projects, system upgrades, and technology investments.

·    Build and maintain structured training, cross-training, mentorship, and professional-development programs, including a skills and certification roadmap and regular opportunities for technology staff to maintain and expand relevant credentials.

·    Strengthen troubleshooting and organizational capability through technical training, knowledge-sharing, documentation, practical development, and cross-training; identify skill gaps and single points of knowledge; and broaden technical capabilities across the organization.

·    Coordinate with NewsNation teams, corporate technology resources, vendors, and other technical partners.

·    Lead represented and non-represented employees while working within applicable collective bargaining agreements and partnering with Human Resources and Labor Relations as appropriate.

 

 

Required Qualifications

·    Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience in broadcast technology, broadcast technology, television technology, live-production technology, or a closely related technical field.

·    Demonstrated experience leading technology teams and technical operations in a complex live television or media environment.

·    Strong knowledge of studios, control rooms, broadcast production systems, signal flow, transmission, remote production, and supporting technical infrastructure.

·    Experience leading major technical projects, facility upgrades, infrastructure modernization, and system implementations.

·    Experience leading technical teams across multiple facilities or geographically distributed operations.

·    Demonstrated ability to develop technical talent through training, cross-training, mentorship, knowledge transfer, and skills development.

·    Experience working with represented and non-represented employees.

·    Ability to lead effectively through direct-report, dotted-line, and shared-resource organizational structures.

·    Strong troubleshooting, project-management, vendor-management, organizational, and communication skills.

·    Ability to communicate complex technical issues, risks, and recommendations clearly to operational and executive stakeholders.

·    Ability to provide effective leadership in a fast-paced, 24/7 live-news environment.

Preferred Qualifications

·    Bachelor's degree in technology, broadcast technology, computer science, information technology, or a related field preferred, not required.

·    Relevant technical certifications or specialized training.

·    National network or 24/7 news technology experience.

·    Experience with IP-based broadcast infrastructure, remote production, streaming, and digital production technologies.

·    Experience developing multi-year technical and capital plans.

Schedule and Travel

This is an onsite position based in Midtown Manhattan, New York. Regular travel to Chicago and Washington, D.C. is expected, along with other travel as necessary to support NewsNation operations, projects, facilities, training, vendors, and special productions.

The position requires flexibility outside normal business hours during breaking news, special events, major technical projects, system outages, and other critical operational situations.

Compensation

$200,000-$250,000 annually, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Benefits Statement

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more.

About NewsNation

NewsNation is a national news network owned by Nexstar Media Group and dedicated to delivering fact-based, unbiased journalism for all Americans. Reaching audiences nationwide across cable, digital, and mobile platforms, NewsNation combines a national newsroom with the strength of more than 6,000 journalists in 110 local newsrooms across the country.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met.  Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications.  Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast.  Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity.  Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects.  Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +.  The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WXMI (Ionia / Greenville / Lowell / Belding)
job.description:
WXMI, the FOX affiliate in Grand Rapids, Michigan, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company is searching for its next Multimedia Journalist. The MMJ will tell the stories of the Ionia, Greenville, Lowell, and Belding neighborhoods. The right person will dig for stories, write, capture visual content, and edit stories for multiple platforms. Tucked into the scenic Grand River Valley northeast of Grand Rapids, the Ionia, Greenville, Lowell, and Belding area blends small-town Michigan charm with historic downtowns, riverfront trails, and lively community traditions like the Ionia Free Fair. With affordable housing, outdoor recreation at your doorstep, and a proud manufacturing and agricultural heritage, it's a welcoming place. Apply today to join an award-winning team!

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WTKR (Historic Triangle)
job.description:
WTKR, The E.W. Scripps Company CBS affiliate in Norfolk, Virginia, is looking for a motivated Multimedia Journalist to research, write, capture visual content, and edit stories for multiple platforms. This role will be based in the Historic Triangle — serving the communities of Williamsburg, Yorktown, and Jamestown — putting you at the center of one of the most historically significant and story-rich corners of the Hampton Roads DMA. In this role, you'll be on the front lines of local news — from developing story ideas to delivering live reports in the field — helping viewers across Hampton Roads stay informed, engaged, and connected. If you're passionate about journalism and ready to do it all, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Norfolk, Virginia sits at the heart of Hampton Roads, one of the most historically rich and geographically stunning metro areas on the East Coast. As home to Naval Station Norfolk — the largest naval installation in the world — the city carries a proud military heritage that shapes its culture, its people, and its sense of purpose. The waterfront downtown is vibrant and walkable, lined with restaurants, craft breweries, and live music venues, with the iconic Nauticus maritime museum and the battleship Wisconsin drawing visitors and locals alike year-round.


Beyond the city limits, Hampton Roads offers an incredible range of outdoor adventures and coastal living. Virginia Beach is just a short drive away, offering miles of Atlantic coastline perfect for surfing, swimming, and sunsets. The Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge provides kayaking, hiking, and wildlife watching just south of the city, while First Landing State Park offers camping among ancient cypress trees. With easy access to Washington, D.C. to the north and the Outer Banks of North Carolina to the south, Norfolk puts you squarely in the middle of one of the most exciting corridors on the Eastern Seaboard.


Culturally, Norfolk punches well above its weight. The Chrysler Museum of Art houses a world-class collection and is free to the public, while the Virginia Arts Festival draws internationally acclaimed performers every spring. The NEON (New East Ocean View Norfolk) arts district buzzes with galleries and community events, and a thriving culinary scene celebrates local seafood — from fresh oysters to blue crab — alongside global cuisines. Norfolk is a city where community pride runs deep and there's always something new to discover.

job.title: Sr Mgr, Community Connections, WTMJ
job.description:
WTMJ, the NBC affiliate in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for a Senior Manager of Community Connections. You'll be the station's main link to the community, building trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, education and government leaders. You'll turn community insights into stronger journalism, partnerships that matter and events people show up for, like town halls and public forums. You'll also lead the newsroom's daily community engagement and make sure audience questions, story tips and concerns get a fast, thoughtful response. If you love connecting people and making a real local impact, we want to hear from you.

From the lakefront and the Riverwalk to Brewers games and summer festivals, Milwaukee is a city with big energy and a lot of heart. It has historic neighborhoods, a thriving food and arts scene and easy access to Lake Michigan, so there's always something to explore in the Cream City. Apply today!

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

job.title: Supervisor, Master Control Hub
job.description:
Are you a seasoned master control professional ready to step into a leadership role that shapes how great television gets delivered? Scripps is looking for a Supervisor, Master Control to join our centralized Master Control Hub in Indianapolis, Indiana. In this critical role, you'll work alongside the Master Control Hub Manager to oversee the vision, mission, and day-to-day operations of a team that serves Scripps stations across the country. From managing and mentoring a team of Hub Operators to ensuring seamless, consistent service delivery for our internal station partners, you'll be at the heart of keeping Scripps on the air — and doing it right, every time.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Assumes leadership responsibilities when the Master Control Hub Manager is not available.
  • Together with the Master Control Manager, is responsible for the Master Control Operations, which includes program monitoring and logs, signal monitoring, quality assurance checks, and discrepancy reporting.
  • Together with the Master Control Manager, fosters an environment that ensures all of our internal customers have a consistent experience.
  • Ensures Hub Operators have appropriate procedures and training to interact with internal Hub client stations in a consistent and reliable manner. When and how Master Control Operators send alerts, respond to inquiries, collaborate on problem solving, document and/or resolve issues is of critical importance.
  • Manages a group of seven to ten Master Control Hub Operators. Management duties include staffing, onboarding, training, performance management, feedback/coaching/counseling, development, discipline, and corrective action.
  • Constructs, maintains, improves, and oversees the Master Control program for disaster recovery and associated procedures and tests.
  • Performs management and supervisory duties associated with the Master Control team, including staffing, onboarding, training, expectation setting, work assignments, scheduling, performance management, coaching and development, enforcing policies, and monitoring workflow.
  • When on-air problems are escalated, quickly investigates, resolves, and reports results to all parties concerned.
  • Responsible for forecasting and monitoring budgets in conjunction with the Hub Manager.
  • May be involved in performing Master Control Hub Operator duties as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent. Technical Certificate or training desirable.
  • Technical or Associate's Degree in related field or equivalent experience is required.
  • A minimum of 5 years of Television Master Control experience is required, with at least 3 of those years in a hubbed master control environment.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated leadership ability, including engaging, motivating, and building a high-performance team.
  • Strong customer service orientation.
  • A continuous process improvement mindset.
  • Able to construct, implement, and monitor effective work procedures and training.
  • Composure and command skills: Has a settling influence and is looked to for direction in a crisis.
  • Ability to manage and measure work with the appropriate level of detail to facilitate feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Strong working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment as well as master control operations.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television Master Control and news operation.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Indianapolis is a city that punches well above its weight — a true American sports capital and a thriving Midwestern hub with an unmistakable sense of community. Home to the Indianapolis 500, one of the most storied racing events in the world, and the NFL's Colts and NBA's Pacers, Indy offers world-class sports and entertainment year-round. The revitalized downtown scene along the Canal Walk and Mass Ave arts district is packed with acclaimed restaurants, eclectic boutiques, live music venues, and a craft beer culture that continues to grow.


Beyond the city center, Indianapolis offers an outstanding quality of life with affordable housing, top-rated suburbs, and excellent schools. Outdoor enthusiasts enjoy Eagle Creek Park — one of the largest municipal parks in the country — along with miles of greenways, trails, and the scenic White River. The city's central location makes weekend getaways to Chicago, Cincinnati, Louisville, and Nashville easily accessible.


Indianapolis is also a city of culture and intellect, home to the renowned Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, the Indiana Repertory Theatre, and a vibrant local food scene that highlights everything from farm-to-table dining to beloved neighborhood gems. It's a place where careers are built, communities are strong, and there's always something new to explore.

job.title: Sr. Accountant, Record to Report Digital Streaming
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a senior accountant to support the Finance, Record to Report team for Digital. This position is involved in all aspects of the monthly accounting close process related to our streaming digital business.  The position reports to the Manager, Record to Report for Digital.


ABOUT YOU:

You are a detail-oriented and analytical accounting professional with strong technical accounting knowledge and the ability to exercise sound judgment when addressing complex accounting matters. You are proactive, adaptable, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. You bring strong communication and interpersonal skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to build effective relationships and work across all levels of the organization.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Manage the monthly closing process by preparing and uploading journal entries, ensuring accuracy and timely completion
  • Prepare, review and maintain complex monthly recurring entries, ensuring compliance with accounting policies
  • Prepare various general ledger account analyses by reviewing transactions within the general ledger to ensure accurate activity within the account
  • Manage revenue recognition for content licensing and streaming distribution agreements for ViX, ensuring accurate accounting treatment, timing of recognition, contract compliance, and financial statement integrity.
  • Analyze contractual arrangements and determine appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Responsible for the accounting for specialized contractual obligations.
  • Prepare the Quarterly Flux analysis book, identify variances and communicate findings to management
  • Assist in gathering support for the internal/external audit requests
  • Support ad hoc projects/system implementation

 

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • 4+ yrs. accounting experience, and strong technical accounting knowledge
  • Strong PC Skills with moderate knowledge of Excel
  • Ability to independently manage multiple accounting activities in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to resolve complex accounting issues and establish priorities
  • Ability to analyze and interpret contracts
  • Certified Public Accountant is a plus
  • Bilingual - Ability to speak and write in English/Spanish

New Jersey Salary Range: $67,650 - $82,000

Salary ranges for other locations may differ based on local market conditions and candidate qualifications

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: VP, Agency Sales
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

 

TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching audiences across streaming, digital, social, audio, live events, sports, and linear television. Powered by the scale of ViX, premium content, first-party audience capabilities, and deep cultural connection with Hispanic consumers, we help brands drive measurable business outcomes across every stage of the consumer journey.

 

We are seeking a strategic, client-focused Vice President, Agency Sales based in New York to lead revenue growth across a portfolio of major agency and client relationships. This executive will serve as a trusted advisor to senior agency and brand leaders, developing innovative, outcome-based advertising solutions that leverage TelevisaUnivision's full ecosystem.

 

The ideal candidate brings a modern understanding of media and advertising, including streaming, audience-based buying, programmatic, social content partnerships, commerce and retail media integrations, data and measurement solutions, and cross-platform sponsorship opportunities. This leader will inspire high-performing sales teams, strengthen marketplace partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth through consultative selling and strategic account leadership.

 

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for a dynamic sales executive with deep agency relationships, strong business acumen, and a passion for helping brands connect authentically with Hispanic audiences at scale.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Drive quarterly and annual revenue goals across assigned agency and client portfolios.
  • Build and grow executive-level relationships with agencies and advertisers.
  • Lead sales strategies across Streaming/CTV, Digital, Social, Audio, Live Events, and Linear platforms.
  • Develop integrated, audience-led marketing solutions that deliver measurable client outcomes.
  • Negotiate complex, high-value partnerships and sponsorships.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Research, Pricing & Planning, Client Success, and Ad Operations teams.
  • Coach and develop a high-performing team of Account Executives and sales support professionals.
  • Identify new business opportunities, market trends, and revenue growth strategies.
  • Deliver accurate forecasting and business insights to senior leadership.
  • Responsible to delivering their sales targets as provided by the EVP of U.S. Agency sales

YOU HAVE:

·       Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

·       10+ years of media advertising sales experience, including leadership responsibilities.

·       Proven success exceeding revenue goals and managing large agency/client relationships.

·       2+ years of product knowledge and expertise across Streaming/CTV, Digital, Social, Data & Measurement, Audience-Based Buying, and Linear TV.

·       Strong understanding of today's advertising ecosystem, including programmatic, retail media, attribution, and AI-enabled sales solutions.

·       Established relationships with major agencies and advertisers.

·       Exceptional leadership, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.

·       Excellent executive-level presentation, leadership and interpersonal skills, as well as influencing skills

·       Strong problem solving, analytical capabilities and collaboration skills

·       Spanish language skills are a plus.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tolls to support sales strategies, client prospecting, proposal development, and business reporting.
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering, including the ability to develop clear, effective prompts to generate actionable business insights and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven advertising solutions, including audience targeting, campaign optimization, and performance measurement.

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work from office in New York, NY
  • Employment/education will be verified
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a fulltime basis
  • Time flexibility required to interact with people in different geographical locations, and work extended hours, sometimes on short notice due to project deadlines
  • Must be willing to attend after-hour client events
  • Ability to travel nationwide if necessary to attend client meetings, conferences, seminars and industry events

 

Base Pay Range: $200-300k base plus variable comp

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.
