job.title: Summer 2027 FOX Sports - Big Ten Network - Internship Program - Chicago, IL
job.description:
Headquartered in Chicago, the Big Ten Network (BTN) is a joint venture between FOX Sports and the Big Ten Conference, dedicated to delivering comprehensive coverage of the nation's premier collegiate conference. As part of the broader FOX Sports portfolio, BTN produces more than 3,100 live events across all platforms, paired with studio shows, game highlights, and original programming across linear and digital platforms. 

FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest sports, media, and entertainment companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects, which provides valuable work experience and leadership skills.

Please note that this internship is an on-site opportunity in Chicago, IL.


ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program 
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Strong academic record 
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned Internship site
  • Must be able to work on-site in Chicago, IL
  • Must be available on weekdays/weekends

STUDENTS SELECTED TO MOVE FORWARD IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS:

  • Must demonstrate knowledge of the company and sports media industry

TO APPLY:

  • Submit a 1-page resume (PDF preferred) 
  • Submit a cover letter (PDF Preferred) 
  • Explain why your background and experience make you a good fit for our program
  • Share your top areas of interest 

STUDENTS ACCEPTED INTO THE SUMMER 2027 PROGRAM:

Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment

job.title: Sr. Manager, Legal and Business Affairs LATAM
job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Legal & Business Affairs will provide strategic legal counsel and business-oriented support to the company's operations across Latin America, with a particular focus on Mexico and Central America.

This role will serve as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders and cross-functional teams, providing practical, commercially focused guidance on a broad range of legal, contractual, regulatory, and corporate matters.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience navigating complex legal and business environments within multinational organizations, demonstrating the ability to assess legal risks, develop effective solutions, and support business objectives while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The position requires strong commercial awareness, sound legal judgment, excellent stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Advisory & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted legal and business advisor to regional leadership and cross-functional teams across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America.
  • Provide strategic, practical, and timely legal guidance on commercial, operational, regulatory, and corporate matters.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate legal implications, identify potential risks, and develop solutions that support business priorities and commercial objectives.
  • Provide legal support for business initiatives, transactions, and operational projects, ensuring alignment with corporate policies and applicable legal requirements.

2. Commercial Contracts & Negotiations

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of commercial agreements, including marketing, vendor, licensing, service, and other business-related contracts.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contractual terms, obligations, liabilities, and potential legal or commercial risks.
  • Support contract negotiations with external partners, suppliers, and service providers, balancing legal protections with business needs.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and corporate standards.

3. Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support corporate governance activities, including legal entity management, corporate documentation, regulatory filings, and coordination with external legal advisors.
  • Provide legal guidance on regulatory requirements affecting business operations across relevant Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with internal compliance teams to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks.
  • Monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments and proactively communicate potential implications for business operations.
  • Support the implementation of appropriate legal and compliance practices in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

4. Legal Risk Management & External Counsel

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with commercial activities, contractual relationships, and regional operations.
  • Develop practical, risk-based recommendations that support informed business decisions.
  • Coordinate and oversee external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring consistent, high-quality, and cost-effective legal support.
  • Manage legal matters requiring specialized external advice and facilitate coordination between internal stakeholders and external advisors.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate closely with business, finance, compliance, and operations teams to support regional business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on cross-functional projects and initiatives involving multiple business units or jurisdictions.
  • Facilitate effective communication between legal and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on legal requirements, commercial priorities, and operational needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing legal processes, operational efficiency, and risk management practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Law degree from an accredited university or institution.
  • Admission to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, either as in-house counsel or at a reputable law firm, preferably within a multinational or regional business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on commercial contracts, corporate matters, and business operations.
  • Experience supporting legal and commercial activities across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America, is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, advertising, technology, or other fast-paced industries is considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to provide practical legal advice while balancing regulatory requirements, risk management, and business objectives.

Languages

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required.
  • Ability to draft, review, and negotiate legal documents and communicate effectively with stakeholders in both languages.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial operations and the ability to align legal recommendations with business objectives.
  • Legal Analysis & Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks while providing practical, solution-oriented guidance.
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation: Excellent legal drafting, contract review, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships with business leaders, cross-functional teams, and external advisors.
  • Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate complex legal matters, anticipate potential challenges, and recommend commercially viable solutions.
  • Organization & Prioritization: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
  • Professional Integrity & Judgment: High ethical standards, discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential matters.

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

KVDA Telemundo San Antonio is seeking a Multiplatform Producer to join our award-winning team. The Multiplatform Producer will be responsible for successful coordination and execution of a newscast, other special programs as needed, content for all platforms including apps, social media accounts and streaming channels. This role will report to the Executive Producer.

We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about news, loves breaking news and has a creative vision for crafting live programs. You’ll work closely with managers to create innovative, up-to-the-minute content that resonates with our audiences. The ideal candidate loves to collaborate, wants to help lead a team, and is ready to take on new challenges to help us continue to grow.

Responsibilities

  • Understand and follow all Telemundo San Antonio News and NBC standards and ethics.
  • Responsible for multiple news cast production, content, and elements of the shows.
  • Responsible for being a strong communicator in the newsroom- talking with key stakeholders who will participate or provide content for that newscast (i.e. VP of News, Executive Producer, Managing Editor, anchors, Digital, MMJ's and production crews).
  • Coordinate Live Shots and Satellite Remotes during live newscasts.
  • Select, assign, write, and organize news stories. Write news scripts, headlines, teases and topicals.
  • Contribute story ideas, participate in daily coverage decisions and editorial meetings.
  • Must select stories, understand all the elements, and design a newscast that achieves the daily goal.
  • Knowledgeable on daily news events, awareness of past news events and know what news in the market.
  • Respond to breaking news with urgency and accuracy.
  • Develop special projects involving community and social content.
  • Work with Multimedia Journalists to improve story and presentation.
  • Work closely with VP. Of News, Executive Producer and Managing Editor on story/sweeps planning and coordination.
  • Complete discrepancy reports with detail and accuracy to help prevent future problems and cue sheet.
  • Support Talent with the creation of original digital content.
  • Contribute to the creation of video series for OTT, FAST and all platforms.
  • Understand newscast mission, station priorities and be familiar with all the platforms.
  • Leadership: take responsibility for own actions and take risks for the team and be a team player.
  • Be detail oriented, organized, and able to handle intense deadline pressure.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages
  • Minimum of 2 years producer experience
  • 1 year experience with writing and/or editing and/or producing daily video
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or media communication or equivalent experience products

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must have a valid driver's license
  • Must be available to work overtime, evenings, weekends and holidays as needed or required
  • Must have a flexible schedule with ability to work multiple shift and willingness to travel and work long hours and on weekends and holidays with short notice
  • Must be able to carry or lift 25 lbs.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Leadership qualities
  • Team player mentality
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • Excellent news instincts with the ability to react decisively to breaking news
  • Take an active role in selecting the stories of the day - come up with story ideas that reporters can turn in one day
  • Create producer driven content to enhance our coverage of the big story and other stories that appear in the newscast
  • Anticipate problems and address them throughout the course of the shift, eliminate all factual/spelling/other errors that appear in the show. If a problem arises, address it immediately
  • Ability to resolve conflict
  • Bring creativity into every aspect of the newscast
  • Ability to perform under tight time deadlines
  • Editing skills to edit video clips

Additional Job Requirements

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

NBCUniversal’s Network Engineering group within the Operations & Technology organization has an opening for a Network Engineer based at 30 Rockefeller Plaza, NYC.

The engineer will work within a dedicated team of network and firewall engineers tasked with building reliable and scalable network infrastructure for NBCUniversal’s broadcast and media production facilities. The selected candidate will have experience in the configuration, deployment, and support of Cisco, Arista, and Palo Alto firewalls using vendor and internal automation and monitoring systems.

  • 3+ years' experience configuring, deploying, and supporting network technology from multiple vendors including Cisco (IOS, NX-OS, XR), Arista, Palo Alto, and F5.
  • Experience with AWS and Azure network configurations (Direct Connect, Express Route).

    • OSPF, IS-IS, vPC, port-channeling, 10/40/100G optics, IPSEC, QoS, VLAN, Multicast
    • MP-BGP, route-reflection, MPLS (IP and Segment Routing), Traffic Engineering, L3VPN, VRF
  • Ability to analyze network logging and other data sets to troubleshoot and isolate production and design problems.
  • Experience with network automation and version control tools such as Ansible and Git to deploy networks at scale

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 
  • At our Universal City office interns will have access to the NBCUCommutes program, which provides fully subsidized transit passes to full-time lower lot employees, good for unlimited rides on all Metro bus and rail, such as the Metro Red Line.

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

Franchise, Products & Partnerships extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.​

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Franchise Creative: this intern will help bring characters and worlds to life through illustration, concept development, and visual storytelling. They’ll also create digital sketches and final artwork for characters, creatures, sets, and vehicles; develop 2D character turns and production-ready content for style guides; and support creative development across products ranging from toys and publications to interactive games. This intern will conduct visual research, review character-based products, and help organize project artwork. The ideal candidate is proficient in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, has a strong understanding of character design, anatomy, and perspective, and brings a versatile visual development skill set along with an interest in animation and storytelling.
  • Toys & Hardlines: this intern will support the development of innovative toys, plush, novelty products, and packaging for Universal Parks, helping create engaging “play experiences” for consumers. Working with cross-functional teams, partners, vendors, and global counterparts, this intern will develop concept sketches, Illustrator artwork, mood boards, stylized character plush designs, and packaging concepts while researching consumer insights, global toy trends, and the competitive landscape. Looking for an organized, out-of-the-box thinker with strong illustration and product design skills who can manage multiple priorities and leverage AI tools to support project work.
  • Toys Packaging: this intern will support the design and development of innovative, consumer-focused packaging through market research, creative ideation, and graphic design. Working with the Packaging team and cross-functional partners, this intern will create packaging concepts, structural ideas, sketches, Illustrator artwork, and mood boards while researching consumer insights, global toy trends, and the competitive landscape. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of graphic design principles, including typography, color theory, layout, and composition, along with strong conceptual thinking, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Ability to communicate ideas clearly through sketches and presentations.
  • Skilled in CS Suite, 3D software and all relevant software for product design & development including Keynote for presentations. 
  • Have a broad understanding of character design and development.
  • Strong understanding of anatomy and perspective.

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

The Programmatic Ad Operations team within Business Operations & Services is a close-knit, fast-paced team tasked with executing all programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace deals domestically and globally. The Programmatic Sales Operations Campaign Manager is responsible for overseeing the lifecycle of a programmatic deal.   • Setup regularly cadenced reporting to identify trends amongst creative failures within various ad distributors/ DSPs
  • Must seek to gain knowledge within the Programmatic ecosystem to better support our internal and external partners
  • Ensuring media is delivered to published specifications and lead time
  • Direct interaction with Programmatic Sales Team and Clients to ensure campaign fulfillment
  • Functional knowledge on trafficking programmatic deals in FreeWheel, OperativeOne and Google Ad Manager
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required

  • Fluency in the language of digital media: impressions, CTR, CPMs, eCPMs, etc.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Keen problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
  • Strong verbal/written communication skills and the ability to prioritize tasks

  • Coordinate testing, deployments, cutover, production support, and incident resolution. 
  • Mentor engineers and drive SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP best practices.

  • Experience developing technical designs, integration specifications, and RICEF specifications.

  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI), including API, file-based, and middleware integrations leveraging OData, Compound Employee API, REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, and SFTP. 
  • Experience developing and extending cloud applications using SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP). 
  • Experience conducting technical reviews and ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture, governance, and development standards. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Certification in two or more SAP SuccessFactors Talent modules, including Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Compensation, or Performance & Goals. 
  • Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including Cloud Foundry, API Management, Cloud Connector, Event Mesh, Build, Work Zone, Cloud ALM, SAP Joule, and ABAP Cloud. 
  • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Signavio, and SAP Fieldglass.

  • Preferred to have experience with at least one SmartRecruiters implementation.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

 

KPIX-TV, is looking for an experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist (MSJ) to join our team. A successful candidate is passionate about community storytelling, brings ideas to the table daily, cultivates sources, and has a strong social media presence. Candidates must have creative storytelling skills and an energetic delivery. We want a journalist who can create shareable stories for both broadcast and digital/social platforms with excellent writing, compelling video, and editing. Please provide a link to examples of broadcast and digital video work.
This role will be based out of San Jose, CA.
 

 

Qualifications: 
•    Development story ideas, write, shoot, and edit news content for on-air daily newscasts.
•    Pitch vetted stories reflective of the community 
•    Establish and maintain relationships/sources in the community 
•    Produce content for Twitter, Facebook and other social media sites 
•    Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines 
•    Perform other duties as assigned
•    Valid driver's license required
•    SAG-AFTRA union membership will be required

 

 

PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS: 
•    Ability to shoot and edit broadcast quality video for television newscast and digital platforms
•    Must be able to work independently with accuracy and the ability to problem solve quickly
•    Must have knowledge of Broadcast ENG camera, lighting, audio and Live U
•    Must have strong social media skills and be able to contribute on all platforms
•    Must be able to work a flexible schedule including nights, holidays and weekends
•    Must be a team player and able to work under deadlines and have the ability to multi-task. 
•    College degree in Journalism/Communications/Broadcasting preferred, or equivalent experience 
•    Minimum of 4 years MSJ/television reporting experience preferred

CBS News is seeking a smart, driven, and organized Editorial Producer with booking and political newsgathering skills. Primary responsibilities include booking political newsmakers, including lawmakers, political candidates, analysts, and internal contributors for CBS News platforms, with a strong focus on CBS News 24/7’s The Takeout with Major Garrett, in addition to CBS Mornings and CBS Evening News.   Candidates must have strong communication and interpersonal skills, have the ability to cultivate sources and maintain relationships with key political contacts, and book high-profile guests. This position requires attention to detail, persistence, organization, sound editorial judgment, and a command of the political landscape and the Washington news cycle. This person must have the ability to communicate effectively internally with newsroom managers and shows/teams across the news division, as well as externally with guests, communications directors, and other contacts. Candidates must be flexible with occasional travel requirements and schedule changes as news events warrant. This role will report into the Central Booking team and the schedule is Monday through Friday dayside.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Secure multiple guest bookings for daily and future news coverage, including high-profile political newsmakers, experts, and contributors 
  • Develop, cultivate, and maintain relationships with key political sources, communications teams, and Washington-based contacts to generate booking opportunities
  • Partner with producers, newsroom leadership, and cross-functional teams to identify, pitch, and execute guests that support editorial priorities and breaking news coverage
  • Manage multiple bookings and projects simultaneously, exercising strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and adaptability in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a newsroom, with a background in political, Capitol Hill, or Washington news strongly preferred
  • Must have a strong understanding of Congress, the executive branch, campaigns, and the broader political landscape
  • Must have solid news judgment, including the ability to recognize and pitch the right guest for a developing story
  • Strong research skills, including use of public and private records databases such as Lexis Nexis, as well as social media, are preferred
  • Must be an excelled writer with well-developed oral communication skills
  • Must be able to juggle and prioritize multiple projects with different deadlines: short, medium, and long-term
  • Must have the ability to develop and maintain ongoing relationships with external contacts
  • Must be a team player with a positive attitude
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Thrives in high-pressure, time-critical situations, and works with a sense of urgency
  • Degree in broadcast journalism, political science, or a related field is preferred
  • Passion for news, politics, live events, and journalism is required
  • Must be willing and able to work occasional late/overnight and/or weekend shifts as needed

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

At WVEC-TV, a TEGNA-owned ABC affiliate in Hampton Roads, we are looking for our next Account Executive. As an Account Executive, you are responsible for achieving or exceeding the individual sales goals across all TEGNA marketing solutions from linear TV to digital, including OTT with PREMION. You will act as a lead generator by identifying and reaching clients in the Hampton Roads market that will best take advantage of our solutions. You then become a marketing consultant to the clients helping them define and achieve their business objectives.

Current driver's license is required.

What We Offer:

  • Winning, inclusive, collaborative, supportive, and fun culture
  • Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions
  • Leading media products
  • Training resources
  • Generous benefit
  • Career growth opportunities at one of our 64 ABC, NBC, CBS, or FOX stations.

What You Will Do:

  • Consistently prospect for new revenue opportunities using client and category insights. 
  • Upsell current clients by engaging them in the full product line of WVEC-TV offerings. 
  • Create custom solutions-driven campaigns that meet client needs across multiple media platforms including broadcast, digital, and Streaming (OTT). 
  • Seek opportunities to expand relationships with key clients by taking an active role in understanding their business needs and competitive landscape. 
  • Establish strong relationships with internal team members by providing the Account Management team with clear and concise direction for the successful execution of campaigns. 
  • Partner with your Account Manager to provide exceptional customer service and contract fulfillment. 
  • Strategically utilize Matrix and station CRM to manage day-to-day activity, pipeline, and forecasts.
  • Positively and professionally represent the media group to the community at events and surrounding businesses.

What You Need:

  • 1-3 years of account engagement in a professional, fast-paced media sales environment. 
  • Proven track record of successfully achieving or exceeding sales goals and developing new business opportunities as a seller.
  • Established knowledge of marketing solutions including broadcasting and digital advertising including audio and interactive, and be a perpetual learner, eager to continuously expand your knowledge.
  • Prior working experience using Microsoft Office Suite and CRM (Client Relationship Management) systems, and ability to leverage technology to project manage workload and achieve goals.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities to proactively communicate with clients, co-workers, and vendors, and to write/edit compelling proposals.
  • Possess a creative mind to put together unique campaigns focused on solving client needs with ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Proven effective problem solver with ability to quickly adapt to changing and competing priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Strong business acumen with attention to detail and accuracy, as well as strong organization and time management skills.
  • Self-motivation and a strong work ethic are essential attributes to be successful.

 

Pay Range$70,000—$120,000 USD

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

job.description:
Inform readers, celebrate achievement and demand accountability.

We are seeking a High School Sports Reporter to help lead our coverage of local teams and athletes while becoming a prominent on-camera voice. The reporter will produce frequent field video and authoritative rankings of teams, players, games and performances that keep fans returning throughout the season. The role also includes breaking news, major events and distinctive enterprise reporting.

Video and high-interest rankings are central to the job. The reporter will create mobile-first updates, interviews, analysis and personality-driven features, along with recurring lists of top teams, players, games and performances. Other coverage will include daily stories, investigations, explainers, profiles, newsletters and service journalism—all designed to build readership and subscriptions.

What you’ll do:

Partner with our current high school reporter to own the high school sports beat by developing deep knowledge of local teams, athletes, coaches, athletic directors and governing organizations.

Shoot and edit vertical video, conduct interviews and become a recognizable on-camera personality who can host and analyze high school sports coverage.

Break news with urgency and accuracy, including off-field developments, policy changes and other issues affecting student-athletes and school communities.

Publish a regular cadence of authoritative rankings and compelling lists of teams, players, games, matchups and standout performances, backed by clear reporting and analysis. Add timely previews, profiles, trend and investigative stories, reader polls and postseason honors.

Build and maintain a diverse network of sources and consistently identify distinctive stories that competitors do not have.

Use newsletters, social platforms, audience data, reader feedback and verified real-time reporting to strengthen engagement, reach new readers and convert loyal audiences into subscribers.

Work independently on deadline and collaborate closely with editors, photographers and other journalists to set priorities and coordinate coverage.

Pitch ambitious enterprise and accountability stories that examine trends, decisions and institutions influencing high school sports.

What you’ll need:

A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

At least two years of journalism experience, with demonstrated reporting and writing ability; sports reporting experience is preferred.

Strong news judgment, high ethical standards and a proven ability to source, report and break news.

Clear, engaging writing and the ability to deliver accurate work on tight deadlines.

Demonstrated video production skills, including shooting and editing, plus the confidence and presence to appear regularly on camera and build a credible, engaging connection with viewers.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance breaking news, daily assignments and longer-term projects.

Experience building and engaging digital audiences, using metrics, emerging tools and responsible applications of artificial intelligence to improve reporting, presentation and reach.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, along with the initiative to work independently.

A commitment to inclusive sourcing and coverage that reflects the breadth of the communities we serve.

Work requirements:

This position requires regular night and weekend work based on the sports calendar, as well as travel to games, practices, interviews and other assignments. Reliable transportation is required. The reporter must be comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and adjusting coverage plans as news develops.

How to apply:

Applicants should submit a resume and three to five work samples that demonstrate reporting, writing and digital storytelling skills. Video or multimedia work samples are required.

job.title: Senior Financial Accounting Process and Automation Analyst
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Financial Accounting team enables The Washington Post to report accurately, operate with sound controls, and make timely business decisions. The Financial Accounting Process and Automation Analyst strengthens the way that work gets done by translating accounting needs into practical process improvements, automation opportunities, and ERP-enabled solutions. This role helps reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and create consistent, well-documented workflows across the financial accounting function.


What Motivates You

  • You enjoy understanding how accounting work moves from source data to financial reporting and finding practical ways to make each step clearer, faster, and more reliable.
  • You are curious about automation, ERP capabilities, and data, and you can connect technical possibilities to real accounting and control needs.
  • You value disciplined processes, accurate records, and thoughtful documentation because they make it easier for people to do high-quality work.
  • You like working across Accounting, Finance, Technology, and external partners to turn requirements into solutions that colleagues can adopt.
  • You take ownership of details, follow through on commitments, and use feedback and results to continuously improve the work.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Map financial accounting processes by documenting current-state workflows, systems, dependencies, controls, and pain points across areas such as the general ledger, close, reconciliations, reporting, and accounting operations, creating a shared foundation for improvement.
  • Design improved workflows by translating accounting requirements into clear future-state processes, business requirements, and acceptance criteria that reduce rework, improve consistency, and preserve appropriate financial controls.
  • Advance automation opportunities by identifying repeatable manual work, evaluating automation and AI-enabled options with appropriate human review, and helping implement solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and auditability.
  • Contribute to ERP design and enhancement by supporting requirements gathering, configuration decisions, testing, data validation, and release readiness so ERP capabilities meet financial-accounting needs.
  • Strengthen data quality and controls by investigating process and data issues, partnering with stakeholders to resolve root causes, and helping maintain reliable handoffs, reconciliations, and documentation.
  • Enable change adoption by developing process documentation, job aids, and training materials that help accounting colleagues understand and consistently use new workflows and tools.
  • Support close and reporting readiness by coordinating process improvements with the accounting calendar and ensuring changes are tested, communicated, and implemented without disrupting critical reporting obligations.
  • Measure process performance by maintaining process metrics, issue logs, and improvement recommendations that help the Controller and accounting leaders prioritize work and assess results.
  • Collaborate across teams by serving as a trusted accounting-process partner to Financial Accounting, FP&A, Technology, Internal Audit, and vendors, bringing clear requirements and disciplined follow-through to shared initiatives.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in financial accounting, accounting operations, finance systems, audit, consulting, or a comparable environment that combines accounting knowledge with process improvement.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, core financial-accounting processes, internal controls, and the close and reporting cycle.
  • Experience documenting business processes, gathering requirements, testing changes, and translating stakeholder needs into usable process or system improvements.
  • Experience working with ERP, financial-reporting, workflow, or reconciliation tools; familiarity with platforms such as Workday, Oracle, SAP, BlackLine, Alteryx, or comparable tools is welcome.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data or process exceptions and identify practical root-cause solutions.
  • Ability to use data, automation, and AI-enabled tools responsibly, with attention to data governance, source validation, access controls, and human review.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create concise documentation and work effectively with both accounting and technical partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$91,800 - $153,000 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Manager, Global Distribution Operations
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

Distribution operations are the specialist team within the WEA Global Operations dept that supports WMG’s distribution business including ADA. In the Distribution Operations department, we work to ensure that releases from independent labels and artists are delivered on time and in accordance with industry standards, DSP guidelines, and the creative strategy of our partners. This is a collaborative role that interfaces with internal business entities as well as other Global Operations teams as well as external label partners and artists. We’re a group of creative problem solvers whose goal is to support independent music and position labels and artists for success. Getting products to market is the backbone of a distribution company!


Your role:

As Manager of Revelator Distribution Operations, you will play a critical role in supporting key clients and internal teams during US business hours. You will build deep expertise in the Revelator platform to oversee end-to-end operational workflows. In this position, you will drive seamless catalog ingestion support, monitor release deliveries, resolve technical DSP issues, optimize metadata and assets, and deliver actionable operational reporting to ensure independent labels and artists are set up for success across global digital service providers.


Here you’ll get to:


  • Catalog ingestion & delivery - provide support to the DSCO Catalog Ingestion team as they lead on catalog creation and delivery into Revelator
  • Delivery monitoring - Monitor delivery feeds and supply chain events daily; identify failed, stalled and rejected deliveries and action them within agreed turnaround time
  • Delivery monitoring - Manage (Investigate and resolve) DSP delivery errors, metadata rejections and asset failures
  • Delivery monitoring - bring up relevant issues to engineering with reproducible detail where a platform fix is required.
  • Delivery monitoring - Raise, track and chase tickets with DSP partners (Apple, Spotify, YouTube, Amazon and others) through to closure.
  • Metadata & asset optimization - Identify and optimize metadata including artist disambiguation / profile mapping, contributor enhancement, artwork / audio replacement, 
  • Operational reporting - Produce recurring operational reporting on delivery volumes, error rates, open partner tickets and ingestion progress.
  • Operational reporting - Respond to internal and client queries on delivery and catalogue status within agreed service levels
  • Key direct operational contact - provide key direct operational support to US time zone business entities

About you:

  • 2–4 years' experience in digital distribution, digital supply chain or content operations within the music, media or entertainment industry.
  • Hands-on experience of content ingestion, metadata management and delivery to digital service providers including their unique CMSs (Apple Connect, S4MP etc)
  • Working knowledge of music metadata standards and the identifiers that underpin them (ISRC, UPC/EAN, ISNI), and familiarity with DDEX message types and delivery feeds.
  • Intermediate SQL — able to write and adapt queries with joins and filters against a relational database without assistance.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Passion for supporting independent music
  • An interest in efficiency tools (Airtable etc) and application of AI tools for business 
  • Working knowledge of industry developments and commercial practices


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

The OTC Manager holds a global remit and is responsible for defining the future state Order to Cash (OTC) processes and measures within SAP S/4 HANA and Fiori that are aligned with organizational strategies, country-specific knowledge, and operational requirements. This process lead will strive to assemble opportunities, reviewing existing and best-practice workflows, tools, and data. Ensure that any business needs driving a requirement for customization are strongly challenged and options for process redesign are considered. Where customizations are needed, ensure justification is documented and changes progress via the governance model. 
  • Update relevant OTC documentation based on changes to the global template (including SOPs, User Guides, and training materials).

  • Be responsible for the resolution and review of OTC issues, risks, and business impacts for the owned process. 
  • Proactively and on an ongoing basis identify internal and external OTC guidelines (e.g., automation in cash application, AI-driven credit scoring, streamlined collections) that will enable improvement of the standard end-to-end process.

  • Daily user of SAP with deep knowledge of OTC Processes focusing on OTC processes (Credit, Collections, Cash Application, Billing, AR) or related finance transformation experience.

job.title: Assistant Producer, Brand & Content
job.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Assistant Producer, Brand & Content


Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, great stories help people connect with our brand, our tech, and the humans behind our customer experiences. We’re looking for an Assistant Producer who has natural storytelling instincts, loves digging into research, and wants to learn the ins and outs of brand producing from the ground up.
If you just wrapped up a degree in Broadcast, Journalism, or Media and want to put your reporting and writing chops to work in a fast-paced creative environment, this role is built for you. Instead of spending your day behind a camera lens or buried inside an editing timeline, you’ll focus on the heart of the narrative: researching guests, setting up shoots, drafting interview questions that get past corporate speak, and serving as a key right hand to our Brand and Content leadership.

How You’ll Find Success

  • A Reporter’s Instinct for a Good Story: You just know when an angle works. You can listen to someone talk for 10 minutes, cut through the fluff, and spot the compelling human hook that makes people stop scrolling and pay attention.
  • Curiosity & Interview Smarts: You love digging into a topic, learning what makes a subject tick, and writing fresh, conversational interview questions that draw out memorable, authentic soundbites.
  • Poise Around Team Leaders: You’re confident jumping into conversations, sharing your point of view, and working side-by-side with senior leaders on the Brand & Content team. You stay one step ahead, anticipating what needs to get done next.
  • Video Production Fluency: You speak the language of video. While you won't be trapped behind a camera or an edit bay, you already understand how shoots run from pre-pro to post, making it easy for you to coordinate with videographers, freelance crews, and editors.
  • Scrappy, Get-It-Done Energy: Production moves fast and plans change. You stay organized, keep your cool when schedules shift, and take pride in coordinating shoot logistics, prepping guests, and keeping projects on track.

How You’ll Grow

  • Learn Directly from Creative Leaders: Work hand-in-hand every day with senior directors and strategists, getting a front-row seat to how enterprise creative campaigns and brand strategies are built.
  • Master High-Stakes Storytelling: Build your portfolio by turning complex business and human topics into engaging video packages, mini-docs, and social-first narratives.
  • On-Camera & Hosting Opportunities: If you have an interest or background in front of the lens, we love putting talented storytellers on camera for social segments, event coverage, and internal features.
  • Cross-Media Versatility: Sharpen your voice across video, audio, social media hooks, and written editorial content.

Things You’ll Do

  • Set Up & Build Interviews: Research internal leaders, customers, and industry experts; coordinate interview schedules and logistics; and write tailored interview guides designed to get authentic, unscripted answers.
  • Own Pre-Interview Prep: Run pre-interviews to vet storylines, brief guests so they feel comfortable before the cameras roll, and flag key talking points for the production team.
  • Support Brand & Content Leadership: Act as a central point person for our creative leaders by drafting briefs, prepping meeting decks, keeping track of action items, and ensuring team projects cross the finish line.
  • Write Supporting Creative Copy: Draft video outlines, social copy teasers, video hooks, and promotional blurbs that support our multimedia campaigns.
  • Coordinate On-Set Logistics: Keep shoot days running smoothly by building call sheets, greeting and prepping talent, managing schedules, and keeping external videographers looped in on creative goals.
  • Help Bridge Pre-Production to Post: Review raw interview footage, pull the best quotes and soundbites, and pass time-coded notes to video editors to help shape the final cut.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 1-3+ years of experience in Broadcasting, Videography, or another relevant field.
  • Background in Storytelling: A degree in Journalism, Broadcast Media, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on student media/internship experience).
  • Interview & Writing Samples: A portfolio or reel featuring work you’ve produced, reported, or written—such as student broadcast packages, interview transcripts/articles, video scripts, or multimedia stories.
  • Organizational Hustle: Experience coordinating shoots, managing production schedules, or juggling multiple creative deadlines in a newsroom, studio, agency, or internship environment.
  • Awesome Bonuses:
    • On-Camera Experience: Experience reporting for a campus news station, hosting a podcast, or presenting on social channels.
    • Basic Editing Literacy: Familiarity with tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, Descript, or CapCut for pulling selects or rough assemblies.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • High-energy, collaborative team culture that values curiosity, fresh ideas, and taking initiative.
  • Fast feedback loops with real opportunities to pitch ideas and see them produced.
  • Direct mentorship from experienced brand storytellers and creative leaders.
  • A hybrid setup that blends in-person creative collaboration with remote flexibility.

Perks and Benefits Highlights

  • Performance-based incentive structure and 100% merit-based promotions driven by impact rather than tenure.
  • Continuous professional growth opportunities and direct creative mentorship.

  • On-site amenities including catered lunches, quarterly team socials, seasonal parties, and Qualtrics swag.
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic. Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know. Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.

job.title: Director, Partnership Management
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

Semafor is seeking an experienced, strategically minded Director of Partnerships Management to lead high-value client relationships and oversee the delivery of integrated commercial partnerships across live events, digital advertising, custom content, and other Semafor programs.

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships Management, the Director will own the strategic relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients. You will build trusted relationships with senior executives, understand their business priorities, and ensure Semafor's partnerships deliver meaningful value.

This role emphasizes strategic account leadership rather than day-to-day project administration. Directors are supported by Project Managers who handle timelines, deliverables, and routine follow-up, freeing you to focus on client strategy, executive engagement, satisfaction, and commercial growth.

Your Responsibilities

Strategic Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as primary strategic relationship owner and trusted advisor for a portfolio of high-value, complex client partnerships.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, communications, marketing, and public affairs leaders.
  • Develop tailored account strategies aligned with each client's business objectives, and lead executive-level conversations and planning sessions.
  • Monitor account health and client satisfaction, and act as the primary escalation point for relationship-sensitive issues.

Partnership Strategy and Delivery Leadership

  • Own accountability for delivering contracted partnerships to Semafor's quality standards.
  • Partner with Sales in late-stage deals and lead kickoffs that set objectives, expectations, and success measures.
  • Provide strategic leadership across integrated programs spanning live events, executive convenings, digital advertising, custom content, podcasts, video, and research.
  • Assess risks, resolve complex challenges, and manage changes to scope, timelines, or deliverables with Sales and leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Connect clients with Semafor teams including Sales, Editorial, Audience, Concierge, Events, Marketing, Creative, Revenue Operations, and Product.
  • Work with Project Managers to keep visibility into commitments, progress, and risks without duplicating day-to-day administration.
  • Resolve competing priorities with functional leaders and recommend improvements to the broader operating model.

Commercial Growth and Retention

  • Partner with Sales on retention, renewals, and expansion, identifying opportunities to deepen partnerships through additional Semafor offerings.
  • Lead post-program reviews, translate performance reporting into client insights, and make evidence-based recommendations for future investment.
  • Track partnership economics with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to resolve issues affecting scope, revenue, or profitability.

Executive Engagement and Client Experience

  • Design executive engagement strategies that maximize the value of Semafor's global convenings, editorial platforms, and leadership communities.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact at major events and executive interactions, navigating sensitive requests with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Represent Semafor confidently and professionally while maintaining high standards for responsiveness and client satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, client services, or a related field within media, marketing, or editorial environments.
  • Experience working with global clients across the US, the Gulf, and beyond, with a deep understanding of and appreciation for cultural, business, and geopolitical dynamics. Experience with clients focused on B2B and B2G strategies is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, integrated projects involving multiple stakeholders and deliverables.
  • Experience managing large- and small-format events, digital advertising campaigns, podcasts, and marketing services.
  • Expertise in project management tools and methodologies, with a strong focus on operational efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of and respect for media, journalism, and the importance of editorial independence.

Additional Job Details

  • Based in New York, NY or Washington, DC, with a four-day in-office schedule (Fridays work from home).
  • Flexible hours around events and domestic and international travel as needed.
  • Salary range: $145,000 – $180,000 per year, based on factors including education, experience, and relevant qualifications.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Producer, Audio/Video
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a skilled video producer/editor for a daily technology show. In this role, you’ll oversee recording sessions, make creative and editorial decisions to shape episodes, ensure high quality and accuracy, and edit episodes to completion. 


The show is a companion product to a daily newsletter, and you’ll work closely with the hosts, newsletter authors, and editors to highlight the best reporting and analysis each day — while building a distinct product that stands alone and features the unique strengths of a conversational format.


Our shows are multiplatform products, with audio, video, and social media elements. The ideal candidate is a strong video editor; experience with audio editing is a strong plus. Please note your skillset in your application. 


This is a Sunday-Thursday role and requires some evening work to produce a daily early-morning show (the estimated schedule is 2pm-10pm EST). We’ll consider candidates to work out of our HQ (Arlington, VA), New York, San Francisco or Sacramento.


Who You Are:

  • An experienced producer with a track record of writing scripts or briefings for shows and translating complex reporting into compelling pod/vodcasts. 
  • A strong session producer with experience coaching talent and working with experienced hosts and newer voices. 
  • A skilled video editor able to produce tight, polished edits on a deadline
  • A keen follower of tech and AI news, with an interest in how those overlap with politics and policy. 
  • Experienced in multiplatform distribution, finding production efficiencies between audio, video and social media, and producing for different channels and audiences
  • A team player, great at giving and taking notes and working across different teams of people

What You’ll Do:

  • Oversee the virtual recording of a daily tech news podcast — including technical aspects and helping coach talent and guide editorial direction
  • Collaborate with hosts, editors, and the audio/video team to identify daily topics
  • Edit and publish clean, final cuts of episodes, often under tight deadlines
  • Write headline and caption copy for podcast feeds, YouTube and other social platforms
  • Partner with teams across the newsroom on distribution and publishing
  • Monitor episode performance metrics and use audience insights to inform future episodes

What You’ll Need:

  • 3+ years’ experience in podcast or video production, with significant experience in news, politics, or policy
  • Strong editing ability; producing clean, polished video under tight deadlines (audio editing a strong plus).
  • Sharp editorial judgment and storytelling instincts grounded in journalistic standards
  • Strong communication skills for coordinating with hosts, editors and cross-functional partners
  • Familiarity with audience analytics and platform metrics to help guide content strategy

This role is based in our Arlington, VA HQ. We’re also open to candidates in New York or California (Sacramento or San Francisco).


Compensation:

  • $90,000-$110,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here.


About Us.

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. Learn more about Axel Springer.
