job.title: Hub Editor, MENA, Reuters
job.description:
Job Description


The Hub Editor role requires a sharp, decisive and collaborative editorial leader to support the Breaking News & Daily Editor in managing the daily news file across all formats; text, video, pictures and other storytelling tools. This role is central to setting editorial priorities for the day, coordinating coverage, and ensuring the file is fast, accurate, and compelling.


The successful candidate will act as the daily traffic cop for news flow, helping to shape the pace and direction of coverage. They will decide which lines to develop as trunk, including directing string for trunk stories, or spot stories versus sidebars, anticipate legal, ethical questions, and ensure that coverage is aligned with Reuters’ editorial standards and client needs.


They will work closely with the Breaking & Daily News Editor to coordinate coverage across formats and platforms. They will be expected to bring strong news judgement, excellent communication skills, and the ability to prioritise in a fast-moving environment. They will also need to anticipate how stories will develop and what clients will need next.


Key Responsibilities

  • Daily editorial priorities: Set priorities in coordination with the Breaking and Daily News Editor. Together with the Executive Producer anticipate the next move in major stories and drive coverage ahead.
  • Story development: Decide, in conjunction with bureau chiefs, which news lines to develop as trunk or spot stories, which to handle as sidebars, and in which medium; direct string for trunk stories. Maximise the value of field reporting across formats.
  • News-flow coordination: Act as the traffic cop for the daily news file, ensuring coverage is timely, coherent and well prioritised. Make fast editorial calls as stories develop and priorities shift.
  • Editorial risk: Anticipate legal and ethical considerations as stories develop and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Cross-format integration: Support integrated breaking news coverage across text, video, pictures and other storytelling formats. Bring the right formats together around the biggest stories.
  • Client impact: Ensure coverage meets the needs of Reuters’ diverse client base.
  • Innovation: Help drive smart ideas and innovation in daily coverage.
  • Breaking news excellence: Deliver the Reuters Breaking News Drill across assets to win the story for clients.

Required Qualifications

  • Regional expertise: Strong knowledge of the Middle East and North Africa and proven experience of hostile and challenging environments
  • Breaking news experience: Proven experience running a compelling breaking news file.
  • Editorial judgement: Strong news judgement and the ability to make decisive, sound decisions under pressure.
  • Coordination and communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to prioritise and coordinate coverage in a fast-paced environment.
  • Client and platform knowledge: Strong understanding of the needs of multiple platforms and client types.
  • Writing and editing: Strong writing and editing skills across a range of news stories.
  • Editorial values: Demonstrated commitment to the Reuters Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Major news leadership: Proven track record leading major breaking news, elections, conflicts or disasters. Demonstrated ability to coordinate coverage across multiple bureaux and field teams.
  • Video and cross-format knowledge: Understanding of video journalism, its importance to agency clients and the requirements of cross-format coverage.
  • Newsroom technology: Strong technical understanding of new technology and its use to improve the speed and impact of coverage. Familiarity with AI tools to accelerate research, verification, production and news workflows.
  • People development: A track record of mentoring and developing talent.


#LI-JU1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:

  • Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities.

  • Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits:  We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days.

  • Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories.

About Reuters

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers.

 

 

About Thomson Reuters

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

job.title: Sr. Project Manager, Marketing & Comms
job.description:
Job Description

Marketing & Communications is rebuilding how it works around AI, and this role helps deliver that change. As a Sr. Project Manager on the Transformation & PMO team, you will lead initiatives that change how a 750-person marketing organization operates: AI-enabled workflows, marketing technology enhancements, redesigns of marketing and communications processes, and the campaigns that depend on them.

This is not a coordination role. You will work directly with marketing leadership and partner with MarTech, MarComm, and Product teams. You will map how work happens today, help design how it should happen, and own delivery through adoption. If you want a PM role where process thinking and solution design are part of the job, and where your work visibly changes how a large organization operates, this is that role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional project teams through planning and execution of large-scale marketing projects, ensuring alignment with business goals
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, and resources across concurrent projects, owning deliverables and dependencies
  • Establish goals and KPIs, monitor progress against them, and proactively address risks, issues, and barriers to execution
  • Facilitate process mapping and cross-functional working sessions to identify bottlenecks and rework, brainstorm and recommend solutions, and translate them into implementation plans with clear owners, timelines, and success measures
  • Develop and maintain scalable, repeatable project management processes and standards
  • Partner with internal customers and teams across MarTech, MarComm, Product, and other business units to understand needs, manage expectations, and keep stakeholders aligned
  • Prepare and present status, performance, key risks, and recommended actions to leadership on a regular cadence, raising decisions and escalations early
  • Drive adoption and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, so delivered work is used and lessons learned are applied

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in project or program management, marketing operations, or a related role
  • Track record of delivering large-scale, complex projects with multiple stakeholders under tight deadlines
  • Ability to influence and lead without authority in a matrixed environment
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and leadership
  • Hands-on experience applying Lean Six Sigma or similar continuous improvement methods, including process mapping and root cause analysis. Formal certification is not required
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to track progress and identify improvement opportunities
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-ready status reporting and presentations
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and shifting priorities
  • Customer-service mindset with experience supporting internal clients
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt training and certification
  • Experience with project management tools such as Workfront

What if you could shape the future of legal AI while leading a team of engineers embedded directly with customers to solve their most complex problems? At Thomson Reuters, we're redefining how professionals interact with the law through CoCounsel, our generative AI legal assistant, and we're looking for a technically strong, people-focused leader to guide our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team as we scale AI-powered solutions across the legal industry.

As Manager, Software Development Engineering for CoCounsel FDE, you will provide technical leadership and people management for engineers embedded in customer-facing initiatives, translating ambiguous, real-world problems into scalable AI/ML solutions. You'll balance hands-on technical guidance with strategic influence, ensuring your team delivers high-quality, secure, and reusable AI components while growing as engineers and professionals.

About the Role

In this opportunity as Manager, Software Development Engineering, CoCounsel FDE, you will:

  • Lead and support multiple cross-functional Forward Deployed Engineering project teams, ensuring efficient and effective execution while resolving issues as they arise

  • Architect and guide the design of scalable, secure AI/software solutions, applying deep knowledge of software and AI system architecture to complex, end-to-end AI/ML development across the software development lifecycle

  • Drive innovation by evaluating and adopting emerging AI methodologies, influencing enterprise-wide MLOps and LLMOps practices, and setting strategy for testing, AI monitoring, and debugging at the platform level

  • Manage and develop talent through hiring, performance management, coaching, and mentoring of engineers, fostering a culture of technical growth and high performance

  • Translate business needs into AI solutions by communicating and coordinating with project teams, partners, and stakeholders, and by championing thought leadership that promotes reusable, consistent AI frameworks and patterns

  • Own technical delivery across multiple projects and products—including large-scale AI/ML initiatives—by removing impediments, guiding project leads, and managing budgets where applicable

  • Build a customer-aware, high-performing team culture, ensuring close collaboration with Product, Project Management, and Technical Operations to deliver impactful, prioritized work

About You

You're a fit for the role of Manager, Software Development Engineering, CoCounsel FDE if your background includes:

  • 10+ years in software/solutions engineering, including 2+ years in a formal or informal people-management or team-lead capacity, while remaining technically hands-on rather than purely administrative.

  • Team leadership experience — you've led and grown a team of forward-deployed, field, or solutions engineers, with direct accountability for hiring, performance management, career development, and team structure.

  • Sustained customer-facing experience — running discovery sessions, presenting architecture, defending technical decisions, and building trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders (GCs, IT leaders, innovation teams).

  • A track record of scoping, building, and demoing rapid POCs and pilots against ambiguous or evolving requirements, and turning what you learn into repeatable patterns your team can execute on.

  • Strong Python development skills, plus hands-on AWS expertise (Bedrock AgentCore, CDK, EKS, ECR) and ownership of CI/CD pipelines (Docker, SQL/Flyway migrations, Cumulus or similar enterprise deployment platforms).

  • Comfort operating at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, translating customer-specific technical work into structured feedback that shapes the core CoCounsel product roadmap.

  • Familiarity with the legal industry or legal tech (e.g., document review, contract lifecycle, legal research) is a strong plus, given the domain-specific nature of customer requirements.

job.description:

WHO ARE WE?

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!


THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Director to lead our Defect Management (Vulnerability Management) and Penetration Testing teams, which span penetration testing, vulnerability management, bug bounty program management, and defect remediation.


Reporting to the Vice President, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) and Operations, you will lead a multi-disciplinary team and partner with cross-functional teams across regions to ensure vulnerabilities are prioritized, remediated, and monitored to protect Live Nation Entertainment’s assets and data. You will clearly communicate the business impact and urgency of security defects while following the defined risk management process, and you will define the outcomes and metrics for Defect Management across the enterprise.


This is a delivery-focused leadership role: you own program plans, roadmap commitments, and remediation service-level agreements (SLAs), and you are accountable for measurable, on-time reductions in enterprise vulnerability exposure.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Build and lead a high-performing, multi-disciplinary security team across multiple locations
  • Set the team’s strategic direction and development, lead by example, and mentor team members at all levels
  • Research and communicate emerging security threats relevant to the environments we operate
  • Participate in threat modeling, security design reviews, penetration testing, and remediation verification
  • Partner with application teams enterprise-wide to detect, prioritize, and remediate security defects throughout the SDLC, embedding a security mindset from concept through implementation, including hands-on security training for architects and developers
  • Set clear priorities and deadlines and hold the team accountable for timely, high-quality delivery
  • Own budget, headcount planning, and resource allocation for both teams, including tooling, third-party testing, vendor, and bug bounty spend
  • Lead response to zero-day vulnerabilities and urgent exploits: coordinate with Cyber Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, and internal/external business partners, communicate clearly and promptly to leadership and stakeholders, and track each issue to closure. Requires 24/7 availability for urgent matters
  • Partner with Cyber Security Operations and Threat Intelligence on red and purple team exercises to validate detection and response and prioritize remediation of exploitable paths

Program Management & Delivery

  • Own program goals and roadmap commitments; build project plans with milestones, risks, and deadlines; escalate blockers early and deliver on time
  • Drive measurable reduction in vulnerability exposure, including Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) and aged backlog, and remediate all Critical vulnerabilities within regulatory timeframes (ex. PCI DSS)
  • Establish and enforce risk-based remediation SLAs, exception and risk-acceptance criteria, compensating controls, and escalation paths; track exceptions to closure
  • Own scanning and assessment coverage across on-premises, cloud, container, application, and API environments, including authenticated coverage and discovery of unmanaged, shadow, and end-of-life assets
  • Lead the bug bounty program end-to-end, from submission through triage, assignment, remediation, retesting, and closure, with SLA and aging reporting at every stage
  • Lead security testing of AI-enabled products, including LLM-based and agentic applications, incorporating AI-specific threats (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) into testing methodologies
  • Drive automation and AI-enabled integrations across CMDB, ITSM, scanning, and bug bounty platforms to automate ownership mapping, ticket routing, SLA tracking, and reporting
  • Select, implement, and continuously evaluate security testing tooling (coverage, cost, overlap), including continuous and agentic penetration-testing platforms; own the penetration-testing and scanning infrastructure; and make evidence-based retain/discontinue recommendations with transition plans
  • Align the program to PCI DSS, CIS Controls, SOC 1/SOC 2, CCPA, NIS2, and other applicable requirements; maintain audit evidence and support audits, assessments, and security reviews
  • Establish processes to assign, track, and remediate findings from external security-rating and third-party risk services

Business Stakeholder Management & Executive Reporting

  • Build trust and collaboration across business and technology stakeholders with competing priorities through regular, transparent, data-driven communication, and track stakeholder commitments to completion
  • Lead recurring stakeholder reviews of goals, progress, and blockers, ensuring decisions and actions are documented and followed through
  • Produce executive-ready metrics (coverage, SLA attainment, risk burn-down, exceptions, business impact) and present program status and risks to senior leadership

External Partner & Vendor Management

  • Manage third-party vendors and PCI ASV/QSA engagements, including scoping, quality review, and remediation tracking
  • Hold vendors accountable to contractual SLAs; document failures, pursue service credits, and report on vendor effectiveness



WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Knowledge of Cyber Security standards and regulations, including PCI DSS, CIS Controls, SOC 2, CCPA, and NIS2, and of desktop, server, application, database, and network security principles; experience maintaining audit evidence
  • Experience performing penetration testing and exploitation against applications, APIs, web, mobile, and modern infrastructure (containers, microservices, serverless) in cloud (AWS, Azure) and on-premises environments
  • Track record of building and managing large, diverse teams: attracting, hiring, developing, and retaining top security talent and giving them the vision, support, and culture to deliver impact
  • High ethical standards and discretion with confidential information
  • Technical knowledge of adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs)
  • Understanding of common software security issues and remediation techniques (CISA KEV, OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, MITRE, etc.)
  • Deep knowledge of the threat landscape and emerging security strategies and products
  • Strong program management discipline: builds project plans with milestones, risks, and deadlines, communicates status proactively, and delivers on time
  • Attention to detail and a sense of urgency in prioritizing and responding to time-sensitive security issues
  • Experience operating a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program and managing security vendors, third-party penetration-testing firms, SLAs, and reporting
  • Experience managing remediation against compliance-driven SLAs, including PCI DSS requirements, and governing exceptions and risk acceptance

Desirable

  • 10+ years in technical security roles, including penetration testing or security hardening
  • 5+ years driving cyber security initiatives across large, diverse organizations
  • Experience working in global environments spanning multiple time zones
  • Training in Cyber Security-specific disciplines
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, GPEN, GWAPT, CISSP, CISM)

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

job.title: Financial Supervisor
job.description:
Job Summary:

THE JOB

The Financial Supervisor will oversee financial operations, reporting, and controls for Live Nation / Bizarro Peru, ensuring accurate and timely financial information across concerts, events, and local operations. Reporting to the Entertainment Director, this role will lead two direct reports, maintain rigorous oversight of event settlements and ROME, and establish consistent daily controls, follow-up, and accountability. The position partners with local, regional, and corporate teams to protect financial integrity, manage risk, and support sound business decisions.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Supervise, coach, and prioritize the work of two direct reports, establishing clear ownership, daily review routines, deadlines, and timely follow-up on open items and exceptions.
  • Maintain strong control over event settlements and ROME, ensuring complete and accurate entries, supporting documentation, reconciliations, timely updates, issue resolution, and escalation of discrepancies.
  • Oversee event and operating budgets, costs, purchase orders, expense reimbursements, and payment commitments; monitor variances and communicate financial risks and corrective actions.
  • Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, bank reconciliations, cash flow monitoring, and payment forecasts, ensuring appropriate approvals and traceable records.
  • Coordinate financial and accounting close activities, including verification of event costs, liabilities, and supporting documentation, and prepare clear budget and financial control reports for local and regional leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with company financial policies, approval procedures, internal controls, and applicable local requirements; support internal and external audits and recommend process improvements.
  • Partner with Production, Administration, Accounting, Legal, vendors, and regional/corporate Finance teams to resolve issues promptly and sustain disciplined execution across the Peru operation.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Degree or professional qualification in Accounting, Finance, Auditing, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, financial control, or operations, including experience coordinating or supervising others; prior live entertainment or event finance experience is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of event or project settlements, budgeting, cost controls, treasury, financial close, and financial reporting; ability to manage detailed reconciliations and follow-up.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with ERP systems and financial reporting tools preferred. Experience with ROME is preferred, or the ability to learn the platform quickly.
  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, ownership, and integrity, with the ability to set priorities, meet deadlines, and reinforce consistent team processes.
  • Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; intermediate to advanced English for coordination with regional and corporate teams.

job.title: Senior Director, Sales Operations
job.description:
About Us

The Marketing Cloud (TMC) is Stagwell's technology division, bringing together marketing technology, media intelligence, AI-driven products, and data solutions that help brands better understand audiences and drive growth.

Overview

The Marketing Cloud is seeking a Senior Director, Sales Operations to join a team focused on leveraging financial data to help the business scale.  This is a senior position responsible for creating a predictable, scalable, and data-driven revenue engine across Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams supporting a dozen differentiated global brands. The role will build and lead the systems, processes, and insights that power our growing revenue organization. The role will partner with sales leadership across the company to provide timely, fact-based, data-driven decision support to help drive critical revenue decisions supporting our mandate for growth at all costs. This includes forecasting, territory and quota planning, pipeline management, reporting, systems, new product roadmaps, process optimization, and cross-functional GTM planning.  This is a forward-looking team.  We support a global business with a diverse product set and go to market strategy.  The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced and consistently evolving environment.  This role requires an ability to build close working relationships with stakeholders across the business.  A revenue first mindset and constant focus on driving growth and long-term scale is expected, along with a strategic and hands-on approach dynamic enough to establish best practice, bring together disparate data, and handle ad hoc requests with ease.  Excellent communication skills and an ability to work within a global organization are required.  This is a unique opportunity to build processes, take ownership, and make an immediate impact while growing alongside the business.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with C-level and Sales leadership across our brands to develop strategies for scaling the revenue organization, introducing new products and services to market, pricing, packaging, and new monetization opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue growth, productivity, and retention through data and operational insights
  • Develop forecasting methodologies, pipeline coverage models, and performance benchmarks
  • Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, sales cycles, win rates, churn, retention, and expansion
  • Identify risks and opportunities within the revenue funnel and proactively recommend actions
  • Establish a single source of truth for pipeline, forecast, and revenue reporting
  • Build and mature scalable processes, playbooks, and workflows across the revenue lifecycle
  • Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and implement solutions that improve conversion, productivity, and time-to-close
  • Drive consistent process adoption across Sales teams
  • Continuously assess whether existing systems and tools are effectively supporting the needs of the business
  • Build scalable infrastructure that can support continued growth and scale
  • Build dashboards, reporting, and analytical models for Sales and executive leadership
  • Translate complex data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations
  • Develop reporting that enables leaders to understand performance, identify trends, and make better decisions
  • Ensure leadership has a clear understanding of the health and trajectory of the pipeline
  • Deeply understand and effectively communicate the business to internal and external stakeholders
  • Use our tools and systems to streamline processes, improve visibility and understanding, and increase team efficiency
  • Identify, develop, implement, and champion financial and non-financial KPIs that are tangible to the business

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or FP&A experience, ideally at a global, technology focused, Rule of 40 company
  • Experience building or significantly scaling a RevOps organization, ideally in a growth-stage company
  • Proven experience with forecasting, revenue planning, territory design, quota setting, pipeline management, and GTM analytics
  • Experience in varied forecasting ERPs (Salesforce, Hubspot, OneStream, and Maconomy a plus)
  • Demonstrated history of working with C-level, board, or senior leadership teams
  • Keen attention to detail and financial data accuracy
  • Strong analytical, financial, and data modeling skills
  • Experience using data and technology to improve revenue performance and operational efficiency
  • A growth mindset

Compensation

150K

Radio-Canada Québec is seeking an Assignment Editor to lead its daily and breaking news coverage. You will report to the Senior Manager, News and Programming. 


We are looking for a candidate with sharp editorial judgment, keen news instincts and in-depth knowledge of the greater Quebec City area, its key players and its newsmakers.


In this role, you bring a deep understanding of our audience and the stories that matter to them, the agility to clear roadblocks in real time, and a commitment to championing a culture of continuous improvement through constructive feedback.


Working as part of a three-person editorial leadership hub, you will help set priorities, drive advance planning and co-ordinate multiplatform coverage. 


You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the wider network to co-ordinate and fulfil regional coverage requests wherever possible.


This strategic role is central to our daily newsroom operations.


Role:

Assign and co-ordinate the daily work of journalists and camera operators assigned to regional coverage, in keeping with corporate standards and policies.


Key Tasks:

  • Keep up with regional, national and international news stories through various sources.
  • Contact media relations officers to obtain more information about a press conference or other media event. Decide whether the event deserves coverage.
  • Encourage journalists to come up with their own story ideas.
  • Choose which events will be covered during the day. Draw up the assignment schedule.
  • Attend planning meetings for day-to-day, upcoming and special-event coverage. Discuss the various events to be covered, express your opinions and consider those of the team.
  • Inform the National Assignment Editor of local stories having a national angle or liable to take on national importance.
  • Assign stories to journalists and co-ordinate their work. Discuss with reporters which angles they should take and direct them accordingly. Supply reporters with additional documentation if necessary. Inform them of what audio and video clips are available.
  • Assign camera operators to shoots.
  • If necessary, arrange reporters’ and camera operators’ schedules to meet coverage needs (this is a strategic role within our team).
  • Co-ordinate the work of a Research Journalist or Assignment Assistant as needed.
  • Co-ordinate requests for collaboration on regional and national news and current affairs programs. Ensure that the required production resources are available to journalists.
  • Closely follow events as they unfold. Be prepared to reassign journalists at any time. Plan and chase medium- and long-term assignments and create a bank of story ideas.
  • May revise the form and content of the story. May suggest or demand corrections. May refuse to allow a story to be broadcast. Follow up with journalists after the broadcast.
  • Write intros as needed.
  • Occasionally set up interviews for reporters.
  • Ensure that the items under your responsibility are ready on time for the various newscasts per the lineups (digital layouts). Also ensure that adequate human, budgetary and technical resources are available.
  • Perform the duties of a Journalist or Regional Lineup Editor as required.
  • Carry out all other related tasks as needed.

This role requires full-time on-site presence.


Job Requirements:


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Five (5) years’ journalism experience or equivalent.

Skills:

  • Extensive general knowledge.
  • In-depth knowledge of regional current events and issues.
  • Proven ability to identify stories that resonate most with our audience.
  • Fluency in French (working language).
  • Excellent knowledge of the other official language (English) is an asset.
  • In-depth knowledge of newsroom logistics.
  • Very good knowledge of storytelling techniques specific to each platform.
  • Knowledge of production techniques.
  • Ability to thrive in a high-pressure environment under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Knowledge of CBC/Radio-Canada’s Journalistic Standards and Practices.

  • Editorial tests.
  • Interview.

job.title: DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician
job.description:
Title: DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician

Reports to: Director of Safety

 

At Meruelo Enterprises, we’re building more than infrastructure, we’re building communities, careers, and a better tomorrow.

Founded in 1986 and proudly minority-owned, we’ve grown into one of California’s leading construction and engineering firms, serving major utility, transportation, and telecom clients across the West Coast. With a talented team of over 2,500 professionals and a family of top-tier subsidiaries, we deliver innovative, high-impact solutions in gas, electric, water, and more.

From the ground up, we’re committed to safety, quality, and integrity. If you're looking to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company making a real difference, welcome to Meruelo Enterprises.

 

About the Role:

The DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning and continuously improving the company’s transportation compliance and fleet safety programs across all operations. Reporting directly to the Director of Safety, this role serves as the enterprise subject‑matter expert for DOT/CHP compliance, fleet risk reduction, incident investigation, and telematics-driven performance management.

This position has no direct reports but carries company‑wide authority and accountability for transportation safety outcomes, compliance readiness, and fleet risk mitigation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Own all transportation compliance programs, including DOT/FMCSA (as applicable), CHP, DMV pull‑notice, driver qualification files, medical certification tracking, and onboarding controls.

²  Plan, lead, and support internal and external transportation audits and inspections.

²  Interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical SOPs, controls, and field‑ready tools.

²  Lead initiatives to reduce preventable incidents, injuries, and claim severity across CDL and non‑CDL fleets.

²  Conduct transportation incident and collision investigations; perform root‑cause analysis and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions.

²  Partner with Risk Management, Insurance, and Legal on claim documentation, trends, and litigation support.

²  Serve as program owner for fleet telematics and safety technology platforms (e.g., Samsara, Geotab, Lytx or similar).

²  Develop and maintain driver scorecards, coaching workflows, compliance alerts, and trend analysis.

²  Produce monthly dashboards and executive summaries for the VP of Safety and leadership team.

²  Develop and deliver transportation safety training, refresher programs, and remedial coaching.

²  Equip field leaders with coaching tools and clear compliance expectations.

²  Perform field observations, yard reviews, and ride‑alongs as needed.

²  Create and maintain standardized SOPs, checklists, and documentation related to transportation compliance and fleet safety.

²  Lead cross‑functional corrective action plans with Operations, Fleet, HR, and Safety.

²  Support contractor and vendor transportation compliance expectations where applicable.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

²  Preventable incident frequency and severity trends

²  DOT/CHP audit readiness and outcomes

²  Driver coaching completion and improvement metrics

²  DMV pull‑notice and DQ file accuracy

²  Telematics utilization and leading indicator improvement

²  Timely investigation and corrective action closure

 

Qualifications:

²  5+ years of experience in transportation safety, DOT compliance, fleet risk, or safety roles within construction, utilities, logistics, or similar environments.

²  Demonstrated ownership of compliance programs and audits.

²  Strong incident investigation and corrective action leadership skills.

²  Strong analytical capability; working knowledge of Excel and fleet analytics platforms.

²  Experience supporting utility construction or heavy civil operations. (Preferred)

²  Familiarity with California fleet compliance standards and CHP interactions. (Preferred)

²  Experience with safety management systems and telematics‑driven coaching programs. (Preferred)

²  Safety or compliance certifications (CSP, ASP, CHST, accident investigation, etc.). (Preferred)

²  Bilingual Spanish a plus.

²  Reports directly to: VP of Safety

²  Works closely with: Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Risk/Insurance, HR, and Legal

²  Senior Individual Contributor (no direct reports)

²  Combination of office and field environment.

²  Regular visits to yards and jobsites across Southern California.

²  Occasional after‑hours support during serious incidents.

 

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Media Technology
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Senior Project Manager – Media Technology

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

We are looking for a strong leader to join the Broadcast Engineering team within Rogers as a Sr. Project Manager.  In this role, you will be responsible for delivering project management excellence on key strategic initiatives through disciplined execution. The breadth and complexity of these projects cannot be understated. The successful candidate should be able to oversee the impacts, interdependencies and timelines between functional teams and work to ensure project initiatives meet the goals and objectives set forth by the senior and executive leadership teams.

 

What you'll do: 

  • Manage infrastructure-related deployments, upgrades, and strategic technology initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Manage project funding, including Capital Authorization (CA) requests, budget development, forecasting, financial tracking, and variance reporting.
  • Developed business cases, procurement documentation, and financial approvals required to support project delivery.
  • Participate in vendor evaluation and selection processes, including RFP development, proposal reviews, and recommendation activities.
  • Manage vendor relationships and holding vendors accountable for contractual obligations, milestones, deliverables, schedules, and project outcomes.
  • Coordinate and facilitating workshops, discovery sessions, design reviews, and planning meetings with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Partner with stakeholders to evaluate requirements, scope changes, project impacts, and resource needs.
  • Developed and maintaining project plans, schedules, RAID logs, action registers, and project documentation.
  • Provide regular project status updates, executive summaries, dashboards, and governance reporting to stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, issues, and constraints early, and proactively driving mitigation and resolution plans.
  • Lead steering committee, governance, and stakeholder discussions to support informed decision-making and project alignment.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure deliverables are completed on time, dependencies are managed, and project momentum is maintained.
  • Conduct analysis and providing recommendations to support operational, financial, and technology decisions.
  • Ensure alignment between project delivery, financial objectives, strategic priorities, and operational goals.
  • Drive accountability across project teams by tracking commitments, following up on actions, removing roadblocks, and ensuring successful execution of key initiatives.

 

What you bring: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Broadcast Technology, or a related field or experience would be an asset.
  • PMP certification preferred; Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and SAFe certification considered assets.
  • 7+ years of project management experience, preferably leading complex technology, infrastructure, media asset management, broadcast engineering, or digital media transformation projects.
  • Experience delivering projects within a broadcast, media, content production, streaming, or digital media environment.
  • Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
  • Knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and technology deployment lifecycles.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, programs, and cross-functional workstreams.
  • Experience with Media Asset Management (MAM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), content workflows, video content management systems, or related broadcast technologies.
  • Proven experience managing project budgets, capital funding, forecasting, financial reporting, and cost controls.
  • Experience developing business cases, Capital Authorization (CA) submissions, procurement documentation, and vendor statements of work.
  • Demonstrated experience participating in vendor selection processes, RFP evaluations, contract negotiations, and vendor governance activities.
  • Proven ability to manage vendor performance, track deliverables, facilitate workshops, and ensure contractual commitments are achieved.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with experience presenting project status, risks, financials, and recommendations to senior leadership and steering committees.
  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Project, Microsoft 365 applications, and project reporting tools.
  • Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and other Atlassian tools considered an asset.
  • Strong financial, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and drive projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing changing priorities and competing business objectives.
  • A commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Belonging, and Accessibility, helping create an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and supported.

 

What's in it for you? 

 

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including: 

 

  • Competitive salary & annual bonus.
  • Competitive & flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA, and Stock matching programs.
  • Discounts: Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
  • Paid time off for volunteering.
  • Company matching contributions to charities you support.

 

Growth & Development Opportunities

  • Self-driven career development programs
  • Rogers First: priority in applying to internal roles of interest

 

Wellness Programs

  • Employee & family assistance program
  • Virtual Healthcare
  • Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
  • Low or no-cost fitness membership

 

Our commitment to diversity:

  • An inclusive and diverse workplace where you can bring your whole self to work.

 

To protect our people, brand and assets, a pre-employment background check will be conducted. As part of our selection process, all candidates must clear a criminal background check. Additionally, a credit check and drivers abstract may be required depending on the role.

job.title: Human Resources Generalist
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Fox Television Stations (FTS) HR team is seeking a business-minded, hands-on HR Business Partner to support our Sales Team, Finance and other corporate functions. This role is for an experienced HR professional who pairs strategic thinking with strong day-to-day execution and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast and streaming environment.


Reporting to the Senior Regional HR Director, the HRBP will own day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle while acting as a trusted advisor to department leadership. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, credibility, and the ability to translate business needs into practical people solutions. This individual will be comfortable navigating change and balancing competing priorities.


The HRBP will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, and Learning & Development, to deliver a consistent and effective employee experience across stations.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner and advisor to station leadership, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, staffing models, and people priorities
  • Serve as the primary HR resource for employees and managers, providing guidance on policies, procedures, benefits, and employment practices and resolving issues directly
  • Develop a deep understanding of sales, finance and corporate function, and proactively identify people needs and opportunities
  • Lead talent management and performance processes, including talent reviews, succession planning for key roles, development planning, and performance management
  • Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives that strengthen performance, collaboration, and team culture
  • Manage offboarding and exit interview processes, analyzing themes and trends to inform retention strategies and recommendations to department leadership
  • Provide solutions-oriented counsel on employee relations matters, conducting or coordinating investigations and partnering with Employment Legal and HR leadership as appropriate
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Compensation on hiring strategies, recruitment, and competitive offer development
  • Own the new hire experience, including onboarding, orientation, and Form I-9 completion and compliance, and continuously improve onboarding practices in partnership with Talent Acquisition and HR Operations
  • Coach and advise managers on employee development, performance, scheduling challenges, team effectiveness, and management practices
  • Use workforce data, including headcount, turnover, and leave trends, to identify issues, influence decisions, and recommend actions to leadership
  • Ensure accurate and timely employee data in Workday, including new hires, job changes, transfers, promotions, and terminations, and regularly audit station data for accuracy
  • Partner across HR functions to ensure programs and policies are effectively implemented and aligned with department needs
  • Support HR initiatives and special projects that advance FTS and FOX's broader people and business strategies
  • Maintain a strong understanding of employment law, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements across the markets supported
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including Form I-9, required postings, mandatory trainings, and record keeping, and identify and address compliance risks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience supporting complex, fast-paced, or multi-location organizations
  • Experience in broadcast, local media, news, or another 24/7, deadline-driven operating environment strongly preferred
  • Broad HR expertise across the employee lifecycle, including talent management, employee relations, performance management, organizational design, and workforce planning
  • Hands-on experience with core HR operations, including onboarding, Form I-9 compliance, and HRIS transactions, with the ability to both execute directly and improve processes
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies
  • Excellent judgment and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive employee matters with discretion
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt to executive, management, and employee audiences
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to inform recommendations; experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships across HR functions and with stakeholders in multiple locations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility to support employees across shifts, including occasional early morning, evening, or weekend needs
  • Willingness to travel to supported locations as needed up to 25%.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

Headquartered in Chicago, the Big Ten Network (BTN) is a joint venture between FOX Sports and the Big Ten Conference, dedicated to delivering comprehensive coverage of the nation's premier collegiate conference. As part of the broader FOX Sports portfolio, BTN produces more than 3,100 live events across all platforms, paired with studio shows, game highlights, and original programming across linear and digital platforms. 


FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest sports, media, and entertainment companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects, which provides valuable work experience and leadership skills.


Please note that this internship is an on-site opportunity in Chicago, IL.


ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program 
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Strong academic record 
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned Internship site
  • Must be able to work on-site in Chicago, IL
  • Must be available on weekdays/weekends

  • Must demonstrate knowledge of the company and sports media industry

  • Explain why your background and experience make you a good fit for our program
  • Share your top areas of interest 

 

STUDENTS ACCEPTED INTO THE SUMMER 2027 PROGRAM:

Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment

Depending on your area of interest, you’ll have an opportunity to participate in one of the following below. Please include one top area in your cover letter.


  • Corporate Partnerships: The Corporate Partnerships Intern supports the Big Ten Corporate Partnership across both the Partnership Activation and Business Development groups. The intern will gain full lifecycle sponsorship experience - from lead generation to activation. Tasks include managing select Big Ten partner activations, asset tracking, event planning & execution and recap reports. On the business development side, the intern will contribute to updating the sales pipeline, tracking industry trends, researching prospects and building materials to help drive new revenue opportunities.
  • Creative Services: The Creative Services intern will work alongside the design team to learn how to develop various motion graphics, branded projects, support elements and beyond. This position will sit within a team of motion graphics designers across various experience levels. Technically, these projects will require versioning 2D elements using Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator, exploring 3D design in Cinema 4D, and producing completed graphics with Adobe After Effects for both studio and remote live programming.
  • Digital: The Digital Intern will work closely with the Digital Content, Digital Partnerships, Streaming and Video Operations teams. During the internship, you will have exposure/will be able to support content strategy/social media distribution, video archives, customer relationship management, and digital research.

  • Marketing: The Marketing Intern supports event marketing initiatives for signature events, including the BTN Big 10K, Football Media Days, and B1G Tailgate. This role requires hands-on experience in brand strategy, sports marketing, social media promotion, and event planning.
  • Originals & Storytelling: The Originals & Storytelling Intern will be responsible for providing production support to our originals team on summer productions. This can range from assisting going through interviews, helping screen and locate footage, helping organize BTN assets, creating player reels and scenic reels, and going on location for Big Ten Football Media Day.
  • Remote Production: The Remote Production Intern will work with the production staff to help prepare for live game broadcasts on the Big Ten Network and B1G+. This may include working on and preparing for coverage of our fall sports such as football, helping prepare and execute Big Ten Volleyball media days and organizing a variety of production elements and paperwork to get prepared for the upcoming season.
  • Studio Production: The Studio Production Intern will help us prepare for the upcoming season, as well as assisting with production of B1G Today studio show. Duties will include logging games, finding footage, and producing video highlight packages. The intern will also be a part of the planning and production of football and volleyball media days.

Summer Session 2: Monday, June 21, 2027 - Friday, August 13, 2027

  • The ability to maintain a professional demeanor when interfacing with talent and executives.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. About WLOX:

Ready to join a newsroom that aggressively uncovers the truth? For over six decades, WLOX has been South Mississippi's undisputed news leader, proudly holding down both the #1 and #2 spots as the region's ABC and CBS affiliate. We're building the future of local news with a sharp focus on impactful investigative journalism and leading the charge in digital storytelling across every platform. WLOX is on the hunt for a Multimedia Journalist who can bring their A-game to every platform, from broadcast to the web, and into the heart of our community. If you're a self-starter with a nose for news and a passion for connecting with audiences wherever they are, then this is your opportunity to make a significant impact!

- Craft compelling stories: Write, shoot, and edit engaging news stories for TV, web, and all our digital platforms, ensuring our community is always informed and connected.
- Be the first on the scene: Report live and react instantly to breaking news, severe weather, or major community events, bringing real-time updates across every screen and channel.
- Unearth vital narratives: Research, pitch, and develop impactful news stories that resonate deeply with our local audience and shed light on important issues.
- Own the moment: Navigate fast-paced, high-pressure environments and make sound, split-second decisions during live broadcasts, maintaining composure and confidence under pressure.
- Step up to the anchor desk: Seize opportunities to fill in as an anchor, showcasing your versatility and leadership in front of the camera (based on your interest and ability, of course!).

Qualifications/Requirements:

- A degree in Communications/Journalism or an equivalent passion-driven, real-world experience (we value grit and smarts!).
- An insatiable curiosity for current events and what truly matters to our local community.
- Digital fluency: You're not just comfortable with social media; you wield it as a powerful newsgathering, storytelling, and audience engagement tool.
- Team player & solo star: You thrive in collaborative environments but are equally effective working independently, especially when deadlines are tight.
- Physical readiness: Able to confidently lift and carry essential equipment, including your tripod, camera, and lights—because great stories don't always happen in a studio!
- A clean driving record and a valid driver's license (essential for covering stories across our community).
- Unshakeable news judgment: You know a story when you see it, how to tell it responsibly, and why it matters to our viewers.
- Urgency with empathy: You're driven to get the story first, but always with respect, understanding, and a commitment to accuracy.

Job Summary: Job Requirements Disney Experiences Intelligence (DXi) influences data-driven and consumer-centric decision making with integrated, objective, and actionable insights across Disney Experiences. The Advanced Modeling team within DXi applies innovative methods to some of the most complex and consequential questions facing Disney Experiences, including advanced, scalable forecasting, attribution and causal inference, guest behavior modeling, and experimental design and survey science. These are questions with no off-the-shelf answer. We partner with executives and teams across DXi, turning complex business questions into actionable intelligence. We are hiring an Analytics & Optimization Manager who is an expert in the science behind statistics and modern AI/ML, and an excellent Python programmer. You will bring the methodological depth to solve complex modeling problems and contribute to the team’s technical growth. You are an ideal candidate if you have a strong scientific and modeling background, stay at the cutting edge of methods and are curious, resourceful, and always learning. You choose the right method for an ambiguous problem, explain why it fits, and show that it holds up. This is an individual contributor role, reporting to Manager, Advanced Sales Analytics and is based in Celebration, FL. What You Will Do: Modeling and methods Own the methodology for modeling projects: select the method, define the assumptions, and design how the results will be validated, with a vision of how it will run at scale. Build scalable forecasting models that integrate structural and dynamic regression with machine learning through hybrid and ensemble approaches, producing probabilistic forecasts and scenario analyses to support planning and decision-making under uncertainty. Develop causal inference and attribution models to quantify the drivers of business outcomes, leveraging methods from difference-in-differences to synthetic control, instrumental variables, and double machine learning. Develop reusable frameworks that can be extended as new data and business questions emerge. Conduct conditional forecasts and scenario analyses under alternative assumptions and apply causal methods to estimate counterfactual outcomes and treatment effects associated with changes in specific business levers, explicitly quantifying uncertainty. Model guest behavior over time, using survival analysis, customer-based models, and related methods to answer important questions about long-term patterns and their drivers. Adapt methods when standard approaches break down, such as sparse data, short histories, or selection bias. Technical leadership Apply rigorous modeling practices: validation, back testing, calibration, and uncertainty reporting. Conduct technical review of assumptions, identification, and leakage, including high-visibility results before they go to senior leadership. Follow and help improve team practices for reproducibility, experiment tracking, and code review, and write maintainable, well-documented modeling code. Evaluate emerging machine learning and AI methods, including foundation models, benchmark them against established approaches, and share findings with the team. Business partnership Scope ambiguous business questions into well-posed modeling problems and recommend appropriate analytical approaches. Translate complex results into clear recommendations, state their limits, and push back constructively when a requested analysis cannot support the conclusion being sought. Required Qualifications & Skills: Master’s degree in Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 3+ years of professional data science and complex modeling experience. Demonstrated expertise in time-series forecasting and probabilistic (including Bayesian) modeling, and knowledge of supervised and unsupervised machine learning, including how to select and apply the right method for a given problem. Strong understanding of causal inference and quasi-experimental methods, and how to apply them to attribution and driver analysis, including the distinction between predictive relationships and causal effects. Proficient in Python, including writing clean, efficient, production-quality code Advanced SQL and experience with large analytical datasets (e.g., Snowflake). Ability to communicate complex methodology clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications PhD in a related quantitative field with 1+ year of relevant professional experience, or a Master’s degree with 5+ years of relevant professional experience. Experience with scalable and reproducible data science practices, such as distributed or parallel computing, experiment tracking, containerization, CI/CD, or related modern ML engineering tools. Experience using AI coding and analysis tools to design, build, and accelerate complex modeling work, with the judgment to validate what they produce. Experience with additional advanced modeling methods. Experience evaluating and applying LLM and generative AI methods to real-world problems. Experience in travel, hospitality, entertainment, or consumer-facing businesses. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Orlando is $113,500-$152,200 per year. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Software Engineer II - AI Insights Job ID 10164956 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Software Engineer II - AI Insights Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Job Description Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. The Observability & Insights group ensures that Disney Streaming’s distributed systems are reliable, performant, and transparent. We build the telemetry, dashboards, alerting, insights pipelines, and developer experience tooling that enable engineers across the organization to understand system health and take action quickly. Job Summary As a Software Engineer II, you will design and build intelligent, AI driven systems that enhance the reliability and compliance posture of Disney's large-scale streaming infrastructure. You will develop agentic systems, machine learning models, and real-time automation that transform telemetry, logs, and infrastructure signals into automated detection, root cause analysis, and proactive policy enforcement and insights. In this role, you will contribute to the development of autonomous agents capable of reasoning over complex system behavior, identifying issues in real time, and driving faster detection and resolution across Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN. You will also contribute to systems that provide infrastructure visibility across a variety of Disney products, enforce compliance through preventative guardrails, correlate services to incidents for faster resolution, and quantify the impact of AI-driven observability tools on operational outcomes. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to embed intelligence directly into operational workflows, improving system resilience and compliance posture at scale. As a Software Engineer II, you will deliver high quality features end-to-end, contribute to system design and architecture reviews, and begin owning components of production systems within a fast-paced, AI-native SRE engineering environment. Responsibilities Design and operate intelligent, production-grade systems that leverage real-time signals and AI-driven detection to improve the health of streaming platforms, critical services, and customer experience Build and scale AI-driven capabilities including agentic AI systems powered by modern foundation models (e.g. Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT-4) enabling automated reasoning and decisioning, as well as predictive modeling and anomaly detection for real-time system health and reliability Develop end-to-end data and decisioning pipelines that transform telemetry, logs, and user signals into actionable insights, automated detection, and root cause analysis Create and deploy scalable APIs and services that deliver predictive signals, explainability, and insights to engineering teams, operational tools, and product stakeholders Contribute to infrastructure visibility and compliance enforcement systems that aggregate resource data across Disney products, enable ownership-scoped querying, and prevent non-compliant deployments Partner cross-functionally to embed intelligence into workflows (incident response, release validation, customer insights), improving speed and reducing operational overhead Drive innovation in observability, reliability, and developer productivity through applied AI and new approaches Basic Qualifications 3+ years of applicable experience in backend development, including building AI-powered or data driven applications and scalable APIs (e.g. FastAPI, Flask) Knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture to inform what infrastructure characteristics should be measured and evaluated for reliability and compliance Practical experience in AI/ML engineering, with knowledge in at least one of the following areas: Agentic Workflows: Orchestrating foundation models (GPT-4, Claude) using frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph. Traditional ML: Developing, training, or fine-tuning models using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow. Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate engineering velocity. Experience with modern development practices, including version control (GitHub), containerization (Docker), and cloud-native deployments (AWS/EKS). Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, and standard SDLC workflows. Strong analytical and technical skills to troubleshoot issues, perform rapid iteration and quickly come-up with the possible solutions, Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and clearly explain complex technical concepts Preferred Qualifications Experience with observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, Conviva) and handling high-volume telemetry data. Familiarity with large-scale data platforms and distributed data processing tools (e.g., PySpark, Pandas, Databricks, Snowflake). Knowledge of prompt design, model evaluation, and fine-tuning foundation models (GPT-4, Claude). Experience implementing production-grade systems at scale within a fast-paced, distributed environment. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY Job Posting Statement The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $124,900.00 to $167,400.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.
