job.title: Lead Business Information Analyst
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Lead Business Information Analyst Job ID 10164349 Location Orlando, Florida, United States Business Disney Experiences Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Lead Business Information Analyst Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Job Requirements We are looking for a Lead Business Information Analyst who will be the primary link between Data Products & Platform and the business user community across Disney Experiences, including partners in Marketing, Decision Sciences, Industrial Engineering, Commercial Strategy, and Operations. You will own how we listen to, communicate with, and build relationships across that community, and you will work with our teams to set the goals we hold ourselves to and measure real progress against them. You will bring the community's voice into what we commit to next and tell the story of what we have delivered. You will also serve as the organization's liaison to the annual financial planning cycle and run the operating rhythm that keeps commitments, decisions, and communications moving in sync. This role reports to a Director in Data Products & Platform and works closely with product managers, who own depth on individual products, by providing the community-wide view no single product can see. Key Responsibilities Community Relationships & Listening Serve as the front door for the business user community, building trusted relationships across Disney Experiences functions and representing the full community rather than any one product's users Listen through surveys, forums, and direct feedback, and identify patterns across products and user groups Route insight to product managers and team leads, and close the loop so partners see what changed because of their input OKRs & Measurement Work with internal teams to turn objectives into measurable key results with clear targets, favoring outcomes the community cares about (adoption, reliability, time to value, satisfaction) over internal activity Design the measurement framework for each key result, choosing the right source (platform and usage data, delivery metrics, operational data, surveys) and building new instruments where none exist Partner with data teams to source, calculate, and validate results Maintain scorecards that give an honest, consistent view of progress and risk Communications & Organizational Narrative Decide which OKRs and results are community-facing and tell the story in plain language, capturing accomplishments so good work is recognized Run monthly forums, newsletters, training, and organization-wide events, plus platform-wide release and migration communications, so the community hears one consistent voice Financial Planning & Funding Liaison Serve as the liaison between teams and finance for the annual cycle (capital requests, annual operating plans, long-term plans, budgets), coordinating inputs so submissions are consistent, complete, and on time Connect funding requests to OKRs and measured outcomes, so the case for investment is grounded in results Flag funding risks to commitments early, with a recommendation Operating Rhythm & Follow-Through Own the planning and governance calendar (OKR reviews, decision forums, quarterly check-ins), providing the content, data, and narrative behind each and preparing leaders with pre-reads and talking points Keep a single record of decisions, actions, and owners, and follow through until items close Surface misalignment, dependencies, and off-track commitments early, and escalate with a recommendation Assess feasibility, effort, and cost, and drive cross-functional work to completion by clarifying scope, aligning owners, and removing blockers Handle sensitive information (funding positions, at-risk commitments, pre-decisional plans) with discretion, deciding what to share, with whom, and when What Success Looks Like Business partners across Disney Experiences know where to go, feel heard, and see their input reflected in what we deliver Every OKR has an agreed target and a trusted, working measurement, and there is one current view of progress and risk The community knows how we're doing against what we committed to Accomplishments are captured and told consistently, so good work gets seen Product managers receive community-wide insight they couldn't get on their own Funding submissions are consistent, on time, and tied to measurable outcomes Reviews and decisions happen on time with clear owners Sensitive information is handled with discretion, and leaders trust this role with it Required Qualifications 7+ years in business analysis, program management, strategy and operations, or a similar cross-functional role, with experience leading work across teams without direct authority Experience defining OKRs, KPIs, or similar performance frameworks and actually measuring them, using data from multiple sources, including surveys and feedback instruments, and analyzing both quantitative and qualitative results Demonstrated ability to build trust with a broad business community, including senior stakeholders, and to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences Excellent writing and storytelling: turning accomplishments, metrics, and feedback into clear, engaging updates for a broad audience Strong facilitation, prioritization, and follow-through across multiple concurrent workstreams Working familiarity with annual planning, capital request, and budget processes, and the ability to partner effectively with finance Exceptional judgment and discretion with confidential and sensitive information Preferred Experience in a data, analytics, or technology organization Familiarity with data platforms, governance, or product management practices Experience with survey or feedback tools and automating measurement workflows Experience with internal communications, change management, training, or event planning Working knowledge of process mapping, use cases, or UML for documenting workflows Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $113,500 to $152,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Content Sales Assistant - ANZ/APAC
job.description:
FOX Entertainment Global is FOX Entertainment’s centralized content sales division, providing the worldwide multi-platform marketplace with exclusive access to its diverse, rapidly expanding production pipeline and library of owned original programming and co-production partnerships.  A central component of FOX Entertainment’s long-term growth strategy is to fortify its globally recognized, world-class brand and owned distribution platforms spanning broadcast and streaming with FOX Entertainment Global’s singular focus on broadly distributing the company’s full portfolio of owned intellectual property across all genres of scripted, unscripted and animated programming, including film and television titles as well as vertical and creator-led content.

FOX Entertainment Global is seeking a Content Sales Assistant - APAC and ANZ. The Content Sales Assistant plays a critical role in supporting the sales team across various activities and functions, including sales and account management, as well as administrative duties. The Content Sales Assistant reports to the two Directors of Content Sales APAC and ANZ and works closely with the wider Global Sales Team and other departments across the organization (Strategy & Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, Marketing, Finance, etc.) to ensure we meet and anticipate the needs of our global client base.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in day-to-day account management, including creation and curation of high-volume rights availability listings, preparation of sales pitch materials (presentations, ratings reports, etc), and addressing deliverables queries
  • Assist with marketing and events
  • Assist in analyzing territories and gathering market research
  • Manage sales tracking, including inputting client and deal information into company systems and generating regular sales reports
  • Client interactions
  • Language version tracking and report preparation
  • Support the Directors with pre-sales and post-sales processes, business development initiatives, coordination of meetings and events with clients, and any other requests
  • Provide email/call support as needed and act as the first screen/main point of contact for incoming business-related requests
  • Alongside the Sales team, provides post-market follow-ups, including but not limited to screening materials and marketing information
  • Keep an accurate record of content feedback on the internal company system in a timely fashion for internal stakeholders and producers' reports
  • Track the availability of foreign language versions of FOX content (i.e., dubbed versions) for our client base
  • Proactively communicate and build collaborative relationships with cross-functional teams and external partners to ensure best-in-class customer service and business practices
  • Some travel as required
  • Perform other duties as required

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 2+ years of experience in a sales, operations, or administrative role within an entertainment/media company
  • Self-starter and detail-oriented with excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, proficient in administrative tasks, and passionate about the entertainment industry
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and time management skills
  • Strong interest and passion in media and entertainment, with the capability to learn complex industry topics quickly
  • Working understanding of rights management as it relates to distribution
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Ability to listen effectively, transmit information accurately and understandably, and actively seek feedback
  • Ability to maintain confidential information
  • Promptly adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and shifting priorities
  • Aptitude and flexibility to work well on multiple projects in various phases of the sales cycle in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Confidence and professionalism in client interactions
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and good judgment in all interactions with colleagues, customers, vendors, and stakeholders
  • Fluent English speaker

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Rightsline, and Microsoft Office Suite, with a focus on Excel

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Human Resources Generalist
job.description:
The Fox Television Stations (FTS) HR team is seeking a business-minded, hands-on HR Business Partner to support our Sales Team, Finance and other corporate functions. This role is for an experienced HR professional who pairs strategic thinking with strong day-to-day execution and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast and streaming environment.

Reporting to the Senior Regional HR Director, the HRBP will own day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle while acting as a trusted advisor to department leadership. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, credibility, and the ability to translate business needs into practical people solutions. This individual will be comfortable navigating change and balancing competing priorities.

The HRBP will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, and Learning & Development, to deliver a consistent and effective employee experience across stations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner and advisor to station leadership, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, staffing models, and people priorities
  • Serve as the primary HR resource for employees and managers, providing guidance on policies, procedures, benefits, and employment practices and resolving issues directly
  • Develop a deep understanding of sales, finance and corporate function, and proactively identify people needs and opportunities
  • Lead talent management and performance processes, including talent reviews, succession planning for key roles, development planning, and performance management
  • Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives that strengthen performance, collaboration, and team culture
  • Manage offboarding and exit interview processes, analyzing themes and trends to inform retention strategies and recommendations to department leadership
  • Provide solutions-oriented counsel on employee relations matters, conducting or coordinating investigations and partnering with Employment Legal and HR leadership as appropriate
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Compensation on hiring strategies, recruitment, and competitive offer development
  • Own the new hire experience, including onboarding, orientation, and Form I-9 completion and compliance, and continuously improve onboarding practices in partnership with Talent Acquisition and HR Operations
  • Coach and advise managers on employee development, performance, scheduling challenges, team effectiveness, and management practices
  • Use workforce data, including headcount, turnover, and leave trends, to identify issues, influence decisions, and recommend actions to leadership
  • Ensure accurate and timely employee data in Workday, including new hires, job changes, transfers, promotions, and terminations, and regularly audit station data for accuracy
  • Partner across HR functions to ensure programs and policies are effectively implemented and aligned with department needs
  • Support HR initiatives and special projects that advance FTS and FOX's broader people and business strategies
  • Maintain a strong understanding of employment law, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements across the markets supported
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including Form I-9, required postings, mandatory trainings, and record keeping, and identify and address compliance risks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience supporting complex, fast-paced, or multi-location organizations
  • Experience in broadcast, local media, news, or another 24/7, deadline-driven operating environment strongly preferred
  • Broad HR expertise across the employee lifecycle, including talent management, employee relations, performance management, organizational design, and workforce planning
  • Hands-on experience with core HR operations, including onboarding, Form I-9 compliance, and HRIS transactions, with the ability to both execute directly and improve processes
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies
  • Excellent judgment and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive employee matters with discretion
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt to executive, management, and employee audiences
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to inform recommendations; experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships across HR functions and with stakeholders in multiple locations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility to support employees across shifts, including occasional early morning, evening, or weekend needs
  • Willingness to travel to supported locations as needed up to 25%.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Specialist, Learning and Talent Development
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV 

 

Location: New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on what the data says

• Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• 6+ years writing software

• 3+ years building Roku applications

• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

• You know OOP, data structures, and algorithms well enough to design systems, not just pass interviews

• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3

• You can explain Roku's memory model, the render-thread/task-thread split, device tiers, and what certification requires

• RESTful API design and data serialization

• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay

• Unit and integration testing on Roku

• HTTP protocol and caching behavior

• Git and GitHub

• You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them

• You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)

• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS

• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry

• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns

• You've worked with personalization or recommendation APIs on resource-constrained devices

• E2E testing for connected-device applications

• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)

• GraphQL

• You share AI tools and workflows that save the team time

• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right

• You say "I don't know" when you don't know

• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock you

 

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 

• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day

• Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough

• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what happened

• You track Roku OS releases and adopt new APIs when they solve a real problem, not because they're new

• You write architecture docs, component guides, and Slack explanations that save ten people from asking the same question

• You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better one

• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features

• You make the people around you better at their jobs

job.description:

  Overview Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team is part of Enterprise Solutions & Technology. They create a shared AI agent infrastructure. This infrastructure supports teams in Finance, Legal & Business Affairs, Content Operations, Rights, People, and Technology. It helps these teams complete their business workflows using AI. As our Lead AI Engineer, you’ll build secure, production AI applications that orchestrate large language models, enterprise APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and Automation Anywhere bots. Your applications will execute business workflows with human approvals, audit trails and monitoring built in. In this individual contributor role, you will work directly with business stakeholders. You will use a forward deployed model and take responsibility for applications. This means you will discover problems, develop user interfaces, coordinate with multiple agents, test the applications, deploy them, and manage operations. You’ll make application architecture, agent design, tool design and model selection decisions, while collaborating with the hiring manager and architecture review process on platform standards.     Responsibilities
  • Architect and build secure, full stack AI applications using Python, TypeScript, APIs and React or similar user interface frameworks. Integrate LLMs, including Gemini, Claude, GPT and open weight models through Vertex AI and Azure OpenAI, with enterprise systems, MCP tool servers and Automation Anywhere A360 and Agentic Process Automation bots. Support workflows across ERP, HR, ITSM, finance close, electronic signatures and collaboration platforms.
  • Implement coordination across multiple agents using planner and worker, supervisor and handoff patterns with Google Agent Development Kit, Agent Engine, LangGraph or equivalent tools. Build deterministic guardrails, approval gates, role based permissions and complete audit trails so automated actions are explainable, attributable and reversible. Design state management, retries, idempotency and escalation paths for workflows that run over extended periods.
  • Apply enterprise security controls. Use OAuth2/OIDC and ensure service identities have the least privilege access. Manage secrets and implement defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration, like Model Armor. Also, make sure to administer PII properly and maintain audit evidence that meets SOX requirements. Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit and Legal to define and maintain the security and production readiness checklist for agentic applications across the enterprise.
  • Build automated evaluation suites covering task success, groundedness, safety, latency and cost. Develop regression tests, CI/CD pipelines, OpenTelemetry tracing of agent steps, token and spend telemetry, SLOs and on call runbooks. Lead production readiness reviews and drive improvements following incidents
  • Partner with business process owners to identify valuable workflows, develop rapid prototypes, define success metrics and ROI, and turn pilots into supported production products. Translate requirements for offshore contractors and vendor engineers, and review their deliverables for quality and security.
  • Contribute reusable MCP servers, agent templates, approval interface components and evaluation harnesses to the shared platform. Create reference architectures and documentation. Mentor engineers in Enterprise Solutions & Technology. Help them understand development practices that encourage self-sufficiency.
  • Support ad hoc projects, including proofs of concept for executive stakeholders and evaluation of emerging models, protocols such as MCP and A2A, and vendor capabilities.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2 years of designing and delivering production LLM applications. The applications should be used by real users on an enterprise scale. They must have features like retrieval augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agents.
  • Expertise in Python or be proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript. Experience in full stack development is required. This means you will create backend services and APIs, like FastAPI or Node. You should also know modern frontend frameworks such as React. It is necessary to have experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Extensive functional experience with at least one major cloud platform. Google Cloud experience, including Vertex AI, Cloud Run/GKE, Pub/Sub and IAM, is preferred; AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. Experience must include Docker/Kubernetes, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and CI/CD.
  • Proven experience building agentic systems with orchestration across multiple steps, tool integration including MCP, state management, human approval flows, and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs for correctness, safety and cost.
  • Understand enterprise integration and automation. This includes knowledge of REST and GraphQL APIs. Also, knowledge of event-driven architectures, workflow and business process management concepts, and RPA platforms. Automation Anywhere is preferred; UiPath or Power Automate experience is acceptable.
  • Solid knowledge of application security and compliance. This covers authentication, authorization, secrets management, data privacy, and audit logging. You also need a successful history of passing security and architecture reviews.
  • Great communication skills are important. You need to lead discovery sessions with business partners who might not have technical backgrounds. You should also write clear design documents. Additionally, you will present tradeoffs to senior leaders.
  • Experience coordinating with offshore or globally distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent functional experience.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Experience with Automation Anywhere’s agentic capabilities, including AI Agent Studio, Process Reasoning Engine and Control Room/A360 governance, or building AI agents that invoke RPA bots as tools.
  • Experience with Google’s agent stack, including Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine, Gemini Enterprise and Model Armor, or with Azure OpenAI and Anthropic Claude platforms.
  • Experience authoring MCP servers, working with the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol or contributing to open source agent frameworks.
  • Awareness with LLM evaluation tools such as Vertex AI Evaluation, Ragas, DeepEval and Promptfoo.
  • Prior experience in media and entertainment business operations is preferred. This experience can include rights and royalties, content supply chain, finance procedures, and SOX controls. It can also include legal contract workflows. Alternatively, experience in a consulting role with Fortune 500 clients is acceptable.
  • Experience with token budgeting, caching, model routing and user interface design for enterprise applications.

job.description:

We are looking for a Cloud Team Lead to lead the cloud and DevOps team that builds and operates the infrastructure behind TEGNA's content management and streaming platforms across Azure and AWS. Content management runs on Azure (C#/.NET Function Apps, Service Bus), streaming runs on AWS media services, and cloud-agnostic services run on Kubernetes — all Terraform-managed. Reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager, this is a hands-on technical leadership role: you lead a team of onshore and offshore cloud engineers, own the team's delivery and the reliability of the platform's infrastructure, and stay hands-on in the work. You partner closely with the Cloud Architect — who sets reference architectures and standards and holds production approval — to deliver well-architected infrastructure, and with the microservices pods on their infrastructure needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead a distributed team of cloud/DevOps engineers (onshore and offshore), owning planning, delivery, quality, and day-to-day technical direction.
  • Remain hands-on: contribute to Terraform/infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes workloads across Azure and AWS.
  • Own the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of the platform's infrastructure, including incident response and the on-call rotation.
  • Break infrastructure initiatives and epics into actionable, well-sequenced work, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform health.
  • Partner with the Cloud Architect to apply the standards, reference architectures, and guardrails they define, and with the dev pods to support their delivery.
  • Drive engineering practices across the team: IaC standards, pipeline safety, observability, and security.
  • Mentor and grow engineers, and manage the throughput and quality of offshore contributors.

  • Solid experience with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM/identity, observability, and security best practices.

The role also provides as-needed support to Development and Membership and serves as backup to the Senior Executive Assistant to the President & CEO, including assisting with organization-wide internal meetings such as all-staff meetings.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

job.title: E-Commerce & Growth Manager
job.description:
Job Title

E-Commerce & Growth Manager

Job Description

About the Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

Our CPG team brings our brands into consumers’ everyday lives through new products, beginning with our beverage business. The ECommerce & Growth Manager, CPG will build and operate the direct-to-consumer engine behind this growing business - owning eCommerce performance across site, acquisition, conversion, retention, revenue performance and analytics.


This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn a beverage brand and an audience into a high-performing commerce channel. You’ll work closely across our CPG team (Brand Marketing, Social, Product, Newsletter, Operations, Finance, Sales and external partners) to launch, test, learn and scale. We’re looking for someone who will own this channel, its sales performance and its relationship with our customer.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and continuously optimize the commercial playbook across offers, bundles, merchandising, promotions and customer experience - scaling what works and eliminating what doesn’t.
  • Build and manage the CPG customer acquisition strategy and conversion funnel across paid, owned and emerging channels.
  • Own CRM and lifecycle marketing, including email, SMS, welcome flows, abandoned cart, replenishment and retention programs.
  • Develop the promotional and eCommerce calendar in partnership with Brand Marketing and Operations, with a disciplined testing roadmap across creative, landing pages, pricing, offers and checkout.
  • Track and optimize core growth and profitability metrics including revenue, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, contribution margin, LTV, repeat rate and retention.
  • Manage eCommerce and growth agencies, freelancers, technology partners and platform vendors.
  • Partner with Operations on inventory, fulfillment, shipping experience and demand planning.
  • Build clear weekly and monthly performance reporting that translates data into recommendations and action.
  • Partner with People Inc. brands and editorial teams to turn existing audiences into commerce opportunities.
  • Support marketplace and retail eCommerce expansion as the business grows, and help establish the technology stack and processes required to scale.


Remote-

In-office Expectations: This position is fully remote with no in-office requirements (might require coming into an office a few times per year)


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field and/or equivalent experience.


Experience:

  • 6-8+ years of experience in eCommerce, growth marketing or digital commerce, with a track record of owning a meaningful Shopify or DTC business. Experience in CPG beverage is strongly preferred, though applicable food, beauty, wellness or another high-repeat consumer category will also be considered.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors and complex cross-functional projects.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Strong command of paid acquisition, CRM/lifecycle marketing and conversion optimization.
  • Analytical yet sales-oriented, with the ability to make commercial decisions, move quickly from strategy to execution, and test and pivot until the business grows.
  • Comfortable working directly with platforms and tools - not dependent on an agency to execute.
  • Strong understanding of eCommerce unit economics, including COGS, gross margin, shipping and fulfillment costs, promotional impact and contribution margin, with the ability to manage the channel as a healthy business.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across stakeholders.
  • A collaborative operating style that creates clarity, trust and accountability.
  • Ability and comfort with working in an early-stage environment where systems and playbooks are still being built.

% Travel Required (Approximate): Minimal travel to area offices and events as requested (<10%).

job.title: Vice President, Strategy & Business Transformation
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 


We are seeking an experienced, highly analytical, and execution-oriented Vice President, Strategy & Business Transformation. In this role, the incumbent will work closely with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and the senior leadership team to build and operationalize enterprise capabilities. Key responsibilities include translating strategic priorities into actionable business decisions, aligning resources around our highest-value opportunities, and driving measurable results.

 

This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between executive-level problem-solving and practical implementation. The successful candidate will help establish the frameworks, processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable leaders to make informed decisions, prioritize investments, manage competing resources, and accelerate strategic initiatives.

 

The ideal candidate combines the analytical rigor of a management consultant with the pragmatism of an operator. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, influencing senior stakeholders, and turning complex business questions into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Importantly, this role serves as an enabler and facilitator of enterprise strategy. Business leaders retain accountability for decisions and execution within their respective functions.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Enterprise Strategy & Executive Alignment

  • Partner with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and executive leadership to translate the enterprise operating model into actionable priorities, processes, and governance.
  • Facilitate executive alignment on strategic priorities, organizational objectives, decision rights, and resource allocation.
  • Help define the Strategy Team’s mandate, operating model, engagement approach, and partnership with business functions.
  • Prepare executive presentations, decision briefs, and recommendations to support critical business decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen cross-functional alignment and accelerate enterprise-wide initiatives.

 

Strategic Portfolio & Initiative Management

  • Establish and maintain a consolidated view of enterprise initiatives, strategic investments, resources, ownership, milestones, and expected business outcomes.
  • Develop consistent evaluation frameworks to assess initiatives based on strategic alignment, financial and operational value, ownership, and execution capacity.
  • Facilitate portfolio reviews and recommend opportunities to accelerate, continue, sequence, redesign, or discontinue initiatives.
  • Identify resource constraints, competing priorities, dependencies, and opportunities to redirect capacity toward higher-value business objectives.
  • Establish transparent portfolio reporting and tracking mechanisms.

 

Business Strategy & Decision Support

  • Lead and support high-priority strategic engagements across the organization, translating complex business questions into actionable recommendations.
  • Develop business cases, financial analyses, scenario models, and strategic assessments to inform investment and resource decisions.
  • Create structured decision-making frameworks that clearly outline business questions, supporting evidence, alternatives, financial implications, risks, and recommendations.
  • Work backward from defined decision milestones to ensure strategic engagements produce timely, actionable outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, and organizational alignment.

 

Strategy Operations & Governance

  • Design and implement the Strategy Team’s operating processes, including initiative intake, prioritization, engagement selection, and delivery tracking.
  • Establish and facilitate regular enterprise strategy reviews, portfolio reviews, and executive decision forums.
  • Develop governance tools, templates, decision logs, dashboards, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Clarify roles and responsibilities across executive sponsors, initiative owners, working teams, and decision-makers.
  • Streamline existing reporting and meeting structures to improve decision velocity and reduce unnecessary administrative processes.

 

Enterprise Performance & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Partner with Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Product, Editorial, and Revenue leadership to connect enterprise strategy with financial investment, organizational capacity, and business performance.
  • Develop an enterprise scorecard and key performance indicators to measure strategic progress, financial impact, execution, audience growth, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Monitor initiative performance, identify barriers to execution, and facilitate timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
  • Support change management and organizational adoption of new strategy processes and operating practices.
  • Build the capabilities, tools, and knowledge transfer necessary to establish a sustainable Strategy Operations function.

 

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Strategy, or a related discipline; advanced degree or MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business operations, enterprise transformation, or strategy execution.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise prioritization, portfolio management, and strategic operating frameworks.
  • Strong financial acumen, including business case development, financial modeling, investment analysis, and resource planning.
  • Proven ability to partner with CEOs, C-suite executives, and senior functional leaders.
  • Experience facilitating complex business discussions, challenging assumptions, and navigating competing priorities and resource tradeoffs.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, executive communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex information and ambiguity into concise insights, options, and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Media, digital publishing, advertising, audience development, subscription, product, or technology experience strongly preferred.

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change). 


Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Vets

job.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking a Systems Engineer for its Distribution IT Infrastructure team to manage, test, and maintain our enterprise virtualized infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking systems. In this role, you will deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot modern virtualization platforms (such as VMware vSphere, HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, or Proxmox) to guarantee high availability, scalability, and security across NPR's core distribution technologies.

This role sits at the intersection of physical and virtual infrastructure: you will help stand up new data center hardware and build NPR's private cloud environment on top of it, from rack and cable to hypervisor and host networking.

Working collaboratively with Infrastructure and Security colleagues, you will analyze business workflows, implement structured change management processes, and support capacity planning initiatives to deliver resilient, mission-critical operations for NPR and our nationwide Member station network.

Responsibilities

  • Physical Infrastructure Build-Out: Partner with Infrastructure colleagues to install, rack, cable, and configure new server, storage, and network hardware, including firmware updates, out-of-band management (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC), and RAID/BIOS configuration, to establish the foundation for virtualized workloads.
  • Virtual Infrastructure Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualized systems using enterprise tools (e.g., HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, Proxmox, Nutanix, Incus, or VMware) to support operational reliability.
  • Architecture Evaluation & Testing: Evaluate virtual system architecture, compare existing applications, and create metrics to measure response times and availability for test environments.
  • Change Management Implementation: Recommend and execute system enhancements following established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  • Operational & Capacity Support: Assist the Distribution Infrastructure team in executing cloud/virtualization workflows and capacity planning tools focused on return on investment and business value.
  • Security Alignment & Compliance: Partner with Security Engineers to ensure virtual hosts, operating systems, and network configurations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Workflow & Process Analysis: Analyze and document Distribution IT process workflows, identifying areas for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create comprehensive documentation, procedures, instructions, and training materials for internal colleagues and system users.
  • Incident Escalation & Operational Support: Proactively communicate operational status to management, participate in an on-call rotation, and respond to critical system issues on a 24x7 basis as needed.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and administering servers and networking within a data center environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in the planning, design, deployment, and management of enterprise virtualized cloud infrastructure (e.g., VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or open-source hypervisors).
  • Hands-on experience with physical data center hardware, including racking and cabling servers, configuring out-of-band 
  • Competence in DNS administration (BIND preferred).
  • Experience with IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP services.
  • Experience with configuration management (Puppet preferred).
  • Experience creating agentless automation workflows (Ansible preferred).
  • Experience with Mail Transfer Agent administration (Exim).
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration (2022+) alongside core directory and networking protocols (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS).
  • Practical experience supporting enterprise storage (NetApp or TrueNAS).
  • Comfortable with networking configuration of hosts, switches, and routers, including VLANs, trunking, and NIC bonding/link aggregation as applied to hypervisor hosts.
  • Proven track record as a key contributor or project leader on complex technical initiatives, including the creation of detailed technical documentation and workflow diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in a team environment, handle multiple concurrent projects, and contribute to an on-call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Unix/Linux networking configuration and Cisco switches and routers (Catalyst or Nexus/NX-OS).
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript).
  • Experience with enterprise backup/recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam).
  • Experience with HPE ProLiant or Dell PowerEdge server hardware.
  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems and relevant industry certifications (VMware VCP, Microsoft, or AWS).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • System Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve complex issues across hardware, server, storage, network, and virtualized layers.
  • Structured Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to present technical concepts and write actionable system documentation.
  • Prioritization Under Pressure: Capacity to prioritize tasks effectively during high-urgency system maintenance or operational incidents.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to partner seamlessly with Security, Network, and Distribution engineering teams.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Commitment to staying current with emerging virtualization tools, cloud platforms, and data center technologies.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience.

Work Location

Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Risk Sales is a dynamic, global organization focused on helping businesses make smarter decisions through trusted news, data, insights, and information solutions. job.title: Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions. Our product team shapes how readers discover our subscription, decide to join, and build habits as long-term subscribers. We own the flows people move through on the way to becoming a subscriber, and we work closely with our subscriptions marketing team to bring new readers in.

 

The Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions, leads a cross-functional team focused on turning unknown users into known users, and known users into paying subscribers. You will dig into how people behave, find the spots where they hesitate or drop off, and turn what you learn into a clear roadmap. You will also work with our revenue science team on the models that help us show the right offer to the right user at the right time.


What Motivates You

  • You get energized by the puzzle of why people choose to subscribe and what makes them stay.
  • You like working across teams and are good at turning ideas from marketing, design, data science, and engineering into something everyone can build toward.
  • You're curious about customers. You want to understand what they need, where they get stuck, and what would make the experience feel easy.
  • You care about the mission and values of the organization and bring determination and good organization to the work.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Own the roadmap for conversion and acquisition flows, from a reader's first visit through registration, checkout, and early onboarding.
  • Develop strategies that move unknown users to known users and known users to payers.
  • Partner with the revenue science team on the models and testing that inform which offer reaches which user, and when.
  • Partner closely with the subscriptions marketing team to plan and launch experiments and campaigns that bring in new subscribers.·       Work with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and QA to ship high quality products on a steady rhythm.
  • Write clear requirements and prioritize features against our acquisition and revenue goals.
  • Use A/B testing and other experimentation to learn what works, then apply it to the next round of improvements.
  • Spot roadblocks early and clear them before they slow the team down.
  • Share updates, risks, and new opportunities with leadership on a regular basis.
  • Keep up with trends in subscription products, conversion optimization, and consumer behavior.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in digital subscriptions.
  • Experience improving conversion funnels or acquisition flows, ideally in a B2C digital subscription product. This is a strong plus.·      
  • Experience using data to inform decisions, including a track record of running experiments and combining numbers with customer feedback to decide what to build.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics partners on models and personalization, even if you aren't building the models yourself.
  • A collaborative style and the ability to build good working relationships with marketing, design, engineering, and analytics partners.    
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to juggle several projects in a fast-moving environment.    
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas and share results with people at every level of the company.
  • Experience working with research and design teams to run qualitative studies and turn what you learn into product improvements.  
  • Media experience is welcome and not required.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$119,700 - $199,300 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The B2B Subscription Marketing Team is looking for an enthusiastic intern, interested in learning and applying problem solving skills to engagement marketing, acquisition strategy, and other work to connect and build their audience. 

The B2B Subscription Team’s mission is to cultivate an audience of millions of curious readers and the next generation of paying Times subscribers. They do this through the sale of digital access and group subscriptions in Education (High School and Higher Ed), the Corporate/Government space, and Public Libraries. We also support Subscription Partnerships. 

You will be a part of a small but mighty team whose goal is to drive acquisition and engagement with B2B Subscription Clients across verticals. 

About Our Summer Internships 

  • The duration is 10 weeks long, starting on June 7, 2027. 
  • The rate of pay for this role is $20.00 per hour. 
  • Interns work 35 hours per week. 
  • This is a hybrid role  based in New York City. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Curating New York Times journalism into reading lists to be shared with both prospective clients and current B2B users in the Education space 
  • Identifying campus contacts and performing outreach and awareness building at higher education institutions that have a New York Times subscription 
  • Managing and updating our materials marketplace 
  • Supporting B2B marketing campaigns (insights, operations, analytics) 
  • Sourcing prospect lists against key verticals and brainstorming on outreach strategy 
  • Helping to develop an end-user engagement strategy 
  • Identifying partnership opportunities 
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • A junior or senior in college, or a grad student, studying a relevant field (i.e. Marketing, Hospitality, Media Communications, Advertising, Business, etc.) 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Academic or Professional experience in the media industry

job.title: Client Coordinator
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

The Client Coordinator sits within Semafor’s Revenue Operations team and plays a central role in supporting sales, client partnerships, and integrated program delivery.

This role is the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Events, and Ad Operations. The Client Coordinator supports the execution of integrated media programs by partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate client goals into proposals and ensure seamless delivery across pre-sale functions. This role plays a critical part in maintaining organized workflows, clear communication, and a high-quality client experience across Semafor’s media and events portfolio.

This is an ideal role for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is excited to learn the media business end-to-end and grow into sales, client strategy, or revenue operations over time.

Key Responsibilities

Media Planning, Pre-Sale Strategy & Sales Support

  • Partner with Sales to support the development of integrated media programs and media plans across newsletters, digital products, custom content, and events.
  • Support pricing inputs, packaging, deal revisions, and rate guidance within established yield and inventory frameworks.
  • Coordinate proposal kick-offs, deal brief creation, internal feasibility checks, cross-functional inputs, and timeline management 
  • Support RFP responses and the creation of polished, visually engaging proposal decks.
  • Prepare for client meetings by compiling research, agendas, and supporting materials; capture notes and draft follow-ups to ensure clear next steps and accountability.

Client Communication & Relationship Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client coordination, ensuring timely communication and follow-through.
  • Build familiarity with client priorities, sensitivities, and goals to anticipate needs.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure clarity on scope, deliverables, and timelines.

Post-Sale Transition & Program Coordination

  • Support smooth transitions from pre-sale into execution.
  • Maintain client-facing timelines and deliverable trackers.
  • Coordinate campaign launches across newsletters and digital media.
  • Support asset collection, ad specifications, proofs, and confirms in partnership with Ad Ops and Editorial.

Campaign Support, Performance & Optimization

  • Assist with mid-campaign check-ins and performance updates, including basic metric review and insight generation.
  • Help identify potential optimization, added-value, or upsell opportunities in collaboration with Sales.
  • Ensure a consistently high bar for client experience throughout the lifecycle of the program.

Revenue Operations & Internal Coordination

  • Maintain accurate documentation and updates in our CRM (boostr) and workflow tools.
  • Ensure opportunities, products, budgets, and deal details are up to date and accurate.
  • Support maintenance of rate cards, packaging menus, and go-to-market materials.
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen pre-sale workflows and cross-functional alignment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • 2–4 years of experience in media, advertising, communications, client services, account coordination, or related commercial role. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Media, or a related field.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, judgement, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort interacting with clients.
  • Ability to synthesize concepts into actionable next steps.
  • Interest in media planning, integrated programs, and the business of journalism.
  • Ability to operate calmly under pressure and adapt in fast-moving environments.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of fast-moving work and shifting priorities
  • High ethical standards and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Comfort managing administrative details, timelines, and a T&E budget responsibly.
  • Boostr experience is a plus.

Additional Job Details

This position is based in New York, NY.

Comprehensive employee benefits: unlimited PTO, medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability, flexible spending, health savings accounts, life insurance, 401(k), pre-Tax commuter benefits.

Salary Range: Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc. Base: $65,000 - $72,000 per year.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

job.title: Account Manager, Migration
job.description:
Job Description


This account manager position leads the migration of existing Thomson Reuters Corporate SMB customers to CoCounsel, working a defined list of assigned target accounts from first conversation through completed migration. You will be expected to meet/exceed migration and customer engagement activity targets (emphasis on account outreach, discovery conversations, and migration progression) as established.


This position supports the efforts of the SMB Corporates organization within Thomson Reuters Legal by accelerating CoCounsel adoption across our existing customer base. This role requires a seasoned, consultative seller who can quickly diagnose each customer's current workflows, articulate the value of CoCounsel, overcome resistance to change, and guide accounts through a smooth upsell transition.

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a CoCounsel Account Manager, you will:

  • Achieve and exceed monthly and annual migration quotas, measuring accounts migrated within set KPI’s and sales processes
  • Proactively engage decision-makers and end users at assigned accounts using outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to schedule discovery and migration conversations
  • Gather and log all call information, migration orders, and account activity within Salesforce, Thomson Reuters CRM system, correctly and accurately, ensuring migration status and stage are tracked for every target account
  • Develop and deliver accurate migration forecasts and account-level progress reporting against the target list
  • Identify and escalate migration risks (contract and renewal timing, technical or adoption blockers) and build account-specific plans to resolve them
  • Assume other responsibilities as required or requested by Sales Management
  • Own a defined list of existing Corporate SMB target accounts and drive each account from initial outreach through completed transition to CoCounsel

Relationship Management

  • Serve as the trusted advisor for each assigned account through the migration, using consultative discovery to map current workflows to CoCounsel capabilities and demonstrate clear value
  • Work with organizations (Customer Success, Onboarding and Training, Product Specialists, Order Fulfillment, Customer Service, etc.) throughout Thomson Reuters to ensure migrations are executed efficiently and accurately and customer issues are resolved in a timely manner
  • Actively contribute to and works responsibly in a team environment, including collaborating with Account Managers and key stakeholders who own the broader customer relationship
  • Capture customer feedback, objections, and competitive insights from conversations and share them to refine playbooks and product strategy
  • Maintain expert knowledge of CoCounsel and the legacy products being migrated, along with migration programs and incentives within the sales division
  • Actively participate in meetings, training sessions and individual professional development and skill building

Required Qualifications

You’re a fit for the Account Manager if your background includes:

  • Minimum of 4 years of B2B sales experience with a consistent record of quota attainment, ideally including customer conversions, incremental sales, renewals, or technology transitions
  • College Degree in business, sales or related field strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to manage a defined book of accounts and drive change with existing customers; outbound outreach experience required
  • Experience selling AI, SaaS, or legal technology solutions strongly preferred
  • Strong organizational and time management skills coupled with the ability to embrace change
  • Pipeline management skills in the CRM environment required – Salesforce.com experience strongly preferred
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; including ability to demonstrate online products using web-based tools (Microsoft Teams, Zoom, WebEx, etc.)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to negotiate migration terms, pricing, and timelines with customers within set parameters
  • Demonstrated knowledge of proper telephone etiquette and professional attitude and integrity
  • Legal industry knowledge or experience, particularly with corporate legal departments, strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent migrations and prioritize effectively across the assigned target list

Preferred Qualifications


  • N/A

#LI-D2E

 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay and any target sales incentive are part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. Target total cash compensation ranges are inclusive of both base pay and any target sales incentive.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting?
