Job Description


Producer, Video Podcasts (Level 1 Journalist, Temp Guild)


Are you a video-first news producer who can turn a major developing story into a polished, audience-ready program on deadline? If so, we want to hear from you.


Reuters World News delivers authoritative, visually compelling global-news coverage to millions of viewers and listeners across streaming, video, and podcast platforms.


Based in Los Angeles, you will produce the daily afternoon update for Reuters World News, a flagship 10-minute news program. You will collaborate with colleagues across Reuters’ global newsroom, using strong editorial judgment and sophisticated video-production skills to script and produce high-value journalism for digital audiences.



This assignment is expected to last approximately six months and reports to the Senior Podcast Producer.

 


Key Responsibilities



As Producer, Video Podcasts (Level 1 Journalist, Temp Guild), you will:


  • Video news production:  produce the daily afternoon Reuters World News update from editorial planning through final delivery, creating polished, visually engaging video coverage for streaming and digital audiences.
  • Breaking-news storytelling: Monitor developing news, identify the stories that matter most, and rapidly shape accurate, compelling video segments under tight deadlines.
  • Visual editorial execution: Write scripts, select and sequence visuals, edit footage, and package stories with strong pacing, clarity, and production value
  • Editorial judgment: Apply sound news judgment to prioritize coverage, ensure accuracy and impartiality, and present complex global stories in an accessible way.
  • Multi-platform adaptation: Create video-first programming that also translates effectively to podcast and audio audiences, preserving the direct, engaging style that connects creators with listeners and viewers.
  • On-air presentation: Host segments or provide on-camera and audio presentation when needed, communicating with authority, clarity, and credibility.
  • Independent collaboration: Work autonomously while coordinating effectively with reporters, editors, producers, and technical teams across locations and time zones.



Required Qualifications



  • Experience: Demonstrated experience independently producing polished video news content in a fast-paced newsroom, broadcast, streaming, or digital-news environment.
  • Video production skills: Strong hands-on ability to edit and package audience-ready video, including scripting, audio-visual storytelling, pacing, and delivery to professional editorial standards.
  • Editorial judgment: Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate coverage under deadline pressure.
  • Writing and presentation: Excellent news writing and scripting skills, with experience or demonstrated ability to present on camera and/or on audio as required.
  • Independent working style: Ability to take the initiative running the full production process with limited minute-to-minute supervision while maintaining clear communication with a manager and colleagues working in other locations and time zones.
  • Journalistic standards: Commitment to Reuters’ principles of independence, integrity, accuracy, and impartiality, along with a strong interest in global news and current affairs.



Preferred Qualifications



  • Streaming and digital-video experience: Experience producing short-form video news for streaming, digital-first, or social video audiences.
  • Breaking-news experience: Experience covering live events or fast-moving breaking news, particularly in a global-news environment.
  • Podcast expertise: Experience producing podcasts or audio journalism, with an understanding of how hosts and creators build a direct connection with their audience.
  • Subject-matter knowledge: Familiarity with international affairs, politics, business, or other major Reuters coverage areas.
  • Additional qualities: Strong organization, visual creativity, calmness under pressure, curiosity, and a collaborative approach to producing trusted journalism.

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. Integration Consultant


Job description


Are you a curious, proactive problem solver eager to take on the challenge of becoming an Integration Consultant at Thomson Reuters, where you´ll collaborate with a dynamic team and develop technical solutions in a rapidly growing network? If you thrive in a supportive, knowledge sharing environment, this role might be perfect for you!


As an Integrator at Thomson Reuters, you'll play a key role in identifying and implementing technical solutions, and connecting customers to our global network. You'll work closely with various departments, handling tasks like configuration, format development, testing, and troubleshooting. The Integration department is divided into several sub teams and the role offers opportunities for cross-functional collaboration and specialization in areas that interest you most.

Ideal candidates are curious, proactive problem-solvers who thrive in a dynamic and knowledge sharing environment. You'll receive comprehensive training and mentorship to support your growth.


Together, we are building the world’s largest, open business network. With our cloud-based network, customers can reach any business, anywhere in the world – no matter how many borders their operations may cross. We take care of the technical and regulatory requirements across the entire order-to-cash, purchase-to-pay and freight processes, to give customers data accuracy and security, transparency, and real-time visibility. All this through a single connection.

This position is open for Stockholm and Gothenburg applications.


Key Responsibilities:


In this opportunity as Integration Consultant, you will:

  • Guide and suggest best practice solutions, based on scalability, supportability, security, and efficiency.
  • Run thorough gap analyses.
  • Build support for customers file formats
  • Act as stakeholders to R&D in development of new services and solutions
  • Configure, test, troubleshoot and implement customized solutions.
  • Be a technical resource in both local and global customer projects.
  • Connect customers’ data platforms to our global network.
  • Have cross-functional cooperation within the Professional Services, R&D and Support organizations.

Required Qualifications:


You’re a fit for the role of Integration Consultant if you have the following required qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Systems Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent education background with some experience in relevant practice field.
  • Team player with strong collaboration skills.
  • Analytical and quality conscious.
  • You’re able to perform GAP analyses and understand requirements from data.
  • Technically curios with attention for details and the ambition to always learn more.
  • Understanding of business processes/flows and data exchange on a technical level.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
  • Successfully pass an extended background check (criminal and credit).

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Hands on experience from working with integration.
  • Experience of working with XML/XSLT.
  • Experience of EDI (e-invoice/order).
  • Experience of working with communication protocols (SFTP, AS2, HTTPS, API etc)
  • Familiarity or experience with concepts such as PEPPOL, Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Visual Studio Code.
  • Additional languages.

What’s in it For You?

job.description:
Job Description

Buscamos um(a) Gerente Sênior de Produtos com forte experiência em adquirência e meios de pagamento para liderar a estratégia, desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de pagamentos físicos e digitais. Será responsável pela gestão do roadmap do produto, integração entre POS e ERP, conciliação financeira, antecipação de recebíveis, relacionamento com parceiros estratégicos e garantia de conformidade regulatória. É essencial possuir sólida vivência em produtos de pagamentos, conhecimento do ecossistema de adquirência e experiência na liderança de produtos complexos e de alto impacto.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Definir e comunicar a visão estratégica da solução de adquirência, abrangendo meios de pagamento físicos e digitais.
  • Construir e gerenciar o roadmap do produto considerando tendências de mercado, evolução tecnológica e mudanças regulatórias.
  • Identificar oportunidades de inovação e garantir a competitividade da solução.
  • Liderar a estratégia de integração entre adquirência, ERP, financeiro, fiscal e contabilidade.
  • Garantir a emissão fiscal integrada ao processo de venda e a rastreabilidade completa das transações.
  • Estruturar e evoluir processos de conciliação de cartões e lançamentos contábeis automáticos.
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar ofertas de antecipação de recebíveis.
  • Garantir conformidade regulatória junto ao Bacen, LGPD, PCI-DSS e demais normativos do setor.
  • Gerenciar relacionamento e negociações com adquirentes, processadoras, fornecedores de infraestrutura e parceiros financeiros.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de arquitetura, engenharia e desenvolvimento para evolução da plataforma.
  • Definir requisitos técnicos, especificações funcionais e critérios de aceite.
  • Priorizar iniciativas com base em impacto de negócio, viabilidade técnica e regulatória.
  • Liderar lançamentos e evoluções de produto em parceria com áreas de Produto, Tecnologia, Comercial e Operações.
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar KPIs de negócio, operação, conciliação e antecipação de recebíveis.
  • Apresentar estratégias, resultados e roadmap para stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Representar a solução em discussões estratégicas e fóruns executivos

Required Qualifications

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Tecnologia, Administração, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em produtos, tecnologia ou meios de pagamento.
  • Entre 6 e 8 anos de experiência específica em adquirência ou mercado de pagamentos.
  • Pelo menos 4 anos como Gerente Sênior de Produto ou posição equivalente.
  • Experiência comprovada na estruturação, lançamento e evolução de produtos complexos.
  • Histórico de atuação com arquitetos, engenheiros e equipes técnicas.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de pagamentos, processamento, tokenização e roteamento de transações.
  • Forte conhecimento em POS, adquirência, PIX, cartão de crédito, débito, wallets e Open Banking.
  • Domínio de EMV, NFC, Contactless, Tap2Pay, QR Code, APIs, webhooks e integrações.
  • Experiência com integração de POS e ERP via TEF, APIs e SDKs.
  • Conhecimento de emissão fiscal integrada (NFC-e, NF-e e NFS-e).
  • Conhecimento de conciliação financeira e contábil de cartões.
  • Conhecimento de antecipação de recebíveis, funding e risco de crédito.
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações do Bacen, PCI-DSS, LGPD e compliance para meios de pagamento.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA em Gestão de Produtos, Negócios ou Finanças.
  • Experiência em adquirentes, fintechs, processadoras ou instituições de pagamento.
  • Experiência com Tap2Pay em produção.
  • Participação na criação de produtos de pagamento do zero.
  • Experiência com Open Finance/Open Banking.
  • Experiência com APIs de pagamento e Pix.
  • Vivência em integração completa entre POS, ERP e emissão fiscal.
  • Experiência com antecipação de recebíveis, registradoras, FIDC e SCD.
  • Experiência com conciliação contábil automatizada.
  • Atuação em ambientes de alto volume transacional.
  • Rede de relacionamento consolidada no ecossistema de pagamentos.

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.

job.title: Retention & Renewal Analytics - CS Lead
job.description:
Job Description


We are seeking a data-driven CS Operations professional to lead retention and renewal operations and analytics within the Asia and Emerging Markets (AEM) Customer Success Operations team. In this role, you will own the operational and analytical frameworks that underpin renewal forecasting, churn risk identification, and revenue retention operations strategy. Reporting to the Director of CS Operations, you will serve as the analytical backbone for Customer Success Managers and leadership — including VP of Customer Success and CS Directors — translating complex customer data into clear, actionable intelligence that drives measurable retention outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


  • Renewal Pipeline Analytics: Own end-to-end analytics for the renewal pipeline — track renewal rates, ARR/ACV at risk, and on-time renewal performance across segments and regions; publish CS key metrics regularly.
  • Churn & Contraction Modelling: Build and maintain predictive models to identify churn risk signals, contraction patterns, and at-risk cohorts; deliver proactive alerts to CS leadership and account teams.
  • Retention Performance Reporting: Design and manage recurring retention dashboards and scorecards (weekly, monthly, QBR-level) surfacing retention metrics, win-back trends, and save-play effectiveness; leverage AI and automation tools to develop a programmatic approach for retention operations reporting.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Lead post-churn or cancellation root cause analysis to identify systemic patterns; synthesise findings into actionable recommendations for Product, CS, and Commercial teams.
  • Renewal Process Optimisation: Partner with CS and Finance to refine renewal workflows, escalation triggers, and SLA frameworks within tools like Gainsight and Salesforce.
  • Executive Storytelling: Translate analytical findings into crisp executive narratives, supporting QBRs, exec-level reporting, and business reviews.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Ops, Finance, and Product to align retention KPIs with broader go-to-market objectives.

Required Qualifications
 

  • 8–12 years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar analytically focused role within a SaaS or subscription-based business.
  • Proven expertise in renewal and retention operations and analytics, including Gross Retention Rate (GRR), Net Retention Rate (NRR), churn rate, logo retention, and ARR/ACV metrics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) and Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight including experience building reports, dashboards, and customer lifecycle journeys.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial and data modelling, scenario analysis, and cohort/funnel analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent) for self-service dashboard development and executive reporting.
  • Strong statistical aptitude — comfortable with cohort analysis, funnel analysis, and basic predictive modelling techniques.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to present data-driven narratives clearly and concisely to senior stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Background in revenue accounting or finance, particularly for ARR reconciliation and SaaS metrics reporting.
  • Exposure to Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, Planhat, or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting or leading digital Customer Success or tech-touch retention programmes at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered analytics or automation solutions integrated within CS or CRM workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management across cross-functional teams including Finance, Sales, and Product.
  • Exposure to global or multi-regional SaaS operations with an understanding of India-based delivery and GTM models.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Working knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and analysis; comfort with large datasets and data validation.
  • Familiarity with machine learning or propensity modelling frameworks applied to churn prediction (e.g., logistic regression, gradient boosting).

job.title: Content Author
job.description:
Content Author


Job Description

The Content Author is an entry point into the content team's career path, combining hands-on content authorship with full ownership of the content production process. This role analyzes source material from multiple resources and writes, edits, and updates clear, accurate, customer-facing content, while also performing the technical production tasks — coding, copyreading, merging, rendering, loading, and validating — needed to move that content through the team's systems and into publication. The Content Author works under the guidance of more senior team members while building independent proficiency in the team's content, processes, and systems, with the goal of taking on progressively broader responsibility over time. Specific product knowledge is not required at entry; the role is designed around generalizable content and systems skills that apply across the team's product portfolio.


Key Responsibilities 

  • Read source material from multiple places and write, edit, and update content so it's clear and correct, with guidance from senior team members. 
  • Handle the full content production process in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): coding, copyreading, editing, merging, DITA formatting, and checking content. 
  • Turn confusing, incomplete, or mixed-up source material into clear, well-organized content for customers. 
  • Take ownership of your own content's accuracy and completeness; work independently on familiar tasks and ask for help on harder ones. 
  • Spot routine content problems, fix what you can, and know when to ask for help on anything unclear. 
  • Meet deadlines by managing your own workload and working well with teammates. 
  • Help test and review content to make sure it works and reads well across different formats. 
  • Suggest small process improvements when you spot them. 
  • Leverage strong product knowledge to enhance our workflow and content, for strategic products. 
  • Learn the team's content, systems, and tools, and pick up general product knowledge over time. 

Required Qualifications

  • Process-oriented: comfortable following and improving structured, multi-step content workflows. 
  • Attention to detail: consistently accurate, complete, and quality-checked work. 
  • Strong writing skills: clear, well-organized, professional writing across content types. 
  • Strong sense of voice: able to write and edit in a consistent, appropriate tone and style. 
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity: works effectively from incomplete, conflicting, or multi-source information and knows when to escalate. 
  • General product knowledge: comfortable learning new product context quickly; deep expertise in any single product is not required at entry. 
  • Works successfully in a team environment and understands team member roles. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to AI-assisted content tools or workflows. 
  • Familiarity with knowledge maps or other structured-content models. 
  • Basic content or data analytics skills. 
  • Experience with DITA or other structured-authoring frameworks. 
  • Experience working in a component content management system (CCMS). 
  • Broader content creation experience (e.g., digital, consumer-facing, or SEO-oriented content).

job.title: Analyst - Global Trade Content
job.description:
Job Description:

The Analyst – Global Trade Content is responsible for the accurate compilation, maintenance, validation, and quality assurance of global trade regulatory content. This role supports regulatory research, tariff content management, data analysis, standardization, product support, and documentation activities to ensure trade content is accurate, timely, and compliant with internal standards. The analyst is also expected to actively utilize AI and digital tools to improve productivity, accuracy, consistency, and content quality while adhering to company governance and data privacy requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conducts comprehensive research and analysis to interpret and update global trade regulations from official government sources.
  • Monitors official sources for assigned tariffs and promptly delivers accurate updates into internal systems.
  • Converts regulatory updates into standardized or system-compatible formats for loading.
  • Analyzes customer or internal inquiries related to assigned tariffs and provides well-researched, accurate responses in a timely manner.
  • Identifies reliable contacts and official data sources for assigned countries and establishes effective working relationships.
  • Documents processes, procedures, and work instructions according to established guidelines and templates.
  • Identifies and reports bugs in standard files and systems and assists in testing new features and improvements through the ADO process.
  • Supports project management tasks including data collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Uses AI and digital tools daily to support research, comparison, validation, formatting, content updates, and efficiency improvements.
  • HS nomenclature, classification rules, explanatory notes.
  • Tariff schedules and regulatory interpretation related to HS.
  • HS related data validation includes HS codes, Description, UOM charges, controls, regulations, additional codes, etc.
  • Data Extraction, Validation and analysis of the HS tariffs content data.
  • Shift Timings: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (IST).
  • Work from office for 2-3 days in a week (Mandatory)

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in International Trade, Business, Economics, Information Science, or a related field.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant work experience.
  • Knowledge of Harmonized System (HS) and Customs regulations.
  • Knowledge in import and export operations.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
  • Ability to independently gather, analyze, and interpret trade data.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel.
  • AI-enabled productivity and research tools.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a professional or academic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

job.description:
Thomson Reuters is hiring Senior Internal Auditors in Bangalore, India. The role focuses on delivering independent, risk-based assurance and protecting stakeholder interests. It offers exposure to a wide range of audit responsibilities, including SOX compliance and fraud investigation. The position also involves helping modernize and advance the company's SOX program. Join Internal Audit as we build a data-driven, AI-enabled audit function by 2028, with one integrated platform across audit engagements, controls testing and fraud investigations. Alongside SOX and fraud, you will have the opportunity to build experience in systems implementation, technology and cyber, data and analytics, and audit quality.


About the Role:

As a Senior Internal Auditor, you will be instrumental in advancing our digital transformation initiatives while strengthening the organization's risk management and control environment.

  • Support the modernization of our SOX program, including the enhancement of control frameworks and management testing methodologies.
  • Execute, oversee, and continuously monitor SOX management testing across IT system and business process controls to ensure ongoing compliance with SOX requirements and industry best practices.
  • Identify control deficiencies and recommend practical, actionable remediation strategies to strengthen the control environment.
  • Act as a strategic liaison between external auditors, business partners, and key stakeholders to align risk mitigation strategies, drive efficiency initiatives, and facilitate effective communication and coordination.
  • Support and lead internal audit engagements across diverse business areas and risk domains.
  • Lead fraud investigations as required, including planning, fieldwork execution, stakeholder interviews, and reporting.
  • Prepare clear, concise, and well-documented audit reports and investigation findings for presentation to senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with international teams and cross-functional partners to ensure alignment of risk management practices.
  • Implement emerging technologies and AI tools, including using Thomson Reuters products, to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and drive innovation.
  • Help build and use the Internal Audit Data & Agentic AI Platform.
  • Lead automation and data analytics to detect anomalies, simplify control testing, and boost audit efficiency.
  • Provide assurance over ERP/S4HANA implementations and technology and cyber risks.
  • Contribute to engagement quality, methodology, and conformance with the Global IIA Standards.
  • Contribute to the Internal Audit transformation journey by driving key initiatives.
  • Foster understanding of internal controls and SOX requirements across the organization.
  • Stay updated on emerging risks, fraud trends, audit methods, and regulatory changes.

About You:

  • 6+ years of experience in IT audit, internal controls, cybersecurity, data analytics, or audit quality within complex environments.
  • Strong knowledge of IT governance and technology risk & control frameworks (e.g., ITGCs, change management, access management).
  • Experience in one or more of the following: ERP/S4HANA implementation assurance, cyber frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), Python/SQL/Power BI analytics, audit quality, and methodology.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Portals)
job.description:
About SoundExchange

SoundExchange is the largest global neighboring rights organization in the world, redefining how creators in the music industry get paid. By turning data into fast, accurate revenue for artists and rights owners, we have collected and distributed more than $13 billion in digital performance royalties to date on behalf of more than 800,000 music creators. As the sole organization designated by the U.S. government to administer the Section 114 sound recording license, SoundExchange seamlessly collects and distributes digital performance royalties from platforms like Pandora, SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and thousands more, as well as all available international performance royalties through a strong global partnership network. 

 

Title: Senior Software Engineer (Portals Team)
Department: Technology
Job Location: Washington, DC or anywhere (Continental US) (If local, on-site Tuesdays and Wednesdays)
Reports To: Director, Engineering
Supervisory Role: No
FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Summary: 

The Senior Software Engineer for our Portals team will be a key contributor to full lifecycle software development while coaching and mentoring other contributors within their technical team. This role is a primary contributor to the software development process for one or more applications and collaborates across the engineering organization to ensure efficient development and delivery of technical solutions. The Senior Engineer is a critical element in our agile delivery process for new features and capabilities to support our growing music and technology products and solutions.

Essential Functions:

  • Contribute as a code author and reviewer within a small team of software engineers
  • Collaborate across teams to design, develop, test, and support data driven solutions
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and decision-making both within their team and coordination with interfacing teams
  • Interface with key project stakeholders, mentor team members, and promote and improve software engineering practices
  • Demonstrate responsibility, accountability, and dedication to engineering team success
  • Utilize AI coding techniques to increase efficiency in coding and troubleshooting without losing ownership of code
  • Follow and improve established software development standards and best practices
  • Contribute actively to full Agile SDLC, especially from refinement to release

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):

  • Proficiency at designing and developing software using many of the following: Python, Django, SQL (Postgres), AWS (S3, ECS, OpenSearch, RDS, Cloudfront, etc.), JavaScript, Typescript, JPax, Git, Kiro
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code technologies
  • Experience with Vue3 or other UI frameworks
  • Experience building enterprise software with complex business rules and data models
  • Experience designing and developing microservices or other distributed systems
  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively with team members and business partners
  • Proficiency in Agile software development methodology, processes, and practices

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
  • 5 or more years of experience in software engineering

ADA Specifications:

  • This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (standing and/or seated) all of the time
  • This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:

  • If hired remote, this person is expected to travel to the Washington DC corporate office as needed (3-4 times per year at minimum).

 

PAY RANGE: $158,000.00 - $190,000.00 

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. job.title: Deputy Managing Editor
job.description:
Title: Deputy Managing Editor

Schedule Format - Location:Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $129,776 - $162,220 Annually



A Deputy Managing Editor at KQED’s primary responsibility is to direct strategy and management of senior editors and reporters on beats across the newsroom, as well as to generate story ideas and execute edits with members of the newsroom. A deputy managing editor at KQED works closely with managing editors to set editorial priorities on coverage across our platforms. A deputy managing editor assists managing editors in shaping coverage, and often manages and directs editors, reporters and producers throughout the newsroom. 

Deputy managing editors work closely with managing editors to work as part of our newsroom leadership to take our editorial priorities and help decide how to greenlight stories and projects with those guiding principles in mind.

Deputy managing editors also provide direction, editing and help to other senior editors as needed, but work as a strong and empathetic leader and manager to senior editors as well.  

California Newsroom Editor Addendum

The California Newsroom, a collaboration of public radio and nonprofit news outlets in the state spearheaded by KQED, is seeking a deputy managing editor to lead statewide content planning and coordination.

This position requires a journalist who is skilled in leading collaborations and partnerships across multiple newsrooms. We are seeking an empathetic and human-centered manager who works well with people at all levels of experience, from early-career reporters to seasoned editors. The deputy managing editor will also be a key editorial strategist, working closely with news directors, reporters and editors from multiple outlets to serve the needs of all the partner newsrooms, from major outlets in large markets to smaller stations with limited resources and personnel. 

This editor will work in collaboration with journalists spread across 14 public radio stations and other partners such as the nonprofit news organization CalMatters to ensure coverage of significant issues, assigning and editing daily news and in-depth features and projects. The editor will also be responsible for coordinating California coverage for a national audience in partnership with NPR.

This editor will work closely with the California Newsroom Managing Editor to ensure that content production aligns with larger strategic goals. The Deputy Managing Editor will step in to run the entire California Newsroom operation in the absence of the Managing Editor, so we’re seeking candidates with both impeccable news judgment and advanced managerial skills. This is a remote position, but the editor must reside in California. The Deputy Managing Editor will manage from 1-4 journalists.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. We value the contributions of marginalized people in society, including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people, and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do. We strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics: https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics
 

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.




Essential Functions:
  • Coordinates with newsroom leaders throughout California on daily news coverage, major breaking news and long-term joint projects.
  • Maintains a running database of assignments and planning.
  • Oversees California Newsroom employees assigned to content production and planning. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Non-Essential Functions:
  • Occasionally fills in for other colleagues.
  • Represents KQED at events.

Knowledge/Experience Required:
  • At least five years of experience in a similar role in a newsroom or news environment.
  • Interest and knowledge in California news.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills; clear communication with colleagues.
  • Excellent news judgment.
  • Thorough command of journalistic principles, ethics and standards.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and goals while working under pressure.
  • Proven collaboration skills, which are essential in working with fellow KQED staffers across departments and with partner organizations.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to stay focused, organized, communicative and proactive while working with a number of journalists and staffers across the organization and dealing with several different editors.
  • Ability to stay organized and prioritize tasks when working on multiple projects at once.

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Non-English language skills (fluency in Spanish, Mandarin or other widely spoken languages in California).
  • Previous work as a newsroom manager.
  • Proven capacity to identify opportunities for stories of high relevance to audiences.
NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Edelman Malaysia – Senior Accountant Role

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Senior Accountant to join our Company.  In this role, you will be exposed to the following areas in Finance and Management Accounting: Financial Accounting, Business Law/Contracts, Procurement, Project Accounting, Taxation, and Compliance. 

 

We seek an individual with excellent people skills, numbers’ skills, and beyond all one with a winning attitude to become a successful finance business partner to our core operational team members. Our work environment is fast-paced and not for the faint-hearted. You will be coached and mentored to grow within the organization. We seek only candidates with a long-term aspiration to grow and learn within this organization.

 

Position Summary:

The Senior Accountant is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the company's financial records and delivering timely financial reporting, statutory compliance, audit coordination, and business support. This role plays a key part in managing the month-end and year-end closing processes, maintaining compliance with accounting standards and company policies, and partnering with business stakeholders to support operational and financial objectives.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Recognition & Project Accounting

  • Perform monthly revenue assessment to ensure project revenue and costs are accurately recognised.
  • Work closely with Client Finance, Client Leaders and Operations to resolve revenue-related issues.
  • Support project profitability analysis and financial performance monitoring.
  • Support in RFQ / RFP submission.

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Lead and coordinate the monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close process.
  • Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Ensure the completeness and accuracy of the general ledger.
  • Perform monthly financial analysis and explain significant variances.
  • Prepare management reports and support with financial analysis.

Balance Sheet Management

  • Review and reconcile balance sheet accounts, including intercompany balances, fixed assets, receivables, payables, accruals, and provisions.
  • Ensure timely clearance of reconciling items and maintain accurate supporting documentation.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and statutory requirements.
  • Support tax compliance, including Sales & Services Tax (SST), withholding tax, and corporate tax reporting.
  • Maintain effective internal controls and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes and strengthen operational controls.

Statutory Reporting & Audit

  • Coordinate year-end statutory audit and prepare audit schedules.
  • Liaise with external auditors to resolve audit queries and provide supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate with the Company Secretary on statutory filings, annual returns, and board resolutions.
  • Prepare statutory financial statements in compliance with local accounting standards.

Regional & Global Reporting

  • Prepare supplementary reporting packages for Regional and Global Finance.
  • Coordinate statutory-to-GAAP reporting and ensure reporting timelines are met.
  • Support regional finance requests, reporting submissions, and ad hoc analyses.

 

Qualifications:

  • University degree in Accounting/Finance/Business Studies and/or Professional Accounting qualifications (ACCA, CA, CPA).
  • Minimum 5–7 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a multinational or professional services environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience in full-set accounting and month-end/year-end closing.
  • Experience in statutory reporting, balance sheet reconciliations, and external audit coordination.
  • Good knowledge of Malaysian accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory requirements, including SST, corporate tax, withholding tax (WHT), and stamp duty.

 

Skills & Experience:

  • Proven experience in preparing statutory financial statements and regional/global reporting packages.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial reporting skills.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, PivotTables, and data analysis.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and transformative SVP, Product to lead the critical capability area of Marketing Performance within the WPP Open platform. This is a truly unique opportunity to define the future of how WPP measures and attributes marketing effectiveness across our vast and diverse agency and client ecosystem. 

Leveraging WPP's pioneering agentic marketing platform, you will lead the development of best-in-class solutions that turn live signals into predictive intelligence, empower our agencies and clients to drive superior outcomes, and solidify WPP Open's competitive edge. Your mandate will extend beyond traditional paid media measurement, encompassing a holistic view of performance across the entire Paid, Earned, Shared, and Owned media spectrum. 

This role demands a leader who can not only set a compelling product vision, but also inspire and lead a multi-disciplinary team, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. You will directly contribute to achieving key WPP Open priorities, including driving profitability, maximizing strategic advantage, and delivering an integrated, intelligent experience for our users and clients. 

JOB PURPOSE 

The SVP, Product for Marketing Performance will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. This includes the development of visualizations and user experiences to democratize and utilize campaign and performance data, and the development of advanced analytics capabilities to enable Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and Geo-experimentation.  Including the use of agentic tooling for automated analytics outputs and conversational data analytics. 

You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:

  • Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs. 
  • Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 
  • Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 
  • Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance. 
  • Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work. 

 Commercial Acumen & Growth:

  • Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 
  • In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 
  • Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 
  • Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery. 
  • Partner with WPP agency leadership, client teams and strategic external partners to understand evolving needs, gather feedback, and ensure optimal product market fit and adoption. 
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress effectively and influentially to senior leadership, diverse stakeholders, and internal teams, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling presentations.

Product Development & Execution:

 Domain Expertise & Innovation:

  • Maintain deep expertise in marketing performance measurement, advanced attribution models (MTA, MMM, including various methodologies), media mix optimization, incrementality testing, and experimentation design (e.g., geo-experimentation). 
  • Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics. 
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation. 
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization. 

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

Experience: 

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain. 
  • Proven track record of successfully bringing complex, data-driven, and AI-enabled products from concept to market, driving significant competitive advantage and exponential growth. 
  • Extensive experience navigating and leading product teams through significant organizational change, mergers, or integrations, transforming disparate teams into a unified, high-performing organization. 
  • Strong understanding and application of modern agile product development methodologies. 
  • Experience managing significant operating and capital expenditure budgets and defining commercial models for product portfolios. 
  • Proven experience in managing global product rollouts and supporting a large, diverse client base (e.g., 1000+ clients across multiple markets). 

 

Domain Expertise: 

  • Advanced, hands-on knowledge of how marketing activity across Paid, Earned, Shared, Owned media channels is measured, coupled with a proven ability to translate this expertise into a compelling product vision and strategic roadmap. 
  • Deep expertise in advanced measurement techniques including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) (including various methodologies like Bayesian), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and marketing experimentation. 
  • Strong understanding of marketing data sources, data ingestion, transformation, and reporting challenges. 
  • Deep expertise in data architecture and engineering principles, data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and advanced analytics, particularly in the context of marketing data. 

 

Leadership & Communication: 

  • Exceptional leadership, team-building, and people management skills, with a passion for mentoring and developing diverse talent. 
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and strategic concepts to diverse audiences (technical, business, executive, client) and build compelling presentations. 
  • Strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities, capable of building strong relationships and collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Proven ability to navigate and excel within a fast-paced, multi-market, matrixed global organization. 

 

Strategic & Analytical Thinking: 

  • Exceptional strategic thinking and complex problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify ptimal courses of action and articulate a clear, long-term vision. 
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with the ability to make informed decisions based on market insights, user data, and business objectives. 
  • A proactive, independent, and adaptable leader with a strong sense of ownership, thriving within demanding, fast-paced environments. 

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

job.title: VML & Ogilvy | Business Consulting Director - Sr. Business Consulting Director, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

JOB OVERVIEW

The Business Consulting Director is a senior consulting leader responsible for leading global branding and global marketing consulting for Japan's leading B2B corporations. As a core member of VOJ's Business Consulting practice, you will own the full engagement lifecycle — from originating new client relationships and structuring complex business challenges, to developing strategy and directing creative development — ensuring that brand thinking translates into tangible business value on a global stage. Working in English with overseas offices and global client stakeholders, you will design and facilitate cross-functional workshops, lead multiple engagements in parallel, and serve as the bridge between client leadership and our creative teams. This role combines consulting rigor, a deep understanding of global B2B business, and a genuine appreciation for creativity, contributing directly to the global brand value and business growth of our clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Business Development & Client Growth
  • New Client Acquisition: Proactively identify, approach, and develop new client opportunities, leading the strategic development of proposals and pitches for major Japanese B2B corporations.
  • Proposal Development: Create compelling, well-structured proposals and planning documents that clearly articulate client challenges, recommended approaches, and expected business outcomes.
  • Trusted Client Partnership: Build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, positioning VOJ as a long-term business partner in their global brand and marketing agenda.
  1. Global Branding & Marketing Consulting
  • Issue Structuring: Diagnose and structure clients' business and brand challenges, translating complex, multi-stakeholder situations into clear problem definitions and priorities.
  • Strategy Development: Lead the development of global brand strategies, positioning, and marketing strategies that support clients' international business growth.
  • B2B Business Insight: Apply a strong understanding of global B2B business models, buying processes, and decision-making to ensure recommendations drive measurable business value.

III. Workshop Facilitation & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Workshop Design & Facilitation: Plan and facilitate high-impact client workshops that bring together multiple departments, driving alignment, consensus, and co-creation of solutions.
  • Cross-Departmental Coordination: Align diverse client stakeholders and internal agency teams around shared objectives, managing differing interests and building momentum toward decisions.
  • Global Communication: Communicate effectively in English with overseas offices, global clients, and the wider network, including meetings, presentations, and English-language proposals.
  1. Creative Direction & Integrated Delivery
  • Creative Briefing: Write clear, incisive creative briefs that translate consulting outputs into inspiring direction for creative teams.
  • Creative Collaboration: Engage actively in discussions with creative teams, providing strategic input to idea development and evaluating creative work with constructive feedback.
  • Strategic Consistency: Ensure that creative and communication output remains grounded in the agreed brand and marketing strategy and business objectives from concept through execution.
  1. Engagement Management & Practice Contribution
  • Multi-Project Leadership: Lead multiple consulting engagements in parallel, managing scope, timelines, resources, and quality to maximize client value.
  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Actively leverage generative AI and other AI tools to enhance the speed, depth, and quality of research, analysis, and deliverables.
  • Practice Development: Contribute to the growth of the Business Consulting practice by sharing knowledge, refining consulting methodologies, and supporting colleagues.

SKILLS and QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in brand consulting, marketing strategy, or a related field, including hands-on experience in global B2B business.
  • Branding & Marketing Knowledge: Solid foundational knowledge of marketing and branding principles, and the ability to apply them to complex B2B business challenges.
  • Business-Level English: Ability to lead meetings and presentations, read English-language materials, and write proposals in English.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Proven ability to facilitate workshops involving multiple departments and stakeholders, driving productive discussion and alignment.
  • Creative Understanding: A sound understanding of creativity, with the ability to write creative briefs and to evaluate and give feedback on creative ideas.
  • Multi-Tasking: Ability to drive multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Digital & AI Proficiency: Practical, day-to-day proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word, and the ability to make effective use of generative AI and other AI tools in daily work.
  • Preferred Background: Experience at a global agency, brand consulting firm, or consulting firm, or in a B2B company (e.g., marketing, brand, or corporate planning functions). Basic knowledge of and experience with CRM is a plus.
  • Personal Attributes: A constant drive to take on new challenges; a passion for engaging deeply with clients' business issues and solving them through the power of brand and creativity; and self-driven leadership in a fast-changing environment.

job.title: Digital Media Strategist
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 19 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspiring with respect and giving voice to all the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Position Overview

We're looking for someone with exceptional digital acumen to act as our Digital Media Strategist in the Seattle market. This role will contribute to achieving digital revenue goals working collaboratively with our team to represent our digital advertising assets, both owned and operated and third-party vendor extension products, to new and existing clients. In addition, this person will work as a trusted consultant providing recommendations of digital advertising strategies to reach key performance goals and providing evaluations of relevant digital performance metrics.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.


What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:


  • Work with AE’s on prospecting and identifying digital revenue opportunities, creating digital sales packages, presenting to clients and assisting in closing the sale. 
  • Conduct virtual and in-person meetings demonstrating digital knowledge and expertise.
  • Achieve and grow digital revenue on all digital platforms both existing and newly added.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, platform changes, and emerging ad technologies; translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations to stakeholders ranging from marketing managers to C-suite executives.
  • Product knowledge expert. Demonstrate knowledge of selling digital advertising products including digital display ads, SEO, paid media, social media, mobile, programmatic, IP targeting, OTT, e-mail, mobile advertising and website and landing page development
  • Oversee onboarding and fulfillment of digital advertising campaigns, providing valuable audience insights, tactical consultation, and performance evaluations. 
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet revenue goals.
  • Collaborate with account executives to identify and grow new opportunities.
  • Collaborate with account executives to promote retention of customers and overall positive experience with the brand.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • College degree in business, communications, sales, marketing, related field or equivalent, preferred  
  • Excellent project management skills; experience with sales operations preferred 
  • Possess excellent oral, written, presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Three to five years of digital marketing and advertising sales experience, preferably with programmatic placement 
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising products, attribution tool, and conversion metrics
  • The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, positive, persistent, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
  • Strong analytical abilities
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with DV360, Google Ads, Google Analytics (G4) and TapClicks.
  • Ability to develop client facing presentations 
  • Willingness to embrace AI innovation in accordance with Bonneville’s policies and procedures
  • Ability to create and present comprehensive marketing solutions 
  • Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools is a must 
  • Proficiency in managing sophisticated advertising programs and delivery methodologies 

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Maintain a valid driver's license and proven ability to safely drive personal vehicle without exposing company to serious liability risks. 

 

Compensation Range

$81,000 - $95,500 This salary range spans multiple levels for this role.

Salary will be determined by an evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal and external benchmarks.

 

What We Offer You: Check Out Our Bonneville Benefits!

Employees at Bonneville can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including:

  • Robust, affordable medical, dental and vision coverage with no wait period for enrollment
  • 401(k) with Company match and employer-funded retirement account, both fully vested from day one
  • Paid leave for new parents under our Medical Maternity (8 weeks) and Parental Leave (4 weeks) benefits
  • Opportunities to apply for tuition reimbursement
  • Paid time off for vacation (120 hours accrued per year) and sick leave (80 hours accrued per year) in addition to 12 paid company holidays per year
  • Paid time off for volunteering (40 hours per year)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

 

Bonneville is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Minority/female/disability PWDNET/veteran are encouraged to apply.

  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Experience in developing complex and high-performance mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in Android Studio, Git, and the Kotlin language.
  • Experience in developing an application published on Google Play.
  • Experience in developing within code review context (pull request).
  • Knowledge of programming patterns (such as MVP or MVVM).
  • Knowledge of SOLID architecture principles is an asset.
  • Ability to read, produce, and adhere to software architecture diagrams (UML, sequence diagram, etc.).
  • Interest in working on an application available on multiple form factors (mobile/tablet/TV).
  • Knowledge of Jetpack Compose, Exoplayer, Kotlin Multiplatform is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the libraries Dagger, Hilt, Koin is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Google architecture components is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Maven (including the design/maintenance of internal libraries) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). You’re an exceptional leader who can manage complex operations independently; navigate ethical and legal considerations to tight deadlines; and support assignment and programming teams in an unrelenting news environment. You are a decisive leader who can act independently under pressure. At the same time, you prioritize deep collaboration with colleagues in the Toronto Broadcast Centre and across the country to deliver relevant stories and compelling formats urgently and efficiently.


In this role, you’ll be on the ground with weekend programming teams, driving live and daily news coverage, co-ordination and distribution across CBC News Network, digital, streaming, social, and CBC Radio One newscasts and national call-in programs.


You know how to build a respectful culture where teams are motivated to support each other, producing impactful journalism that prioritizes live and breaking news that resonates with all Canadians. You are a collaborator who can wear many hats, equally adept at pivoting for live programming as you are at evolving workflows and supporting staff under pressure. You expertly navigate daily digital, streaming, broadcast and social platforms, and help to prioritize
the relentless demands for teams who deliver the highest quality audio, video and text coverage. You’ll work with colleagues across the CBC News division, sharing both content and expertise across platforms and programs..


In this role, you are the first stop for teams around legal issues and questions involving the CBC's Journalistic Standards and Practices, ensuring they’re providing fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful and immediate coverage.


You support executive producers, senior producers and assignment leaders in managing budgets, resource allocation and ensuring the mental and physical well-being of your teams is front-and-centre.

You work closely with other managing editors to ensure CBC News delivers on its mission to provide seamless live, breaking and daily coverage 24/7.

As a top-tier leader, you'll be front and centre in fulfilling the CBC News mission by driving journalism, innovation and connection. In this role, you’ll:


● Lead with Impact: Bring your A-game everyday, guiding and inspiring a talented team of journalists and directing editorial and audience growth strategy on all platforms. In collaboration with the Head of Live and Daily News, Managing Editors, Executive and Senior Producers, you oversee the weekend news strategy for live and daily coverage of national and international stories and major events.

You understand the pulse of Canadian audiences and their habits, and translate insights and data into actionable content strategies for all platforms.

constructive feedback, and growth opportunities to a large team of journalists. You cultivate a high-performing, collaborative, and respectful work culture where everyone feels empowered to contribute. ● Resource Management: Manage budgets, allocate resources effectively, and co-ordinate technical and production requirements for coverage.


● Innovate & Strategize: Demonstrate daily the role of a public broadcaster in a media landscape proliferated with misinformation, disinformation and rapidly evolving technologies. Verification is a core value. You lean into data, and use it to drive audience-focused strategies for your team. You translate big ideas into tangible actions.

Your Role

 

Reporting to the Program Manager, you will join the Digital Products and Innovation team, where a major initiative to modernize CBC/Radio-Canada's digital ecosystem is underway to make it more resilient in a changing media landscape. This work is being done in close collaboration with several departments and will contribute to building the future of the public broadcaster.

 

As a Project Lead, you oversee the entire lifecycle of your projects. While ensuring adherence to deadlines, budgets, and defined scope, you provide motivating leadership to teams to guide their work, distribute responsibilities, and maintain a high level of commitment.

 

To achieve this, you will first need to contribute to the analysis and feasibility of the projects and propose the best approaches to meet the mandate's objectives. You will also need to plan the lifecycle stages of each project, from initiation to launch. Furthermore, you will need to follow up with relevant stakeholders and members of the various teams involved to ensure project progress, implement proactive risk management, and communicate status updates to stakeholders.

 

Note that our working methodology is hybrid (Agile and Waterfall).

 

What will your responsibilities be?

  • Evaluate, coordinate and optimize human resources material, budgetary and project activities.
  • Advise, guide and provide specialist expertise during the evaluation, planning or development of projects.
  • Recommend solutions taking into account management objectives and CBC/Radio-Canada policies.
  • Orchestrate the team's calendar, including agile events such as daily stand-ups, planning (sprint or kanban), retrospectives, reviews, cross-team dependency alignment, and any other relevant meetings.
  • Develop the timeline based on the Product Manager's priorities (and/or sprints), factoring in scope, estimates, target delivery date, required resources, and budget.
  • Formally manage requests for scope changes in evaluating and communicating their impact on timelines, team capacity and initial budgets.
  • Align project timelines with the interdependencies of other initiatives and ensure that communication remains fluid between the different teams and stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain the project risk register and develop the necessary mitigation plans.
  • Participate in negotiating agreements with internal and external stakeholders as needed for the projects.
  • Establish control processes at different stages of the project and ensure compliance with acceptance criteria.
  • Take full accountability for project reporting and status updates, and, in collaboration with the Product Manager and Program Manager, serve as the primary point of contact for senior leadership and executive committees.
  • With the help of experts, find solutions to both technical and operational problems and constraints.
  • In collaboration with the program manager, he defines and enforces the project governance structure (e.g., steering committees).
  • Transmit blocking elements to higher hierarchical levels if support is needed.
  • Identify, define, track and analyze key indicators to measure team delivery and performance.
  • Fostering a self-organizing and high-performing team culture by promoting autonomy, accountability and cross-functional collaboration, while helping teams establish and overcome barriers to ensure smooth progress and value delivery.

 

How will you make the difference?

Your role


CBC Newfoundland and Labrador is looking for a Producer, Visual News to lead our visual content focus across digital, streaming, social and broadcast platforms.


Reporting to the Executive Producer and collaborating closely with newsroom leadership; you and other producers responsible for visual news will produce and guide journalists daily. This role is central in shaping how our visual journalism connects with audiences in Newfoundland and Labrador and across Canada. Using analytics and audience research to inform your editorial choices, you ensure all visual content meets CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices (JSP) while driving our multi-platform newsroom forward in the daily news cycle.

  • Guide reporters, VJs and video producers on all aspects related to visual elements. Review, fact-check, and vet scripts, rough cuts, and packaged stories for accuracy, tone, fairness and adherence to CBC Journalistic Standards and Practices (JSP).

  • Write intros, headlines and captions in an audience growth mindset. Source, edit and assemble video and audio elements; request and create custom graphics, supers, and maps; and optimize video packaging (such as custom thumbnails and SEO-friendly metadata).

  • Facilitate constructive feedback, and contribute to shared best-practice documentation.

  • University degree in Journalism or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of Newfoundland and Labrador news, culture, communities, and regional realities, along with a firm grasp of national and international affairs.
