Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.
That's where you come in.

 

What You’ll Do:

You'll become a trusted marketing advisor to local business owners and decision-makers, helping them navigate today's rapidly evolving media landscape.
You'll work with entrepreneurs, CEOs, marketing directors, nonprofits, and community leaders to develop customized marketing strategies that deliver real business results.

Every day you'll:

  • Build new relationships with businesses throughout West Michigan
  • Create strategic marketing plans using radio, streaming audio, streaming TV, websites, social media, SEO, search marketing, programmatic advertising, events, and more
  • Present creative ideas that help clients grow revenue and strengthen their brands
  • Negotiate and close new business
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, programming, and leadership teams to bring campaigns to life
  • Become a respected business resource within the community

No two days look alike—and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

 

Who Thrives Here?

Our best Account Executives are naturally curious, highly competitive, resilient, and genuinely enjoy helping people succeed.
They don't see themselves as salespeople.
They see themselves as consultants, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Love building relationships
  • Enjoy winning new business
  • Are energized by goals and competition
  • Take pride in delivering exceptional client service
  • Want to continue learning in one of the fastest-changing industries in business
  • Believe your income should reflect your performance

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Confidence prospecting and developing new business opportunities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Uncapped earning potential with a competitive compensation plan
  • Comprehensive onboarding and industry-leading sales training
  • Continuous coaching from experienced local leadership
  • Career advancement opportunities within one of America's leading media companies
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop

 

More Than a Job. Build your future. Build your community. Build something extraordinary—with Townsquare Media Grand Rapids.

When you join Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you're joining a team that celebrates big wins, supports one another, embraces innovation, and believes local businesses deserve world-class marketing.
You'll help launch new ideas, work with recognizable brands, attend exciting community events, collaborate with talented teammates, and build a career where your effort directly impacts your success.
If you're looking for a place where your ambition is rewarded, your ideas matter, and no two days are ever the same, we'd love to talk.

job.title: Baseball Internships
job.description:
Position Overview

Are you passionate about sports and interested in gaining hands-on experience in the exciting world of professional baseball? The Durham Bulls Baseball Club is seeking enthusiastic, motivated, and hardworking interns to join our team.

As an intern with the Durham Bulls, you'll have the opportunity to experience the business side of Minor League Baseball while contributing to the day-to-day operations of one of the most recognized franchises in professional baseball.

Internship opportunities may be available in Marketing, Sales, Stadium Operations, Ticketing, and Retail. Interns will work alongside experienced professionals, develop valuable skills, and gain exposure to multiple aspects of the sports and entertainment industry.

Key Responsibilities

Depending on departmental assignment, responsibilities may include:

  • Marketing & Promotions: Assist with promotional campaigns, social media initiatives, community engagement, special events, and in-game entertainment.

  • Sales & Partnerships: Support ticket sales initiatives, corporate partnerships, sponsorship activation, customer outreach, and sales-related projects.

  • Stadium & Game Day Operations: Assist with stadium preparation, event coordination, game day logistics, guest services, and ensuring a positive fan experience.

  • Ticketing: Support box office operations, ticket sales, customer service, ticket distribution, and fan engagement initiatives.

  • Retail & Merchandise: Assist with team store operations, merchandise displays, inventory management, sales transactions, and customer service.

  • Collaborate with team members across departments to support organizational goals and special projects.

  • Represent the Durham Bulls professionally while interacting with fans, sponsors, community partners, and fellow employees.

  • Perform additional duties and participate in learning opportunities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a college or university, preferably pursuing a degree in Sports Management, Business, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or a related field.

  • Strong interest in professional sports, entertainment, or business operations.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

  • Strong customer service skills and attention to detail.

  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, particularly during the baseball season.

  • Previous experience in sports, retail, hospitality, sales, or customer service is a plus but not required.

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience working within a professional baseball organization.

  • Exposure to multiple areas of sports business and stadium operations.

  • Opportunities to network with experienced professionals in the sports and entertainment industry.

  • Development of practical skills in communication, teamwork, problem-solving, customer service, and business operations.

  • A behind-the-scenes look at what it takes to deliver an exceptional Minor League Baseball experience.

About the Durham Bulls

The Durham Bulls are the Triple-A affiliate of the Tampa Bay Rays and one of the most recognizable teams in Minor League Baseball. Playing at the iconic Durham Bulls Athletic Park in downtown Durham, North Carolina, the Bulls are known for their rich history, passionate fan base, and commitment to delivering outstanding entertainment and memorable experiences.

As part of Capitol Broadcasting Company, the Durham Bulls offer interns the opportunity to learn within a dynamic organization that values teamwork, innovation, community involvement, and professional development.


Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in the Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) program. However, completing the WOTC questionnaire is completely voluntary. Your decision will have absolutely no impact on your hiring chances, and your application WILL be accepted regardless of whether you choose to provide this information or not.

 

EEO Statement:

Capitol Broadcasting Company is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.


CBC Statement:

Capitol Broadcasting Company, Inc. is a diversified communications leader which owns and/or operates WRAL-TV, WRAZ-TV, WRAL News+ (WNGT-CD), WRAL-FM, WRAL-HD2, WCMC-FM, WCMC-HD1, WDNC-AM, WCMC-HD2, WCMC-HD3, WCMC-HD4, Microspace Communications, and Capitol B Creative in Raleigh, NC; WILM-TV, WILT-LD and Sunrise Broadcasting in Wilmington, NC; The Durham Bulls Baseball Club, Bull City Hospitality, and the Coastal Plain League in Durham, NC; The Holly Springs Salamanders in Holly Springs, NC; the Zebulon Devil Dogz in Zebulon, NC; the American Underground startup hub and workspace in Durham, NC; and real estate interests including the American Tobacco Historic District in Durham, NC, and Rocky Mount Mills in Rocky Mount, NC.

job.title: NewsNation News Internship Spring 2027 (Washington, DC)
job.description:
Are you a curious, passionate, energetic, and hardworking undergraduate or graduate student majoring in journalism or communications who is looking for a hands-on learning experience which will help you to further prepare you for an exciting career in journalism? job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.
  • 5+ years of people-management experience leading engineers, technicians, managers, project teams, vendors, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing live production environments where reliability, speed, operational discipline, and incident response are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, studio systems, production control rooms, intercom, audio, video, routing, replay, graphics, transmission, post-production, monitoring, and media asset workflows.
  • Working knowledge of IP media standards and systems, including SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022-6/7, PTP/IEEE 1588, NMOS IS-04/IS-05, AES67, Dante, multicast networking, QoS, and media-over-IP troubleshooting.
  • Experience with cloud, virtualization, digital media, or software-defined infrastructure, including hybrid workflows that connect broadcast operations with cloud production, streaming, OTT, FAST, remote production, or digital distribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with compute, storage, networking, cybersecurity, automation, orchestration, APIs, monitoring, observability, and DevOps-style support practices as they apply to media systems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical strategy, capital projects, budgets, vendor negotiations, RFPs, scopes of work, implementation plans, and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support live events, urgent technical issues, launches, maintenance windows, and business-critical operations.

Qualifications

  • Experience with ST 2110 facility design, IP fabric architecture, timing design, boundary clocks, grandmaster redundancy, multicast routing, and vendor interoperability testing.
  • Experience with media supply chain platforms, MAM/DAM systems, storage orchestration, transcoding, cloud-based playout, streaming workflows, and metadata-driven content operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational change, facility transformation, SDI-to-IP migration, cloud adoption, or major technology refresh initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted media workflows, automation, quality control, captioning, accessibility, rights-aware distribution, and digital content monetization platforms.

job.title: Manager, Soundtracks & Marketing
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Manager, Soundtracks & Marketing, Film Music supports integrated soundtrack, score, artist, social, publicity, awards, and event campaigns across the film slate. Working closely with the SVP, Soundtracks & Marketing, this role supports priority campaigns while independently leading select album, awards, and screening initiatives. The ideal candidate is creative, highly organized, collaborative, and able to manage multiple partners, deliverables, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Soundtrack Marketing & Publicity

  • Develop and manage marketing and publicity strategies for soundtracks, scores, singles, composers, and artists.
  • Partner with the SVP on major soundtrack campaigns while independently leading select releases from planning through execution.
  • Liaise with composers, artists, managers, labels, and internal and external marketing teams to establish rollout plans, timelines, key dates, approvals, and deliverables.
  • Create and distribute campaign strategies, release information, assets, and updates to domestic and international partners.
  • Coordinate major-label soundtrack and album campaigns with outside record labels and distribution partners.
  • Work with publicity teams to secure interviews, features, exclusives, and editorial opportunities for composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Prepare priorities and action items before and after executive meetings; create and distribute Back Lot Music press releases and campaign communications.
  • Develop and maintain strong music-industry relationships. DSP, editorial, and music-press contacts are a plus.

Social Media & Digital Marketing

  • Manage Back Lot Music social accounts, content calendars, release posts, and music distribution and smart-link destinations.
  • Coordinate copy, creative, timing, approvals, tagging, and collaborative posts with film accounts, artists, composers, labels, and partners.
  • Create, organize, and distribute social assets and identify catalog, anniversary, talent, and film-marketing moments that extend campaign reach.
  • Ensure messaging and creative remain consistent across social channels and partner campaigns.

Awards Strategy & Submissions

  • Support awards strategies for eligible scores, songs, soundtracks, composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Lead direct submissions, including the GRAMMY Awards, Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA), and Society of Composers & Lyricists (SCL) Awards.
  • Spearhead submission reels and supporting materials, including music assets, credits, and required documentation.
  • Manage awards accounts and profiles; track eligibility, categories, lists, deadlines, submissions, and status.
  • Coordinate with talent representatives, labels, internal awards and publicity teams, and other partners to ensure accurate, timely submissions and communicate action items.

Premieres, Screenings & Events

  • Manage quarterly music department screenings and composer or artist hosted screenings for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage invitations, guest lists, RSVPs, print requests, security, drive-ons, venue coordination, and guest accommodations.
  • Partner with events, publicity, security, and operations teams to execute screenings smoothly.
  • Staff premieres and support composers, songwriters, artists, and music partners throughout event and red-carpet activity.

Campaign & Project Management

  • Manage concurrent release, social, publicity, awards, and event workstreams from planning through completion.
  • Maintain campaign timelines, release calendars, asset and awards trackers, meeting follow-ups, and status updates.
  • Identify and resolve scheduling, asset, approval, eligibility, and communication issues; serve as a central point of contact across internal and external teams.
  • Track campaign activity and identify opportunities to improve collaboration, efficiency, reach, and engagement.
  • Experience in music or soundtrack marketing, record labels, artist or film marketing, entertainment publicity, awards, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of music release campaigns and how publicity, social, digital platforms, talent, labels, awards organizations, and film marketing work together.
  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines, detailed submissions, and time-sensitive materials.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, discretion, and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience managing social campaigns, content calendars, creative assets, and partner approvals.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior executives, talent representatives, artists, composers, labels, and outside partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for film, music, soundtracks, artists, and popular culture. DSP, music-media, or editorial relationships are a plus, but not required.

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $80,000 - $100,000 (bonus eligible).

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WUSA9, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Washington, DC, is seeking a Local Sales Manager. The Local Sales Manager (LSM) is responsible for growing market share and creating brand new TV/Digital business opportunities. The LSM manages and develops the Account Executives and Account Managers on the sales team and develops strategies to win over clients within the market. The LSM oversees performance and holds the team accountable for meeting individual goals and achieving collective objectives for both television and digital.  This position reports to the Director of Sales.  

Responsibilities: 

  • Recruit, retain, and effectively train ‘A’ sales and support talent for your team on how to sell TV and TEGNA’s large portfolio of digital products.  
  • Lead and develop a team of direct reports consisting of Account Executives, Account Managers and manage a handful of dotted-line reports.  
  • Supports sales staff with ride-along coaching, participating in client meetings, developing proposals, and other aspects of the full sales process.   
  • Identify market potential through lead generation and qualification.  
  • Develop a sales strategy for your team and everyone on the team to reach or exceed revenue goals for the station.  
  • Analyze each account to create and maximize ideal marketing executions for clients, and complete appropriate business activity reports and forecasts as required.  
  • Develop strong relationships with local clients, manage key local accounts with your team, and ensure top-shelf service is provided to all accounts.  
  • Review and adjust metrics to monitor sales/market share changes. 
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of large-scale sports sponsorships, including building budgets, developing go-to-market strategies, and developing key relationships to maximize revenue opportunities. 

 

Requirements: 

  • Minimum of 2 years of sales management experience 
  • Track record of successfully achieving or exceeding sales goals in the broadcast TV industry within fast-changing, dynamic environments, spanning all the facets of marketing solutions from linear TV to digital, including OTT.    
  • Established leadership skills and demonstrated ability to develop teams with elite sales and customer service skills.   
  • Strategic thinker and disciplined executor comfortable developing and making recommendations to senior management.  
  • Possess the ability to build inclusive and positive work culture to foster success for the sales team.   
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Wide Orbit Sales, Salesforce, Wide Orbit Traffic & Wide Orbit Analytics, ComScore, Matrix, Media Monitors, and qualitative data.  
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects effectively under deadline pressure.  
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.  
  • Ability to effectively solve problems.  
  • Strong presenter and communicator with internal and external customers and partners. 

 On-Target Earnings (OTE): Base salary of $130,000–$160,000 annually, plus target variable compensation, for total on-target earnings of $250,000–$275,000 annually. Actual earnings may vary based on performance.

Pay Range$130,000—$160,000 USD

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 


A little bit about our team:

The legal department is located at the corporate headquarters of Warner Music Group (“WMG”). The legal department supports WMG and its operating companies in all corporate legal matters, including information technology (IT), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), securities, compliance, employment, records management, litigation, digital and intellectual property.


Your role:

This position is a unique opportunity to be a generalist in the corporate legal department of a global entertainment company and participate in a range of corporate activities and practice areas, with a focus on corporate, IT and M&A matters. The Counsel will primarily support the corporate, IT and M&A areas and work on various corporate matters/contracts. 


Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the legal work on domestic and cross-border acquisitions, dispositions, mergers, and carve-outs, including share and asset deals, catalog and rights acquisitions, and acqui-hires.
  • Structure, negotiate, and document joint ventures, strategic partnerships, and commercial alliances, including JV agreements, shareholders' agreements, operating agreements, and related governance, exit, and deadlock provisions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to corporate development and business leaders on deal strategy, structuring, valuation-related terms, and negotiation positions.
  • Draft, review and negotiate various corporate agreements, including non-disclosure agreements, license agreements, facilities agreements, real estate leases and various vendor and services agreements.
  • Assist on corporate secretarial matters managing numerous domestic and global entities of the Company.
  • Work closely with members of the legal group and teams from across the company to support numerous projects, including researching and analyzing various legal issues.

About you: 

  • JD required from an accredited law school and admission in good standing to at least one U.S. state bar
  • 4-7 years of experience with a primary focus on corporate / M&A and at least several years in a major law firm.
  • Developed negotiation skills and experience.
  • Developed drafting skills (including, the ability to identify and cultivate creative solutions in areas with evolving legal guidance).
  • Ability to manage a variety of responsibilities and multi-task in a sometimes fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills.

Supervising Senior Producers are newsroom leaders who reinforce our culture of audience centricity, professional respect and journalistic excellence. This role, which reports to the Senior Editor of Audio Strategy, will work a Wednesday through Sunday schedule, with conventional business hours on weekdays, and a 7 a.m. start time on weekends.   • Ability to manage several projects concurrently

  • Excellent broadcast writing and editing skills

  • Experience working with and managing on-air talent

  • Fluency in audio editing, working in a variety of content management systems, and other broadcast and digital delivery systems

  • Experience leading breaking news coverage

  • Impeccable journalistic integrity and editorial judgment

This is a full-time role with an annual salary $103,500.00. New York Public Radio also offers excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance, vacation, personal and sick time as well as inclusive family leave.

job.title: Producer
job.description:
Producer, Radiolab

Radiolab, pioneer of narrative nonfiction podcasting, is seeking a full-time Producer to join the team. Radiolab producers take ideas from pitch to broadcast, participating in all parts of the production process. We’re seeking an ambitious, deep-thinking, deep-feeling journalist who is obsessed with great stories, eager to help our team tackle the big questions facing our world today. The Producer will spend much of their time deep in tape, sorting through vast amounts of audio, crafting the arc of the episode in ProTools, and building out the story. They will work closely with the editorial team, making new drafts of episodes. Sometimes the Producer will work on ideas they’ve pitched; oftentimes they’ll produce other team member’s work. The Producer will help craft the soundscape of the show.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Regularly produce episodes from pitch to broadcast with minimal support

  • Find, pitch more ambitious, nuanced, and successful story ideas

  • Develop the arc of an episodes and craft narratives, with minimal editorial support

  • Executing notes from editors on new drafts of episodes

  • Cut interview selects and tracking tape

  • Source archival tape

  • Research for story ideas, booking guests, arranging logistics (ie ISDN, travel)

  • Pre-interview, book potential guests, engineer in-studio interviews and tracking

  • Perform field reporting and/or recording

  • Conceive of storyboards with the team

  • Write narration and craft the sound design/soundscape of episodes.

  • Create new drafts of episodes in ProTools, experimenting relentlessly with story construction

  • Liaise with fact checker for episodes

  • Write and produce content for web, newsletter, and other platforms as needed


Key Qualifications:

  • At least five years experience producing, reporting and/or editing in long-form narrative audio, and/or comparable experience in a related field

  • Preferably has experience creating stories similar to the ones heard on Radiolab

  • Has a clear grasp of what makes a surprising, impactful and complicated story that could be heard on Radiolab

  • Has a proven ability to develop story arc and narrative

  • Has solid journalism skills including: interviewing, database research and fact checking

  • Has experience with linear editing software (ProTools, Logic, et cetera), and an advanced understanding of sound design

  • Sense of humor and musicality are a plus

It's important on the Radiolab team for everyone to work hard, be willing to pitch in on whatever is needed to get the job done, have an open mind, demonstrate integrity in their journalism, be wildly curious, and not be afraid to be a little bit weird.


Additional Information


This is a full-time non-exempt position with a salary range of $87,771-$95,000 and includes eligibility for medical, dental and vision insurance through SAG-AFTRA.

This role is based in New York City and is expected to work at our NYC Headquarters two days per week.

This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement between New York Public Radio and SAG-AFTRA.


Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion


New York Public Radio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We continuously strive to place our employees at the center of our thinking and elevate inclusive practices to develop and support a more engaged and productive workforce. Our journalism and operations in the service of that journalism benefit from a broad range of perspectives, from all backgrounds, at all levels of the organization. Diversity is essential to honest, authentic, accurate storytelling and reportage; creating an institution in which all voices are encouraged, valued, and heard.

New York Public Radio is an equal opportunity employer committed to achieving the goal of equal employment opportunity for all. Applicants and employees are considered and evaluated for positions without regard to mental or physical disability, race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, citizenship status, age, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, employment status or any protected federal, state or local status unrelated to the performance of the work involved.


About Radiolab:


Created in 2002 by host Jad Abumrad, and now co-hosted by Lulu Miller and Latif Nasser, Radiolab began as an exploration of science, philosophy, and ethics using innovative composition and sound design. Radiolab has expanded and evolved to become a platform for long-form journalism and storytelling. The show challenges its listeners’ preconceived notions about how the world works. Radiolab provokes, it moves, it delights, and it asks its audience to see the world around them anew.

In the past year, the show released a series on a Guantanamo Bay detainee named Latif Nasser; covered the pandemic (by looking at the present and the past); composed an experimental non-narrative meditation on the end of the world; reported out topical stories on the power of protest (here and here, too), the risk of Donald Trump trying to steal the election, the responsibilities of the police (and lack thereof); and escaped to the bottom of the sea to spend time with an octomom.

Since its founding nearly two decades ago, Radiolab has won some of the most prestigious awards in journalism, including two George Foster Peabody Awards, Third Coast awards, The Silver Gavel, as well as other accolades. In 2011 Abumrad received the MacArthur Genius grant. The show has spawned successful spinoff series, like More Perfect, Gonads, The Other Latif, G, Border Trilogy, and Radiolab for Kids.

job.title: News/Sports Reporter
job.description:
WDAY, the number #1 station located in the Fargo, ND-Moorhead, MN metro area, broadcasts across the entire state of North Dakota, Western Minnesota, and Eastern South Dakota. WDAY is an award-winning station, taking home multiple Emmy awards as well as regional and national Edward R Murrow awards in recent years. They produce more live, local sports coverage than anyone in the region, and are the proud home of North Dakota State University Athletics and North Dakota High School Activities State Tournaments. WDAY is part of Forum Communications Company, a 5th-generation family-owned media company, and produces over 40 hours of local news, weather, and sports content each week, making them the most watched news station in the state of North Dakota and Western Minnesota.


Job Summary

As a News/Sports MMJ, you’ll cover the stories that matter to our community, from breaking news and major events to local sports. You’ll develop story ideas, conduct interviews, write scripts, shoot video and edit compelling stories for our newscasts and digital platforms. You’ll also report live from the field and have opportunities to develop your anchoring skills and fill in on both news and sports broadcasts.


Essential Functions

  • Research, investigate, and report on assigned topics, events, and issues of public interest
  • Develop story ideas, evaluate news leads/tips, and determine appropriate angles and story focus
  • Gather, verify, and analyze information from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and credibility
  • Conduct interviews with a wide range of sources, including officials, experts, and community members
  • Write clear, concise, and compelling scripts and stories that align with broadcast style, tone, and formatting standards
  • Produce and deliver content for live and recorded broadcasts, including stand-ups and field reporting
  • Collaborate with producers, photographers, and others to create engaging visual and audio elements that enhance storytelling
  • Respond quickly and effectively to breaking news, delivering accurate information under tight deadlines
  • Maintain a strong on-air presence and communicate information in a confident, professional manner
  • Utilize digital platforms and social media to share news content and engage with audiences in real time
  • Ensure all reporting adheres to journalistic ethics, standards, and legal guidelines
  • Stay informed on current events, industry trends, and community issues to inform coverage decisions
  • Build and maintain a network of reliable sources to support ongoing and future reporting
  • Represent the station professionally at community events and in public interactions
  • Drive audience engagement and loyalty by producing timely, relevant, and impactful content
  • Embrace a creative, collaborative approach with other team members and with other FCC departments and locations.
  • Maintain prompt and reliable attendance.


Non-Essential Duties and Functions

  • Perform additional duties as assigned.


We’re looking for someone with strong writing, communication and organizational skills who is eager to learn,

collaborate and deliver impactful journalism. A college degree in journalism or a related field is preferred, but

we’re willing to train the right candidate who brings the right attitude, curiosity and work ethic.

Join a newsroom that values strong journalism, teamwork and professional development while continuing to

expand its local news, weather and sports coverage.



Why WDAY?

  • A collaborative newsroom: Work alongside a great mix of experienced journalists and emerging
  • professionals. We’re committed to helping our team members sharpen their skills, take on new
  • challenges to reach their professional goals
  • A proven path for career growth: WDAY has a strong track record of developing talented journalists
  • who have gone on to advance their careers in Top 20 television markets across the country.
  • Time to recharge: Generous PTO and holiday benefits, with up to 23 paid days off in your first year.
  • Competitive benefits: Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, plus a 401(k) plan.
  • Onsite workout room: Convenient fitness facilities available to employees.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Mass Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant work experience will be considered
  • Prior experience in broadcast journalism, reporting, or multimedia content creation preferred (internships and student media acceptable)
  • Strong news judgment with the ability to identify compelling stories and prioritize coverage based on urgency and audience impact
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clearly, accurately, and concisely under deadline pressure, and while managing multiple assignments
  • Experience using digital analytics tools and social media platforms to inform and engage audiences preferred
  • Ability to shoot, edit, or collaborate effectively on video production is a plus
  • Comfortable delivering live reports and appearing on camera with professionalism and confidence
  • Strong research, interviewing, and fact-checking skills with a commitment to accuracy and fairness and excellent attention to detail
  • Willingness and flexibility to work varied schedules, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as news coverage requires
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license and a driving record that is insurable by the company.
  • Must carry an acceptable level of vehicle insurance as required by the company.


Expected compensation for this role is between $18.26 - $19.23.hr, based on qualifications and experience.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

Forum Communications Company is a family-owned media and technology leader with more than a century of delivering trusted, quality journalism and innovative business solutions. Storytelling is at the heart of who we are, but today, we’re so much more than a newspaper. As one of the Upper Midwest’s leading media organizations, we’re driving the future across print and digital news, sports streaming, technology, broadcasting, commercial printing, and full-service agency advertising.

  • Retirement benefits with company match
  • Generous PTO and paid volunteer hours

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. job.title: North Dakota Energy and Government Reporter
job.description:
Full-time

Forum Communications Company is seeking a multimedia reporter to cover the oil and energy industry and its far-reaching impact on North Dakota. Ideally based in Bismarck, this reporter will produce timely, authoritative stories about one of the state’s most consequential industries while traveling as needed to the Bakken and communities across western North Dakota. The reporter will explore how energy development shapes the state’s economy, government, land, infrastructure, workforce and people. The position will also contribute general news coverage from Bismarck for the FCC network, with a focus on state government and legislative developments during active legislative sessions.

This is a multimedia position serving Forum Communications audiences across digital, print and broadcast platforms. In addition to written reporting, the reporter will gather video and other visual content.

The ideal candidate can translate complex subjects into clear, compelling journalism while building strong relationships with industry leaders, public officials, landowners, workers, tribal communities and local residents. Experience covering the energy industry or state government is valuable but not required. We are also interested in candidates who are curious, resourceful and eager to develop expertise in a complex and nationally important beat.


Key Responsibilities

  • Cover North Dakota’s oil and gas industry, including production, exploration, transportation, refining and emerging technologies.
  • Travel regularly throughout western North Dakota to report from energy sites, communities, public meetings and breaking-news scenes.
  • Monitor state and federal energy policy, regulation, taxation and legislation, explaining how decisions affect the industry and North Dakota residents.
  • Contribute general Bismarck news coverage for Forum Communications audiences across the state and region.
  • Provide additional coverage of the Legislature during legislative sessions, including significant bills, debates and decisions beyond the energy beat.
  • Report on the economic impact of energy development, including state revenue, local government finances, employment, housing and business growth.
  • Examine environmental and land-use issues such as water use, spills, emissions, reclamation, pipeline development and abandoned wells.
  • Tell the stories of the people and communities affected by the energy industry, including workers, families, landowners, tribal nations and longtime western North Dakota residents.
  • Cover breaking news involving industrial accidents, spills, regulatory actions and significant business or government developments.
  • Develop enterprise and accountability reporting that goes beyond announcements and news releases.
  • Use public records, data and other reporting tools to identify trends and hold companies and public institutions accountable.
  • Build a diverse network of sources across industry, government, environmental organizations, academia, tribal nations and local communities.
  • Produce journalism in multiple formats, including written stories, photography, social video and broadcast-quality video; may include appearing on camera when appropriate.
  • Use audience data and community feedback to identify coverage opportunities and strengthen engagement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Previous reporting experience, preferably covering business, government, energy, agriculture, the environment or rural communities.
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to balance daily reporting, breaking news and deeper enterprise work.
  • Ability to explain technical, regulatory, legislative and financial topics in accessible language.
  • Experience using public records and data in reporting.
  • Strong interviewing, writing and storytelling skills.
  • Experience producing video journalism or a willingness to develop skills in shooting, editing and reporting for digital and television audiences.
  • Comfort appearing on camera and delivering live or recorded reports.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative, regional newsroom.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout western North Dakota, sometimes on short notice.
  • A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

Expected compensation for this role is between $60,000 - $70,000, based on qualifications and experience.

job.title: Anchor/Multimedia Journalist - Spectrum News NECN
job.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

Are you looking for an opportunity to gain journalistic experience in both the newsroom and the field? Do you want to pitch stories, deliver newscasts, and connect with your local community? Apply to be an Anchor/Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) at Spectrum News NECN.

 

Spectrum News NECN covers MA, NH, ME, VT, RI, and CT. We use innovative journalistic approaches, backed by comprehensive research, to engage and inform viewers on the most essential news, issues, and events taking place in their communities. 

 

Beyond TV news distribution, our newsrooms publish via the Spectrum News app and connected television. We’re committed to providing viewers with 24-hour news—no matter how, when, and where they want it. Check out all the ways we share news on the Spectrum News Mobile App. 


As an Anchor/MMJ, you’ll build a vital connection between a story and your audience. From pitching stories to delivering engaging newscasts, your responsibilities will encompass all aspects of reporting and anchoring. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that creates compelling, timely, accurate, character-driven content to connect with viewers across traditional and digital platforms.

 

WHAT OUR ANCHOR/MULTIMEDIA JOURNALISTS ENJOY MOST

  • Striking a balance between reporting and anchoring
  • Going into the field to discover original stories and delivering news in-studio
  • Telling character-driven stories that resonate with local communities
  • Working across platforms including TV news, connected television, and digital news

 

As a part of Spectrum News NECN, you’re creative, highly technical, and ready to bring your community’s stories to life in our newsroom. You value accuracy and want to leverage your curiosity and storytelling abilities to share inspiring news across multiple platforms. Each day is fast paced in a constantly evolving work environment with new stories to tell and perspectives to uncover. If you’re a nimble, passionate team player, you’ll find a home on our team.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO SPECTRUM NEWS NECN

 

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Television news anchoring - 3+ years, Television news reporting - 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or related field; or comparable television work experience
  • Technical Skills: Video editing, still photography, social media marketing
  • Skills: Reporting and anchoring
  • Abilities: Managing multiple priorities effectively, lifting and carrying up to 30 pounds
  • Travel Ability: Must be open to travel to discover the important stories in your neighborhood and willing to interact with the community
  • Schedule: Work different shifts or longer shifts due to 'breaking news' and severe weather emergencies and able to work weekends and holidays
  • Valid driver's license for authorized driving in the state of residence

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a 24-hour news channel

 

Working Conditions

  • Works inside in a climate-controlled environment but may be assigned to field duties and be subjected to various weather conditions that could include extreme heat or cold conditions.

BE PART OF THE CONNECTION

 

As a Senior Producer, you'll play a crucial role in the newsroom by making editorial decisions, fact-checking scripts, and creating show rundowns. You will use data to inform these decisions and determine the news stories that will air each day. Along with your editorial duties, you will serve as the heart of the newsroom - leadership, inspiration, and feedback will be important aspects of your role.

 

WHAT OUR SENIOR PRODUCERS ENJOY MOST  

  • Developing strong leadership and management skills
  • Reading, writing, and copyediting scripts
  • Making data-informed decisions
  • Initiating and controlling plans for breaking news

 

As a part of Spectrum Noticias, you’re creative, highly technical, and ready to bring your community’s stories to life in our newsroom. You value accuracy and want to leverage your curiosity and storytelling abilities to share inspiring news across multiple platforms. Do you have an eye for detail? Are you looking to kickstart your journalism career in a 24/7 newsroom? Apply to be an Associate Producer at Spectrum News.

  

Part of Charter Communications, Spectrum News is made up of over 30 hyper-local news and regional sports networks that are constantly expanding and dedicated to producing original, unbiased, and high-quality content. We use innovative journalistic approaches, backed by comprehensive research, to engage and inform viewers on the most essential news, issues, and events taking place in their communities. 

 

Beyond TV news distribution, our newsrooms publish via the Spectrum News app and connected television. We’re committed to providing viewers with 24-hour news—no matter how, when and where they want it. Check out all the ways we share news on the Spectrum News Mobile App.


BE PART OF THE CONNECTION

As an Associate Producer, you will collaborate with producers in the newsroom to craft compelling stories. Your creativity and upbeat attitude will be essential as you tackle sensitive topics and tell character-driven stories. Alongside the team, you’ll represent what’s happening in your community and connect audiences with the stories that matter.

 

WHAT OUR ASSOCIATE PRODUCERS ENJOY MOST

  • Transforming stories from a simple pitch into a hit that inspires and delights viewers
  • Working with colleagues in a collaborative environment
  • Connecting with neighbors as you dig into the issues that matter to your local community
  • Telling stories across platforms including TV, connected television, and digital

 

As a part of Spectrum News, you’re creative, highly technical, and ready to bring your community’s stories to life in our newsroom. You value accuracy and want to leverage your curiosity and storytelling abilities to share inspiring news across multiple platforms. Each day is fast paced in a constantly evolving work environment with new stories to tell and perspectives to uncover. If you’re a nimble, passionate team player, you’ll find a home on our team.

job.title: Agente de Suporte
job.description:
Você deseja desenvolver sua carreira como Analista de Suporte - TI em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia, que promove integração e crescimento para seus clientes? Junte-se a nós!


Job Description


Como Agente de Suporte (Suporte Técnico T.I), você estará na linha de frente, auxiliando nossa base de clientes com rapidez e eficiência, garantindo a melhor experiência possível.

Key Responsibilities

Você atuará com as Soluções Domínio, uma suíte de sistemas integrados que oferece gestão, eficiência e segurança para profissionais do segmento contábil. Suas responsabilidades serão:


  • Prestar suporte técnico aos usuários em acesso ao sistema, atualizações, instalação, configuração, certificados digitais, impressoras e utilitários, garantindo o funcionamento adequado das soluções.
  • Comunicar informações ao cliente com clareza e assertividade.
  • Conduzir o atendimento com eficiência, buscando a resolução rápida dos problemas.
  • Conhecer a jornada do cliente e os caminhos indicados para cada necessidade.
  • Encaminhar solicitações de alterações e correções dos produtos às equipes responsáveis.
  • Praticar e promover os valores e comportamentos da organização.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre a evolução das soluções e a legislação vigente da área.

Required Qualifications


Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as Habilidades & Experiência:

 

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Informática ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência ou interesse comprovado em atendimento e suporte técnico.
  • Boa capacidade de raciocínio lógico e comunicação clara para explicar soluções a diferentes públicos.
  • Facilidade em trabalhar com metas e em se adaptar a processos de trabalho.
  • Facilidade em lidar com pessoas e em trabalhar em equipe. 

Preferred Qualifications


  • Vivência com o software Domínio.
  • Conhecimento em SQL.
  • Experiência prévia em suporte ao cliente ou help desk.

#LI-GG1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).

Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Sales Executive in the Small Law Channel is responsible for retaining and growing their existing account base and acquiring new accounts within their area of responsibility. The territory consists primarily of an existing client base of approximately 800 accounts in 1-10 attorney size firms. This position is field based, requiring excellent face to face, telephone and writing skills. To be successful in this role, you will draw on your high level of initiative and ability to apply strong business acumen to conduct a thorough needs analysis within your accounts. You'll possess the ability to develop trust, demonstrate your credibility with all account stakeholders through your knowledge of Thomson Reuters’ products, and services and acquired knowledge of the legal industry.

job.title: Cyber Security Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE TEAM

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineering team deploys and manages enterprise SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, and related integrations. It partners with Security Operations and IT teams to maintain effective detection, response, resilience, and security-control coverage.


THE ROLE

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineer 3 is the highest non-lead individual contributor in the solutions engineering team. This role provides advanced technical ownership across one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, architects complex integrations and automation, leads high-severity technical response and major change, establishes engineering standards, and develops the capability of lower-level engineers.


The engineer must be able to become effective quickly in a complex environment and serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing response across critical platforms and ensuring timely escalation. The position operates with broad technical discretion.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Act as technical owner and subject-matter expert for one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, defining reference configurations, lifecycle standards, resilience patterns, capacity requirements, recovery objectives, and measurable service outcomes.
  • Serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing cross-platform triage and response, assigning technical actions, making time-sensitive decisions within delegated authority, and escalating material risk promptly.
  • Architect and deliver complex multi-platform integrations, telemetry and data pipelines, orchestration and automation frameworks, and connections to cloud, identity, endpoint, network, IT service-management, and enterprise data services.
  • Serve as the final internal escalation point before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer or vendor product engineering for systemic failures, scale and performance issues, data-quality defects, high-availability problems, and cross-platform dependencies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and problem remediation for recurring or high-impact failures, ensuring corrective actions address technical, process, monitoring, documentation, and resilience gaps
  • Lead the security engineering workstream during high-severity incidents and readiness exercises, coordinating specialized analysis, emergency tool changes, containment execution, telemetry validation, recovery, and after-action improvement.
  • Define tuning, query, content, detection-support, vulnerability-scan, and telemetry-quality strategies in partnership with Security Operations and control owners; establish measures that demonstrate improvement
  • Lead major upgrades, migrations, platform consolidations, architecture changes, and new capability implementations; own technical design, dependency analysis, risk assessment, test strategy, rollback, readiness, and operational handover.
  • Build and govern reusable automation frameworks and deployment tooling, including code standards, peer review, secrets handling, testing, observability, failure recovery, and maintainability expectations.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead proofs of concept, comparative testing, technical due diligence, and recommendation development; provide evidence for the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer's roadmap.
  • Establish engineering standards for configuration validation, documentation, change quality, disaster recovery, access control, auditability, and operational support across the role family.
  • Use service, risk, coverage, performance, and incident data to identify systemic gaps, develop technical and business cases, and present prioritized recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor Levels 1 and 2, delegate project tasks, assess technical quality, and provide development feedback without assuming formal performance-management authority.
  • Represent Cyber Security Solutions Engineering in architecture, governance, audit, major project, and vendor forums; translate business and control requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Partner with the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer on roadmap planning, capacity, vendor performance, and operating-model improvement.

Level Scope and Accountability

  • Autonomy: Operates with broad technical discretion and without routine supervision within approved strategy, architecture principles, policy, and governance.
  • Technical scope: Critical platform ecosystems, complex cross-platform dependencies, enterprise integrations, and high-risk engineering change.
  • Decision authority: Sets technical methods and standards within delegated scope, approves complex designs and changes, and directs technical response. Escalates policy exceptions, risk acceptance, budget, resource conflicts, and final roadmap decisions.
  • Escalation: Final internal technical escalation before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer, vendor product engineering, architecture governance, or executive risk channels.
  • Leadership: Leads major technical workstreams, design reviews, and capability development. No direct reports, compensation decisions, performance reviews, hiring authority, budget ownership, or final portfolio prioritization.
  • Core-hours accountability: Serves as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing complex response across critical platform ecosystems and ensuring timely escalation of material risk.

 


WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • At least 8 years of direct, hands-on professional or military cybersecurity engineering experience, including at least 3 years serving as a senior technical owner, subject-matter expert, or escalation point for enterprise security platforms in complex environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in multiple security technology domains such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, security orchestration, or comparable platforms, with deep expertise in at least one domain.
  • Deep administration and troubleshooting capability across Linux/Unix, Windows, TCP/IP networking, DNS, PKI and certificates, authentication, APIs, virtualization, public cloud, load balancing, clustering, and high-availability design.
  • Advanced scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or comparable languages, including production coding practices, testing, version control, logging, error handling, and secure secrets management
  • Demonstrated success architecting complex integrations, leading major upgrades or migrations, and resolving systemic or high-impact platform failures
  • Experience leading technical response during significant security incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and driving sustained corrective action.
  • Working knowledge of security and control frameworks and statutory/regulatory mandates such as NIST and ISO 27001, GDPR and CCPA, including the ability to translate control requirements into technical standards and auditable evidence.
  • Strong technical leadership, design-review, mentoring, vendor-management, and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Type A personality and work style: an exceptionally self-directed, decisive, and results-oriented technical leader who acts with disciplined urgency, maintains exacting standards, owns complex outcomes, and drives sustained resolution while remaining measured, collaborative, and risk-aware.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CISSP, CISM, GIAC GCIA or GCIH, advanced cloud security, architecture, or vendor-specific engineering certification.
  • Experience with large-scale data pipelines, orchestration platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, configuration management, or security-content engineering.
  • Experience supporting globally distributed environments, high-volume event platforms, or services with strict availability and response requirements

These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.
